import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

test.describe("Authentication Flow", () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
  });

  test("WEB-01: Login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "admin@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');

    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });
  });

  test("WEB-02: Login with invalid credentials shows error", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "invalid@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "wrongpassword");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');

    await expect(page.locator("text=Invalid credentials")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
  });

  test("WEB-03: Token refresh on 401", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/dashboard");
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/, { timeout: 5000 });

    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "admin@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');

    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });
  });

  test("WEB-04: Logout clears tokens and redirects to login", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "admin@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });

    await page.click('button:has-text("Logout")');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/, { timeout: 5000 });

    const token = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem("access_token"));
    expect(token).toBeNull();
  });
});

test.describe("Token Handling", () => {
  test("401 response triggers token refresh", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "admin@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });

    await page.evaluate(() => {
      localStorage.setItem("access_token", "invalid-token");
    });

    await page.reload();
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  });

  test("Failed refresh redirects to login", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      localStorage.setItem("access_token", "expired-token");
      localStorage.setItem("refresh_token", "invalid-refresh");
    });

    await page.goto("/dashboard");
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/, { timeout: 5000 });
  });
});

import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

test.describe("Borrow Flow", () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "patron@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');
    await page.waitForURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });
  });

  test("WEB-16: Navigate to borrow page", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/borrow");
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  });

  test("WEB-17: Borrow success shows confirmation", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/borrow");
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    const barcodeInput = page.locator('input[placeholder*="barcode"], input[placeholder*="mã vạch"]');
    if (await barcodeInput.isVisible({ timeout: 3000 })) {
      await barcodeInput.fill("TEST-BOOK-001");
    }
  });

  test("WEB-18: Borrow fails when patron outside library", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route(
      /\/api\/patrons\/me/,
      async (route) => {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            id: "test-patron",
            current_status: "outside",
            full_name: "Test Patron",
          }),
        });
      }
    );

    await page.goto("/borrow");
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  });

  test("WEB-19: Borrow shows book info after scan", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/borrow");
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  });
});

import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

test.describe("Gate/Kiosk Flow", () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "admin@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');
    await page.waitForURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });
  });

  test("WEB-05: Navigate to gate page", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/gate");
    await expect(page.locator("text=Cổng")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
  });

  test("WEB-06: Gate page shows entry/exit camera feeds", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/gate");
    await expect(page.locator("text=Cổng vào")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
    await expect(page.locator("text=Cổng ra")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
  });

  test("WEB-07: Enter MSSV and lookup patron", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/gate");
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

    const mssvInput = page.locator('input[placeholder*="MSSV"]');
    if (await mssvInput.isVisible()) {
      await mssvInput.fill("TEST001");
      await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    }
  });

  test("WEB-08: Gate page shows today's entry/exit counts", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/gate");
    await expect(page.locator("text=Vào hôm nay")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
    await expect(page.locator("text=Ra hôm nay")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
  });

  test("WEB-09: SSE connection for real-time events", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/gate");
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  });
});

test.describe("Kiosk Self-Service Flow", () => {
  test("WEB-10: Kiosk lookup with invalid student code", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/kiosk/enroll");
    const input = page.locator('input[name="student_code"]');
    if (await input.isVisible({ timeout: 3000 })) {
      await input.fill("NONEXISTENT");
      await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
      await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
    }
  });
});

import { test, expect, Page } from "@playwright/test";

test.describe("JobPoll Component", () => {
  test("WEB-11: JobPoll shows pending state with spinner", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.fill('input[name="email"]', "admin@example.com");
    await page.fill('input[name="password"]', "password123");
    await page.click('button[type="submit"]');
    await page.waitForURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 10000 });

    await page.goto("/enroll");
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  });

  test("WEB-12: JobPoll displays SUCCESS with result info", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route(
      /\/api\/tasks\/mock-success*/,
      async (route) => {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            task_id: "mock-success-task",
            status: "SUCCESS",
            result: { status: "success", is_live: true, score: 0.95 },
          }),
        });
      }
    );
  });

  test("WEB-13: JobPoll displays FAILURE with error message", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route(
      /\/api\/tasks\/mock-failure*/,
      async (route) => {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            task_id: "mock-failure-task",
            status: "FAILURE",
            result: { error: "NO_FACE_DETECTED", type: "task_failure" },
          }),
        });
      }
    );
  });

  test("WEB-14: Task polling transitions from PENDING to SUCCESS", async ({ page }) => {
    let callCount = 0;
    await page.route(
      /\/api\/tasks\/poll-task*/,
      async (route) => {
        callCount++;
        if (callCount === 1) {
          await route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({
              task_id: "poll-task-id",
              status: "PENDING",
              result: null,
            }),
          });
        } else {
          await route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({
              task_id: "poll-task-id",
              status: "SUCCESS",
              result: { is_live: true, score: 0.95 },
            }),
          });
        }
      }
    );

    await page.goto("/enroll");
    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
  });

  test("WEB-15: JobPoll handles NULL confidence (edge case)", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route(
      /\/api\/tasks\/null-confidence*/,
      async (route) => {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            task_id: "null-confidence-task",
            status: "SUCCESS",
            result: { is_live: null, score: 0 },
          }),
        });
      }
    );
  });
});

File: src/__tests__/books/BarcodeRangeList.test.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { BarcodeRangeList } from '@/app/(dashboard)/_components/books/BarcodeRangeList';

describe('BarcodeRangeList', () => {
  it('renders a dash when barcodes array is empty', () => {
    render(<BarcodeRangeList barcodes={[]} />);
    expect(screen.getByText('-')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('renders single barcode directly without chip or expander', () => {
    render(<BarcodeRangeList barcodes={['LIB-9780132350884-001']} />);
    expect(screen.getByText('LIB-9780132350884-001')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/mã/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('renders contiguous range with range arrow and count chip', () => {
    const barcodes = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => `LIB-9780132350884-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`);
    render(<BarcodeRangeList barcodes={barcodes} />);

    // Should show range format: LIB-9780132350884-001 → 015
    expect(screen.getByText(/LIB-9780132350884-001\s*→\s*015/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Should show chip with count
    expect(screen.getByText('15 mã')).toBeInTheDocument();

    // Expanded list is not visible initially
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('barcode-expanded-list')).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    // Click chip or expand button to expand
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('15 mã'));

    // Now all barcodes should be visible
    expect(screen.getByTestId('barcode-expanded-list')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('LIB-9780132350884-008')).toBeInTheDocument();

    // Click again to collapse
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('15 mã'));
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('barcode-expanded-list')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('handles non-contiguous barcodes gracefully with count chip and expand', () => {
    const barcodes = ['LIB-9780132350884-001', 'LIB-9780132350884-005', 'LIB-9780132350884-010'];
    render(<BarcodeRangeList barcodes={barcodes} />);

    expect(screen.getByText('3 mã')).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('3 mã'));
    expect(screen.getByText('LIB-9780132350884-005')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

    });
  });
});

================
File: src/app/_components/landing/TechLibraryBackground.tsx
================
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Box, useTheme } from "@mui/material";

interface Particle {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  radius: number;
  baseAlpha: number;
  color: string;
}

export default function TechLibraryBackground() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    let animationFrameId: number;
    let width = (canvas.width = window.innerWidth);
    let height = (canvas.height = window.innerHeight);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!canvas) return;
      width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);

    // Mouse tracking for interactive knowledge nodes
    const mouse = {
      x: -1000,
      y: -1000,
      radius: 160,
    };

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      mouse.x = e.clientX;
      mouse.y = e.clientY;
    };

    const handleMouseLeave = () => {
      mouse.x = -1000;
      mouse.y = -1000;
    };

    window.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener("mouseleave", handleMouseLeave);

    // Palette: IUH Navy, Cyber Cyan, Golden Amber, Crisp White
    const palette = isDark
      ? ["#38BDF8", "#818CF8", "#F59E0B", "#60A5FA", "#E2E8F0"]
      : ["#1E6091", "#0284C7", "#D97706", "#2563EB", "#0A2540"];

    // Initialize particles
    const particleCount = Math.min(Math.floor((width * height) / 18000), 75);
    const particles: Particle[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * width,
        y: Math.random() * height,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
        radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1.2,
        baseAlpha: Math.random() * 0.45 + 0.25,
        color: palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)],
      });
    }

    const render = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Draw subtle connections between close nodes
      const maxDistance = 130;
      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
          const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
          const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

          if (dist < maxDistance) {
            const alpha = (1 - dist / maxDistance) * (isDark ? 0.22 : 0.14);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            ctx.strokeStyle = isDark
              ? `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${alpha})`
              : `rgba(30, 96, 145, ${alpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }

      // Update and draw particles
      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        const p = particles[i];

        // Move
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;

        // Bounce off edges
        if (p.x < 0 || p.x > width) p.vx *= -1;
        if (p.y < 0 || p.y > height) p.vy *= -1;

        // Mouse interaction (gentle attraction / highlight)
        const dx = mouse.x - p.x;
        const dy = mouse.y - p.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        let currentAlpha = p.baseAlpha;
        let currentRadius = p.radius;

        if (dist < mouse.radius) {
          const factor = (1 - dist / mouse.radius);
          currentAlpha = Math.min(1, p.baseAlpha + factor * 0.5);
          currentRadius = p.radius + factor * 1.5;

          // Connect to mouse
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
          ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = isDark
            ? `rgba(245, 158, 11, ${factor * 0.35})`
            : `rgba(217, 119, 6, ${factor * 0.25})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Draw particle node
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, currentRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.globalAlpha = currentAlpha;
        ctx.fill();

        // Glow ring around nodes
        if (p.radius > 2) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, currentRadius * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
          ctx.globalAlpha = currentAlpha * 0.25;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };

    render();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      window.removeEventListener("mousemove", handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener("mouseleave", handleMouseLeave);
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
    };
  }, [isDark]);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        overflow: "hidden",
        pointerEvents: "none",
        zIndex: 0,
        bgcolor: isDark ? "#071321" : "#F4F7FB",
        transition: "background-color 0.4s ease",
      }}
    >
      {/* ── 1. Animated Gradient Mesh Blobs ──────────────────────────────── */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: "absolute",
          top: "-15%",
          right: "-10%",
          width: { xs: "380px", md: "650px" },
          height: { xs: "380px", md: "650px" },
          borderRadius: "50%",
          background: isDark
            ? "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.22) 0%, rgba(30, 96, 145, 0.08) 50%, transparent 75%)"
            : "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(30, 96, 145, 0.16) 0%, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.08) 50%, transparent 75%)",
          filter: "blur(60px)",
          animation: "meshFloat1 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate",
        }}
      />

      <Box
        sx={{
          position: "absolute",
          top: "30%",
          left: "-12%",
          width: { xs: "320px", md: "580px" },
          height: { xs: "320px", md: "580px" },
          borderRadius: "50%",
          background: isDark
            ? "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.18) 0%, rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.06) 50%, transparent 75%)"
            : "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.12) 0%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05) 50%, transparent 75%)",
          filter: "blur(70px)",
          animation: "meshFloat2 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate",
        }}
      />

      <Box
        sx={{
          position: "absolute",
          bottom: "-10%",
          right: "20%",
          width: { xs: "350px", md: "600px" },
          height: { xs: "350px", md: "600px" },
          borderRadius: "50%",
          background: isDark
            ? "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2) 0%, rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.1) 50%, transparent 75%)"
            : "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.12) 0%, rgba(30, 96, 145, 0.06) 50%, transparent 75%)",
          filter: "blur(80px)",

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import Box from "@mui/material/Box";
import Chip from "@mui/material/Chip";
import Typography from "@mui/material/Typography";
import Collapse from "@mui/material/Collapse";

interface BarcodeRangeListProps {
  barcodes?: string[];
}

function parseBarcodeSequence(barcodes: string[]) {
  if (!barcodes || barcodes.length === 0) return null;
  if (barcodes.length === 1) return { single: barcodes[0] };

  const matchFirst = barcodes[0].match(/^(.*-)(\d+)$/);
  const matchLast = barcodes[barcodes.length - 1].match(/^(.*-)(\d+)$/);

  if (matchFirst && matchLast && matchFirst[1] === matchLast[1]) {
    const prefix = matchFirst[1];
    const firstSeq = parseInt(matchFirst[2], 10);
    const lastSeq = parseInt(matchLast[2], 10);

    // Check if contiguous
    let isContiguous = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < barcodes.length; i++) {
      const m = barcodes[i].match(/^(.*-)(\d+)$/);
      if (!m || m[1] !== prefix || parseInt(m[2], 10) !== firstSeq + i) {
        isContiguous = false;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (isContiguous) {
      return {
        isContiguous: true,
        summary: `${barcodes[0]} → ${matchLast[2]}`,
        count: barcodes.length,
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    isContiguous: false,
    summary: `${barcodes[0]}...`,
    count: barcodes.length,
  };
}

export function BarcodeRangeList({ barcodes }: BarcodeRangeListProps) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  if (!barcodes || barcodes.length === 0) {
    return <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", color: "text.secondary" }}>-</Typography>;
  }

  if (barcodes.length === 1) {
    return (
      <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", fontSize: "0.875rem" }}>
        {barcodes[0]}
      </Typography>
    );
  }

  const parsed = parseBarcodeSequence(barcodes);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: "inline-flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 0.5 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
        <Typography
          component="span"
          sx={{
            fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
            fontSize: "0.875rem",
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          {parsed?.summary}
        </Typography>
        <Chip
          size="small"
          label={`${barcodes.length} mã`}
          color="primary"
          variant="outlined"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setExpanded((prev) => !prev);
          }}
          sx={{
            fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
            cursor: "pointer",
            fontSize: "0.75rem",
            height: 20,
            "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
          }}
        />
      </Box>

      {expanded && (
        <Box
          data-testid="barcode-expanded-list"
          sx={{
            mt: 0.5,
            p: 1,
            maxHeight: 160,
            overflowY: "auto",
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
            borderRadius: 1,
            border: "1px solid",
            borderColor: "divider",
            fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
            fontSize: "0.75rem",
          }}
        >
          {barcodes.map((code) => (
            <Box key={code} sx={{ py: 0.25 }}>
              {code}
            </Box>
          ))}
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
}

export default BarcodeRangeList;

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";

} from "@mui/material";

import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlineOutlined";

interface BookCopiesTableProps {
  bookId: string;
  isbn?: string;
  copies: BookCopy[];
  loading?: boolean;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  showNotice: (
    severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info",
    message: string
  ) => void;
}

export function BookCopiesTable({
  bookId,
  isbn,
  copies,
  loading = false,
  onRefresh,
  showNotice,
}: BookCopiesTableProps) {
  // Add modal state
  const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false);
  const [addLoading, setAddLoading] = useState(false);
  const [addBarcode, setAddBarcode] = useState("");
  const [addCondition, setAddCondition] = useState<CopyCondition>("new");
  const [addStatus, setAddStatus] = useState<CopyStatus>("available");
  const [addShelf, setAddShelf] = useState("");

  // Edit modal state
  const [editCopy, setEditCopy] = useState<BookCopy | null>(null);
  const [editLoading, setEditLoading] = useState(false);
  const [editCondition, setEditCondition] = useState<CopyCondition>("good");
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState<CopyStatus>("available");
  const [editShelf, setEditShelf] = useState("");
  const [editNote, setEditNote] = useState("");

  // Delete modal state
  const [deleteCopy, setDeleteCopy] = useState<BookCopy | null>(null);
  const [deleteLoading, setDeleteLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleOpenAdd = () => {
    setAddBarcode("");
    setAddCondition("new");
    setAddStatus("available");
    setAddShelf("");
    setAddOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    setAddLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.createBookCopy({
        book_id: bookId,
        barcode: addBarcode.trim() || undefined,
        condition: addCondition,
        status: addStatus,
        shelf_location: addShelf.trim() || undefined,
      });
      showNotice("success", "Thêm bản sao thành công");
      setAddOpen(false);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Thêm bản sao thất bại");
    } finally {
      setAddLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (copy: BookCopy) => {
    setEditCopy(copy);
    setEditCondition((copy.condition as CopyCondition) || "good");
    setEditStatus((copy.status as CopyStatus) || "available");
    setEditShelf(copy.shelf_location || "");
    setEditNote("");
  };

  const handleUpdate = async () => {
    if (!editCopy) return;
    setEditLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.updateBookCopy(editCopy.id, {
        condition: editCondition,
        status: editStatus,
        shelf_location: editShelf.trim() || undefined,
        note: editNote.trim() || undefined,
      });
      showNotice("success", "Cập nhật bản sao thành công");
      setEditCopy(null);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Cập nhật bản sao thất bại");
    } finally {
      setEditLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteCopy) return;
    setDeleteLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.deleteBookCopy(deleteCopy.id);
      showNotice("success", "Xóa bản sao thành công");
      setDeleteCopy(null);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Xóa bản sao thất bại");
    } finally {
      setDeleteLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const cardAction = (
    <Button
      variant="contained"
      size="small"
      startIcon={<AddIcon />}
      onClick={handleOpenAdd}
    >
      Thêm bản sao
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <DashboardCard title="Danh sách bản sao" actions={cardAction}>
      {loading ? (
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", py: 4 }}>
          <CircularProgress size={32} />
        </Box>
      ) : copies.length === 0 ? (
        <Box sx={{ py: 3, textAlign: "center" }}>
          <Typography color="text.secondary">
            Chưa có bản sao nào. Hãy nhấn &quot;Thêm bản sao&quot; để tạo mã vạch quản lý.
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <TableContainer>
          <Table size="small">
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Mã vạch</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Tình trạng</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Trạng thái</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Ngày nhập</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Vị trí kệ</TableCell>
                <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  Thao tác
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {copies.map((copy) => {
                const condition = (copy.condition as CopyCondition) || "new";
                const status = (copy.status as CopyStatus) || "available";
                const formattedDate = copy.imported_at
                  ? new Date(copy.imported_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", {
                      day: "2-digit",
                      month: "2-digit",
                      year: "numeric",
                    })
                  : "-";

                return (
                  <TableRow key={copy.id} hover>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                        <QrCode2Icon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                        <Typography
                          variant="body2"
                          sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontWeight: 600 }}
                        >
                          {copy.barcode}
                        </Typography>
                      </Stack>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        label={CONDITION_LABELS[condition] || condition}
                        color={getConditionColor(condition)}
                        variant="outlined"
                      />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        label={COPY_STATUS_LABELS[status] || status}
                        color={getStatusColor(status)}
                      />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{formattedDate}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{copy.shelf_location || "-"}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="right">
                      <Tooltip title="Chỉnh sửa bản sao">

                      </Tooltip>
                      <Tooltip title="Xóa bản sao">

      {/* Add Copy Dialog */}
      <Dialog

      >

        <DialogContent dividers>
          <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
            <TextField
              label="Mã vạch (Barcode)"
              placeholder={`VD: LIB-${isbn || "..."}-001`}
              helperText="Để trống để hệ thống tự động sinh theo mẫu LIB-<isbn>-<seq>"
              value={addBarcode}
              onChange={(e) => setAddBarcode(e.target.value)}

                labelId="add-condition-label"

      <Dialog

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Button, Dialog, DialogActions, DialogContent, DialogTitle, Stack, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import { QRCodeSVG } from "qrcode.react";
import type { BorrowRecord } from "@/lib/types";

interface ReturnReceiptProps {
  record: BorrowRecord | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function ReturnReceipt({ record, onClose }: ReturnReceiptProps) {
  if (!record) return null;

  const rows: Array<{ label: string; value: string; strong?: boolean }> = [
    { label: "Sách", value: record.book?.title ?? record.book_id },
    { label: "Tiền phạt trễ hạn", value: `${Number(record.fine_amount ?? 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ` },
    { label: "Phí hư hỏng", value: `${Number(record.damage_fee ?? 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ` },
    { label: "Tổng cộng", value: `${Number(record.total_due ?? (record.fine_amount ?? 0) + (record.damage_fee ?? 0)).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ`, strong: true },
    { label: "Phương thức", value: record.payment_method === "qr_code" ? "Quét mã QR" : record.payment_method === "cash" ? "Tiền mặt" : "-" },
    { label: "Mã thanh toán", value: record.payment_ref ?? "—" },
  ];

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!record} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>Biên nhận trả sách</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <Stack spacing={1}>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <Stack key={r.label} direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">{r.label}</Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={r.strong ? { fontWeight: 800 } : undefined}>{r.value}</Typography>
            </Stack>
          ))}
          {record.payment_ref ? (
            <Stack sx={{ alignItems: "center", mt: 1 }}>
              <QRCodeSVG value={record.payment_ref} size={120} />
            </Stack>
          ) : null}
        </Stack>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose} variant="outlined">Đóng</Button>
        <Button onClick={() => window.print()} variant="contained">In phiếu</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useRef } from "react";
import { Box, TextField, useTheme } from "@mui/material";

interface OtpPinInputProps {
  length?: number;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  error?: boolean;
}

export default function OtpPinInput({
  length = 6,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  autoFocus = true,
  error = false,
}: OtpPinInputProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";
  const inputRefs = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);

  const digits = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => value[i] || "");

  const handleInputChange = (index: number, e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const rawVal = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (!rawVal) {
      // User cleared slot
      const chars = value.split("");
      chars[index] = "";
      onChange(chars.join("").slice(0, length));
      return;
    }

    // Single digit input
    const singleDigit = rawVal.slice(-1);
    const chars = value.padEnd(length, " ").split("");
    chars[index] = singleDigit;
    const nextVal = chars.join("").trimEnd();
    onChange(nextVal);

    // Auto advance to next slot
    if (index < length - 1) {
      inputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Backspace") {
      if (!digits[index] && index > 0) {
        // Current is empty, delete previous and move back
        const chars = value.split("");
        chars[index - 1] = "";
        onChange(chars.join(""));
        inputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
      } else if (digits[index]) {
        // Clear current
        const chars = value.split("");
        chars[index] = "";
        onChange(chars.join(""));
      }
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && index > 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      inputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && index < length - 1) {
      e.preventDefault();
      inputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handlePaste = (e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pastedData = e.clipboardData.getData("text").replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (!pastedData) return;

    const trimmed = pastedData.slice(0, length);
    onChange(trimmed);

    // Focus last filled or next slot
    const targetIdx = Math.min(trimmed.length, length - 1);
    inputRefs.current[targetIdx]?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: "flex",
        gap: { xs: 1, sm: 1.5 },
        justifyContent: "center",
        alignItems: "center",
        my: 1,
      }}
    >
      {digits.map((digit, idx) => {
        const isFilled = Boolean(digit);
        return (
          <TextField
            key={idx}
            inputRef={(el) => {
              inputRefs.current[idx] = el;
            }}
            value={digit}
            onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => handleInputChange(idx, e)}
            onKeyDown={(e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => handleKeyDown(idx, e)}
            onPaste={handlePaste}
            disabled={disabled}
            autoFocus={autoFocus && idx === 0}
            slotProps={{
              htmlInput: {
                maxLength: 1,
                inputMode: "numeric",
                pattern: "[0-9]*",
                autoComplete: "one-time-code",
                style: {
                  textAlign: "center",
                  fontSize: "1.65rem",
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  fontFamily: "'Space Grotesk', monospace, sans-serif",
                  padding: 0,
                  height: "56px",
                  width: "48px",
                  letterSpacing: "-0.02em",
                },
              },
            }}
            sx={{
              width: { xs: 44, sm: 50 },
              "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
                borderRadius: 2.5,
                bgcolor: isFilled
                  ? isDark
                    ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)"
                    : "rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.04)"
                  : isDark
                  ? "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)"
                  : "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)",
                transition: "all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
                "& fieldset": {
                  borderWidth: isFilled ? 2 : 1.5,
                  borderColor: error
                    ? theme.palette.error.main
                    : isFilled
                    ? isDark
                      ? "#38BDF8"
                      : theme.palette.primary.main
                    : isDark
                    ? "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)"
                    : "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)",
                },
                "&:hover fieldset": {
                  borderColor: error
                    ? theme.palette.error.main
                    : theme.palette.primary.main,
                },
                "&.Mui-focused": {
                  boxShadow: error
                    ? `0 0 0 3px ${theme.palette.error.light}40`
                    : `0 0 0 4px ${isDark ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)" : "rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.12)"}`,
                  "& fieldset": {
                    borderColor: error ? theme.palette.error.main : theme.palette.primary.main,
                    borderWidth: 2,
                  },
                },
              },
            }}
          />
        );
      })}
    </Box>
  );
}

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";

export async function GET(_request: NextRequest) {
  const API_BASE = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:80").replace(/\/api\/?$/, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/library/shelves`, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Backend returned ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    return Response.json(data);
  } catch {
    return Response.json({ error: "Không thể kết nối backend" }, { status: 502 });
  }
}

File: src/lib/error-reporter.ts

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:80';

interface ReportErrorParams {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  priority?: 'Highest' | 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
  labels?: string[];
  service?: string;
  endpoint?: string;
  method?: string;
  stacktrace?: string;
  requestBody?: string;
}

export async function reportError(params: ReportErrorParams): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await fetch(`${API_BASE}/errors/report`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...params,
        service: params.service || 'frontend-web',
      }),
    });
  } catch {
    // Silent fail — error reporting should never break the app
  }
}

// Global error handler for unhandled errors
export function setupGlobalErrorHandlers() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
    reportError({
      title: `[Frontend-Web] Uncaught Error - ${event.message}`,
      description: event.message,
      priority: 'High',
      labels: ['frontend-web', 'uncaught-error'],
      stacktrace: event.error?.stack || `${event.filename}:${event.lineno}:${event.colno}`,
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
    const reason = event.reason;
    const message = reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason);
    const stack = reason instanceof Error ? reason.stack : undefined;
    reportError({
      title: `[Frontend-Web] Unhandled Promise Rejection - ${message}`,
      description: message,
      priority: 'High',
      labels: ['frontend-web', 'unhandled-rejection'],
      stacktrace: stack,
    });
  });
}

File: src/lib/fee-estimate.ts
================
export interface FineBracket {
  from: number;
  to: number | null;
  amount: number;
}

export interface FineConfigDto {
  fine_brackets?: FineBracket[];
  fine_per_day?: number;
  damage_fee_pct?: { minor: number; major: number; lost: number };
  damage_fee_fixed?: { minor: number; major: number; lost: number };
  fallback_book_price?: number;
  fine_lock_threshold_days?: number;
}

export function estimateOverdueFine(overdueDays: number, fine?: FineConfigDto | null): number {
  if (overdueDays <= 0) return 0;

  const brackets = fine?.fine_brackets;
  const finePerDay = (fine?.fine_per_day ?? 5000) as number;

  if (brackets && brackets.length > 0) {
    for (const b of brackets) {
      const from = Number(b.from);
      const to = b.to === null || b.to === undefined ? Infinity : Number(b.to);
      if (overdueDays >= from && overdueDays <= to) return Number(b.amount);
    }
    const lastBracket = brackets[brackets.length - 1];
    if (lastBracket.to === null || lastBracket.to === undefined) return Number(lastBracket.amount);
    if (finePerDay > 0) return overdueDays * finePerDay;
    return Number(lastBracket.amount);
  }

  if (overdueDays <= 7) return 10000;
  if (overdueDays <= 14) return 20000;
  if (overdueDays <= 30) return 50000;
  return 100000;
}

export function estimateDamageFee(
  condition: string | null | undefined,
  priceVnd: number | null | undefined,
  fine?: FineConfigDto | null,
): number {
  const pct = fine?.damage_fee_pct ?? { minor: 30, major: 70, lost: 100 };
  const fixed = fine?.damage_fee_fixed ?? { minor: 5000, major: 10000, lost: 10000 };
  const fallback = fine?.fallback_book_price ?? 100000;
  const effectivePrice = priceVnd !== null && priceVnd !== undefined && Number(priceVnd) > 0 ? Number(priceVnd) : fallback;

  switch (condition) {
    case "minor_damage":
      return Math.round(effectivePrice * pct.minor / 100) + fixed.minor;
    case "major_damage":
      return Math.round(effectivePrice * pct.major / 100) + fixed.major;
    case "lost":
      return Math.round(effectivePrice * pct.lost / 100) + fixed.lost;
    default:
      return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Tests for the 401 → re-auth queue behavior in api-client.
 *
 * Since handleUnauthorized is a private method, we test the public contract:
 * - retryPendingRequests retries queued requests with new token
 * - cancelPendingRequests rejects queued requests
 * - refresh failure emits "auth:required" on bus (tested via integration)
 */

import { bus } from "@/lib/event-bus";

// We need to mock axios before importing api-client
jest.mock("axios", () => {
  const mockAxiosInstance = {
    get: jest.fn(),
    post: jest.fn(),
    put: jest.fn(),
    delete: jest.fn(),
    interceptors: {
      request: { use: jest.fn(), eject: jest.fn() },
      response: { use: jest.fn(), eject: jest.fn() },
    },
  };
  const mockAxios = {
    create: jest.fn(() => mockAxiosInstance),
    post: jest.fn(),
  };
  return {
    __esModule: true,
    default: mockAxios,
    AxiosError: jest.requireActual("axios").AxiosError,
  };
});

describe("api-client auth queue", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    bus["listeners"] = {};
  });

  it("should export retryPendingRequests function", () => {
    const { retryPendingRequests } = require("@/lib/api-client");
    expect(typeof retryPendingRequests).toBe("function");
  });

  it("should export cancelPendingRequests function", () => {
    const { cancelPendingRequests } = require("@/lib/api-client");
    expect(typeof cancelPendingRequests).toBe("function");
  });

  it("should emit auth:required event when retryPendingRequests is called (placeholder for actual test)", () => {
    // This is a structural verification that the event-bus integration works
    const fn = jest.fn();
    bus.on("auth:required", fn);

    // Simulate what would happen after handleUnauthorized refresh failure
    bus.emit("auth:required");

    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("should NOT fetch auth endpoints through re-auth flow", () => {
    // Auth endpoints like /auth/login should skip the 401 handling
    // This is verified by the existing line 210 check in api-client.ts
    const { api } = require("@/lib/api-client");
    // The { api } default export is the ApiClient singleton
    expect(api).toBeDefined();
    // Verify auth skip exists in the interceptor
    const responseInterceptor = api.client.interceptors.response.use;
    expect(responseInterceptor).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

File: src/__tests__/auth/event-bus.test.ts

import { bus } from "@/lib/event-bus";

describe("EventBus", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    bus["listeners"] = {};
  });

  it("should subscribe and emit events", () => {
    const fn = jest.fn();
    bus.on("auth:required", fn);

    bus.emit("auth:required");

    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("should pass arguments to listeners", () => {
    const fn = jest.fn();
    bus.on("auth:success", fn);

    bus.emit("auth:success", "new-token-123");

    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledWith("new-token-123");
  });

  it("should return unsubscribe function from on()", () => {
    const fn = jest.fn();
    const unsubscribe = bus.on("auth:required", fn);

    unsubscribe();
    bus.emit("auth:required");

    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("should support multiple listeners on same event", () => {
    const fn1 = jest.fn();
    const fn2 = jest.fn();
    bus.on("auth:required", fn1);
    bus.on("auth:required", fn2);

    bus.emit("auth:required");

    expect(fn1).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(fn2).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("should not throw when emitting event with no listeners", () => {
    expect(() => bus.emit("auth:required")).not.toThrow();
  });

  it("should handle off() correctly", () => {
    const fn = jest.fn();
    bus.on("auth:required", fn);
    bus.off("auth:required", fn);

    bus.emit("auth:required");

    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

import ReauthOverlay from "@/app/_components/ReauthOverlay";

}

describe("ReauthOverlay", () => {

    bus["listeners"] = {};
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("should not render when auth:required has not been emitted", () => {

    expect(container.firstChild).toBeNull();
  });

  it("should render blurred overlay when auth:required event is emitted", async () => {

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/phiên đăng nhập hết hạn/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

      expect(screen.getByDisplayValue("admin@test.com")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("should call retryPendingRequests on successful re-login", async () => {

    render(<ReauthOverlay />);
    emitAuthRequired();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/phiên đăng nhập hết hạn/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText(/mật khẩu/i);
    await userEvent.type(passwordInput, "newpass123");

    const loginButton = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^đăng nhập$/i });
    await userEvent.click(loginButton);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockRetry).toHaveBeenCalledWith("new-token");
    });
  });

  it("should call cancelPendingRequests on close", async () => {
    render(<ReauthOverlay />);
    emitAuthRequired();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/phiên đăng nhập hết hạn/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockCancel).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

    mockLogin.mockRejectedValue({ response: { data: { detail: "Sai mật khẩu" } } });

    render(<ReauthOverlay />);
    emitAuthRequired();

    await waitFor(() => {

    const loginButton = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^đăng nhập$/i });
    await userEvent.click(loginButton);

    await waitFor(() => {

    });

    render(<ReauthOverlay />);
    emitAuthRequired();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/đăng nhập bằng khuôn mặt/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("should have a logout button", async () => {
    render(<ReauthOverlay />);
    emitAuthRequired();

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/đăng xuất/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.useFakeTimers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    jest.useRealTimers();
  });

  it('renders with label', () => {
    render(<HoldButton onHoldComplete={jest.fn()}>Xác nhận</HoldButton>);
    expect(screen.getByText('Xác nhận')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('fires onHoldComplete after holding for duration', () => {
    const onHoldComplete = jest.fn();
    render(<HoldButton onHoldComplete={onHoldComplete} duration={1000}>Xác nhận</HoldButton>);
    const button = screen.getByText('Xác nhận');
    fireEvent.mouseDown(button);
    jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000);
    expect(onHoldComplete).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not fire onHoldComplete if released early', () => {
    const onHoldComplete = jest.fn();
    render(<HoldButton onHoldComplete={onHoldComplete} duration={1000}>Xác nhận</HoldButton>);
    const button = screen.getByText('Xác nhận');
    fireEvent.mouseDown(button);
    jest.advanceTimersByTime(300);
    fireEvent.mouseUp(button);
    jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000);
    expect(onHoldComplete).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

File: src/__tests__/hooks/useHold.test.ts

import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import useHold from '@/lib/hooks/useHold';

describe('useHold', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.useFakeTimers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    jest.useRealTimers();
  });

  it('returns idle state initially', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useHold({ onHoldComplete: jest.fn() }));
    expect(result.current.holding).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.progress).toBe(0);
  });

  it('starts holding on pointer down', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useHold({ onHoldComplete: jest.fn() }));
    act(() => result.current.onStart());
    expect(result.current.holding).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.progress).toBe(0);
  });

  it('increases progress over time', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useHold({ duration: 1000, onHoldComplete: jest.fn() }));
    act(() => result.current.onStart());
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(500); });
    expect(result.current.progress).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.49);
    expect(result.current.progress).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.51);
  });

  it('fires onHoldComplete when duration reached', () => {
    const onHoldComplete = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useHold({ duration: 1000, onHoldComplete }));
    act(() => result.current.onStart());
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000); });
    expect(onHoldComplete).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(result.current.holding).toBe(false);
  });

  it('cancels hold on pointer up before duration', () => {
    const onHoldComplete = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useHold({ duration: 1000, onHoldComplete }));
    act(() => result.current.onStart());
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(300); });
    act(() => result.current.onEnd());
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000); });
    expect(onHoldComplete).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result.current.holding).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.progress).toBe(0);
  });
});

File: src/__tests__/hooks/useUndo.test.ts
================
import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import useUndo from '@/lib/hooks/useUndo';

describe('useUndo', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.useFakeTimers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    jest.useRealTimers();
  });

  it('returns idle state initially', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo<string>({ onConfirm: jest.fn() }));
    expect(result.current.pendingDelete).toBeNull();
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(0);
    expect(result.current.isPending).toBe(false);
  });

  it('marks item for delete and starts countdown', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo<string>({ onConfirm: jest.fn() }));
    act(() => result.current.markForDelete('item-1'));
    expect(result.current.pendingDelete).toBe('item-1');
    expect(result.current.isPending).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(5);
  });

  it('decrements countdown every second', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo<string>({ onConfirm: jest.fn() }));
    act(() => result.current.markForDelete('item-1'));
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000); });
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(4);
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(2000); });
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(2);
  });

  it('calls onConfirm when countdown reaches 0', () => {
    const onConfirm = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo<string>({ onConfirm }));
    act(() => result.current.markForDelete('item-1'));
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(5000); });
    expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledWith('item-1');
    expect(result.current.pendingDelete).toBeNull();
    expect(result.current.isPending).toBe(false);
  });

  it('cancels delete on undo and restores item', () => {
    const onConfirm = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo<string>({ onConfirm }));
    act(() => result.current.markForDelete('item-1'));
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(2000); });
    act(() => result.current.undo());
    expect(result.current.pendingDelete).toBeNull();
    expect(result.current.isPending).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(0);
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(5000); });
    expect(onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns countdown as seconds remaining', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo<string>({ onConfirm: jest.fn(), undoDuration: 3 }));
    act(() => result.current.markForDelete('item-1'));
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(3);
    act(() => { jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000); });
    expect(result.current.countdown).toBe(2);
  });
});

import { api } from "@/lib/api-client";

jest.mock("axios", () => {
  const mockAxiosInstance = {
    post: jest.fn(),
    get: jest.fn(),
    interceptors: {
      request: { use: jest.fn(), eject: jest.fn() },
      response: { use: jest.fn(), eject: jest.fn() },
    },
  };
  return {
    create: jest.fn(() => mockAxiosInstance),
    default: {
      create: jest.fn(() => mockAxiosInstance),
    },
  };
});

describe("KIOSK-1 API methods", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("createKioskApprovalRequest should call POST with correct payload", async () => {
    const axios = require("axios");
    axios.create().post.mockResolvedValue({
      data: { event_code: "A45", device_auth_token: "tok1", status: "pending", expires_at: "2026-07-02T12:00:00Z" },
    });

    const result = await api.createKioskApprovalRequest({
      device_id: "kiosk-1",
      patron_id: "patron-uuid",
      student_code: "SV001",
    });

    expect(axios.create().post).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/access/kiosk/approval-request", {
      device_id: "kiosk-1",
      patron_id: "patron-uuid",
      student_code: "SV001",
    });
    expect(result.event_code).toBe("A45");
  });

  it("getPendingApprovalRequests should call GET", async () => {
    const axios = require("axios");
    axios.create().get.mockResolvedValue({ data: [{ event_code: "A45", status: "pending" }] });

    const result = await api.getPendingApprovalRequests();
    expect(axios.create().get).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/pending");
    expect(result[0].event_code).toBe("A45");
  });

  it("approveKioskRequest should call POST approve", async () => {
    const axios = require("axios");
    axios.create().post.mockResolvedValue({ data: { status: "approved", event_code: "A45" } });

    const result = await api.approveKioskRequest("A45", "staff-uuid");
    expect(axios.create().post).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/A45/approve", { approved_by: "staff-uuid" });
    expect(result.status).toBe("approved");
  });

  it("rejectKioskRequest should call POST reject", async () => {
    const axios = require("axios");
    axios.create().post.mockResolvedValue({ data: { status: "rejected", event_code: "A45" } });

    const result = await api.rejectKioskRequest("A45", "staff-uuid", "Hình ảnh không rõ");
    expect(axios.create().post).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/A45/reject", {
      approved_by: "staff-uuid",
      reason: "Hình ảnh không rõ",
    });
    expect(result.status).toBe("rejected");
  });

  it("getApprovalRequestStatus should call GET with code", async () => {
    const axios = require("axios");
    axios.create().get.mockResolvedValue({ data: { event_code: "A45", status: "pending" } });

    const result = await api.getApprovalRequestStatus("A45");
    expect(axios.create().get).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/A45");
    expect(result.event_code).toBe("A45");
  });
});

import { api } from "@/lib/api-client";

// Mock axios at the module level so the ApiClient can be instantiated
jest.mock("axios", () => {
  const mockAxiosInstance = {
    post: jest.fn(),
    get: jest.fn(),
    interceptors: {
      request: { use: jest.fn(), eject: jest.fn() },
      response: { use: jest.fn(), eject: jest.fn() },
    },
  };
  return {
    create: jest.fn(() => mockAxiosInstance),
    default: {
      create: jest.fn(() => mockAxiosInstance),
    },
  };
});

describe("kioskPresence API method", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("should exist on api client", () => {
    expect(typeof api.kioskPresence).toBe("function");
  });

  it("should call POST /api/access/kiosk/presence with correct payload", async () => {
    const axios = require("axios");
    const mockResponse = { data: { current_status: "inside", message: "Đã ghi nhận" } };

    const result = await api.kioskPresence("patron-uuid", "SV001", "kiosk-1");

    await expect(api.kioskPresence("patron-uuid", "SV001", "kiosk-1")).rejects.toThrow("Network error");
  });

import { computeDimensions } from '@/lib/image-utils';

describe('image-utils', () => {
  describe('computeDimensions', () => {
    it('returns original dimensions when within max', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(800, 600, 1280);
      expect(result).toEqual({ width: 800, height: 600 });
    });

    it('scales down width when width exceeds max', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(2560, 1440, 1280);
      expect(result.width).toBe(1280);
      expect(result.height).toBe(720);
    });

    it('scales down height when height exceeds max', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(1440, 2560, 1280);
      expect(result.width).toBe(720);
      expect(result.height).toBe(1280);
    });

    it('scales down proportionally when both exceed max', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(3840, 2160, 1280);
      expect(result.width).toBe(1280);
      expect(result.height).toBe(720);
    });

    it('handles square images', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(2000, 2000, 1280);
      expect(result.width).toBe(1280);
      expect(result.height).toBe(1280);
    });

    it('handles small images', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(100, 100, 1280);
      expect(result).toEqual({ width: 100, height: 100 });
    });

    it('rounds dimensions to integers', () => {
      const result = computeDimensions(1920, 1080, 1280);
      expect(Number.isInteger(result.width)).toBe(true);
      expect(Number.isInteger(result.height)).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

import { startOfWeek, getWeekDays, toDateInput, formatDateRange } from "@/hooks/useScheduleData";

describe("useScheduleData utilities", () => {
  describe("startOfWeek", () => {
    it("returns Monday for a Wednesday", () => {
      const wed = new Date(2026, 6, 1);
      const result = startOfWeek(wed);
      expect(result.getDay()).toBe(1);
      expect(result.getDate()).toBe(29);
      expect(result.getMonth()).toBe(5);
    });

    it("returns Monday for a Sunday", () => {
      const sun = new Date(2026, 5, 28);
      const result = startOfWeek(sun);
      expect(result.getDay()).toBe(1);
      expect(result.getDate()).toBe(22);
    });

    it("returns same date when input is Monday", () => {
      const mon = new Date(2026, 5, 29);
      const result = startOfWeek(mon);
      expect(result.getDay()).toBe(1);
      expect(result.getDate()).toBe(29);
    });
  });

  describe("getWeekDays", () => {
    it("returns 7 days starting from anchor", () => {
      const monday = new Date(2026, 5, 29);
      const days = getWeekDays(monday);
      expect(days).toHaveLength(7);
      expect(days[0].getDay()).toBe(1);
      expect(days[6].getDay()).toBe(0);
      expect(days[6].getDate()).toBe(5);
    });
  });

  describe("toDateInput", () => {
    it("formats date as YYYY-MM-DD", () => {
      const date = new Date(2026, 6, 1);
      expect(toDateInput(date)).toBe("2026-07-01");
    });

    it("pads month and day with zeros", () => {
      const date = new Date(2026, 0, 5);
      expect(toDateInput(date)).toBe("2026-01-05");
    });
  });

  describe("formatDateRange", () => {
    it("formats 7-day range with vietnamese locale", () => {
      const days = getWeekDays(new Date(2026, 5, 29));
      const result = formatDateRange(days);
      expect(result).toContain("—");
      expect(typeof result).toBe("string");
      expect(result.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });
});

import { renderHook, act } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useScheduleFilters } from "@/hooks/useScheduleFilters";
import type { StaffScheduleAssignment, StaffShift, ScheduleStaff, LibraryZone } from "@/lib/types";

const mockShifts: StaffShift[] = [
  { id: "s1", name: "Sáng", startTime: "08:00", endTime: "12:00", minStaff: 1, maxStaff: 2, isActive: true },
  { id: "s2", name: "Chiều", startTime: "13:00", endTime: "17:00", minStaff: 1, maxStaff: 2, isActive: true },
  { id: "s3", name: "Tối", startTime: "18:00", endTime: "22:00", minStaff: 1, maxStaff: 2, isActive: false },
];

const mockZones: LibraryZone[] = [
  { id: "z1", zoneName: "Zone A", floor: 1, description: null, isActive: true },
  { id: "z2", zoneName: "Zone B", floor: 2, description: null, isActive: true },
];

const mockStaff: ScheduleStaff[] = [
  { id: "u1", fullName: "A", email: "a@test.com", role: "staff", status: "active" },
  { id: "u2", fullName: "B", email: "b@test.com", role: "staff", status: "active" },
];

const mockAssignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[] = [
  { id: "a1", staffId: "u1", shiftId: "s1", zoneId: "z1", workDate: "2026-07-01", status: "scheduled", shiftName: "Sáng", zoneName: "Zone A", staffName: "A" } as any,
  { id: "a2", staffId: "u2", shiftId: "s2", zoneId: "z2", workDate: "2026-07-01", status: "scheduled", shiftName: "Chiều", zoneName: "Zone B", staffName: "B" } as any,
  { id: "a3", staffId: "u2", shiftId: "s1", zoneId: "z1", workDate: "2026-07-02", status: "cancelled", shiftName: "Sáng", zoneName: "Zone A", staffName: "B" } as any,
];

describe("useScheduleFilters", () => {
  it("initializes with default filter values", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    expect(result.current.filter).toBe("all");
    expect(result.current.zoneFilter).toBe("");
    expect(result.current.shiftFilter).toBe("");
  });

  it("sorts shiftList by startTime", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    expect(result.current.shiftList[0].name).toBe("Sáng");
    expect(result.current.shiftList[1].name).toBe("Chiều");
  });

  it("filters assignments by zone", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    act(() => { result.current.setZoneFilter("z2"); });
    expect(result.current.filteredAssignments).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.current.filteredAssignments[0].zoneId).toBe("z2");
  });

  it("filters assignments by shift", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    act(() => { result.current.setShiftFilter("s2"); });
    expect(result.current.filteredAssignments).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.current.filteredAssignments[0].shiftId).toBe("s2");
  });

  it("filters shifts to single when shiftFilter set", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    act(() => { result.current.setShiftFilter("s1"); });
    expect(result.current.filteredShifts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.current.filteredShifts[0].id).toBe("s1");
  });

  it("computes weekStats correctly", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    expect(result.current.weekStats.total).toBe(2);
    expect(result.current.weekStats.staffCount).toBe(2);
  });

  it("updates filter value", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScheduleFilters(mockAssignments, mockShifts, mockStaff, mockZones));
    act(() => { result.current.setFilter("active"); });
    expect(result.current.filter).toBe("active");
  });
});

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Box, Button, Stack, TextField, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import CloudUploadOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CloudUploadOutlined";
import RefreshOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";

interface CameraFallbackProps {
  lastFrameUrl?: string | null;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onManualSubmit?: (value: string) => void;
  manualLabel?: string;
  manualPlaceholder?: string;
  showManualInput?: boolean;
  showFileUpload?: boolean;
  onFileUpload?: (file: File) => void;
}

export default function CameraFallback({
  lastFrameUrl,
  onRetry,
  onManualSubmit,
  manualLabel = "Nhập thông tin thủ công",
  manualPlaceholder = "Nhập tại đây...",
  showManualInput = false,
  showFileUpload = false,
  onFileUpload,
}: CameraFallbackProps) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (showManualInput && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
    }
  }, [showManualInput]);

  const handleFileChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (file && onFileUpload) {
      onFileUpload(file);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center", py: 2 }}>
      {lastFrameUrl ? (
        <Box
          sx={{
            width: "100%",
            aspectRatio: "16 / 9",
            borderRadius: 1,
            overflow: "hidden",
            position: "relative",
            bgcolor: "black",
          }}
        >
          <Box
            component="img"
            src={lastFrameUrl}
            alt=""
            sx={{
              width: "100%",
              height: "100%",
              objectFit: "contain",
              filter: "blur(24px)",
              opacity: 0.6,
            }}
          />
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: "absolute",
              inset: 0,
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              flexDirection: "column",
              gap: 1,
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="body2" color="grey.400">
              Camera đã ngắt kết nối
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <Box
          sx={{
            width: "100%",
            aspectRatio: "16 / 9",
            borderRadius: 1,
            bgcolor: "action.hover",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
          }}
        >
          <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", color: "text.secondary", px: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="body2">Không thể khởi động camera</Typography>
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      )}

      {showManualInput && (
        <Box
          component="form"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            const form = event.target as HTMLFormElement;
            const input = form.elements.namedItem("manual-input") as HTMLInputElement;
            if (input?.value && onManualSubmit) {
              onManualSubmit(input.value);
            }
          }}
          sx={{ width: "100%" }}
        >
          <TextField
            inputRef={inputRef}
            name="manual-input"
            label={manualLabel}
            placeholder={manualPlaceholder}
            variant="outlined"
            size="small"
            fullWidth
            autoComplete="off"
          />
        </Box>
      )}

      {showFileUpload && (
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          startIcon={<CloudUploadOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          fullWidth
        >
          Tải ảnh lên
        </Button>
      )}

      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        style={{ display: "none" }}
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        data-testid="file-input"
      />

      <Button
        variant="contained"
        startIcon={<RefreshOutlinedIcon />}
        onClick={onRetry}
        fullWidth
      >
        Thử lại camera
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  );
}

import { Box, Button, CircularProgress, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import useHold from "@/lib/hooks/useHold";

interface HoldButtonProps {
  onHoldComplete: () => void;
  duration?: number;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  color?: "primary" | "success" | "error" | "warning";
}

export default function HoldButton({ onHoldComplete, duration = 1000, children, disabled, color = "primary" }: HoldButtonProps) {
  const { holding, progress, onStart, onEnd } = useHold({ onHoldComplete, duration });

  return (
    <Box sx={{ position: "relative", display: "inline-flex" }}>
      <Button
        variant="contained"
        color={color}
        disabled={disabled}
        onMouseDown={onStart}
        onMouseUp={onEnd}
        onMouseLeave={onEnd}
        onTouchStart={onStart}
        onTouchEnd={onEnd}
        sx={{
          minWidth: 160,
          position: "relative",
          transition: "none",
          ...(holding && { bgcolor: `${color}.dark` }),
        }}
      >
        {holding ? (
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
            <CircularProgress size={18} color="inherit" variant="determinate" value={progress * 100} />
            <Typography variant="button">Giữ để xác nhận</Typography>
          </Box>
        ) : children}
      </Button>
    </Box>
  );
}

File: src/app/_components/Lazy3DScene.tsx

"use client";

import { useRef, useState, useEffect, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Box, type SxProps, type Theme } from "@mui/material";

interface Lazy3DSceneProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  height?: number | string;
  placeholder?: ReactNode;
  sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
  /** Margin before the element enters viewport (default: "200px") */
  rootMargin?: string;
}

function BlurPlaceholder({ height }: { height: number | string }) {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: "100%",
        height,
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        bgcolor: "action.hover",
        backdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
        WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
        backgroundImage:
          "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.05) 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.1) 100%)",
        borderRadius: 1,
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: "100%",
          height: "100%",
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          opacity: 0.5,
          "&::after": {
            content: '""',
            display: "block",
            width: 48,
            height: 48,
            borderRadius: "50%",
            border: "3px solid",
            borderColor: "divider",
            borderTopColor: "primary.main",
            animation: "spin 0.8s linear infinite",
          },
          "@keyframes spin": { "100%": { transform: "rotate(360deg)" } },
        }}
      />
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function Lazy3DScene({
  children,
  height = 400,
  placeholder,
  sx,
  rootMargin = "200px",
}: Lazy3DSceneProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [rootMargin]);

  return (
    <Box ref={ref} sx={{ width: "100%", height, position: "relative", ...sx }}>
      {inView ? children : placeholder || <BlurPlaceholder height={height} />}
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence, HTMLMotionProps } from "framer-motion";
import { EASINGS, SPRINGS, DURATIONS, MOTION_VARIANTS, useMotionPreference } from "@/lib/motion";

/* ─── 1. MotionButton (Spring Micro-interaction) ─── */
export interface MotionButtonProps extends HTMLMotionProps<"button"> {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "danger";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
}

const variantStyles: Record<string, string> = {
  primary: "bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary-dark shadow-md hover:shadow-lg",
  secondary: "bg-secondary text-white hover:bg-secondary-dark",
  outline: "border border-border text-text hover:bg-surface-2",
  ghost: "bg-transparent text-text hover:bg-surface-2",
  danger: "bg-error text-white hover:opacity-90",
};

const sizeStyles: Record<string, string> = {
  sm: "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg gap-1.5",
  md: "px-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-xl gap-2",
  lg: "px-6 py-3 text-base rounded-2xl gap-2.5",
};

export const MotionButton = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, MotionButtonProps>(
  ({ children, variant = "primary", size = "md", className = "", disabled, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { shouldReduceMotion } = useMotionPreference();

    return (
      <motion.button
        ref={ref}
        disabled={disabled}
        whileHover={shouldReduceMotion || disabled ? undefined : { scale: 1.02, y: -1 }}
        whileTap={shouldReduceMotion || disabled ? undefined : { scale: 0.96 }}
        transition={SPRINGS.snappy}
        className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed will-change-transform ${variantStyles[variant]} ${sizeStyles[size]} ${className}`}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </motion.button>
    );
  }
);
MotionButton.displayName = "MotionButton";

/* ─── 2. MotionCard (Smooth Composite Elevation) ─── */
export interface MotionCardProps extends HTMLMotionProps<"div"> {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  interactive?: boolean;
}

export const MotionCard = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MotionCardProps>(
  ({ children, interactive = false, className = "", ...props }, ref) => {
    const { shouldReduceMotion } = useMotionPreference();

    return (
      <motion.div
        ref={ref}
        whileHover={interactive && !shouldReduceMotion ? { y: -4, scale: 1.01 } : undefined}
        whileTap={interactive && !shouldReduceMotion ? { scale: 0.99 } : undefined}
        transition={SPRINGS.gentle}
        className={`rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-5 shadow-sm transition-shadow ${
          interactive ? "cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40 will-change-transform" : ""
        } ${className}`}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </motion.div>
    );
  }
);
MotionCard.displayName = "MotionCard";

/* ─── 3. MotionModal (Backdrop + Spring Pop-up) ─── */
export interface MotionModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  maxWidth?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl";
}

const maxWidthStyles = {
  sm: "max-w-sm",
  md: "max-w-md",
  lg: "max-w-lg",
  xl: "max-w-xl",
};

export function MotionModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  maxWidth = "md",
}: MotionModalProps) {
  const { shouldReduceMotion } = useMotionPreference();

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          {/* Backdrop */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: shouldReduceMotion ? 0 : DURATIONS.fast }}
            onClick={onClose}
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm"
          />

          {/* Modal Box */}
          <motion.div
            variants={MOTION_VARIANTS.modalDialog}
            initial={shouldReduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : "initial"}
            animate={shouldReduceMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : "animate"}
            exit={shouldReduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : "exit"}
            className={`relative z-10 w-full ${maxWidthStyles[maxWidth]} overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-2xl will-change-transform`}
          >
            {title && (
              <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-text">{title}</h3>
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  aria-label="Close modal"
                  className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-text-2 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text transition-colors"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {children}
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

/* ─── 4. StaggerList & StaggerItem (60fps Cascading) ─── */
export function StaggerList({
  children,
  className = "",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      variants={MOTION_VARIANTS.staggerContainer}
      initial="initial"
      animate="animate"
      className={className}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export function StaggerItem({
  children,
  className = "",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      variants={MOTION_VARIANTS.staggerItem}
      className={`will-change-transform ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
