"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import CameraAltOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import CloseOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CloseOutlined";
import LogoutOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LogoutOutlined";
import { bus } from "@/lib/event-bus";
import api, { retryPendingRequests, cancelPendingRequests } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";

export default function ReauthOverlay() {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"password" | "face">("password");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubRequired = bus.on("auth:required", () => setOpen(true));
    const unsubCancelled = bus.on("auth:cancelled", () => {
      setOpen(false);
      cancelPendingRequests();
    });
    return () => {
      unsubRequired();
      unsubCancelled();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      stopCamera();
      setMode("password");
      setPassword("");
      setError("");
    }
  }, [open]);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      stopCamera();
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "user", width: { ideal: 320 }, height: { ideal: 240 } },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
    } catch {
      setError("Không thể mở camera");
      setMode("password");
    }
  }, [stopCamera]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === "face") startCamera();
    return () => { if (mode === "face") stopCamera(); };
  }, [mode, startCamera, stopCamera]);

  const captureAndLogin = useCallback(async () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !video.videoWidth) return;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((res) => canvas.toBlob(res, "image/jpeg", 0.85));
    if (!blob) return;
    const file = new File([blob], "face.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await api.faceLogin(file);
      if (res.access_token) {
        retryPendingRequests(res.access_token);
        setOpen(false);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || "Xác thực khuôn mặt thất bại");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handlePasswordSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.login({ email: user?.email || "", password });
      if (!res.access_token) throw new Error("Không nhận được token");
      retryPendingRequests(res.access_token);
      setOpen(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || "Đăng nhập thất bại");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await logout();
    cancelPendingRequests();
    setOpen(false);
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 9999,
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)",
        backdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          borderRadius: 3,
          p: 4,
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 400,
          mx: 2,
          position: "relative",
        }}
      >
        <IconButton
          onClick={() => { setOpen(false); cancelPendingRequests(); }}
          sx={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, right: 8 }}
          size="small"
        >
          <CloseOutlinedIcon />
        </IconButton>

        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5 }}>
          Phiên đăng nhập hết hạn
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textAlign: "center", mb: 3 }}>
          Vui lòng xác thực lại để tiếp tục
        </Typography>

        {error && (
          <Typography color="error" variant="body2" sx={{ textAlign: "center", mb: 2 }}>
            {error}
          </Typography>
        )}

        {mode === "password" ? (
          <Box component="form" onSubmit={handlePasswordSubmit} sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
            <TextField label="Email" value={user?.email || ""} disabled size="small" />
            <TextField
              label="Mật khẩu"
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              size="small"
              autoFocus
              slotProps={{ htmlInput: { "aria-label": "mật khẩu" } }}
            />
            <Button type="submit" variant="contained" disabled={loading || !password} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
              {loading ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : "Đăng nhập"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="text"
              onClick={() => setMode("face")}
              startIcon={<CameraAltOutlinedIcon />}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
            >
              Đăng nhập bằng khuôn mặt
            </Button>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
            <Box
              sx={{
                position: "relative",
                overflow: "hidden",
                borderRadius: 2,
                bgcolor: "common.black",
                aspectRatio: "4 / 3",
              }}
            >
              <Box component="video" ref={videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }} />
            </Box>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={captureAndLogin}
              disabled={loading}
              startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={18} color="inherit" /> : <CameraAltOutlinedIcon />}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
            >
              {loading ? "Đang xử lý..." : "Chụp & Xác thực"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="text"
              onClick={() => setMode("password")}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
            >
              Quay lại đăng nhập mật khẩu
            </Button>
          </Box>
        )}

        <Box sx={{ mt: 2, textAlign: "center" }}>
          <Button
            color="error"
            size="small"
            startIcon={<LogoutOutlinedIcon />}
            onClick={handleLogout}
            sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
          >
            Đăng xuất
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/AIWidget/hooks/useAudioPlayer.ts

'use client';

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';

interface UseAudioPlayerReturn {
  isPlaying: boolean;
  play: (audioBase64: string) => Promise<void>;
  stop: () => void;
  error: string | null;
}

export function useAudioPlayer(): UseAudioPlayerReturn {
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const sourceRef = useRef<AudioBufferSourceNode | null>(null);

  const play = useCallback(async (audioBase64: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      stop();

      if (!audioContextRef.current) {
        audioContextRef.current = new AudioContext();
      }
      const audioContext = audioContextRef.current;

      const binaryString = atob(audioBase64);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
      }

      const audioBuffer = await audioContext.decodeAudioData(bytes.buffer);

      const source = audioContext.createBufferSource();
      source.buffer = audioBuffer;
      source.connect(audioContext.destination);

      source.onended = () => {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        sourceRef.current = null;
      };

      source.start(0);
      sourceRef.current = source;
      setIsPlaying(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to play audio');
      setIsPlaying(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    if (sourceRef.current) {
      sourceRef.current.stop();
      sourceRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsPlaying(false);
  }, []);

  return {
    isPlaying,
    play,
    stop,
    error,
  };
}

File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/AIWidget/hooks/useVoiceRecorder.ts

'use client';

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';

interface UseVoiceRecorderReturn {
  isRecording: boolean;
  audioBase64: string | null;
  startRecording: () => Promise<void>;
  stopRecording: () => Promise<void>;
  error: string | null;
}

export function useVoiceRecorder(): UseVoiceRecorderReturn {
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [audioBase64, setAudioBase64] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  const startRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setAudioBase64(null);

      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, {
        mimeType: 'audio/webm;codecs=opus',
      });

      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      chunksRef.current = [];

      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
        if (event.data.size > 0) {
          chunksRef.current.push(event.data);
        }
      };

      mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
        const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = () => {
          const base64 = (reader.result as string).split(',')[1];
          setAudioBase64(base64);
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);

        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      };

      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to start recording');
      setIsRecording(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const stopRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
        mediaRecorderRef.current.onstop = () => {
          const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onloadend = () => {
            const base64 = (reader.result as string).split(',')[1];
            setAudioBase64(base64);
            setIsRecording(false);
            resolve();
          };
          reader.readAsDataURL(blob);

          mediaRecorderRef.current?.stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
        };
        mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      } else {
        setIsRecording(false);
        resolve();
      }
    });
  }, [isRecording]);

  return {
    isRecording,
    audioBase64,
    startRecording,
    stopRecording,
    error,
  };
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AlertIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import LockIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlineOutlined";
import type { BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";

export interface BookBulkDeleteDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedIds: Set<string>;
  displayBooks: BookWithStats[];
  deleteInput: string;
  setDeleteInput: (val: string) => void;
  deleteConfirmed: boolean;
  deleting: boolean;
  onDelete: () => void;
}

export function BookBulkDeleteDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
  selectedIds,
  displayBooks,
  deleteInput,
  setDeleteInput,
  deleteConfirmed,
  deleting,
  onDelete,
}: BookBulkDeleteDialogProps) {
  const selectedBooks = displayBooks.filter((b) => selectedIds.has(b.id));
  const hasBorrowed = selectedBooks.some((b) => b.total_copies - b.available_copies > 0);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1, fontFamily: "'Space Grotesk', sans-serif" }}>
        <AlertIcon sx={{ color: "warning.main" }} />
        Xóa {selectedIds.size} cuốn sách?
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
            Sách sẽ bị xóa vĩnh viễn cùng tất cả bản sao:
          </Typography>
          <Box sx={{ maxHeight: 200, overflow: "auto", p: 1, bgcolor: "grey.900", borderRadius: 1 }}>
            {selectedBooks.map((book) => (
              <Stack key={book.id} direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ py: 0.5, alignItems: "center" }}>
                {book.total_copies - book.available_copies > 0 ? (
                  <LockIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "error.main" }} />
                ) : null}
                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", color: "text.secondary", minWidth: 120 }}>
                  {book.isbn}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, flex: 1 }} noWrap>
                  {book.title}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                  {book.total_copies} bản
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            ))}
          </Box>
          {hasBorrowed ? (
            <Alert severity="error">
              Một số sách đang được mượn và sẽ không thể xóa. Hệ thống sẽ bỏ qua chúng.
            </Alert>
          ) : null}
          <TextField
            label='Nhập "XÓA" để xác nhận'
            value={deleteInput}
            onChange={(e) => setDeleteInput(e.target.value)}
            fullWidth
            size="small"
            autoFocus
          />
        </Stack>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions sx={{ p: 2 }}>
        <Button onClick={onClose} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
          Hủy
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          color="error"
          disabled={!deleteConfirmed || deleting}
          onClick={onDelete}
          startIcon={deleting ? <CircularProgress size={16} /> : <DeleteIcon />}
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
        >
          {deleting ? "Đang xóa..." : "Xóa vĩnh viễn"}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  Chip,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  IconButton,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AlertIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import CheckIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlineOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";
import type { BookImportPreviewRow } from "@/lib/types";
import { BarcodeRangeList } from "./BarcodeRangeList";

export interface BookImportPreviewSectionProps {
  previewFile: File | null;
  previewData: BookImportPreviewRow[] | null;
  setPreviewData: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<BookImportPreviewRow[] | null>>;
  selectedPreviewIndices: Set<number>;
  setSelectedPreviewIndices: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Set<number>>>;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onImport: () => void;
  importing: boolean;
  showNotice: (severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info", message: string) => void;
}

function statusColor(status: string): "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error" | "default" {
  if (["new", "imported"].includes(status)) return "success";
  if (["updated"].includes(status)) return "info";
  if (["exists", "skipped"].includes(status)) return "default";
  if (["warning"].includes(status)) return "warning";
  return "error";
}

function statusLabel(status: string) {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    exists: "Đã có",
    new: "Mới",
    warning: "Cảnh báo",
    invalid: "Lỗi",
    imported: "Thành công",
    updated: "Cập nhật",
    skipped: "Bỏ qua",
    error: "Lỗi",
  };
  return labels[status] || status;
}

export function BookImportPreviewSection({
  previewFile,
  previewData,
  setPreviewData,
  selectedPreviewIndices,
  setSelectedPreviewIndices,
  onCancel,
  onImport,
  importing,
  showNotice,
}: BookImportPreviewSectionProps) {
  const [deletePreviewOpen, setDeletePreviewOpen] = useState(false);

  if (!previewFile || !previewData) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <DashboardCard title={`Xem trước: ${previewFile.name} (${previewData.length} dòng)`}>
        <Stack spacing={2}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
              {selectedPreviewIndices.size > 0 ? `Đã chọn ${selectedPreviewIndices.size} dòng` : "Chọn dòng để xóa"}
            </Typography>
            {selectedPreviewIndices.size > 0 ? (
              <Button
                size="small"
                color="error"
                variant="outlined"
                startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                onClick={() => setDeletePreviewOpen(true)}
              >
                Xóa {selectedPreviewIndices.size} dòng
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </Stack>

          <TableContainer component={Paper} variant="outlined" sx={{ maxHeight: 320, borderRadius: 2, overflowX: "auto" }}>
            <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
              <TableHead>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell padding="checkbox" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>
                    <Checkbox
                      size="small"
                      indeterminate={
                        selectedPreviewIndices.size > 0 &&
                        selectedPreviewIndices.size < (previewData?.filter((r) => r.status !== "invalid").length ?? 0)
                      }
                      checked={
                        !!previewData?.length &&
                        selectedPreviewIndices.size === previewData.filter((r) => r.status !== "invalid").length
                      }
                      onChange={(_, checked) => {
                        if (checked) {
                          setSelectedPreviewIndices(
                            new Set(previewData.map((_, i) => i).filter((i) => previewData[i].status !== "invalid"))
                          );
                        } else {
                          setSelectedPreviewIndices(new Set());
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>ISBN</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>Tên sách</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>Tác giả</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>NXB</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>Số lượng</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>Mã vạch mẫu</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>Trạng thái</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderBottom: "2px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>
                    Xóa
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHead>
              <TableBody>
                {previewData.length === 0 ? (
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell colSpan={10} align="center" sx={{ py: 3, color: "text.secondary" }}>
                      Không có dòng nào
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ) : (
                  previewData.slice(0, 50).map((row, index) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedPreviewIndices.has(index);
                    const isInvalid = row.status === "invalid";
                    return (
                      <TableRow
                        key={`${row.isbn}-${index}`}
                        selected={isInvalid || isSelected}
                        sx={{
                          "&:hover .preview-delete-btn": { opacity: 1 },
                          "& > td": { py: 0.5 },
                          cursor: isInvalid ? "default" : "pointer",
                          ...staggerSx(index, 0.03),
                        }}
                      >
                        <TableCell padding="checkbox">
                          <Checkbox
                            size="small"
                            checked={isSelected}
                            disabled={isInvalid}
                            onChange={(_, checked) => {
                              const newSet = new Set(selectedPreviewIndices);
                              if (checked) newSet.add(index);
                              else newSet.delete(index);
                              setSelectedPreviewIndices(newSet);
                            }}
                            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", py: 0.5 }}>{row.isbn || "-"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>{row.title || "-"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>{row.author || "-"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>{row.publisher || "-"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>{row.quantity}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>
                          <BarcodeRangeList barcodes={row.barcodes} />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>
                          <Chip size="small" color={statusColor(row.status)} label={statusLabel(row.status)} />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell align="center" sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>
                          <IconButton
                            className="preview-delete-btn"
                            size="small"
                            sx={{ opacity: 0, transition: "opacity 0.15s" }}
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              setPreviewData(previewData.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
                              setSelectedPreviewIndices((prev) => {
                                const next = new Set<number>();
                                prev.forEach((v) => {
                                  if (v < index) next.add(v);
                                  else if (v > index) next.add(v - 1);
                                });
                                return next;
                              });
                              showNotice("info", "Đã xóa dòng");
                            }}
                          >
                            <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" color="error" />
                          </IconButton>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </TableContainer>

          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
            <Button variant="outlined" onClick={onCancel} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
              Hủy
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              startIcon={<CheckIcon />}
              onClick={onImport}
              disabled={importing}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
            >
              {importing ? "Đang nhập..." : "Xác nhận nhập kho"}
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </DashboardCard>

      <Dialog open={deletePreviewOpen} onClose={() => setDeletePreviewOpen(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
          <AlertIcon sx={{ color: "warning.main" }} />
          Xóa {selectedPreviewIndices.size} dòng khỏi danh sách?
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
              Các dòng sau sẽ bị xóa khỏi danh sách trước khi nhập:
            </Typography>
            <Box sx={{ maxHeight: 200, overflow: "auto", p: 1, bgcolor: "grey.900", borderRadius: 1 }}>
              {previewData?.filter((_, i) => selectedPreviewIndices.has(i)).slice(0, 10).map((row, idx) => (
                <Stack key={idx} direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ py: 0.5, alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", color: "text.secondary", minWidth: 130 }}>
                    {row.isbn}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, flex: 1 }} noWrap>
                    {row.title || "Không có tên"}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                    SL: {row.quantity}
                  </Typography>
                </Stack>
              ))}
              {selectedPreviewIndices.size > 10 ? (
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", mt: 1, textAlign: "center" }}>
                  ... và {selectedPreviewIndices.size - 10} dòng khác
                </Typography>
              ) : null}
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setDeletePreviewOpen(false)}>Hủy</Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            color="error"
            startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
            onClick={() => {
              setPreviewData(previewData.filter((_, i) => !selectedPreviewIndices.has(i)));
              setSelectedPreviewIndices(new Set());
              setDeletePreviewOpen(false);
              showNotice("info", `Đã xóa ${selectedPreviewIndices.size} dòng`);
            }}
          >
            Xóa {selectedPreviewIndices.size} dòng
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import type { BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";

export interface BookQuantityDialogProps {
  selectedBook: BookWithStats | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  editQuantity: number;
  setEditQuantity: (q: number) => void;
  quantityError: string;
  setQuantityError: (err: string) => void;
  onSave: () => void;
  savingQuantity: boolean;
}

export function BookQuantityDialog({
  selectedBook,
  onClose,
  editQuantity,
  setEditQuantity,
  quantityError,
  setQuantityError,
  onSave,
  savingQuantity,
}: BookQuantityDialogProps) {
  if (!selectedBook) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!selectedBook} onClose={onClose} fullWidth maxWidth="sm">
      <DialogTitle sx={{ fontFamily: "'Space Grotesk', sans-serif", fontWeight: 700 }}>
        Sửa số lượng sách
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            {selectedBook.cover_url ? (
              <Box
                component="img"
                src={selectedBook.cover_url}
                alt={selectedBook.title}
                sx={{ width: 48, height: 64, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 1 }}
              />
            ) : (
              <Paper
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{ width: 48, height: 64, display: "grid", placeItems: "center", borderRadius: 1 }}
              >
                <BookIcon />
              </Paper>
            )}
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }} noWrap>
                {selectedBook.title}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace" }}>
                ISBN: {selectedBook.isbn}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Stack>
          <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(3, 1fr)" }, gap: 1 }}>
            <Alert severity="info">Tổng: {selectedBook.total_copies}</Alert>
            <Alert severity="success">Sẵn sàng: {selectedBook.available_copies}</Alert>
            <Alert severity="warning">Đang mượn: {selectedBook.total_copies - selectedBook.available_copies}</Alert>
          </Box>
          {selectedBook.publisher ? (
            <Typography variant="body2">
              <strong>NXB:</strong> {selectedBook.publisher}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          {selectedBook.published_date ? (
            <Typography variant="body2">
              <strong>Năm XB:</strong> {selectedBook.published_date}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          {selectedBook.categories ? (
            <Typography variant="body2">
              <strong>Thể loại:</strong> {selectedBook.categories}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          {selectedBook.page_count ? (
            <Typography variant="body2">
              <strong>Số trang:</strong> {selectedBook.page_count}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          {selectedBook.average_rating ? (
            <Typography variant="body2">
              <strong>Đánh giá:</strong> {selectedBook.average_rating}/5
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          {selectedBook.language ? (
            <Typography variant="body2">
              <strong>Ngôn ngữ:</strong> {selectedBook.language}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          {selectedBook.description ? (
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{ display: "-webkit-box", WebkitLineClamp: 3, WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical", overflow: "hidden" }}
            >
              {selectedBook.description}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}
          <TextField
            label="Số lượng mới"
            type="number"
            value={editQuantity}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setEditQuantity(Number(event.target.value) || 0);
              setQuantityError("");
            }}
            error={!!quantityError}
            helperText={quantityError || "Số lượng không được nhỏ hơn số bản đang mượn"}
            fullWidth
            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1 } }}
          />
        </Stack>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions sx={{ p: 2 }}>
        <Button onClick={onClose} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
          Hủy
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          onClick={onSave}
          disabled={savingQuantity}
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
        >
          {savingQuantity ? "Đang lưu..." : "Lưu thay đổi"}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Grid,
  LinearProgress,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,

} from "@mui/material";
import ArrowForwardIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward";
import BadgeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/BadgeOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import FaceIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceOutlined";
import VideocamIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VideocamOutlined";
import WarningIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";

import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";

import { fadeInUp } from "@/lib/animations";

export interface BorrowStepPatronProps {
  patronCode: string;
  setPatronCode: (val: string) => void;
  patronId: string | null;
  patronName: string;
  activeCount: number;
  overdueCount: number;
  borrowConfig: { max_borrow_books: number };
  remaining: number;
  canBorrow: boolean;
  faceVerifyDisabled: boolean;
  handleLookupAndOpenCamera: () => void;
  startWebcam: () => void;
  handleFaceVerify: () => void;
  setOverdueGuideOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  setCurrentStep: (step: number) => void;
  videoRef: React.RefObject<HTMLVideoElement | null>;
  cameraStarted: boolean;
  cameraLoading: boolean;
  cameraReady: boolean;
  cameraError: string;
  faceScanning: boolean;
}

export function BorrowStepPatron({
  patronCode,
  setPatronCode,
  patronId,
  patronName,
  activeCount,
  overdueCount,
  borrowConfig,
  remaining,
  canBorrow,
  faceVerifyDisabled,
  handleLookupAndOpenCamera,
  startWebcam,
  handleFaceVerify,
  setOverdueGuideOpen,
  setCurrentStep,
  videoRef,

                }}
                placeholder="Nhập mã số sinh viên (MSSV)..."
                size="small"
                fullWidth

                sx={{
                  "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {

                    bgcolor: "background.paper",
                    "&:hover": { "& fieldset": { borderColor: "primary.main" } },
                  },
                }}
              />
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                fullWidth
                onClick={handleLookupAndOpenCamera}
                disabled={faceVerifyDisabled}
                startIcon={<FaceIcon />}
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: "4px",
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  textTransform: "none",
                  py: 1.2,
                }}
              >
                Kiểm tra & Bật camera
              </Button>
            </Stack>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>

        {patronId ? (
          <Box sx={{ ...staggerSx(2), animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.4s ease-out` }}>
            <DashboardCard noPadding>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  px: 2.5,
                  pt: 2,
                  pb: 2.5,
                  borderLeft: 4,
                  borderLeftColor: overdueCount > 0 ? "error.main" : "success.main",
                }}
              >
                <Stack spacing={2}>
                  <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 2 }}>
                    <AvatarUser name={patronName || patronId} role="patron" size={48} />
                    <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }} noWrap>
                        {patronName || patronId}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace" }}>
                        MSSV: {patronCode}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                    <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Đã xác minh" icon={<CheckCircleIcon />} sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }} />
                  </Box>
                  <Divider />
                  <Stack spacing={1}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        Số sách đã mượn
                      </Typography>
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        color={activeCount >= borrowConfig.max_borrow_books ? "error" : "primary"}
                        label={`${activeCount}/${borrowConfig.max_borrow_books}`}
                        sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}
                      />
                    </Box>
                    <LinearProgress
                      variant="determinate"
                      value={(activeCount / borrowConfig.max_borrow_books) * 100}
                      color={activeCount >= borrowConfig.max_borrow_books ? "error" : "primary"}
                      sx={{ borderRadius: "2px", height: 6, bgcolor: "action.hover" }}
                    />
                    {overdueCount > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ py: 0.5, borderRadius: "4px" }}>
                          <WarningIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ mr: 0.5 }} />
                          Có {overdueCount} cuốn sách quá hạn
                        </Alert>
                        <Button
                          variant="outlined"
                          size="small"
                          onClick={() => setOverdueGuideOpen(true)}
                          sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, borderRadius: "4px" }}
                        >
                          Xem hướng dẫn xử lý
                        </Button>
                      </>
                    ) : null}
                    <Typography variant="body2" color={remaining > 0 ? "text.secondary" : "error"} sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                      {remaining > 0 ? `Được phép mượn thêm ${remaining} cuốn` : "Đã đạt giới hạn số lượng mượn"}
                    </Typography>
                  </Stack>
                  <Divider />
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    fullWidth
                    size="large"
                    endIcon={<ArrowForwardIcon />}
                    disabled={!canBorrow}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentStep(1)}
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: "4px",
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      textTransform: "none",
                      py: 1.4,
                    }}
                  >
                    {canBorrow ? "Tiếp tục: Quét mã vạch sách" : overdueCount > 0 ? "Cần trả sách quá hạn" : "Đã đạt giới hạn mượn"}
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              </Box>
            </DashboardCard>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <Box sx={staggerSx(2)}>
            <DashboardCard>
              <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", color: "text.secondary", minHeight: 200, justifyContent: "center" }}>
                <BadgeIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56, opacity: 0.2 }} />
                <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, textAlign: "center" }}>
                  Nhập MSSV hoặc quét khuôn mặt<br />để xác minh độc giả
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            </DashboardCard>
          </Box>
        )}
      </Grid>

      {/* Right Column: Face Camera Feed */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 7, lg: 8 }} sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2, overflowY: "auto", minHeight: 0 }}>
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard title="Camera nhận diện khuôn mặt" actions={<VideocamIcon color="primary" />} noPadding>
            <Box
              sx={{
                bgcolor: "background.paper",
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: "divider",
                borderRadius: "4px",
                overflow: "hidden",
                position: "relative",
                minHeight: 400,
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
              }}
            >
              {cameraError ? (
                <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", height: "100%", color: "grey.300", p: 3 }}>
                  <VideocamIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: "error.main" }} />
                  <Typography sx={{ textAlign: "center", color: "text.primary" }}>{cameraError}</Typography>
                  <Button size="small" variant="outlined" color="primary" onClick={startWebcam}>
                    Thử lại
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              ) : !cameraStarted ? (
                <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", p: 4, textAlign: "center" }}>
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      width: 68,
                      height: 68,
                      borderRadius: "50%",
                      bgcolor: (t) => (t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.04)"),
                      display: "grid",
                      placeItems: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    <VideocamIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                  </Box>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      Camera xác minh đang ở chế độ chờ
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 0.5, maxWidth: 340 }}>
                      Bấm nút bên dưới hoặc nhập MSSV để bật camera nhận diện độc giả
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    size="medium"
                    startIcon={<VideocamIcon />}
                    onClick={startWebcam}
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: "4px",
                      textTransform: "none",
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      px: 3,
                    }}
                  >
                    Mở camera
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <video
                    ref={videoRef as any}
                    autoPlay
                    playsInline
                    muted
                    style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain", display: "block", transform: "scaleX(-1)" }}
                  />
                  {cameraLoading && !cameraReady ? (
                    <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.65)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1.5}>
                      <CircularProgress size={32} color="inherit" />
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : null}
                  {faceScanning && cameraReady ? (
                    <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.65)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1.5}>
                      <CircularProgress size={32} color="inherit" />
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Đang xác minh khuôn mặt...</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : null}
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ position: "absolute", bottom: 12, left: 12, right: 12, justifyContent: "center" }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      size="large"
                      startIcon={<FaceIcon />}
                      onClick={handleFaceVerify}
                      disabled={!cameraReady || faceScanning || !patronCode.trim()}
                      sx={{ display: cameraReady ? undefined : "none", minWidth: 200, borderRadius: "4px", fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}
                    >
                      {faceScanning ? "Đang xác minh..." : "Xác minh khuôn mặt"}
                    </Button>
                  </Stack>
                </>
              )}
            </Box>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { Box, Button, Chip, Stack, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import ArrowForwardIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward";
import CalendarIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import type { StaffScheduleAssignment } from "@/lib/types";

interface TodayScheduleCardProps {
  assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  loading: boolean;
}

function formatShiftTime(startTime?: string, endTime?: string) {
  if (!startTime || !endTime) return "";
  return `${startTime.slice(0, 5)} - ${endTime.slice(0, 5)}`;
}

function statusColor(status: string) {
  const map: Record<string, "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info" | "default"> = {
    approved: "success",
    confirmed: "success",
    checked_in: "success",
    pending: "warning",
    pending_confirm: "warning",
    pending_admin_confirm: "warning",
    unchecked: "error",
    absent: "error",
    cancelled: "default",
  };
  return map[status] || "default";
}

function statusLabel(status: string) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    approved: "Đã duyệt",
    confirmed: "Đã xác nhận",
    checked_in: "Đã check-in",
    pending: "Chờ duyệt",
    pending_confirm: "Chờ xác nhận",
    pending_admin_confirm: "Chờ admin",
    unchecked: "Chưa check-in",
    absent: "Vắng mặt",
    cancelled: "Đã hủy",
  };
  return map[status] || status;
}

export default function TodayScheduleCard({ assignments, loading }: TodayScheduleCardProps) {
  return (
    <DashboardCard
      title="Lịch trực hôm nay"
      subtitle={`${assignments.length} ca trực`}
      actions={
        <Button component={Link} href="/staff-schedules" endIcon={<ArrowForwardIcon />} size="small">
          Xem lịch
        </Button>
      }
      noPadding
    >
      {assignments.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<CalendarIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
          title="Hôm nay không có ca trực"
        />
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
          {assignments.slice(0, 6).map((a) => (
            <Stack
              key={a.id}
              direction="row"
              spacing={1.5}
              sx={{
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                p: 1.5,
                borderRadius: 2,
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: "divider",
              }}
            >
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", minWidth: 0 }}>
                <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} noWrap>
                    {a.shift?.name || "Ca trực"} · {formatShiftTime(a.shift?.startTime, a.shift?.endTime)}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                    {a.staff?.fullName || a.staffId} · {a.zone?.zoneName || a.zoneId}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              </Stack>
              <Chip size="small" label={statusLabel(a.status)} color={statusColor(a.status)} sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem" }} />
            </Stack>
          ))}
        </Stack>
      )}
    </DashboardCard>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Chip,
  Divider,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  TextField,
  ToggleButton,
  ToggleButtonGroup,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import MenuBookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBook";
import SearchIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Search";
import ClearIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Clear";
import FiberManualRecordIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FiberManualRecord";
import type { BookData, ShelfData } from "./types";

interface FloorMapProps {
  shelves: ShelfData[];
  onBookClick?: (book: BookData) => void;
}

interface ShelfGroup {
  shelf: ShelfData;
  tiers: TierRow[];
}

interface TierRow {
  tierIndex: number;
  faces: [BookData[], BookData[]];
}

function groupByFloor(shelves: ShelfData[]): Record<string, ShelfData[]> {
  const map: Record<string, ShelfData[]> = {};
  for (const s of shelves) {
    const f = s.floor || "A";
    if (!map[f]) map[f] = [];
    map[f].push(s);
  }
  for (const f of Object.keys(map)) {
    map[f].sort((a, b) => a.shelfNum - b.shelfNum);
  }
  return map;
}

function buildGroups(shelves: ShelfData[], query: string): ShelfGroup[] {
  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  return shelves
    .map((shelf) => {
      const tierMap = new Map<number, [BookData[], BookData[]]>();
      for (const book of shelf.books) {
        if (q) {
          const match =
            book.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            book.author.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            book.isbn.toLowerCase().includes(q);
          if (!match) continue;
        }
        if (!tierMap.has(book.tierIndex)) tierMap.set(book.tierIndex, [[], []]);
        const face = book.face === 1 ? 1 : 0;
        tierMap.get(book.tierIndex)![face].push(book);
      }
      const tiers: TierRow[] = Array.from(tierMap.entries())
        .sort(([a], [b]) => a - b)
        .map(([tierIndex, faces]) => ({ tierIndex, faces }));
      return { shelf, tiers };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.shelf.shelfNum - b.shelf.shelfNum);
}

const FACE_LABELS = ["Mặt trái", "Mặt phải"] as const;

export default function FloorMap({ shelves, onBookClick }: FloorMapProps) {
  const floorMap = useMemo(() => groupByFloor(shelves), [shelves]);
  const floors = useMemo(() => Object.keys(floorMap).sort(), [floorMap]);

  const [activeFloor, setActiveFloor] = useState(() => floors[0] || "A");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  const currentShelves = floorMap[activeFloor] || [];
  const groups = useMemo(() => buildGroups(currentShelves, searchQuery), [currentShelves, searchQuery]);

  const totalBooks = useMemo(() => {
    return currentShelves.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.books.length, 0);
  }, [currentShelves]);

  const searchResultCount = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.tiers.reduce((ts, t) => ts + t.faces[0].length + t.faces[1].length, 0), 0);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ minHeight: "100vh", bgcolor: "background.default", p: 3 }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
        <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
          <MenuBookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 28, color: "primary.main" }} />
          Bản đồ thư viện
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
          Chọn tầng để xem vị trí sách trên kệ
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      {/* Floor tabs */}
      <ToggleButtonGroup
        value={activeFloor}
        exclusive
        onChange={(_, v) => v && setActiveFloor(v)}
        size="small"
        sx={{ mb: 2, "& .MuiToggleButton-root": { px: 2, py: 1, textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600 } }}
      >
        {floors.map((f) => (
          <ToggleButton key={f} value={f}>
            Tầng {f}
          </ToggleButton>
        ))}
      </ToggleButtonGroup>

      {/* Search bar */}
      <TextField
        size="small"
        fullWidth
        placeholder="Tìm kiếm sách theo tên, tác giả, ISBN..."
        value={searchQuery}
        onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
        sx={{ mb: 2, maxWidth: 480 }}
        slotProps={{
          input: {
            startAdornment: <InputAdornment position="start"><SearchIcon fontSize="small" /></InputAdornment>,
            endAdornment: searchQuery ? (
              <InputAdornment position="end">
                <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}>
                  <ClearIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </InputAdornment>
            ) : undefined,
          },
        }}
      />

      {/* Stats */}
      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 2, mb: 2 }}>
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          Kệ: <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{currentShelves.length}</Box>
        </Typography>
        <Divider orientation="vertical" flexItem />
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
          Sách: <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{totalBooks}</Box>
        </Typography>
        {searchQuery && (
          <>
            <Divider orientation="vertical" flexItem />
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Kết quả: <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main" }}>{searchResultCount}</Box>
            </Typography>
          </>
        )}
      </Box>

      {/* Table */}
      {groups.length === 0 ? (
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", py: 8, color: "text.secondary" }}>
          <MenuBookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, opacity: 0.3, mb: 1 }} />
          <Typography variant="body2">Không tìm thấy kệ nào{searchQuery ? ` với từ khóa "${searchQuery}"` : ""}</Typography>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <TableContainer sx={{ borderRadius: 2, border: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
          <Table size="small">
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow sx={{ bgcolor: "background.paper" }}>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, width: 120 }}>Kệ</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, width: 100 }}>Tầng kệ</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, width: 110 }}>Mặt</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>Sách</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {groups.map((group) =>
                group.tiers.flatMap((tier, ti) =>
                  tier.faces.map((faceBooks, faceIdx) => {
                    const isFirstRowOfShelf = ti === 0 && faceIdx === 0;
                    const isFirstFaceOfTier = faceIdx === 0;
                    return (
                      <TableRow
                        key={`${group.shelf.id}-${tier.tierIndex}-${faceIdx}`}
                        sx={{
                          borderTop: ti === 0 && faceIdx === 0 ? 2 : 1,
                          borderColor: ti === 0 && faceIdx === 0 ? "primary.light" : "divider",
                          "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(25,118,210,0.03)" },
                        }}
                      >
                        {isFirstRowOfShelf && (
                          <TableCell rowSpan={group.tiers.length * 2} sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main", verticalAlign: "top" }}>
                            {group.shelf.code}
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                        {isFirstFaceOfTier && (
                          <TableCell rowSpan={2} sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontWeight: 500, verticalAlign: "top" }}>
                            Tầng {tier.tierIndex + 1}
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", color: "text.secondary" }}>
                          {FACE_LABELS[faceIdx]}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {faceBooks.length === 0 ? (
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>Trống</Typography>
                          ) : (
                            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "2px 12px" }}>
                              {faceBooks.map((book) => (
                                <Tooltip key={book.id} title={book.status === "available" ? "Có sẵn" : "Đã mượn"} arrow>
                                  <Box
                                    component="button"
                                    onClick={() => onBookClick?.(book)}
                                    sx={{
                                      display: "inline-flex",
                                      alignItems: "center",
                                      border: "none",
                                      bgcolor: "transparent",
                                      cursor: "pointer",
                                      p: 0,
                                      "&:hover": { "& .book-title": { color: "primary.main" } },
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <Typography variant="caption" className="book-title" sx={{ transition: "color 0.15s" }}>
                                      {book.title}
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 0.5 }}>
                                      — {book.author}
                                    </Typography>
                                    <FiberManualRecordIcon
                                      sx={{
                                        fontSize: 8,
                                        ml: 0.5,
                                        color: book.status === "available" ? "success.main" : "error.main",
                                      }}
                                    />
                                  </Box>
                                </Tooltip>
                              ))}
                            </Box>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })
                )
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Divider,
  Paper,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  ToggleButton,
  ToggleButtonGroup,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import ViewModuleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ViewModule";
import FiberManualRecordIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FiberManualRecord";
import type { ShelfData, BookData } from "./types";

interface FloorTablePanelProps {
  shelves: ShelfData[];
  onBookClick?: (book: BookData) => void;
  onFloorSelect?: (floor: string) => void;
}

const FACE_LABELS = ["Mặt trái", "Mặt phải"] as const;

function groupByFloor(shelves: ShelfData[]): Record<string, ShelfData[]> {
  const map: Record<string, ShelfData[]> = {};
  for (const s of shelves) {
    const f = s.floor || "A";
    if (!map[f]) map[f] = [];
    map[f].push(s);
  }
  for (const f of Object.keys(map)) {
    map[f].sort((a, b) => a.shelfNum - b.shelfNum);
  }
  return map;
}

export default function FloorTablePanel({ shelves, onBookClick, onFloorSelect }: FloorTablePanelProps) {
  const floorMap = useMemo(() => groupByFloor(shelves), [shelves]);
  const floors = useMemo(() => Object.keys(floorMap).sort(), [floorMap]);
  const [activeFloor, setActiveFloor] = useState(() => floors[0] || "A");

  const currentShelves = floorMap[activeFloor] || [];

  const handleFloorClick = (f: string) => {
    setActiveFloor(f);
    onFloorSelect?.(f);
  };

  return (
    <Paper
      elevation={8}
      sx={{
        position: "absolute",
        top: 56,
        left: 16,
        zIndex: 20,
        width: 520,
        maxHeight: "calc(100vh - 80px)",
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        borderRadius: 2,
        overflow: "hidden",
        backdropFilter: "blur(12px)",
        bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)",
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <Box sx={{ px: 2, pt: 2, pb: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.5 }}>
          <ViewModuleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: "primary.main" }} />
          Bảng chọn tầng
        </Typography>

        {/* Floor tabs */}
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.75, mt: 1.5 }}>
          <ToggleButtonGroup
            value={activeFloor}
            exclusive
            onChange={(_, v) => v && handleFloorClick(v)}
            size="small"
            sx={{ "& .MuiToggleButton-root": { px: 1.5, py: 0.5, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600 } }}
          >
            {floors.map((f) => (
              <ToggleButton key={f} value={f}>
                Tầng {f}
              </ToggleButton>
            ))}
          </ToggleButtonGroup>
          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: "auto", fontSize: "0.65rem" }}>
            {currentShelves.length} kệ
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Table scroll area */}
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", minHeight: 0 }}>
        <TableContainer>
          <Table size="small">
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow sx={{ bgcolor: "background.paper" }}>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, width: 60 }}>Kệ</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, width: 50 }}>Tầng</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, width: 70 }}>Mặt</TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>Sách</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {currentShelves.map((shelf) => {
                const tierMap = new Map<number, [BookData[], BookData[]]>();
                for (const book of shelf.books) {
                  const t = book.tierIndex;
                  if (!tierMap.has(t)) tierMap.set(t, [[], []]);
                  tierMap.get(t)![book.face === 1 ? 1 : 0].push(book);
                }
                const tiers = Array.from(tierMap.entries()).sort(([a], [b]) => a - b);

                return tiers.flatMap(([tierIndex, faces], ti) =>
                  faces.map((faceBooks, faceIdx) => {
                    const isFirst = ti === 0 && faceIdx === 0;
                    const isFirstFace = faceIdx === 0;
                    return (
                      <TableRow
                        key={`${shelf.id}-${tierIndex}-${faceIdx}`}
                        sx={{
                          borderTop: isFirst ? 2 : 1,
                          borderColor: isFirst ? "primary.light" : "divider",
                          "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(25,118,210,0.04)" },
                        }}
                      >
                        {isFirst && (
                          <TableCell rowSpan={tiers.length * 2} sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main", verticalAlign: "top" }}>
                            {shelf.code}
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                        {isFirstFace && (
                          <TableCell rowSpan={2} sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontWeight: 500, verticalAlign: "top" }}>
                            {tierIndex + 1}
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                        <TableCell sx={{ color: "text.secondary", whiteSpace: "nowrap", fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
                          {FACE_LABELS[faceIdx]}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {faceBooks.length === 0 ? (
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>Trống</Typography>
                          ) : (
                            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "2px 8px" }}>
                              {faceBooks.map((book) => (
                                <Tooltip key={book.id} title={book.status === "available" ? "Có sẵn" : "Đã mượn"} arrow>
                                  <Box
                                    component="button"
                                    onClick={() => onBookClick?.(book)}
                                    sx={{
                                      display: "inline-flex",
                                      alignItems: "center",
                                      border: "none",
                                      bgcolor: "transparent",
                                      cursor: "pointer",
                                      p: 0,
                                      "&:hover": { "& .book-title": { color: "primary.main" } },
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <Typography variant="caption" className="book-title" sx={{ transition: "color 0.15s" }}>
                                      {book.title}
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 0.5 }}>
                                      — {book.author}
                                    </Typography>
                                    <FiberManualRecordIcon
                                      sx={{
                                        fontSize: 6,
                                        ml: 0.5,
                                        color: book.status === "available" ? "success.main" : "error.main",
                                      }}
                                    />
                                  </Box>
                                </Tooltip>
                              ))}
                            </Box>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  List,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  ToggleButton,
  ToggleButtonGroup,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AlertIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import QrCodeScannerIcon from "@mui/icons-material/QrCodeScannerOutlined";
import UsersIcon from "@mui/icons-material/GroupsOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import AvatarUser from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/AvatarUser";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import SearchField from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/SearchField";
import type { StaffActiveBorrowerSummary } from "@/lib/types";

export type BorrowerFilter = "all" | "overdue" | "active";

function formatDate(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "-";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN");
}

function borrowerName(borrower: StaffActiveBorrowerSummary) {
  return borrower.patron.full_name || borrower.patron.student_code || "Không rõ tên";
}

interface ReturnBorrowerListProps {
  filteredBorrowers: StaffActiveBorrowerSummary[];
  selectedStudentCode: string | null;
  onSelectBorrower: (code: string) => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (search: string) => void;
  filter: BorrowerFilter;
  onFilterChange: (filter: BorrowerFilter) => void;
  loading: boolean;
  selectedBorrower: StaffActiveBorrowerSummary | null;
  onOpenScanner: () => void;
  onOpenOverdueGuide: () => void;
}

export default function ReturnBorrowerList({
  filteredBorrowers,
  selectedStudentCode,
  onSelectBorrower,
  search,
  onSearchChange,
  filter,
  onFilterChange,
  loading,
  selectedBorrower,
  onOpenScanner,
  onOpenOverdueGuide,
}: ReturnBorrowerListProps) {
  return (
    <Stack spacing={2}>
      <DashboardCard>
        <Stack spacing={2}>
          <SearchField
            value={search}
            onChange={onSearchChange}
            placeholder="Tìm theo MSSV hoặc tên..."
          />

          <ToggleButtonGroup
            exclusive
            fullWidth
            size="small"
            value={filter}
            onChange={(_, value) => value && onFilterChange(value)}
            sx={{
              "& .MuiToggleButton-root": {
                px: 2,
                py: 0.6,
                borderRadius: "20px!important",
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 600,
                fontSize: "0.78rem",
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: "divider",
              },
            }}
          >
            <ToggleButton value="all">Tất cả</ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="overdue">Quá hạn</ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="active">Đúng hạn</ToggleButton>
          </ToggleButtonGroup>
        </Stack>
      </DashboardCard>

      {loading ? (
        <DashboardCard>
          <LoadingOverlay loading message="Đang tải danh sách độc giả..." />
        </DashboardCard>
      ) : filteredBorrowers.length === 0 ? (
        <DashboardCard>
          <EmptyState
            icon={<UsersIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, opacity: 0.3 }} />}
            title="Không tìm thấy độc giả phù hợp"
          />
        </DashboardCard>
      ) : (
        <List disablePadding sx={{ flex: 1, maxHeight: 420, overflowY: "auto", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1 }}>
          {filteredBorrowers.map((borrower) => {
            const selected = borrower.patron.student_code === selectedStudentCode;
            const hasOverdue = borrower.overdue_count > 0;
            return (
              <Paper
                key={borrower.patron.id}
                variant="outlined"
                onClick={() => onSelectBorrower(borrower.patron.student_code)}
                sx={{
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  p: 1.5,
                  borderRadius: 2,
                  borderLeft: 4,
                  borderLeftColor: hasOverdue ? "error.main" : "success.main",
                  borderColor: selected ? "primary.main" : "divider",
                  bgcolor: selected ? "action.selected" : "background.paper",
                  transition: "all .15s",
                  "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.light", transform: "translateY(-1px)", boxShadow: 1 },
                }}
              >
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <AvatarUser
                    user={borrower.patron}
                    name={borrowerName(borrower)}
                    role="patron"
                    size={36}
                  />
                  <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13 }} noWrap>
                      {borrowerName(borrower)}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", display: "block", color: "text.secondary" }}>
                      {borrower.patron.student_code}
                    </Typography>
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", mt: 0.3 }}>
                      <Chip size="small" label={`${borrower.total_borrowed} sách`} sx={{ height: 18, fontSize: 10 }} />
                      {hasOverdue ? (
                        <Chip size="small" color="error" label={`${borrower.overdue_count} quá hạn`} sx={{ height: 18, fontSize: 10 }} />
                      ) : (
                        <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Tốt" sx={{ height: 18, fontSize: 10 }} />
                      )}
                    </Stack>
                  </Box>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textAlign: "right", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    {formatDate(borrower.nearest_due_at)}
                  </Typography>
                </Stack>
              </Paper>
            );
          })}
        </List>
      )}

      {selectedBorrower ? (
        <DashboardCard
          title={borrowerName(selectedBorrower)}
          subtitle={selectedBorrower.patron.student_code}
          actions={<Chip size="small" color="success" label="Đang mượn" icon={<CheckCircleIcon />} />}
        >
          <Stack spacing={2}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <Chip size="small" color="primary" label={`${selectedBorrower.total_borrowed} sách`} />
              {selectedBorrower.overdue_count > 0 ? (
                <Chip size="small" color="error" label={`${selectedBorrower.overdue_count} quá hạn`} />
              ) : null}
            </Stack>

            {selectedBorrower.overdue_count > 0 ? (
              <>
                <Alert severity="error" sx={{ py: 0.5 }}>
                  <AlertIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ mr: 0.5 }} />
                  Có {selectedBorrower.overdue_count} cuốn sách quá hạn
                </Alert>
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  size="small"
                  onClick={onOpenOverdueGuide}
                  sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, borderRadius: 2 }}
                >
                  Xem hướng dẫn xử lý
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : null}

            <Button
              variant="contained"
              size="large"
              fullWidth
              startIcon={<QrCodeScannerIcon />}
              onClick={onOpenScanner}
            >
              Quét mã vạch trả sách
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </DashboardCard>
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { Box, Paper, Typography, Button, Stack, Divider } from "@mui/material";

import type { ScannedCardData } from "@/lib/ocr";

interface CardPreviewProps {

  onRetake: () => void;

export function CardPreview({ data, onConfirm, onRetake, onSkip }: CardPreviewProps) {

      <Stack spacing={2}>
        <Stack direction="row" sx={{ alignItems: "center" }} spacing={1}>
          <CheckCircleIcon color="success" />
          <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Thông tin từ thẻ sinh viên
          </Typography>
        </Stack>
        <Divider />
        <InfoRow label="MSSV" value={data.studentCode} />
        <InfoRow label="Họ tên" value={data.fullName} />
        {data.className != null && <InfoRow label="Lớp" value={data.className} />}
        {data.dateOfBirth != null && <InfoRow label="Ngày sinh" value={data.dateOfBirth} />}
        {data.course != null && <InfoRow label="Khóa học" value={data.course} />}
        {data.permanentAddress != null && <InfoRow label="HKTT" value={data.permanentAddress} />}
        {data.faculty != null && <InfoRow label="Khoa" value={data.faculty} />}
        {data.rawText && (
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ cursor: "pointer", userSelect: "none" }}
              onClick={(e) => {
                const el = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).nextElementSibling;
                if (el) (el as HTMLElement).style.display = el?.getAttribute("data-open") === "1" ? "none" : "block";
                e.currentTarget.setAttribute("data-open", e.currentTarget.getAttribute("data-open") === "1" ? "0" : "1");
              }}
            >
              ▸ Raw OCR text (debug)
            </Typography>
            <Box data-open="0" sx={{ display: "none", mt: 1, p: 1.5, bgcolor: "grey.900", borderRadius: 1, maxHeight: 120, overflow: "auto" }}>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", color: "grey.300", fontSize: "0.7rem" }}>
                {data.rawText}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        )}
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={onConfirm} fullWidth>
            Xác nhận
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outlined" startIcon={<ReplayIcon />} onClick={onRetake} fullWidth>
            Chụp lại
          </Button>
        </Stack>
        {onSkip && (
          <Button color="inherit" variant="text" onClick={onSkip} fullWidth size="small">
            Nhập thủ công
          </Button>
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Paper>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Box, Typography, Button, Stack, Chip, Alert } from "@mui/material";

import HourglassBottomIcon from "@mui/icons-material/HourglassBottom";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircle";
import type { ScannedCardData } from "@/lib/ocr";

type ScannerPhase = "detecting" | "processing" | "confirm";

interface ScannerInfoPanelProps {
  phase: ScannerPhase;
  ocrResult: Partial<ScannedCardData> | null;
  error: string;
  cameraReady: boolean;
  processing: boolean;
