const PHASE_LABELS: Record<ScannerPhase, string> = {
  detecting: "Đang phát hiện thẻ...",
  processing: "Đang nhận dạng...",
  confirm: "Đọc thẻ thành công",
};

const PHASE_COLORS: Record<ScannerPhase, "info" | "primary" | "success"> = {
  detecting: "info",
  processing: "primary",
  confirm: "success",
};

function InfoRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ minWidth: 72, flexShrink: 0, fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
        {label}
      </Typography>
      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: "0.85rem", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>
        {value || "—"}
      </Typography>
    </Stack>
  );
}

const PLACEHOLDER_FIELDS = [
  { label: "MSSV", placeholder: "Đang chờ..." },
  { label: "Họ tên", placeholder: "Đang chờ..." },
  { label: "Lớp", placeholder: "—" },
  { label: "Khóa học", placeholder: "—" },
  { label: "HKTT", placeholder: "—" },
];

function PhaseIcon({ phase }: { phase: ScannerPhase }) {
  if (phase === "detecting") return <RadioButtonUncheckedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />;
  if (phase === "processing") return <HourglassBottomIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />;
  return <CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />;
}

export function ScannerInfoPanel({
  phase, ocrResult, error, cameraReady, processing, onCapture, onFileUpload, onSkip,
}: ScannerInfoPanelProps) {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        flex: 1,
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        bgcolor: "background.paper",
        borderRadius: { xs: "0 0 12px 12px", md: "0 12px 12px 0" },
        borderLeft: { md: "1px solid" },
        borderTop: { xs: "1px solid", md: "none" },
        borderColor: "divider",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ px: 2.5, py: 2, borderBottom: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.3 }}>

            color={PHASE_COLORS[phase]}

            icon={<PhaseIcon phase={phase} />}

      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, px: 2.5, py: 2, overflow: "auto" }}>
        {ocrResult ? (
          <Stack spacing={1.5}>
            <InfoRow label="MSSV" value={ocrResult.studentCode ?? ""} />

                  {field.placeholder}

              </Stack>
            ))}
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Box>

      {error && (
        <Box sx={{ px: 2.5, pb: 1 }}>
          <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>{error}</Alert>
        </Box>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ px: 2.5, py: 2, borderTop: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>
        <Stack spacing={1}>
          <Button
            variant="contained"

          </Button>
          {onSkip && (
            <Button color="inherit" variant="text" onClick={onSkip} fullWidth size="small">

"use client";

import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { Box, Stack, Fade } from "@mui/material";
import Webcam from "react-webcam";
import { useOcrProcessor, type ScannedCardData } from "@/lib/ocr";
import { useFaceScanner } from "@/lib/ocr/useFaceScanner";
import { ScannerUI } from "./ScannerUI";
import { CardPreview } from "./CardPreview";
import { ScannerInfoPanel } from "./ScannerInfoPanel";

type Phase = "detecting" | "processing" | "confirm";

interface StudentCardScannerProps {
  onScanned: (data: ScannedCardData) => void;
  onError?: (error: string) => void;
  onSkip?: () => void;
  videoSource?: "webcam" | "ipcamera";
  ipCameraUrl?: string;
}

export function StudentCardScanner({
  onScanned, onError, onSkip,
  videoSource = "webcam", ipCameraUrl,
}: StudentCardScannerProps) {
  const webcamRef = useRef<Webcam>(null);
  const ipCamRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("detecting");
  const [ocrResult, setOcrResult] = useState<Partial<ScannedCardData> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const autoDetectStarted = useRef(false);

  const { state: ocrState, runOcr } = useOcrProcessor(
    useCallback((msg: string) => {
      onError?.(msg);
      setError(msg);
    }, [onError]),
  );

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (imageData: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    const parsed = await runOcr(imageData);
    if (parsed && parsed.studentCode && parsed.fullName) {
      setOcrResult(parsed);
      setPhase("confirm");
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }, [runOcr]);

  const {
    cameraReady, setCameraReady,
    detectAttempts,
    startDetection, stopDetection,
  } = useFaceScanner({
    phase,
    onPhaseChange: setPhase,
    onCapture: handleCapture,
    onError: (msg) => setError(msg),
    videoSource,
    webcamRef,
    ipCamRef,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cameraReady && phase === "detecting" && !autoDetectStarted.current) {
      autoDetectStarted.current = true;
      startDetection();
    }
    return () => { stopDetection(); };
  }, [cameraReady, phase, startDetection, stopDetection]);

  const handleManualCapture = useCallback(async () => {
    stopDetection();
    setPhase("processing");
    setError("");

    let imageSrc: string | null = null;
    if (videoSource === "ipcamera") {
      const img = ipCamRef.current;
      if (img && img.complete) {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = img.naturalWidth;
        canvas.height = img.naturalHeight;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx?.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
        imageSrc = canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.95);
      }
    } else {
      imageSrc = webcamRef.current?.getScreenshot() || null;
    }

    if (!imageSrc) {
      setError("Không thể chụp ảnh từ camera");
      setPhase("detecting");
      return;
    }
    const parsed = await runOcr(imageSrc);
    if (parsed && parsed.studentCode && parsed.fullName) {
      setOcrResult(parsed);
      setPhase("confirm");
    } else {
      setError("Không thể đọc thông tin từ thẻ. Hãy đảm bảo thẻ rõ nét và đủ ánh sáng.");
      setPhase("detecting");
    }
  }, [stopDetection, videoSource, runOcr]);

  const handleFileUpload = useCallback(async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    stopDetection();
    setPhase("processing");
    setError("");
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async (ev) => {
      const dataUrl = ev.target?.result as string;
      const parsed = await runOcr(dataUrl);
      if (parsed && parsed.studentCode && parsed.fullName) {
        setOcrResult(parsed);
        setPhase("confirm");
      } else {
        setError("Không thể đọc thông tin từ ảnh này");
        setPhase("detecting");
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }, [stopDetection, runOcr]);

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (ocrResult) onScanned(ocrResult as ScannedCardData);
  };

  const handleRetake = () => {
    setOcrResult(null);
    setError("");
    setPhase("detecting");
    autoDetectStarted.current = false;
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={0}>
      {phase === "confirm" && ocrResult ? (
        <Fade in>
          <Box>
            <CardPreview
              data={ocrResult as ScannedCardData}
              onConfirm={handleConfirm}
              onRetake={handleRetake}
              onSkip={onSkip}
            />
          </Box>
        </Fade>
      ) : (
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: { xs: "column", md: "row" }, gap: 0, minHeight: { md: 420 } }}>
          <ScannerUI
            videoSource={videoSource}
            ipCameraUrl={ipCameraUrl}
            phase={phase}
            cameraReady={cameraReady}
            ocrLoading={ocrState.loading}
            ocrProgress={ocrState.progress}
            detectAttempts={detectAttempts}
            maxDetectAttempts={10}
            webcamRef={webcamRef}
            ipCamRef={ipCamRef}
            onCameraReady={() => setCameraReady(true)}
            onCameraError={(msg) => setError(msg)}
          />
          <ScannerInfoPanel
            phase={phase}
            ocrResult={ocrResult}
            error={error}
            cameraReady={cameraReady}
            processing={ocrState.loading}
            onCapture={handleManualCapture}
            onFileUpload={handleFileUpload}
            onSkip={onSkip}
          />
        </Box>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import type { ScheduleStaff, StaffShift, LibraryZone } from "@/lib/types";

interface AutoScheduleProposal {
  staffId: string;
  shiftId: string;
  zoneId: string;
  workDate: string;
  note: string;
}

interface AutoSchedulePreviewProps {
  proposals: AutoScheduleProposal[];
  staff: ScheduleStaff[];
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  onConfirm: (selected: AutoScheduleProposal[]) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  loading: boolean;
  skippedCount: number;
}

export default function AutoSchedulePreview({
  proposals,
  staff,
  shifts,
  zones,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
  loading,
  skippedCount,
}: AutoSchedulePreviewProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<number>>(
    () => new Set(proposals.map((_, i) => i))
  );

  const staffMap = useMemo(() => new Map(staff.map((s) => [s.id, s])), [staff]);
  const shiftMap = useMemo(() => new Map(shifts.map((s) => [s.id, s])), [shifts]);
  const zoneMap = useMemo(() => new Map(zones.map((z) => [z.id, z])), [zones]);

  const toggleAll = () => {
    if (selected.size === proposals.length) {
      setSelected(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelected(new Set(proposals.map((_, i) => i)));
    }
  };

  const toggleRow = (index: number) => {
    const next = new Set(selected);
    if (next.has(index)) {
      next.delete(index);
    } else {
      next.add(index);
    }
    setSelected(next);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const selectedProposals = proposals.filter((_, i) => selected.has(i));
    onConfirm(selectedProposals);
  };

  if (!proposals.length) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ py: 4, textAlign: "center" }}>
        <Typography color="text.secondary">
          {skippedCount > 0
            ? `Không có ca nào được đề xuất (${skippedCount} ca đã bỏ qua)`
            : "Không có ca nào được đề xuất"}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2}>
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {selected.size}/{proposals.length} ca được chọn
          {skippedCount > 0 && (
            <Typography component="span" variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>
              ({skippedCount} ca bỏ qua)
            </Typography>
          )}
        </Typography>
        <Button size="small" onClick={toggleAll} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
          {selected.size === proposals.length ? "Bỏ chọn tất cả" : "Chọn tất cả"}
        </Button>
      </Stack>

      <TableContainer component={Paper} variant="outlined" sx={{ maxHeight: 400 }}>
        <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
          <TableHead>
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell padding="checkbox">
                <Checkbox
                  indeterminate={selected.size > 0 && selected.size < proposals.length}
                  checked={selected.size === proposals.length}
                  onChange={toggleAll}
                />
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Nhân viên</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Ca</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Khu vực</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Ngày</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Ghi chú</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHead>
          <TableBody>
            {proposals.map((p, idx) => (
              <TableRow key={idx} hover selected={selected.has(idx)}>
                <TableCell padding="checkbox">
                  <Checkbox
                    checked={selected.has(idx)}
                    onChange={() => toggleRow(idx)}
                  />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{staffMap.get(p.staffId)?.fullName || staffMap.get(p.staffId)?.email || p.staffId}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{shiftMap.get(p.shiftId)?.name || p.shiftId}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{zoneMap.get(p.zoneId)?.zoneName || p.zoneId}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{new Date(p.workDate + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit" })}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{p.note || "-"}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>

      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
        <Button onClick={onCancel} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
          Hủy
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          disabled={selected.size === 0 || loading}
          onClick={handleConfirm}
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          {loading ? "Đang xử lý..." : `Xác nhận (${selected.size} ca)`}
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  );
}

File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/staff-schedule/GeofenceConfigPanel.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Drawer,
  IconButton,
  MenuItem,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Delete";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { LibraryZone } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  onUpdated: () => void;
}

function getApiError(err: any): string {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  return data?.error || data?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra";
}

export default function GeofenceConfigPanel({ open, onClose, zones, onUpdated }: Props) {
  const [configs, setConfigs] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [zoneId, setZoneId] = useState("");
  const [lat, setLat] = useState("");
  const [lng, setLng] = useState("");
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState("100");
  const [wifiSsids, setWifiSsids] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await api.getGeofenceConfigs();
      setConfigs(result);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) loadData();
  }, [open]);

  const handleSet = async () => {
    if (!zoneId || !lat || !lng) { setError("Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin"); return; }
    const latVal = parseFloat(lat);
    const lngVal = parseFloat(lng);
    const radiusVal = parseInt(radius) || 100;
    if (isNaN(latVal) || latVal < -90 || latVal > 90) { setError("Vĩ độ phải từ -90 đến 90"); return; }
    if (isNaN(lngVal) || lngVal < -180 || lngVal > 180) { setError("Kinh độ phải từ -180 đến 180"); return; }
    if (radiusVal < 10 || radiusVal > 10000) { setError("Bán kính phải từ 10m đến 10,000m"); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.setGeofenceConfig({
        zoneId,
        latitude: latVal,
        longitude: lngVal,
        radiusMeters: radiusVal,
        allowedWifiSsids: wifiSsids.trim() ? wifiSsids.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : null,
      });
      setZoneId(""); setLat(""); setLng(""); setRadius("100"); setWifiSsids("");
      await loadData();
      onUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (zId: string) => {
    if (!confirm("Xóa cấu hình geofence?")) return;
    try {
      await api.deleteGeofenceConfig(zId);
      await loadData();
      onUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    }
  };

  return (
    <Drawer anchor="right" open={open} onClose={onClose} sx={{ zIndex: 1300 }}>
      <Box sx={{ width: { xs: "100%", sm: 400 }, height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 2, py: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
          <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
            Cấu hình Geofence
          </Typography>
          <IconButton onClick={onClose} size="small">
            <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
          {error && <Alert severity="error" onClose={() => setError(null)}>{error}</Alert>}

          <Stack spacing={1.5}>
            <TextField
              select
              size="small"
              label="Khu vực"
              value={zoneId}
              onChange={(e) => setZoneId(e.target.value)}
              fullWidth
            >
              <MenuItem value="">Chọn khu vực</MenuItem>
              {zones.filter((z) => z.isActive).map((z) => (
                <MenuItem key={z.id} value={z.id}>{z.zoneName} (Tầng {z.floor})</MenuItem>
              ))}
            </TextField>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
              <TextField
                size="small"
                type="number"
                label="Vĩ độ"
                value={lat}
                onChange={(e) => setLat(e.target.value)}
                sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                slotProps={{ htmlInput: { step: "any" } }}
              />
              <TextField
                size="small"
                type="number"
                label="Kinh độ"
                value={lng}
                onChange={(e) => setLng(e.target.value)}
                sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                slotProps={{ htmlInput: { step: "any" } }}
              />
            </Stack>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <TextField
                size="small"
                type="number"
                label="Bán kính (m)"
                value={radius}
                onChange={(e) => setRadius(e.target.value)}
                sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 10, max: 10000 } }}
              />
              <Button
                size="small"
                variant="contained"
                onClick={handleSet}
                disabled={saving}
                sx={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}
              >
                {saving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : "Lưu"}
              </Button>
            </Stack>
            <TextField
              size="small"
              placeholder="WiFi SSID (phẩy ngăn cách)"
              value={wifiSsids}
              onChange={(e) => setWifiSsids(e.target.value)}
              fullWidth
            />
          </Stack>

          <Box sx={{ pt: 2, borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, display: "block", mb: 1 }}>
              Đã cấu hình
            </Typography>
            {loading && (
              <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={12} />
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Đang tải...</Typography>
              </Box>
            )}
            {!loading && configs.length === 0 && (
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>
                Chưa có geofence nào
              </Typography>
            )}
            <Stack spacing={0.5}>
              {configs.map((cfg) => (
                <Box key={cfg.id} sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 1.5, py: 1, borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "background.paper", border: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{cfg.zone?.zoneName || "Khu vực"}</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ display: "block" }} color="text.secondary">
                      {cfg.latitude}, {cfg.longitude} · {cfg.radiusMeters}m
                      {cfg.allowedWifiSsids?.length ? ` · WiFi: ${cfg.allowedWifiSsids.join(", ")}` : null}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => handleDelete(cfg.zoneId)}>
                    <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Stack>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </Drawer>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { Box, IconButton, Menu, MenuItem, ListItemIcon, ListItemText, Tooltip } from "@mui/material";
import AddIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Add";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Delete";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined";
import type { StaffScheduleAssignment, StaffShift } from "@/lib/types";
import AssignmentCard from "./AssignmentCard";

interface TimetableCellProps {
  assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  date?: string;
  shiftId?: string;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  onCellClick?: (date: string, shiftId: string) => void;
  onDeleteAssignment?: (id: string) => void;
  onViewStaff?: (staffId: string) => void;
  shift?: StaffShift | null;
}

function isUnderstaffed(assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[], shift?: StaffShift | null): boolean {
  if (!shift?.minStaff) return false;
  const activeCount = assignments.filter(a => a.status !== "cancelled" && a.status !== "completed").length;
  return activeCount < shift.minStaff;
}

export default function TimetableCell({
  assignments, date, shiftId, isAdmin, onCellClick, onDeleteAssignment, onViewStaff, shift,
}: TimetableCellProps) {
  const [menuAnchor, setMenuAnchor] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [menuAssignment, setMenuAssignment] = useState<StaffScheduleAssignment | null>(null);
  const under = isUnderstaffed(assignments, shift);
  const canAdmin = isAdmin && date && shiftId && onCellClick;

  const handleContextMenu = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>, assignment: StaffScheduleAssignment) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setMenuAssignment(assignment);
    setMenuAnchor(e.currentTarget);
  }, []);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    setMenuAnchor(null);
    setMenuAssignment(null);
  }, []);

  if (assignments.length === 0) {
    if (!canAdmin) return null;
    return (
      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 0.5 }}>
        <Tooltip title="Thêm nhân viên">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={() => onCellClick(date!, shiftId!)}
            sx={{
              width: "100%",
              py: 0.25,
              borderRadius: 1,
              border: "1px dashed",
              borderColor: "divider",
              "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.main", bgcolor: "rgba(99,102,241,0.05)", color: "primary.main" },
              color: "text.disabled",
            }}
          >
            <AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 0.5 }}>
      {assignments.map((a) => (
        <Box
          key={a.id}
          onContextMenu={(e) => isAdmin ? handleContextMenu(e, a) : undefined}
        >
          <AssignmentCard assignment={a} onDelete={onDeleteAssignment} understaffed={under} />
        </Box>
      ))}
      {canAdmin ? (
        <Tooltip title="Thêm nhân viên">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={() => onCellClick(date!, shiftId!)}
            sx={{
              width: "100%",
              py: 0.25,
              borderRadius: 1,
              border: "1px dashed",
              borderColor: "divider",
              "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.main", bgcolor: "rgba(99,102,241,0.05)", color: "primary.main" },
              color: "text.disabled",
            }}
          >
            <AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      ) : null}

      {isAdmin && menuAssignment ? (
        <Menu
          open={Boolean(menuAnchor)}
          anchorEl={menuAnchor}
          onClose={handleClose}
          anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "left" }}
          transformOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "left" }}
          slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { minWidth: 180 } } }}
        >
          {onViewStaff && menuAssignment.staffId ? (
            <MenuItem onClick={() => { onViewStaff(menuAssignment.staffId); handleClose(); }}>
              <ListItemIcon><PersonIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "primary.main" }} /></ListItemIcon>
              <ListItemText>Xem nhân viên</ListItemText>
            </MenuItem>
          ) : null}
          {onDeleteAssignment ? (
            <MenuItem onClick={() => { onDeleteAssignment(menuAssignment.id); handleClose(); }} sx={{ color: "error.main" }}>
              <ListItemIcon><DeleteIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "error.main" }} /></ListItemIcon>
              <ListItemText>Xóa ca trực</ListItemText>
            </MenuItem>
          ) : null}
        </Menu>
      ) : null}
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Box, Button, ButtonGroup, IconButton, Stack, Tooltip, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import ArrowBackIosNewIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowBackIosNew";
import ArrowForwardIosIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowForwardIos";
import TodayIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Today";
import AutoAwesomeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesome";
import SettingsIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Settings";
import PrintIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Print";

interface TimetableHeaderProps {
  weekStart: Date;
  onPrevWeek: () => void;
  onNextWeek: () => void;
  onToday: () => void;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  onOpenManagement?: () => void;
  onAutoSchedule?: () => void;
}

function getWeekDays(anchor: Date) {
  return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
    const d = new Date(anchor);
    d.setDate(anchor.getDate() + i);
    return d;
  });
}

function toDateInput(date: Date) {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

export default function TimetableHeader({
  weekStart, onPrevWeek, onNextWeek, onToday, isAdmin, onOpenManagement, onAutoSchedule,
}: TimetableHeaderProps) {
  const days = useMemo(() => getWeekDays(weekStart), [weekStart]);
  const dateRange = `${toDateInput(days[0])} ~ ${toDateInput(days[6])}`;

  const isCurrentWeek = useMemo(() => {
    const monday = getWeekDays(weekStart);
    return toDateInput(monday[0]) === toDateInput(getWeekDays(new Date())[0]);
  }, [weekStart]);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ pb: 2, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
          Lịch trực theo tuần
          <Box component="span" sx={{ display: { xs: "none", print: "inline" }, ml: 2, fontSize: "0.875rem", fontFamily: "monospace", fontWeight: 400, color: "text.secondary" }}>
            {dateRange}
          </Box>
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ display: { xs: "flex", print: "none" }, alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
            {dateRange}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
        <ButtonGroup size="small" variant="outlined">
          <Button onClick={onPrevWeek} startIcon={<ArrowBackIosNewIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12 }} />}>
            Tuần trước
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={onToday}
            variant={isCurrentWeek ? "contained" : "outlined"}
            color={isCurrentWeek ? "primary" : "inherit"}
            startIcon={<TodayIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
          >
            Hôm nay
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={onNextWeek} endIcon={<ArrowForwardIosIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12 }} />}>
            Tuần sau
          </Button>
        </ButtonGroup>

        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ display: { print: "none" } }}>
          {isAdmin && (
            <>
              {onAutoSchedule && (
                <Tooltip title="Gợi ý lịch tự động">
                  <Button
                    size="small"
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="primary"
                    startIcon={<AutoAwesomeIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
                    onClick={onAutoSchedule}
                  >
                    Gợi ý lịch
                  </Button>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
              {onOpenManagement && (
                <Tooltip title="Quản lý ca trực và khu vực">
                  <Button
                    size="small"
                    variant="outlined"
                    startIcon={<SettingsIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
                    onClick={onOpenManagement}
                  >
                    Quản lý
                  </Button>
                </Tooltip>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          <Tooltip title="In lịch">
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => window.print()}>
              <PrintIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

import { Controller, Control, FieldValues, Path } from "react-hook-form";
import { TextField, MenuItem } from "@mui/material";

interface SelectOption {
  value: string | number;
  label: string;
}

interface FormSelectProps<T extends FieldValues> {
  name: Path<T>;
  control: Control<T>;
  label: string;
  options: SelectOption[];
  rules?: Record<string, any>;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: "small" | "medium";
}

export default function FormSelect<T extends FieldValues>({
  name,
  control,
  label,
  options,
  rules,
  fullWidth = true,
  disabled = false,
  size = "small",
}: FormSelectProps<T>) {
  return (
    <Controller
      name={name}
      control={control}
      rules={rules}
      render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
        <TextField
          {...field}
          select
          label={label}
          fullWidth={fullWidth}
          disabled={disabled}
          size={size}
          error={!!fieldState.error}
          helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
          sx={{ "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2 } }}
        >
          {options.map((opt) => (
            <MenuItem key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
              {opt.label}
            </MenuItem>
          ))}
        </TextField>
      )}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import { Box, Paper, Skeleton, Stack } from "@mui/material";

interface TableSkeletonProps {
  columns?: number;
  rows?: number;
  height?: number;
}

export default function TableSkeleton({
  columns = 5,
  rows = 6,
  height = 40,
}: TableSkeletonProps) {
  const colWidths = ["20%", "30%", "15%", "15%", "20%"];

  return (
    <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 2, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "background.paper" }}>
      {/* Header row */}
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ pb: 1.5, mb: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
        {Array.from({ length: columns }).map((_, i) => (
          <Box key={i} sx={{ width: colWidths[i % colWidths.length], flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <Skeleton variant="text" height={24} width="70%" />
          </Box>
        ))}
      </Stack>

      {/* Body rows */}
      <Stack spacing={1.5}>
        {Array.from({ length: rows }).map((_, rowIdx) => (
          <Stack
            key={rowIdx}
            direction="row"
            spacing={2}
            sx={{
              py: 0.75,
              alignItems: "center",
              borderBottom: rowIdx < rows - 1 ? "1px solid" : "none",
              borderColor: "divider",
            }}
          >
            {Array.from({ length: columns }).map((_, colIdx) => (
              <Box key={colIdx} sx={{ width: colWidths[colIdx % colWidths.length], flexShrink: 0 }}>
                <Skeleton
                  variant="rounded"
                  height={height - 16}
                  width={colIdx === 0 ? "85%" : colIdx === 1 ? "95%" : "60%"}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 1 }}
                />
              </Box>
            ))}
          </Stack>
        ))}
      </Stack>
    </Paper>
  );
}

"use client";

import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup, Tooltip } from "@mui/material";
import ViewModuleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ViewModuleOutlined";
import ViewListIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ViewListOutlined";

export interface ViewToggleProps {
  value: "grid" | "list";
  onChange: (v: "grid" | "list") => void;
}

export default function ViewToggle({ value, onChange }: ViewToggleProps) {
  return (
    <ToggleButtonGroup
      value={value}
      exclusive
      onChange={(_, v) => { if (v) onChange(v); }}
      size="small"
      sx={{
        "& .MuiToggleButton-root": {
          px: 1.2,
          py: 0.5,
          border: "1px solid",
          borderColor: "divider",
          borderRadius: "20px !important",
          textTransform: "none",
          color: "text.secondary",
          "&.Mui-selected": {
            bgcolor: "primary.main",
            color: "#fff",
            "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" },
          },
        },
      }}
    >
      <Tooltip title="Dạng lưới">
        <ToggleButton value="grid"><ViewModuleIcon fontSize="small" /></ToggleButton>
      </Tooltip>
      <Tooltip title="Danh sách">
        <ToggleButton value="list"><ViewListIcon fontSize="small" /></ToggleButton>
      </Tooltip>
    </ToggleButtonGroup>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Box, CircularProgress, Paper, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import BarChartIcon from "@mui/icons-material/BarChart";
import {
  BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer,
} from "recharts";
import type { AccessFrequencyDay } from "@/lib/types";

export default function FrequencyChart({ data, loading }: { data: AccessFrequencyDay[]; loading: boolean }) {
  return (
    <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 3, borderRadius: 2 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1, mb: 2 }}>
        <BarChartIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
        <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
          Thống kê tần suất ra vào
        </Typography>
      </Box>
      {loading ? (
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1, py: 2 }}>
          <CircularProgress size={16} />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Đang tải...</Typography>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={250}>
          <BarChart data={data} margin={{ top: 5, right: 20, left: 0, bottom: 5 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#2E3345" />
            <XAxis
              dataKey="date"
              tickFormatter={(d: string) => {
                const date = new Date(d + "T00:00:00");
                return date.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "numeric", month: "numeric" });
              }}
              fontSize={12}
              tick={{ fill: "#B8B0A4" }}
            />
            <YAxis allowDecimals={false} fontSize={12} tick={{ fill: "#B8B0A4" }} />
            <Tooltip
              labelStyle={{ color: "#EDE8DF" }}
              contentStyle={{ background: "#1C2030", border: "1px solid #2E3345", borderRadius: "8px" }}
              labelFormatter={(d: any) => {
                if (!d) return "";
                const date = new Date(String(d) + "T00:00:00");
                return date.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" });
              }}
            />
            <Legend wrapperStyle={{ color: "#B8B0A4" }} />
            <Bar dataKey="entry" fill="#4A8C5C" name="Vào" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
            <Bar dataKey="exit" fill="#C49A3C" name="Ra" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
          </BarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
}

    "/dashboard",

    "/return",

  const toggleRoute = (path: string) => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin" || path === "/dashboard") return;

      prev.includes(path) ? prev.filter((p) => p !== path) : [...prev, path]
    );
  };

    const match =
      r.label.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      r.path.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    if (!match) return false;
    const isAllowed = selectedRole === "admin" || allowedRoutes.includes(r.path);
    if (filter === "allowed") return isAllowed;
    if (filter === "blocked") return !isAllowed;
    return true;
  });

  return (

                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: "1.1rem",
                  letterSpacing: "-0.01em",
                  color: isDark ? "#F8FAFC" : "#0F172A",
                  lineHeight: 1.2,
                }}
              >
                DESIGN SANDBOX — SPLIT-PANE HIGH-DENSITY ADMIN
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }}>
                Thử nghiệm cơ chế Bố cục phân vùng: Vùng B (Rail) + Vùng C (Data Table) + Vùng D (Live Inspector)

          </Typography>

          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5, mb: 2 }}>
            {(selectedRole === "admin" ? MOCK_ROUTES.map((r) => r.path) : allowedRoutes).map((p) => (
              <Chip
                key={p}
                label={p}
                size="small"
                sx={{
                  height: 20,
                  fontSize: "0.68rem",
                  fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  borderRadius: "2px",
                  bgcolor: alpha("#059669", 0.12),
                  color: "#059669",
                  border: "1px solid",
                  borderColor: alpha("#059669", 0.3),
                }}
              />
            ))}
          </Box>

          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "text.primary", display: "block", mb: 0.5 }}>
            Payload JSON:
          </Typography>

          <Box
            component="pre"
            sx={{
              p: 1.5,
              borderRadius: "3px",
              bgcolor: isDark ? "#0F172A" : "#F8FAFC",
              border: "1px solid",
              borderColor: isDark ? "#334155" : "#E2E8F0",
              fontSize: "0.72rem",
              fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
              overflowX: "auto",
              maxHeight: 280,
              color: isDark ? "#38BDF8" : "#0369A1",
            }}
          >
            {JSON.stringify(
              {
                role: selectedRole,
                allowedPages: selectedRole === "admin" ? MOCK_ROUTES.map((r) => r.path) : allowedRoutes,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              },
              null,
              2
            )}
          </Box>
        </Paper>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Button } from '@mui/material';
import type { ButtonProps } from '@mui/material';

interface GateButtonProps {
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger';
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

const variantConfig = {
  primary: {
    color: 'primary' as const,
    variant: 'contained' as const,
    sx: {
      py: 2,
      px: 4,
      fontSize: '1.1rem',
      fontWeight: 700,
      borderRadius: 3,
      textTransform: 'none',
      boxShadow: '0 4px 14px 0 rgba(59,130,246,0.39)',
      '&:hover': { boxShadow: '0 6px 20px 0 rgba(59,130,246,0.47)' },
    },
  } satisfies Partial<ButtonProps>,
  secondary: {
    color: 'inherit' as const,
    variant: 'outlined' as const,
    sx: {
      py: 2,
      px: 4,
      fontSize: '1.1rem',
      fontWeight: 700,
      borderRadius: 3,
      textTransform: 'none',
      borderColor: 'grey.600',
      color: 'white',
      '&:hover': { borderColor: 'grey.500', bgcolor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
    },
  } satisfies Partial<ButtonProps>,
  danger: {
    color: 'error' as const,
    variant: 'outlined' as const,
    sx: {
      py: 2,
      px: 4,
      fontSize: '1.1rem',
      fontWeight: 700,
      borderRadius: 3,
      textTransform: 'none',
      borderColor: 'error.dark',
      color: 'error.light',
      bgcolor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)',
      '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)', borderColor: 'error.main' },
    },
  } satisfies Partial<ButtonProps>,
};

export default function GateButton({
  onClick,
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  disabled,
  fullWidth,
}: GateButtonProps) {
  const config = variantConfig[variant];

  return (
    <Button
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      fullWidth={fullWidth}
      variant={variant === 'primary' ? 'contained' : config.variant || 'outlined'}
      color={config.color}
      sx={config.sx}
    >
      {children}
    </Button>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { IconButton, InputAdornment, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import ArrowForwardIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward';

interface MssvInputProps {
  onSubmit: (mssv: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export default function MssvInput({ onSubmit, disabled }: MssvInputProps) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('');

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && value.trim()) {
      onSubmit(value.trim());
    }
  };

  return (
    <TextField
      fullWidth
      type="text"
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      disabled={disabled}
      placeholder="Nhập MSSV..."
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        "& .MuiInputBase-root": {
          fontSize: "1.1rem",
          fontFamily: "monospace",
          letterSpacing: "0.1em",
          textAlign: "center",
          bgcolor: "rgba(30,41,59,0.8)",
          borderRadius: 3,
          "& fieldset": { borderColor: "grey.600" },
          "&:hover fieldset": { borderColor: "primary.main" },
          "&.Mui-focused fieldset": { borderColor: "primary.main", borderWidth: 2 },
        },
        "& .MuiInputBase-input": { textAlign: "center", py: "16px" },
      }}
      slotProps={{
        input: {
          endAdornment: value ? (
            <InputAdornment position="end">
              <IconButton
                onClick={() => onSubmit(value.trim())}
                disabled={disabled}
                color="primary"
                sx={{ bgcolor: "primary.main", color: "white", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" }, p: 1 }}
              >
                <ArrowForwardIcon />
              </IconButton>
            </InputAdornment>
          ) : undefined,
        },
      }}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import { keyframes } from '@mui/system';

const pulseAnimation = keyframes`
  0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0; }
  50% { opacity: 0.4; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.8); opacity: 0; }
`;

interface PulseAnimationProps {
  color?: 'blue' | 'emerald' | 'red';
  size?: number;
}

const colorMap = {
  blue: { border: 'primary.main', ring: 'primary.dark' },
  emerald: { border: 'success.main', ring: 'success.dark' },
  red: { border: 'error.main', ring: 'error.dark' },
};

export default function PulseAnimation({ color = 'blue', size = 120 }: PulseAnimationProps) {
  const colors = colorMap[color];

  return (
    <Box sx={{ position: 'relative', width: size, height: size, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
      {/* Outer pulse ring */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'absolute',
          inset: 0,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          border: 2,
          borderColor: colors.border,
          animation: `${pulseAnimation} 2s ease-out infinite`,
        }}
      />
      {/* Middle ring */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'absolute',
          inset: '8px',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          border: 1,
          borderColor: colors.border,
          opacity: 0.4,
        }}
      />
      {/* Inner ring */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'absolute',
          inset: '16px',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          border: 1,
          borderColor: colors.border,
          opacity: 0.6,
        }}
      />
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Box, CircularProgress, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";

export default function KioskLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (!isLoading && !isAuthenticated) {
      router.push("/login");
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, isLoading, mounted, router]);

  if (!mounted || isLoading) {
    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          minHeight: "100vh",
          bgcolor: "grey.900",
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", gap: 2 }}>
          <CircularProgress size={40} sx={{ color: "primary.light" }} />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="grey.400">
            Đang tải...
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) return null;

  return <>{children}</>;
}

File: src/app/api/camera/snapshot/[cameraId]/route.ts
================
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";

const CAMERA_URLS: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
  entry_gate: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENTRY_CAM,
  exit_gate: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EXIT_CAM,
};

export async function GET(
  _request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ cameraId: string }> }
) {
  const { cameraId } = await params;
  const rawUrl = CAMERA_URLS[cameraId];

  if (!rawUrl) {
    return new Response("Unknown camera ID", { status: 404 });
  }

  const proxyBase = new URL(_request.url).origin;
  const proxyUrl = `${proxyBase}/api/camera/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(rawUrl)}`;

  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);

    const response = await fetch(proxyUrl, { signal: controller.signal });
    clearTimeout(timeout);

    if (!response.ok) {
      return new Response("Camera unreachable", { status: 502 });
    }

    const contentType = response.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";

    return new Response(response.body, {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": contentType,
        "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate",
        Pragma: "no-cache",
        Expires: "0",
      },
    });
  } catch {
    return new Response("Failed to connect to camera", { status: 502 });
  }
}

File: src/app/login/_components/ForgotPasswordDialog.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import EmailOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined";
import ShieldOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ShieldOutlined";
import LockOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";
import ArrowBackIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack";
import VisibilityIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Visibility";
import VisibilityOffIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOff";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";

interface ForgotPasswordDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function ForgotPasswordDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
}: ForgotPasswordDialogProps) {
  const [forgotStep, setForgotStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3 | 4>(1);
  const [forgotEmail, setForgotEmail] = useState("");
  const [forgotCode, setForgotCode] = useState("");
  const [forgotPassword, setForgotPassword] = useState("");
  const [forgotConfirmPassword, setForgotConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [forgotLoading, setForgotLoading] = useState(false);
  const [forgotError, setForgotError] = useState("");
  const [showForgotPassword, setShowForgotPassword] = useState(false);
  const [resendCooldown, setResendCooldown] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resendCooldown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setResendCooldown((prev) => prev - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [resendCooldown]);

  const handleClose = () => {
    onClose();
    setForgotStep(1);
    setForgotEmail("");
    setForgotCode("");
    setForgotPassword("");
    setForgotConfirmPassword("");
    setForgotError("");
    setShowForgotPassword(false);
  };

  const handleForgotSendCode = async () => {
    if (!forgotEmail) {
      setForgotError("Vui lòng nhập email");
      return;
    }
    setForgotLoading(true);
    setForgotError("");
    try {
      await api.forgotPassword(forgotEmail);
      setForgotStep(2);
      setResendCooldown(60);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setForgotError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể gửi mã reset");
    } finally {
      setForgotLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyCode = async () => {
    if (!forgotCode || forgotCode.length !== 6) {
      setForgotError("Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ 6 chữ số mã xác minh");
      return;
    }
    setForgotLoading(true);
    setForgotError("");
    try {
      await api.verifyResetCode(forgotEmail, forgotCode);
      setForgotStep(3);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setForgotError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Mã xác minh không hợp lệ");
    } finally {
      setForgotLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleForgotReset = async () => {
    if (!forgotPassword || !forgotConfirmPassword) {
      setForgotError("Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu mới");
      return;
    }
    if (forgotPassword !== forgotConfirmPassword) {
      setForgotError("Mật khẩu mới không khớp");
      return;
    }
    if (forgotPassword.length < 6) {
      setForgotError("Mật khẩu phải ít nhất 6 ký tự");
      return;
    }
    setForgotLoading(true);
    setForgotError("");
    try {
      await api.resetPassword(forgotEmail, forgotCode, forgotPassword);
      setForgotStep(4);
      setTimeout(() => {
        handleClose();
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setForgotError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Đặt lại mật khẩu thất bại");
    } finally {
      setForgotLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={handleClose}
      maxWidth="xs"
      fullWidth
      slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: 3.5, p: 0.5 } } }}
    >
      <DialogContent sx={{ p: 3, pt: "20px !important" }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", mb: 1 }}>
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: "Space Grotesk, sans-serif" }}>
            {forgotStep === 4 ? "Thành công" : "Quên mật khẩu"}
          </Typography>
          <IconButton onClick={handleClose} size="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }}>
            <CloseIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>

        {/* Step Indicator - Dot style */}
        {forgotStep < 4 && (
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", mb: 3, mt: 1.5 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3].map((s) => (
              <Box key={s} sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: forgotStep === s ? 32 : 10,
                    height: 8,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    bgcolor: forgotStep >= s ? "primary.main" : "action.hover",
                    transition: "all 0.3s ease",
                  }}
                />
                {s < 3 && (
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      width: 24,
                      height: 2,
                      mx: 0.5,
                      bgcolor: forgotStep > s ? "primary.main" : "action.hover",
                      transition: "background-color 0.3s ease",
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            ))}
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Error Message */}
        {forgotError && (
          <Box
            sx={{
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 1,
              p: 1.5,
              borderRadius: 2,
              mb: 2,
              bgcolor: "error.light",
              color: "error.contrastText",
            }}
          >
            <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "error.main" }} />
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{forgotError}</Typography>
          </Box>
        )}

        {forgotStep === 1 && (
          <Stack spacing={2.5}>
            <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center", mb: 0.5 }}>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  width: 64,
                  height: 64,
                  borderRadius: "50%",
                  mx: "auto",
                  mb: 2,
                  bgcolor: "action.hover",
                  display: "grid",
                  placeItems: "center",
                }}
              >
                <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32, color: "primary.main" }} />
              </Box>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Nhập email đã đăng ký để nhận mã xác minh.
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <TextField
              label="Email"
              type="email"
              value={forgotEmail}
              onChange={(e) => setForgotEmail(e.target.value)}
              fullWidth
              autoFocus
              slotProps={{
                input: {
                  startAdornment: (
                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                      <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                    </InputAdornment>
                  ),
                  sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
                },
              }}
            />
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleForgotSendCode}
              disabled={forgotLoading || !forgotEmail}
              fullWidth
              size="large"
              sx={{
                py: 1.35,
                fontWeight: 700,
                borderRadius: 2.5,
                boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
              }}
            >
              {forgotLoading ? "Đang gửi..." : "Gửi mã xác minh"}
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        )}

        {forgotStep === 2 && (
          <Stack spacing={2}>
            <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center", mb: 1 }}>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  width: 64,
                  height: 64,
                  borderRadius: "50%",
                  mx: "auto",
                  mb: 2,
                  bgcolor: "action.hover",
                  display: "grid",
                  placeItems: "center",
                }}
              >
                <ShieldOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32, color: "primary.main" }} />
              </Box>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Nhập mã 6 chữ số đã gửi đến</Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mt: 0.5 }}>{forgotEmail}</Typography>
            </Box>
            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 1.5, justifyContent: "center" }}>
              {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
                <TextField
                  key={i}
                  id={`code-${i}`}
                  value={forgotCode[i] || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "");
                    if (val.length > 1) return;
                    const newCode = forgotCode.split("");
                    newCode[i] = val;
                    const code = newCode.join("").slice(0, 6);
                    setForgotCode(code);
                    if (val && i < 5) {
                      setTimeout(() => document.getElementById(`code-${i + 1}`)?.focus(), 10);
                    }
                  }}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Backspace" && !forgotCode[i] && i > 0) {
                      setTimeout(() => document.getElementById(`code-${i - 1}`)?.focus(), 10);
                    }
                  }}
                  slotProps={{
                    htmlInput: {
                      maxLength: 1,
                      style: { textAlign: "center", fontSize: "1.5rem", fontWeight: 700, width: 48, height: 48, padding: 0 },
                    },
                  }}
                  sx={{
                    "& fieldset": {
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      borderWidth: forgotCode[i] ? 2 : 1,
                      borderColor: forgotCode[i] ? "primary.main" : "divider",
                    },
                    transition: "all 0.2s ease",
                    bgcolor: forgotCode[i] ? "action.selected" : "transparent",
                  }}
                />
              ))}
            </Box>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleVerifyCode}
              disabled={forgotLoading || forgotCode.length !== 6}
              fullWidth
              size="large"
              sx={{
                py: 1.35,
                fontWeight: 700,
                borderRadius: 2.5,
                boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
              }}
            >
              {forgotLoading ? "Đang xác minh..." : "Xác minh mã"}
            </Button>
            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <Button
                variant="text"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
                onClick={() => { setForgotStep(1); setForgotCode(""); setForgotError(""); }}
                sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, color: "text.secondary" }}
              >
                Quay lại
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="text"
                size="small"
                onClick={handleForgotSendCode}
                disabled={forgotLoading || resendCooldown > 0}
                sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600 }}
              >
                {resendCooldown > 0 ? `Gửi lại (${resendCooldown}s)` : "Gửi lại mã"}
              </Button>
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        )}

        {forgotStep === 3 && (
          <Stack spacing={2.5}>
            <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center", mb: 0.5 }}>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  width: 64,
                  height: 64,
                  borderRadius: "50%",
                  mx: "auto",
                  mb: 2,
                  bgcolor: "action.hover",
                  display: "grid",
                  placeItems: "center",
                }}
              >
                <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32, color: "primary.main" }} />
              </Box>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Tạo mật khẩu mới cho tài khoản của bạn.</Typography>
            </Box>
            <TextField
              label="Mật khẩu mới"
              type={showForgotPassword ? "text" : "password"}
              value={forgotPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setForgotPassword(e.target.value)}
              fullWidth
              autoFocus
              slotProps={{
                input: {
                  startAdornment: (
                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                      <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                    </InputAdornment>
                  ),
                  endAdornment: (
                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={() => setShowForgotPassword(!showForgotPassword)}
                        edge="end"
                        size="small"
                      >
                        {showForgotPassword ? <VisibilityOffIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} /> : <VisibilityIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />}
                      </IconButton>
                    </InputAdornment>
                  ),
                  sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
                },
              }}
            />
            <TextField
              label="Xác nhận mật khẩu mới"
              type={showForgotPassword ? "text" : "password"}
              value={forgotConfirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setForgotConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              fullWidth
              error={forgotConfirmPassword.length > 0 && forgotPassword !== forgotConfirmPassword}
              helperText={forgotConfirmPassword.length > 0 && forgotPassword !== forgotConfirmPassword ? "Mật khẩu không khớp" : ""}
              slotProps={{
                input: {
                  startAdornment: (
                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                      <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                    </InputAdornment>
                  ),
                  sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
                },
              }}
            />
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleForgotReset}
              disabled={forgotLoading || !forgotPassword || !forgotConfirmPassword}
              fullWidth
              size="large"
              sx={{
                py: 1.35,
                fontWeight: 700,
                borderRadius: 2.5,
                boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
              }}
            >
              {forgotLoading ? "Đang xử lý..." : "Đặt lại mật khẩu"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="text"
              size="small"
              startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
              onClick={() => { setForgotStep(2); setForgotError(""); setForgotPassword(""); setForgotConfirmPassword(""); }}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, color: "text.secondary" }}
            >
              Quay lại
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        )}

        {forgotStep === 4 && (
          <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", py: 3 }}>
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 80,
                height: 80,
                borderRadius: "50%",
                bgcolor: "success.light",
                display: "grid",
                placeItems: "center",
                animation: "scaleIn 0.3s ease-out",
                "@keyframes scaleIn": {
                  "0%": { transform: "scale(0)", opacity: 0 },
                  "100%": { transform: "scale(1)", opacity: 1 },
                },
              }}
            >
              <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: "success.main" }} />
            </Box>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công!</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
              Bạn có thể đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới ngay bây giờ.
            </Typography>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleClose}
              fullWidth
              size="large"
              sx={{ mt: 1, py: 1.5, fontWeight: 700 }}
            >
              Quay lại đăng nhập
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

================
