"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Typography,
  alpha,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlined";
import PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PhotoCameraOutlined";
import VideocamOffOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VideocamOffOutlined";
import RefreshOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";
import VerifiedUserOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VerifiedUserOutlined";
import WbIncandescentOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WbIncandescentOutlined";
import CameraFallback from "@/app/_components/CameraFallback";

interface LoginFormFaceProps {
  onFaceLogin: (file: File) => Promise<void>;
  isLoading: boolean;
  onSwitchToPassword: (prefillEmail?: string) => void;
  setError: (err: string) => void;
}

export default function LoginFormFace({
  onFaceLogin,
  isLoading,
  onSwitchToPassword,
  setError,
}: LoginFormFaceProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCameraOn, setIsCameraOn] = useState(false);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [showFaceFallback, setShowFaceFallback] = useState(false);
  const [countdownProgress, setCountdownProgress] = useState(100);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const readyTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const countdownIntervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const frameCaptureRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const lastFaceFrameRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const hasFaceCameraWorkedRef = useRef(false);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (countdownIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(countdownIntervalRef.current);
      countdownIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    if (frameCaptureRef.current) {
      clearInterval(frameCaptureRef.current);
      frameCaptureRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsCameraOn(false);
    setCameraReady(false);
    setCountdownProgress(100);
  }, []);

  const resetFaceState = () => {
    setImagePreview(null);
    setShowFaceFallback(false);
    setCountdownProgress(100);
  };

  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError("");
      setShowFaceFallback(false);
      setCameraReady(false);
      stopCamera();
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: "user",
          width: { ideal: 1280, min: 640 },
          height: { ideal: 720, min: 480 },
        },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      setIsCameraOn(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") {
        setError("Không có quyền truy cập camera. Vui lòng cấp quyền trong cài đặt trình duyệt.");
      } else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") {
        setError("Không tìm thấy camera trên thiết bị này.");
      } else {
        setError("Không thể khởi động camera.");
      }
      setIsCameraOn(false);
      setShowFaceFallback(true);
    }
  }, [stopCamera, setError]);

  // Video stream initialization
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCameraOn || !videoRef.current || !streamRef.current) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const onReady = () => {
      setCameraReady(true);
      hasFaceCameraWorkedRef.current = true;
    };
    video.onloadedmetadata = onReady;
    video.onplaying = onReady;
    video.onerror = () => {
      setError("Camera gặp sự cố phát hình ảnh.");
      setShowFaceFallback(true);
    };
    video.srcObject = streamRef.current;
    if (video.readyState >= 2) {
      onReady();
      hasFaceCameraWorkedRef.current = true;
    }
    readyTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setCameraReady(true);
      hasFaceCameraWorkedRef.current = true;
    }, 2500);

    return () => {
      if (readyTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(readyTimeoutRef.current);
      video.onloadedmetadata = null;
      video.onplaying = null;
      video.onerror = null;
      video.srcObject = null;
    };
  }, [isCameraOn, setError]);

  // Periodic frame capture for fallback preview
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCameraOn || !cameraReady || !videoRef.current) return;
    frameCaptureRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      if (!video || video.videoWidth === 0 || !streamRef.current) return;
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) return;
        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
        lastFaceFrameRef.current = canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.3);
      } catch {
        lastFaceFrameRef.current = null;
      }
    }, 2000);
    return () => {
      if (frameCaptureRef.current) clearInterval(frameCaptureRef.current);
    };
  }, [isCameraOn, cameraReady]);

  // Clean-up on unmount
  useEffect(() => () => stopCamera(), [stopCamera]);

  const capturePhoto = useCallback((callback?: (file: File) => void) => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !cameraReady || video.videoWidth === 0 || video.videoHeight === 0) return;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (!blob) return;
      const file = new File([blob], "face.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
      setImagePreview(canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg"));
      callback?.(file);
    }, "image/jpeg", 0.92);
  }, [cameraReady]);

  const executeFaceLogin = useCallback(() => {
    capturePhoto((file) => {
      stopCamera();
      onFaceLogin(file).catch(() => {
        resetFaceState();
      });
    });
  }, [capturePhoto, onFaceLogin, stopCamera]);

  // Auto-capture with smooth visual countdown (2.4s)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cameraReady && !imagePreview && !isLoading) {
      const TOTAL_STEPS = 24;
      const STEP_TIME = 100; // 24 * 100ms = 2400ms
      let currentStep = TOTAL_STEPS;
      setCountdownProgress(100);

      countdownIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        currentStep -= 1;
        setCountdownProgress((currentStep / TOTAL_STEPS) * 100);
        if (currentStep <= 0) {
          if (countdownIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(countdownIntervalRef.current);
          countdownIntervalRef.current = null;
          executeFaceLogin();
        }
      }, STEP_TIME);
    }

    return () => {
      if (countdownIntervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(countdownIntervalRef.current);
        countdownIntervalRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [cameraReady, imagePreview, isLoading, executeFaceLogin]);

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2.5}>
      <Paper
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          aspectRatio: "4 / 3",
          overflow: "hidden",
          bgcolor: isCameraOn || imagePreview ? "#07111E" : (theme.palette.mode === "dark" ? "background.paper" : "#F8FAFC"),
          display: "grid",
          placeItems: "center",
          position: "relative",
          borderRadius: 3.5,
          borderColor: isCameraOn ? "transparent" : "divider",
          boxShadow: isCameraOn
            ? "0 12px 32px -4px rgba(7, 17, 30, 0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)"
            : "0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.03)",
          transition: "all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
        }}
      >
        {/* CSS Animations */}
        <Box
          component="style"
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
            __html: `
              @keyframes scanLaser {
                0% { top: 14%; opacity: 0.3; }
                50% { opacity: 0.95; }
                100% { top: 84%; opacity: 0.3; }
              }
              @keyframes pulseHud {
                0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.85; }
                50% { transform: scale(1.015); opacity: 1; }
              }
              @keyframes rippleRing {
                0% { transform: scale(0.96); opacity: 0.8; }
                100% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 0; }
              }
            `,
          }}
        />

        {/* ── STATE 1: Display Captured Image Preview + In-Frame Verification ── */}
        {imagePreview ? (
          <Box sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", position: "relative" }}>
            <Box
              component="img"
              src={imagePreview}
              alt="Ảnh khuôn mặt độc giả"
              sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }}
            />
            {/* In-Frame Verification Overlay (Prevents Layout Shift) */}
            {isLoading && (
              <Stack
                sx={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  inset: 0,
                  bgcolor: "rgba(7, 17, 30, 0.78)",
                  backdropFilter: "blur(6px)",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  color: "white",
                  p: 3,
                  textAlign: "center",
                  gap: 1.5,
                  zIndex: 10,
                }}
              >
                <Box sx={{ position: "relative", display: "grid", placeItems: "center" }}>
                  <CircularProgress
                    size={56}
                    thickness={3.5}
                    sx={{ color: "primary.main" }}
                  />
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      position: "absolute",
                      width: 70,
                      height: 70,
                      borderRadius: "50%",
                      border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
                      animation: "rippleRing 1.5s infinite ease-out",
                    }}
                  />
                </Box>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.5, mt: 0.5 }}>
                  Đang đối soát sinh trắc học...
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" }}>
                  Hệ thống AI đang so khớp khuôn mặt với cơ sở dữ liệu thư viện
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            )}
          </Box>
        ) : showFaceFallback ? (
          /* ── STATE 2: Camera Fallback ── */
          <CameraFallback
            lastFrameUrl={hasFaceCameraWorkedRef.current ? lastFaceFrameRef.current : null}
            onRetry={startCamera}
            showManualInput
            manualLabel="Email"
            manualPlaceholder="Nhập email để đăng nhập..."
            onManualSubmit={(value) => onSwitchToPassword(value)}
            showFileUpload={false}
          />
        ) : isCameraOn ? (
          /* ── STATE 3: Active Camera & Biometric Oval HUD ── */
          <>
            <Box
              component="video"
              ref={videoRef}
              autoPlay
              playsInline
              muted
              sx={{
                width: "100%",
                height: "100%",
                objectFit: "cover",
                transform: "scaleX(-1)", // Mirror effect for natural selfie alignment
              }}
            />

            {/* Connecting Camera Overlay */}
            {!cameraReady && (
              <Stack
                sx={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  inset: 0,
                  bgcolor: "rgba(7, 17, 30, 0.85)",
                  color: "white",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  zIndex: 4,
                }}
              >
                <CircularProgress color="inherit" size={32} thickness={4} />
                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ mt: 1.5, fontWeight: 500, color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" }}>
                  Đang kết nối camera...
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            )}

            {/* Biometric Face ID Mask & HUD */}
            {cameraReady && (
              <>
                {/* Oval Biometric Reticle */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    width: "54%",
                    height: "72%",
                    borderRadius: "48%",
                    border: "2px solid",
                    borderColor: "primary.light",
                    boxShadow: "0 0 0 9999px rgba(7, 17, 30, 0.58)",
                    zIndex: 2,
                    animation: "pulseHud 3s infinite ease-in-out",
                    pointerEvents: "none",
                  }}
                />

                {/* Corner Target Marks (Biometric Framing) */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    width: "60%",
                    height: "78%",
                    zIndex: 2,
                    pointerEvents: "none",
                    "&::before, &::after": {
                      content: '""',
                      position: "absolute",
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      borderColor: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)",
                    },
                    "&::before": {
                      top: 0,
                      left: 0,
                      borderTop: "2px solid",
                      borderLeft: "2px solid",
                      borderTopLeftRadius: "6px",
                    },
                    "&::after": {
                      top: 0,
                      right: 0,
                      borderTop: "2px solid",
                      borderRight: "2px solid",
                      borderTopRightRadius: "6px",
                    },
                  }}
                />
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    width: "60%",
                    height: "78%",
                    zIndex: 2,
                    pointerEvents: "none",
                    "&::before, &::after": {
                      content: '""',
                      position: "absolute",
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      borderColor: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)",
                    },
                    "&::before": {
                      bottom: 0,
                      left: 0,
                      borderBottom: "2px solid",
                      borderLeft: "2px solid",
                      borderBottomLeftRadius: "6px",
                    },
                    "&::after": {
                      bottom: 0,
                      right: 0,
                      borderBottom: "2px solid",
                      borderRight: "2px solid",
                      borderBottomRightRadius: "6px",
                    },
                  }}
                />

                {/* Scanning Laser Beam */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    width: "52%",
                    height: "2px",
                    background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #D4AF37 30%, #8B0000 70%, transparent)",
                    boxShadow: "0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.8), 0 0 16px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.6)",
                    zIndex: 3,
                    animation: "scanLaser 2.2s infinite ease-in-out",
                    pointerEvents: "none",
                  }}
                />

                {/* Top Status & Countdown Bar */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    top: 14,
                    zIndex: 4,
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 1,
                    px: 1.8,
                    py: 0.6,
                    borderRadius: 20,
                    bgcolor: "rgba(7, 17, 30, 0.72)",
                    backdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
                    border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)",
                    color: "white",
                  }}
                >
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      width: 8,
                      height: 8,
                      borderRadius: "50%",
                      bgcolor: countdownProgress > 20 ? "#10B981" : "#F59E0B",
                      boxShadow: `0 0 8px ${countdownProgress > 20 ? "#10B981" : "#F59E0B"}`,
                    }}
                  />
                  <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.78rem" }}>
                    Tự động nhận diện sau {Math.max(1, Math.ceil((countdownProgress / 100) * 2.4))}s
                  </Typography>
                </Box>

                {/* Bottom Guidance Tag */}
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    bottom: 14,
                    zIndex: 4,
                    color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)",
                    bgcolor: "rgba(7, 17, 30, 0.68)",
                    backdropFilter: "blur(6px)",
                    border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
                    px: 2,
                    py: 0.5,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    fontSize: "0.76rem",
                  }}
                >
                  Giữ khuôn mặt ổn định trong khung elip
                </Typography>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          /* ── STATE 4: Friendly Initial State (Not Connected Yet) ── */
          <Stack
            spacing={2}
            sx={{
              alignItems: "center",
              px: 3,
              textAlign: "center",
              py: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 76,
                height: 76,
                borderRadius: "50%",
                bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.08),
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.2),
                display: "grid",
                placeItems: "center",
                color: "primary.main",
                position: "relative",
              }}
            >
              <FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40 }} />
              <Box
                sx={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  bottom: -2,
                  right: -2,
                  bgcolor: "background.paper",
                  borderRadius: "50%",
                  p: 0.3,
                  display: "grid",
                  placeItems: "center",
                  color: "secondary.main",
                }}
              >
                <VerifiedUserOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
              </Box>
            </Box>

            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5 }}>
                Đăng nhập khuôn mặt AI
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", maxWidth: 280 }}>
                Nhận diện nhanh không cần nhập mật khẩu. Vui lòng bật camera để tiếp tục.
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <Stack
              direction="row"
              spacing={1}
              sx={{
                bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.04),
                px: 1.5,
                py: 0.75,
                borderRadius: 2,
                alignItems: "center",
              }}
            >
              <WbIncandescentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: "text.secondary" }} />
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
                Đảm bảo đủ ánh sáng và không đeo khẩu trang
              </Typography>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Paper>

      {/* ── Control Actions ── */}
      {imagePreview ? (
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          startIcon={<RefreshOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={() => {
            resetFaceState();
            startCamera();
          }}
          disabled={isLoading}
          fullWidth
          size="medium"
          sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5, py: 1.1, fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          Chụp lại
        </Button>
      ) : !isCameraOn ? (
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          startIcon={<PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={startCamera}
          size="large"
          fullWidth
          sx={{
            py: 1.35,
            fontWeight: 700,
            borderRadius: 2.5,
            boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
          }}
        >
          Bật camera
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5}>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            startIcon={<PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon />}
            onClick={executeFaceLogin}
            disabled={!cameraReady || isLoading}
            fullWidth
            size="large"
            sx={{
              py: 1.3,
              fontWeight: 700,
              borderRadius: 2.5,
              boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
            }}
          >
            Chụp ngay
          </Button>
          <Button
            color="inherit"
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={<VideocamOffOutlinedIcon />}
            onClick={stopCamera}
            disabled={isLoading}
            sx={{
              borderRadius: 2.5,
              minWidth: 120,
              borderColor: "divider",
              color: "text.secondary",
              "&:hover": { borderColor: "text.primary", color: "text.primary" },
            }}
          >
            Tắt
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Stack,
  TextField,
} from "@mui/material";
import VisibilityIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Visibility";
import VisibilityOffIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOff";
import LoginOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LoginOutlined";
import EmailOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined";
import LockOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";

interface LoginFormPasswordProps {
  email: string;
  setEmail: (val: string) => void;
  password: string;
  setPassword: (val: string) => void;
  showPassword: boolean;
  setShowPassword: (val: boolean) => void;
  onSubmit: (e: React.FormEvent) => void;
  onForgotClick: () => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
}

export default function LoginFormPassword({
  email,
  setEmail,
  password,
  setPassword,
  showPassword,
  setShowPassword,
  onSubmit,
  onForgotClick,
  isLoading,
}: LoginFormPasswordProps) {
  return (
    <Box component="form" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
      <Stack spacing={2.5}>
        <TextField
          label="Email"
          type="email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
          autoComplete="email"
          required
          fullWidth
          disabled={isLoading}
          slotProps={{
            input: {
              startAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="start">
                  <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
              sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
            },
          }}
        />

        <TextField
          label="Mật khẩu"
          type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
          value={password}
          onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
          autoComplete="current-password"
          required
          fullWidth
          disabled={isLoading}
          slotProps={{
            input: {
              startAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="start">
                  <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
              endAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="end">
                  <IconButton
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    edge="end"
                    size="small"
                    aria-label={showPassword ? "Ẩn mật khẩu" : "Hiện mật khẩu"}
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <VisibilityOffIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} /> : <VisibilityIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />}
                  </IconButton>
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
              sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
            },
          }}
        />

        {/* Forgot password */}
        <Box sx={{ textAlign: "right", mt: -0.5 }}>
          <Box
            component="button"
            type="button"
            onClick={onForgotClick}
            sx={{
              border: "none",
              bgcolor: "transparent",
              color: "primary.main",
              cursor: "pointer",
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: "0.85rem",
              transition: "opacity 0.2s",
              "&:hover": { opacity: 0.8, textDecoration: "underline" },
            }}
          >
            Quên mật khẩu?
          </Box>
        </Box>

        <Button
          type="submit"
          variant="contained"
          startIcon={isLoading ? <CircularProgress size={18} color="inherit" /> : <LoginOutlinedIcon />}
          size="large"
          fullWidth
          disabled={isLoading}
          sx={{
            py: 1.35,
            fontWeight: 700,
            borderRadius: 2.5,
            boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
          }}
        >
          {isLoading ? "Đang đăng nhập..." : "Đăng nhập"}
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Box, Button, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import ErrorOutlineIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlineOutlined';

export default function Error({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error('Route error:', error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        minHeight: '100vh',
        p: 3,
        textAlign: 'center',
        bgcolor: 'background.default',
      }}
    >
      <ErrorOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 64, color: 'error.main', mb: 2 }} />
      <Typography variant="h5" gutterBottom sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
        Đã xảy ra lỗi
      </Typography>
      <Typography color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 3, maxWidth: 400 }}>
        {error.message || 'Không thể tải trang. Vui lòng thử lại.'}
      </Typography>
      <Button variant="contained" onClick={reset}>
        Thử lại
      </Button>
    </Box>
  );
}

import { AxiosInstance } from 'axios';
import {
  AccessLogList,
  AccessLogPublic,
  CameraEvent,
  FaceResultEvent,
  ActivePatron,
  AccessFrequencyResponse,
  StatsResponse,
  PatronLookupResult,
  KioskResult,
  CameraStatus,
} from '../types';
import { normalizeAccessLog } from './utils';

const API_BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:80';

export function createAccessMethods(client: AxiosInstance) {
  return {
    async getAccessLogs(
      params?: {
        patronId?: string;
        cameraId?: string;
        status?: string;
        accessType?: string;
        dateFrom?: string;
        dateTo?: string;
        search?: string;
        skip?: number;
        limit?: number;
      }
    ): Promise<AccessLogList> {
      const query: any = {};
      if (params) {
        if (params.patronId) query.patron_id = params.patronId;
        if (params.cameraId) query.camera_id = params.cameraId;
        if (params.status) query.status = params.status;
        if (params.accessType) query.access_type = params.accessType;
        if (params.dateFrom) query.date_from = params.dateFrom;
        if (params.dateTo) query.date_to = params.dateTo;
        if (params.search) query.search = params.search;
        query.skip = params.skip ?? 0;
        query.limit = Math.min(params.limit ?? 50, 200);
      }
      const response = await client.get<AccessLogList | AccessLogPublic[]>("/api/access/logs", { params: query });
      const data = response.data;
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        const items = data.map(normalizeAccessLog);
        return { items, total: items.length };
      }
      const items = Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items.map(normalizeAccessLog) : [];
      return {
        items,
        total: typeof data?.total === "number" ? data.total : items.length,
      };
    },

    connectAccessSSE(
      onEvent: (event: CameraEvent) => void,
      onConnectionChange?: (connected: boolean) => void,
    ): () => void {
      const es = new EventSource(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/access/events`, { withCredentials: true });
      es.addEventListener("open", () => onConnectionChange?.(true));
      es.addEventListener("camera_event", (msg: MessageEvent) => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(msg.data) as CameraEvent;
          onEvent(data);
        } catch { /* ignore parse errors */ }
      });
      es.addEventListener("error", () => { onConnectionChange?.(false); });
      return () => es.close();
    },

    connectFaceResultSSE(
      onEvent: (event: FaceResultEvent) => void,
      onConnectionChange?: (connected: boolean) => void,
    ): () => void {
      const es = new EventSource(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/access/events`, { withCredentials: true });
      es.addEventListener("open", () => onConnectionChange?.(true));
      es.addEventListener("face_result", (msg: MessageEvent) => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(msg.data) as FaceResultEvent;
          onEvent(data);
        } catch { /* ignore parse errors */ }
      });
      es.addEventListener("error", () => { onConnectionChange?.(false); });
      return () => es.close();
    },

    async getRecentLogs(): Promise<AccessLogList> {
      const response = await client.get<AccessLogList | AccessLogPublic[]>("/api/access/recent");
      const data = response.data;
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        const items = data.map(normalizeAccessLog);
        return { items, total: items.length };
      }
      const items = Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items.map(normalizeAccessLog) : [];
      return {
        items,
        total: typeof data?.total === "number" ? data.total : items.length,
      };
    },

    async getActivePatrons(): Promise<{ items: ActivePatron[]; total: number }> {
      const response = await client.get<{ items: ActivePatron[]; total: number } | any[]>("/api/access/active");
      const data = response.data;
      const rawItems = Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : [];
      const items = rawItems.map((item: any) => ({
        ...item,
        id: item.id || item.patron_id,
        full_name: item.full_name || item.fullName || "",
        student_code: item.student_code || item.studentCode || "",
        entered_at: item.entered_at || item.last_entry_at || item.lastEntryAt || "",
        camera_id: item.camera_id || item.last_entry_camera || item.lastEntryCamera || "",
        image_url: item.image_url || null,
        confidence: item.confidence ?? null,
      }));
      return {
        items,
        total: typeof (data as any)?.total === "number" ? (data as any).total : items.length,
      };
    },

    async forceExitPatron(patronId: string): Promise<void> {
      await client.post("/api/access/force-exit", { patron_id: patronId });
    },

    async getAccessFrequency(params?: { dateFrom?: string; dateTo?: string }): Promise<AccessFrequencyResponse> {
      const query: any = {};
      if (params?.dateFrom) query.date_from = params.dateFrom;
      if (params?.dateTo) query.date_to = params.dateTo;
      const response = await client.get<AccessFrequencyResponse | any[]>("/api/access/frequency", { params: query });
      const data = response.data;
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        return { daily: Array.isArray(data?.daily) ? data.daily : [] };
      }
      const byDate = new Map<string, { date: string; entry: number; exit: number }>();
      data.forEach((row: any) => {
        const date = new Date(row.date).toISOString().split("T")[0];
        const item = byDate.get(date) || { date, entry: 0, exit: 0 };
        const type = row.access_type || row.accessType;
        const count = Number(row.count || 0);
        if (type === "entry") item.entry += count;
        if (type === "exit") item.exit += count;
        byDate.set(date, item);
      });
      return { daily: [...byDate.values()].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)) };
    },

    async getStats(): Promise<StatsResponse> {
      const response = await client.get<any>("/api/patrons/stats");
      const data = response.data || {};
      return {
        total_patrons: data.totalPatrons ?? 0,
        active_patrons: data.activePatrons ?? 0,
        today_entries: data.todayEntries ?? 0,
        today_exits: data.todayExits ?? 0,
      };
    },

    async kioskLookup(studentCode?: string, cardNumber?: string): Promise<PatronLookupResult> {
      const params: any = {};
      if (studentCode) params.student_code = studentCode;
      if (cardNumber) params.card_number = cardNumber;
      const response = await client.post<PatronLookupResult>("/api/kiosk/lookup", null, { params });
      return response.data;
    },

    async kioskEnroll(
      imageFile: File, fullName: string, studentCode: string, membershipExpiry: string,
      className?: string, angle: string = "frontal"
    ): Promise<KioskResult> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("image", imageFile);
      formData.append("full_name", fullName);
      formData.append("student_code", studentCode);
      formData.append("membership_expiry", membershipExpiry);
      formData.append("angle", angle);
      if (className) formData.append("class_name", className);
      const response = await client.post<KioskResult>("/api/kiosk/enroll", formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async kioskEnter(imageFile: File, studentCode: string): Promise<KioskResult> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("image", imageFile);
      formData.append("student_code", studentCode);
      const response = await client.post<KioskResult>("/api/kiosk/enter", formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async kioskBatchEnroll(
      imageFrontal: File, imageRight: File, imageLeft: File, imageDown: File,
      fullName: string, studentCode: string, membershipExpiry: string, className?: string,
    ): Promise<KioskResult> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("image_frontal", imageFrontal);
      formData.append("image_right", imageRight);
      formData.append("image_left", imageLeft);
      formData.append("image_down", imageDown);
      formData.append("full_name", fullName);
      formData.append("student_code", studentCode);
      formData.append("membership_expiry", membershipExpiry);
      if (className) formData.append("class_name", className);
      const response = await client.post<KioskResult>("/api/kiosk/batch-enroll", formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async kioskPresence(patronId: string, studentCode: string, deviceId: string): Promise<{ current_status: string; message: string }> {
      const response = await client.post("/api/access/kiosk/presence", { patron_id: patronId, student_code: studentCode, device_id: deviceId });
      return response.data;
    },

    async confirmEntry(patronId: string): Promise<{ current_status: string; message: string }> {
      const response = await client.post(`/api/internal/access/patrons/${patronId}/confirm-entry`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async revertPending(patronId: string): Promise<{ current_status: string; message: string }> {
      const response = await client.post(`/api/internal/access/patrons/${patronId}/revert-pending`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async createKioskApprovalRequest(data: { device_id: string; patron_id: string; student_code: string; fail_image_url?: string; isbns?: string }) {
      const response = await client.post("/api/access/kiosk/approval-request", data);
      return response.data;
    },

    async getPendingApprovalRequests() {
      const response = await client.get("/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/pending");
      return response.data;
    },

    async getApprovalRequestStatus(code: string) {
      const response = await client.get(`/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/${code}`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async approveKioskRequest(code: string, approvedBy: string): Promise<{ status: string; event_code: string }> {
      const response = await client.post(`/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/${code}/approve`, { approved_by: approvedBy });
      return response.data;
    },

    async rejectKioskRequest(code: string, approvedBy: string, reason?: string): Promise<{ status: string; event_code: string }> {
      const response = await client.post(`/api/access/kiosk/approval-requests/${code}/reject`, { approved_by: approvedBy, reason });
      return response.data;
    },

    async kioskEnrollFace(patronId: string, imageFile: File, angle: string = "frontal"): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("image", imageFile);
      formData.append("angle", angle);
      const response = await client.post(`/api/kiosk/enroll-face/${patronId}`, formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async getCameraStatus(): Promise<CameraStatus[]> {
      const response = await client.get<CameraStatus[]>("/api/camera/status");
      return response.data;
    },

    async reconnectCamera(cameraId: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
      const response = await client.post<{ message: string }>(`/api/camera/reconnect/${cameraId}`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async reconnectAllCameras(): Promise<{ message: string; cameras: string[] }> {
      const response = await client.post<{ message: string; cameras: string[] }>("/api/camera/reconnect-all");
      return response.data;
    },
  };
}

import { AxiosInstance } from "axios";
import type {
  LoginRequest,
  RegisterRequest,
  TokenResponse,
  UserPublic,
} from "../types";

export function createAuthMethods(client: AxiosInstance) {
  return {
    login: async (data: LoginRequest): Promise<TokenResponse> => {
      const response = await client.post<TokenResponse>("/api/auth/login", data);
      return response.data;
    },

    register: async (data: RegisterRequest): Promise<UserPublic> => {
      const response = await client.post<UserPublic>("/api/auth/register", data);
      return response.data;
    },

    verifyEmail: async (data: { email: string; code: string }): Promise<void> => {
      await client.post("/api/auth/verify-email", data);
    },

    resendVerification: async (email: string): Promise<void> => {
      await client.post("/api/auth/resend-verification", { email });
    },

    requestEmailCorrection: async (data: {
      current_email: string;
      new_email: string;
    }): Promise<void> => {
      await client.post("/api/auth/correct-email/request-otp", data);
    },

    verifyEmailCorrection: async (data: {
      current_email: string;
      new_email: string;
      code: string;
    }): Promise<void> => {
      await client.post("/api/auth/correct-email/verify", data);
    },

    refreshAuthToken: async (refreshToken: string): Promise<TokenResponse> => {
      const response = await client.post<TokenResponse>("/api/auth/refresh", {
        refresh_token: refreshToken,
      });
      return response.data;
    },

    logout: async (): Promise<void> => {
      await client.post("/api/auth/logout");
    },

    faceLogin: async (imageFile: File): Promise<TokenResponse> => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", imageFile);
      const response = await client.post<TokenResponse>(
        "/api/auth/face-login",
        formData
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    getCurrentUser: async (): Promise<UserPublic> => {
      const response = await client.get<UserPublic>("/users/me");
      return response.data;
    },

    uploadAvatar: async (file: File): Promise<{ avatarUrl: string }> => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("avatar", file);
      const response = await client.post<{ avatarUrl: string }>(
        "/users/me/avatar",
        formData
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    deleteAvatar: async (): Promise<void> => {
      await client.delete("/users/me/avatar");
    },

    updateProfile: async (data: {
      full_name?: string;
      phone?: string;
      permanent_address?: string;
    }): Promise<UserPublic> => {
      const response = await client.put<UserPublic>("/users/me/profile", data);
      return response.data;
    },

    requestPasswordChangeOtp: async (data: {
      old_password: string;
      new_password: string;
    }): Promise<{ message: string }> => {
      const response = await client.post<{ message: string }>(
        "/users/me/password/request-otp",
        data
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    changePassword: async (data: {
      old_password?: string;
      new_password?: string;
      code?: string;
      otp?: string;
    }): Promise<{ message: string }> => {
      const response = await client.put<{ message: string }>(
        "/users/me/password",
        data
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    requestEmailChangeOtp: async (data: {
      new_email: string;
    }): Promise<{ message: string }> => {
      const response = await client.post<{ message: string }>(
        "/users/me/email/request-otp",
        data
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    verifyAndChangeEmail: async (data: {
      new_email: string;
      code: string;
    }): Promise<{ message: string }> => {
      const response = await client.put<{ message: string }>(
        "/users/me/email",
        data
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    getFaceEnrollmentStatus: async (): Promise<{
      has_face: boolean;
      full_name: string | null;
      role: string;
    }> => {
      const response = await client.get<{
        has_face: boolean;
        full_name: string | null;
        role: string;
      }>("/api/users/me");
      return response.data;
    },
  };

================
File: src/lib/api/client.ts
================
import axios, { AxiosInstance, AxiosError } from "axios";
import { bus } from "../event-bus";
import type { TokenResponse } from "../types";
import {
  getApiAccessToken,
  setApiAccessToken,
  getCookieValue,
  isTokenExpiringSoon,
  setAccessTokenCookie,
} from "./utils";

const RAW_API_BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:80";
const API_BASE_URL = RAW_API_BASE_URL.replace(/\/api\/?$/, "").replace(/\/$/, "");

export class ApiClient {
  client: AxiosInstance;
  private refreshPromise: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
  private _pendingRequests: Array<{ request: any; resolve: (val: any) => void; reject: (err: any) => void }> = [];
  private _showingReauth = false;

  constructor() {
    this.client = axios.create({
      baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
      withCredentials: true,
    });

    this.client.interceptors.request.use(
      async (config) => {
        let token = getApiAccessToken();
        if (!token && typeof document !== "undefined") {
          token = getCookieValue("access_token");
        }
        if (token && isTokenExpiringSoon(token) && !config.url?.includes('/auth/')) {
          if (!this.refreshPromise) {
            this.refreshPromise = this.refreshToken();
          }
          const refreshed = await this.refreshPromise;
          this.refreshPromise = null;
          if (refreshed) {
            token = getApiAccessToken() || getCookieValue("access_token");
          }
        }
        if (token) {
          config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
        }
        return config;
      },
      (error) => Promise.reject(error)
    );

    this.client.interceptors.response.use(
      (response) => response,
      async (error: AxiosError) => {
        const url = error.config?.url || '';
        const status = error.response?.status;
        const data = error.response?.data;
        if (status && status >= 400) {
          const msg = typeof data === 'object' ? (data as any).detail || (data as any).error || '' : '';
          console.warn(`[API] ${error.config?.method?.toUpperCase()} ${url} ${status}${msg ? `: ${msg}` : ''}`);
        }
        const originalRequest = error.config;
        if (status === 401 && originalRequest) {
          if (originalRequest.url?.includes('/auth/') || originalRequest.url?.includes('/camera/')) {
            return Promise.reject(error);
          }
          return this.handleUnauthorized(originalRequest);
        }
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
    );
  }

  private async handleUnauthorized(originalRequest: any): Promise<any> {
    if (originalRequest._retry) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error("Session expired"));
    }
    originalRequest._retry = true;

    if (!this.refreshPromise) {
      this.refreshPromise = this.refreshToken();
    }

    const refreshed = await this.refreshPromise;
    this.refreshPromise = null;

    if (refreshed) {
      return this.client(originalRequest);
    }

    bus.emit("auth:required");
    return Promise.reject(new Error("Session expired"));
  }

  public retryPendingRequests(newToken: string): void {
    const token = newToken;
    setApiAccessToken(token);
    setAccessTokenCookie(token);
    const queue = [...this._pendingRequests];
    this._pendingRequests = [];
    this._showingReauth = false;
    queue.forEach(({ request, resolve, reject }) => {
      request.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
      this.client(request).then(resolve).catch(reject);
    });
  }

  public cancelPendingRequests(): void {
    const queue = [...this._pendingRequests];
    this._pendingRequests = [];
    this._showingReauth = false;
    queue.forEach(({ reject }) => reject(new Error("Session expired")));
  }

  private async refreshToken(): Promise<boolean> {
    let refreshToken = getCookieValue("refresh_token");
    if (!refreshToken) {
      refreshToken = getApiAccessToken() ? null : null;
    }
    if (!refreshToken) return false;

    try {
      const response = await axios.post<TokenResponse>(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/api/auth/refresh`,
        { refresh_token: refreshToken }
      );
      const { access_token, refresh_token: newRefreshToken } = response.data;
      if (!access_token) return false;
      setApiAccessToken(access_token);
      setAccessTokenCookie(access_token);
      if (newRefreshToken) {
        document.cookie = `refresh_token=${newRefreshToken}; path=/; max-age=${7 * 24 * 60 * 60}; SameSite=Lax`;
      }
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

export const api = new ApiClient();
export default api;

import { AxiosInstance } from "axios";

export function createFaceMethods(client: AxiosInstance) {
  return {
    async enrollBatch(
      files: { frontal: File; right: File; left: File; down: File },
      consentGiven: boolean = true,
      token?: string
    ): Promise<{ job_id: string }> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("frontal", files.frontal);
      formData.append("right", files.right);
      formData.append("left", files.left);
      formData.append("down", files.down);
      formData.append("consent_given", String(consentGiven));

      const config = token ? { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } : undefined;
      const response = await client.post("/api/face/enroll-batch", formData, config);
      return response.data;
    },

    async verifyFace(
      imageFile: File,
      targetUserId: string,
      consentGiven: boolean = true
    ): Promise<{ job_id: string }> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", imageFile);
      formData.append("target_user_id", targetUserId);
      formData.append("consent_given", String(consentGiven));

      const response = await client.post("/api/face/verify", formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async identifyFace(
      imageFile: File,
      consentGiven: boolean = true
    ): Promise<{ job_id: string }> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", imageFile);
      formData.append("consent_given", String(consentGiven));

      const response = await client.post("/api/face/identify", formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async livenessCheck(
      imageFile: File,
      consentGiven: boolean = true
    ): Promise<{ job_id: string }> {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", imageFile);
      formData.append("consent_given", String(consentGiven));

      const response = await client.post("/api/face/liveness", formData);
      return response.data;
    },

    async deleteFaceData(userId: string): Promise<{ job_id: string }> {
      const response = await client.delete(`/api/face/${userId}`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async processFaceImage(formData: FormData): Promise<{ task_id: string; status: string }> {
      const response = await client.post("/api/face/process", formData, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      return response.data;
    },

    async processFaceImageSync(data: {
      image: string;
      camera_id?: string;
      process_type?: string;
      consent_given?: boolean;
      target_user_id?: string;
      connection_id?: string;

      status: string;

    }> {

  };

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface UseHoldOptions {
  onHoldComplete: () => void;
  duration?: number;
}

export default function useHold({ onHoldComplete, duration = 1000 }: UseHoldOptions) {
  const [holding, setHolding] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const completedRef = useRef(false);

  const clearTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const onStart = useCallback(() => {
    completedRef.current = false;
    setHolding(true);
    setProgress(0);

    const interval = 50;
    const steps = duration / interval;
    let currentStep = 0;

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      currentStep++;
      const newProgress = Math.min(currentStep / steps, 1);
      setProgress(newProgress);

      if (newProgress >= 1 && !completedRef.current) {
        completedRef.current = true;
        clearTimer();
        setHolding(false);
        setProgress(0);
        onHoldComplete();
      }
    }, interval);
  }, [clearTimer, duration, onHoldComplete]);

  const onEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (!completedRef.current) {
      clearTimer();
      setHolding(false);
      setProgress(0);
    }
  }, [clearTimer]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => clearTimer();
  }, [clearTimer]);

  return { holding, progress, onStart, onEnd };
}

File: src/lib/hooks/useTaskSSE.ts

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { FaceResultEvent } from "@/lib/types";

export interface TaskSSEState {
  /** Current task status: IDLE | CONNECTING | WAITING | SUCCESS | FAILURE | ERROR | TIMEOUT */
  status: "IDLE" | "CONNECTING" | "WAITING" | "SUCCESS" | "FAILURE" | "ERROR" | "TIMEOUT";
  /** Result data when status is SUCCESS */
  result: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  /** Error message when status is FAILURE or ERROR or TIMEOUT */
  error: string | null;
  /** Whether SSE is connected */
  connected: boolean;
}

/**
 * Generic hook that replaces HTTP polling for task results.
 *
 * Listens for `face_result` SSE events filtered by task_id.
 * Returns `{ status, result, error, connected }` and a `start` function.
 *
 * Usage:
 * ```tsx
 * const { state, start, reset } = useTaskSSE();
 * // After calling an async face API that returns job_id:
 * start(jobId);
 * // state.status will change to SUCCESS/FAILURE when the SSE event arrives
 * ```
 */
export function useTaskSSE(timeoutMs = 120000) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<TaskSSEState>({
    status: "IDLE",
    result: null,
    error: null,
    connected: false,
  });

  const targetTaskIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const timeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const cleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
      cleanupRef.current?.();
    };
  }, []);

  const safeSetState = useCallback((updater: (prev: TaskSSEState) => TaskSSEState) => {
    if (mountedRef.current) setState(updater);
  }, []);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    cleanupRef.current?.();
    cleanupRef.current = null;
    targetTaskIdRef.current = null;
    safeSetState(() => ({
      status: "IDLE",
      result: null,
      error: null,
      connected: false,
    }));
  }, [safeSetState]);

  const start = useCallback((taskId: string) => {
    // Clean up any previous listener
    if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    cleanupRef.current?.();

    targetTaskIdRef.current = taskId;
    safeSetState(() => ({
      status: "CONNECTING",
      result: null,
      error: null,
      connected: false,
    }));

    const cleanup = api.connectFaceResultSSE(
      (event: FaceResultEvent) => {
        if (event.task_id !== targetTaskIdRef.current) return;
        if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
        cleanupRef.current?.();
        cleanupRef.current = null;

        if (event.status === "SUCCESS") {
          safeSetState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            status: "SUCCESS",
            result: event.result || null,
            error: null,
          }));
        } else {
          const errorMsg = (event.result as any)?.error || "Tác vụ thất bại.";
          safeSetState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            status: "FAILURE",
            result: event.result || null,
            error: errorMsg,
          }));
        }
      },
      (connected) => {
        safeSetState((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          connected,
          status: connected && prev.status === "CONNECTING" ? "WAITING" : prev.status,
        }));
      },
    );

    cleanupRef.current = cleanup;

    // Set timeout
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      cleanupRef.current?.();
      cleanupRef.current = null;
      safeSetState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        status: "TIMEOUT",
        error: "Quá thời gian chờ kết quả.",
      }));
    }, timeoutMs);
  }, [timeoutMs, safeSetState]);

  return { state, start, reset };
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface UseUndoOptions<T> {
  onConfirm: (item: T) => void | Promise<void>;
  undoDuration?: number;
}

export default function useUndo<T>({ onConfirm, undoDuration = 5 }: UseUndoOptions<T>) {
  const [pendingDelete, setPendingDelete] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(0);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const clearTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const markForDelete = useCallback((item: T) => {
    clearTimer();
    setPendingDelete(item);
    setCountdown(undoDuration);

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearTimer();
          setPendingDelete(null);
          setCountdown(0);
          onConfirm(item);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, [clearTimer, onConfirm, undoDuration]);

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimer();
    setPendingDelete(null);
    setCountdown(0);
  }, [clearTimer]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => clearTimer();
  }, [clearTimer]);

  return { pendingDelete, countdown, isPending: pendingDelete !== null, markForDelete, undo };
}

type OcrWorkerStatus = "idle" | "processing" | "done" | "error";

interface OcrWorkerCallbacks {
  onProgress?: (pct: number) => void;
  onResult?: (preprocessed: string) => void;
  onError?: (err: string) => void;
}

const WORKER_CODE = `
self.addEventListener("message", async (e) => {
  const { imageData } = e.data;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(imageData);
    const blob = await response.blob();
    const imageBitmap = await createImageBitmap(blob);
    
    const w = Math.min(imageBitmap.width, 1920);
    const scale = w / imageBitmap.width;
    const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(w, Math.round(imageBitmap.height * scale));
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) {
      imageBitmap.close();
      self.postMessage({ type: "done", data: imageData });
      return;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(imageBitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    imageBitmap.close();
    
    const imageDataObj = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const data = imageDataObj.data;
    const weights = [0.299, 0.587, 0.114];
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
      sum += weights[0] * data[i] + weights[1] * data[i + 1] + weights[2] * data[i + 2];
    }
    const avgBrightness = sum / (data.length / 4);
    const factor = avgBrightness > 180 ? 1.3 : avgBrightness < 80 ? 1.5 : 1.1;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
      const gray = weights[0] * data[i] + weights[1] * data[i + 1] + weights[2] * data[i + 2];
      const enhanced = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.round((gray - 128) * factor + 128)));
      data[i] = enhanced; data[i + 1] = enhanced; data[i + 2] = enhanced;
    }
    ctx.putImageData(imageDataObj, 0, 0);
    canvas.convertToBlob({ type: "image/jpeg", quality: 0.95 }).then((blob) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => self.postMessage({ type: "done", data: reader.result });
      reader.onerror = () => self.postMessage({ type: "done", data: imageData });
      reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
  } catch {
    self.postMessage({ type: "done", data: imageData });
  }
});
`;

function createWorkerBlob(): Worker | null {
  try {
    const blob = new Blob([WORKER_CODE], { type: "application/javascript" });
    return new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export class OcrWorker {
  private worker: Worker | null = null;
  private status: OcrWorkerStatus = "idle";
  private callbacks: OcrWorkerCallbacks = {};

  constructor() {
    this.worker = createWorkerBlob();
    if (this.worker) {
      this.worker.addEventListener("message", (e) => {
        const { type, data } = e.data;
        if (type === "done") {
          this.status = "done";
          this.callbacks.onResult?.(data);
        }
      });
      this.worker.addEventListener("error", () => {
        this.status = "error";
        this.callbacks.onError?.("Worker error");
      });
    }
  }

  get isSupported(): boolean {
    return this.worker !== null;
  }

  get currentStatus(): OcrWorkerStatus {
    return this.status;
  }

  preprocess(imageData: string, cb: OcrWorkerCallbacks): void {
    this.status = "processing";
    this.callbacks = cb;
    if (this.worker) {
      this.worker.postMessage({ imageData });
    } else {
      cb.onError?.("Worker not available");
    }
  }

  terminate(): void {
    this.worker?.terminate();
    this.worker = null;
    this.status = "idle";
  }
}

export interface ScannedCardData {
  studentCode: string;
  fullName: string;
  className: string | null;
  dateOfBirth: string | null;
  course: string | null;
  permanentAddress: string | null;
  faculty: string | null;
  rawText: string;
}

/**
 * Parse raw OCR text into structured card data using the backend LLM endpoint.
 *
 * This replaces the previous regex-based parsing with an LLM-powered extraction
 * that handles variations in card layout, OCR errors, and damaged cards.
 *
 * The backend uses OpenRouter (GPT-4.1-mini) to extract structured fields
 * from the raw OCR text, then returns the parsed result.
 *
 * @param rawText - The raw text output from Tesseract OCR
 * @returns Parsed card data with extracted fields
 */
export async function parseCardText(rawText: string): Promise<Partial<ScannedCardData>> {
  if (!rawText || rawText.trim().length === 0) {
    return { rawText: rawText || "" };
  }

  try {
    const API_BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "";
    const token = typeof window !== "undefined"
      ? localStorage.getItem("accessToken") || sessionStorage.getItem("accessToken")
      : undefined;

    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    };
    if (token) {
      headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }

    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/ai/parse-card-text`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ raw_text: rawText }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      // Fallback: return raw text without parsed fields
      console.warn(`Card parsing API failed: ${response.status}`);
      return { rawText };
    }

    const parsed = await response.json();

    return {
      studentCode: parsed.student_code || "",
      fullName: parsed.full_name || "",
      className: parsed.class_name || null,
      dateOfBirth: parsed.date_of_birth || null,
      course: parsed.course || null,
      permanentAddress: parsed.permanent_address || null,
      faculty: parsed.faculty || null,
      rawText,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Card parsing failed, returning raw text:", err);
    return { rawText };
  }
}

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import Webcam from "react-webcam";

type ScannerPhase = "detecting" | "processing" | "confirm";

const MAX_DETECT_ATTEMPTS = 10;
const DETECT_INTERVAL_MS = 4000;

interface UseFaceScannerOptions {
  phase: ScannerPhase;
  onPhaseChange: (phase: ScannerPhase) => void;
  onCapture: (imageData: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  onError?: (error: string) => void;
  videoSource?: "webcam" | "ipcamera";
  webcamRef: React.RefObject<Webcam | null>;
  ipCamRef: React.RefObject<HTMLImageElement | null>;
}

interface UseFaceScannerReturn {
  cameraReady: boolean;
  setCameraReady: (v: boolean) => void;
  detectAttempts: number;
  startDetection: () => void;
  stopDetection: () => void;
}

export function useFaceScanner({
  phase,
  onPhaseChange,
  onCapture,
  onError,
  videoSource = "webcam",
  webcamRef,
  ipCamRef,
}: UseFaceScannerOptions): UseFaceScannerReturn {
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [detectAttempts, setDetectAttempts] = useState(0);
  const isMounted = useRef(true);
  const phaseRef = useRef(phase);
  const detectTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    phaseRef.current = phase;
  }, [phase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => { isMounted.current = false; };
  }, []);

  const stopDetection = useCallback(() => {
    if (detectTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(detectTimerRef.current);
      detectTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const captureFrame = useCallback((): string | null => {
    if (videoSource === "ipcamera") {
      const img = ipCamRef.current;
      if (!img || !img.complete || img.naturalWidth === 0) return null;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = img.naturalWidth;
      canvas.height = img.naturalHeight;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return null;
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
      return canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.95);
    }
    return webcamRef.current?.getScreenshot() || null;
  }, [videoSource, webcamRef, ipCamRef]);

  const checkImageHasContent = useCallback((dataUrl: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        const w = Math.min(img.width, 320);
        const h = Math.round((w / img.width) * img.height);
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) { resolve(true); return; }
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
        const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
        let sum = 0;
        let min = 255;
        let max = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 16) {
          const gray = 0.299 * data[i] + 0.587 * data[i + 1] + 0.114 * data[i + 2];
          sum += gray;
          if (gray < min) min = gray;
          if (gray > max) max = gray;
        }
        const pixels = data.length / 16;
        const avg = sum / pixels;
        const contrast = max - min;
        resolve(contrast > 30 && avg > 20 && avg < 240);
      };
      img.onerror = () => resolve(true);
      img.src = dataUrl;
    });
  }, []);

  const attemptAutoDetect = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isMounted.current || phaseRef.current !== "detecting") return;

    const imageSrc = captureFrame();
    if (!imageSrc) {
      if (isMounted.current && phaseRef.current === "detecting") {
        detectTimerRef.current = setTimeout(attemptAutoDetect, DETECT_INTERVAL_MS);
      }
      return;
    }

    setDetectAttempts((prev) => {
      const next = prev + 1;
      if (next >= MAX_DETECT_ATTEMPTS && isMounted.current) {
        onError?.("Không thể phát hiện thẻ sau nhiều lần thử. Hãy chụp thủ công hoặc tải ảnh.");
      }
      return next;
    });

    const hasContent = await checkImageHasContent(imageSrc);
    if (!hasContent) {
      if (isMounted.current && phaseRef.current === "detecting") {
        detectTimerRef.current = setTimeout(attemptAutoDetect, DETECT_INTERVAL_MS);
      }
      return;
    }

    onPhaseChange("processing");
    const success = await onCapture(imageSrc);

    if (!isMounted.current) return;

    if (success) return;

    onPhaseChange("detecting");

    if (isMounted.current && phaseRef.current === "detecting") {
      detectTimerRef.current = setTimeout(attemptAutoDetect, DETECT_INTERVAL_MS);
    }
  }, [onCapture, onError, captureFrame, checkImageHasContent, onPhaseChange]);

  const startDetection = useCallback(() => {
    stopDetection();
    setDetectAttempts(0);
    detectTimerRef.current = setTimeout(attemptAutoDetect, 1000);
  }, [stopDetection, attemptAutoDetect]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (detectTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(detectTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return {
    cameraReady,
    setCameraReady,
    detectAttempts,
    startDetection,
    stopDetection,
  };
}

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { OcrWorker } from "./OcrWorker";
import { parseCardText, ScannedCardData } from "./parseCardText";

interface OcrProcessorState {
  progress: number;
  loading: boolean;
  workerAvailable: boolean;
}

interface UseOcrProcessorReturn {
  state: OcrProcessorState;
  runOcr: (imageData: string) => Promise<Partial<ScannedCardData> | null>;
  terminate: () => void;
}

/**
 * OCR processor that sends images to the backend for server-side Tesseract OCR.
 *
 * The frontend still does image preprocessing (Web Worker for grayscale + contrast)
 * to reduce bandwidth, but the actual OCR runs on the backend.
 *
 * This replaces the previous client-side Tesseract.js implementation that loaded
 * 20+ MB WASM and ran OCR in the browser.
 */
export function useOcrProcessor(
  onError?: (error: string) => void,
): UseOcrProcessorReturn {
  const [state, setState] = useState<OcrProcessorState>({
    progress: 0,
    loading: false,
    workerAvailable: true,
  });
  const preprocessWorkerRef = useRef<OcrWorker | null>(null);
  const isMounted = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => { isMounted.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const preprocessor = new OcrWorker();
    preprocessWorkerRef.current = preprocessor;
    if (!preprocessor.isSupported) {
      setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, workerAvailable: false }));
    }

    return () => {
      preprocessor.terminate();
    };
  }, []);

  const runOcr = useCallback(async (
    imageData: string,
  ): Promise<Partial<ScannedCardData> | null> => {
    try {
      setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, progress: 0, loading: true }));

      // Step 1: Preprocess image via Web Worker (grayscale + contrast)
      const preprocessor = preprocessWorkerRef.current;
      let processed: string;
      if (preprocessor?.isSupported) {
        processed = await new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
          preprocessor.preprocess(imageData, {
            onResult: (data) => resolve(data),
            onError: () => resolve(imageData),
          });
        });
      } else {
        processed = imageData;
      }

      // Step 2: Extract base64 data from the processed data URL
      const base64Data = processed.includes(",")
        ? processed.split(",")[1]
        : processed;

      // Step 3: Send to backend OCR endpoint
      const API_BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "";
      const token = typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? localStorage.getItem("accessToken") || sessionStorage.getItem("accessToken")
        : undefined;

      const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      };
      if (token) {
        headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      }

      const ocrResponse = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/face/ocr/process-card`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ image: base64Data }),
      });

      if (!ocrResponse.ok) {
        const errorData = await ocrResponse.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || `OCR request failed: ${ocrResponse.status}`);
      }

      const ocrResult = await ocrResponse.json();
      setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, progress: 100 }));

      // Step 4: Parse the raw OCR text using LLM via backend
      if (!ocrResult.raw_text || ocrResult.raw_text.trim().length === 0) {
        setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, loading: false }));
        return null;
      }

      const parsed = await parseCardText(ocrResult.raw_text);
      setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, loading: false }));
      return parsed;
    } catch (err: any) {
      setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, loading: false }));
      onError?.("Lỗi OCR: " + (err.message || ""));
      return null;
    }
  }, [onError]);

  const terminate = useCallback(() => {
    preprocessWorkerRef.current?.terminate();
    preprocessWorkerRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  return { state, runOcr, terminate };
}

/**
 * Classifies an alert message to determine if it is a business/operational warning
 * or a system error.
 */
export function getAlertSeverity(message?: string | null): "warning" | "error" | "info" {
  if (!message) return "info";
  if (
    /chưa|không tìm thấy|hết hạn|khóa|quá hạn|tối đa|vui lòng|đã mượn|đang mượn|tồn tại|hợp lệ|chú ý|lưu ý|yêu cầu/i.test(
      message
    )
  ) {
    return "warning";
  }
  return "error";
}

export function getAlertTitle(message?: string | null): string {
  if (!message) return "Thông báo";
  if (
    /chưa|không tìm thấy|hết hạn|khóa|quá hạn|tối đa|vui lòng|đã mượn|đang mượn|tồn tại|hợp lệ|chú ý|lưu ý|yêu cầu/i.test(
      message
    )
  ) {
    return "Thông báo";
  }
  return "Lỗi";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Pattern-match table  (order matters — first match wins)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface ErrorPattern {
  pattern: RegExp;
  message: string | ((match: RegExpMatchArray) => string);
}

const PATTERNS: ErrorPattern[] = [
  // "Phiên làm việc đã hết hạn (Xh). Vui lòng vào lại qua cổng."
  {
    pattern: /phi[eê]n l[àa]m vi[eê]c đ[aã] h[eê]t h[aạ]n \((\d+)h\)/i,
    message: (m) =>
      `Phiên làm việc đã hết hạn (${m[1]} giờ). Vui lòng quét thẻ tại cổng để vào lại thư viện.`,
  },
  {
    pattern: /phi[eê]n.*h[eê]t h[aạ]n.*c[oô]ng/i,
    message:
      "Phiên làm việc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng quét thẻ tại cổng để vào lại thư viện.",
  },

  // "Đã quá giới hạn mượn sách (tối đa N cuốn)"
  {
    pattern: /(?:da qua|qua|đã quá) gioi han muon sach.*?(\d+)\s*cu[oô]n/i,
    message: (m) =>
      `Đã đạt giới hạn mượn sách. Bạn chỉ được mượn tối đa ${m[1]} cuốn cùng lúc.`,
  },
  {
    pattern: /qua gioi han muon sach/i,
    message: "Đã đạt giới hạn số sách được phép mượn.",
  },

  // "Đã đạt giới hạn gia hạn tối đa N lần"
  {
    pattern: /da dat gioi han gia han.*?(\d+)\s*l[aâ]n/i,
    message: (m) =>
      `Sách đã được gia hạn tối đa ${m[1]} lần. Vui lòng trả sách và mượn lại nếu cần.`,
  },

  // "Không tìm thấy bản sao nào với mã vạch XXX"
  {
    pattern: /khong tim thay ban sao.*?ma vach (.+)$/i,
    message: (m) =>
      `Không tìm thấy sách với mã vạch "${m[1].trim()}". Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.`,
  },

  // "Bản sao XXX đang được mượn"
  {
    pattern: /b[aả]n sao (.+?) dang du[oơ]c muon/i,
    message: (m) => `Bản sao "${m[1]}" hiện đang được mượn. Vui lòng chọn bản khác.`,
  },

  // "Sách "TITLE" đã được độc giả này mượn"
  {
    pattern: /s[aá]ch\s*[«""](.+?)["""»]\s*(?:da|đã)\s*(?:du[oơ]c|được)\s*(?:doc gia|độc giả)/i,
    message: (m) =>
      `Sách "${m[1].trim()}" đã được độc giả này mượn rồi.`,
  },

  // "Mỗi phiếu mượn tối đa N cuốn"
  {
    pattern: /moi phieu muon toi da (\d+) cu[oô]n/i,
    message: (m) =>
      `Mỗi phiếu mượn chỉ được tối đa ${m[1]} cuốn sách.`,
  },

  // "Bản sao UUID không tồn tại" — hide UUID
  {
    pattern: /b[aả]n sao\s+[0-9a-f-]{8,36}\s+kh[oô]ng t[oồ]n t[aạ]i/i,
    message: "Bản sao sách không tồn tại trong hệ thống. Vui lòng liên hệ thủ thư.",
  },

  // "Sách UUID không tồn tại" — hide UUID
  {
    pattern: /s[aá]ch\s+[0-9a-f-]{8,36}\s+kh[oô]ng t[oồ]n t[aạ]i/i,
    message: "Sách không tồn tại trong hệ thống. Vui lòng liên hệ thủ thư.",
  },

  // Zod / validation errors
  {
    pattern: /required|is required/i,
    message: "Vui lòng điền đầy đủ thông tin bắt buộc.",
  },
  {
    pattern: /invalid.*uuid/i,
    message: "Dữ liệu định danh không hợp lệ. Vui lòng thử lại.",
  },

  // HTTP 5xx generic
  {
    pattern: /5\d\d|internal server|server error/i,
    message: "Hệ thống đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút.",
  },
];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Public API
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Translate a raw backend error string into a user-friendly Vietnamese message.
 * Returns the original string if no mapping is found.
 */
export function translateError(raw: string): string {
  const key = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Exact match
  if (EXACT_MAP[key]) return EXACT_MAP[key];

  // 2. Pattern match
  for (const { pattern, message } of PATTERNS) {
    const m = raw.match(pattern);
    if (m) {
      return typeof message === "function" ? message(m) : message;
    }
  }

  // 3. Return cleaned-up original
  return raw;
}

File: src/lib/event-bus.ts

type Listener = (...args: any[]) => void;

class EventBus {
  private listeners: Record<string, Listener[]> = {};

  on(event: string, fn: Listener): () => void {
    (this.listeners[event] ??= []).push(fn);
    return () => this.off(event, fn);
  }

  off(event: string, fn: Listener): void {
    const list = this.listeners[event];
    if (list) this.listeners[event] = list.filter(l => l !== fn);
  }

  emit(event: string, ...args: any[]): void {
    this.listeners[event]?.forEach(fn => fn(...args));
  }
}

export const bus = new EventBus();

File: src/lib/image-utils.ts

const MAX_DIMENSION = 1280;
const JPEG_QUALITY = 0.85;

export interface DownscaleOptions {
  maxDimension?: number;
  quality?: number;
}

export async function downscaleImage(
  file: File,
  options: DownscaleOptions = {},
): Promise<Blob> {
  const { maxDimension = MAX_DIMENSION, quality = JPEG_QUALITY } = options;

  const img = await loadImage(file);
  const { width, height } = computeDimensions(
    img.naturalWidth,
    img.naturalHeight,
    maxDimension,
  );

  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = width;
  canvas.height = height;

  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('Failed to get canvas 2D context');

  ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);

  return new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
    canvas.toBlob(
      (blob) => {
        if (blob) resolve(blob);
        else reject(new Error('Canvas toBlob returned null'));
      },
      'image/jpeg',
      quality,
    );
  });
}

export async function downscaleImageToFile(
  file: File,
  options: DownscaleOptions = {},
): Promise<File> {
  const blob = await downscaleImage(file, options);
  return new File([blob], file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '.jpg'), {
    type: 'image/jpeg',
    lastModified: Date.now(),
  });
}

function loadImage(file: File): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(img.src);
      resolve(img);
    };
    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image'));
    img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  });
}

export function computeDimensions(
  originalWidth: number,
  originalHeight: number,
  maxDimension: number,
): { width: number; height: number } {
  if (originalWidth <= maxDimension && originalHeight <= maxDimension) {
    return { width: originalWidth, height: originalHeight };
  }
  const ratio = Math.min(maxDimension / originalWidth, maxDimension / originalHeight);
  return {
    width: Math.round(originalWidth * ratio),
    height: Math.round(originalHeight * ratio),
  };
}
