"use client";

import { useReducedMotion, type Variants, type Transition } from "framer-motion";

/**
 * 60fps.design Shared Motion Tokens
 * Standardized easing curves, spring physics, and variants for smooth composite-layer animations.
 */

// 1. Standard Easing Curves (Cubic Bezier)
export const EASINGS = {
  // Ultra-smooth deceleration (optimal for entering modals, popovers, dropdowns)
  smoothOut: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const,
  // Snappy spring-like curve for micro-interactions
  springSnappy: [0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1] as const,
  // Natural curve for bottom sheets and drawer slides
  sheet: [0.32, 0.72, 0, 1] as const,
  // Standard ease-in-out for subtle color or opacity fades
  easeInOut: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] as const,
  // Sharp exit curve for quickly dismissing dialogs
  sharpExit: [0.4, 0, 1, 1] as const,
};

// 2. Spring Physics Configurations
export const SPRINGS = {
  // Micro-interactions (Button tap, Icon click, Like toggle)
  snappy: {
    type: "spring",
    stiffness: 450,
    damping: 28,
    mass: 0.8,
  } satisfies Transition,

  // Gentle, organic movement (Cards, Popovers, Modals)
  gentle: {
    type: "spring",
    stiffness: 280,
    damping: 24,
    mass: 1,
  } satisfies Transition,

  // Playful, bouncy feedback (Badges, Success checkmarks, Notifications)
  bouncy: {
    type: "spring",
    stiffness: 500,
    damping: 15,
    mass: 0.6,
  } satisfies Transition,

  // Heavy, damped movement (Drawers, Full-screen sheets)
  sheet: {
    type: "spring",
    stiffness: 220,
    damping: 28,
    mass: 1.2,
  } satisfies Transition,
};

// 3. Durations (in seconds for Framer Motion)
export const DURATIONS = {
  instant: 0.1,
  fast: 0.18,
  normal: 0.28,
  smooth: 0.38,
  deliberate: 0.5,
};

// 4. Framer Motion Variants
export const MOTION_VARIANTS: Record<string, Variants> = {
  // Fade in with slight lift
  fadeInUp: {
    initial: { opacity: 0, y: 12 },
    animate: {
      opacity: 1,
      y: 0,
      transition: { duration: DURATIONS.normal, ease: EASINGS.smoothOut },
    },
    exit: {
      opacity: 0,
      y: 8,
      transition: { duration: DURATIONS.fast, ease: EASINGS.sharpExit },
    },
  },

  // Modal / Dialog Pop-up
  modalDialog: {
    initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 8 },
    animate: {
      opacity: 1,
      scale: 1,
      y: 0,
      transition: { duration: DURATIONS.normal, ease: EASINGS.smoothOut },
    },
    exit: {
      opacity: 0,
      scale: 0.96,
      y: 4,
      transition: { duration: DURATIONS.fast, ease: EASINGS.sharpExit },
    },
  },

  // Staggered Container for Lists & Grids
  staggerContainer: {

        staggerChildren: 0.04,

    animate: {
      x: 0,
      opacity: 1,
      transition: SPRINGS.sheet,
    },
    exit: {
      x: "100%",
      opacity: 0,
      transition: { duration: DURATIONS.fast, ease: EASINGS.sharpExit },
    },
  },

  // Success Pop for Status Icons / Badges
  successPop: {
    initial: { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 },
    animate: {
      scale: 1,
      opacity: 1,
      transition: SPRINGS.bouncy,
    },
  },

/**
 * Hook to get reduced-motion safe transitions
 */
export function useMotionPreference() {
  const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion();

  return {
    shouldReduceMotion: Boolean(shouldReduceMotion),
    getTransition: (standardTransition: Transition): Transition => {
      if (shouldReduceMotion) {
        return { duration: 0 };
      }
      return standardTransition;
    },
  };
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { jwtVerify } from "jose";

const publicPaths = ["/login", "/register", "/", "/library/vr-tour"];

const rawSecret = process.env.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET || process.env.JWT_SECRET || "";
const rawRefreshSecret = process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET || rawSecret;
const JWT_SECRET = new TextEncoder().encode(rawSecret);
const JWT_REFRESH_SECRET = new TextEncoder().encode(rawRefreshSecret);

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!rawSecret) {
    return new NextResponse(JSON.stringify({ error: "Server misconfigured: JWT secret not set" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname;

  if (publicPaths.includes(path)) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  const token = request.cookies.get("access_token")?.value;
  const refreshToken = request.cookies.get("refresh_token")?.value;

  if (!token && !refreshToken) {
    const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
    loginUrl.searchParams.set("redirect", path);
    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
  }

  // 1. First check access_token
  if (token) {
    try {
      const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, JWT_SECRET, {
        algorithms: ["HS256"],
        issuer: process.env.JWT_ISSUER || undefined,
        audience: process.env.JWT_AUDIENCE || undefined,
      });

      const role =
        (payload.roles as string[])?.[0] ||
        (payload.role as string) ||
        null;
      if (role !== "admin" && role !== "staff") {
        const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
        loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "staff-only");
        const response = NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
        response.cookies.delete("access_token");
        response.cookies.delete("refresh_token");
        return response;
      }

      return NextResponse.next();
    } catch {
      // Access token expired or invalid: fall through to check refresh_token
    }
  }

  // 2. If access_token is expired or missing, check refresh_token
  if (refreshToken) {
    try {
      const { payload } = await jwtVerify(refreshToken, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, {
        algorithms: ["HS256"],
        issuer: process.env.JWT_ISSUER || undefined,
        audience: process.env.JWT_AUDIENCE || undefined,
      });

      const role =
        (payload.roles as string[])?.[0] ||
        (payload.role as string) ||
        null;
      if (role !== "admin" && role !== "staff") {
        const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
        loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "staff-only");
        const response = NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
        response.cookies.delete("access_token");
        response.cookies.delete("refresh_token");
        return response;
      }

      // Valid refresh_token! Allow page to load so client-side AuthProvider can silently refresh access_token
      return NextResponse.next();
    } catch {
      // Both access_token and refresh_token are invalid
    }
  }

  const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
  loginUrl.searchParams.set("redirect", path);
  loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "session-expired");
  const response = NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
  response.cookies.delete("access_token");
  response.cookies.delete("refresh_token");
  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    /*
     * Match all request paths except for:
     * - api (API routes)
     * - _next/static, _next/image (Next.js internals)
     * - static files with extensions (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .svg, .ico, .webp, .mp4, etc.)
     * - VRLIB (VR Tour assets)
     */
    "/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon\\.ico|favicon\\.svg|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|ico|mp4|webm)|VRLIB/).*)",
  ],
};

export const middleware = proxy;

import React from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import {
  ALL_RESOURCES,
  ALL_ACTIONS,
  ALL_ROUTES,
  type SystemResource,
  type CrudAction,
  type RolePermissionConfig,
  type UserPermissionOverride,
  type EffectivePermissions,
} from "../../lib/types";

// Permission algebra testing (pure function mirror)
function resolveEffective(
  role: string,
  baseConfig: RolePermissionConfig,
  override?: UserPermissionOverride | null
): EffectivePermissions {
  if (role === "admin") {
    return {
      role: "admin",
      isCustom: false,
      allowedPages: ALL_ROUTES.map((r) => r.path),
      crud: {
        books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
        patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
        borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
        schedules: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
        ai_tools: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
        settings: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
        stats: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true },
      },
    };
  }

  if (!override || !override.enabled) {
    return {
      role,
      isCustom: false,
      allowedPages: [...baseConfig.allowedPages],
      crud: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(baseConfig.crud)),
    };
  }

  const pageSet = new Set<string>(baseConfig.allowedPages);
  (override.grantedPages || []).forEach((p) => pageSet.add(p));
  (override.revokedPages || []).forEach((p) => pageSet.delete(p));

  const effectiveCrud = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(baseConfig.crud));

  ALL_RESOURCES.forEach((res) => {
    ALL_ACTIONS.forEach((action) => {
      if (override.grantedCrud?.[res]?.[action] === true) {
        effectiveCrud[res][action] = true;
      }
      if (override.revokedCrud?.[res]?.[action] === true) {
        effectiveCrud[res][action] = false;
      }
    });
  });

  return {
    role,
    isCustom: true,
    allowedPages: Array.from(pageSet),
    crud: effectiveCrud,
  };
}

describe("Dynamic RBAC Permissions Engine", () => {
  const staffBaseConfig: RolePermissionConfig = {
    role: "staff",
    label: "Thủ thư",
    allowedPages: ["/dashboard", "/books", "/patrons", "/borrow"],
    crud: {
      books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false },
      patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false },
      borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false },
      schedules: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false },
      ai_tools: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false },
      settings: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
      stats: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false },
    },
  };

  it("admin always has full access to all pages and all CRUD actions", () => {
    const effective = resolveEffective("admin", staffBaseConfig);
    expect(effective.role).toBe("admin");
    expect(effective.allowedPages).toContain("/settings");
    expect(effective.allowedPages).toContain("/dynamic-admin");
    expect(effective.crud.books.delete).toBe(true);
    expect(effective.crud.settings.delete).toBe(true);
  });

  it("staff inherits baseline permissions when no override is present", () => {
    const effective = resolveEffective("staff", staffBaseConfig, null);
    expect(effective.isCustom).toBe(false);
    expect(effective.allowedPages).toEqual(["/dashboard", "/books", "/patrons", "/borrow"]);
    expect(effective.crud.books.create).toBe(true);
    expect(effective.crud.books.delete).toBe(false);
    expect(effective.crud.settings.read).toBe(false);
  });

  it("applies user override: grants extra page and extra CRUD delete permission", () => {
    const override: UserPermissionOverride = {
      enabled: true,
      grantedPages: ["/settings"],
      revokedPages: [],
      grantedCrud: {
        books: { delete: true },
      },
      revokedCrud: {},
    };

    const effective = resolveEffective("staff", staffBaseConfig, override);
    expect(effective.isCustom).toBe(true);
    expect(effective.allowedPages).toContain("/settings");
    expect(effective.crud.books.delete).toBe(true);
  });

  it("applies user override: revokes a baseline page and baseline CRUD create permission", () => {
    const override: UserPermissionOverride = {
      enabled: true,
      grantedPages: [],
      revokedPages: ["/books"],
      grantedCrud: {},
      revokedCrud: {
        books: { create: true },
      },
    };

    const effective = resolveEffective("staff", staffBaseConfig, override);
    expect(effective.isCustom).toBe(true);
    expect(effective.allowedPages).not.toContain("/books");
    expect(effective.crud.books.create).toBe(false);
  });

  it("revocation takes precedence over grant when both are specified", () => {
    const override: UserPermissionOverride = {
      enabled: true,
      grantedPages: ["/books"],
      revokedPages: ["/books"],
      grantedCrud: {
        books: { delete: true },
      },
      revokedCrud: {
        books: { delete: true },
      },
    };

    const effective = resolveEffective("staff", staffBaseConfig, override);
    expect(effective.allowedPages).not.toContain("/books");
    expect(effective.crud.books.delete).toBe(false);
  });

  it("supports extended enterprise actions: approve and print", () => {
    expect(ALL_ACTIONS).toContain("approve");
    expect(ALL_ACTIONS).toContain("print");

    const staffWithExtended: RolePermissionConfig = {
      role: "staff",
      label: "Thủ thư",
      allowedPages: ["/borrow", "/books"],
      crud: {
        books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: true },
        patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: true, print: true },
        borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: true, print: true },
        schedules: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: true },
        ai_tools: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        settings: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        stats: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: true },
      },
    };

    const effective = resolveEffective("staff", staffWithExtended, null);
    expect(effective.crud.borrows.approve).toBe(true);
    expect(effective.crud.books.approve).toBe(false);
    expect(effective.crud.books.print).toBe(true);
  });

  it("applies user override for approve and print actions", () => {
    const staffWithExtended: RolePermissionConfig = {
      role: "staff",
      label: "Thủ thư",
      allowedPages: ["/borrow", "/books"],
      crud: {
        books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        schedules: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        ai_tools: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        settings: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        stats: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
      },
    };

    const override: UserPermissionOverride = {
      enabled: true,
      grantedPages: [],
      revokedPages: [],
      grantedCrud: {
        books: { approve: true, print: true },
      },
      revokedCrud: {},
    };

    const effective = resolveEffective("staff", staffWithExtended, override);
    expect(effective.crud.books.approve).toBe(true);
    expect(effective.crud.books.print).toBe(true);
  });

  it("validates that all 21 routes have assigned valid categories", () => {
    expect(ALL_ROUTES.length).toBe(21);
    const validCategories = ["library", "circulation", "personnel", "ai_vision", "admin"];
    ALL_ROUTES.forEach((route) => {
      expect((route as any).category).toBeDefined();
      expect(validCategories).toContain((route as any).category);
    });
  });
});

"use client";

import { useRef, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import * as THREE from "three";

interface Book3DProps {
  position: [number, number, number];
  rotation?: [number, number, number];
  color?: string;
  scale?: number;
  floatSpeed?: number;
  floatAmplitude?: number;
  rotateSpeed?: number;
}

const COVER_COLORS = [
  "#1A73E8", // Blue
  "#4A8C5C", // Green
  "#C44E4E", // Red
  "#E6A817", // Gold
  "#8B5CF6", // Violet
  "#F59E0B", // Amber
  "#3B82F6", // Light Blue
  "#10B981", // Emerald
];

export default function Book3D({
  position,
  rotation = [0, 0, 0],
  color,
  scale = 1,
  floatSpeed = 1,
  floatAmplitude = 0.15,
  rotateSpeed = 0.3,
}: Book3DProps) {
  const meshRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const initialY = useRef(position[1]);

  const coverColor = useMemo(() => color || COVER_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COVER_COLORS.length)], [color]);

  const materials = useMemo(() => {
    const coverMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: coverColor,
      roughness: 0.4,
      metalness: 0.1,
    });
    const spineMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(coverColor).multiplyScalar(0.7),
      roughness: 0.5,
      metalness: 0.05,
    });
    const pageMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xF5F5F0,
      roughness: 0.8,
      metalness: 0,
    });

    return [
      pageMat,   // right (pages edge)
      spineMat,  // left (spine)
      pageMat,   // top (pages edge)
      pageMat,   // bottom (pages edge)
      coverMat,  // front cover
      spineMat,  // back cover
    ];
  }, [coverColor]);

  // Clean up materials to prevent WebGL memory leaks
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      materials.forEach((mat) => mat.dispose());
    };
  }, [materials]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    if (!meshRef.current) return;
    const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
    meshRef.current.position.y = initialY.current + Math.sin(t * floatSpeed + position[0]) * floatAmplitude;
    meshRef.current.rotation.y += rotateSpeed * 0.003;
  });

  return (
    <mesh
      ref={meshRef}
      position={position}
      rotation={rotation}
      scale={scale}
      material={materials}
      castShadow
      receiveShadow
    >
      <boxGeometry args={[1.2, 1.8, 0.25]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";

interface Bookshelf3DProps {
  position: [number, number, number];
  rotation?: [number, number, number];
  scale?: number;
  shelves?: number;
  booksPerShelf?: number;
}

const SHELF_COLORS = [
  "#5D4037", // Dark wood
  "#6D4C41", // Medium wood
  "#795548", // Light wood
];

const BOOK_COLORS = [
  "#1A73E8", "#4A8C5C", "#C44E4E", "#E6A817",
  "#8B5CF6", "#F59E0B", "#3B82F6", "#10B981",
  "#EF4444", "#6366F1", "#EC4899", "#14B8A6",
];

function ShelfBook({ x, color, height }: { x: number; color: string; height: number }) {
  const materials = useMemo(() => {
    const coverMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.1 });
    const spineMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(color).multiplyScalar(0.7),
      roughness: 0.5,
    });
    const pageMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xF5F5F0, roughness: 0.8 });
    return [pageMat, spineMat, pageMat, pageMat, coverMat, spineMat];
  }, [color]);

  // Clean up materials to prevent WebGL memory leaks
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      materials.forEach((mat) => mat.dispose());
    };
  }, [materials]);

  return (
    <mesh position={[x, height / 2, 0]} material={materials} castShadow>
      <boxGeometry args={[0.18, height, 0.22]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

export default function Bookshelf3D({
  position,
  rotation = [0, 0, 0],
  scale = 1,
  shelves = 4,
  booksPerShelf = 6,
}: Bookshelf3DProps) {
  const shelfColor = useMemo(() => SHELF_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SHELF_COLORS.length)], []);
  const shelfWidth = 3.2;
  const shelfHeight = 0.06;
  const shelfDepth = 0.4;
  const gap = 0.65;

  const shelfData = useMemo(() => {
    const data: { y: number; books: { x: number; color: string; height: number }[] }[] = [];
    for (let s = 0; s < shelves; s++) {
      const shelfY = s * gap;
      const books: { x: number; color: string; height: number }[] = [];
      let cursorX = -shelfWidth / 2 + 0.15;
      for (let b = 0; b < booksPerShelf; b++) {
        const bookHeight = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.2;
        const bookWidth = 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.08;
        const color = BOOK_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOK_COLORS.length)];
        books.push({ x: cursorX + bookWidth / 2, color, height: bookHeight });
        cursorX += bookWidth + 0.02;
      }
      data.push({ y: shelfY, books });
    }
    return data;
  }, [shelves, booksPerShelf]);

  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation} scale={scale}>
      {shelfData.map((shelf, si) => (
        <group key={si}>
          {/* Shelf board */}
          <mesh position={[0, shelf.y, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
            <boxGeometry args={[shelfWidth, shelfHeight, shelfDepth]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={shelfColor} roughness={0.6} metalness={0.05} />
          </mesh>
          {/* Books on shelf */}
          {shelf.books.map((book, bi) => (
            <ShelfBook key={bi} x={book.x} color={book.color} height={book.height} />
          ))}
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* Top board */}
      <mesh position={[0, shelves * gap, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
        <boxGeometry args={[shelfWidth, shelfHeight, shelfDepth]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={shelfColor} roughness={0.6} metalness={0.05} />
      </mesh>
      {/* Side panels */}
      {[-1, 1].map((side) => (
        <mesh key={side} position={[side * shelfWidth / 2, (shelves * gap) / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[shelfHeight, shelves * gap + shelfHeight, shelfDepth]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color={shelfColor} roughness={0.6} metalness={0.05} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Suspense, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { Canvas, useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { Box } from "@mui/material";
import Book3D from "./Book3D";
import Bookshelf3D from "./Bookshelf3D";
function FloatingParticles() {
  const pointsRef = useRef<THREE.Points>(null);

  const [positions, colors] = useMemo(() => {
    const count = 300;
    const pos = new Float32Array(count * 3);
    const col = new Float32Array(count * 3);
    const palette = [
      new THREE.Color(0x1A73E8),
      new THREE.Color(0xE6A817),
      new THREE.Color(0xffffff),
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      pos[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
      pos[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
      pos[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15 - 3;
      const c = palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)];
      col[i * 3] = c.r;
      col[i * 3 + 1] = c.g;
      col[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
    }
    return [pos, col];
  }, []);

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    if (!pointsRef.current) return;
    pointsRef.current.rotation.y += delta * 0.02;
    pointsRef.current.rotation.x += delta * 0.008;
  });

  return (
    <points ref={pointsRef}>
      <bufferGeometry>
        <bufferAttribute attach="attributes-position" args={[positions, 3]} />
        <bufferAttribute attach="attributes-color" args={[colors, 3]} />
      </bufferGeometry>
      <pointsMaterial
        size={0.06}
        vertexColors
        transparent
        opacity={0.7}
        sizeAttenuation
        blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
        depthWrite={false}
      />
    </points>
  );
}

function CameraRig() {
  useFrame((state) => {
    const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
    state.camera.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.1) * 0.5;
    state.camera.position.y = Math.cos(t * 0.08) * 0.3;
    state.camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
  });
  return null;
}

function normalizeDays(days: string): string {
  return days
    .replace(/Monday\s*-\s*Friday/i, "Thứ Hai - Thứ Sáu")
    .replace(/Saturday\s*-\s*Sunday/i, "Thứ Bảy - Chủ Nhật")
    .replace(/Monday/i, "Thứ Hai")
    .replace(/Tuesday/i, "Thứ Ba")
    .replace(/Wednesday/i, "Thứ Tư")
    .replace(/Thursday/i, "Thứ Năm")
    .replace(/Friday/i, "Thứ Sáu")
    .replace(/Saturday/i, "Thứ Bảy")
    .replace(/Sunday/i, "Chủ Nhật");
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, keyframes } from '@mui/material';
import type { CompanionState, VisemeData } from '@/lib/types/ai';

interface CompanionAvatarProps {
  state: CompanionState;
  visemeData?: VisemeData[];
  size?: number;
}

const pulse = keyframes`
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
`;

const speaking = keyframes`
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1.1); }
`;

const glow = keyframes`
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.3); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.6); }
`;

const getStateColor = (state: CompanionState): string => {
  switch (state) {
    case 'idle':
      return '#8B0000';
    case 'listening':
      return '#0A2540';
    case 'speaking':
      return '#059669';
    case 'thinking':
      return '#D4AF37';
    case 'error':
      return '#DC2626';
    default:
      return '#8B0000';
  }
};

const getStateAnimation = (state: CompanionState) => {
  switch (state) {
    case 'idle':
      return `${pulse} 2s ease-in-out infinite`;
    case 'listening':
      return `${pulse} 1s ease-in-out infinite`;
    case 'speaking':
      return `${speaking} 0.3s ease-in-out infinite`;
    case 'thinking':
      return `${pulse} 1.5s ease-in-out infinite`;
    default:
      return 'none';
  }
};

export default function CompanionAvatar({
  state,
  visemeData = [],
  size = 120,
}: CompanionAvatarProps) {
  const color = getStateColor(state);
  const animation = getStateAnimation(state);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${color} 0%, ${color}dd 100%)`,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        position: 'relative',
        animation,
        transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
        '&::before': {
          content: '""',
          position: 'absolute',
          inset: -4,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          border: `2px solid ${color}40`,
          animation: state === 'speaking' ? `${glow} 1s ease-in-out infinite` : 'none',
        },
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: size * 0.6,
          height: size * 0.6,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          fontSize: size * 0.3,
          fontWeight: 'bold',
          color,
        }}
      >
        {state === 'thinking' ? '...' : state === 'error' ? '!' : 'AI'}
      </Box>

      {state === 'speaking' && visemeData.length > 0 && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: -8,
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 0.5,
            alignItems: 'flex-end',
            height: 20,
          }}
        >
          {visemeData.slice(0, 5).map((viseme, index) => (
            <Box
              key={index}
              sx={{
                width: 4,
                height: Math.max(4, viseme.value * 2),
                background: color,
                borderRadius: 1,
                transition: 'height 0.1s ease',
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Box, Typography, Button, CircularProgress, Stack } from "@mui/material";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";
import AIScoreCard from "../cards/AIScoreCard";
import { useAIWidgetStore } from "../store/useAIWidgetStore";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";

export default function ScoreTab() {
  const { lastSummary, updateSummary } = useAIWidgetStore();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleRefresh = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const raw = await api.getAICommandCenterSummary();
      updateSummary({
        operational_score: raw.operational_score,
        active_patrons: raw.snapshot.active_patrons,
        overdue_borrows: raw.snapshot.overdue_borrows,
        scheduled_staff_today: raw.snapshot.scheduled_staff_today,
        today_entries: raw.snapshot.today_entries,
        today_exits: raw.snapshot.today_exits,
        generated_at: raw.generated_at,
      });
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: 2 }}>
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", mb: 2 }}>
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, flex: 1 }}>
          Tình trạng hệ thống
        </Typography>
        <Button
          size="small"
          startIcon={loading ? <CircularProgress size={14} /> : <RefreshIcon />}
          onClick={handleRefresh}
          disabled={loading}
          sx={{ fontSize: "0.75rem" }}
        >
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </Stack>

      <AIScoreCard />
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Box, useTheme, useMediaQuery, Tabs, Tab } from "@mui/material";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { useAIWidgetStore } from "./store/useAIWidgetStore";
import AIWidgetHeader from "./AIWidgetHeader";
import ScoreTab from "./tabs/ScoreTab";
import ChatTab from "./tabs/ChatTab";
import ActionsTab from "./tabs/ActionsTab";

interface AIWidgetPanelProps {
  role: string;
}

export default function AIWidgetPanel({ role }: AIWidgetPanelProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down("sm"));
  const { isOpen, activeTab, minimize, setActiveTab } = useAIWidgetStore();
  const isPatron = role === 'patron';

  const panelWidth = isMobile ? "100vw" : 420;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {isOpen && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: "fixed",
            top: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            left: isMobile ? 0 : "auto",
            zIndex: 99999,
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            alignItems: "flex-end",
          }}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ x: panelWidth, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ x: panelWidth, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{
              type: "spring",
              stiffness: 300,
              damping: 30,
            }}
            style={{
              width: panelWidth,
              height: "100%",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: "column",
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: "100%",
                height: "100%",
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                bgcolor: "background.paper",
                boxShadow: isMobile ? 0 : 6,
                borderLeft: isMobile ? 0 : 1,
                borderColor: "divider",
                borderRadius: isMobile ? 0 : "12px 0 0 12px",
                overflow: "hidden",
              }}
            >
              <AIWidgetHeader onMinimize={minimize} />

              {!isPatron && <TabNavigation />}

              <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflow: "auto" }}>
                {isPatron ? (
                  <ChatTab />
                ) : (
                  <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                    {activeTab === "score" && <ScoreTab key="score" />}
                    {activeTab === "chat" && <ChatTab key="chat" />}
                    {activeTab === "actions" && <ActionsTab key="actions" />}
                  </AnimatePresence>
                )}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </motion.div>
        </Box>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

function TabNavigation() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const { activeTab, setActiveTab } = useAIWidgetStore();

  const handleChange = (_: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: 'score' | 'chat' | 'actions') => {
    setActiveTab(newValue);
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", bgcolor: "background.default" }}>
      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onChange={handleChange}
        variant="fullWidth"
        sx={{
          minHeight: 44,
          "& .MuiTab-root": {
            minHeight: 44,
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: "0.8rem",
            textTransform: "none",
          },
          "& .Mui-selected": {
            color: "primary.main",
          },
          "& .MuiTabs-indicator": {
            bgcolor: "primary.main",
          },
        }}
      >
        <Tab label="Score" value="score" />
        <Tab label="Chat" value="chat" />
        <Tab label="Actions" value="actions" />
      </Tabs>
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import {
  Button,
  Chip,
  Paper,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Tooltip,
} from "@mui/material";
import PrintIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PrintOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import type { BookImportResultRow } from "@/lib/types";
import { BarcodeRangeList } from "./BarcodeRangeList";

export interface BookImportResultSectionProps {
  showResults: boolean;
  importResults: BookImportResultRow[] | null;
  onPrintBarcodes: () => void;
  canPrint?: boolean;
}

function statusColor(status: string): "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error" | "default" {
  if (["new", "imported"].includes(status)) return "success";
  if (["updated"].includes(status)) return "info";
  if (["exists", "skipped"].includes(status)) return "default";
  if (["warning"].includes(status)) return "warning";
  return "error";
}

function statusLabel(status: string) {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    exists: "Đã có",
    new: "Mới",
    warning: "Cảnh báo",
    invalid: "Lỗi",
    imported: "Thành công",
    updated: "Cập nhật",
    skipped: "Bỏ qua",
    error: "Lỗi",
  };
  return labels[status] || status;
}

export function BookImportResultSection({
  showResults,
  importResults,
  onPrintBarcodes,
  canPrint = true,
}: BookImportResultSectionProps) {
  if (!showResults || !importResults) return null;

  return (
    <DashboardCard title="Kết quả nhập kho">
      <TableContainer component={Paper} variant="outlined" sx={{ maxHeight: 320, overflowX: "auto" }}>
        <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
          <TableHead>
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>ISBN</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Tên sách</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Số lượng</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Barcode mẫu</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Trạng thái</TableCell>
              <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Thông báo</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHead>
          <TableBody>
            {importResults.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={`${row.isbn}-${index}`} selected={row.status === "error" || row.status === "warning"}>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace" }}>{row.isbn || "-"}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.title || "-"}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.quantity}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <BarcodeRangeList barcodes={row.barcodes} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Chip size="small" color={statusColor(row.status)} label={statusLabel(row.status)} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.message || "-"}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
      {importResults.some((row) => row.status === "imported" || row.status === "warning") ? (
        <Tooltip title={!canPrint ? "Bạn không có quyền in ấn mã vạch sách" : ""}>
          <span>
            <Button
              sx={{ mt: 2, textTransform: "none" }}
              variant="outlined"
              disabled={!canPrint}
              startIcon={<PrintIcon />}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!canPrint) return;
                onPrintBarcodes();
              }}
            >
              In mã vạch vừa tạo
            </Button>
          </span>
        </Tooltip>
      ) : null}
    </DashboardCard>
  );
}

interface BorrowSummaryCardProps {

export default function BorrowSummaryCard({ borrowStats, borrows, loading }: BorrowSummaryCardProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const recentBorrows = [...borrows]
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.borrow_at).getTime() - new Date(a.borrow_at).getTime())
    .slice(0, 5);

  return (

    >

          <Chip
            size="small"
            label={`${borrowStats.active} cuốn đang mượn`}
            color="primary"

          />
          {borrowStats.overdue > 0 ? (
            <Chip
              size="small"

            />
          ) : (
            <Chip
              size="small"
              icon={<CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />}
              label="0 quá hạn"
              color="success"
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.75rem" }}
            />
          )}
        </Stack>
      )}

      {recentBorrows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<BookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
          title="Không có sách nào đang mượn"
        />
      ) : (
        <TableContainer sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
          <Table size="small">

              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>

                return (

                              {author}

                          )}

                      </Stack>
                    </TableCell>

                      {new Date(record.borrow_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN")}
                    </TableCell>

                        }}
                      />
                    </TableCell>

                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>

"use client";

import { Avatar, Box, Chip, Paper, Stack, Typography, useTheme } from "@mui/material";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined";
import ErrorOutlineIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlineOutlined";
import CameraIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PhotoCameraOutlined";
import VideocamIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VideocamOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import type { CameraStatus } from "@/lib/types";

interface CameraStatusGridProps {
  cameras: CameraStatus[];
  loading: boolean;
}

function cameraLabel(id: string) {
  if (id === "entry_gate") return "Cổng vào chính";
  if (id === "exit_gate") return "Cổng ra chính";
  if (id === "kiosk") return "Kiosk Tự phục vụ";
  return id;
}

function cameraRoleDescription(id: string) {
  if (id === "entry_gate") return "Nhận diện khuôn mặt & Check-in";
  if (id === "exit_gate") return "Nhận diện khuôn mặt & Check-out";
  if (id === "kiosk") return "Xác thực mượn/trả tự động";
  return "Camera giám sát";
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { Avatar, Box, Button, Stack, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import ArrowForwardIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward";
import WarningIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CalendarIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlineOutlined";
import NotificationsIcon from "@mui/icons-material/NotificationsNoneOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import type { Notification } from "@/lib/types";

interface RecentNotificationsCardProps {
  notifications: Notification[];
  loading: boolean;
}

const TYPE_CONFIG: Record<string, { icon: React.ReactNode; color: string }> = {
  borrow_overdue: { icon: <WarningIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, color: "#DC2626" },
  book_available: { icon: <BookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, color: "#059669" },
  schedule_change: { icon: <CalendarIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, color: "#D97706" },
  membership_expiry: { icon: <PersonIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, color: "#8B0000" },
};

function relativeTime(dateStr: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const then = new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const diff = Math.floor((now - then) / 1000);
  if (diff < 60) return "vừa xong";
  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)} phút trước`;
  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)} giờ trước`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)} ngày trước`;
}

export default function RecentNotificationsCard({ notifications, loading }: RecentNotificationsCardProps) {
  return (
    <DashboardCard
      title="Thông báo gần đây"
      actions={
        <Button component={Link} href="/notifications" endIcon={<ArrowForwardIcon />} size="small">
          Xem tất cả
        </Button>
      }
      noPadding
    >
      {notifications.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<NotificationsIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
          title="Không có thông báo mới"
        />
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={0.5} sx={{ p: 1.5 }}>
          {notifications.slice(0, 5).map((n) => {
            const config = TYPE_CONFIG[n.type] || { icon: <NotificationsIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, color: "#6b7280" };
            return (
              <Stack
                key={n.id}
                direction="row"
                spacing={1.5}
                sx={{
                  alignItems: "flex-start",
                  p: 1.25,
                  borderRadius: 2,
                  transition: "background 0.15s",
                  "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
                }}
              >
                <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: config.color, width: 32, height: 32 }}>
                  {config.icon}
                </Avatar>
                <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: n.isRead ? 600 : 800 }} noWrap>
                    {n.title}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap sx={{ display: "block" }}>
                    {n.body}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  {relativeTime(n.createdAt)}
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            );
          })}
        </Stack>
      )}
    </DashboardCard>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import UsersIcon from "@mui/icons-material/GroupsOutlined";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import type { BorrowRecord, StaffActiveBorrowerSummary, StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse } from "@/lib/types";
import {
  CONDITION_LABELS,
  COPY_STATUS_LABELS,
  getConditionColor,
  getStatusColor,
  CopyCondition,
  CopyStatus,
} from "@/lib/constants/copy";

function isOverdue(record: BorrowRecord) {
  return new Date(record.due_at) < new Date();
}

function daysUntil(value: string) {
  const today = new Date();
  const due = new Date(value);
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  due.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return Math.ceil((due.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86400000);
}

function formatDate(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "-";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN");
}

function dueChip(record: BorrowRecord) {
  const left = daysUntil(record.due_at);
  if (left < 0) return <Chip size="small" color="error" label={`Quá hạn ${Math.abs(left)} ngày`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />;
  if (left <= 2) return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Sắp đến hạn" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />;
  return <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Đúng hạn" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />;
}

interface ReturnActiveBorrowsProps {
  selectedBorrower: StaffActiveBorrowerSummary | null;
  detail: StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse | null;
  loadingDetail: boolean;
  returningId: string | null;
  onConfirmReturn: (record: BorrowRecord) => void;
}

export default function ReturnActiveBorrows({
  selectedBorrower,
  detail,
  loadingDetail,
  returningId,
  onConfirmReturn,
}: ReturnActiveBorrowsProps) {
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canUpdateBorrow = can("borrows", "update");

  if (!selectedBorrower) {
    return (
      <DashboardCard>
        <EmptyState
          icon={<UsersIcon sx={{ fontSize: 64, opacity: 0.3 }} />}
          title="Chọn độc giả để xem sách cần trả"
          description="Chọn một độc giả từ danh sách bên trái để kiểm tra danh sách sách đang mượn"
        />
      </DashboardCard>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardCard
      title="Sách cần trả"
      actions={detail ? <Chip size="small" label={`${detail.total} cuốn`} sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} /> : null}
    >
      {loadingDetail ? (
        <LoadingOverlay loading message="Đang tải danh sách sách..." />
      ) : !detail || detail.records.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56, color: "success.main" }} />}
          title="Độc giả đã trả hết sách"
          description="Hiện tại độc giả này không còn cuốn sách nào đang mượn."
        />
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={1.5}>
          {detail.records.map((record) => (
            <Paper
              key={record.id}
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{
                p: 1.5,
                borderRadius: 2,
                borderLeft: isOverdue(record) ? 4 : 1,
                borderLeftColor: isOverdue(record) ? "error.main" : "divider",
                bgcolor: "background.paper",
              }}
            >
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
                {record.book?.cover_url ? (
                  <Box
                    component="img"
                    src={record.book.cover_url}
                    alt={record.book.title}
                    sx={{ width: 44, height: 62, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 1, flexShrink: 0 }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 44, height: 62, bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "text.secondary", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    <BookIcon />
                  </Avatar>
                )}
                <Stack spacing={0.4} sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14 }} noWrap>
                    {record.book?.title || record.book_id}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                    {record.book?.author || "Chưa rõ tác giả"}
                  </Typography>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5 }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace", color: "primary.main", fontWeight: 600 }}>
                      {record.book?.isbn}
                    </Typography>
                    {dueChip(record)}
                    {record.copy?.condition && (
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        color={getConditionColor(record.copy.condition)}
                        label={CONDITION_LABELS[record.copy.condition as CopyCondition] || record.copy.condition}
                        sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {record.copy?.status && (
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        color={getStatusColor(record.copy.status)}
                        label={COPY_STATUS_LABELS[record.copy.status as CopyStatus] || record.copy.status}
                        sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Stack>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                    {record.copy?.barcode ? `Mã: ${record.copy.barcode} | ` : ""}Mượn: {formatDate(record.borrow_at)} | Hạn: {formatDate(record.due_at)}
                  </Typography>
                </Stack>
                <Tooltip title={!canUpdateBorrow ? getPermissionDeniedReason("borrows", "update") : ""}>
                  <span>
                    <Button
                      size="small"
                      variant="contained"
                      color="success"
                      startIcon={<CheckCircleIcon />}
                      disabled={!!returningId || !canUpdateBorrow}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (!canUpdateBorrow) return;
                        onConfirmReturn(record);
                      }}
                      sx={{ flexShrink: 0, alignSelf: "center", textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
                    >
                      Trả
                    </Button>
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              </Stack>
            </Paper>
          ))}
        </Stack>
      )}
    </DashboardCard>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogContentText,
  DialogTitle,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  MenuItem,
  Select,
  TextField,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import type { BorrowRecord, StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse } from "@/lib/types";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import { CONDITION_CODES, CONDITION_LABELS, CopyCondition } from "@/lib/constants/copy";
import { estimateOverdueFine, estimateDamageFee, FineConfigDto } from "@/lib/fee-estimate";

interface PaymentChoice {
  isPaidImmediately: boolean;
  paymentMethod: "cash" | "qr_code";
}

interface ReturnConfirmDialogProps {
  record: BorrowRecord | null;
  detail: StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse | null;
  condition: string;
  note?: string;
  fineConfig?: FineConfigDto | null;
  onConditionChange: (val: string) => void;
  onNoteChange?: (val: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (payment: PaymentChoice) => void;
  loading: boolean;
}

export default function ReturnConfirmDialog({
  record,
  detail,
  condition,
  note = "",
  fineConfig,
  onConditionChange,
  onNoteChange,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  loading,
}: ReturnConfirmDialogProps) {
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canUpdateBorrow = can("borrows", "update");
  const patronName = detail?.patron.full_name || detail?.patron.student_code || "độc giả";
  const [isPaidImmediately, setIsPaidImmediately] = React.useState(true);
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = React.useState<"cash" | "qr_code">("cash");

  const selectedCondition = condition || record?.copy?.condition || "good";

  const overdueDays = record && record.due_at && new Date(record.due_at).getTime() < Date.now()
    ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Date.now() - new Date(record.due_at).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)))
    : 0;
  const overdueFine = overdueDays > 0 ? estimateOverdueFine(overdueDays, fineConfig) : 0;
  const damageFee = estimateDamageFee(selectedCondition, (record as any)?.book?.price ?? null, fineConfig);

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!record} onClose={loading ? undefined : onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>Xác nhận trả sách</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogContentText sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
          Xác nhận nhận lại sách &quot;<strong>{record?.book?.title || record?.book_id}</strong>&quot; từ độc giả {patronName}?
        </DialogContentText>

        {record && overdueDays > 0 ? (
          <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ mb: 2, borderRadius: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
              Sách đã quá hạn {overdueDays} ngày
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontSize: "0.82rem", mt: 0.5 }}>
              Tiền phạt trễ hạn ước tính: <strong>{overdueFine.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ</strong>
              {damageFee > 0 ? <> · Phí hư hỏng ước tính: <strong>{damageFee.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ</strong></> : null}.
              Thủ thư vui lòng kiểm tra và thu phí (nếu có) trước khi hoàn tất.
            </Typography>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        {damageFee > 0 ? (
          <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mb: 2, borderRadius: 2 }}>
            Phí hư hỏng ước tính: <strong>{damageFee.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ</strong> (theo tình trạng sách đã chọn). Thủ thư vui lòng kiểm tra trước khi hoàn tất.
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2, mt: 1 }}>
          <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
            <InputLabel id="return-condition-label">Tình trạng sách khi trả</InputLabel>
            <Select
              labelId="return-condition-label"
              id="return-condition-select"
              label="Tình trạng sách khi trả"
              value={selectedCondition}
              onChange={(e) => onConditionChange(e.target.value)}
            >
              {CONDITION_CODES.map((code: CopyCondition) => (
                <MenuItem key={code} value={code}>
                  {CONDITION_LABELS[code]}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </FormControl>

          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              id="pay-immediately"
              checked={isPaidImmediately}
              onChange={(e) => setIsPaidImmediately(e.target.checked)}
            />
            <Typography component="label" htmlFor="pay-immediately" variant="body2">
              Đã thu phí ngay
            </Typography>
          </Box>

          {isPaidImmediately && (
            <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
              <InputLabel id="payment-method-label">Phương thức thanh toán</InputLabel>
              <Select
                labelId="payment-method-label"
                id="payment-method-select"
                label="Phương thức thanh toán"
                value={paymentMethod}
                onChange={(e) => setPaymentMethod(e.target.value as "cash" | "qr_code")}
              >
                <MenuItem value="cash">Tiền mặt</MenuItem>
                <MenuItem value="qr_code">Quét mã QR</MenuItem>
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          )}

          <TextField
            label="Ghi chú thêm (tuỳ chọn)"
            value={note}
            onChange={(e) => onNoteChange?.(e.target.value)}
            fullWidth
            size="small"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            placeholder="Ghi chú thêm nếu sách có hư hỏng..."
          />
        </Box>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={loading}>Hủy</Button>
        <Tooltip title={!canUpdateBorrow ? getPermissionDeniedReason("borrows", "update") : ""}>
          <span>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              color="success"
              onClick={() => {
                if (!canUpdateBorrow) return;
                onConfirm({ isPaidImmediately, paymentMethod });
              }}
              disabled={loading || !canUpdateBorrow}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
            >
              {loading ? "Đang trả..." : "Xác nhận trả"}
            </Button>
          </span>
        </Tooltip>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
