"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Divider,
  IconButton,
  MenuItem,
  Paper,
  Select,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  ToggleButton,
  ToggleButtonGroup,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CameraAltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";
import QrCodeScannerIcon from "@mui/icons-material/QrCodeScannerOutlined";
import VideocamIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VideocamOutlined";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { BorrowRecord, StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse } from "@/lib/types";

const RAW_CAM_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BORROW_CAM_URL || "http://192.168.1.7:8080/shot.jpg";
const BORROW_CAM_URL = `/api/camera/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(RAW_CAM_URL)}`;

export interface ScannedReturnItem {
  isbn: string;
  record: BorrowRecord;
  condition: string;
}

function daysUntil(value: string) {
  const today = new Date();
  const due = new Date(value);
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  due.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return Math.ceil((due.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86400000);
}

function dueChip(record: BorrowRecord) {
  const left = daysUntil(record.due_at);
  if (left < 0) return <Chip size="small" color="error" label={`Quá hạn ${Math.abs(left)} ngày`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />;
  if (left <= 2) return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Sắp đến hạn" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />;
  return <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Đúng hạn" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />;
}

interface ReturnScannerDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  detail: StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse | null;
  onBatchComplete: () => Promise<void>;
  showNotice: (type: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info", msg: string, duration?: number) => void;
}

export default function ReturnScannerDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
  detail,
  onBatchComplete,
  showNotice,
}: ReturnScannerDialogProps) {
  const [camMode, setCamMode] = useState<"webcam" | "ip">("webcam");
  const [scannedReturns, setScannedReturns] = useState<ScannedReturnItem[]>([]);
  const [batchReturning, setBatchReturning] = useState(false);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [imgReady, setImgReady] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState("");

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);
  const readerRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const lastScannedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const reconnectTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const loadingRef = useRef(false);
  const pollTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Stop camera & polling
  const stopWebcam = useCallback(() => {
    if (readerRef.current) {
      try { readerRef.current.reset(); } catch {}
      readerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    }
    setCameraReady(false);
  }, []);

  const stopPolling = useCallback(() => {
    if (pollTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
      pollTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    loadingRef.current = false;
  }, []);

  const stopScanning = useCallback(() => {
    if (intervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
      intervalRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const stopAll = useCallback(() => {
    stopWebcam();
    stopScanning();
    stopPolling();
    if (reconnectTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);
      reconnectTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [stopWebcam, stopScanning, stopPolling]);

  // Start webcam
  const startWebcam = useCallback(async () => {
    setCameraError("");
    setCameraReady(false);
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: { ideal: "environment" },
          width: { ideal: 1280, min: 640 },
          height: { ideal: 720, min: 480 },
        },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.onloadedmetadata = () => {
          setCameraReady(true);
        };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") setCameraError("Chưa cấp quyền camera. Vui lòng cho phép trình duyệt truy cập camera máy tính.");
      else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") setCameraError("Không tìm thấy camera trên máy tính.");
      else setCameraError("Không thể bật camera máy: " + (err.message || "Lỗi không xác định"));
    }
  }, []);

  // IP Camera frame loader
  const loadNextFrame = useCallback(() => {
    if (!imgRef.current || loadingRef.current) return;
    loadingRef.current = true;
    const sep = BORROW_CAM_URL.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
    imgRef.current.src = `${BORROW_CAM_URL}${sep}_t=${Date.now()}`;
  }, []);

  // Handle scanned barcode / ISBN
  const handleScanned = useCallback((rawCode: string) => {
    const cleaned = rawCode.trim();
    const normalized = cleaned.replace(/[-\s]/g, "");
    if (normalized.length < 4) return;
    if (normalized === lastScannedRef.current) return;
    lastScannedRef.current = normalized;

    let toast = "";
    let toastType: "success" | "warning" = "warning";
    setScannedReturns((prev) => {
      if (prev.some((item) => item.isbn === normalized || item.isbn === cleaned)) {
        toast = `Sách "${cleaned}" đã có trong danh sách trả`;
        toastType = "warning";
        return prev;
      }

      // Check matching record in detail.records
      const normTarget = normalized.toLowerCase();
      const libMatch = normTarget.match(/^lib(\d{10,13})(\d+)?$/i);
      const targetIsbn = libMatch ? libMatch[1] : normTarget;

      const match = detail?.records.find((r) => {
        const recordIsbn = (r.book?.isbn || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        const copyBarcode = ((r as any).copy?.barcode || (r as any).barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        return recordIsbn === normTarget || copyBarcode === normTarget || (!!libMatch && recordIsbn === targetIsbn);
      });

      if (match) {
        toast = `Đã nhận diện: ${match.book?.title || cleaned}`;
        toastType = "success";
        return [...prev, { isbn: cleaned, record: match, condition: "" }];
      }

      toast = `Độc giả này không mượn sách có mã: ${cleaned}`;
      toastType = "warning";
      return prev;
    });

    if (toast) {
      showNotice(toastType, toast, toastType === "warning" ? 3.5 : 2);
    }

    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
    }, 1200);
  }, [detail, showNotice]);

  // Dialog open/close lifecycle
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      stopAll();
      setCameraError("");
      setImgReady(false);
      setScannedReturns([]);
      setManualCode("");
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
      return;
    }

    if (camMode === "webcam") {
      startWebcam();
    } else {
      setImgReady(false);
      setCameraError("");
      loadNextFrame();
    }

    return () => {
      stopAll();
    };
  }, [open, camMode, stopAll, startWebcam, loadNextFrame]);

  // Decode barcode from Webcam video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || camMode !== "webcam" || !cameraReady || !videoRef.current) return;
    let active = true;
    let animId: number | null = null;

    (async () => {
      // 1. Native BarcodeDetector (only if browser/OS actually supports code_128 or ean_13)
      let usedNative = false;
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "BarcodeDetector" in window) {
        try {
          const supported: string[] = await (window as any).BarcodeDetector.getSupportedFormats?.() || [];
          if (supported.includes("code_128") || supported.includes("ean_13")) {
            const detector = new (window as any).BarcodeDetector({
              formats: supported.filter((f) => ["code_128", "code_39", "ean_13", "ean_8", "upc_a", "upc_e", "qr_code"].includes(f)),
            });
            const detectNative = async () => {
              if (!active || !videoRef.current) return;
              if (videoRef.current.readyState >= 2) {
                try {
                  const barcodes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current);
                  if (active && barcodes && barcodes.length > 0) {
                    const val = barcodes[0].rawValue;
                    if (val) handleScanned(val);
                  }
                } catch {}
              }
              if (active) animId = requestAnimationFrame(detectNative);
            };
            animId = requestAnimationFrame(detectNative);
            usedNative = true;
          }
        } catch {
          usedNative = false;
        }
      }

      if (usedNative) return;

      // 2. Fallback to ZXing with Hints
      try {
        const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/browser");
        const { BarcodeFormat, DecodeHintType } = await import("@zxing/library");
        if (!active) return;
        const hints = new Map();
        hints.set(DecodeHintType.POSSIBLE_FORMATS, [
          BarcodeFormat.CODE_128,
          BarcodeFormat.EAN_13,
          BarcodeFormat.CODE_39,
          BarcodeFormat.EAN_8,
          BarcodeFormat.UPC_A,
          BarcodeFormat.UPC_E,
          BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE,
        ]);
        hints.set(DecodeHintType.TRY_HARDER, true);
        const reader = new BrowserMultiFormatReader(hints, {
          delayBetweenScanAttempts: 150,
          delayBetweenScanSuccess: 1000,
        });
        readerRef.current = reader;
        reader.decodeFromVideoElement(videoRef.current!, (result, _err) => {
          if (!active) return;
          if (result) {
            const code = result.getText();
            handleScanned(code);
          }
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to decode webcam with ZXing:", err);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      active = false;
      if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
      if (readerRef.current) {
        try { readerRef.current.reset(); } catch {}
        readerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [open, camMode, cameraReady, handleScanned]);

  // Decode barcode from IP camera image
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || camMode !== "ip" || !imgReady || !imgRef.current) return;
    stopScanning();
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
      if (!imgRef.current) return;
      const img = imgRef.current;
      if (!img.complete || !(img.naturalWidth || img.width)) return;
      try {
        if (!readerRef.current) {
          const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/browser");
          readerRef.current = new BrowserMultiFormatReader();
        }
        const result = await readerRef.current.decodeFromImageElement(img);
        if (result) handleScanned(result.getText());
      } catch {}
    }, 200);
    return () => stopScanning();
  }, [open, camMode, imgReady, handleScanned, stopScanning]);

  const updateCondition = (isbn: string, value: string) => {
    setScannedReturns((prev) => prev.map((item) =>
      item.isbn === isbn ? { ...item, condition: value } : item
    ));
  };

  const removeScanned = (isbn: string) => {
    setScannedReturns((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.isbn !== isbn));
  };

  const handleBatchReturn = async () => {
    if (!scannedReturns.length) return;
    setBatchReturning(true);
    let ok = 0;
    let fail = 0;
    for (const item of scannedReturns) {
      try {
        await api.staffReturnBorrowRecord(item.record.id, item.condition || null);
        ok++;
      } catch {
        fail++;
      }
    }
    setBatchReturning(false);
    onClose();
    setScannedReturns([]);
    showNotice(
      fail > 0 ? "warning" : "success",
      `Trả ${ok} sách thành công${fail > 0 ? `, ${fail} thất bại` : ""}`
    );
    await onBatchComplete();
  };

  const totalBorrowCount = detail?.records.length || 0;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={batchReturning ? undefined : onClose} fullWidth maxWidth="xl">
      <DialogTitle sx={{ pb: 1 }}>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 1 }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" />
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>Quét mã vạch trả sách</Typography>
              {detail?.patron ? (
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                  Độc giả: <strong>{detail.patron.full_name}</strong> ({detail.patron.student_code}) — Đang mượn {totalBorrowCount} sách
                </Typography>
              ) : null}
            </Box>
          </Stack>

          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            {/* Toggle Camera Mode */}
            <ToggleButtonGroup
              size="small"
              value={camMode}
              exclusive
              onChange={(_, newMode) => {
                if (newMode) setCamMode(newMode);
              }}
              sx={{ bgcolor: "background.paper" }}
            >
              <ToggleButton value="webcam" sx={{ px: 1.5, py: 0.5, textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}>
                <VideocamIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ mr: 0.5 }} /> Camera máy tính
              </ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton value="ip" sx={{ px: 1.5, py: 0.5, textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600 }}>
                <CameraAltIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ mr: 0.5 }} /> Camera IP
              </ToggleButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>

            {!batchReturning ? (
              <IconButton size="small" onClick={onClose}><CloseIcon fontSize="small" /></IconButton>
            ) : null}
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </DialogTitle>

      <DialogContent dividers sx={{ p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 2.5, flexDirection: { xs: "column", md: "row" }, flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
          {/* Left Column: Camera Viewfinder & Manual Input */}
          <Box sx={{ width: { md: "50%" }, flexShrink: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1.5 }}>
            <Box sx={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "4/3", bgcolor: "#000", borderRadius: 2, overflow: "hidden", boxShadow: 2 }}>
              {/* Webcam View */}
              {camMode === "webcam" ? (
                <>
                  <video
                    ref={videoRef}
                    autoPlay
                    playsInline
                    muted
                    style={{
                      width: "100%",
                      height: "100%",
                      objectFit: "cover",
                      display: cameraReady ? "block" : "none",
                    }}
                  />
                  {!cameraReady && !cameraError ? (
                    <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.7)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1}>
                      <CircularProgress size={32} color="inherit" />
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Đang kết nối camera máy tính...</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : null}
                </>
              ) : (
                /* IP Camera View */
                <>
                  <Box
                    component="img"
                    ref={imgRef}
                    src={BORROW_CAM_URL}
                    onLoad={() => {
                      loadingRef.current = false;
                      setCameraError("");
                      setImgReady(true);
                      if (pollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
                      pollTimerRef.current = setTimeout(loadNextFrame, 150);
                    }}
                    onError={() => {
                      loadingRef.current = false;
                      setCameraError("Không thể kết nối IP Camera");
                      setImgReady(false);
                      if (pollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
                      if (reconnectTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);
                      reconnectTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                        setCameraError("");
                        loadNextFrame();
                      }, 3000);
                    }}
                    alt="IP Camera"
                    sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain" }}
                  />
                  {!imgReady && !cameraError ? (
                    <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1}>
                      <CircularProgress size={28} color="inherit" />
                      <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối IP camera...</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : null}
                </>
              )}

              {/* Error Overlay */}
              {cameraError ? (
                <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.85)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", p: 3 }} spacing={1.5}>
                  <CameraAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: "error.light" }} />
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ textAlign: "center", color: "error.light", fontWeight: 600 }}>{cameraError}</Typography>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="inherit"
                    size="small"
                    startIcon={<RefreshIcon />}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCameraError("");
                      if (camMode === "webcam") startWebcam();
                      else loadNextFrame();
                    }}
                    sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
                  >
                    Thử lại
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              ) : null}

              {/* Scanning Crosshair Overlay */}
              {(cameraReady || imgReady) && !cameraError ? (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    inset: "20% 15%",
                    border: "2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.7)",
                    borderRadius: 2,
                    pointerEvents: "none",
                    boxShadow: "0 0 0 9999px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
                  }}
                />
              ) : null}

              {/* Badge Top Left */}
              <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: 10, left: 10, px: 1.2, py: 0.4, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.65)", borderRadius: 1 }}>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "common.white", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  {camMode === "webcam" ? "🎥 Camera máy tính (Webcam)" : "📡 Camera IP"}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Box>

            {/* Manual Code Input Bar */}
            <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 1.5, borderRadius: 2 }}>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5, display: "block" }}>
                Hoặc nhập tay mã ISBN / Barcode trên bìa sách:
              </Typography>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
                <TextField
                  size="small"
                  fullWidth
                  placeholder="Nhập 10-13 số ISBN hoặc barcode..."
                  value={manualCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setManualCode(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" && manualCode.trim()) {
                      handleScanned(manualCode.trim());
                      setManualCode("");
                    }
                  }}
                  sx={{ "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: "6px" } }}
                />
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (manualCode.trim()) {
                      handleScanned(manualCode.trim());
                      setManualCode("");
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={!manualCode.trim()}
                  sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: "6px", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}
                >
                  Nhận sách
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </Paper>
          </Box>

          {/* Right Column: Scanned Books for Return */}
          <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflow: "auto" }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                  {scannedReturns.length > 0 ? `Sách đã nhận diện để trả (${scannedReturns.length} cuốn)` : "Sách đã nhận diện để trả"}
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
              {scannedReturns.length > 0 ? (
                <Chip size="small" color="success" icon={<CheckCircleIcon />} label={`${scannedReturns.length} cuốn sẵn sàng`} />
              ) : null}
            </Stack>

            {scannedReturns.length === 0 ? (
              <Alert severity="info" sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
                Đưa mã vạch ISBN sau bìa sách trước camera máy tính (hoặc nhập mã ở khung bên trái). Hệ thống sẽ tự động đối chiếu với danh sách sách độc giả đang mượn.
              </Alert>
            ) : (
              scannedReturns.map((item) => (
                <Paper key={item.isbn} variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 1.5, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "background.paper" }}>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
                    {item.record.book?.cover_url ? (
                      <Box
                        component="img"
                        src={item.record.book.cover_url}
                        alt={item.record.book.title}
                        sx={{ width: 44, height: 60, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 1, flexShrink: 0 }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 44, height: 60, bgcolor: "action.hover", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                        <BookIcon color="action" />
                      </Avatar>
                    )}
                    <Stack spacing={0.4} sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} noWrap>
                        {item.record.book?.title || item.record.book_id}
                      </Typography>
                      {item.record.book?.author ? (
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>{item.record.book.author}</Typography>
                      ) : null}
                      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace", color: "primary.main", fontWeight: 700 }}>
                        Mã: {item.isbn}
                      </Typography>
                      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", pt: 0.5 }}>
                        {dueChip(item.record)}
                        {item.condition ? <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" label={item.condition} /> : null}
                      </Stack>
                      <Select
                        value={item.condition}
                        onChange={(e) => updateCondition(item.isbn, e.target.value)}
                        displayEmpty
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        sx={{ mt: 1, borderRadius: 1 }}
                      >
                        <MenuItem value="">Tình trạng sách khi trả (tuỳ chọn)</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Còn mới">Còn mới</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Bình thường">Bình thường</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Sách cũ">Sách cũ</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Rách bìa">Rách bìa</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Rách trang">Rách trang</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Thiếu trang">Thiếu trang</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Ẩm mốc">Ẩm mốc</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Viết/bôi bẩn">Viết/bôi bẩn</MenuItem>
                        <MenuItem value="Hư hỏng nặng">Hư hỏng nặng</MenuItem>
                      </Select>
                    </Stack>
                    <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => removeScanned(item.isbn)} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                      <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </Stack>
                </Paper>
              ))
            )}

            {/* List of remaining books borrowed by this patron */}
            {detail?.records && detail.records.length > 0 ? (
              <Box sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                <Divider sx={{ my: 1.5 }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 1, display: "block" }}>
                  Tất cả sách độc giả đang mượn ({detail.records.length} cuốn):
                </Typography>
                <Stack spacing={1}>
                  {detail.records.map((r) => {
                    const isScanned = scannedReturns.some((s) => s.record.id === r.id);
                    return (
                      <Paper
                        key={r.id}
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{
                          p: 1,
                          borderRadius: 1.5,
                          opacity: isScanned ? 0.5 : 1,
                          bgcolor: isScanned ? "action.hover" : "background.default",
                          display: "flex",
                          alignItems: "center",
                          justifyContent: "space-between",
                          gap: 1,
                        }}
                      >
                        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", minWidth: 0 }}>
                          {isScanned ? (
                            <CheckCircleIcon color="success" fontSize="small" />
                          ) : (
                            <BookIcon color="action" fontSize="small" />
                          )}
                          <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }} noWrap>
                              {r.book?.title}
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                              ISBN: {r.book?.isbn || "N/A"} {(r as any).copy?.barcode ? `| Barcode: ${(r as any).copy.barcode}` : ""}
                            </Typography>
                          </Box>
                        </Stack>
                        {!isScanned ? (
                          <Button
                            size="small"
                            variant="outlined"
                            onClick={() => handleScanned(r.book?.isbn || (r as any).copy?.barcode || r.id)}
                            sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 1, py: 0.2 }}
                          >
                            Chọn trả
                          </Button>
                        ) : (
                          <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Đã quét" sx={{ height: 22, fontSize: 11 }} />
                        )}
                      </Paper>
                    );
                  })}
                </Stack>
              </Box>
            ) : null}
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      </DialogContent>

      <DialogActions sx={{ px: 2.5, py: 1.5 }}>
        <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={batchReturning} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>Đóng</Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          color="success"
          disabled={batchReturning || scannedReturns.length === 0}
          onClick={handleBatchReturn}
          startIcon={batchReturning ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <CheckCircleIcon />}
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: 1.5, px: 2.5 }}
        >
          {batchReturning ? "Đang trả sách..." : `Xác nhận trả (${scannedReturns.length} cuốn)`}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Box, Typography, CircularProgress, alpha } from "@mui/material";
import RadioButtonUncheckedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RadioButtonUnchecked";
import HourglassBottomIcon from "@mui/icons-material/HourglassBottom";
import Webcam from "react-webcam";

type ScannerPhase = "detecting" | "processing" | "confirm";

interface ScannerUIProps {
  videoSource: "webcam" | "ipcamera";
  ipCameraUrl?: string;
  phase: ScannerPhase;
  cameraReady: boolean;
  ocrLoading: boolean;
  ocrProgress: number;
  detectAttempts: number;
  maxDetectAttempts: number;
  webcamRef: React.RefObject<Webcam | null>;
  ipCamRef: React.RefObject<HTMLImageElement | null>;
  onCameraReady: () => void;
  onCameraError: (msg: string) => void;
  videoConstraints?: MediaStreamConstraints["video"];
}

const STATUS_BG = "rgba(13, 17, 23, 0.85)";
const CORNER_BORDER = "3px";

export function ScannerUI({
  videoSource,
  ipCameraUrl,
  phase,
  cameraReady,
  ocrLoading,
  ocrProgress,
  detectAttempts,
  maxDetectAttempts,
  webcamRef,
  ipCamRef,
  onCameraReady,
  onCameraError,
  videoConstraints = {
    facingMode: "environment",
    width: { ideal: 1920 },
    height: { ideal: 1080 },
  },
}: ScannerUIProps) {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        flex: { md: "0 0 55%" },
        position: "relative",
        bgcolor: "common.black",
        borderRadius: { xs: "12px 12px 0 0", md: "12px 0 0 12px" },
        overflow: "hidden",
        minHeight: { xs: 280, md: 420 },
      }}
    >
      {videoSource === "ipcamera" ? (
        <Box
          component="img"
          ref={ipCamRef}
          src={ipCameraUrl}
          alt="IP Camera"
          onLoad={onCameraReady}
          onError={() => onCameraError("Không thể kết nối IP Camera")}
          sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain", display: "block" }}
        />
      ) : (
        <Webcam
          ref={webcamRef}
          audio={false}
          screenshotFormat="image/jpeg"
          screenshotQuality={0.9}
          videoConstraints={videoConstraints}
          onUserMedia={onCameraReady}
          onUserMediaError={() => onCameraError("Không thể truy cập camera")}
          style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain", display: "block" }}
        />
      )}

      <CardFrameOverlay />

      {phase !== "confirm" && (
        <StatusBadge
          phase={phase}
          detectAttempts={detectAttempts}
          maxDetectAttempts={maxDetectAttempts}
        />
      )}

      {!cameraReady && <NotReadyOverlay />}

      {phase === "processing" && ocrLoading && (
        <ProcessingOverlay />
      )}
    </Box>
  );
}

function CardFrameOverlay() {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <Box sx={{ width: "70%", aspectRatio: "1.6 / 1", position: "relative" }}>
        {(["top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right"] as const).map((corner) => {
          const isTop = corner.includes("top");
          const isLeft = corner.includes("left");
          return (
            <Box
              key={corner}
              sx={{
                position: "absolute",
                width: 28,
                height: 28,
                [isTop ? "top" : "bottom"]: -2,
                [isLeft ? "left" : "right"]: -2,
                borderColor: "common.white",
                borderStyle: "solid",
                borderWidth: 0,
                [`border${isTop ? "Top" : "Bottom"}Width`]: CORNER_BORDER,
                [`border${isLeft ? "Left" : "Right"}Width`]: CORNER_BORDER,
                borderRadius: isTop && isLeft ? "12px 0 0 0"
                  : isTop && !isLeft ? "0 12px 0 0"
                  : !isTop && isLeft ? "0 0 0 12px"
                  : "0 0 12px 0",
                opacity: 0.9,
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

function StatusBadge({ phase, detectAttempts, maxDetectAttempts }: {
  phase: ScannerPhase;
  detectAttempts: number;
  maxDetectAttempts: number;
}) {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "absolute",
        top: 16,
        left: "50%",
        transform: "translateX(-50%)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 1,
        bgcolor: STATUS_BG,
        px: 2,
        py: 1,
        borderRadius: 20,
        backdropFilter: "blur(4px)",
      }}
    >
      {phase === "detecting" && (
        <RadioButtonUncheckedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#7A8CA8", animation: "pulse-blue 2s ease-in-out infinite" }} />
      )}
      {phase === "processing" && (
        <HourglassBottomIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#1A73E8", animation: "pulse-blue 1s ease-in-out infinite" }} />
      )}
      <Typography
        variant="body2"
        sx={{
          fontWeight: 600,
          color: "common.white",
          whiteSpace: { xs: "normal", sm: "nowrap" },
          fontSize: { xs: "0.7rem", sm: "0.875rem" },
        }}
      >
        {phase === "processing"
          ? `Đang nhận dạng... ${detectAttempts > 0 ? `(${detectAttempts}/${maxDetectAttempts})` : ""}`
          : phase === "detecting"
          ? "Đang phát hiện thẻ..."
          : "Đọc thẻ thành công"}
      </Typography>
    </Box>
  );
}

function NotReadyOverlay() {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "absolute", inset: 0,
        bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
        color: "common.white",
        display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
        flexDirection: "column", gap: 1,
      }}
    >
      <CircularProgress size={28} color="inherit" />
      <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
    </Box>
  );
}

function ProcessingOverlay() {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "absolute", inset: 0,
        bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)",
        color: "common.white",
        display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
        flexDirection: "column", gap: 1,
      }}
    >
      <CircularProgress size={28} color="inherit" />
      <Typography variant="body2">Đang nhận dạng chữ viết...</Typography>
    </Box>
  );
}

  Badge,

  ListItemText,

  Tooltip,
  Typography,

import ActiveIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined";
import GroupIcon from "@mui/icons-material/GroupsOutlined";

interface AdminActionMenuProps {

  pendingSwapCount: number;
  pendingManualCount: number;

export default function AdminActionMenu({
  pendingBidCount,
  pendingSwapCount,
  pendingManualCount,
  onAction,

  const [scheduleAnchor, setScheduleAnchor] = useState<null | HTMLElement>(null);

  const totalPending = pendingBidCount + pendingSwapCount + pendingManualCount;

  const menuStyle = {
    "& .MuiMenuItem-root": { py: 1, px: 2, fontSize: "0.85rem" },

  return (

          size="small"
          onClick={(e) => setScheduleAnchor(e.currentTarget)}

        >
          <AutoAwesomeIcon fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>

        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setScheduleAnchor(null); onAction("auto-schedule"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><AutoAwesomeIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#f59e0b" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Gợi ý lịch tự động</ListItemText>

          <ListItemIcon><ScheduleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "primary.main" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Mẫu lịch</ListItemText>
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setScheduleAnchor(null); onAction("delete-week"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><DeleteIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#ef4444" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText sx={{ color: "#ef4444" }}>Xóa lịch tuần</ListItemText>
        </MenuItem>
      </Menu>

      <Tooltip title="Duyệt">
        <IconButton
          size="small"
          onClick={(e) => setApproveAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
          sx={{ color: "#10b981", border: "1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3)", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(16,185,129,0.1)" } }}
        >
          <Badge badgeContent={totalPending || undefined} color="error" max={9}>
            <ChecklistIcon fontSize="small" />
          </Badge>
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
      <Menu anchorEl={approveAnchor} open={Boolean(approveAnchor)} onClose={() => setApproveAnchor(null)} sx={menuStyle}>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setApproveAnchor(null); onAction("leave-approval"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><LeaveIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#f59e0b" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Đơn nghỉ</ListItemText>
          {pendingBidCount > 0 && <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1, color: "text.secondary" }}>({pendingBidCount})</Typography>}
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setApproveAnchor(null); onAction("bids-review"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><ActiveIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#10b981" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Đăng ký ca</ListItemText>
          {pendingBidCount > 0 && <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1, color: "text.secondary" }}>({pendingBidCount})</Typography>}
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setApproveAnchor(null); onAction("swaps-view"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><GroupIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "primary.main" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Đổi ca</ListItemText>
          {pendingSwapCount > 0 && <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1, color: "text.secondary" }}>({pendingSwapCount})</Typography>}
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setApproveAnchor(null); onAction("manual-checkin"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><EditNoteIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "secondary.main" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Check-in thủ công</ListItemText>
          {pendingManualCount > 0 && <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ ml: 1, color: "text.secondary" }}>({pendingManualCount})</Typography>}
        </MenuItem>
      </Menu>

      <Tooltip title="Cấu hình">
        <IconButton
          size="small"
          onClick={(e) => setConfigAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
          sx={{ color: "text.primary", border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" } }}
        >
          <SettingsIcon fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
      <Menu anchorEl={configAnchor} open={Boolean(configAnchor)} onClose={() => setConfigAnchor(null)} sx={menuStyle}>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setConfigAnchor(null); onAction("management"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><SettingsIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "text.secondary" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Quản lý ca/khu vực</ListItemText>
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setConfigAnchor(null); onAction("templates-config"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><AssignmentTurnedInIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "text.secondary" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Mẫu lịch</ListItemText>
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setConfigAnchor(null); onAction("geofence"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><MapIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#f59e0b" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Geofence</ListItemText>
        </MenuItem>
        <MenuItem onClick={() => { setConfigAnchor(null); onAction("audit-logs"); }}>
          <ListItemIcon><HistoryIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#6b7280" }} /></ListItemIcon>
          <ListItemText>Nhật ký</ListItemText>
        </MenuItem>
      </Menu>
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Box, Chip, IconButton, Tooltip, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import WarningAmberIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import CancelIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CancelOutlined";
import type { StaffScheduleAssignment } from "@/lib/types";

interface AssignmentCardProps {
  assignment: StaffScheduleAssignment;
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  understaffed?: boolean;
}

type StatusKey = "past" | "active" | "future" | "today" | "understaffed" | "cancelled" | "completed";

const STATUS_META: Record<StatusKey, { label: string; chipColor: "default" | "success" | "primary" | "warning" | "error"; accentBorder?: string }> = {
  past:         { label: "Đã qua",     chipColor: "default" },
  active:       { label: "Đang trực",  chipColor: "success", accentBorder: "#10b981" },
  future:       { label: "Sắp tới",    chipColor: "primary" },
  today:        { label: "Hôm nay",    chipColor: "warning", accentBorder: "#f59e0b" },
  understaffed: { label: "Thiếu người", chipColor: "warning" },
  cancelled:    { label: "Đã hủy",     chipColor: "error" },
  completed:    { label: "Hoàn thành", chipColor: "default" },
};

function getStatus(assignment: StaffScheduleAssignment): StatusKey {
  if (assignment.status === "cancelled") return "cancelled";
  if (assignment.status === "completed") return "completed";
  const now = new Date();
  const today = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  if (assignment.workDate < today) return "past";
  if (assignment.workDate > today) return "future";
  const current = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  const start = (assignment.shift?.startTime || "").slice(0, 5);
  const end = (assignment.shift?.endTime || "").slice(0, 5);
  if (start && end && current >= start && current <= end) return "active";
  return "today";
}

export default function AssignmentCard({ assignment, onDelete, understaffed }: AssignmentCardProps) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(false);
  const baseStatus = getStatus(assignment);
  const status: StatusKey = understaffed ? "understaffed" : baseStatus;
  const meta = STATUS_META[status];
  const displayName = assignment.staff?.fullName || assignment.staff?.email || "Nhân viên";
  const zoneName = assignment.zone?.zoneName || "";

  const isGround = status === "past" || status === "completed" || status === "future";
  const isFigure = status === "active" || status === "today";
  const isUnderstaffed = status === "understaffed";
  const isCancelled = status === "cancelled";

  return (
    <Box
      onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
      sx={{
        position: "relative",
        px: 1.5,
        py: 1,
        borderRadius: 1,
        border: "1px solid",
        borderColor: isCancelled
          ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.25)"
          : isUnderstaffed
          ? "rgba(251,146,60,0.35)"
          : isFigure
          ? "transparent"
          : "action.hover",
        borderLeftWidth: isFigure ? 3 : 1,
        borderLeftColor: meta.accentBorder,
        bgcolor: isCancelled
          ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)"
          : isUnderstaffed
          ? "rgba(251,146,60,0.08)"
          : isFigure
          ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.04)"
          : "background.paper",
        backgroundImage: isCancelled
          ? "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 4px, rgba(239,68,68,0.06) 4px, rgba(239,68,68,0.06) 8px)"
          : "none",
        transition: "background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s",
        "&:hover": onDelete ? { borderColor: "action.focus" } : undefined,
      }}
    >
      {zoneName ? (
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{ fontSize: "0.625rem", fontWeight: 500, color: "text.secondary", lineHeight: 1.2, display: "block", mb: 0.25 }}
        >
          {zoneName}
        </Typography>
      ) : null}
      <Typography
        variant="caption"
        sx={{
          fontWeight: 600,
          color: isCancelled ? "error.main" : isUnderstaffed ? "warning.dark" : isFigure ? "text.primary" : "text.secondary",
          display: "block",
          overflow: "hidden",
          textOverflow: "ellipsis",
          whiteSpace: "nowrap",
        }}
      >
        {displayName}
      </Typography>

      <Chip
        icon={isUnderstaffed ? <WarningAmberIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12 }} /> : isCancelled ? <CancelIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12 }} /> : undefined}
        label={meta.label}
        size="small"
        color={meta.chipColor}
        variant={isGround ? "outlined" : "filled"}
        sx={{
          mt: 0.5,
          height: 18,
          fontSize: "0.6rem",
          fontWeight: 700,
          "& .MuiChip-label": { px: 0.75 },
        }}
      />

      {onDelete ? (
        <Tooltip title="Xóa ca trực">
          <IconButton
            size="small"
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(assignment.id); }}
            sx={{
              position: "absolute",
              top: -4,
              right: -4,
              width: 18,
              height: 18,
              bgcolor: "background.paper",
              border: "1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
              color: "#ef4444",
              opacity: hover ? 1 : 0,
              transition: "opacity 0.15s",
              "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)" },
              "& .MuiIconButton-root": { p: 0 },
            }}
          >
            <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      ) : null}
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Box, useTheme } from "@mui/material";
import Table from "antd/es/table";
import Badge from "antd/es/badge";
import Tooltip from "antd/es/tooltip";
import type { ColumnsType } from "antd/es/table";
import type { StaffScheduleAssignment, StaffShift } from "@/lib/types";
import TimetableCell from "./TimetableCell";

interface TimetableGridProps {
  days: Date[];
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  filter: string;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  onCellClick?: (date: string, shiftId: string) => void;
  onDeleteAssignment?: (id: string) => void;
  onViewStaff?: (staffId: string) => void;
}

const DAY_LABELS = ["T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7", "CN"];

function toDateInput(date: Date) {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

function formatDate(d: Date) {
  return `${d.getDate()}/${d.getMonth() + 1}`;
}

function isToday(d: Date) {
  const now = new Date();
  return d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear()
    && d.getMonth() === now.getMonth()
    && d.getDate() === now.getDate();
}

interface ShiftRow {
  key: string;
  shift: StaffShift;
  cells: Record<string, StaffScheduleAssignment[]>;
}

export default function TimetableGrid({
  days, shifts, assignments, filter, isAdmin, onCellClick, onDeleteAssignment, onViewStaff,
}: TimetableGridProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";

  const cellMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, StaffScheduleAssignment[]> = {};
    for (const a of assignments) {
      if (a.status === "cancelled") continue;

      if (filter === "active") {
        const now = new Date();
        const today = toDateInput(now);
        if (a.workDate !== today) continue;
        const current = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        const start = (a.shift?.startTime || "").slice(0, 5);
        const end = (a.shift?.endTime || "").slice(0, 5);
        if (!(start && end && current >= start && current <= end)) continue;
      }
      if (filter === "future" && a.workDate <= toDateInput(new Date())) continue;
      if (filter === "past" && a.workDate >= toDateInput(new Date())) continue;

      const key = `${a.shiftId}:${a.workDate}`;
      if (!map[key]) map[key] = [];
      map[key].push(a);
    }
    return map;
  }, [assignments, filter]);

  const dayCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const a of assignments) {
      if (a.status === "cancelled") continue;
      counts[a.workDate] = (counts[a.workDate] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return counts;
  }, [assignments]);

  const dataSource: ShiftRow[] = useMemo(() =>
    shifts.map((shift) => ({
      key: shift.id,
      shift,
      cells: Object.fromEntries(
        days.map((d) => [toDateInput(d), cellMap[`${shift.id}:${toDateInput(d)}`] || []])
      ),
    })),
    [shifts, days, cellMap]
  );

  const columns: ColumnsType<ShiftRow> = useMemo(() => {
    const shiftCol: ColumnsType<ShiftRow>[number] = {
      title: "Ca / Ngày",
      dataIndex: "shift",
      key: "shift",
      fixed: "left",
      width: 160,
      render: (_: any, row: ShiftRow) => (
        <Tooltip title={`${row.shift.name}: ${row.shift.startTime?.slice(0, 5)} – ${row.shift.endTime?.slice(0, 5)}${row.shift.minStaff ? ` (tối thiểu ${row.shift.minStaff} nhân viên)` : ""}`} placement="right">
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.78rem", color: theme.palette.primary.main }}>
              {row.shift.name}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", color: theme.palette.text.secondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
              {row.shift.startTime?.slice(0, 5)} – {row.shift.endTime?.slice(0, 5)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </Tooltip>
      ),
    };

    const dayCols: ColumnsType<ShiftRow> = days.map((d, i) => {
      const dateStr = toDateInput(d);
      const count = dayCounts[dateStr] || 0;
      const today = isToday(d);
      return {
        title: (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
            <Badge count={count} size="small" offset={[0, 0]}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.75rem", color: today ? theme.palette.primary.main : theme.palette.text.primary }}>
                {DAY_LABELS[i]}
              </span>
            </Badge>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", marginTop: 2, color: today ? theme.palette.primary.light : theme.palette.text.secondary }}>
              {formatDate(d)}
            </div>
          </div>
        ),
        dataIndex: "cells",
        key: dateStr,
        width: 140,
        render: (_: any, row: ShiftRow) => {
          const cellAssignments = row.cells[dateStr] || [];
          return (
            <TimetableCell
              assignments={cellAssignments}
              date={dateStr}
              shiftId={row.shift.id}
              isAdmin={isAdmin}
              onCellClick={onCellClick}
              onDeleteAssignment={onDeleteAssignment}
              onViewStaff={onViewStaff}
              shift={row.shift}
            />
          );
        },
        onCell: () => ({
          style: {
            background: today
              ? isDark ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.06)" : "rgba(99,102,241,0.03)"
              : undefined,
          },
        }),
      };
    });

    return [shiftCol, ...dayCols];
  }, [days, dayCounts, isAdmin, onCellClick, onDeleteAssignment, onViewStaff, theme, isDark]);

  return (
    <Box sx={{
      width: "100%",
      overflowX: "auto",
      border: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
      borderRadius: 1,
      "& .ant-table": {
        background: theme.palette.background.paper,
      },
      "& .ant-table-thead > tr > th": {
        background: isDark ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.08)" : theme.palette.action.hover,
        fontWeight: 700,
        fontSize: "0.75rem",
        color: theme.palette.text.primary,
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
      },
      "& .ant-table-tbody > tr > td": {
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
        background: theme.palette.background.paper,
        color: theme.palette.text.primary,
      },
      "& .ant-table-tbody > tr:hover > td": {
        background: isDark ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.04)" : "rgba(99,102,241,0.02)",
      },
      "& .ant-table-cell": {
        padding: "8px",
      },
      "& .ant-table-fixed-left": {
        "& .ant-table-thead > tr > th": {
          background: isDark ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)" : "rgba(99,102,241,0.06)",
        },
        "& .ant-table-tbody > tr > td": {
          background: isDark ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.04)" : "rgba(99,102,241,0.02)",
        },
      },
      "& .ant-table-bordered .ant-table-thead > tr > th": {
        borderInlineEnd: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
      },
      "& .ant-table-bordered .ant-table-tbody > tr > td": {
        borderInlineEnd: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
      },
    }}>
      <Table<ShiftRow>
        columns={columns}
        dataSource={dataSource}
        pagination={false}
        size="small"
        scroll={{ x: 160 + days.length * 140 }}
        bordered
      />
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Box, Breadcrumbs, Typography, useTheme } from "@mui/material";
import HomeOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/HomeOutlined";
import NavigateNextIcon from "@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext";

const ROUTE_NAME_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  dashboard: "Tổng quan thư viện",
  books: "Kho sách & Tài liệu",
  patrons: "Quản lý bạn đọc",
  active: "Bạn đọc đang có mặt",
  borrow: "Quầy mượn sách",
  return: "Quầy trả sách",
  gate: "Cổng kiểm soát Kiosk",
  "staff-schedules": "Lịch trực thủ thư",
  history: "Nhật ký vào ra & Mượn trả",
  "vr-tour": "Tham quan 3D Thư viện",
  stats: "Báo cáo & Thống kê",
  admin: "Quản trị người dùng",
  "dynamic-admin": "Phân quyền & Vai trò",
  settings: "Cài đặt hệ thống",
  "ai-assistant": "Trợ lý AI Thủ thư",
  enroll: "Đăng ký khuôn mặt",
  verify: "Xác thực khuôn mặt (1:1)",
  identify: "Nhận diện bạn đọc (1:N)",
  liveness: "Kiểm tra thực thể sống",
  profile: "Hồ sơ & Tài khoản cá nhân",
  notifications: "Trung tâm thông báo",
};

export function BreadcrumbsNav() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";

  // Split pathname into segments
  const segments = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);

  // If on root dashboard, don't overwhelm with redundant breadcrumbs
  if (segments.length === 0 || (segments.length === 1 && segments[0] === "dashboard")) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ mb: 2, px: 0.5 }}>
      <Breadcrumbs
        separator={<NavigateNextIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: isDark ? "#64748B" : "#94A3B8" }} />}
        aria-label="breadcrumb"
      >
        <Link
          href="/dashboard"
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 4,
            textDecoration: "none",
            color: isDark ? "#94A3B8" : "#64748B",
            fontSize: "0.8rem",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontFamily: "'Source Sans 3', sans-serif",
          }}
        >
          <HomeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />
          <span>Bàn làm việc</span>
        </Link>

        {segments.map((seg, idx) => {
          const isLast = idx === segments.length - 1;
          const href = "/" + segments.slice(0, idx + 1).join("/");
          const title = ROUTE_NAME_MAP[seg] || decodeURIComponent(seg);

          if (isLast) {
            return (
              <Typography
                key={href}
                sx={{
                  fontSize: "0.8rem",
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontFamily: "'Space Grotesk', sans-serif",
                  color: isDark ? "#F8FAFC" : "#0F172A",
                }}
              >
                {title}
              </Typography>
            );
          }

          return (
            <Link
              key={href}
              href={href}
              style={{
                textDecoration: "none",
                color: isDark ? "#94A3B8" : "#64748B",
                fontSize: "0.8rem",
                fontWeight: 600,
                fontFamily: "'Source Sans 3', sans-serif",
              }}
            >
              {title}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </Breadcrumbs>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default BreadcrumbsNav;

import { ReactNode } from "react";
import Table from "antd/es/table";
import type { ColumnsType, TablePaginationConfig } from "antd/es/table";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";

export interface DataTableColumn<T = any> {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  sortable?: boolean;
  align?: "left" | "center" | "right";
  width?: number | string;
  fixed?: "left" | "right";
  filterOptions?: { text: string; value: string }[];
  render?: (value: any, row: T, index: number) => ReactNode;
}

interface DataTableProps<T = any> {
  columns: DataTableColumn<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  loading?: boolean;
  emptyTitle?: string;
  emptyDescription?: string;
  page?: number;
  rowsPerPage?: number;
  totalCount?: number;
  onPageChange?: (page: number) => void;
  onRowsPerPageChange?: (rowsPerPage: number) => void;
  onRowClick?: (row: T) => void;
  getRowId?: (row: T) => string | number;
  scrollX?: number | string;
}

export default function DataTable<T extends Record<string, any>>({
  columns,
  rows,
  loading = false,
  emptyTitle = "Không có dữ liệu",
  emptyDescription,
  page = 0,
  rowsPerPage = 10,
  totalCount,
  onPageChange,
  onRowsPerPageChange,
  onRowClick,
  getRowId,
  scrollX,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
  const antdColumns: ColumnsType<T> = columns.map((col) => {
    const colDef: ColumnsType<T>[number] = {
      key: col.key,
      dataIndex: col.key,
      title: col.label,
      align: col.align || "left",
      width: col.width,
      fixed: col.fixed,
      sorter: col.sortable ? (a: T, b: T) => {
        const av = a[col.key];
        const bv = b[col.key];
        if (av == null && bv == null) return 0;
        if (av == null) return -1;
        if (bv == null) return 1;
        if (typeof av === "number" && typeof bv === "number") return av - bv;
        return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv));
      } : undefined,
      render: col.render
        ? (value: any, row: T, index: number) => col.render!(value, row, index)
        : (value: any) => value ?? "-",
    };

    if (col.filterOptions) {
      colDef.filters = col.filterOptions.map((o) => ({ text: o.text, value: o.value }));
      colDef.onFilter = (value: any, record: T) => String(record[col.key]) === String(value);
    }

    return colDef;
  });

  const pagination: TablePaginationConfig | false = totalCount !== undefined && onPageChange
    ? {
        current: page + 1,
        pageSize: rowsPerPage,
        total: totalCount,
        showSizeChanger: true,
        pageSizeOptions: ["10", "20", "50", "100"],
        showTotal: (total, range) => `${range[0]}-${range[1]} / ${total}`,
        onChange: (p: number, ps: number) => {
          onPageChange(p - 1);
          onRowsPerPageChange?.(ps);
        },
      }
    : false;

  if (!loading && rows.length === 0) {
    return <EmptyState title={emptyTitle} description={emptyDescription} />;
  }

  return (
    <Table<T>
      columns={antdColumns}
      dataSource={rows}
      rowKey={getRowId ? (row: T) => getRowId(row) : undefined}
      loading={loading}
      size="small"
      pagination={pagination}
      scroll={scrollX ? { x: scrollX } : undefined}
      onRow={onRowClick ? (record: T) => ({ onClick: () => onRowClick(record), style: { cursor: "pointer" } }) : undefined}
    />
  );
}

import { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Avatar, Box, Button, IconButton, Stack, Tooltip, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import ArrowBackIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import type { SvgIconComponent } from "@mui/icons-material";

interface PageHeaderProps {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  backHref?: string;
  icon?: SvgIconComponent;
  /** @deprecated gradient variant được bỏ — dùng flat header thực tế hơn */
  gradient?: string;
  gradientIconBg?: string;
  gradientIconColor?: string;
  statBadges?: string;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
}

export default function PageHeader({
  title,
  subtitle,
  actions,
  backHref,
  icon: Icon,
  onRefresh,
  statBadges,
}: PageHeaderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  return (
    <Stack
      direction="row"
      sx={{
        alignItems: "flex-start",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        mb: 3,
        gap: 2,
        flexWrap: "wrap",
      }}
    >
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
        {backHref && (
          <IconButton
            onClick={() => router.push(backHref)}
            size="small"
            sx={{
              border: "1px solid",
              borderColor: "divider",
              "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
            }}
          >
            <ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        )}
        {Icon && (
          <Avatar
            sx={{
              bgcolor: "action.selected",
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              borderRadius: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Icon sx={{ color: "primary.main", fontSize: 22 }} />
          </Avatar>
        )}
        <Box>
          <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
            {title}
          </Typography>
          {(subtitle || statBadges) && (
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 0.25 }}>
              {statBadges || subtitle}
            </Typography>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Stack>

      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {onRefresh && (
          <Tooltip title="Tải lại">
            <IconButton
              onClick={onRefresh}
              size="small"
              sx={{
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: "divider",
                "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
              }}
            >
              <RefreshIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        )}
        {actions}
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  );
}

export default function PatronGridView({ patrons, onEdit, onRenew, onDelete, onRestore }: PatronGridViewProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(3, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>

              ...staggerSx(idx, 0.05),
              "&:hover": { transform: "translateY(-2px)", boxShadow: 4, borderColor: "primary.main" } }}>
            <Box sx={{ height: 4, background: patron.status === "active" ? STAT_GRADIENT.active : patron.status === "expired" ? STAT_GRADIENT.expired : "linear-gradient(135deg, #64748b 0%, #475569 100%)" }} />
            <Box sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start", mb: 2 }}>
                <AvatarUser user={patron} role="patron" size={44} />
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.3, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{patron.full_name}</Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: "text.secondary" }}>{patron.student_code}</Typography>

                <Chip label={statusLabel(patron.status)} color={statusColor(patron.status)} size="small" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.7rem", height: 24 }} />

                {patron.course ? (

                    <SchoolIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{patron.course}</Typography>
                  </Stack>
                ) : null}
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <FaceIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: patron.has_face ? "primary.main" : "action.disabled" }} />
                  <Typography variant="caption" color={patron.has_face ? "primary.main" : "text.secondary"}>
                    {patron.has_face ? "Đã đăng ký khuôn mặt" : "Chưa có khuôn mặt"}
                  </Typography>
                </Stack>
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <BadgeIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: isExpired ? "error.main" : isSoonExp ? "warning.main" : "text.secondary" }} />

              <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", pt: 1.5, borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                {patron.status === "deleted" ? (
                  <>
                    <Button size="small" variant="outlined" color="success" onClick={() => onRestore(patron)} sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>Khôi phục</Button>

                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Tooltip title="Chỉnh sửa"><IconButton size="small" onClick={() => onEdit(patron)} sx={{ color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { color: "primary.main" } }}><EditIcon fontSize="small" /></IconButton></Tooltip>
                    <Tooltip title="Gia hạn thẻ"><IconButton size="small" onClick={() => onRenew(patron)} sx={{ color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { color: "success.main" } }}><UpdateIcon fontSize="small" /></IconButton></Tooltip>
                    <Tooltip title="Xóa"><IconButton size="small" onClick={() => onDelete(patron)} sx={{ color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { color: "error.main" } }}><DeleteIcon fontSize="small" /></IconButton></Tooltip>
                    <Tooltip title="Xem chi tiết"><IconButton size="small" onClick={() => router.push(`/patrons/${patron.id}`)} sx={{ color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { color: "primary.main" } }}><ChevronRightIcon fontSize="small" /></IconButton></Tooltip>
                  </>

"use client";

import { useRef, Suspense, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import { Canvas, useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { OrbitControls, Environment, useTexture } from "@react-three/drei";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { Box, Typography } from "@mui/material";

interface BookProps {
  coverUrl: string;
}

function BookModel({ coverUrl }: BookProps) {
  const meshRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  
  // Use useTexture from drei which handles suspense and caching better
  // Provide a fallback if coverUrl is empty or fails
  const fallbackUrl = "https://via.placeholder.com/400x600?text=Book+Cover";
  const validUrl = coverUrl && coverUrl.startsWith("http") ? coverUrl : fallbackUrl;
  
  // Use a public image proxy that injects CORS headers to avoid WebGL cross-origin tainted canvas issues
  const proxiedUrl = validUrl.includes("via.placeholder.com") 
    ? validUrl 
    : `https://images.weserv.nl/?url=${encodeURIComponent(validUrl)}&w=400&h=600&fit=cover`;

  const coverTexture = useTexture(proxiedUrl);
  
  // Memoize materials to avoid recreation on every render, and handle their disposal
  const materials = useMemo(() => {
    const pageMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf5f5f5, roughness: 0.8 });
    const coverMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: coverTexture, roughness: 0.3 });
    const backMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1976d2, roughness: 0.4 }); // Primary color spine/back

    // Materials for BoxGeometry (right, left, top, bottom, front, back)
    return [
      pageMaterial,  // right (pages edge)
      backMaterial,  // left (spine)
      pageMaterial,  // top (pages edge)
      pageMaterial,  // bottom (pages edge)
      coverMaterial, // front cover
      backMaterial,  // back cover
    ];
  }, [coverTexture]);

  // Clean up materials to prevent WebGL memory leaks
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      materials.forEach((mat) => mat.dispose());
    };
  }, [materials]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    if (meshRef.current) {
      // Gentle floating animation
      meshRef.current.position.y = Math.sin(state.clock.elapsedTime) * 0.1;
    }
  });

  return (
    <mesh ref={meshRef} material={materials} rotation={[0, -Math.PI / 8, 0]}>
      {/* Width, Height, Depth */}
      <boxGeometry args={[2.2, 3.2, 0.4]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Loader() {
  return (
    <Box sx={{
      width: "100%", height: "400px",
      display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1,
      bgcolor: "action.hover",
      backdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
      WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
      borderRadius: 1,
    }}>
      <Box sx={{
        width: 40, height: 40, borderRadius: "50%",
        border: "3px solid", borderColor: "divider",
        borderTopColor: "primary.main",
        animation: "spin 0.8s linear infinite",
        "@keyframes spin": { "100%": { transform: "rotate(360deg)" } },
      }} />
      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Đang tải 3D...</Typography>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function Book3DViewer({ coverUrl }: BookProps) {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: "100%", height: "400px", cursor: "grab", "&:active": { cursor: "grabbing" } }}>
      <Suspense fallback={<Loader />}>
        <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 0, 5], fov: 45 }}>
          <ambientLight intensity={0.6} />
          <directionalLight position={[5, 10, 5]} intensity={0.8} />
          <spotLight position={[-5, 5, 5]} angle={0.5} penumbra={1} intensity={0.5} />
          <Environment preset="city" />
          <BookModel coverUrl={coverUrl} />
          <OrbitControls 
            enableZoom={true} 
            enablePan={false} 
            minDistance={3} 
            maxDistance={8}
            autoRotate={true}
            autoRotateSpeed={1.5}
          />
        </Canvas>
      </Suspense>
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardMedia,
  Typography,
  Box,
  Chip,
  Divider,
} from "@mui/material";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { SPRINGS } from "@/lib/motion";

export interface BookCardData {
  title: string;
  author?: string;
  isbn?: string;
  categories?: string;
  description?: string;
  cover_url?: string;
  publisher?: string;
  published_date?: string;
  page_count?: number;
  language?: string;
  source?: "database" | "google_books" | "not_found";
}

interface BookCardProps {
  data: BookCardData;
  showActions?: boolean;
  onConfirm?: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

export default function BookCard({
  data,
  showActions = false,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: BookCardProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      whileHover={{ y: -4, scale: 1.01 }}
      whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
      transition={SPRINGS.gentle}
      style={{ willChange: "transform" }}
    >
      <Card
        sx={{
          maxWidth: 360,
          border: "1px solid",
          borderColor: "divider",
          borderRadius: 2,
          overflow: "hidden",
          my: 1,
          transition: "box-shadow 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
          "&:hover": {
            boxShadow: "0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)",
          },
        }}
      >
      {data.cover_url && (
        <CardMedia
          component="img"
          height="200"
          image={data.cover_url}
          alt={data.title}
          sx={{ objectFit: "contain", bgcolor: "grey.100", p: 1 }}
          onError={(e: any) => {
            e.target.style.display = "none";
          }}
        />
      )}
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2 }}>
        <Typography variant="h6" component="h3" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>
          {data.title}
        </Typography>

        {data.author && (
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
            Tác giả: {data.author}
          </Typography>
        )}

        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5, mb: 1 }}>
          {data.isbn && (
            <Chip label={`ISBN: ${data.isbn}`} size="small" variant="outlined" />
          )}
          {data.categories && (
            <Chip label={data.categories} size="small" color="primary" variant="outlined" />
          )}
          {data.source && (
            <Chip
              label={data.source === "database" ? "Trong thư viện" : "Google Books"}
              size="small"
              color={data.source === "database" ? "success" : "info"}
            />
          )}
        </Box>

        {data.description && (
          <>
            <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              color="text.secondary"
              sx={{
                display: "-webkit-box",
                WebkitLineClamp: 3,
                WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical",
                overflow: "hidden",
                lineHeight: 1.5,
              }}
            >
              {data.description}
            </Typography>
          </>
        )}

        <Box sx={{ mt: 1, display: "flex", gap: 1, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          {data.publisher && (
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              NXB: {data.publisher}
            </Typography>
          )}
          {data.published_date && (
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Năm: {data.published_date}
            </Typography>
          )}
          {data.page_count && (
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              {data.page_count} trang
            </Typography>
          )}
        </Box>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export function parseBookCard(text: string): { before: string; bookData: BookCardData | null; after: string } {
  const marker = /:::book_card\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n:::/;
  const match = text.match(marker);

  if (!match) {
    return { before: text, bookData: null, after: "" };
  }

  const idx = text.indexOf(match[0]);
  const before = text.substring(0, idx).trim();
  const after = text.substring(idx + match[0].length).trim();

  try {
    const bookData = JSON.parse(match[1]) as BookCardData;
    return { before, bookData, after };
  } catch {
    return { before: text, bookData: null, after: "" };
  }
}
