File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/camera-capture.tsx
================
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AddAPhotoOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AddAPhotoOutlined";
import CameraswitchOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraswitchOutlined";
import PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PhotoCameraOutlined";
import CameraFallback from "@/app/_components/CameraFallback";

export default function CameraCapture({
  onCapture,
  showManualFallback,
  manualLabel,
  manualPlaceholder,
  onManualSubmit,
  onFileUpload,
}: {
  onCapture: (file: File, dataUrl: string) => void;
  showManualFallback?: boolean;
  manualLabel?: string;
  manualPlaceholder?: string;
  onManualSubmit?: (value: string) => void;
  onFileUpload?: (file: File) => void;
}) {
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCameraOn, setIsCameraOn] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>("");
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [showFallback, setShowFallback] = useState(false);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const readyTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const frameCaptureRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const hasCameraWorkedRef = useRef(false);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (frameCaptureRef.current) {
      clearInterval(frameCaptureRef.current);
      frameCaptureRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsCameraOn(false);
    setCameraReady(false);
  }, []);

  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError("");
      setShowFallback(false);
      setCameraReady(false);
      stopCamera();
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "user", width: { ideal: 640, min: 320 }, height: { ideal: 480, min: 240 } },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      setIsCameraOn(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") setError("Không có quyền truy cập camera. Hãy cấp quyền camera cho trình duyệt rồi thử lại.");
      else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") setError("Không tìm thấy camera trên thiết bị.");
      else setError("Không thể khởi động camera.");
      setIsCameraOn(false);
      setShowFallback(true);
    }
  }, [stopCamera]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCameraOn || !videoRef.current || !streamRef.current) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const onReady = () => {
      setCameraReady(true);
      hasCameraWorkedRef.current = true;
    };
    video.onloadedmetadata = onReady;
    video.onplaying = onReady;
    video.onerror = () => {
      setError("Camera gặp lỗi khi phát hình.");
      setShowFallback(true);
    };
    video.srcObject = streamRef.current;
    if (video.readyState >= 2) {
      onReady();
      hasCameraWorkedRef.current = true;
    }
    readyTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setCameraReady(true);
      hasCameraWorkedRef.current = true;
    }, 3000);
    return () => {
      if (readyTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(readyTimeoutRef.current);
      video.onloadedmetadata = null;
      video.onplaying = null;
      video.onerror = null;
      video.srcObject = null;
    };
  }, [isCameraOn]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCameraOn || !cameraReady || !videoRef.current) return;
    frameCaptureRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      if (!video || video.videoWidth === 0 || !streamRef.current) return;
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) return;
        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
        lastFrameRef.current = canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.3);
      } catch {
        lastFrameRef.current = null;
      }
    }, 2000);
    return () => {
      if (frameCaptureRef.current) clearInterval(frameCaptureRef.current);
    };
  }, [isCameraOn, cameraReady]);

  const capturePhoto = () => {
    if (!videoRef.current || !cameraReady || videoRef.current.videoWidth === 0) {
      setError("Camera chưa sẵn sàng, vui lòng đợi thêm một chút.");
      return;
    }
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = videoRef.current.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = videoRef.current.videoHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) {
      setError("Không thể chụp ảnh từ camera.");
      return;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(videoRef.current, 0, 0);
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (!blob) return;
      const capturedFile = new File([blob], "face_capture.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg");
      setImage(dataUrl);
      onCapture(capturedFile, dataUrl);
      stopCamera();
    }, "image/jpeg", 0.9);
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setImage(null);
    setError("");
    setShowFallback(false);
    stopCamera();
  };

  useEffect(() => () => stopCamera(), [stopCamera]);

  return (
    <Stack spacing={1.5}>
      <Paper
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          position: "relative",
          overflow: "hidden",
          bgcolor: "black",
          aspectRatio: "16 / 9",
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        {image ? (
          <Box component="img" src={image} alt="Ảnh đã chụp" sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain" }} />
        ) : showFallback ? (
          <CameraFallback
            lastFrameUrl={hasCameraWorkedRef.current ? lastFrameRef.current : null}
            onRetry={startCamera}
            showManualInput={showManualFallback}
            manualLabel={manualLabel}
            manualPlaceholder={manualPlaceholder}
            onManualSubmit={onManualSubmit}
            showFileUpload={!!onFileUpload}
            onFileUpload={onFileUpload}
          />
        ) : isCameraOn ? (
          <>
            <Box component="video" ref={videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain" }} />
            {!cameraReady && (
              <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1}>
                <CircularProgress size={26} color="inherit" />
                <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
              </Stack>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center", color: "grey.300", p: 3 }}>
            <PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 42 }} />
            <Typography>{error || "Bật camera để bắt đầu."}</Typography>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Paper>

      <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={1}>
        {image ? (
          <Button variant="outlined" startIcon={<CameraswitchOutlinedIcon />} onClick={reset} fullWidth>
            Chụp lại
          </Button>
        ) : showFallback || (!isCameraOn) ? (
          <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon />} onClick={startCamera} fullWidth>
            Bật camera
          </Button>
        ) : isCameraOn ? (
          <>
            <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<AddAPhotoOutlinedIcon />} onClick={capturePhoto} disabled={!cameraReady} fullWidth>
              Chụp ảnh
            </Button>
            <Button color="error" variant="text" onClick={stopCamera}>
              Tắt
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Box, Button, CircularProgress, IconButton, Stack, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import CameraAltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";

interface Props {
  cameraUrl: string;
  onBarcodeDetected: (barcode: string) => void;
  onError?: (error: string) => void;
}

const POLL_INTERVAL = 150;
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 1200;

export default function IPCameraStream({ cameraUrl, onBarcodeDetected, onError }: Props) {
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);
  const readerRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const pollTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const scanTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const [imgReady, setImgReady] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const lastScannedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const loadingRef = useRef(false);

  const stopPolling = useCallback(() => {
    if (pollTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
      pollTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (scanTimerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(scanTimerRef.current);
      scanTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    loadingRef.current = false;
  }, []);

  const stopReader = useCallback(() => {
    if (readerRef.current) {
      try { readerRef.current.reset(); } catch {}
      readerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const loadNextFrame = useCallback(() => {
    if (!imgRef.current || loadingRef.current) return;
    loadingRef.current = true;
    const sep = cameraUrl.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
    imgRef.current.src = `${cameraUrl}${sep}_t=${Date.now()}`;
  }, [cameraUrl]);

  const handleReconnect = useCallback(() => {
    stopPolling();
    setCameraError("");
    setImgReady(false);
    loadNextFrame();
  }, [loadNextFrame, stopPolling]);

  const handleScan = useCallback((code: string) => {
    const normalized = code.trim();
    if (normalized.length < 4) return;
    if (normalized === lastScannedRef.current) return;
    lastScannedRef.current = normalized;
    onBarcodeDetected(normalized);
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
    }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }, [onBarcodeDetected]);

  const scanCurrentFrame = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!imgRef.current || !readerRef.current) return;
    const img = imgRef.current;
    if (!img.complete || !(img.naturalWidth || img.width)) return;

    try {
      const result = await readerRef.current.decodeFromImageElement(img);
      if (result) {
        handleScan(result.getText());
      }
    } catch {}
  }, [handleScan]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/browser");
        const { BarcodeFormat, DecodeHintType } = await import("@zxing/library");
        if (!active) return;
        const hints = new Map();
        hints.set(DecodeHintType.POSSIBLE_FORMATS, [
          BarcodeFormat.CODE_128,
          BarcodeFormat.EAN_13,
          BarcodeFormat.CODE_39,
          BarcodeFormat.EAN_8,
          BarcodeFormat.UPC_A,
          BarcodeFormat.UPC_E,
          BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE,
        ]);
        hints.set(DecodeHintType.TRY_HARDER, true);
        readerRef.current = new BrowserMultiFormatReader(hints, {
          delayBetweenScanAttempts: 150,
          delayBetweenScanSuccess: 1000,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load ZXing:", err);
      }
    })();
    return () => { active = false; stopReader(); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadNextFrame();
  }, [loadNextFrame]);

  useEffect(() => {
    scanTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      scanCurrentFrame();
    }, 100);
    return () => {
      if (scanTimerRef.current) clearInterval(scanTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [scanCurrentFrame]);

  const handleImgLoad = useCallback(() => {
    loadingRef.current = false;
    setCameraError("");
    setImgReady(true);

    scanCurrentFrame();

    if (pollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
    pollTimerRef.current = setTimeout(loadNextFrame, POLL_INTERVAL);
  }, [loadNextFrame, scanCurrentFrame]);

  const handleImgError = useCallback(() => {
    loadingRef.current = false;
    if (pollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
    pollTimerRef.current = setTimeout(loadNextFrame, 300);
  }, [loadNextFrame]);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "4/3", bgcolor: "black", borderRadius: 1, overflow: "hidden" }}>
      {cameraError ? (
        <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", height: "100%", color: "grey.300", p: 3 }}>
          <CameraAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48 }} />
          <Typography sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>{cameraError}</Typography>
          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "grey.500" }}>URL: {cameraUrl}</Typography>
          <Button variant="outlined" color="inherit" startIcon={<RefreshIcon />} onClick={handleReconnect}>
            Kết nối lại
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Box
            component="img"
            ref={imgRef}
            onLoad={handleImgLoad}
            onError={handleImgError}
            alt="IP Camera Stream"
            sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain", display: "block" }}
          />
          {!imgReady && (
            <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1}>
              <CircularProgress size={28} color="inherit" />
              <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
            </Stack>
          )}
          {imgReady && (
            <IconButton
              onClick={handleReconnect}
              size="small"
              sx={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, right: 8, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", color: "common.white", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.75)" } }}
            >
              <RefreshIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          )}
          <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, left: 8, px: 1, py: 0.5, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.6)", borderRadius: 0.5 }}>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "common.white", fontSize: 11 }}>IP Camera</Typography>
          </Box>
        </>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
}

File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/IsbnScannerDialog.tsx

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Paper,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
  useMediaQuery,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CameraAltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined";
import QrCodeScannerIcon from "@mui/icons-material/QrCodeScannerOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { BookImportResultRow, BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";

interface ScannedItem {
  isbn: string;
  quantity: number;
  lookup: BookWithStats | null;
  loading: boolean;
}

export default function IsbnScannerDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
  onImportComplete,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onImportComplete: (results: BookImportResultRow[]) => void;
}) {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const readerRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const lastScannedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const [scanned, setScanned] = useState<ScannedItem[]>([]);
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState("");
  const [scanToast, setScanToast] = useState("");
  const [manualInput, setManualInput] = useState("");

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (readerRef.current) {
      try { readerRef.current.reset(); } catch {}
      readerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    setCameraReady(false);
  }, []);

  const lookupIsbn = useCallback(async (isbn: string) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.map((item) =>
      item.isbn === isbn ? { ...item, loading: true } : item
    ));
    try {
      const book = await api.lookupBookByIsbn(isbn);
      setScanned((prev) => prev.map((item) =>
        item.isbn === isbn ? { ...item, lookup: book, loading: false } : item
      ));
    } catch (err) {
      setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.isbn !== isbn));
      setScanToast(`Không tìm thấy: ${isbn}`);
    }
  }, []);

  const cleanIsbn = (raw: string) => {
    const trimmed = raw.trim();
    const libMatch = trimmed.match(/^LIB[-]?(\d{10,13})[-]?(\d+)?$/i);
    if (libMatch) return libMatch[1];
    return trimmed.replace(/[-\s]/g, "");
  };

  const addScanned = useCallback((rawCode: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanIsbn(rawCode);
    if (!/^\d{10,13}$/.test(normalized)) return;
    lastScannedRef.current = normalized;
    setScanToast(normalized);
    setScanned((prev) => {
      if (prev.some((item) => item.isbn === normalized)) {
        return prev.map((item) =>
          item.isbn === normalized ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 } : item
        );
      }
      return [...prev, { isbn: normalized, quantity: 1, lookup: null, loading: true }];
    });
    lookupIsbn(normalized);
  }, [lookupIsbn]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      stopCamera();
      setScanned([]);
      setCameraError("");
      setImportError("");
      setScanToast("");
      setManualInput("");
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
      return;
    }
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        setCameraError("");
        const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/browser");
        if (!active) return;
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: "environment", width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
          audio: false,
        });
        if (!active) { stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop()); return; }
        streamRef.current = stream;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
          videoRef.current.onloadedmetadata = () => { setCameraReady(true); };
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (!active) return;
        if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") setCameraError("Không có quyền truy cập camera. Hãy cấp quyền camera cho trình duyệt.");
        else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") setCameraError("Không tìm thấy camera trên thiết bị.");
        else setCameraError("Không thể khởi động camera.");
      }
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [open, stopCamera]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cameraReady || !videoRef.current || !open) return;
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/browser");
        const { BarcodeFormat, DecodeHintType } = await import("@zxing/library");
        if (!active) return;
        const hints = new Map();
        hints.set(DecodeHintType.POSSIBLE_FORMATS, [
          BarcodeFormat.CODE_128,
          BarcodeFormat.EAN_13,
          BarcodeFormat.CODE_39,
          BarcodeFormat.EAN_8,
          BarcodeFormat.UPC_A,
          BarcodeFormat.UPC_E,
          BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE,
        ]);
        hints.set(DecodeHintType.TRY_HARDER, true);
        const reader = new BrowserMultiFormatReader(hints, {
          delayBetweenScanAttempts: 150,
          delayBetweenScanSuccess: 1000,
        });
        readerRef.current = reader;
        reader.decodeFromVideoElement(videoRef.current!, (result, err) => {
          if (!active) return;
          if (result) {
            const code = result.getText();
            if (code) {
              addScanned(code);
            }
          }
        });
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [cameraReady, open, addScanned]);

  useEffect(() => () => stopCamera(), [stopCamera]);

  const removeItem = (isbn: string) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.isbn !== isbn));
  };

  const updateQuantity = (isbn: string, value: number) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.map((item) =>
      item.isbn === isbn ? { ...item, quantity: Math.max(1, value || 1) } : item
    ));
  };

  const handleImport = async () => {
    const valid = scanned.filter((item) => item.lookup);
    if (!valid.length) return;
    setImporting(true);
    setImportError("");
    try {
      const result = await api.batchImportByIsbn(valid.map((item) => ({ isbn: item.isbn, quantity: item.quantity })));
      onImportComplete(result.results);
      stopCamera();
      setScanned([]);
    } catch (err) {
      setImportError(getErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  };

  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down("sm"));

  const validCount = scanned.filter((item) => item.lookup).length;
  const isNew = (item: ScannedItem) => item.lookup && item.lookup.total_copies === 0;

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={open} onClose={importing ? undefined : onClose} fullWidth maxWidth="xl" fullScreen={isMobile}>
        <DialogTitle>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" />
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>Quét mã ISBN</Typography>
            </Stack>
            {!importing && (
              <IconButton size="small" onClick={onClose}><CloseIcon /></IconButton>
            )}
          </Stack>
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers sx={{ p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, flexDirection: { xs: "column", md: "row" }, flex: 1, overflow: "hidden" }}>
            <Paper
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{
                position: "relative",
                overflow: "hidden",
                bgcolor: "black",
                width: { md: "50%" },
                aspectRatio: { xs: "16/9", md: "4/3" },
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              {cameraError ? (
                <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", color: "grey.300", p: 3 }}>
                  <CameraAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 42 }} />
                  <Typography>{cameraError}</Typography>
                </Stack>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Box
                    component="video"
                    ref={videoRef}
                    autoPlay
                    playsInline
                    muted
                    sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain" }}
                  />
                  {!cameraReady && (
                    <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1}>
                      <CircularProgress size={26} color="inherit" />
                      <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </Paper>

            <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ flex: 1, overflow: "auto" }}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>
                  {scanned.length > 0 ? `Đã quét (${scanned.length} cuốn)` : "Sách đã quét"}
                </Typography>
              </Stack>

              {importError ? <Alert severity="error" onClose={() => setImportError("")}>{importError}</Alert> : null}

              <TextField
                size="small"
                placeholder="Quét hoặc nhập mã sách (ISBN hoặc LIB-9780140328721-001)..."
                value={manualInput}
                onChange={(e) => setManualInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && manualInput.trim()) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    addScanned(manualInput.trim());
                    setManualInput("");
                  }
                }}
                slotProps={{
                  input: {
                    startAdornment: (
                      <InputAdornment position="start">
                        <QrCodeScannerIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                      </InputAdornment>
                    ),
                  },
                }}
                fullWidth
              />

              {scanned.length === 0 ? (
                <Alert severity="info" sx={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
                  Đưa mã vạch ISBN hoặc mã bản sao LIB-... vào camera, hoặc nhập mã ở trên.
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                scanned.map((item) => {
                  const isLastScanned = item.isbn === lastScannedRef.current;
                  return (
                    <Paper
                      key={item.isbn}
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        p: 1.5,
                        borderColor: isLastScanned ? "primary.main" : undefined,
                        bgcolor: isLastScanned ? "action.hover" : undefined,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
                        {item.lookup?.cover_url ? (
                          <Box
                            component="img"
                            src={item.lookup.cover_url}
                            alt={item.lookup.title}
                            sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, bgcolor: "background.default", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            <BookIcon />
                          </Avatar>
                        )}
                        <Stack spacing={0.3} sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                            {item.loading ? (
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Đang tra cứu...</Typography>
                            ) : item.lookup ? (
                              <>
                                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900, flex: 1 }} noWrap>
                                  {item.lookup.title}
                                </Typography>
                                {isNew(item) && <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Mới" sx={{ height: 20 }} />}
                              </>
                            ) : null}
                          </Stack>
                          {item.lookup && (
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                              {item.lookup.author || "-"}
                            </Typography>
                          )}
                          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: "primary.main" }}>
                            {item.isbn}
                          </Typography>
                          {item.lookup && !item.loading && (
                            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                              {isNew(item) ? (
                                <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" label="Sách mới - chưa có trong kho" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                              ) : (
                                <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                                  <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" label={`Kho: ${item.lookup.total_copies}`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                                  <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" color="success" label={`Sẵn: ${item.lookup.available_copies}`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                                </Stack>
                              )}
                            </Stack>
                          )}
                          {item.lookup && !item.loading && (
                            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", mt: 0.5 }}>
                              <TextField
                                type="number"
                                size="small"
                                label="SL thêm"
                                value={item.quantity}
                                onChange={(e) => updateQuantity(item.isbn, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1)}
                                slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1, style: { textAlign: "center", width: 40 } } }}
                                sx={{ width: 100 }}
                              />
                              {!isNew(item) && (
                                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                                  → Tổng: {item.lookup.total_copies + item.quantity}
                                </Typography>
                              )}
                            </Stack>
                          )}
                        </Stack>
                        <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => removeItem(item.isbn)} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                          <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Stack>
                    </Paper>
                  );
                })
              )}

            </Stack>
          </Box>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={importing}>Đóng</Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            disabled={importing || validCount === 0}
            onClick={handleImport}
          >
            {importing ? "Đang nhập vào kho..." : `Nhập vào kho (${validCount} cuốn)`}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      <Snackbar
        open={!!scanToast}
        autoHideDuration={2000}
        onClose={() => setScanToast("")}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
        message={
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            <span>Đã quét ISBN: {scanToast}</span>
          </Stack>
        }
      />
    </>
  );
}

File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/job-poll.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  CircularProgress,
  LinearProgress,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlineOutlined";
import { useTaskSSE } from "@/lib/hooks/useTaskSSE";

interface JobPollProps {
  jobId: string;
  onComplete?: (result: any) => void;
  onError?: (error: string) => void;
}

function resultSummary(result: any) {
  if (!result) return "";
  if (result.verified !== undefined) {
    return `Xác minh: ${result.verified ? "đạt" : "không đạt"}${result.score != null ? `, điểm ${(Number(result.score) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : ""}`;
  }
  if (result.matches) return `Tìm thấy ${result.matches.length} kết quả`;
  if (result.is_live !== undefined) {
    return `Khuôn mặt thật: ${result.is_live ? "Có" : "Không"}${result.liveness_score != null ? `, điểm ${(Number(result.liveness_score) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : ""}`;
  }
  return "Tác vụ đã hoàn tất.";
}

export default function JobPoll({ jobId, onComplete, onError }: JobPollProps) {
  const { state, start } = useTaskSSE();

  useEffect(() => {
    start(jobId);
  }, [jobId, start]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.status === "SUCCESS") {
      onComplete?.(state.result);
    } else if (state.status === "FAILURE" || state.status === "ERROR" || state.status === "TIMEOUT") {
      onError?.(state.error || "Tác vụ thất bại.");
    }
  }, [state.status, state.result, state.error, onComplete, onError]);

  if (state.status === "FAILURE" || state.status === "ERROR" || state.status === "TIMEOUT") {
    return (
      <Alert icon={<ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon />} severity="error">
        <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 750 }}>Lỗi</Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2">{state.error}</Typography>
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  if (state.status === "SUCCESS") {
    return (
      <Alert icon={<CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon />} severity="success">
        <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 750 }}>Thành công</Typography>
        {state.result && <Typography variant="body2">{resultSummary(state.result)}</Typography>}
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
        <CircularProgress size={28} />
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>Đang xử lý...</Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", wordBreak: "break-all" }}>
            Job ID: {jobId}
          </Typography>
          <LinearProgress sx={{ mt: 1.5, borderRadius: 99 }} />
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Paper>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Grid,

  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AddAPhotoOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AddAPhotoOutlined";
import CheckOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckOutlined";
import PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PhotoCameraOutlined";
import RestartAltOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RestartAltOutlined";
import WarningAmberOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import Webcam from "react-webcam";
import { FilesetResolver, FaceLandmarker } from "@mediapipe/tasks-vision";

export type CaptureAngle = "frontal" | "right" | "left" | "down";
export type MultiAngleCaptureStatus = "pending" | "capturing" | "done";

export interface AngleConfig {
  angle: CaptureAngle;
  instruction: string;
  tip: string;
  requirements: { yaw: [number, number]; pitch: [number, number] };
}

export interface CapturedAngle {
  angle: CaptureAngle;
  status: MultiAngleCaptureStatus;
  file: File | null;
  dataUrl: string | null;
}

export interface MultiAngleCaptureProps {
  consent: boolean;
  setConsent?: (v: boolean) => void;
  onFilesReady: (files: Record<CaptureAngle, File>) => Promise<void> | void;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_ANGLES: AngleConfig[] = [
  { angle: "frontal", instruction: "Nhìn thẳng", tip: "Mắt nhìn thẳng vào camera", requirements: { yaw: [-12, 12], pitch: [-12, 12] } },
  { angle: "right", instruction: "Quay mặt sang PHẢI", tip: "Xoay mặt sang phải khoảng 30 độ", requirements: { yaw: [20, 50], pitch: [-15, 15] } },
  { angle: "left", instruction: "Quay mặt sang TRÁI", tip: "Xoay mặt sang trái khoảng 30 độ", requirements: { yaw: [-50, -20], pitch: [-15, 15] } },
  { angle: "down", instruction: "Cúi XUỐNG", tip: "Cúi nhẹ cằm xuống", requirements: { yaw: [-15, 15], pitch: [15, 45] } },
];

const ANGLE_LABELS: Record<CaptureAngle, string> = {
  frontal: "Nhìn thẳng",
  right: "Quay phải",
  left: "Quay trái",
  down: "Cúi xuống",
};

// Hàm tiện ích chuyển DataURI sang File
function dataURItoFile(dataURI: string, filename: string): File {
  const byteString = atob(dataURI.split(",")[1]);
  const mimeString = dataURI.split(",")[0].split(":")[1].split(";")[0];
  const ab = new ArrayBuffer(byteString.length);
  const ia = new Uint8Array(ab);
  for (let i = 0; i < byteString.length; i++) {
    ia[i] = byteString.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return new File([ab], filename, { type: mimeString });
}

export default function MultiAngleCapture({
  consent,
  setConsent,
  onFilesReady,
  className,
}: MultiAngleCaptureProps) {
  const [captures, setCaptures] = useState<CapturedAngle[]>(
    DEFAULT_ANGLES.map((item) => ({ angle: item.angle, status: "pending", file: null, dataUrl: null }))
  );
  
  const [isSequenceRunning, setIsSequenceRunning] = useState(false);
  const [currentAngleIdx, setCurrentAngleIdx] = useState(-1);
  
  // Model state
  const [isModelLoaded, setIsModelLoaded] = useState(false);
  const faceLandmarkerRef = useRef<FaceLandmarker | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string>("Đang khởi tạo AI...");
  const [isHold, setIsHold] = useState(false);
  const [holdProgress, setHoldProgress] = useState(0); // 0 to 100
  
  const webcamRef = useRef<Webcam>(null);
  const requestRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const poseHoldStartRef = useRef<number>(0);
  
  const HOLD_DURATION = 1500; // Giữ 1.5 giây

  // --- Khởi tạo Model ---
  const loadModel = async () => {
    try {
      setFeedback("Đang tải model nhận diện khuôn mặt (lần đầu có thể mất vài giây)...");
      const filesetResolver = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(
        "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.9/wasm"
      );
      faceLandmarkerRef.current = await FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions(filesetResolver, {
        baseOptions: {
          modelAssetPath: "https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task",
          delegate: "GPU",
        },
        outputFaceBlendshapes: false,
        outputFacialTransformationMatrixes: true,
        runningMode: "VIDEO",
        numFaces: 1,
      });
      setIsModelLoaded(true);
      setFeedback("Camera sẵn sàng. Vui lòng làm theo hướng dẫn.");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to load FaceLandmarker:", error);
      setFeedback("Lỗi tải model nhận diện khuôn mặt. Hãy tải lại trang.");
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSequenceRunning && !isModelLoaded) {
      loadModel();
    }
    return () => {
      if (requestRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(requestRef.current);
      if (faceLandmarkerRef.current) faceLandmarkerRef.current.close();
    };
  }, [isSequenceRunning]);

  // --- Bắt đầu chuỗi ---
  const startSequence = useCallback(() => {
    setCaptures(DEFAULT_ANGLES.map((item) => ({ angle: item.angle, status: "pending", file: null, dataUrl: null })));
    setCurrentAngleIdx(0);
    setIsSequenceRunning(true);
  }, []);

  const retakeAngle = useCallback((idx: number) => {
    setCaptures((prev) =>
      prev.map((item, index) => (index === idx ? { ...item, status: "pending", file: null, dataUrl: null } : item))
    );
    setCurrentAngleIdx(idx);
    setIsSequenceRunning(true);
  }, []);

  // --- Logic Auto Capture ---
  const captureCurrentPose = useCallback(() => {
    if (webcamRef.current) {
      const dataUrl = webcamRef.current.getScreenshot();
      if (dataUrl) {
        const file = dataURItoFile(dataUrl, `face_${DEFAULT_ANGLES[currentAngleIdx].angle}.jpg`);
        setCaptures((prev) =>
          prev.map((item, index) => (index === currentAngleIdx ? { ...item, status: "done", file, dataUrl } : item))
        );
        
        // Find next pending angle
        setCaptures((currentCaptures) => {
          let nextIdx = -1;
          for (let i = 0; i < currentCaptures.length; i++) {
            if (currentCaptures[i].status !== "done" && i !== currentAngleIdx) {
              nextIdx = i;
              break;
            }
          }
          
          if (nextIdx === -1) {
            // Done all
            setIsSequenceRunning(false);
            setCurrentAngleIdx(-1);
            if (requestRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(requestRef.current);
          } else {
            setCurrentAngleIdx(nextIdx);
          }
          return currentCaptures;
        });
      }
    }
  }, [currentAngleIdx]);

  const detectFace = useCallback(() => {
    if (!faceLandmarkerRef.current || !webcamRef.current?.video || currentAngleIdx < 0) return;
    
    const video = webcamRef.current.video;
    if (video.readyState !== 4) {
      requestRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(detectFace);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const startTimeMs = performance.now();
      const results = faceLandmarkerRef.current.detectForVideo(video, startTimeMs);

      if (results.faceLandmarks.length === 0) {
        setFeedback("Không tìm thấy khuôn mặt trong khung hình");
        setIsHold(false);
        setHoldProgress(0);
        poseHoldStartRef.current = 0;
      } else if (results.faceLandmarks.length > 1) {
        setFeedback("Chỉ cho phép 1 khuôn mặt trong khung hình");
        setIsHold(false);
        setHoldProgress(0);
        poseHoldStartRef.current = 0;
      } else {
        // Compute yaw, pitch from matrix
        const matrix = results.facialTransformationMatrixes?.[0];
        if (matrix) {
          // matrix is 4x4, row-major (16 elements)
          // Rotation extraction
          const pitch = -Math.asin(matrix.data[9]) * (180 / Math.PI); 
          const yaw = Math.atan2(matrix.data[8], matrix.data[10]) * (180 / Math.PI);

          const req = DEFAULT_ANGLES[currentAngleIdx].requirements;
          const isYawOk = yaw >= req.yaw[0] && yaw <= req.yaw[1];
          const isPitchOk = pitch >= req.pitch[0] && pitch <= req.pitch[1];

          if (isYawOk && isPitchOk) {
            setFeedback("Tuyệt vời! Giữ nguyên tư thế...");
            setIsHold(true);
            
            if (poseHoldStartRef.current === 0) {
              poseHoldStartRef.current = performance.now();
            } else {
              const elapsed = performance.now() - poseHoldStartRef.current;
              const progress = Math.min((elapsed / HOLD_DURATION) * 100, 100);
              setHoldProgress(progress);
              
              if (elapsed >= HOLD_DURATION) {
                captureCurrentPose();
                poseHoldStartRef.current = 0;
                setIsHold(false);
                setHoldProgress(0);
                return; // Ngừng phát hiện để chờ pose tiếp theo
              }
            }
          } else {
            setFeedback(DEFAULT_ANGLES[currentAngleIdx].instruction);
            setIsHold(false);
            setHoldProgress(0);
            poseHoldStartRef.current = 0;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
    
    if (isSequenceRunning) {
      requestRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(detectFace);
    }
  }, [currentAngleIdx, captureCurrentPose, isSequenceRunning]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isModelLoaded && isSequenceRunning) {
      poseHoldStartRef.current = 0;
      setHoldProgress(0);
      setIsHold(false);
      requestRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(detectFace);
    }
  }, [isModelLoaded, isSequenceRunning, currentAngleIdx, detectFace]);

  const allCaptured = captures.every((item) => item.status === "done" && Boolean(item.file));
  const doneCount = captures.filter((item) => item.status === "done").length;
  
  const capturedFiles = useMemo(() => {
    const result = {} as Record<CaptureAngle, File>;
    for (const item of captures) {
      if (item.status === "done" && item.file) {
        result[item.angle] = item.file;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }, [captures]);

  const submit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!consent || !allCaptured) return;
    await onFilesReady(capturedFiles);
  }, [allCaptured, capturedFiles, consent, onFilesReady]);

  const currentConfig = currentAngleIdx >= 0 ? DEFAULT_ANGLES[currentAngleIdx] : null;

  return (
    <Box className={className}>
      {!allCaptured && !isSequenceRunning && currentAngleIdx < 0 && (
        <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 3, textAlign: "center" }}>
          <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: 64, height: 64, borderRadius: "50%", display: "grid", placeItems: "center", bgcolor: "primary.main", color: "primary.contrastText" }}>
              <PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" />
            </Box>
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>
                Đăng ký khuôn mặt tự động (eKYC)
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="text.secondary">
                Hệ thống sẽ tự động phát hiện và chụp khi bạn quay đúng góc yêu cầu.
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 2, width: "100%", bgcolor: "action.hover", textAlign: "left" }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 850, mb: 1 }}>
                Lưu ý khi chụp
              </Typography>
              <Stack spacing={0.5}>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">- Bỏ kính râm, khẩu trang.</Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">- Ánh sáng rõ, không bị lóa từ phía sau.</Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">- Làm theo hướng dẫn trên màn hình.</Typography>
              </Stack>
            </Paper>

            <Button variant="contained" size="large" startIcon={<PhotoCameraOutlinedIcon />} onClick={startSequence}>
              Bắt đầu quá trình chụp
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </Paper>
      )}

      {(isSequenceRunning || currentAngleIdx >= 0) && (
        <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ position: "relative", aspectRatio: "4 / 3", overflow: "hidden", bgcolor: "black", maxWidth: 640, mx: "auto" }}>
          <Webcam
            ref={webcamRef}
            audio={false}
            screenshotFormat="image/jpeg"
            videoConstraints={{ facingMode: "user" }}
            style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }}
          />
          
          {/* Hướng dẫn hình Oval */}
          <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>

            Xác nhận đăng ký khuôn mặt
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      )}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  IconButton,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import CameraAltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useTaskSSE } from "@/lib/hooks/useTaskSSE";
import type { PatronPublic } from "@/lib/types";

export interface PatronVerifyResult {
  patron_id: string;
  student_code: string;
  full_name: string;
  score: number;
}

interface Props {
  onVerified: (result: PatronVerifyResult) => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export default function PatronFaceVerify({ onVerified, onClose }: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  const [studentCode, setStudentCode] = useState("");
  const [capturing, setCapturing] = useState(false);
  const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const { state: sseState, start: startSSE, reset: resetSSE } = useTaskSSE(30000);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setCameraReady(false);
  }, []);

  const handleOpen = useCallback(async () => {
    setError("");
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "user", width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.onloadedmetadata = () => setCameraReady(true);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") {
        setError("Không có quyền truy cập camera. Hãy cấp quyền camera cho trình duyệt.");
      } else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") {
        setError("Không tìm thấy camera trên thiết bị.");
      } else {
        setError("Không thể khởi động camera.");
      }
    }
  }, []);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    stopCamera();
    setOpen(false);
    onClose?.();
  }, [stopCamera, onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => resetSSE();
  }, [resetSSE]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sseState.status === "SUCCESS" && sseState.result) {
      const r = sseState.result;
      const patronResult: PatronVerifyResult = {
        patron_id: (r.patron_id as string) || "",
        student_code: (r.student_code as string) || studentCode,
        full_name: (r.full_name as string) || "",
        score: (r.score as number) || 0,
      };
      stopCamera();
      setOpen(false);
      onVerified(patronResult);
      return;
    }
    if (sseState.status === "FAILURE" || sseState.status === "ERROR" || sseState.status === "TIMEOUT") {
      const errMsg = sseState.error || "Xác minh khuôn mặt thất bại";
      setError(typeof errMsg === "string" ? errMsg : JSON.stringify(errMsg));
      setVerifying(false);
      return;
    }
  }, [sseState, studentCode, stopCamera, onVerified]);

  const captureAndVerify = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current || !studentCode.trim()) return;

    setCapturing(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = videoRef.current.videoWidth;
      canvas.height = videoRef.current.videoHeight;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas context error");
      ctx.drawImage(videoRef.current, 0, 0);

      const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
        canvas.toBlob((b) => {
          if (b) resolve(b);
          else reject(new Error("Canvas toBlob failed"));
        }, "image/jpeg", 0.85);
      });

      const file = new File([blob], "capture.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });

      setVerifying(true);
      const result = await api.kioskEnter(file, studentCode.trim());

      if (result.job_id) {
        startSSE(result.job_id);
      } else if (result.patron) {
        const patronResult: PatronVerifyResult = {
          patron_id: result.patron.id,
          student_code: result.patron.student_code || studentCode,
          full_name: result.patron.full_name || "",
          score: result.confidence || 0,
        };
        stopCamera();
        setOpen(false);
        onVerified(patronResult);
        return;
      } else {
        setError(result.message || "Không nhận diện được khuôn mặt");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi xác minh khuôn mặt");
    } finally {
      setCapturing(false);
      setVerifying(false);
    }
  }, [studentCode, stopCamera, onVerified, startSSE]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={handleClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <PersonIcon color="primary" />
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>Xác minh độc giả bằng khuôn mặt</Typography>
          </Stack>
          <IconButton size="small" onClick={handleClose}><CloseIcon /></IconButton>
        </Stack>
      </DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent dividers>
        <Stack spacing={3}>
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
            Nhập mã số sinh viên và đưa khuôn mặt vào camera để xác minh độc giả đang ở trong thư viện.
          </Typography>

          <TextField
            label="Mã số sinh viên"
            value={studentCode}
            onChange={(e) => setStudentCode(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="VD: B21DCCN001"
            fullWidth
            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { sx: { fontFamily: "monospace" } } }}
          />

          <Box
            sx={{
              position: "relative",
              aspectRatio: "4/3",
              bgcolor: "black",
              borderRadius: 1,
              overflow: "hidden",
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
            }}
          >
            {!streamRef.current ? (
              <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", color: "grey.300", p: 3 }}>
                <CameraAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48 }} />
                <Button variant="outlined" onClick={handleOpen} startIcon={<CameraAltIcon />}>
                  Bật camera
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Box
                  component="video"
                  ref={videoRef}
                  autoPlay
                  playsInline
                  muted
                  sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "contain", transform: "scaleX(-1)" }}
                />
                {!cameraReady && (
                  <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1}>
                    <CircularProgress size={26} color="inherit" />
                    <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
                  </Stack>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </Box>

          {error && (
            <Box sx={{ p: 1.5, bgcolor: "error.50", borderRadius: 1, border: 1, borderColor: "error.main" }}>
              <Typography color="error" variant="body2">{error}</Typography>
            </Box>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={handleClose} disabled={verifying}>Hủy</Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          disabled={verifying || !studentCode.trim() || !streamRef.current}
          onClick={captureAndVerify}
          startIcon={verifying ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <CameraAltIcon />}
        >
          {verifying ? "Đang xác minh..." : "Chụp & Xác minh"}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Suspense, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { Canvas, useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { Box } from "@mui/material";
function Particles() {
  const pointsRef = useRef<THREE.Points>(null);

  // Create 1500 particles with random positions
  const [positions, colors] = useMemo(() => {
    const particleCount = 1500;
    const pos = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
    const col = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
    
    // Primary colors of the IUH brand (Blue, Light Blue, White)
    const colorPalette = [
      new THREE.Color(0x1976d2), // MUI Primary Blue
      new THREE.Color(0x42a5f5), // MUI Light Blue
      new THREE.Color(0xffffff), // White
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      // Position them in a large sphere around the camera
      const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
      const theta = Math.random() * 2 * Math.PI;
      const phi = Math.acos((Math.random() * 2) - 1);

      pos[i * 3] = radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
      pos[i * 3 + 1] = radius * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
      pos[i * 3 + 2] = radius * Math.cos(phi);

      const color = colorPalette[Math.floor(Math.random() * colorPalette.length)];
      col[i * 3] = color.r;
      col[i * 3 + 1] = color.g;
      col[i * 3 + 2] = color.b;
    }
    
    return [pos, col];
  }, []);

  useFrame((state, delta) => {
    if (pointsRef.current) {
      pointsRef.current.rotation.y += delta * 0.05;
      pointsRef.current.rotation.x += delta * 0.02;
    }
  });

  return (
    <points ref={pointsRef}>
      <bufferGeometry>
        <bufferAttribute
          attach="attributes-position"
          args={[positions, 3]}
        />
        <bufferAttribute
          attach="attributes-color"
          args={[colors, 3]}
        />
      </bufferGeometry>
      <pointsMaterial
        size={0.15}
        vertexColors
        transparent
        opacity={0.8}
        sizeAttenuation
        blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
      />
    </points>
  );
}

function Scene() {
  return (
    <Box 
      sx={{ 
        position: "fixed", 
        top: 0, 
        left: 0, 
        width: "100vw", 
        height: "100vh", 
        zIndex: -1,
        background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e1e2f 100%)",
        pointerEvents: "none"
      }}
    >
      <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 0, 15], fov: 60 }} dpr={[1, 2]}>
        <fog attach="fog" args={['#0f172a', 10, 30]} />
        <Particles />
      </Canvas>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function LoginBackground3D() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={
      <Box sx={{ width: "100vw", height: "100vh", bgcolor: "#0f172a" }} />
    }>
      <Scene />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";

export interface AutoScheduleState {
  showAutoSchedule: boolean;
  setShowAutoSchedule: (v: boolean) => void;
  autoStep: "select" | "preview";
  autoProposals: any[];
  autoSkipped: number;
  autoActualRange: { from: string; to: string } | null;
  autoLoading: boolean;
  handleAutoSchedule: (from: string, to: string) => Promise<void>;
  handleAutoScheduleConfirm: (selected?: any[]) => Promise<void>;
  setError: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>;
}

export function useAutoSchedule(
  loadData: () => Promise<void>,
  setError: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>,
): AutoScheduleState {
  const [showAutoSchedule, setShowAutoSchedule] = useState(false);
  const [autoLoading, setAutoLoading] = useState(false);
  const [autoStep, setAutoStep] = useState<"select" | "preview">("select");
  const [autoProposals, setAutoProposals] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [autoSkipped, setAutoSkipped] = useState(0);
  const [autoActualRange, setAutoActualRange] = useState<{ from: string; to: string } | null>(null);

  const handleAutoSchedule = useCallback(async (autoFrom: string, autoTo: string) => {
    setAutoLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await api.autoSchedule({ from: autoFrom, to: autoTo });
      const count = result.proposed?.length || 0;
      setAutoActualRange(
        result.actualFrom && result.actualTo ? { from: result.actualFrom, to: result.actualTo } : null,
      );
      if (count === 0) {
        setAutoProposals([]);
        setAutoSkipped(result.skipped || 0);
        setAutoStep("preview");
        setAutoLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setAutoProposals(result.proposed);
      setAutoSkipped(result.skipped || 0);
      setAutoStep("preview");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    }
    setAutoLoading(false);
  }, [setError]);

  const handleAutoScheduleConfirm = useCallback(async (selected?: any[]) => {
    setAutoLoading(true);
    try {
      const items = selected && selected.length > 0 ? selected : autoProposals;
      await api.createScheduleAssignmentsBulk(items);
      await loadData();
      setShowAutoSchedule(false);
      setAutoStep("select");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    }
    setAutoLoading(false);
  }, [autoProposals, loadData, setError]);

  return {
    showAutoSchedule, setShowAutoSchedule,
    autoStep, autoProposals, autoSkipped, autoActualRange, autoLoading,
    handleAutoSchedule, handleAutoScheduleConfirm, setError,
  };
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { ManualCheckInRequest } from "@/lib/types";

export interface PendingCounts {
  pendingManualCount: number;
}

export function usePendingCounts(isAdmin: boolean, loading: boolean): PendingCounts {
  const [pendingManualCount, setPendingManualCount] = useState(0);

  const loadCounts = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    try {
      const manuals = await api.listManualCheckInRequests().catch(() => []);
      setPendingManualCount(
        (manuals as ManualCheckInRequest[]).filter((m) => m.status === "pending_manual").length,
      );
    } catch {}
  }, [isAdmin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCounts();
    const interval = setInterval(loadCounts, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [loadCounts, loading]);

  return { pendingManualCount };
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { LibraryZone, ScheduleStaff, StaffScheduleAssignment, StaffShift } from "@/lib/types";

export interface ScheduleFilters {
  filter: string;
  zoneFilter: string;
  shiftFilter: string;
  setFilter: (v: string) => void;
  setZoneFilter: (v: string) => void;
  setShiftFilter: (v: string) => void;
  shiftList: StaffShift[];
  filteredAssignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  filteredShifts: StaffShift[];
  weekStats: { total: number; active: number; staffCount: number };
}

export function useScheduleFilters(
  assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[],
  shifts: StaffShift[],
  staff: ScheduleStaff[],
  zones: LibraryZone[],
): ScheduleFilters {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
  const [zoneFilter, setZoneFilter] = useState("");
  const [shiftFilter, setShiftFilter] = useState("");

  const shiftList = useMemo(() => {
    return [...shifts].sort((a, b) => (a.startTime || "").localeCompare(b.startTime || ""));
  }, [shifts]);

  const filteredAssignments = useMemo(() => {
    return assignments.filter((a) => {
      if (zoneFilter && a.zoneId !== zoneFilter) return false;
      if (shiftFilter && a.shiftId !== shiftFilter) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [assignments, zoneFilter, shiftFilter]);

  const filteredShifts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!shiftFilter) return shiftList;
    return shiftList.filter((s) => s.id === shiftFilter);
  }, [shiftList, shiftFilter]);

  const weekStats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = assignments.filter((a) => a.status !== "cancelled").length;
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const active = assignments.filter((a) => a.status !== "cancelled" && a.workDate === today).length;
    return { total, active, staffCount: staff.length };
  }, [assignments, staff]);

  return {
    filter, zoneFilter, shiftFilter,
    setFilter, setZoneFilter, setShiftFilter,
    shiftList, filteredAssignments, filteredShifts, weekStats,
  };
}

/**
 * Image Preprocessing Utility
 * 
 * Uses Web Worker for off-main-thread image processing.
 * Falls back to canvas-based processing if Web Worker is not available.
 */

interface PreprocessResult {
  blob: Blob;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  originalSize: number;
  processedSize: number;
  brightness: number;
}

interface PreprocessOptions {
  maxWidth?: number;
  maxHeight?: number;
  quality?: number;
  convertToGrayscale?: boolean;
  brightnessThreshold?: number;
}

const DEFAULT_OPTIONS: PreprocessOptions = {
  maxWidth: 640,
  maxHeight: 480,
  quality: 0.85,
  convertToGrayscale: false,
  brightnessThreshold: 50,
};

let worker: Worker | null = null;
let workerSupported = typeof Worker !== 'undefined';

function getWorker(): Worker | null {
  if (!workerSupported) return null;
  
  if (!worker) {
    try {
      worker = new Worker(
        new URL('../workers/image-preprocessor.worker.ts', import.meta.url),
        { type: 'module' }
      );
    } catch {
      workerSupported = false;
      return null;
    }
  }
  
  return worker;
}

async function preprocessWithWorker(
  image: Blob,
  options: PreprocessOptions
): Promise<PreprocessResult> {
  const worker = getWorker();
  
  if (!worker) {
    return fallbackPreprocess(image, options);
  }
  
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      reject(new Error('Web Worker timeout'));
    }, 5000);
    
    const handler = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      worker!.removeEventListener('message', handler);
      
      if (e.data.error) {
        reject(new Error(e.data.error));
      } else {
        resolve(e.data);
      }
    };
    
    worker.addEventListener('message', handler);
    worker.postMessage({
      image,
      maxWidth: options.maxWidth,
      maxHeight: options.maxHeight,
      quality: options.quality,
      convertToGrayscale: options.convertToGrayscale,
    });
  });
}

async function fallbackPreprocess(
  image: Blob,
  options: PreprocessOptions
): Promise<PreprocessResult> {
  const {
    maxWidth = 640,
    maxHeight = 480,
    quality = 0.7,
    convertToGrayscale = true,
  } = options;

  const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(image);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error('Failed to get canvas context');
  }

  const scale = Math.min(maxWidth / bitmap.width, maxHeight / bitmap.height, 1);
  const newWidth = Math.round(bitmap.width * scale);
  const newHeight = Math.round(bitmap.height * scale);
  
  canvas.width = newWidth;
  canvas.height = newHeight;
  
  ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, newWidth, newHeight);
  bitmap.close();

  const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, newWidth, newHeight);
  const data = imageData.data;

  let totalBrightness = 0;
  const pixelCount = newWidth * newHeight;

  if (convertToGrayscale) {
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
      const r = data[i];
      const g = data[i + 1];
      const b = data[i + 2];
      const gray = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;
      
      totalBrightness += gray;
      
      data[i] = gray;
      data[i + 1] = gray;
      data[i + 2] = gray;
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
      const r = data[i];
      const g = data[i + 1];
      const b = data[i + 2];
      totalBrightness += 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;
    }
  }

  const avgBrightness = totalBrightness / pixelCount;

  ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);

  const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve) => {
    canvas.toBlob(
      (b) => resolve(b!),
      'image/jpeg',
      quality
    );
  });

  return {
    blob,
    width: newWidth,
    height: newHeight,
    originalSize: image.size,
    processedSize: blob.size,
    brightness: avgBrightness,
  };
}

export async function preprocessImage(
  file: File,
  options: PreprocessOptions = {}
): Promise<PreprocessResult> {
  const mergedOptions = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
  
  const blob = new Blob([await file.arrayBuffer()], { type: file.type });
  
  try {
    return await preprocessWithWorker(blob, mergedOptions);
  } catch {
    return fallbackPreprocess(blob, mergedOptions);
  }
}

export function isImageTooDark(brightness: number, threshold: number = 50): boolean {
  return brightness < threshold;
}

export function getImageSizeReduction(original: number, processed: number): number {
  return Math.round((1 - processed / original) * 100);
}

/**
 * Shared utility functions for the design system.
 */

/** Extract initials from a name (max 2 characters). */
export function initials(name: string): string {
  if (!name) return "?";
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  return (parts[0].charAt(0) + parts[parts.length - 1].charAt(0)).toUpperCase();
}

/** Format date as DD/MM/YYYY. */
export function formatDate(date: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (date == null) return "-";
  const d = typeof date === "string" ? new Date(date) : date;
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "-";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" });
}

/** Format datetime as DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm. */
export function formatDateTime(date: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (date == null) return "-";
  const d = typeof date === "string" ? new Date(date) : date;
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "-";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

/** Format time as HH:mm. */
export function formatTime(date: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (date == null) return "-";
  const d = typeof date === "string" ? new Date(date) : date;
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "-";
  return d.toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}

/** Truncate a string to a given length with ellipsis. */
export function truncate(str: string, length: number): string {
  if (!str || str.length <= length) return str;
  return str.slice(0, length) + "...";
}

/** Generate a color from a string (for avatars). */
export function stringToColor(str: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = str.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  const hue = Math.abs(hash) % 360;
  return `hsl(${hue}, 55%, 45%)`;
}

================
File: src/workers/image-preprocessor.worker.ts
================
/**
 * Image Preprocessing Web Worker
 * 
 * Handles image resizing, grayscale conversion, and WebP compression
 * off the main thread to prevent UI blocking.
 */

interface PreprocessMessage {
  image: Blob;
  maxWidth?: number;
  maxHeight?: number;
  quality?: number;
  convertToGrayscale?: boolean;
}

interface PreprocessResult {
  blob: Blob;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  originalSize: number;
  processedSize: number;
  brightness: number;
}

self.onmessage = async (e: MessageEvent<PreprocessMessage>) => {
  const {
    image,
    maxWidth = 640,
    maxHeight = 480,
    quality = 0.85,
    convertToGrayscale = false,
  } = e.data;

  try {
    const originalSize = image.size;
    
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(image);
    const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(maxWidth, maxHeight);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    if (!ctx) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get canvas context');
    }

    const scale = Math.min(maxWidth / bitmap.width, maxHeight / bitmap.height, 1);
    const newWidth = Math.round(bitmap.width * scale);
    const newHeight = Math.round(bitmap.height * scale);
    
    canvas.width = newWidth;
    canvas.height = newHeight;
    
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, newWidth, newHeight);
    bitmap.close();

    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, newWidth, newHeight);
    const data = imageData.data;

    let totalBrightness = 0;
    const pixelCount = newWidth * newHeight;

    if (convertToGrayscale) {
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
        const r = data[i];
        const g = data[i + 1];
        const b = data[i + 2];
        const gray = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;
        
        totalBrightness += gray;
        
        data[i] = gray;
        data[i + 1] = gray;
        data[i + 2] = gray;
      }
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
        const r = data[i];
        const g = data[i + 1];
        const b = data[i + 2];
        totalBrightness += 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;
      }
    }

    const avgBrightness = totalBrightness / pixelCount;

    ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);

    const blob = await canvas.convertToBlob({
      type: 'image/jpeg',
      quality,
    });

    const result: PreprocessResult = {
      blob,
      width: newWidth,
      height: newHeight,
      originalSize,
      processedSize: blob.size,
      brightness: avgBrightness,
    };

    self.postMessage(result);
  } catch (error) {
    self.postMessage({
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
    });
  }
};

import React from "react";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";

  const mockApi = {
    borrowBook: jest.fn(),
    staffReturnBook: jest.fn(),
    getBorrowHistory: jest.fn(),
    lookupBorrowByBarcode: jest.fn(),
  };
  return {
    ...original,
    __esModule: true,
    default: mockApi,
    api: mockApi,
  };
});

const mockApi = apiClient.api as jest.Mocked<typeof apiClient.api>;

describe("Borrow API client", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("borrowBook calls correct endpoint", async () => {
    mockApi.borrowBook.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      status: "success",
      message: "Mượn sách thành công",
      record: { id: "rec-1", status: "borrowed" } as any,
      book: { id: "book-1", isbn: "123", title: "Test" } as any,
    });

    const result = await apiClient.api.borrowBook("LIB-123-001");
    expect(mockApi.borrowBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith("LIB-123-001");
    expect(result.status).toBe("success");
  });

  it("staffReturnBook calls correct endpoint", async () => {
    mockApi.staffReturnBook.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      status: "success",
      message: "Trả sách thành công",
      record: { id: "rec-1", status: "returned" } as any,
    });

    const result = await apiClient.api.staffReturnBook("LIB-123-001");
    expect(mockApi.staffReturnBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith("LIB-123-001");
    expect(result.status).toBe("success");
  });

  it("getBorrowHistory returns records", async () => {
    mockApi.getBorrowHistory.mockResolvedValueOnce([
      { id: "rec-1", status: "borrowed" } as any,
      { id: "rec-2", status: "returned" } as any,
    ]);

    const result = await apiClient.api.getBorrowHistory({ statusFilter: "borrowed" });
    expect(mockApi.getBorrowHistory).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ statusFilter: "borrowed" });
    expect(result).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("lookupBorrowByBarcode returns null on error", async () => {
    mockApi.lookupBorrowByBarcode.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("Not found"));

    const result = await apiClient.api.lookupBorrowByBarcode("NONEXISTENT").catch(() => null);
    expect(result).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("getErrorMessage", () => {
  it("returns detail from response", () => {
    const err = { response: { data: { detail: "Sách không tồn tại" } } };
    expect(apiClient.getErrorMessage(err)).toBe("Sách không tồn tại");
  });

  it("returns message for generic errors", () => {
    const err = new Error("Network error");
    expect(apiClient.getErrorMessage(err)).toBe("Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng và thử lại.");
  });

  it("returns Unknown error for null", () => {
    expect(apiClient.getErrorMessage(null)).toBe("Đã xảy ra lỗi không xác định. Vui lòng thử lại.");
  });
});

export function BorrowStepConfirm({

                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main" }}>
                    {borrowDateStr}
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>
                <Grid size={{ xs: 6 }}>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Hạn trả quy định (+14 ngày):</Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "error.main" }}>
                    {dueDateStr}
                  </Typography>
                </Grid>
              </Grid>
            </Paper>

            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
              Danh sách {cartItems.length} cuốn sách sẽ mượn:
            </Typography>

            <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ maxHeight: 260, overflowY: "auto" }}>

                    borderColor: "divider",
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",

                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "text.secondary", width: 24 }}>
                    #{idx + 1}
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} noWrap>
                      {item.book?.title || item.isbn}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                      Mã bản sao: {item.copy_barcode || item.barcode} • Kệ: {item.shelf_location || "Chung"}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    {item.condition ? (
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        label={CONDITION_LABELS[item.condition as CopyCondition] || item.condition}
                        color={getConditionColor(item.condition)}
                        variant="outlined"
                        sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                    <Chip size="small" color="success" variant="outlined" label="Hợp lệ" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }} />
                  </Stack>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
        </DashboardCard>
      </Grid>

      {/* Right Column: Regulations & Confirm Action */}
      <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 5 }} sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
        <DashboardCard title="Quy định & Hoàn tất" actions={<CheckCircleIcon color="success" />}>
