              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ display: "block", mt: 0.5 }}>
                • Thời hạn mượn sách tiêu chuẩn: <strong>{standardBorrowDays} ngày</strong>.<br />
                • Phí phạt quá hạn: <strong>{finePerDayStr} đ/ngày/cuốn</strong>.<br />
                • Độc giả có trách nhiệm bảo quản sách nguyên vẹn khi hoàn trả.
              </Typography>
            </Alert>

            <Tooltip title={!canCreateBorrow ? getPermissionDeniedReason("borrows", "create") : ""}>
              <span style={{ width: "100%" }}>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  size="large"
                  fullWidth
                  disabled={creatingSlip || cartItems.length === 0 || !canCreateBorrow}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!canCreateBorrow) return;
                    handleConfirmBorrowSlip();
                  }}
                  sx={{
                    py: 1.6,
                    borderRadius: "4px",
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    fontSize: "1.05rem",
                    textTransform: "none",
                  }}
                >
                  {creatingSlip ? (
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <CircularProgress size={22} color="inherit" />
                      <span>Đang tạo phiếu mượn...</span>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : (
                    `Xác nhận tạo phiếu (${cartItems.length} cuốn)`
                  )}
                </Button>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>

            <Button
              variant="outlined"
              fullWidth
              startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
              onClick={() => setCurrentStep(1)}
              disabled={creatingSlip}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: "4px" }}
            >
              Quay lại chọn thêm sách
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </DashboardCard>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  Legend,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  ButtonGroup,
  Chip,
  Stack,
  Typography,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import TrendingUpIcon from "@mui/icons-material/TrendingUpOutlined";
import BarChartIcon from "@mui/icons-material/BarChartOutlined";
import ShowChartIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ShowChartOutlined";
import ClockIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ScheduleOutlined";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import type { AccessLogPublic } from "@/lib/types";

interface HourlyActivityChartProps {
  logs: AccessLogPublic[];
  loading: boolean;
}

type ChartViewType = "area" | "bar";

function CustomChartTooltip({ active, payload, label, theme }: any) {
  if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;

  const entryVal = payload.find((p: any) => p.dataKey === "entry")?.value || 0;
  const exitVal = payload.find((p: any) => p.dataKey === "exit")?.value || 0;
  const total = entryVal + exitVal;

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        p: 1.5,
        borderRadius: 2,
        bgcolor: theme.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)" : "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)",
        backdropFilter: "blur(12px)",
        border: "1px solid",
        borderColor: "divider",
        boxShadow: "0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
        minWidth: 160,
      }}
    >
      <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "text.secondary", display: "block", mb: 1 }}>
        ⏰ {label}:00 — {label}:59
      </Typography>
      <Stack spacing={0.75}>
        <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "#10b981" }} />
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", color: "text.primary" }}>Lượt vào</Typography>
          </Stack>
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#10b981" }}>{entryVal}</Typography>
        </Stack>
        <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "#f59e0b" }} />
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", color: "text.primary" }}>Lượt ra</Typography>
          </Stack>
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#f59e0b" }}>{exitVal}</Typography>
        </Stack>
        <Box sx={{ pt: 0.75, mt: 0.5, borderTop: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "text.secondary" }}>Tổng lượt:</Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "primary.main" }}>{total}</Typography>
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function HourlyActivityChart({ logs, loading }: HourlyActivityChartProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState<ChartViewType>("area");

  const hourlyData = useMemo(() => {
    const buckets = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, hour) => ({ hour, entry: 0, exit: 0, total: 0 }));
    logs.forEach((log) => {
      const hour = new Date(log.access_time).getHours();
      if (hour >= 0 && hour < 24) {
        if (log.access_type === "entry") buckets[hour].entry += 1;
        if (log.access_type === "exit") buckets[hour].exit += 1;
        buckets[hour].total += 1;
      }
    });
    return buckets;
  }, [logs]);

  const peakHour = useMemo(() => {
    let max = { hour: 0, total: 0 };
    hourlyData.forEach((d) => {
      if (d.total > max.total) max = { hour: d.hour, total: d.total };
    });
    return max;
  }, [hourlyData]);

  const hasData = hourlyData.some((item) => item.total > 0);

  return (
    <DashboardCard
      title="Hoạt động theo giờ"
      subtitle="Phân bổ lưu lượng ra/vào hôm nay"
      actions={
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          {hasData && peakHour.total > 0 && (
            <Chip
              icon={<TrendingUpIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />}
              label={`Cao điểm: ${peakHour.hour}h (${peakHour.total} lượt)`}
              size="small"
              sx={{
                bgcolor: theme.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15)" : "rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1)",
                color: "primary.main",
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: "0.72rem",
                display: { xs: "none", sm: "flex" },
              }}
            />
          )}
          <ButtonGroup size="small" variant="outlined">
            <Button
              variant={chartType === "area" ? "contained" : "outlined"}
              onClick={() => setChartType("area")}
              sx={{ px: 1, minWidth: 32 }}
              title="Biểu đồ miền"
            >
              <ShowChartIcon fontSize="small" />
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={chartType === "bar" ? "contained" : "outlined"}
              onClick={() => setChartType("bar")}
              sx={{ px: 1, minWidth: 32 }}
              title="Biểu đồ cột"
            >
              <BarChartIcon fontSize="small" />
            </Button>
          </ButtonGroup>
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      {!hasData ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<ClockIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
          title="Chưa có lượt ra/vào hôm nay"
        />
      ) : (
        <Box sx={{ height: 250, width: "100%", minWidth: 0, px: 0.5, pt: 1 }}>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth={0} minHeight={200}>
            {chartType === "area" ? (
              <AreaChart data={hourlyData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="entryGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#10b981" stopOpacity={0.45} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10b981" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                  </linearGradient>
                  <linearGradient id="exitGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#f59e0b" stopOpacity={0.45} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#f59e0b" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={theme.palette.divider} vertical={false} opacity={0.6} />
                <XAxis
                  dataKey="hour"
                  tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }}
                  tickFormatter={(hour) => `${hour}h`}
                  interval={2}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: theme.palette.divider }}
                />
                <YAxis
                  allowDecimals={false}
                  tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: theme.palette.divider }}
                />
                <Tooltip content={<CustomChartTooltip theme={theme} />} />
                <Legend
                  wrapperStyle={{ color: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 12, paddingTop: 6 }}
                  iconType="circle"
                />
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="entry"
                  name="Lượt vào"
                  stroke="#10b981"
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                  fillOpacity={1}
                  fill="url(#entryGradient)"
                  activeDot={{ r: 5, stroke: "#10b981", strokeWidth: 2, fill: "#fff" }}
                />
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="exit"
                  name="Lượt ra"
                  stroke="#f59e0b"
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                  fillOpacity={1}
                  fill="url(#exitGradient)"
                  activeDot={{ r: 5, stroke: "#f59e0b", strokeWidth: 2, fill: "#fff" }}
                />
              </AreaChart>
            ) : (
              <BarChart data={hourlyData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={theme.palette.divider} vertical={false} opacity={0.6} />
                <XAxis
                  dataKey="hour"
                  tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }}
                  tickFormatter={(hour) => `${hour}h`}
                  interval={2}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: theme.palette.divider }}
                />
                <YAxis
                  allowDecimals={false}
                  tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: theme.palette.divider }}
                />
                <Tooltip content={<CustomChartTooltip theme={theme} />} />
                <Legend
                  wrapperStyle={{ color: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 12, paddingTop: 6 }}
                  iconType="circle"
                />
                <Bar dataKey="entry" name="Lượt vào" fill="#10b981" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} maxBarSize={24} />
                <Bar dataKey="exit" name="Lượt ra" fill="#f59e0b" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} maxBarSize={24} />
              </BarChart>
            )}
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </Box>
      )}
    </DashboardCard>
  );
}

import {

  ALL_ROUTES,

  ACTION_LABELS,
  CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type EffectivePermissions,

  type SystemRoute,
} from "@/lib/types";

export interface EffectiveInspectorTabProps {
  effectivePermissionsPreview: EffectivePermissions;
  setToast: (toast: { open: boolean; message: string; severity: "success" | "error" | "info" }) => void;
}

export function EffectiveInspectorTab({
  effectivePermissionsPreview,
  setToast,
}: EffectiveInspectorTabProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [showJson, setShowJson] = useState(false);

  const jsonString = JSON.stringify(effectivePermissionsPreview, null, 2);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(jsonString);
    setCopied(true);
    setToast({
      open: true,
      message: "Đã sao chép cấu hình quyền vào bộ nhớ tạm!",
      severity: "success",
    });
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const getRouteLabel = (path: string) => {
    const found = ALL_ROUTES.find((r) => r.path === path);
    return found ? found.label : path;
  };

  // Group allowed routes by category
  const allowedRoutesByCategory = React.useMemo(() => {
    const map: Partial<Record<RouteCategory, string[]>> = {};
    const allowedSet = new Set(effectivePermissionsPreview.allowedPages);
    ALL_ROUTES.forEach((r) => {
      if (allowedSet.has(r.path)) {
        const cat = r.category || "library";
        if (!map[cat]) map[cat] = [];
        map[cat]!.push(r.path);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [effectivePermissionsPreview.allowedPages]);

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2.5}>
      {/* ── TOP BANNER: Nhân viên đang kiểm tra & Trạng thái ─────────────────── */}
      <Paper
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          p: 2.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          borderColor: "divider",
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: { xs: "column", sm: "row" },
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", sm: "center" },
          gap: 2,
        }}
      >
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.success.main, 0.1),
              color: theme.palette.success.main,
              display: "grid",
              placeItems: "center",
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            <VerifiedUserOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24 }} />
          </Box>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
              Bản Tóm Tắt Quyền Hạn Đang Áp Dụng
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontSize: "0.84rem" }}>
              Tổng hợp quyền thực tế nhân viên có thể sử dụng khi đăng nhập vào hệ thống
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>

        <Chip
          icon={effectivePermissionsPreview.isCustom ? <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon /> : undefined}
          label={
            effectivePermissionsPreview.isCustom
              ? "Đang dùng thiết lập đặc quyền riêng"
              : "Đang dùng bộ quyền chuẩn theo chức vụ"
          }
          color={effectivePermissionsPreview.isCustom ? "primary" : "default"}
          sx={{ fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: 1, py: 0.5 }}
        />
      </Paper>

      {/* ── 2 COLUMN SUMMARY: Quyền mở màn hình & Quyền thao tác dữ liệu ─────── */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", lg: "1fr 1.15fr" },
          gap: 2.5,
        }}
      >
        {/* Left: Danh sách màn hình được phép mở */}
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            p: 2.5,
            borderRadius: 2,
            borderColor: "divider",
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",

            </Typography>
          </Box>

          <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ maxHeight: 420, overflowY: "auto", pr: 0.5 }}>
            {(Object.keys(allowedRoutesByCategory) as RouteCategory[]).map((cat) => {
              const paths = allowedRoutesByCategory[cat] || [];
              if (paths.length === 0) return null;

              return (
                <Box key={cat}>
                  <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "primary.main", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, display: "block", mb: 0.75 }}>
                    {CATEGORY_LABELS[cat]} ({paths.length})
                  </Typography>
                  <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.75 }}>
                    {paths.map((path) => (
                      <Chip
                        key={path}
                        label={getRouteLabel(path)}
                        size="small"
                        icon={<CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />}
                        sx={{
                          fontWeight: 600,
                          fontSize: "0.78rem",
                          borderRadius: 1,
                          bgcolor: alpha("#059669", 0.08),
                          color: "#059669",
                          border: "1px solid",
                          borderColor: alpha("#059669", 0.2),
                        }}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              );
            })}

            {effectivePermissionsPreview.allowedPages.length === 0 && (
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", py: 2, textAlign: "center" }}>
                Nhân viên hiện không được mở màn hình nào.
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Stack>
        </Paper>

        {/* Right: Bảng thao tác nghiệp vụ (6 Actions) */}
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            borderRadius: 2,
            borderColor: "divider",
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
            overflow: "hidden",
          }}
        >
          <Box
            sx={{
              px: 2.5,
              py: 1.75,
              borderBottom: 1,
              borderColor: "divider",
              bgcolor: isDark ? "background.default" : "#F8FAFC",
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: "0.92rem" }}>
              Quyền thao tác nghiệp vụ thư viện (Chi tiết 6 hành động)
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              Chi tiết các tác vụ được phép thực hiện trên từng phân hệ sách & bạn đọc
            </Typography>
          </Box>

          <TableContainer sx={{ maxHeight: 420 }}>
            <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
              <TableHead>
                <TableRow sx={{ bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.02) : "#F1F5F9" }}>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "25%" }}>Phân hệ</TableCell>
                  {ALL_ACTIONS.map((act) => (
                    <TableCell key={act} align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "12.5%" }}>
                      {ACTION_LABELS[act] || act}
                    </TableCell>
                  ))}
                </TableRow>
              </TableHead>
              <TableBody>
                {ALL_RESOURCES.map((res) => {
                  const perms = effectivePermissionsPreview.crud?.[res] || {
                    read: false,
                    create: false,
                    update: false,
                    delete: false,
                    approve: false,
                    print: false,
                  };

                  return (
                    <TableRow key={res} hover>
                      <TableCell sx={{ py: 1.1 }}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>
                          {RESOURCE_LABELS[res] || res}
                        </Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      {ALL_ACTIONS.map((act) => {
                        const isGranted = Boolean(perms[act]);
                        return (
                          <TableCell key={act} align="center" sx={{ py: 1 }}>
                            {isGranted ? (
                              <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#059669" }} />
                            ) : (
                              <CancelOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: isDark ? "#475569" : "#CBD5E1" }} />
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                        );
                      })}
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </TableContainer>
        </Paper>
      </Box>

      {/* ── BOTTOM: Tùy chọn xem dữ liệu kỹ thuật (Ẩn mặc định cho thủ thư) ──── */}
      <Box sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          startIcon={showJson ? <ExpandLessIcon /> : <ExpandMoreIcon />}
          onClick={() => setShowJson(!showJson)}
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", color: "text.secondary", fontSize: "0.82rem", fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          {showJson ? "Ẩn cấu hình kỹ thuật (JSON)" : "Xem chi tiết cấu hình kỹ thuật (Dành cho Quản trị viên IT)"}
        </Button>

        <Collapse in={showJson}>
          <Paper
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{
              mt: 1.5,
              borderRadius: 2,
              borderColor: "divider",
              bgcolor: isDark ? "#0A0D14" : "#1E293B",
              color: "#E2E8F0",
              overflow: "hidden",
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                p: 1.5,
                px: 2,
                borderBottom: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
              }}
            >
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <CodeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "primary.light" }} />
                <Typography sx={{ fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace", fontSize: "0.8rem", fontWeight: 700, color: "#94A3B8" }}>
                  runtime_payload.json
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
              <Button
                size="small"
                startIcon={copied ? <Check sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} /> : <ContentCopyIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                onClick={handleCopy}
                sx={{
                  color: copied ? "#10B981" : "#E2E8F0",
                  textTransform: "none",
                  fontSize: "0.75rem",
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
                  "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" },
                }}
              >
                {copied ? "Đã chép" : "Sao chép cấu hình"}
              </Button>
            </Box>

            <Box
              component="pre"
              sx={{
                p: 2,
                m: 0,
                maxHeight: 280,
                overflow: "auto",
                fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace",
                fontSize: "0.78rem",
                lineHeight: 1.6,
                color: "#38BDF8",
              }}
            >
              {jsonString}
            </Box>
          </Paper>
        </Collapse>
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  );
}
export default EffectiveInspectorTab;

                Điều khiển 6 hành động (Xem, Thêm, Sửa, Duyệt, In, Xóa) cho 7 phân hệ dữ liệu lõi — chi phối toàn bộ 21 màn hình của thư viện.

          <TableContainer>

                  <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "8.5%", py: 1.25 }}>Xem</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "8.5%", py: 1.25 }}>Thêm</TableCell>

                size="small"

                  bgcolor: "background.paper",
                  borderRadius: 1.5,

                    size="small"
                    variant="outlined"
                    color="inherit"

                  <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "22%", py: 1.25 }}>Trạng thái mở</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHead>
              <TableBody>
                {CATEGORY_ORDER.map((category) => {
                  const routesInCat = filteredRoutes.filter((r) => r.category === category);

                              sx={{
                                height: 18,
                                fontSize: "0.65rem",
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                bgcolor: allowedInCat > 0 ? alpha("#059669", 0.12) : alpha("#64748B", 0.12),
                                color: allowedInCat > 0 ? "#059669" : "text.secondary",
                              }}
                            />
                          </Stack>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell align="center" sx={{ py: 1 }}>
                          {!isAdmin && handleToggleCategoryRoutesForRole && (
                            <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ justifyContent: "center" }}>
                              <Button
                                size="small"
                                variant="text"
                                onClick={() => handleToggleCategoryRoutesForRole(category, true)}
                                sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", py: 0.1, px: 0.75, minWidth: 0, textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
                              >
                                Mở cả nhóm
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                size="small"
                                variant="text"
                                color="inherit"
                                onClick={() => handleToggleCategoryRoutesForRole(category, false)}
                                sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", py: 0.1, px: 0.75, minWidth: 0, textTransform: "none", color: "text.secondary" }}
                              >
                                Khóa nhóm
                              </Button>
                            </Stack>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>

                      {/* Routes inside Category */}
                      {routesInCat.map((route) => {
                        const isAllowed =
                          isAdmin || (activeRoleConfig.allowedPages || []).includes(route.path);
                        const isDashboard = route.path === "/dashboard";

                        return (
                          <TableRow
                            key={route.path}
                            hover
                            sx={{
                              "&:last-child td, &:last-child th": { border: 0 },
                            }}
                          >
                            <TableCell sx={{ py: 1.1, pl: 3.5 }}>
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.84rem", color: "text.primary" }}>
                                {route.label}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontSize: "0.7rem" }}>
                                {route.path}
                              </Typography>
                            </TableCell>
                            <TableCell sx={{ py: 1.1 }}>
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontSize: "0.78rem" }}>
                                {route.area}
                              </Typography>
                            </TableCell>
                            <TableCell align="center" sx={{ py: 1.1 }}>
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                                <Chip
                                  size="small"
                                  label={isAllowed ? "Đang mở" : "Đã khóa"}
                                  sx={{
                                    height: 20,
                                    fontSize: "0.68rem",
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    borderRadius: 1,
                                    bgcolor: isAllowed ? alpha("#059669", 0.12) : alpha("#64748B", 0.1),
                                    color: isAllowed ? "#059669" : "#64748B",
                                  }}
                                />
                                <Switch
                                  size="small"
                                  checked={isAllowed}
                                  disabled={isAdmin || isDashboard}
                                  onChange={() => handleToggleRouteForRole(route.path)}
                                  color="primary"
                                />
                              </Stack>
                            </TableCell>
                          </TableRow>
                        );
                      })}
                    </React.Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </TableContainer>
        </Paper>

        {/* ── BOTTOM SAVE BAR FOR ROLE CONFIG ────────────────────────────── */}
        {!isAdmin && handleSaveRoleConfig && (
          <Paper
            elevation={2}
            sx={{
              p: 2,
              borderRadius: 2,
              borderColor: "divider",
              bgcolor: isDark ? "background.paper" : "#FFFFFF",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: { xs: "column", sm: "row" },
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", sm: "center" },
              gap: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                Lưu cấu hình phân quyền cho chức vụ [{activeRoleConfig.label}]
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                Lưu ý: Quyền hạn được lưu ở đây sẽ áp dụng cho TẤT CẢ nhân viên mang chức vụ &quot;{activeRoleConfig.label}&quot; (trừ những cá nhân được cấp quyền riêng ở Tab 2).
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              size="medium"
              startIcon={saving ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={handleSaveRoleConfig}
              disabled={saving}
              sx={{
                borderRadius: 1.5,
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 700,
                px: 3,
                whiteSpace: "nowrap",
              }}
            >
              {saving ? "Đang lưu..." : `Lưu quyền [${activeRoleConfig.label}]`}
            </Button>
          </Paper>
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  MenuItem,
  Paper,
  Select,
  Stack,
  Switch,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  ToggleButton,
  ToggleButtonGroup,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
  alpha,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import RestartAltOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RestartAltOutlined";
import PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlineOutlined";
import SaveOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SaveOutlined";
import InfoOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/InfoOutlined";
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined";
import BlockOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/BlockOutlined";
import RemoveOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RemoveOutlined";
import CheckOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckOutlined";
import TouchAppOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/TouchAppOutlined";
import { RESOURCE_RELATED_ROUTES } from "./RolePermissionsTab";

import {
  ALL_RESOURCES,
  ALL_ACTIONS,
  ALL_ROUTES,
  RESOURCE_LABELS,
  ACTION_LABELS,
  CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type SystemResource,
  type CrudAction,
  type RouteCategory,
  type SystemRoute,
  type RolePermissionConfig,
  type UserPermissionOverride,
  type ScheduleStaff,
} from "@/lib/types";

export interface UserOverridesTabProps {
  staffList: ScheduleStaff[];
  selectedUserId: string;
  setSelectedUserId: (val: string) => void;
  selectedStaffMember: ScheduleStaff | null;
  userOverride: UserPermissionOverride;
  roles: Record<string, RolePermissionConfig>;
  handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
  handleSetUserRouteState: (path: string, state: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke") => void;
  handleSetUserCrudState: (
    resource: SystemResource,
    action: CrudAction,
    state: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke"
  ) => void;
  handleSaveUserOverride: () => void;
  handleResetUserOverride: () => void;
  saving: boolean;
}

export function UserOverridesTab({
  staffList,
  selectedUserId,
  setSelectedUserId,
  selectedStaffMember,
  userOverride,
  roles,
  handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled,
  handleSetUserRouteState,
  handleSetUserCrudState,
  handleSaveUserOverride,
  handleResetUserOverride,
  saving,
}: UserOverridesTabProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";
  const primaryColor = theme.palette.primary.main;

  const baseRole = selectedStaffMember?.role || "staff";
  const baseConfig = roles[baseRole] || roles["staff"];

  // Group routes by category
  const routesByCategory = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<RouteCategory, SystemRoute[]> = {
      library: [],
      circulation: [],
      personnel: [],
      ai_vision: [],
      admin: [],
    };
    ALL_ROUTES.forEach((r) => {
      const cat = r.category || "library";
      if (!map[cat]) map[cat] = [];
      map[cat].push(r);
    });
    return map;
  }, []);

  const handleSetCategoryRouteState = (cat: RouteCategory, state: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke") => {
    const catRoutes = routesByCategory[cat] || [];
    catRoutes.forEach((r) => handleSetUserRouteState(r.path, state));
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2.5}>
      {/* ── TOP USER SELECTION & MASTER OVERRIDE TOGGLE ────────────────────── */}
      <Paper
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          p: 2.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          borderColor: "divider",
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: { xs: "column", md: "row" },
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", md: "center" },
          gap: 2,
        }}
      >
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              bgcolor: alpha(primaryColor, 0.1),
              color: primaryColor,
              display: "grid",
              placeItems: "center",
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            <PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24 }} />
          </Box>
          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, maxWidth: 360 }}>
            <FormControl fullWidth size="small">
              <InputLabel id="staff-select-label">Chọn nhân viên thư viện</InputLabel>
              <Select
                labelId="staff-select-label"
                value={selectedUserId}
                label="Chọn nhân viên thư viện"
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedUserId(e.target.value)}
                sx={{ borderRadius: 1.5 }}
              >
                {staffList.map((st) => (
                  <MenuItem key={st.id} value={st.id}>
                    {st.fullName || st.email} ({st.role === "admin" ? "Quản trị viên" : "Thủ thư"})
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
          </Box>

          {selectedStaffMember && (
            <Chip
              size="small"
              label={`Chức vụ: ${selectedStaffMember.role === "admin" ? "Quản trị viên" : "Thủ thư"}`}
              sx={{
                fontWeight: 700,
                borderRadius: 1,
                bgcolor: "action.hover",
              }}
            />
          )}
        </Stack>

        {/* Master Override Toggle */}
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Box sx={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              Cấp quyền riêng cho nhân viên này
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
              {userOverride.enabled ? "Đang áp dụng đặc quyền riêng" : "Đang áp dụng theo chức vụ"}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
          <Switch
            checked={Boolean(userOverride.enabled)}
            onChange={(e) => handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled(e.target.checked)}
            color="primary"
          />
          {userOverride.enabled && (
            <Button
              size="small"
              variant="outlined"
              color="error"
              startIcon={<RestartAltOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={handleResetUserOverride}
              disabled={saving}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, borderRadius: 1.5 }}
            >
              Khôi phục quyền mặc định
            </Button>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </Paper>

      {!userOverride.enabled ? (
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            p: 4,
            borderRadius: 2,
            textAlign: "center",
            borderColor: "divider",
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
          }}
        >
          <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5 }}>
            Nhân viên này đang dùng bộ quyền chuẩn của nhóm [{baseConfig?.label || baseRole}]
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ maxWidth: 600, mx: "auto", mb: 2 }}>
            Nếu bạn muốn cấp thêm quyền đặc biệt (ví dụ: giao thêm việc kiểm kê, sửa sách, duyệt phiếu, in thẻ) hoặc tạm khóa một số tính năng riêng cho nhân viên này, hãy nhấn nút bên dưới.
          </Typography>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            size="small"
            onClick={() => handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled(true)}
            sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: 1.5 }}
          >
            Bật thiết lập quyền riêng cho nhân viên
          </Button>
        </Paper>
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={2.5}>
          {/* CRUD Overrides Table (6 Actions) */}
          <Paper
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{
              borderRadius: 2,
              borderColor: "divider",
              bgcolor: "background.paper",
              overflow: "hidden",
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                px: 2.5,
                py: 2,
                borderBottom: 1,
                borderColor: "divider",
                bgcolor: isDark ? "background.default" : "#F8FAFC",
              }}
            >
              <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", md: "row" }} sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", md: "center" }, gap: 1.5 }}>
                <Box>
                  <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                    1. Tùy chỉnh thao tác dữ liệu riêng biệt theo 7 Phân hệ (6 Hành động CRUD)
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                    Nhân viên mặc định dùng quyền theo vai trò. Nhấp chuột vào bất kỳ ô nào để cấp thêm (+) hoặc thu hồi (-) quyền riêng.
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
                {/* Visual Legend / Guide */}
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} useFlexGap sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.6} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "#059669" }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#059669", fontSize: "0.72rem" }}>
                      + Cấp riêng
                    </Typography>
                  </Stack>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.6} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "#DC2626" }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#DC2626", fontSize: "0.72rem" }}>
                      - Thu hồi
                    </Typography>
                  </Stack>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.6} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: isDark ? "#64748B" : "#94A3B8" }} />
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontSize: "0.72rem" }}>
                      Theo vai trò
                    </Typography>
                  </Stack>
                  <Chip
                    size="small"
                    icon={<TouchAppOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />}
                    label="Bấm 1 chạm để đổi trạng thái"
                    variant="outlined"
                    sx={{ height: 22, fontSize: "0.68rem", fontWeight: 600 }}
                  />
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
            </Box>

            <TableContainer>
              <Table size="small">
                <TableHead>
                  <TableRow sx={{ bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.02) : "#F1F5F9" }}>
                    <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "26%" }}>Phân hệ nghiệp vụ & Các màn hình</TableCell>
                    {ALL_ACTIONS.map((act) => (
                      <TableCell key={act} align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "12.3%" }}>
                        {ACTION_LABELS[act] || act}
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHead>
                <TableBody>
                  {ALL_RESOURCES.map((res) => {
                    const relatedRoutes = RESOURCE_RELATED_ROUTES[res] || [];

                    return (
                      <TableRow key={res} hover>
                        <TableCell sx={{ py: 1.25 }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
                            {RESOURCE_LABELS[res] || res}
                          </Typography>
                          <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} useFlexGap sx={{ mt: 0.5, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                            {relatedRoutes.map((r) => (
                              <Chip
                                key={r.path}
                                label={r.label}
                                size="small"
                                variant="outlined"
                                sx={{
                                  height: 18,
                                  fontSize: "0.62rem",
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                  borderRadius: 0.75,
                                  bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.04) : "#F1F5F9",
                                  borderColor: "divider",
                                  color: "text.secondary",
                                }}
                              />
                            ))}
                          </Stack>
                          {/* Quick row actions */}
                          <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ mt: 0.75 }}>
                            <Button
                              size="small"
                              variant="text"
                              onClick={() => {
                                ALL_ACTIONS.forEach((a) => handleSetUserCrudState(res, a, "grant"));
                              }}
                              sx={{
                                fontSize: "0.65rem",
                                py: 0.1,
                                px: 0.5,
                                minWidth: 0,
                                textTransform: "none",
                                color: "#059669",
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                bgcolor: alpha("#059669", 0.08),
                                borderRadius: 1,
                                "&:hover": { bgcolor: alpha("#059669", 0.16) },
                              }}
                            >
                              + Cấp đủ 6 quyền
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              size="small"
                              variant="text"
                              onClick={() => {
                                ALL_ACTIONS.forEach((a) => handleSetUserCrudState(res, a, "inherit"));
                              }}
                              sx={{
                                fontSize: "0.65rem",
                                py: 0.1,
                                px: 0.5,
                                minWidth: 0,
                                textTransform: "none",
                                color: "text.secondary",
                                bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.05) : "#F1F5F9",
                                borderRadius: 1,
                                "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
                              }}
                            >
                              Về mặc định
                            </Button>
                          </Stack>
                        </TableCell>
                      {ALL_ACTIONS.map((act) => {
                        const isGranted = userOverride.grantedCrud?.[res]?.[act] === true;
                        const isRevoked = userOverride.revokedCrud?.[res]?.[act] === true;
                        const currentVal: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke" = isGranted
                          ? "grant"
                          : isRevoked
                          ? "revoke"
                          : "inherit";

                        const baseVal = Boolean(baseConfig?.crud?.[res]?.[act]);

                        const handleCycle = () => {
                          const nextState =
                            currentVal === "inherit"
                              ? "grant"
                              : currentVal === "grant"
                              ? "revoke"
                              : "inherit";
                          handleSetUserCrudState(res, act, nextState);
                        };

                        let chipLabel = "";
                        let chipIcon = null;
                        let tooltipText = "";
                        let chipSx = {};

                        if (currentVal === "grant") {
                          chipLabel = "+ Cấp quyền";
                          chipIcon = <CheckCircleOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />;
                          tooltipText = `[Đặc quyền riêng]: Đã cấp thêm quyền "${ACTION_LABELS[act]}" cho phân hệ này. Bấm để chuyển sang Thu hồi (-)`;
                          chipSx = {
                            bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#059669", 0.3) : alpha("#059669", 0.16),
                            border: `1.5px solid #059669`,
                            color: isDark ? "#6EE7B7" : "#047857",
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            boxShadow: `0 1px 3px ${alpha("#059669", 0.25)}`,
                            "&:hover": {
                              bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#059669", 0.45) : alpha("#059669", 0.26),
                              transform: "translateY(-1px)",
                            },
                          };
                        } else if (currentVal === "revoke") {
                          chipLabel = "- Thu hồi";
                          chipIcon = <BlockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />;
                          tooltipText = `[Chặn quyền]: Đã thu hồi quyền "${ACTION_LABELS[act]}" của nhân viên này. Bấm để trở về Mặc định`;
                          chipSx = {
                            bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#DC2626", 0.3) : alpha("#DC2626", 0.16),
                            border: `1.5px solid #DC2626`,
                            color: isDark ? "#FCA5A5" : "#B91C1C",
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            boxShadow: `0 1px 3px ${alpha("#DC2626", 0.25)}`,
                            "&:hover": {
                              bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#DC2626", 0.45) : alpha("#DC2626", 0.26),
                              transform: "translateY(-1px)",
                            },
                          };
                        } else {
                          // Inherit from role baseline
                          if (baseVal) {
                            chipLabel = "Mặc định (Có)";
                            chipIcon = <CheckOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "13px !important" }} />;
                            tooltipText = `Mặc định theo chức vụ [${baseConfig?.label || baseRole}]: ĐƯỢC PHÉP. Bấm để Cấp riêng (+)`;
                            chipSx = {
                              bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#10B981", 0.08) : alpha("#10B981", 0.06),
                              border: `1px solid ${isDark ? alpha("#10B981", 0.25) : alpha("#10B981", 0.35)}`,
                              color: isDark ? "#34D399" : "#059669",
                              fontWeight: 600,
                              opacity: 0.85,
                              "&:hover": {
                                opacity: 1,
                                bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#10B981", 0.16) : alpha("#10B981", 0.12),
                                transform: "translateY(-1px)",
                              },
                            };
                          } else {
                            chipLabel = "Mặc định (—)";
                            chipIcon = <RemoveOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "13px !important" }} />;
                            tooltipText = `Mặc định theo chức vụ [${baseConfig?.label || baseRole}]: CHƯA CÓ. Bấm để Cấp riêng (+)`;
                            chipSx = {
                              bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#64748B", 0.08) : alpha("#64748B", 0.06),
                              border: `1px solid ${isDark ? alpha("#64748B", 0.2) : alpha("#64748B", 0.25)}`,
                              color: "text.secondary",
                              fontWeight: 500,
                              opacity: 0.75,
                              "&:hover": {
                                opacity: 1,
                                bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#64748B", 0.16) : alpha("#64748B", 0.12),
                                transform: "translateY(-1px)",
                              },
                            };
                          }
                        }

                        return (
                          <TableCell key={act} align="center" sx={{ py: 1 }}>
                            <Tooltip title={tooltipText} arrow placement="top">
                              <Chip
                                icon={chipIcon}
                                label={chipLabel}
                                size="small"
                                onClick={handleCycle}
                                sx={{
                                  cursor: "pointer",
                                  height: 28,
                                  px: 0.75,
                                  fontSize: "0.72rem",
                                  borderRadius: 1.5,
                                  transition: "all 0.15s ease-in-out",
                                  userSelect: "none",
                                  ...chipSx,
                                }}
                              />
                            </Tooltip>
                          </TableCell>
                        );
                      })}
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </Paper>

          {/* Route Overrides Table (Categorized with Batch Actions) */}
          <Paper
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{
              borderRadius: 2,
              borderColor: "divider",
              bgcolor: "background.paper",
              overflow: "hidden",
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                px: 2.5,
                py: 1.75,
                borderBottom: 1,
                borderColor: "divider",
                bgcolor: isDark ? "background.default" : "#F8FAFC",
              }}
            >
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                2. Tùy chỉnh quyền mở màn hình chức năng (Theo 5 nhóm hệ thống)
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                Mở thêm hoặc tạm ẩn các mục trên menu làm việc riêng của nhân viên này
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <TableContainer sx={{ maxHeight: 520 }}>
              <Table size="small" stickyHeader>
                <TableHead>
                  <TableRow sx={{ bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.02) : "#F1F5F9" }}>
                    <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "42%" }}>Màn hình chức năng</TableCell>
                    <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "26%" }}>Mặc định theo chức vụ</TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, width: "32%" }}>Thiết lập riêng cho nhân viên</TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHead>
                <TableBody>
                  {(Object.keys(routesByCategory) as RouteCategory[]).map((categoryKey) => {
                    const categoryRoutes = routesByCategory[categoryKey] || [];
                    if (categoryRoutes.length === 0) return null;

                    return (
                      <React.Fragment key={categoryKey}>
                        {/* Category Group Header */}
                        <TableRow
                          sx={{
                            bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#38BDF8", 0.08) : alpha("#0284C7", 0.05),
                          }}
                        >
                          <TableCell colSpan={3} sx={{ py: 1, px: 2.5 }}>
                            <Stack direction="row" sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "primary.main", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.6 }}>
                                  {CATEGORY_LABELS[categoryKey]}
                                </Typography>
                                <Chip
                                  size="small"
                                  label={`${categoryRoutes.length} màn hình`}
                                  sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: "0.68rem", fontWeight: 700 }}
                                />
                              </Stack>

                              {/* Batch Actions for Category */}
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.75}>
                                <Button
                                  size="small"
                                  variant="outlined"
                                  onClick={() => handleSetCategoryRouteState(categoryKey, "inherit")}
                                  sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", py: 0.25, px: 0.75, minWidth: 0, textTransform: "none", borderRadius: 1 }}
                                >
                                  Theo vai trò cả nhóm
                                </Button>
                                <Button
                                  size="small"
                                  variant="outlined"
                                  color="success"
                                  onClick={() => handleSetCategoryRouteState(categoryKey, "grant")}
                                  sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", py: 0.25, px: 0.75, minWidth: 0, textTransform: "none", borderRadius: 1 }}
                                >
                                  Cấp quyền cả nhóm (+)
                                </Button>
                                <Button
                                  size="small"
                                  variant="outlined"
                                  color="error"
                                  onClick={() => handleSetCategoryRouteState(categoryKey, "revoke")}
                                  sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", py: 0.25, px: 0.75, minWidth: 0, textTransform: "none", borderRadius: 1 }}
                                >
                                  Thu hồi cả nhóm (-)
                                </Button>
                              </Stack>
                            </Stack>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>

                        {/* Individual Route Rows */}
                        {categoryRoutes.map((route) => {
                          const isGranted = (userOverride.grantedPages || []).includes(route.path);
                          const isRevoked = (userOverride.revokedPages || []).includes(route.path);
                          const currentVal: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke" = isGranted
                            ? "grant"
                            : isRevoked
                            ? "revoke"
                            : "inherit";

                          const isBaseAllowed = (baseConfig?.allowedPages || []).includes(route.path);

                          return (
                            <TableRow key={route.path} hover>
                              <TableCell sx={{ py: 1.1, pl: 3.5 }}>
                                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.85rem", color: "text.primary" }}>
                                  {route.label}
                                </Typography>
                                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.72rem" }}>
                                  {route.path}
                                </Typography>
                              </TableCell>
                              <TableCell sx={{ py: 1.1 }}>
                                <Chip
                                  size="small"
                                  label={isBaseAllowed ? "Được mở" : "Không được mở"}
                                  sx={{
                                    height: 20,
                                    fontSize: "0.68rem",
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    borderRadius: 1,
                                    bgcolor: isBaseAllowed ? alpha("#059669", 0.1) : alpha("#64748B", 0.1),
                                    color: isBaseAllowed ? "#059669" : "#64748B",
                                  }}
                                />
                              </TableCell>
                              <TableCell align="center" sx={{ py: 1.1 }}>
                                <ToggleButtonGroup
                                  size="small"
                                  exclusive
                                  value={currentVal}
                                  onChange={(_, val) => val && handleSetUserRouteState(route.path, val)}
                                  sx={{
                                    height: 26,
                                    "& .MuiToggleButton-root": {
                                      px: 1.25,
                                      py: 0,
                                      fontSize: "0.72rem",
                                      fontWeight: 700,
                                      textTransform: "none",
                                    },
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <ToggleButton value="inherit">
                                    Theo chức vụ
                                  </ToggleButton>
                                  <ToggleButton
                                    value="grant"
                                    sx={{
                                      "&.Mui-selected": {
                                        bgcolor: alpha("#059669", 0.15),
                                        color: "#059669",
                                      },
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    Cho phép (+)
                                  </ToggleButton>
                                  <ToggleButton
                                    value="revoke"
                                    sx={{
                                      "&.Mui-selected": {
                                        bgcolor: alpha("#DC2626", 0.15),
                                        color: "#DC2626",
                                      },
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    Tạm khóa (-)
                                  </ToggleButton>
                                </ToggleButtonGroup>
                              </TableCell>
                            </TableRow>
                          );
                        })}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </Paper>

          {/* Guide & Bottom Save Bar */}
          <Paper
            variant="outlined"
            sx={{
              p: 2.5,
              borderRadius: 2,
              borderColor: "divider",
              bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#0284C7", 0.06) : "#F0F9FF",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: { xs: "column", sm: "row" },
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", sm: "center" },
              gap: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
              <InfoOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: "primary.main", mt: 0.2 }} />
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "text.primary" }}>
                  Phân biệt Quyền Chức vụ (Tab 1) và Quyền Riêng Nhân viên (Tab 2):
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "text.secondary", display: "block", mt: 0.5, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                  • <strong>Tab 1 (Chức vụ):</strong> Thay đổi ở Tab 1 sẽ áp dụng cho <strong>tất cả nhân viên</strong> thuộc chức vụ đó (cả Staff A, Staff B,...).<br />
                  • <strong>Tab 2 (Nhân viên):</strong> Chỉ áp dụng đặc quyền riêng cho <strong>{selectedStaffMember?.fullName || "nhân viên này"}</strong>. Các nhân viên khác vẫn áp dụng theo chức vụ gốc.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Stack>

            <Button
              size="medium"
              variant="contained"
              color="primary"
              startIcon={<SaveOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={handleSaveUserOverride}
              disabled={saving}
              sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: 1.5, px: 3, flexShrink: 0 }}
            >
              {saving ? "Đang lưu..." : `Lưu quyền riêng cho ${selectedStaffMember?.fullName || "nhân viên"}`}
            </Button>
          </Paper>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

export default UserOverridesTab;

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Drawer,
  IconButton,
  Pagination,
  Stack,
  TextField,

function getApiError(err: any): string {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  return data?.error || data?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra";
}

const SKIP_META_KEYS = new Set(["staffId", "targetStaffId", "shiftId", "zoneId"]);

function formatMetadata(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): { key: string; value: string }[] {
  if (!metadata || Object.keys(metadata).length === 0) return [];
  const result: { key: string; value: string }[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(metadata)) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || SKIP_META_KEYS.has(k)) continue;
    const key = METADATA_LABELS[k] || k;
    const value = typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v);
    result.push({ key, value });
  }
  return result;
}

const ENTITY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  staff_schedule: "Lịch làm việc", zone: "Khu vực",
  shift: "Ca", template: "Mẫu lịch", attendance: "Điểm danh",
};

function getDateKey(dateStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function getRelativeDate(dateStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  const target = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
  const diffDays = Math.floor((today.getTime() - target.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  if (diffDays === 0) return "Hôm nay";
  if (diffDays === 1) return "Hôm qua";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" });
}

export default function AuditLogsPanel({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState("");
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState("");
  const [showStats, setShowStats] = useState(false);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<any>(null);
  const [statsLoading, setStatsLoading] = useState(false);
  const limit = 50;

  const buildFilters = useCallback(() => {
    const f: any = { page, limit };
    if (fromDate) f.fromDate = fromDate;
    if (toDate) f.toDate = toDate;
    if (search.trim()) f.search = search.trim();
    return f;
  }, [page, limit, fromDate, toDate, search]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await api.getAuditLogs(buildFilters());
      setLogs(result.items);
      setTotal(result.total);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [buildFilters]);

  const loadStats = useCallback(async () => {
    setStatsLoading(true);
    try {
      const s = await api.getAuditStats({ fromDate: fromDate || undefined, toDate: toDate || undefined });
      setStats(s);
    } catch { /* ignore */ } finally {
      setStatsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fromDate, toDate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setPage(1);
      setFilterCategory("all");
      setSearch("");
      setFromDate("");
      setToDate("");
      loadData();
    }
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) loadData();
  }, [page, filterCategory, fromDate, toDate, search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && showStats) loadStats();
  }, [open, showStats, fromDate, toDate]);

  const groupedLogs = (() => {
    const filtered = filterCategory === "all"
      ? logs
      : logs.filter((log) => ACTION_CONFIG[log.action]?.category === filterCategory);
    const map = new Map<string, any[]>();
    for (const log of filtered) {
      const dk = log.createdAt ? getDateKey(log.createdAt) : "unknown";
      if (!map.has(dk)) map.set(dk, []);
      map.get(dk)!.push(log);
    }
    const groups: { label: string; dateKey: string; items: any[] }[] = [];
    for (const [dk, items] of map) {
      groups.push({ label: dk === "unknown" ? "Không rõ" : getRelativeDate(dk), dateKey: dk, items });
    }
    return groups;
  })();

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);

  return (
    <Drawer anchor="right" open={open} onClose={onClose} sx={{ zIndex: 9999 }}>
      <Box sx={{ width: { xs: "100%", sm: 540 }, height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1.5 }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 1, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", bgcolor: "rgba(212,175,55,0.15)" }}>
              <TimelineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#D4AF37" }} />
            </Box>
            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "common.white" }}>Nhật ký hoạt động</Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" }}>
                {groupedLogs.reduce((s, g) => s + g.items.length, 0)} / {total} bản ghi
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
            <IconButton
              size="small"
              onClick={() => setShowStats(!showStats)}
              sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)", bgcolor: showStats ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" : "transparent" }}
            >
              <BarChartIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
            </IconButton>
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={onClose} sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" }}>
              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Stats Summary */}
        {showStats && (
          <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", bgcolor: (t) => t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(10,37,64,0.3)" : "rgba(10,37,64,0.04)" }}>
            {statsLoading ? (
              <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", py: 1 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={16} />
              </Box>
            ) : stats ? (
              <Stack spacing={1}>
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", p: 1, borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "action.hover" }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main" }}>{stats.totalToday}</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Hôm nay</Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", p: 1, borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "action.hover" }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "secondary.main" }}>{stats.totalThisWeek}</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Tuần này</Typography>
                  </Box>
                </Stack>
                {stats.topActions?.length > 0 && (

                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }} useFlexGap>
                      {stats.topActions.slice(0, 5).map((a: any) => (
                        <Chip key={a.action} label={`${ACTION_CONFIG[a.action]?.label || a.action} (${a.count})`} size="small" sx={{ height: 22, fontSize: 10, bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" }} />
                      ))}
                    </Stack>
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Stack>
            ) : null}
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* Filter Bar */}
        <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1.5 }}>
          <TextField
            size="small"
            placeholder="Tìm theo tên nhân viên, metadata..."
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
            fullWidth
            slotProps={{

            onChange={(dates) => {
              setFromDate(dates?.[0]?.format("YYYY-MM-DD") || "");

              setPage(1);

          />

                  return (
                    <Box key={log.id} sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, py: 1.5, borderBottom: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", "&:last-child": { borderBottom: 0 }, "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.02)" }, borderRadius: 0.5, px: 0.5 }}>

                            {meta.map((m, i) => (

                                {m.key}: <Box component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 500, color: "text.primary" }}>{m.value}</Box>
                              </Typography>
                            ))}

                        )}

                        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.5, mt: 0.5 }}>
                          <ScheduleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 10, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", color: "text.secondary" }}>{time}</Typography>
                          {log.actorName && (
                            <>
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", color: "text.secondary", mx: 0.5 }}>·</Typography>
                              <PersonIcon sx={{ fontSize: 10, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontSize: "0.65rem" }}>{log.actorName}</Typography>
                            </>
                          )}

                      </Box>
                    </Box>
                  );
                })}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          ))}
        </Box>

        {/* Pagination */}
        {totalPages > 1 && (
          <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 1.5, borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider", bgcolor: "background.paper", display: "flex", justifyContent: "center" }}>
            <Pagination
              count={totalPages}
              page={page}
              onChange={(_, p) => setPage(p)}
              size="small"
              color="primary"
            />
          </Box>
        )}
      </Box>
    </Drawer>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import Modal from "antd/es/modal";

import Tag from "antd/es/tag";
