import { useColorMode } from "@/lib/mui-theme";

const { RangePicker } = DatePicker;

function toDateInput(date: Date): string {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

function formatDisplayDate(iso: string): string {
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-");
  return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
}

function getMonday(d: Date): Date {
  const date = new Date(d);
  const day = date.getDay();
  const diff = date.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
  date.setDate(diff);
  return date;
}

function getEndOfMonth(year: number, month: number): Date {
  return new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
}

interface QuickOption {
  label: string;
  sub: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
}

function getQuickOptions(): QuickOption[] {
  const now = new Date();
  const monday = getMonday(now);
  const sunday = new Date(monday);
  sunday.setDate(monday.getDate() + 6);

  const nextMonday = new Date(monday);
  nextMonday.setDate(monday.getDate() + 7);
  const nextSunday = new Date(nextMonday);
  nextSunday.setDate(nextMonday.getDate() + 6);

  const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
  const monthEnd = getEndOfMonth(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth());

  const nextMonthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 1);
  const nextMonthEnd = getEndOfMonth(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1);

  const yearStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
  const yearEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), 11, 31);

  return [
    { label: "Tuần này", sub: `${monday.getDate()}/${monday.getMonth() + 1} — ${sunday.getDate()}/${sunday.getMonth() + 1}`, from: toDateInput(monday), to: toDateInput(sunday) },
    { label: "Tuần sau", sub: `${nextMonday.getDate()}/${nextMonday.getMonth() + 1} — ${nextSunday.getDate()}/${nextSunday.getMonth() + 1}`, from: toDateInput(nextMonday), to: toDateInput(nextSunday) },
    { label: "Tháng này", sub: `Tháng ${now.getMonth() + 1}/${now.getFullYear()}`, from: toDateInput(monthStart), to: toDateInput(monthEnd) },
    { label: "Tháng sau", sub: `Tháng ${now.getMonth() + 2 > 12 ? 1 : now.getMonth() + 2}/${now.getMonth() + 2 > 12 ? now.getFullYear() + 1 : now.getFullYear()}`, from: toDateInput(nextMonthStart), to: toDateInput(nextMonthEnd) },
    { label: "Năm nay", sub: `${now.getFullYear()}`, from: toDateInput(yearStart), to: toDateInput(yearEnd) },
  ];
}

interface ProposedItem {
  staffId: string;
  shiftId: string;
  zoneId: string;
  workDate: string;
  note: string;
  staffName?: string;
  shiftName?: string;
  zoneName?: string;
}

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (from: string, to: string) => void;
  onConfirmFinal: (selected: ProposedItem[]) => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  step: "select" | "preview";
  proposals: ProposedItem[];
  skippedCount: number;
  actualRange?: { from: string; to: string } | null;
}

export default function AutoScheduleDialog({ open, onClose, onConfirm, onConfirmFinal, loading, step, proposals, skippedCount, actualRange }: Props) {
  const { effectiveMode } = useColorMode();
  const isDark = effectiveMode === "dark";
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(0);
  const [useCustom, setUseCustom] = useState(false);
  const [customRange, setCustomRange] = useState<[dayjs.Dayjs | null, dayjs.Dayjs | null] | null>(null);
  const [checkedSet, setCheckedSet] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const options = getQuickOptions();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (step === "preview" && proposals.length > 0) {
      const initial = new Set<number>();
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(proposals.length, 50); i++) initial.add(i);
      setCheckedSet(initial);
    } else if (step === "select") {
      setCheckedSet(new Set());
    }
  }, [step, proposals.length]);

  const displayProposals = useMemo(() => proposals.slice(0, 50), [proposals]);

  const allChecked = displayProposals.length > 0 && displayProposals.every((_, i) => checkedSet.has(i));
  const selectedCount = useMemo(() => {
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < displayProposals.length; i++) {
      if (checkedSet.has(i)) count++;
    }
    for (let i = displayProposals.length; i < proposals.length; i++) {
      count++;
    }
    return count;
  }, [checkedSet, displayProposals.length, proposals.length]);

  const toggleAll = () => {
    if (allChecked) {
      setCheckedSet(new Set());
    } else {
      const next = new Set<number>();
      for (let i = 0; i < displayProposals.length; i++) next.add(i);
      setCheckedSet(next);
    }
  };

  const toggleRow = (idx: number) => {
    const next = new Set(checkedSet);
    if (next.has(idx)) {
      next.delete(idx);
    } else {
      next.add(idx);
    }
    setCheckedSet(next);
  };

  const handleSelectConfirm = () => {
    if (useCustom) {
      if (!customRange || !customRange[0] || !customRange[1]) return;
      onConfirm(customRange[0].format("YYYY-MM-DD"), customRange[1].format("YYYY-MM-DD"));
    } else if (selected !== null) {
      onConfirm(options[selected].from, options[selected].to);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmFinal = () => {
    const selectedItems: ProposedItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < proposals.length; i++) {
      if (i < displayProposals.length) {
        if (checkedSet.has(i)) selectedItems.push(proposals[i]);
      } else {
        selectedItems.push(proposals[i]);
      }
    }
    onConfirmFinal(selectedItems);
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={onClose}
      width={step === "preview" ? 640 : 480}
      title={step === "select" ? "Gợi ý lịch tự động" : `Xác nhận tạo ${selectedCount} ca`}
      footer={
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: 8 }}>
          <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={loading}>
            {step === "preview" ? "Hủy" : "Đóng"}
          </Button>
          {step === "select" ? (
            <Button
              type="primary"
              onClick={handleSelectConfirm}
              disabled={useCustom ? !customRange || !customRange[0] || !customRange[1] : selected === null}
              style={{ background: "#f59e0b", borderColor: "#f59e0b" }}
            >
              Xem đề xuất
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              type="primary"
              onClick={handleConfirmFinal}
              loading={loading}
              disabled={selectedCount === 0}
              style={{ background: "#10b981", borderColor: "#10b981" }}
            >
              {loading ? "Đang tạo..." : `Xác nhận tạo ${selectedCount} ca`}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      }
      mask={{ closable: !loading }}
    >
      {step === "select" ? (
        <div>
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", fontWeight: 600, color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#344054", marginBottom: 8 }}>Chọn nhanh:</div>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, 1fr)", gap: 8 }}>
              {options.map((opt, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  onClick={() => { setSelected(i); setUseCustom(false); }}
                  style={{
                    display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, padding: 12, borderRadius: 8,
                    border: `2px solid ${!useCustom && selected === i ? "#f59e0b" : isDark ? "#2E3345" : "#D0D7E2"}`,
                    background: !useCustom && selected === i ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.08)" : isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" : "#F5F7FA",
                    cursor: "pointer", transition: "all 0.15s",
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.75rem", color: !useCustom && selected === i ? "#f59e0b" : isDark ? "#EDE2DF" : "#101828" }}>
                    {opt.label}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>
                    {opt.sub}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", fontWeight: 600, color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#344054", marginBottom: 8 }}>Hoặc chọn khoảng ngày:</div>
            <div
              onClick={() => { setUseCustom(true); setSelected(null); }}
              style={{
                display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, padding: 12, borderRadius: 8,
                border: `2px solid ${useCustom ? "#f59e0b" : isDark ? "#2E3345" : "#D0D7E2"}`,
                background: useCustom ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.08)" : isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" : "#F5F7FA",
                cursor: "pointer", transition: "all 0.15s",
              }}
            >
              <RangePicker
                value={customRange as any}
                onChange={(dates) => {
                  setCustomRange(dates as any);
                  setUseCustom(true);
                  setSelected(null);
                }}
                format="DD/MM/YYYY"
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                placeholder={["Từ ngày", "Đến ngày"]}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          {proposals.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 24, color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: "0.875rem", fontStyle: "italic" }}>Không có đề xuất lịch mới</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: "0.7rem", marginTop: 4 }}>Tất cả ca đã đủ nhân viên</div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {actualRange && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: "0.7rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999", textAlign: "center", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 6, background: isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" : "#F5F7FA", border: `1px solid ${isDark ? "#2E3345" : "#D0D7E2"}`, marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  Đề xuất từ <span style={{ color: "#10b981", fontWeight: 600 }}>{formatDisplayDate(actualRange.from)}</span> — <span style={{ color: "#10b981", fontWeight: 600 }}>{formatDisplayDate(actualRange.to)}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", padding: 8, borderRadius: 6, background: "rgba(16,185,129,0.1)" }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#10b981", fontSize: "1rem" }}>{selectedCount}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: "0.6rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>Ca đã chọn</div>
                </div>
                {proposals.length - selectedCount > 0 && (
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", padding: 8, borderRadius: 6, background: "rgba(245,158,11,0.1)" }}>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#f59e0b", fontSize: "1rem" }}>{proposals.length - selectedCount}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: "0.6rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>Bỏ chọn</div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {skippedCount > 0 && (
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", padding: 8, borderRadius: 6, background: "rgba(245,158,11,0.1)" }}>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "#f59e0b", fontSize: "1rem" }}>{skippedCount}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: "0.6rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>Bỏ qua</div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{ maxHeight: 280, overflowY: "auto" }}>
                <div
                  onClick={toggleAll}
                  style={{
                    display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, padding: "8px 12px", marginBottom: 4,
                    borderRadius: 6, cursor: "pointer", background: isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" : "#F5F7FA", border: `1px solid ${isDark ? "#2E3345" : "#D0D7E2"}`,
                  }}
                >
                  <Checkbox checked={allChecked} indeterminate={selectedCount > 0 && !allChecked} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#344054", fontSize: "0.7rem" }}>
                    {allChecked ? "Bỏ chọn tất cả" : "Chọn tất cả"}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {displayProposals.map((p, i) => {
                  const checked = checkedSet.has(i);
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      onClick={() => toggleRow(i)}
                      style={{
                        display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, padding: "8px 12px", marginBottom: 4,
                        borderRadius: 6, cursor: "pointer", transition: "background 0.1s",
                        background: checked ? "rgba(16,185,129,0.05)" : isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" : "#F5F7FA",
                        border: `1px solid ${checked ? "rgba(16,185,129,0.2)" : isDark ? "#2E3345" : "#D0D7E2"}`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Checkbox checked={checked} />
                      <div style={{
                        width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
                        fontSize: "0.6rem", fontWeight: 700, background: "rgba(16,185,129,0.15)", color: "#10b981", flexShrink: 0,
                      }}>
                        {i + 1}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: "0.7rem", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap", color: isDark ? "#EDE2DF" : "#101828" }}>
                          {p.staffName || p.staffId.slice(0, 8)}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: "0.6rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>
                          {p.shiftName || "Ca"} — {p.zoneName || "Zone"} — {p.workDate}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Tag color={p.note?.includes("template") ? "blue" : p.note?.includes("preference") ? "purple" : "default"} style={{ fontSize: "0.55rem" }}>
                        {p.note?.includes("template") ? "template" : p.note?.includes("preference") ? "sở thích" : "auto"}
                      </Tag>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
                {proposals.length > 50 && (
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "center", fontSize: "0.6rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999", padding: "6px 0" }}>
                    ... và {proposals.length - 50} ca nữa (tự động chọn)
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Drawer,
  IconButton,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import Alert from "antd/es/alert";
import Modal from "antd/es/modal";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircle";
import CancelIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Cancel";
import PendingIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Pending";
import InfoIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Info";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { ManualCheckInRequest, ScheduleStaff } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated?: () => void;
}

function getApiError(err: any): string {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  return data?.error || data?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra";
}

const STATUS_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; color: "warning" | "success" | "info" | "error"; icon: React.ReactNode }> = {
  pending_manual: { label: "Chờ duyệt", color: "warning", icon: <PendingIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> },
  check_in: { label: "Đã check-in", color: "success", icon: <CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> },
  check_out: { label: "Đã check-out", color: "info", icon: <InfoIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> },
  rejected: { label: "Từ chối", color: "error", icon: <CancelIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> },
};

export default function ManualCheckInAdmin({ open, onClose, onUpdated }: Props) {
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState<ManualCheckInRequest[]>([]);
  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<ScheduleStaff[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actioningId, setActioningId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState<string>("");
  const [rejectingId, setRejectingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [reqs, staffList] = await Promise.all([
        api.listManualCheckInRequests(),
        api.getScheduleStaffOptions(),
      ]);
      setRequests(reqs);
      setStaff(staffList);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) loadData();
  }, [open]);

  const getStaffName = (id: string) => {
    const s = staff.find((x) => x.id === id);
    return s?.fullName || s?.email || "Nhân viên";
  };

  const handleApprove = async (id: string) => {
    setActioningId(id);
    try {
      await api.approveManualCheckIn(id);
      await loadData();
      onUpdated?.();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setActioningId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (id: string) => {
    const reason = rejectReason.trim() || "Từ chối bởi quản lý";
    setActioningId(id);
    try {
      await api.rejectManualCheckIn(id, reason);
      await loadData();
      setRejectingId(null);
      setRejectReason("");
      onUpdated?.();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setActioningId(null);
    }
  };

  const startReject = (id: string) => {
    setRejectingId(id);
    setRejectReason("");
  };

  const cancelReject = () => {
    setRejectingId(null);
    setRejectReason("");
  };

  const openConfirmDialog = (id: string) => {
    Modal.confirm({
      title: "Xác nhận",
      content: "Duyệt check-in thủ công này?",
      okText: "Duyệt",
      cancelText: "Hủy",
      okButtonProps: { style: { background: "#10b981", borderColor: "#10b981" } },
      onOk: () => handleApprove(id),
    });
  };

  const pending = requests.filter((r) => r.status === "pending_manual");
  const others = requests.filter((r) => r.status !== "pending_manual");

  return (
    <>
      <Drawer anchor="right" open={open} onClose={onClose} sx={{ zIndex: 1300 }}>
        <Box sx={{ width: { xs: "100%", sm: 420 }, height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 2, py: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Check-in thủ công
            </Typography>
            <IconButton onClick={onClose} size="small">
              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1.5 }}>
            {error && <Alert title={error} type="error" showIcon closable onClose={() => setError(null)} />}

            {loading && (
              <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", py: 4 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={20} />
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ ml: 1 }}>Đang tải...</Typography>
              </Box>
            )}

            {!loading && pending.length === 0 && others.length === 0 && (
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", textAlign: "center", py: 4 }}>
                Không có yêu cầu nào
              </Typography>
            )}

            {pending.length > 0 && (
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="caption" color="warning.main" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                  Chờ duyệt ({pending.length})
                </Typography>
                <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                  {pending.map((req) => {
                    const config = STATUS_CONFIG[req.status] || { label: req.status, color: "info" as const, icon: <InfoIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> };
                    return (
                      <Box key={req.id} sx={{ border: 1, borderColor: "warning.light", borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "warning.light", opacity: 0.9, p: 1.5, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{getStaffName(req.staffId)}</Typography>
                          <Chip icon={config.icon as React.ReactElement} label={config.label} color={config.color} size="small" sx={{ height: 22, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 }} />
                        </Box>
                        {req.invalidatedReason && (
                          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>
                            Lý do: {req.invalidatedReason.replace("manual_checkin_request:", "")}
                          </Typography>
                        )}
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          Giờ check-in: {req.checkInAt ? new Date(req.checkInAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN") : "Chưa"}
                        </Typography>
                        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
                          <Button
                            size="small"
                            variant="contained"
                            color="success"
                            onClick={() => openConfirmDialog(req.id)}
                            disabled={actioningId === req.id}
                            fullWidth
                          >
                            {actioningId === req.id ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : "Duyệt"}
                          </Button>
                          {rejectingId === req.id ? (
                            <Button size="small" variant="outlined" onClick={cancelReject} fullWidth>
                              Hủy
                            </Button>
                          ) : (
                            <Button
                              size="small"
                              variant="contained"
                              color="error"
                              onClick={() => startReject(req.id)}
                              disabled={actioningId === req.id}
                              fullWidth
                            >
                              Từ chối
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </Stack>
                        {rejectingId === req.id && (
                          <Stack spacing={1}>
                            <TextField
                              size="small"
                              placeholder="Lý do từ chối (không bắt buộc)"
                              value={rejectReason}
                              onChange={(e) => setRejectReason(e.target.value)}
                              fullWidth
                            />
                            <Button
                              size="small"
                              variant="contained"
                              color="error"
                              onClick={() => handleReject(req.id)}
                              disabled={actioningId === req.id}
                              fullWidth
                            >
                              {actioningId === req.id ? "Đang xử lý..." : "Xác nhận từ chối"}
                            </Button>
                          </Stack>
                        )}
                      </Box>
                    );
                  })}
                </Stack>
              </Box>
            )}

            {others.length > 0 && (
              <Box>
                <Divider sx={{ my: 1 }} />
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                  Đã xử lý
                </Typography>
                <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                  {others.map((req) => {
                    const config = STATUS_CONFIG[req.status] || { label: req.status, color: "info" as const, icon: <InfoIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> };
                    return (
                      <Box key={req.id} sx={{ border: 1, borderColor: "divider", borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "background.paper", p: 1.5, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 0.5 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{getStaffName(req.staffId)}</Typography>
                          <Chip icon={config.icon as React.ReactElement} label={config.label} color={config.color} size="small" sx={{ height: 22, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 }} />
                        </Box>
                        {req.invalidatedReason && (
                          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>
                            {req.invalidatedReason.replace("manual_checkin_rejected:", "Từ chối: ").replace("manual_checkin_request:", "")}
                          </Typography>
                        )}
                      </Box>
                    );
                  })}
                </Stack>
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Drawer>

    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Drawer,
  IconButton,
  MenuItem,
  Stack,
  Tab,
  Tabs,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import Alert from "antd/es/alert";
import Modal from "antd/es/modal";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Delete";
import AddIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Add";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { LibraryZone, StaffShift } from "@/lib/types";

interface ScheduleManagementPanelProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  onUpdate: () => void;
}

function getApiError(err: any): string {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  return data?.error || data?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra";
}

export default function ScheduleManagementPanel({
  open, onClose, zones, shifts, onUpdate,
}: ScheduleManagementPanelProps) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"zones" | "shifts">("zones");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [zoneFloor, setZoneFloor] = useState("1");
  const [zoneName, setZoneName] = useState("");

  const [shiftName, setShiftName] = useState("");
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState("07:30");
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState("11:30");
  const [minStaff, setMinStaff] = useState("1");

  const handleCreateZone = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.createScheduleZone({ floor: Number(zoneFloor) || 1, zoneName: zoneName.trim() || `Tầng ${zoneFloor}` });
      setZoneName("");
      onUpdate();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const openDeleteZoneConfirm = async (id: string) => {
    let warning = "";
    try {
      const assignments = await api.getScheduleAssignments({ zoneId: id });
      const active = assignments.items.filter((a: any) => a.status === "scheduled" || a.status === "confirmed");
      if (active.length > 0) warning = `Có ${active.length} ca trực đang chờ xử lý sử dụng khu vực này. `;
    } catch {}
    Modal.confirm({
      title: "Xác nhận xóa",
      content: (
        <div>
          {warning && <Alert title={warning} type="warning" showIcon style={{ marginBottom: 8 }} />}
          <span>Xóa khu vực này?</span>
        </div>
      ),
      okText: "Xóa",
      cancelText: "Hủy",
      okButtonProps: { danger: true },
      onOk: async () => {
        setSaving(true);
        try {
          await api.deleteScheduleZone(id);
          onUpdate();
        } catch (err: any) {
          setError(getApiError(err));
        } finally {
          setSaving(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const openDeleteShiftConfirm = async (id: string) => {
    let warning = "";
    try {
      const assignments = await api.getScheduleAssignments({ shiftId: id });
      const active = assignments.items.filter((a: any) => a.status === "scheduled" || a.status === "confirmed");
      if (active.length > 0) warning = `Có ${active.length} ca trực đang chờ xử lý sử dụng ca này. `;
    } catch {}
    Modal.confirm({
      title: "Xác nhận xóa",
      content: (
        <div>
          {warning && <Alert title={warning} type="warning" showIcon style={{ marginBottom: 8 }} />}
          <span>Xóa ca trực này?</span>
        </div>
      ),
      okText: "Xóa",
      cancelText: "Hủy",
      okButtonProps: { danger: true },
      onOk: async () => {
        setSaving(true);
        try {
          await api.deleteScheduleShift(id);
          onUpdate();
        } catch (err: any) {
          setError(getApiError(err));
        } finally {
          setSaving(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleCreateShift = async () => {
    if (!shiftName.trim()) { setError("Vui lòng nhập tên ca"); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.createScheduleShift({
        name: shiftName.trim(),
        startTime, endTime,
        minStaff: Math.max(1, Number(minStaff) || 1),
      });
      setShiftName("");
      onUpdate();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const createDefaults = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if (!zones.length) {
        await Promise.all([
          api.createScheduleZone({ floor: 1, zoneName: "Tầng 1" }),
          api.createScheduleZone({ floor: 2, zoneName: "Tầng 2" }),
        ]);
      }
      if (!shifts.length) {
        await Promise.all([
          api.createScheduleShift({ name: "Ca sáng", startTime: "07:30", endTime: "11:30", minStaff: 1 }),
          api.createScheduleShift({ name: "Ca chiều", startTime: "13:00", endTime: "17:00", minStaff: 1 }),
          api.createScheduleShift({ name: "Ca tối", startTime: "17:30", endTime: "20:30", minStaff: 1 }),
        ]);
      }
      onUpdate();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Drawer anchor="right" open={open} onClose={onClose} sx={{ zIndex: 1300 }}>
        <Box sx={{ width: { xs: "100%", sm: 400 }, height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 2, py: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Quản lý lịch trực
            </Typography>
            <IconButton onClick={onClose} size="small">
              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>

          <Tabs
            value={tab}
            onChange={(_, v) => setTab(v)}
            variant="fullWidth"
            sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", minHeight: 36 }}
          >
            <Tab label="Khu vực" value="zones" sx={{ minHeight: 36, py: 0, textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.8rem" }} />
            <Tab label="Ca trực" value="shifts" sx={{ minHeight: 36, py: 0, textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.8rem" }} />
          </Tabs>

          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
            {error && <Alert title={error} type="error" showIcon closable onClose={() => setError(null)} />}

            {tab === "zones" && (
              <>
                <Stack spacing={1}>
                  {zones.length === 0 && (
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>Chưa có khu vực nào</Typography>
                  )}
                  {zones.map((z) => (
                    <Box key={z.id} sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 1.5, py: 1, borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "background.paper", border: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{z.zoneName}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Tầng {z.floor}</Typography>
                      </Box>
                      <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => openDeleteZoneConfirm(z.id)}>
                        <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Box>
                  ))}
                </Stack>

                <Divider />

                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
                  <TextField
                    size="small"
                    type="number"
                    label="Tầng"
                    value={zoneFloor}
                    onChange={(e) => setZoneFloor(e.target.value)}
                    sx={{ width: 70 }}
                    slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1 } }}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    size="small"
                    placeholder="Tên khu vực"
                    value={zoneName}
                    onChange={(e) => setZoneName(e.target.value)}
                    fullWidth
                  />
                  <Button size="small" variant="contained" onClick={handleCreateZone} disabled={saving} startIcon={<AddIcon />}>
                    Thêm
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              </>
            )}

            {tab === "shifts" && (
              <>
                <Stack spacing={1}>
                  {shifts.length === 0 && (
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>Chưa có ca trực nào</Typography>
                  )}
                  {shifts.map((s) => (
                    <Box key={s.id} sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 1.5, py: 1, borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "background.paper", border: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{s.name}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {s.startTime?.slice(0, 5)}-{s.endTime?.slice(0, 5)} · {s.minStaff} NV
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                      <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => openDeleteShiftConfirm(s.id)}>
                        <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Box>
                  ))}
                </Stack>

                <Divider />

                <Stack spacing={1.5}>
                  <TextField
                    size="small"
                    placeholder="Tên ca (vd: Ca sáng)"
                    value={shiftName}
                    onChange={(e) => setShiftName(e.target.value)}
                    fullWidth
                  />
                   <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <TextField
                      size="small"
                      type="time"
                      value={startTime}
                      onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                      sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                    />
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">–</Typography>
                    <TextField
                      size="small"
                      type="time"
                      value={endTime}
                      onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                      sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                    />
                  </Stack>
                   <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>Số NV tối thiểu:</Typography>
                    <TextField
                      size="small"
                      type="number"
                      value={minStaff}
                      onChange={(e) => setMinStaff(e.target.value)}
                      sx={{ width: 70 }}
                      slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1 } }}
                    />
                    <Button size="small" variant="contained" onClick={handleCreateShift} disabled={saving} sx={{ ml: "auto" }} startIcon={<AddIcon />}>
                      Thêm
                    </Button>
                  </Stack>
                </Stack>
              </>
            )}
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ px: 2, py: 1.5, borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
            <Button
              fullWidth
              variant="outlined"
              size="small"
              onClick={createDefaults}
              disabled={saving}
            >
              {saving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : "Tạo mẫu (2 khu vực + 3 ca)"}
            </Button>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Drawer>

    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  CircularProgress,
  Divider,
  Drawer,
  IconButton,
  MenuItem,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  ToggleButton,
  ToggleButtonGroup,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import Alert from "antd/es/alert";
import Modal from "antd/es/modal";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Delete";
import AddIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Add";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { LibraryZone, StaffShift, ScheduleStaff } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  staff: ScheduleStaff[];
  onUpdated: () => void;
}

function getApiError(err: any): string {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  return data?.error || data?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra";
}

const DAYS = ["CN", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7"];

export default function TemplateManagementPanel({ open, onClose, zones, shifts, staff, onUpdated }: Props) {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [selectedDays, setSelectedDays] = useState<number[]>([1]);
  const [shiftId, setShiftId] = useState("");
  const [zoneId, setZoneId] = useState("");
  const [staffId, setStaffId] = useState("");
  const [validFrom, setValidFrom] = useState("");
  const [validTo, setValidTo] = useState("");

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await api.getScheduleTemplates();
      setTemplates(result);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) loadData();
  }, [open]);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!name.trim() || !shiftId || !zoneId || !staffId || selectedDays.length === 0) {
      setError("Vui lòng điền tên mẫu, chọn ca trực, khu vực, nhân viên và ít nhất 1 ngày trong tuần");
      return;
    }
    const duplicate = selectedDays.some((day) =>
      templates.some((t) => t.shiftId === shiftId && t.zoneId === zoneId && t.dayOfWeek === day && t.staffId === staffId)
    );
    if (duplicate) {
      setError("Nhân viên này đã có ca trực trong khung giờ/khu vực này vào ngày đã chọn");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      for (const day of selectedDays) {
        await api.createScheduleTemplate({
          name: name.trim(),
          dayOfWeek: day,
          shiftId,
          zoneId,
          staffId,
          validFrom: validFrom || undefined,
          validTo: validTo || undefined,
        });
      }
      setName(""); setShiftId(""); setZoneId(""); setStaffId(""); setValidFrom(""); setValidTo("");
      setSelectedDays([1]);
      await loadData();
      onUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const openDeleteConfirm = (id: string) => {
    Modal.confirm({
      title: "Xác nhận xóa",
      content: "Xóa mẫu lịch này?",
      okText: "Xóa",
      cancelText: "Hủy",
      okButtonProps: { danger: true },
      onOk: async () => {
        try {
          await api.deleteScheduleTemplate(id);
          await loadData();
          onUpdated();
        } catch (err) {
          setError(getApiError(err));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const getStaffName = (id: string) => {
    const s = staff.find((x) => x.id === id);
    return s?.fullName || s?.email || "Nhân viên";
  };
  const getShiftName = (id: string) => shifts.find((s) => s.id === id)?.name || "Ca";
  const getZoneName = (id: string) => zones.find((z) => z.id === id)?.zoneName || "Khu vực";

  return (
    <>
      <Drawer anchor="right" open={open} onClose={onClose} sx={{ zIndex: 1300 }}>
        <Box sx={{ width: { xs: "100%", sm: 420 }, height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 2, py: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Mẫu lịch tự động
            </Typography>
            <IconButton onClick={onClose} size="small">
              <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 }}>
            {error && <Alert title={error} type="error" showIcon closable onClose={() => setError(null)} />}

            <Stack spacing={1.5}>
              <TextField
                size="small"
                placeholder="Tên mẫu (vd: Ca sáng T2-T6)"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                fullWidth
              />

              <Box>
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", mb: 0.5 }}>Ngày trong tuần</Typography>
                <ToggleButtonGroup
                  value={selectedDays}
                  onChange={(_, v) => setSelectedDays(v)}
                  size="small"
                  sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5, "& .MuiToggleButton-root": { px: 1, py: 0.25, fontSize: "0.7rem", textTransform: "none", borderRadius: 1 } }}
                >
                  {DAYS.map((d, i) => (
                    <ToggleButton key={i} value={i}>{d}</ToggleButton>
                  ))}
                </ToggleButtonGroup>
              </Box>

              <TextField
                select
                size="small"
                label="Ca trực"
                value={shiftId}
                onChange={(e) => setShiftId(e.target.value)}
                fullWidth
              >
                <MenuItem value="">Chọn ca trực</MenuItem>
                {shifts.filter((s) => s.isActive).map((s) => (
                  <MenuItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name} ({s.startTime?.slice(0, 5)}-{s.endTime?.slice(0, 5)})</MenuItem>
                ))}
              </TextField>

              <TextField
                select
                size="small"
                label="Khu vực"
                value={zoneId}
                onChange={(e) => setZoneId(e.target.value)}
                fullWidth
              >
                <MenuItem value="">Chọn khu vực</MenuItem>
                {zones.filter((z) => z.isActive).map((z) => (
                  <MenuItem key={z.id} value={z.id}>{z.zoneName} (Tầng {z.floor})</MenuItem>
                ))}
              </TextField>

              <TextField
                select
                size="small"
                label="Nhân viên"
                value={staffId}
                onChange={(e) => setStaffId(e.target.value)}
                fullWidth
              >
                <MenuItem value="">Chọn nhân viên</MenuItem>
                {staff.map((s) => (
                  <MenuItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.fullName || s.email}</MenuItem>
                ))}
              </TextField>

              <Box>
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", mb: 0.5 }}>Thời hạn áp dụng</Typography>
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
                  <Button
                    size="small"
                    variant={!validFrom && !validTo ? "contained" : "outlined"}
                    onClick={() => { setValidFrom(""); setValidTo(""); }}
                    sx={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", textTransform: "none" }}
                  >
                    Vô thời hạn
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    size="small"
                    variant={validFrom && validTo && validFrom.startsWith(`${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(new Date().getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`) ? "contained" : "outlined"}
                    onClick={() => {
                      const now = new Date();
                      const first = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
                      const last = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0);
                      setValidFrom(first.toISOString().split("T")[0]);
                      setValidTo(last.toISOString().split("T")[0]);
                    }}
                    sx={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", textTransform: "none" }}
                  >
                    Tháng này
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    size="small"
                    variant={validFrom && validTo && validFrom.startsWith(`${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(new Date().getMonth() + 2).padStart(2, '0')}`) ? "contained" : "outlined"}
                    onClick={() => {
                      const now = new Date();
                      const first = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 1);
                      const last = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 2, 0);
                      setValidFrom(first.toISOString().split("T")[0]);
                      setValidTo(last.toISOString().split("T")[0]);
                    }}
                    sx={{ fontSize: "0.65rem", textTransform: "none" }}
                  >
                    Tháng sau
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
                  <TextField
                    size="small"
                    type="date"
                    label="Từ ngày"
                    value={validFrom}
                    onChange={(e) => setValidFrom(e.target.value)}
                    sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                    slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    size="small"
                    type="date"
                    label="Đến ngày"
                    value={validTo}
                    onChange={(e) => setValidTo(e.target.value)}
                    sx={{ flex: 1 }}
                    slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                  />
                </Stack>
              </Box>

              <Button
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                size="small"
                onClick={handleCreate}
                disabled={saving}
                startIcon={saving ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : <AddIcon />}
              >
                {saving ? "Đang tạo..." : "Thêm mẫu"}
              </Button>
            </Stack>

            <Divider />

            <Box>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                Đã tạo ({templates.length})
              </Typography>
              {loading && <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", mt: 0.5 }}>Đang tải...</Typography>}
              {!loading && templates.length === 0 && (
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", mt: 0.5 }}>Chưa có mẫu nào</Typography>
              )}
              <Stack spacing={0.5} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                {templates.map((t) => (
                  <Box key={t.id} sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 1.5, py: 1, borderRadius: 1, bgcolor: "background.paper", border: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                    <Box>
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{t.name}</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {DAYS[t.dayOfWeek]} · {getShiftName(t.shiftId)} · {getZoneName(t.zoneId)}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block" }}>
                        {getStaffName(t.staffId)}
                        {t.validFrom ? ` (${t.validFrom} → ${t.validTo || "..."})` : " (Vô thời hạn)"}
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                    <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => openDeleteConfirm(t.id)}>
                      <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </Box>
                ))}
              </Stack>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Drawer>

    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Avatar, Box, Stack, Typography, type SxProps, type Theme } from "@mui/material";
import { initials, stringToColor } from "@/lib/utils";

const ROLE_GRADIENT: Record<string, string> = {
  admin: "linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B89628 100%)",
  staff: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
  patron: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
};

export interface AvatarUserProps {
  user?: {
    full_name?: string | null;
    fullName?: string | null;
    name?: string | null;
    email?: string | null;
    avatar_url?: string | null;
    avatarUrl?: string | null;
    role?: string | null;
  } | null;
  name?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  avatarUrl?: string | null;
  role?: string | null;
  size?: number;
  showName?: boolean;
  showRole?: boolean;
  border?: boolean | string;
  sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
  className?: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
}

export default function AvatarUser({
  user,
  name,
  email,
  avatarUrl,
  role,
  size = 36,
  showName = false,
  showRole = false,
  border = false,
  sx,
  className,
  onClick,
}: AvatarUserProps) {
  const [imgError, setImgError] = useState(false);

  const displayName =
    user?.full_name ||
    user?.fullName ||
    user?.name ||
    name ||
    user?.email ||
    email?.split("@")[0] ||
    "User";

  const rawUrl = user?.avatar_url || user?.avatarUrl || avatarUrl;
  const effectiveAvatarUrl = imgError ? undefined : rawUrl || undefined;
  const effectiveRole = (user?.role || role || "").toLowerCase();

  const bgGradient = ROLE_GRADIENT[effectiveRole] || stringToColor(displayName);

  const borderStyle =
    typeof border === "string"
      ? border
      : border
      ? "2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.85)"
      : "none";

  const avatarNode = (
    <Avatar
      src={effectiveAvatarUrl}
      slotProps={{
        img: {
          onError: () => setImgError(true),
        },
      }}
      className={className}
      onClick={onClick}
      sx={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        background: effectiveAvatarUrl ? "transparent" : bgGradient,
        color: "#ffffff",
        fontWeight: 750,
        fontSize: Math.max(10, Math.round(size * 0.38)),
        boxShadow: "0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)",
        border: borderStyle,
        flexShrink: 0,
        cursor: onClick ? "pointer" : "inherit",
        ...sx,
      }}
    >
      {initials(displayName)}
    </Avatar>
  );

  if (!showName) {
    return avatarNode;
  }

  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.25} sx={{ alignItems: "center", minWidth: 0 }}>
      {avatarNode}
      <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.3 }} noWrap>
          {displayName}
        </Typography>
        {showRole && effectiveRole ? (
          <Typography
            variant="caption"
            color="text.secondary"
            sx={{ textTransform: "capitalize", display: "block" }}
            noWrap
          >
            {effectiveRole === "admin"
              ? "Quản trị viên"
              : effectiveRole === "staff"
              ? "Nhân viên"
              : "Độc giả"}
          </Typography>
        ) : email || user?.email ? (
          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block" }} noWrap>
            {email || user?.email}
          </Typography>
        ) : null}
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  Paper,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  Step,
  StepLabel,
  Stepper,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import CheckCircleOutlineIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import BadgeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/BadgeOutlined";
import SchoolIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SchoolOutlined";
import ArrowBackIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack";
import ArrowForwardIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward";

import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { initials } from "@/lib/utils";
import { StudentCardScanner, type ScannedCardData } from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/scanner";
import type { CaptureAngle } from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/MultiAngleCapture";
import MultiAngleCapture from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/MultiAngleCapture";
import type { PatronPublic } from "@/lib/types";

const _RAW_CAM_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BORROW_CAM_URL;
const CARD_CAM_URL = _RAW_CAM_URL ? `/api/camera/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(_RAW_CAM_URL)}` : "";

function QrCodeSvg({ value }: { value: string }) {
  const size = 110;
  const cellSize = 4;
  const cells = value.split("").map((_, i) => ({
    x: (i % 25) * cellSize,
    y: Math.floor(i / 25) * cellSize,
    visible: (value.charCodeAt(i) + i) % 3 !== 0,
  }));
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${25 * cellSize} ${25 * cellSize}`} xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <rect width={25 * cellSize} height={25 * cellSize} fill="white" rx={4} />
      {cells.filter((c) => c.visible).map((c, i) => (
        <rect key={i} x={c.x} y={c.y} width={cellSize} height={cellSize} fill="black" rx={0.5} />
      ))}
      {[[0, 0], [18, 0], [0, 18]].map(([ox, oy], i) => (
        <g key={`finder-${i}`}>
          <rect x={ox} y={oy} width={7 * cellSize} height={7 * cellSize} fill="black" rx={1} />
          <rect x={ox + cellSize} y={oy + cellSize} width={5 * cellSize} height={5 * cellSize} fill="white" rx={0.5} />
          <rect x={ox + 2 * cellSize} y={oy + 2 * cellSize} width={3 * cellSize} height={3 * cellSize} fill="black" rx={0.5} />
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

interface PatronWizardProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onComplete: () => void;
}

type Notice = { severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info"; message: string } | null;

const initialFormData = {
  fullName: "",
  studentCode: "",
  className: "",
  course: "",
  email: "",
  phone: "",
  identityNumber: "",
  permanentAddress: "",
  issueDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
  membershipExpiry: (() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + 1);
    return d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
  })(),
};

const steps = ["Quét thẻ", "Xác minh", "Khuôn mặt", "Hoàn tất"];

export default function PatronWizard({ open, onClose, onComplete }: PatronWizardProps) {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(initialFormData);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [scannedFromCard, setScannedFromCard] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [newPatron, setNewPatron] = useState<PatronPublic | null>(null);
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice>(null);

  const showNotice = (severity: NonNullable<Notice>["severity"], message: string) => {
    setNotice({ severity, message });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setCurrentStep(0);
      setFormData(initialFormData);
      setErrors({});
      setScannedFromCard(false);
      setSubmitting(false);
      setNewPatron(null);
      setConsent(false);
    }
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && currentStep === 1) {
      const studentCode = formData.studentCode || "";
      const course = formData.course || "";
      let startYear = 0;
      let endYear = 0;
      const years = course.match(/\b(20\d{2})\b/g);
      if (years && years.length > 0) {
        startYear = parseInt(years[0]);
        endYear = years.length > 1 ? parseInt(years[1]) : startYear + 4;
      } else if (studentCode && studentCode.match(/^(1[0-9]|2[0-9])/)) {
        const prefix = parseInt(studentCode.substring(0, 2));
        startYear = 2000 + prefix;
        endYear = startYear + 4;
      }
      if (startYear > 0 && endYear > 0) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          issueDate: `${startYear}-09-01`,
          membershipExpiry: `${endYear}-09-01`,
        }));
      }
    }
  }, [currentStep, open, formData.studentCode, formData.course]);

  const handleCardScanned = useCallback((data: ScannedCardData) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      fullName: data.fullName || prev.fullName,
      studentCode: data.studentCode || prev.studentCode,
      className: data.className || prev.className,
      course: data.course || prev.course,
      permanentAddress: data.permanentAddress || prev.permanentAddress,
    }));
    setScannedFromCard(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCurrentStep(1), 600);
  }, []);

  const handleChange = (field: keyof typeof initialFormData) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: e.target.value }));
    if (errors[field]) {
      setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: "" }));
    }
  };

  const validate = () => {
    const errs: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!formData.fullName.trim()) errs.fullName = "Vui lòng nhập họ và tên";
    if (!formData.studentCode.trim()) {
      errs.studentCode = "Vui lòng nhập MSSV";
    } else if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(formData.studentCode.trim())) {
      errs.studentCode = "MSSV chỉ chứa chữ và số";
    }
    if (formData.email && !/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(formData.email)) {
      errs.email = "Email không hợp lệ";
    }
    if (formData.phone && !/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(formData.phone)) {
      errs.phone = "Số điện thoại phải gồm 10 chữ số";
    }
    if (!formData.membershipExpiry) {
      errs.membershipExpiry = "Vui lòng chọn hạn thẻ";
    }
    setErrors(errs);
    return Object.keys(errs).length === 0;
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (validate()) {
      setCurrentStep(2);
    }
  };

  const handleSkipFace = async () => {
    if (!validate()) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const patron = await api.createPatron({
        full_name: formData.fullName,
        student_code: formData.studentCode,
        class_name: formData.className || undefined,
        course: formData.course || undefined,
        email: formData.email || undefined,
        phone: formData.phone || undefined,
        identity_number: formData.identityNumber || undefined,
        permanent_address: formData.permanentAddress || undefined,
        issue_date: formData.issueDate || undefined,
        membership_expiry: formData.membershipExpiry || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      });
      setNewPatron(patron);
      setCurrentStep(3);
      onComplete();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.response?.status === 409) {
        showNotice("error", "MSSV hoặc mã thẻ đã tồn tại trong hệ thống.");
      } else {
        showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể tạo độc giả");
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFaceReady = async (files: Record<CaptureAngle, File>) => {
    if (!validate()) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const patron = await api.createPatron({
        full_name: formData.fullName,
        student_code: formData.studentCode,
        class_name: formData.className || undefined,
        course: formData.course || undefined,
        email: formData.email || undefined,
        phone: formData.phone || undefined,
        identity_number: formData.identityNumber || undefined,
        permanent_address: formData.permanentAddress || undefined,
        issue_date: formData.issueDate || undefined,
        membership_expiry: formData.membershipExpiry || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      });
      await api.enrollPatronFaceBatch(patron.id, files);
      setNewPatron(patron);
      setCurrentStep(3);
      onComplete();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.response?.status === 409) {
        showNotice("error", "MSSV hoặc mã thẻ đã tồn tại trong hệ thống.");
      } else {
        showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể tạo độc giả");
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendEmail = () => {
    showNotice("info", "Tính năng gửi email thông báo tự động đang được hoàn thiện.");
  };

  const handleResetWizard = () => {
    setCurrentStep(0);
    setFormData(initialFormData);
    setErrors({});
    setScannedFromCard(false);
    setNewPatron(null);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} fullScreen slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { bgcolor: "background.default" } } }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <Box sx={{ p: 2.5, px: 4, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", bgcolor: "background.paper", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <BadgeIcon sx={{ color: "primary.main", fontSize: 28 }} />
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>Cấp Phát Thẻ Độc Giả</Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Hệ thống thư viện thông minh Đại học Công nghiệp TP.HCM</Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
        <Button color="inherit" onClick={onClose} startIcon={<CloseIcon />} sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}>
          Đóng
        </Button>
      </Box>

      {/* Stepper Progress */}
      <Box sx={{ py: 3, bgcolor: "background.paper", borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
        <Box sx={{ maxWidth: 800, mx: "auto", px: 4 }}>
          <Stepper activeStep={currentStep} alternativeLabel>
            {steps.map((label) => (
              <Step key={label}>
                <StepLabel
                  sx={{
                    "& .MuiStepLabel-label": { fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.875rem" },
                    "& .Mui-active": { color: "primary.main" },
                    "& .Mui-completed": { color: "success.main" },
                  }}
                >
                  {label}
                </StepLabel>
              </Step>
            ))}
          </Stepper>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      <DialogContent sx={{ p: { xs: 2, md: 4 }, display: "flex", justifyContent: "center" }}>
        <Box sx={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 1000 }}>
          {/* BƯỚC 1: QUÉT THẺ */}
          {currentStep === 0 && (
            <Stack spacing={3}>
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 1 }}>Quét thẻ sinh viên</Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  Đặt thẻ sinh viên vào vùng camera để hệ thống tự động nhận diện và trích xuất thông tin.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Paper
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: 3,
                  overflow: "hidden",
                  border: "2px dashed",
                  borderColor: "primary.light",
                  bgcolor: "background.paper",
                }}
              >
                <StudentCardScanner
                  onScanned={handleCardScanned}
                  onError={(msg) => showNotice("warning", `Lỗi quét thẻ: ${msg}`)}
                  onSkip={() => setCurrentStep(1)}
                  videoSource="ipcamera"
                  ipCameraUrl={CARD_CAM_URL}
                />
              </Paper>
            </Stack>
          )}

          {/* BƯỚC 2: XÁC MINH THÔNG TIN */}
          {currentStep === 1 && (
            <Stack spacing={3} component="form" onSubmit={handleFormSubmit}>
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 1 }}>Xác minh thông tin độc giả</Typography>
                {scannedFromCard ? (
                  <Alert severity="success" sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
                    Đã trích xuất thông tin tự động từ thẻ sinh viên. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại trước khi lưu.
                  </Alert>
                ) : (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    Vui lòng điền thông tin chi tiết của độc giả mới vào biểu mẫu dưới đây.
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </Box>

              <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", md: "1fr 1fr" }, gap: 3 }}>
                {/* Academic info */}
                <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 3, borderRadius: 2.5 }}>
                  <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
                    Thông tin học vụ
                  </Typography>
                  <Stack spacing={2}>
                    <TextField
                      label="Họ và tên *"
                      value={formData.fullName}
                      onChange={handleChange("fullName")}
                      error={Boolean(errors.fullName)}
                      helperText={errors.fullName}
                      fullWidth
                      size="small"
                      placeholder="Nguyễn Văn A"
                    />
                    <TextField
                      label="MSSV *"
                      value={formData.studentCode}
                      onChange={handleChange("studentCode")}
                      error={Boolean(errors.studentCode)}
                      helperText={errors.studentCode}
                      fullWidth
                      size="small"
                      placeholder="21012345"
                    />
                    <TextField
                      label="Khóa học"
                      value={formData.course}
                      onChange={handleChange("course")}
                      fullWidth
                      size="small"
                      placeholder="K17 (2021 - 2025)"
                    />
                    <TextField
                      label="Lớp sinh hoạt"
                      value={formData.className}
                      onChange={handleChange("className")}
                      fullWidth
                      size="small"
                      placeholder="DHKTPM17A"
                    />
                  </Stack>
                </Paper>

                {/* Library credentials */}
                <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 3, borderRadius: 2.5 }}>

                    Cấp quyền & Liên hệ

                  <Stack spacing={2}>

                    />
                    <TextField

              <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "1fr 1fr" }, gap: 2 }}>

                  onChange={handleChange("issueDate")}
                  fullWidth
                  size="small"
                  slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                />
                <TextField
                  label="Hạn sử dụng thẻ *"
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.membershipExpiry}
                  onChange={handleChange("membershipExpiry")}
                  error={Boolean(errors.membershipExpiry)}
                  helperText={errors.membershipExpiry}
                  fullWidth
                  size="small"
                  slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                />
              </Box>

              <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", pt: 2 }}>
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentStep(0)}
                  startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 3, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Quay lại
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  type="submit"
                  endIcon={<ArrowForwardIcon />}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 4, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Tiếp tục thu thập khuôn mặt
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </Stack>
          )}

          {/* BƯỚC 3: KHUÔN MẶT */}
          {currentStep === 2 && (
            <Stack spacing={3}>
              <Box>
                <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 1 }}>Thu thập khuôn mặt sinh trắc học</Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  Hướng mặt về phía camera để hệ thống ghi nhận đa góc khuôn mặt cho tính năng AI Face Recognition.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden", p: 2, bgcolor: "background.paper" }}>
                <MultiAngleCapture consent={consent} setConsent={setConsent} onFilesReady={handleFaceReady} />
              </Paper>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentStep(1)}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 3, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Quay lại
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  onClick={handleSkipFace}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 4, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}

                  {submitting ? <CircularProgress size={20} color="inherit" sx={{ mr: 1 }} /> : null}

                </Typography>
              </Box>

              {/* IUH Virtual Card */}
              <Paper
                elevation={6}

                  aspectRatio: "1.586",
                  borderRadius: 4,
                  color: "white",
                  p: 3,
                  background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #0A2540 100%)",
                  boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.25)",
                  position: "relative",

                  justifyContent: "space-between",

              >

                  <SchoolIcon sx={{ fontSize: 240, color: "white" }} />
                </Box>

                {/* Card Header */}
                <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", zIndex: 1 }}>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ letterSpacing: 1.5, textTransform: "uppercase", fontWeight: 700, color: "#FCD34D" }}>
                      ĐẠI HỌC CÔNG NGHIỆP TP.HCM
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, opacity: 0.9 }}>
                      THẺ ĐỘC GIẢ THƯ VIỆN
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Chip
                    label="ACTIVE"
                    size="small"
                    sx={{ bgcolor: "rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.9)", color: "white", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.7rem" }}
                  />

                {/* Card Body */}
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={2.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", zIndex: 1 }}>
                  <Avatar
                    sx={{

                      height: 60,

                      fontSize: 22,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      border: "2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4)",
                    }}
                  >
                    {initials(newPatron.full_name)}
                  </Avatar>
                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, fontSize: "0.95rem", lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                      {newPatron.full_name}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.95, fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", mt: 0.5 }}>
                      MSSV: {newPatron.student_code}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ opacity: 0.8, display: "block" }}>
                      Lớp: {newPatron.class_name || "N/A"}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box sx={{ bgcolor: "white", p: 0.75, borderRadius: 1.5, display: "flex" }}>
                    <QrCodeSvg value={newPatron.student_code || newPatron.id} />
                  </Box>
                </Stack>
              </Paper>

              <Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  onClick={handleResetWizard}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 4, py: 1.2, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Cấp thẻ tiếp theo
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  onClick={handleSendEmail}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 3, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Gửi qua Email
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </Stack>
          )}
        </Box>
      </DialogContent>

      <Snackbar
        open={Boolean(notice)}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        {notice ? (
          <Alert
            onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
            severity={notice.severity}
            variant="filled"
            sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: "8px", boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}
          >
            {notice.message}
          </Alert>
        ) : undefined}
      </Snackbar>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
