"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
  LinearProgress,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AutoAwesomeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesomeOutlined";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CloseOutlined";
import LightbulbIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LightbulbOutlined";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { AIBookRecommendation, AIBookRecommendationResponse } from "@/lib/types";
import { fadeInUp } from "@/lib/animations";

export default function BookRecommendations({
  studentCode,
  onClose,
}: {
  studentCode: string;
  onClose?: () => void;
}) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<AIBookRecommendationResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!studentCode) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    api
      .getBookRecommendations(studentCode)
      .then(setData)
      .catch(() => setError("Không thể tải gợi ý sách"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [studentCode]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 3 }}>
        <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <CircularProgress size={24} />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">AI đang phân tích sở thích đọc sách...</Typography>
        </Stack>
      </Paper>
    );
  }

  if (error) return null;

  if (!data || !data.recommendations.length) return null;

  return (
    <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 2, borderColor: "primary.light", bgcolor: (t) => t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(139,0,0,0.05)" : "rgba(139,0,0,0.02)" }}>
      <Stack spacing={2}>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <AutoAwesomeIcon sx={{ color: "primary.main" }} fontSize="small" />
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>
              Gợi ý sách cho {data.patron_name}
            </Typography>
            <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" label="AI đề xuất" color="primary" />
          </Stack>
          {onClose && (
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={onClose}><CloseIcon fontSize="small" /></IconButton>
          )}
        </Stack>

        <Box sx={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", md: "repeat(3, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(5, 1fr)" },
          gap: 2,
        }}>
          {data.recommendations.slice(0, 5).map((book, idx) => (
            <RecommendationCard key={book.book_id || book.isbn} book={book} index={idx} />
          ))}
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Paper>
  );
}

function RecommendationCard({ book, index }: { book: AIBookRecommendation; index: number }) {
  return (
    <Card
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.35s ease-out`,
        animationDelay: `${index * 0.08}s`,
        animationFillMode: "both",
        "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.main", boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(139,0,0,0.12)" },
      }}
    >
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2, "&:last-child": { pb: 2 } }}>
        <Stack spacing={1}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 1.5, alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
            {book.cover_url ? (
              <Box
                component="img"
                src={book.cover_url}
                alt={book.title}
                sx={{
                  width: 42,
                  height: 58,
                  objectFit: "cover",
                  borderRadius: 0.5,
                  flexShrink: 0,
                  bgcolor: "background.default",
                }}
              />
            ) : (
              <Avatar
                variant="rounded"
                sx={{ width: 42, height: 58, bgcolor: "background.default", flexShrink: 0 }}
              >
                <BookIcon fontSize="small" />
              </Avatar>
            )}
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900, lineHeight: 1.3 }} noWrap>{book.title}</Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>{book.author}</Typography>
              {book.category && (
                <Chip size="small" label={book.category} sx={{ mt: 0.5, height: 18, fontSize: 10 }} />
              )}
            </Box>
          </Box>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <LightbulbIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: "warning.main" }} />
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{book.reason}</Typography>
          </Stack>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
            <LinearProgress
              variant="determinate"
              value={book.relevance_score}
              color={book.relevance_score >= 70 ? "success" : book.relevance_score >= 40 ? "warning" : "primary"}
              sx={{ flex: 1, height: 4, borderRadius: 4 }}
            />
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ flexShrink: 0, fontWeight: 700 }}>
              {book.relevance_score}%
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Suspense, useRef, useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Canvas, useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { OrbitControls, Text } from "@react-three/drei";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { Box, Typography } from "@mui/material";

// Mock data for the 3D visualization
const MOCK_DATA = [
  { label: "CNTT", value: 45, color: "#0A2540" },
  { label: "Kinh tế", value: 30, color: "#059669" },
  { label: "Cơ khí", value: 25, color: "#D97706" },
  { label: "Ngoại ngữ", value: 15, color: "#D4AF37" },
  { label: "Điện tử", value: 35, color: "#8B0000" },
  { label: "Luật", value: 20, color: "#64748B" },
];

function Bar3D({ position, height, color, label }: { position: [number, number, number]; height: number; color: string; label: string }) {
  const meshRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);

  // Normalize height for display
  const displayHeight = height / 10;
  
  // Animated float effect on hover
  const targetY = hovered ? displayHeight / 2 + 0.5 : displayHeight / 2;

  useFrame((state, delta) => {
    if (meshRef.current) {
      meshRef.current.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        meshRef.current.position.y,
        targetY,
        delta * 5
      );
    }
  });

  return (
    <group position={[position[0], 0, position[2]]}>
      <mesh
        ref={meshRef}
        position={[0, displayHeight / 2, 0]}
        onPointerOver={() => setHovered(true)}
        onPointerOut={() => setHovered(false)}
      >
        <boxGeometry args={[1, displayHeight, 1]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial 
          color={color} 
          roughness={0.2} 
          metalness={0.1}
          emissive={color}
          emissiveIntensity={hovered ? 0.5 : 0}
        />
      </mesh>
      
      {/* Label under the bar */}
      <Text
        position={[0, -0.5, 0]}
        rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}
        fontSize={0.4}
        color="#333333"
        anchorX="center"
        anchorY="middle"
      >
        {label}
      </Text>
      
      {/* Value on top of the bar (only when hovered) */}
      {hovered && (
        <Text
          position={[0, displayHeight + 1, 0]}
          fontSize={0.5}
          color={color}
          anchorX="center"
          anchorY="middle"
        >
          {height}
        </Text>
      )}
    </group>
  );
}

function GridFloor() {
  return (
    <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.1, 0]} receiveShadow>
      <planeGeometry args={[20, 20]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#f0f0f0" />
      <gridHelper args={[20, 20, "#cccccc", "#e0e0e0"]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

export default function DataVisualization3D() {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: "100%", height: 350, position: "relative", borderRadius: 2, overflow: "hidden", bgcolor: "#fafafa" }}>
      <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: 16, left: 16, zIndex: 1, pointerEvents: "none" }}>
        <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: "bold" }}>
          TƯƠNG QUAN MƯỢN SÁCH THEO KHOA
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.disabled">
          Tương tác: Kéo thả để xoay • Cuộn để zoom • Trỏ chuột vào cột
        </Typography>
      </Box>
      <Suspense fallback={<Box sx={{ width: "100%", height: 350, bgcolor: "action.hover", backdropFilter: "blur(8px)", WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(8px)" }} />}>
      <Canvas shadows camera={{ position: [5, 5, 8], fov: 50 }}>
        <ambientLight intensity={0.5} />
        <directionalLight 
          position={[10, 10, 5]} 
          intensity={1} 
          castShadow 
          shadow-mapSize-width={1024} 
          shadow-mapSize-height={1024} 
        />
        
        <GridFloor />
        
        {/* Layout bars in a circle or line */}
        <group position={[-((MOCK_DATA.length - 1) * 1.5) / 2, 0, 0]}>
          {MOCK_DATA.map((item, index) => (
            <Bar3D 
              key={item.label}
              position={[index * 1.5, 0, 0]}
              height={item.value}
              color={item.color}
              label={item.label}
            />
          ))}
        </group>

        <OrbitControls 
          enablePan={false}
          minPolarAngle={0}
          maxPolarAngle={Math.PI / 2 - 0.1} // Prevent going below floor
          minDistance={3}
          maxDistance={15}
          autoRotate
          autoRotateSpeed={0.5}
        />
      </Canvas>
      </Suspense>
    </Box>
  );
}

  const primaryColor = theme.palette.primary.main;
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { refreshPermissions } = usePermission();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<number>(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [routeSearch, setRouteSearch] = useState<string>("");
  const [routeFilter, setRouteFilter] = useState<"all" | "allowed" | "blocked">("all");

  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: "success" | "error" | "info" }>({
    open: false,
    message: "",
    severity: "info",
  });

  // Role Matrix State
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState<Record<string, RolePermissionConfig>>(DEFAULT_FALLBACK_ROLES);
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState<string>("staff");

  // Custom Role Modal State
  const [openNewRoleModal, setOpenNewRoleModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [newRoleName, setNewRoleName] = useState<string>("");
  const [newRoleLabel, setNewRoleLabel] = useState<string>("");

  // User Overrides State
  const [staffList, setStaffList] = useState<ScheduleStaff[]>([]);
  const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState<string>("");
  const [userOverride, setUserOverride] = useState<UserPermissionOverride>({
    enabled: false,
    grantedPages: [],
    revokedPages: [],
    grantedCrud: {},
    revokedCrud: {},
  });

  // Load initial data: Role matrix & Staff list
  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      try {
        const matrixRes = await api.getPermissionMatrix();
        if (matrixRes && matrixRes.roles) {
          setRoles(matrixRes.roles);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.warn("[DynamicAdmin] Could not load permission matrix from API, using defaults:", err?.message);
      }

      try {
        const staffRes = await api.getScheduleStaffOptions();
        if (Array.isArray(staffRes) && staffRes.length > 0) {
          setStaffList(staffRes);
          setSelectedUserId(staffRes[0].id);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.warn("[DynamicAdmin] Could not load staff list:", err?.message);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  // Load user override when selectedUserId changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedUserId) return;
    let isCancelled = false;

    const fetchOverride = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await api.getUserPermissionOverride(selectedUserId);
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setUserOverride(
            res || {
              enabled: false,
              grantedPages: [],
              revokedPages: [],
              grantedCrud: {},
              revokedCrud: {},
            }
          );
        }
      } catch {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setUserOverride({
            enabled: false,
            grantedPages: [],
            revokedPages: [],
            grantedCrud: {},
            revokedCrud: {},
          });
        }
      }
    };

    fetchOverride();
    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [selectedUserId]);

  const activeRoleConfig = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      roles[selectedRole] || {
        role: selectedRole,
        label: selectedRole,
        allowedPages: [],
        crud: {
          books: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false },
          patrons: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
          borrows: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
          schedules: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
          ai_tools: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
          settings: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
          stats: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false },
        },
      }
    );
  }, [roles, selectedRole]);

  // ROLE CONFIG HANDLERS
  const handleToggleRouteForRole = (path: string) => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;

    setRoles((prev) => {
      const current = prev[selectedRole] || activeRoleConfig;
      const pages = new Set(current.allowedPages);
      if (pages.has(path)) {
        pages.delete(path);
      } else {
        pages.add(path);
      }
      return {
        ...prev,
        [selectedRole]: {
          ...current,
          allowedPages: Array.from(pages),
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const handleToggleAllRoutesForRole = (enableAll: boolean) => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;

    setRoles((prev) => {
      const current = prev[selectedRole] || activeRoleConfig;
      return {
        ...prev,
        [selectedRole]: {
          ...current,
          allowedPages: enableAll ? ALL_ROUTES.map((r) => r.path) : ["/dashboard"],
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const handleToggleCategoryRoutesForRole = (category: string, enableAll: boolean) => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;

    const categoryPaths = ALL_ROUTES.filter((r) => r.category === category).map((r) => r.path);
    setRoles((prev) => {
      const current = prev[selectedRole] || activeRoleConfig;
      const currentPages = new Set(current.allowedPages || []);
      categoryPaths.forEach((p) => {
        if (p === "/dashboard") return;
        if (enableAll) currentPages.add(p);
        else currentPages.delete(p);
      });
      return {
        ...prev,
        [selectedRole]: {
          ...current,
          allowedPages: Array.from(currentPages),
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const handleToggleCrudForRole = (resource: SystemResource, action: CrudAction) => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;

    setRoles((prev) => {
      const current = prev[selectedRole] || activeRoleConfig;
      const currentVal = Boolean(current.crud?.[resource]?.[action]);
      return {
        ...prev,
        [selectedRole]: {
          ...current,
          crud: {
            ...current.crud,
            [resource]: {
              ...current.crud[resource],
              [action]: !currentVal,
            },
          },
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSetResourcePresetForRole = (resource: SystemResource, preset: "full" | "readonly") => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;

    setRoles((prev) => {
      const current = prev[selectedRole] || activeRoleConfig;
      const newPerms =
        preset === "full"
          ? { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true }
          : { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
      return {
        ...prev,
        [selectedRole]: {
          ...current,
          crud: {
            ...current.crud,
            [resource]: newPerms,
          },
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const handleApplyRoleTemplate = (template: "circulation" | "cataloging" | "assistant") => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;

    setRoles((prev) => {
      const current = prev[selectedRole] || activeRoleConfig;
      let allowedPages: string[] = [];
      const crud: Record<SystemResource, any> = {
        books: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        patrons: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        borrows: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        schedules: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        ai_tools: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        settings: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
        stats: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
      };

      if (template === "circulation") {
        allowedPages = [
          "/dashboard",
          "/patrons",
          "/active",
          "/gate",
          "/history",
          "/borrow",
          "/return",
          "/books",
          "/staff-schedules",
          "/profile",
          "/notifications",
        ];
        crud.borrows = { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: true, print: true };
        crud.patrons = { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: true, print: true };
        crud.books = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: true };
        crud.schedules = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
      } else if (template === "cataloging") {
        allowedPages = [
          "/dashboard",
          "/books",
          "/patrons",
          "/stats",
          "/profile",
          "/notifications",
        ];
        crud.books = { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true };
        crud.patrons = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
        crud.borrows = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
        crud.stats = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: true };
      } else if (template === "assistant") {
        allowedPages = [
          "/dashboard",
          "/borrow",
          "/return",
          "/gate",
          "/history",
          "/active",
          "/profile",
        ];
        crud.borrows = { create: true, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
        crud.books = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
        crud.patrons = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false };
      }

      return {
        ...prev,
        [selectedRole]: {
          ...current,
          allowedPages,
          crud,
        },
      };
    });

    const labelMap = {
      circulation: "Thủ thư Quầy Lưu hành",
      cataloging: "Thủ thư Kho & Biên mục",
      assistant: "Cộng tác viên Sinh viên",
    };

    setToast({
      open: true,
      message: `Đã áp dụng mẫu [${labelMap[template]}]! Nhấn nút 'Lưu quyền chức vụ' để lưu vĩnh viễn.`,
      severity: "info",
    });
  };

  const handleSaveRoleConfig = async () => {
    if (selectedRole === "admin") return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const configToSave = roles[selectedRole];
      await api.updateRolePermissions(selectedRole, configToSave);
      await refreshPermissions();
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: `Đã lưu thành công cấu hình phân quyền vai trò [${configToSave.label || selectedRole}]!`,
        severity: "success",
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể lưu cấu hình vai trò",
        severity: "error",
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateCustomRole = async () => {
    if (!newRoleName.trim() || !newRoleLabel.trim()) {
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: "Vui lòng nhập mã vai trò và tên hiển thị",
        severity: "error",
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanRoleKey = newRoleName.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, "");
    if (roles[cleanRoleKey]) {
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: `Mã vai trò "${cleanRoleKey}" đã tồn tại!`,
        severity: "error",
      });
      return;
    }

    const baseCrud: Record<SystemResource, any> = {} as any;
    ALL_RESOURCES.forEach((r) => {
      baseCrud[r] = { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false };
    });

    const newRoleObj: RolePermissionConfig = {
      role: cleanRoleKey,
      label: newRoleLabel.trim(),
      description: "Vai trò tùy biến người dùng tạo",
      allowedPages: ["/dashboard"],
      crud: baseCrud,
    };

    setRoles((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [cleanRoleKey]: newRoleObj,
    }));
    setSelectedRole(cleanRoleKey);
    setOpenNewRoleModal(false);
    setNewRoleName("");
    setNewRoleLabel("");

    setToast({
      open: true,
      message: `Đã tạo vai trò [${newRoleObj.label}]. Hãy cấu hình quyền và bấm Lưu!`,
      severity: "success",
    });
  };

  // USER OVERRIDE HANDLERS
  const selectedStaffMember = useMemo(() => {
    return staffList.find((s) => s.id === selectedUserId) || null;
  }, [staffList, selectedUserId]);

  const handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
    setUserOverride((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      enabled,
    }));
  };

  const handleSetUserRouteState = (path: string, state: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke") => {
    setUserOverride((prev) => {
      const granted = new Set(prev.grantedPages || []);
      const revoked = new Set(prev.revokedPages || []);

      if (state === "inherit") {
        granted.delete(path);
        revoked.delete(path);
      } else if (state === "grant") {
        granted.add(path);
        revoked.delete(path);
      } else if (state === "revoke") {
        granted.delete(path);
        revoked.add(path);
      }

      return {
        ...prev,
        grantedPages: Array.from(granted),
        revokedPages: Array.from(revoked),
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSetUserCrudState = (
    resource: SystemResource,
    action: CrudAction,
    state: "inherit" | "grant" | "revoke"
  ) => {
    setUserOverride((prev) => {
      const grantedCrud = { ...(prev.grantedCrud || {}) };
      const revokedCrud = { ...(prev.revokedCrud || {}) };

      const resGranted = { ...(grantedCrud[resource] || {}) };
      const resRevoked = { ...(revokedCrud[resource] || {}) };

      if (state === "inherit") {
        delete resGranted[action];
        delete resRevoked[action];
      } else if (state === "grant") {
        resGranted[action] = true;
        delete resRevoked[action];
      } else if (state === "revoke") {
        delete resGranted[action];
        resRevoked[action] = true;
      }

      grantedCrud[resource] = resGranted;
      revokedCrud[resource] = resRevoked;

      return {
        ...prev,
        grantedCrud,
        revokedCrud,
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSaveUserOverride = async () => {
    if (!selectedUserId) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.updateUserPermissionOverride(selectedUserId, userOverride);
      await refreshPermissions();
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: `Đã lưu thành công cấu hình quyền cho tài khoản [${selectedStaffMember?.fullName || selectedUserId}]!`,
        severity: "success",
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi lưu cấu hình cá nhân",
        severity: "error",
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetUserOverride = async () => {
    if (!selectedUserId) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const emptyOverride: UserPermissionOverride = {
        enabled: false,
        grantedPages: [],
        revokedPages: [],
        grantedCrud: {},
        revokedCrud: {},
      };
      await api.updateUserPermissionOverride(selectedUserId, emptyOverride);
      setUserOverride(emptyOverride);
      await refreshPermissions();
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: "Đã hủy bỏ phân quyền riêng, tài khoản trở về quyền mặc định theo vai trò!",
        severity: "info",
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi khôi phục quyền",
        severity: "error",
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // LIVE EFFECTIVE PERMISSIONS CALCULATION (FOR INSPECTOR TAB)
  const effectivePermissionsPreview: EffectivePermissions = useMemo(() => {
    const baseRole = selectedStaffMember?.role || selectedRole;
    const baseConfig = roles[baseRole] || roles["staff"] || DEFAULT_FALLBACK_ROLES.staff;

    if (baseRole === "admin") {
      return {
        role: "admin",
        isCustom: false,
        allowedPages: ALL_ROUTES.map((r) => r.path),
        crud: DEFAULT_FALLBACK_ROLES.admin.crud,
      };
    }

    if (!userOverride || !userOverride.enabled) {
      return {
        role: baseRole,
        isCustom: false,
        allowedPages: [...baseConfig.allowedPages],
        crud: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(baseConfig.crud)),
      };
    }

    const pages = new Set(baseConfig.allowedPages);
    (userOverride.grantedPages || []).forEach((p) => pages.add(p));
    (userOverride.revokedPages || []).forEach((p) => pages.delete(p));

    const finalCrud: Record<SystemResource, any> = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(baseConfig.crud));

    ALL_RESOURCES.forEach((res) => {
      ALL_ACTIONS.forEach((act) => {
        if (userOverride.grantedCrud?.[res]?.[act] === true) {
          finalCrud[res][act] = true;
        }
        if (userOverride.revokedCrud?.[res]?.[act] === true) {
          finalCrud[res][act] = false;
        }
      });
    });

    return {
      role: baseRole,
      isCustom: true,
      allowedPages: Array.from(pages),
      crud: finalCrud,
    };
  }, [selectedStaffMember, selectedRole, roles, userOverride]);

  // Filtered routes list for quick table review
  const filteredRoutes = useMemo(() => {
    return ALL_ROUTES.filter((r) => {
      const matchSearch =
        r.label.toLowerCase().includes(routeSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
        r.path.toLowerCase().includes(routeSearch.toLowerCase());
      if (!matchSearch) return false;

      const isAllowed =
        selectedRole === "admin" || (activeRoleConfig.allowedPages || []).includes(r.path);

      if (routeFilter === "allowed") return isAllowed;
      if (routeFilter === "blocked") return !isAllowed;
      return true;
    });
  }, [routeSearch, routeFilter, selectedRole, activeRoleConfig]);

  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 1440, mx: "auto", pb: 5 }}>
      {/* ── TOP OPERATIONAL ACTION HEADER ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: { xs: "column", sm: "row" },
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", sm: "center" },
          gap: 2,
          pb: 2.5,
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: "divider",
          mb: 2.5,
        }}
      >
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              bgcolor: alpha(primaryColor, 0.1),
              border: `1px solid ${alpha(primaryColor, 0.25)}`,
              display: "grid",
              placeItems: "center",
              color: primaryColor,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            <ShieldOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24 }} />
          </Box>
          <Box>
            <Typography
              variant="h5"
              sx={{
                fontFamily: "Space Grotesk, sans-serif",
                fontWeight: 800,
                fontSize: { xs: "1.2rem", sm: "1.4rem" },
                color: "text.primary",
                lineHeight: 1.2,
              }}
            >
              Phân Quyền & Quản Lý Nhân Sự Thư Viện
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={{
                color: "text.secondary",
                fontSize: "0.85rem",
                mt: 0.25,
              }}
            >
              Thiết lập quyền mở màn hình chức năng và các thao tác nghiệp vụ cho từng vị trí và nhân viên
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>

        {/* Global Actions */}
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", alignSelf: { xs: "stretch", sm: "auto" } }}>
          <Button
            size="medium"
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={<RefreshOutlinedIcon />}
            onClick={loadData}
            disabled={loading}
            sx={{
              borderRadius: 1.5,
              textTransform: "none",
              fontWeight: 600,
              borderColor: "divider",
              color: "text.primary",
              "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.main", bgcolor: "action.hover" },
            }}
          >
            Làm mới
          </Button>

          {activeTab === 0 ? (
            <Button
              size="medium"
              variant="contained"
              startIcon={saving ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={handleSaveRoleConfig}
              disabled={saving || selectedRole === "admin"}
              sx={{
                borderRadius: 1.5,
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 700,
                px: 2.5,
              }}
            >
              {saving ? "Đang lưu..." : `Lưu quyền chức vụ [${activeRoleConfig.label}]`}
            </Button>
          ) : activeTab === 1 ? (
            <Button
              size="medium"
              variant="contained"
              startIcon={saving ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <SaveOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={handleSaveUserOverride}
              disabled={saving || !userOverride.enabled}
              sx={{
                borderRadius: 1.5,
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 700,
                px: 2.5,
              }}
            >
              {saving ? "Đang lưu..." : "Lưu quyền riêng nhân viên"}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </Stack>
      </Box>

      {/* ── WORKSPACE TABS SELECTOR (DATA-FIRST, NO BULKY KPI BARS) ───────── */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: "flex",
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: "divider",
          mb: 3,
          gap: 1,
          overflowX: "auto",
        }}
      >
        {[
          { label: "Phân quyền theo Chức vụ", icon: <RuleOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
          { label: "Đặc quyền riêng Nhân viên", icon: <KeyOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
          { label: "Kiểm tra Quyền hạn Thực tế", icon: <CodeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
        ].map((tab, idx) => {
          const isSelected = activeTab === idx;
          return (
            <Button
              key={idx}
              startIcon={tab.icon}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(idx)}
              sx={{
                borderRadius: "6px 6px 0 0",
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: isSelected ? 700 : 600,
                fontSize: "0.88rem",
                px: 2.5,
                py: 1.25,
                color: isSelected ? "primary.main" : "text.secondary",
                borderBottom: isSelected ? `2px solid ${primaryColor}` : "2px solid transparent",
                bgcolor: isSelected ? alpha(primaryColor, 0.08) : "transparent",
                "&:hover": {
                  color: "primary.main",
                  bgcolor: alpha(primaryColor, 0.05),
                },
              }}
            >
              {tab.label}
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </Box>

      {/* ── TAB CONTENT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {loading ? (
        <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ py: 2 }}>
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={60} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={320} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
          <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={320} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }} />
        </Stack>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* TAB 0: ROLE MATRIX (BY ROLE) */}
          {activeTab === 0 && (
            <RolePermissionsTab
              roles={roles}
              selectedRole={selectedRole}
              setSelectedRole={setSelectedRole}
              activeRoleConfig={activeRoleConfig}
              filteredRoutes={filteredRoutes}
              routeSearch={routeSearch}
              setRouteSearch={setRouteSearch}
              routeFilter={routeFilter}
              setRouteFilter={setRouteFilter}
              handleToggleRouteForRole={handleToggleRouteForRole}
              handleToggleAllRoutesForRole={handleToggleAllRoutesForRole}
              handleToggleCategoryRoutesForRole={handleToggleCategoryRoutesForRole}
              handleToggleCrudForRole={handleToggleCrudForRole}
              handleSetResourcePresetForRole={handleSetResourcePresetForRole}
              handleSaveRoleConfig={handleSaveRoleConfig}
              handleApplyRoleTemplate={handleApplyRoleTemplate}
              saving={saving}
              setOpenNewRoleModal={setOpenNewRoleModal}
            />
          )}

          {/* TAB 1: USER OVERRIDES */}
          {activeTab === 1 && (
            <UserOverridesTab
              staffList={staffList}
              selectedUserId={selectedUserId}
              setSelectedUserId={setSelectedUserId}
              selectedStaffMember={selectedStaffMember}
              userOverride={userOverride}
              roles={roles}
              handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled={handleToggleUserOverrideEnabled}
              handleSetUserRouteState={handleSetUserRouteState}
              handleSetUserCrudState={handleSetUserCrudState}
              handleSaveUserOverride={handleSaveUserOverride}
              handleResetUserOverride={handleResetUserOverride}
              saving={saving}
            />
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: LIVE EFFECTIVE INSPECTOR */}
          {activeTab === 2 && (
            <EffectiveInspectorTab
              effectivePermissionsPreview={effectivePermissionsPreview}
              setToast={setToast}
            />
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* ── CREATE CUSTOM ROLE MODAL ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <NewRoleDialog
        open={openNewRoleModal}
        onClose={() => setOpenNewRoleModal(false)}
        newRoleName={newRoleName}
        setNewRoleName={setNewRoleName}
        newRoleLabel={newRoleLabel}
        setNewRoleLabel={setNewRoleLabel}
        onCreate={handleCreateCustomRole}
      />

      {/* ── NOTIFICATION TOAST ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Snackbar
        open={toast.open}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        <Alert
          severity={toast.severity}
          variant="filled"
          onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
          sx={{ borderRadius: 1.5, fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          {toast.message}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  Divider,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  LinearProgress,
  Paper,
  Skeleton,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  Switch,
  Tab,
  Tabs,
  TextField,
  Typography,
  alpha,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
} from "@mui/material";
import SettingsOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SettingsOutlined";
import RefreshOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import SaveOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SaveOutlined";
import EmailOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined";
import DeleteOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlineOutlined";
import AddOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AddOutlined";
import MenuBookOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MonetizationOnOutlined";
import ScheduleOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ScheduleOutlined";
import MeetingRoomOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MeetingRoomOutlined";
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined";
import VisibilityOffOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOffOutlined";
import RestartAltOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RestartAltOutlined";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlineOutlined";
import SearchOffOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SearchOffOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";
import type { SystemConfigEntry } from "@/lib/types";

const CATEGORIES = ["borrow", "fine", "smtp", "automation", "access"] as const;

const CATEGORY_META: Record<string, { label: string; icon: React.ReactElement; color: string; gradient: string }> = {
  borrow: {
    label: "Mượn trả",
    icon: <MenuBookOutlinedIcon />,
    color: "#8B0000",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
  },
  fine: {
    label: "Phí phạt",
    icon: <MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon />,
    color: "#DC2626",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #DC2626 0%, #B91C1C 100%)",
  },
  smtp: {
    label: "Email SMTP",
    icon: <EmailOutlinedIcon />,
    color: "#0A2540",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
  },
  automation: {
    label: "Tác vụ tự động",
    icon: <ScheduleOutlinedIcon />,
    color: "#059669",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
  },
  access: {
    label: "Ra vào",
    icon: <MeetingRoomOutlinedIcon />,
    color: "#D97706",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706 0%, #B45309 100%)",
  },
} as const;

type TabCategory = (typeof CATEGORIES)[number];

function renderField(
  entry: SystemConfigEntry,
  value: any,
  onChange: (key: string, val: any) => void,
) {
  const label = entry.label;
  const desc = entry.description;

  if (typeof value === "boolean") {
    return (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
        <Switch
          checked={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(entry.config_key, e.target.checked)}
        />
        <Box>
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{label}</Typography>
          {desc && <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{desc}</Typography>}
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value) && typeof value[0] === "object") {
    return (
      <EditableTable
        label={label}
        description={desc}
        rows={value as Record<string, any>[]}
        onChange={(rows) => onChange(entry.config_key, rows)}
      />
    );
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return (
      <Box>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 1 }}>{label}</Typography>
        {desc && <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1.5, display: "block" }}>{desc}</Typography>}
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          {(value as string[]).map((v, i) => (
            <Chip key={i} label={v} size="small" sx={{ borderRadius: 1.5, fontWeight: 600 }} />
          ))}
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  const isPassword = entry.config_key === "pass" || entry.config_key === "password";

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>{label}</Typography>
      {desc && (
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1, display: "block" }}>
          {desc}
        </Typography>
      )}
      <PasswordField
        value={value ?? ""}
        isPassword={isPassword}
        type={typeof entry.config_value === "number" ? "number" : "text"}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const raw = e.target.value;
          const originalIsNum = typeof entry.config_value === "number";
          onChange(entry.config_key, originalIsNum ? (raw === "" ? 0 : Number(raw)) : raw);
        }}
      />
    </Box>
  );
}

function PasswordField({ value, isPassword, type, onChange }: {
  value: any; isPassword: boolean; type: string; onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
}) {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  return (
    <TextField
      fullWidth
      type={isPassword && !show ? "password" : type === "number" ? "number" : "text"}
      value={value}
      onChange={onChange}
      size="small"
      slotProps={{
        input: isPassword ? {
          endAdornment: (
            <InputAdornment position="end">
              <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setShow((s) => !s)} edge="end">
                {show ? <VisibilityOffOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> : <VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
              </IconButton>
            </InputAdornment>
          ),
        } : undefined,
      }}
      sx={{ "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2, fontSize: "0.9rem" } }}
    />
  );
}

function EditableTable({ label, description, rows, onChange }: {
  label: string; description?: string | null;
  rows: Record<string, any>[]; onChange: (rows: Record<string, any>[]) => void;
}) {
  const keys = rows.length > 0 ? Object.keys(rows[0]) : [];

  const COLUMN_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
    from: "Từ ngày",
    to: "Đến ngày",
    amount: "Số tiền (VNĐ)",
    bracket: "Bậc",
  };

  const updateCell = (rowIdx: number, colKey: string, val: any) => {
    const next = rows.map((r, i) => (i === rowIdx ? { ...r, [colKey]: val } : r));
    onChange(next);
  };

  const deleteRow = (rowIdx: number) => {
    onChange(rows.filter((_, i) => i !== rowIdx));
  };

  const addRow = () => {
    const template: Record<string, any> = {};
    keys.forEach((k) => { template[k] = null; });
    onChange([...rows, template]);
  };

  const formatCellValue = (key: string, val: any) => {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return "";
    if (key === "to" && val === null) return "∞";
    return val;
  };

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mb: 0.5 }}>{label}</Typography>
      {description && (
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1.5, display: "block" }}>{description}</Typography>
      )}
      <TableContainer component={Paper} variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
        <Table size="small">
          <TableHead>
            <TableRow sx={{ "& .MuiTableCell-head": { fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: "action.hover", fontSize: "0.78rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 } }}>
              {keys.map((k) => (
                <TableCell key={k}>{COLUMN_LABELS[k] || k}</TableCell>
              ))}
              <TableCell width={48}></TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHead>
          <TableBody>
            {rows.map((row, ri) => (
              <TableRow key={ri} sx={{ "&:last-child td": { border: 0 } }}>
                {keys.map((k) => (
                  <TableCell key={k} sx={{ py: 0.5, px: 1 }}>
                    {k === "amount" ? (
                      <TextField
                        size="small"
                        type="number"
                        value={row[k] ?? ""}
                        onChange={(e) => updateCell(ri, k, e.target.value === "" ? null : Number(e.target.value))}
                        sx={{ "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 1.5 } }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <Typography
                        variant="body2"
                        sx={{
                          px: 1,
                          py: 0.5,
                          fontWeight: row[k] === null && k === "to" ? 400 : 600,
                          color: row[k] === null && k === "to" ? "text.disabled" : "text.primary",
                          fontFamily: k === "to" && row[k] === null ? "monospace" : undefined,
                          fontSize: "0.9rem",
                        }}
                      >
                        {formatCellValue(k, row[k])}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                ))}
                <TableCell sx={{ py: 0.5, px: 0.5 }}>
                  <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => deleteRow(ri)}>
                    <DeleteOutlineOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </IconButton>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
      <Button
        size="small"
        startIcon={<AddOutlinedIcon />}
        onClick={addRow}
        sx={{ mt: 1, borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.8rem" }}
      >
        Thêm bậc phạt
      </Button>
    </Box>
  );
}

function TabPanel({ children, value, index }: { children: React.ReactNode; value: number; index: number }) {
  if (value !== index) return null;
  return <Box sx={{ pt: 3 }}>{children}</Box>;
}

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const { isLoading, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(0);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Record<string, SystemConfigEntry[]> | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [modified, setModified] = useState<Record<string, Record<string, any>>>({});
  const [snackbar, setSnackbar] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: "success" | "error" }>({ open: false, message: "", severity: "success" });
  const [testEmailOpen, setTestEmailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [testEmail, setTestEmail] = useState("");
  const [testEmailSending, setTestEmailSending] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !isAuthenticated) router.push("/login");
  }, [isLoading, isAuthenticated, router]);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      const data = await api.getAdminSettings();
      setSettings(data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.detail || "Không thể tải cài đặt hệ thống.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const currentCategory = CATEGORIES[tab] as TabCategory | undefined;
  const entries = currentCategory && settings ? settings[currentCategory] || [] : [];

  const getCurrentValue = (entry: SystemConfigEntry) => {
    const cat = entry.category;
    const key = entry.config_key;
    if (modified[cat] && modified[cat][key] !== undefined) return modified[cat][key];
    return entry.config_value;
  };

  const handleFieldChange = (key: string, val: any) => {
    if (!currentCategory) return;
    setModified((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [currentCategory]: { ...(prev[currentCategory] || {}), [key]: val },
    }));
  };

  const hasChanges = currentCategory && modified[currentCategory] && Object.keys(modified[currentCategory]).length > 0;

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!currentCategory || !hasChanges) return;
    try {
      setSaving(true);
      const values = modified[currentCategory]!;
      await api.updateAdminSettings(currentCategory, values);
      setModified((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[currentCategory];
        return next;
      });
      load();
      setSnackbar({ open: true, message: "Lưu cài đặt thành công.", severity: "success" });
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err) || "Lưu cài đặt thất bại.";
      setSnackbar({ open: true, message: msg, severity: "error" });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    if (!currentCategory) return;
    setModified((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[currentCategory];
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleTestEmail = async () => {
    if (!testEmail || !settings?.smtp) return;
    try {
      setTestEmailSending(true);
      const smtpConfig: Record<string, any> = {};
      settings.smtp.forEach((e) => { smtpConfig[e.config_key] = e.config_value; });
      const res = await api.testSmtpConfig({ to: testEmail, ...smtpConfig } as any);
      if (res.success) {
        setSnackbar({ open: true, message: "Gửi email test thành công.", severity: "success" });
      } else {
        setSnackbar({ open: true, message: res.message || "Gửi email test thất bại.", severity: "error" });
      }
      setTestEmailOpen(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err) || "Gửi email test thất bại.";
      setSnackbar({ open: true, message: msg, severity: "error" });
    } finally {
      setTestEmailSending(false);
    }
  };

  const totalConfigs = settings ? Object.values(settings).reduce((sum, arr) => sum + arr.length, 0) : 0;
  const changedCount = Object.values(modified).reduce((sum, m) => sum + Object.keys(m).length, 0);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Stack sx={{ minHeight: 400, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
        <CircularProgress size={28} />
      </Stack>
    );
  }
  if (!isAuthenticated) return null;

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3} sx={{ pb: 4 }}>
      {/* ─── Gradient Header ─── */}
      <Box sx={{
        p: 3, borderRadius: 3,
        background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #154E78 50%, #0A2540 100%)",
        border: "1px solid", borderColor: "rgba(212,175,55,0.3)",
        display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between",
        flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 2, position: "relative", overflow: "hidden",
      }}>
        <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: -40, right: -40, width: 180, height: 180, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "rgba(212,175,55,0.06)", pointerEvents: "none" }} />
        <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", bottom: -60, left: 200, width: 220, height: 220, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "rgba(212,175,55,0.04)", pointerEvents: "none" }} />
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ zIndex: 1, alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: "rgba(212,175,55,0.15)", width: 52, height: 52, border: "1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.35)" }}>
            <SettingsOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: "#D4AF37", fontSize: 28 }} />
          </Avatar>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#ffffff" }}>Cài đặt hệ thống</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)", mt: 0.3 }}>
              {totalConfigs > 0
                ? `${totalConfigs} cấu hình · ${CATEGORIES.length} nhóm${changedCount > 0 ? ` · ${changedCount} thay đổi chưa lưu` : ""}`
                : "Quản lý cấu hình vận hành thư viện"}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ zIndex: 1 }}>
          <IconButton onClick={load} size="small" sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25)", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" } }}>
            <RefreshOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Stack>
      </Box>

      {/* ─── Error Banner ─── */}
      {error && (
        <Alert
          severity="error"
          sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}
          action={<Button size="small" onClick={load} sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Thử lại</Button>}
        >
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* ─── Category Summary Chips ─── */}
      {settings && !error && (
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
            const count = settings[cat]?.length || 0;
            const catMod = modified[cat] ? Object.keys(modified[cat]).length : 0;
            const meta = CATEGORY_META[cat];
            return (
              <Chip
                key={cat}
                icon={meta.icon}
                label={`${meta.label} (${count}${catMod ? `, ${catMod} đã sửa` : ""})`}
                variant={tab === CATEGORIES.indexOf(cat) ? "filled" : "outlined"}
                onClick={() => setTab(CATEGORIES.indexOf(cat))}
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: 2,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: "0.78rem",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  ...(tab === CATEGORIES.indexOf(cat)
                    ? { bgcolor: alpha(meta.color, 0.12), color: meta.color, borderColor: meta.color }
                    : {}),
                  transition: "all 0.15s",
                  "&:hover": { bgcolor: alpha(meta.color, 0.08) },
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </Stack>
      )}

      {/* ─── Tabs ─── */}
      <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <Tabs
          value={tab}
          onChange={(_, v) => setTab(v)}
          variant="scrollable"
          scrollButtons="auto"
          sx={{
            px: 2, pt: 0.5,
            minHeight: 52,
            "& .MuiTab-root": {
              textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.85rem",
              minHeight: 52, py: 1,
              flexDirection: "row", gap: 1,
            },
            "& .MuiTabs-indicator": { height: 3, borderRadius: "3px 3px 0 0" },
          }}
        >
          {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
            const meta = CATEGORY_META[cat];
            const catMod = modified[cat] ? Object.keys(modified[cat]).length : 0;
            return (
              <Tab
                key={cat}
                icon={<Box sx={{ fontSize: "1.1rem", display: "flex" }}>{meta.icon}</Box>}
                iconPosition="start"
                label={
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                    <span>{meta.label}</span>
                    {catMod > 0 && (
                      <Chip
                        label={catMod}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{
                          height: 18, minWidth: 18, fontSize: "0.65rem", fontWeight: 800,
                          borderRadius: "9px", color: "#fff", bgcolor: meta.color,
                        }}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Stack>
                }
              />
            );
          })}
        </Tabs>
      </Paper>

      {/* ─── Content ─── */}
      {loading ? (
        <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: 3, p: 3 }}>
          <Stack spacing={3}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <Box key={i}>
                <Skeleton variant="text" width="30%" height={20} />
                <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={40} sx={{ borderRadius: 2, mt: 0.5 }} />
              </Box>
            ))}
          </Stack>
        </Paper>
      ) : entries.length === 0 ? (
        <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: 3, p: 6 }}>
          <Stack sx={{ alignItems: "center", gap: 1.5 }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: 56, height: 56, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "action.hover", display: "grid", placeItems: "center", color: "text.disabled" }}>
              <SearchOffOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" />
            </Box>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Chưa có cài đặt</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ maxWidth: 360, textAlign: "center" }}>
              Chưa có cài đặt nào cho nhóm &ldquo;{currentCategory && CATEGORY_META[currentCategory]?.label}&rdquo;.
            </Typography>
            <Button size="small" onClick={load} sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>Tải lại</Button>
          </Stack>
        </Paper>
      ) : (
        CATEGORIES.map((cat, idx) => {
          const meta = CATEGORY_META[cat];
          return (
            <TabPanel key={cat} value={tab} index={idx}>
              <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}>
                {/* Category gradient accent bar */}
                <Box sx={{ height: 4, background: meta.gradient }} />

                <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                  <Stack spacing={3}>
                    {entries.map((entry, ei) => (
                      <Box key={entry.id} sx={staggerSx(ei, 0.04)}>
                        {renderField(entry, getCurrentValue(entry), handleFieldChange)}
                      </Box>
                    ))}

                    <Divider sx={{ borderStyle: "dashed" }} />

                    {/* Action buttons */}
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                      {cat === "smtp" && (
                        <Button
                          variant="outlined"
                          startIcon={<EmailOutlinedIcon />}
                          onClick={() => setTestEmailOpen(true)}
                          sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}
                        >
                          Gửi email test
                        </Button>
                      )}
                      <Button
                        variant="outlined"
                        color="inherit"
                        startIcon={<RestartAltOutlinedIcon />}
                        disabled={!hasChanges}
                        onClick={handleReset}
                        sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}
                      >
                        Hoàn tác
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        startIcon={saving ? <CircularProgress size={16} sx={{ color: "#fff" }} /> : <SaveOutlinedIcon />}
                        disabled={!hasChanges || saving}
                        onClick={handleSave}
                        sx={{
                          borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 140,
                          background: meta.gradient,
                          boxShadow: `0 4px 14px ${alpha(meta.color, 0.4)}`,
                          "&:hover": { opacity: 0.9 },
                          "&.Mui-disabled": { bgcolor: "action.disabledBackground" },
                        }}
                      >
                        {saving ? "Đang lưu..." : "Lưu thay đổi"}
                      </Button>
                    </Stack>
                  </Stack>
                </Box>
              </Paper>
            </TabPanel>
          );
        })
      )}

      {/* ─── Test Email Dialog ─── */}
      <Dialog open={testEmailOpen} onClose={() => setTestEmailOpen(false)} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth
        slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: 3 } } }}>
        <DialogTitle sx={{ fontWeight: 800, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1 }}>
          <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: CATEGORY_META.smtp.color }} />
          Gửi email test
          <IconButton onClick={() => setTestEmailOpen(false)} size="small" sx={{ position: "absolute", right: 16, top: 16 }}>
            <CloseIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            fullWidth
            label="Địa chỉ email nhận"
            type="email"
            value={testEmail}
            onChange={(e) => setTestEmail(e.target.value)}
            sx={{ mt: 1, "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2 } }}
          />
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions sx={{ p: 2, pt: 0 }}>
          <Button onClick={() => setTestEmailOpen(false)} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>Hủy</Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!testEmail || testEmailSending}
            onClick={handleTestEmail}
            sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: CATEGORY_META.smtp.color, "&:hover": { bgcolor: "#071A2E" } }}
          >
            {testEmailSending ? "Đang gửi..." : "Gửi"}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ─── Save Feedback ─── */}
      <Snackbar
        open={snackbar.open}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setSnackbar((s) => ({ ...s, open: false }))}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        <Alert
          icon={snackbar.severity === "success" ? <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> : <ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />}
          severity={snackbar.severity}
          sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 600, boxShadow: 4 }}
        >
          {snackbar.message}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </Stack>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { Suspense, useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

// Subcomponent: Perspective Camera Manager to handle smooth zoom (FOV changes)
function CameraManager({ fov }: { fov: number }) {
  const { camera } = useThree();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (camera instanceof THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
      camera.fov = fov;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }
  }, [fov, camera]);
  return null;
}
