// Subcomponent: VRScene handles mesh rendering, camera setups, loop renders, and memory-safe background texture loading
interface SceneProps {
  room: Room;
  onNavigate: (roomId: string) => void;
  gyroEnabled: boolean;
  resetTrigger: number;
  hotspotsVisible: boolean;
  hideHotspots?: boolean;
}

function VRScene({ room, onNavigate, gyroEnabled, resetTrigger, hotspotsVisible, hideHotspots }: SceneProps) {
  const [texture, setTexture] = useState<THREE.Texture | null>(null);
  const [isTransitioning, setIsTransitioning] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const { camera } = useThree();
  const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const materialRef = useRef<THREE.MeshBasicMaterial>(null);
  const textureRef = useRef<THREE.Texture | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    textureRef.current = texture;
  }, [texture]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (textureRef.current) {
        textureRef.current.dispose();
      }
    };
  }, []);
  
  // Load and dispose texture dynamically in background (prevent unmount/flicker and memory leak)
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsTransitioning(true);
    const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
    let isMounted = true;

    loader.load(
      room.imageUrl,
      (loadedTexture) => {
        if (!isMounted) {
          loadedTexture.dispose();
          return;
        }
        // Optimize WebGL settings and set sRGB color space to fix overexposed gamma
        loadedTexture.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
        loadedTexture.generateMipmaps = false;
        loadedTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

        setTexture((prevTexture) => {
          if (prevTexture) {
            prevTexture.dispose();
          }
          return loadedTexture;
        });
        setIsTransitioning(false);
      },
      undefined,
      (err) => {
        console.error('Failed to load texture:', room.imageUrl, err);
        setIsTransitioning(false);
      }
    );

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [room.imageUrl]);

  // Set initial camera rotation when texture is ready
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!texture) return;
    camera.position.set(0, 0, 0.1); 
    if (room.defaultRotation) {
      camera.rotation.set(room.defaultRotation[0], room.defaultRotation[1], room.defaultRotation[2]);
    } else {
      camera.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
    }
  }, [room, texture, camera, resetTrigger]);

  // Push new texture map and update shader compiled flags to prevent black screens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (texture && materialRef.current) {
      materialRef.current.map = texture;
      materialRef.current.needsUpdate = true; // Crucial to update three.js shader definitions
    }
  }, [texture]);

  // Handle mobile gyroscope orientation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gyroEnabled) {
      if (groupRef.current) {
        groupRef.current.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
      }
      return;
    }

    const handleOrientation = (e: DeviceOrientationEvent) => {
      if (!groupRef.current) return;
      
      const beta = e.beta ? (e.beta * Math.PI) / 180 : 0;
      const gamma = e.gamma ? (e.gamma * Math.PI) / 180 : 0;
      const alpha = e.alpha ? (e.alpha * Math.PI) / 180 : 0;

      groupRef.current.rotation.y = -alpha;
      groupRef.current.rotation.x = beta - Math.PI / 2; 
      groupRef.current.rotation.z = gamma;
    };

    window.addEventListener('deviceorientation', handleOrientation);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('deviceorientation', handleOrientation);
    };
  }, [gyroEnabled]);

  return (
    <group ref={groupRef}>
      {/* 360 Sphere mesh */}
      <mesh scale={[-1, 1, 1]} visible={!!texture}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[500, 60, 40]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial ref={materialRef} side={THREE.DoubleSide} />
      </mesh>

      {/* Floating Canvas Overlay for transition state */}
      {isTransitioning && (
        <Html center zIndexRange={[1000, 2000]}>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/85 border border-slate-800/40 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl shadow-2xl pointer-events-none">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 border-3 border-yellow-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-2" />
            <p className="text-white text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap tracking-wide animate-pulse">
              Đang di chuyển...
            </p>
          </div>
        </Html>
      )}

      {/* Loop and render separate NavigationArrow components */}
      {hotspotsVisible && texture && !hideHotspots && room.navigationArrows.map((arrow) => (
        <NavigationArrow 
          key={arrow.id}
          {...arrow}
          onNavigate={onNavigate}
        />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

// Loading component inside the canvas
function CanvasLoader() {
  return (
    <Html center>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700/50 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-cyan-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-3" />
        <p className="text-white text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
          Đang tải không gian 3D...
        </p>
      </div>
    </Html>
  );
}

// Main Component
export default function VRViewer() {
  const [currentRoomId, setCurrentRoomId] = useState<string>('room1');
  const [isWebView, setIsWebView] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [gyroEnabled, setGyroEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [fov, setFov] = useState<number>(75);
  const [hotspotsVisible, setHotspotsVisible] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [resetTrigger, setResetTrigger] = useState<number>(0);
  const [infoVisible, setInfoVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isToolbarVisible, setIsToolbarVisible] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [mapVisible, setMapVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);
  
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const currentRoom = libraryTourData[currentRoomId] || libraryTourData.room1;

  useEffect(() => {
    const isUAWebView = typeof window !== 'undefined' && 
      (window.navigator.userAgent.includes('wv') || 
       window.navigator.userAgent.includes('WebView') ||
       !!(window as any).ReactNativeWebView);
    
    setIsWebView(isUAWebView);
  }, []);

  const handleRoomChange = (roomId: string) => {
    setCurrentRoomId(roomId);
    
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).ReactNativeWebView) {
      (window as any).ReactNativeWebView.postMessage(
        JSON.stringify({
          type: 'ROOM_CHANGE',
          payload: { roomId, roomName: libraryTourData[roomId]?.name }
        })
      );
    }
  };

  const handlePrevRoom = () => {
    const roomKeys = Object.keys(libraryTourData);
    const currentIndex = roomKeys.indexOf(currentRoomId);
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      handleRoomChange(roomKeys[currentIndex - 1]);
    }
  };

  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      containerRef.current.requestFullscreen().then(() => {
        setIsFullscreen(true);
      }).catch(err => {
        console.error('Fullscreen request failed:', err);
      });
    } else {
      document.exitFullscreen().then(() => {
        setIsFullscreen(false);
      });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleFullscreenChange = () => {
      setIsFullscreen(!!document.fullscreenElement);
    };
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', handleFullscreenChange);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', handleFullscreenChange);
  }, []);

  const requestGyroPermission = async () => {
    if (gyroEnabled) {
      setGyroEnabled(false);
      return;
    }

    if (
      typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      typeof (DeviceOrientationEvent as any).requestPermission === 'function'
    ) {
      try {
        const permission = await (DeviceOrientationEvent as any).requestPermission();
        if (permission === 'granted') {
          setGyroEnabled(true);
        } else {
          alert('Quyền truy cập cảm biến bị từ chối.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error requesting gyro permission:', err);
      }
    } else {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'ondeviceorientation' in window) {
        setGyroEnabled(true);
      } else {
        alert('Thiết bị của bạn không hỗ trợ xoay bằng cảm biến hoặc trình duyệt bị chặn.');
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className="relative w-full h-full bg-black select-none overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Three.js Canvas */}
      <Canvas camera={{ fov: 75, near: 0.1, far: 1000 }}>
        <CameraManager fov={fov} />
        <Suspense fallback={<CanvasLoader />}>
          <VRScene 
            room={currentRoom} 
            onNavigate={handleRoomChange} 
            gyroEnabled={gyroEnabled}
            resetTrigger={resetTrigger}
            hotspotsVisible={hotspotsVisible}
            hideHotspots={mapVisible || infoVisible}
          />
        </Suspense>
        
        <OrbitControls 
          enableZoom={false} 
          enablePan={false} 
          rotateSpeed={-0.4} 
          enabled={!gyroEnabled}
        />
      </Canvas>

      {/* Top Left Library Badge */}
      <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 z-10 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-800 border border-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-bold text-sm shadow-xl animate-fade-in pointer-events-auto">
        Thư viện
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Center Toolbar - Chuẩn UI IUH */}
      <div 
        className={`absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-10 bg-[#3b5598] rounded-full px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 shadow-2xl flex items-center pointer-events-auto max-w-[95vw] overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide border border-white/20 transition-all duration-300`}
      >
        
        {/* NÚT THU GỌN / MỞ RỘNG TOOLBAR */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsToolbarVisible(!isToolbarVisible)}
          className={`w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors ${isToolbarVisible ? 'mr-4 sm:mr-8' : ''}`}
          title={isToolbarVisible ? "Thu gọn thanh công cụ" : "Mở rộng thanh công cụ"}
        >
          {isToolbarVisible ? <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />}
        </button>

        {/* CÁC CHỨC NĂNG BÊN TRONG (CHỈ HIỂN THỊ KHI TOOLBAR MỞ) */}
        {isToolbarVisible && (
          <>
            {/* CỤM TRÁI: Nút mở Drawer Danh sách phòng */}
            <div className="flex items-center mr-4 sm:mr-8">
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsDrawerOpen(!isDrawerOpen)}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Danh sách phòng"
              >
                <Menu className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* CỤM GIỮA: Các tính năng chính */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleRoomChange('room1')}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Về cổng vào"
              >
                <Home className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setIsMuted(!isMuted)}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title={isMuted ? "Bật âm thanh" : "Tắt âm thanh"}
              >
                {isMuted ? <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setFov(prev => Math.min(100, prev + 5))}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Thu nhỏ"
              >
                <Minus className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setFov(prev => Math.max(35, prev - 5))}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Phóng to"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setMapVisible(true)}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Vị trí thư viện trên bản đồ"
              >
                <MapPin className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setResetTrigger(prev => prev + 1)}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Khôi phục góc nhìn"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setInfoVisible(!infoVisible)}
                className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                title="Thông tin"
              >
                <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* CỤM PHẢI: Fullscreen */}
            {!isWebView && (
              <div className="flex items-center ml-4 sm:ml-8">
                <button
                  onClick={toggleFullscreen}
                  className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-white flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/30 transition-colors"
                  title={isFullscreen ? 'Thoát toàn màn hình' : 'Bật toàn màn hình'}
                >
                  {isFullscreen ? <Minimize2 className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* SIDEBAR BÊN TRÁI - GIAO DIỆN CHUẨN IUH */}
      <div 
        className={`absolute top-0 left-0 h-full w-[300px] sm:w-[350px] bg-[#22408c] z-40 transform transition-transform duration-500 ease-in-out shadow-[10px_0_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] flex flex-col ${
          isDrawerOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full'
        }`}
      >
        {/* Phần Logo Header Trắng */}
        <div className="bg-white h-[100px] w-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 shrink-0">
          <img
            src="/logo.png"
            alt="IUH Logo"
            className="h-14 w-auto object-contain"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Dải phân cách màu vàng */}
        <div className="w-full h-[6px] bg-[#f8b22a] shrink-0" />

        {/* Danh sách Menu - Chỉ chứa Rooms */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-white/30 scrollbar-track-transparent">
          
          {/* Tiêu đề danh sách */}
          <div className="w-full px-5 py-3 bg-[#1e347b] border-b border-white/20 text-white font-bold text-[13px] uppercase tracking-wide sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-sm">
            Hệ thống phòng thư viện
          </div>

          {/* Danh sách các phòng lấy từ Data */}
          <div className="flex flex-col w-full pb-6">
            {Object.values(libraryTourData).map((room) => (
              <button
                key={room.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  handleRoomChange(room.id);
                  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 640) {
                    setIsDrawerOpen(false);
                  }
                }}
                className={`w-full px-5 py-3.5 text-left text-[14px] border-b border-white/10 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 ${
                  currentRoomId === room.id 
                    ? 'bg-[#152a65] text-white font-bold' 
                    : 'bg-[#22408c] text-slate-200 hover:bg-[#2a4494] hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0 transition-colors ${currentRoomId === room.id ? 'bg-[#f8b22a]' : 'bg-transparent'}`} />
                <span className="truncate">{room.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <button

      </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-4">

          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-2xl w-full shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-4 animate-fade-in">

                  className="w-full opacity-90 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                ></iframe>

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import useSWR from "swr";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import type {
  AccessLogPublic,
  BorrowRecord,
  CameraStatus,
  Notification,
  StatsResponse,
  StaffScheduleAssignment,
} from "@/lib/types";

function toDateStr(d: Date) {
  return d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
}

interface DashboardSnapshot {
  stats: StatsResponse | null;
  recentLogs: AccessLogPublic[];
  hourlyLogs: AccessLogPublic[];
  cameraStatuses: CameraStatus[];
  borrowStats: { total: number; active: number; overdue: number } | null;
  activeBorrows: BorrowRecord[];
  todaySchedule: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  notifications: Notification[];
}

const CACHE_KEY = "dashboard:data";

export interface DashboardData {
  stats: StatsResponse | null;
  recentLogs: AccessLogPublic[];
  hourlyLogs: AccessLogPublic[];
  cameraStatuses: CameraStatus[];
  borrowStats: { total: number; active: number; overdue: number } | null;
  activeBorrows: BorrowRecord[];
  todaySchedule: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  notifications: Notification[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

function applySnapshot(snap: DashboardSnapshot, setters: {
  setStats: (v: StatsResponse | null) => void;
  setRecentLogs: (v: AccessLogPublic[]) => void;
  setHourlyLogs: (v: AccessLogPublic[]) => void;
  setCameraStatuses: (v: CameraStatus[]) => void;
  setBorrowStats: (v: { total: number; active: number; overdue: number } | null) => void;
  setActiveBorrows: (v: BorrowRecord[]) => void;
  setTodaySchedule: (v: StaffScheduleAssignment[]) => void;
  setNotifications: (v: Notification[]) => void;
}) {
  console.log("[Dashboard] applySnapshot:", {
    stats: snap.stats ? `${snap.stats.total_patrons} patrons` : null,
    recentLogs: snap.recentLogs.length,
    hourlyLogs: snap.hourlyLogs.length,
    cameraStatuses: snap.cameraStatuses.length,
    borrowStats: snap.borrowStats,
    activeBorrows: snap.activeBorrows.length,
    todaySchedule: snap.todaySchedule.length,
    notifications: snap.notifications.length,
  });
  setters.setStats(snap.stats);
  setters.setRecentLogs(snap.recentLogs);
  setters.setHourlyLogs(snap.hourlyLogs);
  setters.setCameraStatuses(snap.cameraStatuses);
  setters.setBorrowStats(snap.borrowStats);
  setters.setActiveBorrows(snap.activeBorrows);
  setters.setTodaySchedule(snap.todaySchedule);
  setters.setNotifications(snap.notifications);
}

const fetchDashboardData = async (): Promise<DashboardSnapshot> => {
  const today = toDateStr(new Date());

  const [statsResult, recentResult, hourlyResult, cameraResult, borrowStatsResult, borrowsResult, scheduleResult, notifResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    api.getStats(),
    api.getRecentLogs(),
    api.getAccessLogs({ dateFrom: today, limit: 50 }),
    api.getCameraStatus(),
    api.getBorrowStats(),
    api.getAllActiveBorrows(),
    api.getScheduleAssignments({ from: today, to: today }),
    api.getNotifications({ limit: 5 }),
  ]);

  return {
    stats: statsResult.status === "fulfilled" ? statsResult.value : null,
    recentLogs: recentResult.status === "fulfilled" ? recentResult.value.items.slice(0, 6) : [],
    hourlyLogs: hourlyResult.status === "fulfilled" ? hourlyResult.value.items : [],
    cameraStatuses: cameraResult.status === "fulfilled" ? cameraResult.value : [],
    borrowStats: borrowStatsResult.status === "fulfilled" ? borrowStatsResult.value : null,
    activeBorrows: borrowsResult.status === "fulfilled" ? borrowsResult.value : [],
    todaySchedule: scheduleResult.status === "fulfilled" ? scheduleResult.value.items : [],
    notifications: notifResult.status === "fulfilled" ? notifResult.value.items : [],
  };
};

export function useDashboardData(): DashboardData {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<StatsResponse | null>(null);
  const [recentLogs, setRecentLogs] = useState<AccessLogPublic[]>([]);
  const [hourlyLogs, setHourlyLogs] = useState<AccessLogPublic[]>([]);
  const [cameraStatuses, setCameraStatuses] = useState<CameraStatus[]>([]);
  const [borrowStats, setBorrowStats] = useState<{ total: number; active: number; overdue: number } | null>(null);
  const [activeBorrows, setActiveBorrows] = useState<BorrowRecord[]>([]);
  const [todaySchedule, setTodaySchedule] = useState<StaffScheduleAssignment[]>([]);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);

  const setters = { setStats, setRecentLogs, setHourlyLogs, setCameraStatuses, setBorrowStats, setActiveBorrows, setTodaySchedule, setNotifications };

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !isAuthenticated) router.push("/login");
  }, [authLoading, isAuthenticated, router]);

  const { data: cachedData, mutate } = useSWR<DashboardSnapshot>(
    isAuthenticated ? CACHE_KEY : null,
    fetchDashboardData,
    {
      refreshInterval: 30000,
      dedupingInterval: 5000,
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
      onSuccess: (data) => {
        console.log("[Dashboard] SWR onSuccess:", data);
        if (mountedRef.current && data) {
          applySnapshot(data, setters);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        console.error("[Dashboard] SWR onError:", err);
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setError("Không thể tải dữ liệu tổng quan.");
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
    }
  );

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;
    try {
      setError("");
      await mutate();
    } catch {
      if (mountedRef.current) setError("Không thể tải dữ liệu tổng quan.");
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, mutate]);

  return {
    stats, recentLogs, hourlyLogs, cameraStatuses,
    borrowStats, activeBorrows, todaySchedule, notifications,
    loading, error, refresh,
  };
}

import { AxiosInstance } from "axios";
import type {
  AICommandCenterSummary,
  AIInsight,
  AIInsightExplanation,
  AIInsightList,
  AIChatResponse,
  AIConfirmResponse,
  AIBookRecommendationResponse,
  CompanionChunk,
} from "../types";

export function createAIMethods(client: AxiosInstance) {
  return {
    async getAICommandCenterSummary(): Promise<AICommandCenterSummary> {
      const response = await client.get<AICommandCenterSummary>("/api/ai/command-center/summary");
      return response.data;
    },

    async refreshAiCommandCenter(): Promise<AICommandCenterSummary> {
      const response = await client.post<AICommandCenterSummary>("/api/ai/command-center/refresh");
      return response.data;
    },

    async getAIInsights(params?: { status?: string; category?: string; severity?: string }): Promise<AIInsightList> {
      const response = await client.get<AIInsightList>("/api/ai/insights", { params });
      return response.data;
    },

    async dismissAIInsight(id: string): Promise<AIInsight> {
      const response = await client.post<AIInsight>(`/api/ai/insights/${id}/dismiss`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async explainAIInsight(id: string): Promise<AIInsightExplanation> {
      const response = await client.get<AIInsightExplanation>(`/api/ai/insights/${id}/explain`);
      return response.data;
    },

    async askAiCommandCenter(question: string): Promise<AIChatResponse> {
      const response = await client.post<AIChatResponse>("/api/ai/command-center/chat", { question });
      return response.data;
    },

    async askAiChat(message: string, sessionId?: string): Promise<AIChatResponse> {
      const storedUser = typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("user") : null;
      const userData = storedUser ? JSON.parse(storedUser) : null;
      const role = userData?.role || "staff";

      const endpoint =
        role === "patron"
          ? "/api/ai/patrons/chat"
          : role === "staff"
            ? "/api/ai/staff/chat"
            : "/api/ai/admin/chat";

      const body: Record<string, any> = { message };
      if (sessionId) body.sessionId = sessionId;

      const response = await client.post(endpoint, body);
      return response.data;
    },

    async confirmAction(
      sessionId: string,
      action: "approve" | "reject",
      role?: string
    ): Promise<AIConfirmResponse> {
      const storedUser = typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("user") : null;
      const userData = storedUser ? JSON.parse(storedUser) : null;
      const effectiveRole = role || userData?.role || "staff";

      const endpoint =
        effectiveRole === "patron"
          ? "/api/ai/patrons/confirm"
          : effectiveRole === "staff"
            ? "/api/ai/staff/confirm"
            : "/api/ai/admin/confirm";

      const response = await client.post(endpoint, { sessionId, action });
      return response.data;
    },

    async getBookRecommendations(studentCode: string): Promise<AIBookRecommendationResponse> {
      const response = await client.get<AIBookRecommendationResponse>(
        `/api/ai/recommendations/patron/${studentCode}`
      );
      return response.data;
    },

    async streamCompanionChat(
      message: string | undefined,
      audioBase64: string | undefined,
      sessionId: string | undefined,
      onChunk: (chunk: CompanionChunk) => void,
      onError?: (error: Error) => void,
    ): Promise<void> {
      const storedUser = typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("user") : null;
      const userData = storedUser ? JSON.parse(storedUser) : null;
      const token = typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("accessToken") : null;

      const body: Record<string, any> = {};
      if (message) body.message = message;
      if (audioBase64) body.audioBase64 = audioBase64;
      if (sessionId) body.sessionId = sessionId;

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/ai/companion/stream", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(body),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
        }

        const reader = response.body?.getReader();
        if (!reader) throw new Error("No response body");

        const decoder = new TextDecoder();
        let buffer = "";

        while (true) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;

          buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
          const lines = buffer.split("\n");
          buffer = lines.pop() || "";

          for (const line of lines) {
            if (line.startsWith("data: ")) {
              try {
                const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
                onChunk(data);
              } catch {}
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        onError?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));
      }
    },

  };
}

import type { AccessLogPublic } from "../types";
import { translateError } from "../error-messages";

let _accessToken: string | null = null;

export function setApiAccessToken(token: string | null) {
  _accessToken = token;
}

export function getApiAccessToken(): string | null {
  return _accessToken;
}

export function normalizeAccessLog(log: any): AccessLogPublic {
  const user = log?.user || {};
  return {
    ...log,
    patron_id: log?.patron_id || log?.patronId || user.id || null,
    patron_name: log?.patron_name || log?.full_name || log?.fullName || user.full_name || user.fullName || null,
    student_code: log?.student_code || log?.studentCode || user.student_code || user.studentCode || null,
    access_type: log?.access_type || log?.accessType || "",
    verify_method: log?.verify_method || log?.verifyMethod || "face",
    confidence: log?.confidence ?? null,
    camera_id: log?.camera_id || log?.cameraId || "",
    access_time: log?.access_time || log?.accessTime || log?.created_at || log?.createdAt || "",
    status: log?.status === "granted" ? "success" : (log?.status || ""),
  };
}

export function setStoredAccessToken(token: string) {
  _accessToken = token;
  setAccessTokenCookie(token);
}

export function clearStoredAuth() {
  _accessToken = null;
  clearAccessTokenCookie();
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    document.cookie = "refresh_token=; path=/; max-age=0";
    localStorage.removeItem("user");
    localStorage.removeItem("access_token");
    localStorage.removeItem("refresh_token");
  }
}

export function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const base64Url = token.split(".")[1];
    if (!base64Url) return null;
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      atob(base64)
        .split("")
        .map((c) => `%${(`00${c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)}`).slice(-2)}`)
        .join("")
    );
    return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function isTokenExpiringSoon(token: string, skewSeconds = 30): boolean {
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  const exp = typeof payload?.exp === "number" ? payload.exp : null;
  if (!exp) return false;
  return Date.now() >= (exp - skewSeconds) * 1000;
}

export function getCookieValue(name: string): string | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${name}=([^;]*)`));
  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
}

export function setAccessTokenCookie(token: string) {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  const isProduction = typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";
  const secureFlag = isProduction ? "; Secure" : "";
  document.cookie = `access_token=${token}; path=/; max-age=${7 * 24 * 60 * 60}; SameSite=Lax${secureFlag}`;
}

export function clearAccessTokenCookie() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  document.cookie = "access_token=; path=/; max-age=0";
}

export function getErrorMessage(err: any): string {
  if (!err) return "Đã xảy ra lỗi không xác định. Vui lòng thử lại.";
  if (typeof err === "string") return translateError(err);
  if (err.response?.data?.detail) {
    const detail = err.response.data.detail;
    if (typeof detail === "string") return translateError(detail);
    if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
      const raw = detail.map((d: any) =>
        typeof d === "string" ? d : `${d.loc?.join(".")}: ${d.msg}`
      ).join("; ");
      return translateError(raw);
    }
    if (typeof detail === "object") {
      const raw = detail.msg || detail.message || JSON.stringify(detail);
      return translateError(raw);
    }
  }
  if (err.response?.data?.error) {
    const errorVal = err.response.data.error;
    if (typeof errorVal === "string") return translateError(errorVal);
    if (typeof errorVal === "object") {
      const raw = errorVal.msg || errorVal.message || JSON.stringify(errorVal);
      return translateError(raw);
    }
  }
  const raw = err.message || err.msg || String(err);
  return translateError(raw);
}

// Convenience functions that delegate to the ApiClient singleton.
// Uses dynamic import to avoid circular dependency with ./client.
export function retryPendingRequests(token: string) {
  import("./client").then((m) => m.api.retryPendingRequests(token));
}
export function cancelPendingRequests() {
  import("./client").then((m) => m.api.cancelPendingRequests());
}

File: src/lib/permission-context.tsx

"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from './auth-context';
import api from './api-client';
import type {
  SystemResource,
  CrudAction,
  EffectivePermissions,
} from './types';

interface PermissionContextType {
  permissions: EffectivePermissions | null;
  loading: boolean;
  can: (resource: SystemResource, action: CrudAction) => boolean;
  canAccessPage: (path: string) => boolean;
  refreshPermissions: () => Promise<void>;
}

const PermissionContext = createContext<PermissionContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function PermissionProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState<EffectivePermissions | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const userId = user?.id;
  const userRole = user?.role;

  const refreshPermissions = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!userId) {
      setPermissions(null);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    // Admin bypass: always granted full permissions
    if (userRole === "admin") {
      setPermissions({
        role: "admin",
        isCustom: false,
        allowedPages: [
          "/dashboard",
          "/books",
          "/patrons",
          "/borrow",
          "/return",
          "/gate",
          "/history",
          "/active",
          "/staff-schedules",
          "/ai-assistant",
          "/enroll",
          "/verify",
          "/identify",
          "/liveness",
          "/library/vr-tour",
          "/profile",
          "/notifications",
          "/dashboard/admin",
          "/dynamic-admin",
          "/settings",
          "/stats",
        ],
        crud: {
          books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
          patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
          borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
          schedules: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
          ai_tools: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
          settings: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
          stats: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
        },
      });
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading((prev) => (permissions ? false : true));
      const res = await api.getMyPermissions();
      setPermissions(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("[PermissionProvider] Could not fetch permissions, fallback to defaults:", err.message);
      // Fallback baseline for staff
      if (userRole === "staff") {
        setPermissions({
          role: "staff",
          isCustom: false,
          allowedPages: [
            "/dashboard",
            "/books",
            "/patrons",
            "/borrow",
            "/return",
            "/gate",
            "/history",
            "/active",
            "/staff-schedules",
            "/ai-assistant",
            "/enroll",
            "/verify",
            "/identify",
            "/liveness",
            "/library/vr-tour",
            "/profile",
            "/notifications",
            "/stats",
          ],
          crud: {
            books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: true },
            patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: true, print: true },
            borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: true, print: true },
            schedules: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: true },
            ai_tools: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
            settings: { create: false, read: false, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: false },
            stats: { create: false, read: true, update: false, delete: false, approve: false, print: true },
          },
        });
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [userId, userRole]);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshPermissions();
  }, [refreshPermissions]);

  const can = useCallback(
    (resource: SystemResource, action: CrudAction): boolean => {
      if (!user) return false;
      if (user.role === 'admin') return true;
      if (!permissions || !permissions.crud || !permissions.crud[resource]) {
        return false;
      }
      return Boolean(permissions.crud[resource][action]);
    },
    [user, permissions]
  );

  const canAccessPage = useCallback(
    (path: string): boolean => {
      if (!user) return false;
      if (user.role === 'admin') return true;

      // Base path match (e.g. /books matches /books/123)
      const targetPath = path.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];

      // /dashboard/admin requires explicit permission if not admin
      if (targetPath === '/dashboard/admin' || targetPath.startsWith('/dashboard/admin/')) {
        return Boolean(permissions?.allowedPages?.includes('/dashboard/admin'));
      }

      if (!permissions || !permissions.allowedPages) {
        // Fallback for staff
        if (
          user.role === 'staff' &&
          targetPath !== '/dynamic-admin' &&
          targetPath !== '/settings'
        ) {
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      }

      // Exact match or prefix match
      return permissions.allowedPages.some(
        (allowed) => targetPath === allowed || targetPath.startsWith(`${allowed}/`)
      );
    },
    [user, permissions]
  );

  const contextValue = useMemo(
    () => ({
      permissions,
      loading,
      can,
      canAccessPage,
      refreshPermissions,
    }),
    [permissions, loading, can, canAccessPage, refreshPermissions]
  );

  return (
    <PermissionContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </PermissionContext.Provider>
  );
}

const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CONTEXT: PermissionContextType = {
  permissions: {
    role: 'admin',
    isCustom: false,
    allowedPages: [
      '/dashboard',
      '/books',
      '/patrons',
      '/borrow',
      '/return',
      '/gate',
      '/history',
      '/active',
      '/staff-schedules',
      '/ai-assistant',
      '/enroll',
      '/verify',
      '/identify',
      '/liveness',
      '/library/vr-tour',
      '/profile',
      '/notifications',
      '/dashboard/admin',
      '/dynamic-admin',
      '/settings',
      '/stats',
    ],
    crud: {
      books: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
      patrons: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
      borrows: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
      schedules: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
      ai_tools: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
      settings: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
      stats: { create: true, read: true, update: true, delete: true, approve: true, print: true },
    },
  },
  loading: false,
  can: () => true,
  canAccessPage: () => true,
  refreshPermissions: async () => {},
};

export function usePermission() {
  const context = useContext(PermissionContext);
  return context || DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CONTEXT;
}

interface CanProps {
  I?: CrudAction;
  a?: SystemResource;
  page?: string;
  pass?: boolean;
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Declarative component for conditional rendering based on RBAC permissions
 * e.g. <Can I="delete" a="books"> <DeleteButton /> </Can>
 * or <Can page="/settings"> <SettingsTab /> </Can>
 */
export function Can({ I, a, page, pass, fallback = null, children }: CanProps) {
  const { can, canAccessPage } = usePermission();

  let hasPermission = false;

  if (typeof pass === 'boolean') {
    hasPermission = pass;
  } else if (page) {
    hasPermission = canAccessPage(page);
  } else if (I && a) {
    hasPermission = can(a, I);
  }

  if (!hasPermission) {
    return <>{fallback}</>;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

export function getPermissionDeniedReason(resource: SystemResource, action: CrudAction): string {
  const resourceNames: Record<SystemResource, string> = {
    books: 'kho sách',
    patrons: 'độc giả',
    borrows: 'mượn / trả sách',
    schedules: 'lịch trực',
    ai_tools: 'công cụ AI',
    settings: 'cài đặt hệ thống',
    stats: 'báo cáo thống kê',
  };
  const actionNames: Record<CrudAction, string> = {
    create: 'thêm mới',
    read: 'xem dữ liệu',
    update: 'chỉnh sửa',
    delete: 'xóa dữ liệu',
    approve: 'phê duyệt',
    print: 'in ấn',
  };
  return `Bạn không có quyền ${actionNames[action] || action} trên ${resourceNames[resource] || resource}. Liên hệ Quản trị viên để được cấp quyền.`;
}

# Face Recognition Platform - Frontend

Giao diện web quản lý thư viện thông minh — dashboard cho admin/nhân viên, mượn/trả sách, AI chatbot, quản lý bạn đọc, nhận diện khuôn mặt, VR tour và kiosk cổng ra vào.

![Thư viện thông minh](./smart-library.png)

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 15** (App Router, Turbopack)
- **React 19** với Server Components
- **TypeScript** 5
- **MUI** 9 (Material UI) — dashboard components
- **Tailwind CSS** — utility styling
- **Framer Motion** — animation, layout transitions
- **Three.js** (`@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`) — 3D landing, VR tour
- **Axios** + JWT interceptor — API client
- **react-webcam** — chụp ảnh từ camera
- **@zxing** — QR/barcode scanner
- **Jest** + **Playwright** — unit test + E2E

## API Integration

Frontend giao tiếp với backend qua API Gateway (`http://localhost/api`). Cấu hình trong `next.config.js`:

```js
// Rewrites /api/* → http://127.0.0.1:80/api/*
async rewrites() { ... }
```

### Auth Flow

1. Đăng nhập → nhận `access_token` + `refresh_token`
2. Lưu token trong localStorage
3. Axios interceptor tự động gắn `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
4. 401 → auto refresh token → retry request
5. Hết hạn refresh → redirect `/login`

## Cài đặt

### Yêu cầu

- Node.js 20 LTS
- Backend đang chạy (xem `Backend/README.md`)

### Local dev

```bash
# 1. Cài dependencies
npm install

# 2. Tạo .env.local
echo NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost/api > .env.local

# 3. Start backend (riêng terminal)
cd ../Backend
docker compose up -d

# 4. Start frontend
cd ../Frontend_Web
npm run dev
```

Truy cập http://localhost:3000

### Docker

```bash
cd ../Backend
docker compose up -d

cd ../Frontend_Web
docker compose up -d
```

## Scripts

```bash
npm run dev      # Dev server (Turbo)
npm run build    # Build production
npm run start    # Start production
npm run lint     # ESLint
npm test         # Jest unit tests
npx playwright test  # E2E tests
```

## Tính năng chính

### Dashboard
- Thống kê real-time: bạn đọc trong thư viện, lượt ra vào, sách đang mượn
- Biểu đồ hoạt động theo giờ/ngày/tuần
- AI widget gợi ý sách, trả lời câu hỏi

### Face Recognition
- Đăng ký khuôn mặt qua webcam
- Xác thực khuôn mặt (1:1)
- Nhận diện khuôn mặt (1:N)
- Kiểm tra sống (liveness detection)

### Mượn/Trả sách
- Quét QR/barcode sách
- Tìm kiếm danh mục
- Lịch sử mượn trả
- Gợi ý sách từ AI

### Cổng ra vào (Kiosk)
- Check-in/out bằng khuôn mặt
- Màn hình cảm ứng cho cổng thư viện

### Quản lý
- Bạn đọc (patron CRUD, gia hạn thẻ, khóa)
- Nhân viên (lịch làm việc, ca, chấm công)
- Thống kê báo cáo

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Mô tả |
|----------|---------|-------|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` | `/api` | Backend API Gateway URL |

## Troubleshooting

Xem `docker compose logs` của backend nếu API không hoạt động. Đảm bảo `.env.local` tồn tại và backend service đang `Healthy`.
1. [ ] Docker Desktop is running
2. [ ] Backend is fully built and running (`docker-compose ps` shows all Up/Healthy)
3. [ ] TypeScript services built (`npm run build` succeeds locally)
4. [ ] `.env.local` exists with correct `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`
5. [ ] `npm install` completed without errors
6. [ ] Port 3000 (frontend) and 80 (backend gateway) are free
7. [ ] Browser has camera permissions for face recognition features

import React from "react";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import JobPoll from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/job-poll";
import * as apiClient from "@/lib/api-client";

jest.mock("@/lib/api-client", () => {
  const listeners: Record<string, (event: any) => void> = {};
  const mockApi = {
    connectFaceResultSSE: jest.fn((onEvent: (event: any) => void, onConnectionChange?: (connected: boolean) => void) => {
      // Simulate SSE connection
      onConnectionChange?.(true);
      // Store event listener so tests can trigger it
      const key = `_listener_${Object.keys(listeners).length}`;
      listeners[key] = onEvent;
      return () => {
        delete listeners[key];
      };
    }),
  };
  return {
    __esModule: true,
    default: mockApi,
    api: mockApi,
    getErrorMessage: jest.fn((err) => err?.message || "Unknown error"),
  };
});

const mockApi = apiClient.api as jest.Mocked<typeof apiClient.api>;

// Helper to trigger SSE event to all listeners
function triggerSSEEvent(event: any) {
  // Access the listeners via the mock
  const call = mockApi.connectFaceResultSSE.mock.calls[0];
  if (call) {
    (call[0] as Function)(event);
  }
}

describe("JobPoll Component", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("renders pending state with spinner", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="test-task" />);

    expect(screen.getByText("Đang xử lý...")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Job ID: test-task/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("renders success state with verification result", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="test-task" />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "test-task",
      status: "SUCCESS",
      result: { status: "success", verified: true, score: 0.9523 },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText("Thành công")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("renders success with liveness result", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="liveness-task" />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "liveness-task",
      status: "SUCCESS",
      result: { status: "success", is_live: true, liveness_score: 0.9876 },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText("Thành công")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/Khuôn mặt thật: Có/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("renders failure state with error message", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="fail-task" />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "fail-task",
      status: "FAILURE",
      result: { error: "NO_FACE_DETECTED", type: "task_failure" },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText("Lỗi")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/NO_FACE_DETECTED/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("calls onComplete callback on success", async () => {
    const onComplete = jest.fn();
    render(<JobPoll jobId="callback-task" onComplete={onComplete} />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "callback-task",
      status: "SUCCESS",
      result: { status: "success", is_live: true },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(onComplete).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ status: "success", is_live: true });
    });
  });

  it("calls onError callback on failure", async () => {
    const onError = jest.fn();
    render(<JobPoll jobId="error-task" onError={onError} />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "error-task",
      status: "FAILURE",
      result: { error: "LOW_QUALITY" },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(onError).toHaveBeenCalledWith("LOW_QUALITY");
    });
  });

  it("handles NULL confidence edge case", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="null-task" />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "null-task",
      status: "SUCCESS",
      result: { status: "success", is_live: undefined, score: 0 },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText("Thành công")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("handles empty result object", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="empty-task" />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "empty-task",
      status: "SUCCESS",
      result: { status: "success" },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText("Thành công")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("handles is_live false (spoof detected)", async () => {
    render(<JobPoll jobId="spoof-task" />);

    triggerSSEEvent({
      event_type: "face_result",
      task_id: "spoof-task",
      status: "SUCCESS",
      result: { status: "success", is_live: false, liveness_score: 0.1234 },
    });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText("Thành công")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/Khuôn mặt thật: Không/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

describe("Face Login API", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("W2: calls correct endpoint and returns tokens", async () => {
    const mockFile = new File(["face-data"], "face.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
    mockApi.faceLogin.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      access_token: "mock-access-token",
      refresh_token: "mock-refresh-token",
      token_type: "bearer",
    });

    const result = await mockApi.faceLogin(mockFile);

    expect(mockApi.faceLogin).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockFile);
    expect(result.access_token).toBe("mock-access-token");
    expect(result.refresh_token).toBe("mock-refresh-token");
    expect(result.token_type).toBe("bearer");
  });

  it("W2: throws on API error", async () => {
    const mockFile = new File(["face-data"], "face.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
    mockApi.faceLogin.mockRejectedValueOnce({
      response: { status: 400, data: { detail: "Khuôn mặt không khớp" } },
    });

    await expect(mockApi.faceLogin(mockFile)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      response: { status: 400 },
    });
  });

  it("W2: sends FormData with file field", async () => {
    const mockFile = new File(["binary-data"], "capture.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
    mockApi.faceLogin.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      access_token: "token",
      refresh_token: null,
      token_type: "bearer",
    });

    await mockApi.faceLogin(mockFile);

    // Verify the call was made with a File object
    const callArg = mockApi.faceLogin.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(callArg).toBeInstanceOf(File);
    expect(callArg.name).toBe("capture.jpg");
  });
});

// W8: Token storage after face login
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe("Token Storage After Face Login", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    // Clear cookies
    document.cookie.split(";").forEach((c) => {
      document.cookie = c.replace(/^ +/, "").replace(/=.*/, "=; path=/; max-age=0");
    });
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("W8: does NOT store access_token in localStorage (security: uses cookie)", async () => {
    const mockFile = new File(["face"], "face.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
    mockApi.faceLogin.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      access_token: "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.test",
      refresh_token: "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.refresh",
      token_type: "bearer",
    });

    const result = await mockApi.faceLogin(mockFile);

    // Access token should NOT be in localStorage (XSS protection)
    expect(localStorage.getItem("access_token")).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem("refresh_token")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("W8: clears tokens on logout", () => {
    // Set cookie to simulate existing session
    document.cookie = "access_token=token-to-clear; path=/";
    document.cookie = "refresh_token=refresh-to-clear; path=/";

    // Simulate logout
    document.cookie = "access_token=; path=/; max-age=0";
    document.cookie = "refresh_token=; path=/; max-age=0";

    expect(localStorage.getItem("access_token")).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem("refresh_token")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("Face Login Success Flow", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {

    // Step 1: Mock face login API
    const mockFile = new File(["face-image"], "face.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
    mockApi.faceLogin.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      access_token: "access-abc123",
      refresh_token: "refresh-xyz789",
      token_type: "bearer",
    });

    // Step 2: Call face login
    const tokenResponse = await mockApi.faceLogin(mockFile);
    expect(tokenResponse.access_token).toBe("access-abc123");

    // Step 3: Verify tokens NOT in localStorage (security)
    expect(localStorage.getItem("access_token")).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem("refresh_token")).toBeNull();

    // Step 4: Call setAuthFromToken (simulating auth context update)
    mockSetAuthFromToken(
      tokenResponse.access_token,
      tokenResponse.refresh_token,
      "admin@example.com",
      "admin"
    );

    // Verify setAuthFromToken was called with correct args
    expect(mockSetAuthFromToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      "access-abc123",
      "refresh-xyz789",
      "admin@example.com",
      "admin"
    );
  });
});

// W4: Face login fail 2x -> password mode
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe("Face Login Fail Fallback", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("W4: after 2 consecutive failures, should fallback to password mode", () => {
    // Simulate face login fail counter logic (from login page)
    let faceFailCount = 0;
    let loginMode = "face";

    const handleFaceFail = () => {
      faceFailCount += 1;
      if (faceFailCount >= 2) {
        loginMode = "password";
      }
    };

    // First failure
    handleFaceFail();
    expect(loginMode).toBe("face");
    expect(faceFailCount).toBe(1);

    // Second failure -> should switch to password
    handleFaceFail();
    expect(loginMode).toBe("password");
    expect(faceFailCount).toBe(2);
  });

  it("W4: failure count resets on mode switch", () => {
    let faceFailCount = 0;

    const resetFailCount = () => {
      faceFailCount = 0;
    };

    faceFailCount = 2;
    resetFailCount();
    expect(faceFailCount).toBe(0);
  });
});

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
import api from '@/lib/api-client';
import type { CompanionChunk, CompanionState, VisemeData } from '@/lib/types/ai';

export interface CommandCenterSummary {
  operational_score: number;
  active_patrons: number;
  overdue_borrows: number;
  scheduled_staff_today: number;
  today_entries: number;
  today_exits: number;
  generated_at: string;
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
  timestamp: number;
  isVoice?: boolean;
}

interface AIWidgetStore {
  isOpen: boolean;
  isMinimized: boolean;
  activeTab: 'score' | 'chat' | 'actions';
  lastSummary: CommandCenterSummary | null;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  isLoadingChat: boolean;
  chatSessionId?: string;
  proactiveMessage: string | null;
  failedSearchCount: number;

  companionState: CompanionState;
  isVoiceActive: boolean;
  visemeData: VisemeData[];
  audioQueue: string[];
  currentAudio: string | null;

  open: () => void;
  close: () => void;
  toggle: () => void;
  minimize: () => void;
  setActiveTab: (tab: 'score' | 'chat' | 'actions') => void;
  updateSummary: (summary: CommandCenterSummary) => void;
  sendMessage: (message: string) => Promise<void>;
  sendVoiceMessage: (audioBase64: string) => Promise<void>;
  setCompanionState: (state: CompanionState) => void;
  setVoiceActive: (active: boolean) => void;
  setVisemeData: (visemes: VisemeData[]) => void;
  setCurrentAudio: (audio: string | null) => void;
  clearMessages: () => void;
  recordFailedSearch: () => void;
  resetFailedSearch: () => void;
  dismissProactive: () => void;
}

export const useAIWidgetStore = create<AIWidgetStore>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      isOpen: false,
      isMinimized: false,
      activeTab: 'score',
      lastSummary: null,
      messages: [],
      isLoadingChat: false,
      chatSessionId: undefined,
      proactiveMessage: null,
      failedSearchCount: 0,

      companionState: 'idle',
      isVoiceActive: false,
      visemeData: [],
      audioQueue: [],
      currentAudio: null,

      open: () => set({ isOpen: true }),
      close: () => set({ isOpen: false }),
      toggle: () => set((state) => ({ isOpen: !state.isOpen })),
      minimize: () => set((state) => ({ isMinimized: !state.isMinimized })),

      setActiveTab: (tab) => set({ activeTab: tab }),

      updateSummary: (summary) => set({ lastSummary: summary }),

      setCompanionState: (state) => set({ companionState: state }),
      setVoiceActive: (active) => set({ isVoiceActive: active }),
      setVisemeData: (visemes) => set({ visemeData: visemes }),
      setCurrentAudio: (audio) => set({ currentAudio: audio }),

      recordFailedSearch: () => set((state) => {
        const next = state.failedSearchCount + 1;
        if (next >= 3 && !state.proactiveMessage) {
          return {
            failedSearchCount: next,
            proactiveMessage: "Bạn đang tìm sách? Tôi có thể giúp bạn tìm kiếm hoặc gợi ý sách phù hợp.",
          };
        }
        return { failedSearchCount: next };
      }),

      resetFailedSearch: () => set({ failedSearchCount: 0 }),

      dismissProactive: () => set({ proactiveMessage: null }),

      sendMessage: async (message: string) => {
        const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
          id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
          role: 'user',
          content: message,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        };

        set((state) => ({
          messages: [...state.messages, userMessage],
          isLoadingChat: true,
          companionState: 'thinking',
        }));

        try {
          const { chatSessionId } = get();

          let accumulatedText = '';
          await api.streamCompanionChat(
            message,
            undefined,
            chatSessionId,
            (chunk: CompanionChunk) => {
              switch (chunk.type) {
                case 'text':
                  accumulatedText += chunk.data.content;
                  set((state) => ({
                    messages: [
                      ...state.messages.filter((m) => m.id !== 'streaming'),
                      {
                        id: 'streaming',
                        role: 'assistant',
                        content: accumulatedText,
                        timestamp: Date.now(),
                      },
                    ],
                  }));
                  break;
                case 'audio':
                  set({ currentAudio: chunk.data.audioBase64, companionState: 'speaking' });
                  break;
                case 'viseme':
                  set({ visemeData: chunk.data.visemes });
                  break;
                case 'companion_done':
                  set((state) => ({
                    messages: state.messages.map((m) =>
                      m.id === 'streaming' ? { ...m, id: `assistant-${Date.now()}` } : m
                    ),
                    isLoadingChat: false,
                    companionState: 'idle',
                    chatSessionId: chunk.data.sessionId || state.chatSessionId,
                  }));
                  break;
              }
            },
            (error) => {
              console.error('Companion stream error:', error);
              set((state) => ({
                messages: [
                  ...state.messages,
                  {
                    id: `error-${Date.now()}`,
                    role: 'assistant',
                    content: 'Xin lỗi, đã xảy ra lỗi khi kết nối AI. Vui lòng thử lại.',
                    timestamp: Date.now(),
                  },
                ],
                isLoadingChat: false,
                companionState: 'error',
              }));
            },
          );
        } catch {
          const errorMessage: ChatMessage = {
            id: `error-${Date.now()}`,
            role: 'assistant',
            content: 'Xin lỗi, đã xảy ra lỗi khi kết nối AI. Vui lòng thử lại.',
            timestamp: Date.now(),
          };

          set((state) => ({
            messages: [...state.messages, errorMessage],
            isLoadingChat: false,
            companionState: 'error',
          }));
        }
      },

      sendVoiceMessage: async (audioBase64: string) => {
        const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
          id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
          role: 'user',
          content: '[Voice message]',
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          isVoice: true,
        };

        set((state) => ({
          messages: [...state.messages, userMessage],
          isLoadingChat: true,
          companionState: 'listening',
        }));

        try {
          const { chatSessionId } = get();

          let accumulatedText = '';
          await api.streamCompanionChat(
            undefined,
            audioBase64,
            chatSessionId,
            (chunk: CompanionChunk) => {
              switch (chunk.type) {
                case 'text':
                  accumulatedText += chunk.data.content;
                  set((state) => ({
                    messages: [
                      ...state.messages.filter((m) => m.id !== 'streaming'),
                      {
                        id: 'streaming',
                        role: 'assistant',
                        content: accumulatedText,
                        timestamp: Date.now(),
                      },
                    ],
                  }));
                  break;
                case 'audio':
                  set({ currentAudio: chunk.data.audioBase64, companionState: 'speaking' });
                  break;
                case 'viseme':
                  set({ visemeData: chunk.data.visemes });
                  break;
                case 'companion_done':
                  set((state) => ({
                    messages: state.messages.map((m) =>
                      m.id === 'streaming' ? { ...m, id: `assistant-${Date.now()}` } : m
                    ),
                    isLoadingChat: false,
                    companionState: 'idle',
                    chatSessionId: chunk.data.sessionId || state.chatSessionId,
                  }));
                  break;
              }
            },
            (error) => {
              console.error('Companion stream error:', error);
              set((state) => ({
                messages: [
                  ...state.messages,
                  {
                    id: `error-${Date.now()}`,
                    role: 'assistant',
                    content: 'Xin lỗi, đã xảy ra lỗi khi kết nối AI. Vui lòng thử lại.',
                    timestamp: Date.now(),
                  },
                ],
                isLoadingChat: false,
                companionState: 'error',
              }));
            },
          );
        } catch {
          const errorMessage: ChatMessage = {
            id: `error-${Date.now()}`,
            role: 'assistant',
            content: 'Xin lỗi, đã xảy ra lỗi khi kết nối AI. Vui lòng thử lại.',
            timestamp: Date.now(),
          };

          set((state) => ({
            messages: [...state.messages, errorMessage],
            isLoadingChat: false,
            companionState: 'error',
          }));
        }
      },

      clearMessages: () => set({ messages: [], chatSessionId: undefined }),
    }),
    {
      name: 'ai-widget-storage',
      partialize: (state) => ({
        isMinimized: state.isMinimized,
        activeTab: state.activeTab,
        messages: state.messages,
        chatSessionId: state.chatSessionId,
      }),
    }
  )
);

"use client";

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  TextField,
  IconButton,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Avatar,
  useTheme,
  CircularProgress,
  Chip,
  alpha,
} from "@mui/material";
import SendIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SendOutlined";
import SmartToyIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SmartToyOutlined";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined";
import AccessTimeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined";
import SearchIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SearchOutlined";
import CalendarMonthIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined";
import HelpOutlineIcon from "@mui/icons-material/HelpOutlineOutlined";
import ReactMarkdown from "react-markdown";

import { useAIWidgetStore, ChatMessage } from "../store/useAIWidgetStore";
import { type BookCardData } from "../../BookCard";
import BookLocationCard from "../cards/BookLocationCard";
import LibraryHoursCard, { type LibraryScheduleData } from "../cards/LibraryHoursCard";

type Segment =
  | { type: "text"; content: string }
  | { type: "book_card"; bookData: BookCardData; shelfLocation?: string }
  | { type: "library_hours"; scheduleData: LibraryScheduleData };

const QUICK_SUGGESTIONS = [
  { label: "Giờ mở cửa thư viện?", icon: <AccessTimeIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} /> },
  { label: "Tìm sách lập trình Web", icon: <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} /> },
  { label: "Lịch trực hôm nay", icon: <CalendarMonthIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} /> },
  { label: "Quy định mượn trả sách", icon: <HelpOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} /> },
];

function extractSchedule(text: string): {
  before: string;
  scheduleData: LibraryScheduleData | null;
  after: string;
} {
  const blockRegex = /```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?"schedule"\s*:\s*\[[\s\S]*?\][\s\S]*?\})\s*```/;
  const blockMatch = text.match(blockRegex);
  if (blockMatch) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(blockMatch[1]);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.schedule)) {
        const idx = text.indexOf(blockMatch[0]);
        return {
          before: text.substring(0, idx).trim(),
          scheduleData: parsed,
          after: text.substring(idx + blockMatch[0].length).trim(),
        };
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  const rawRegex = /\{[\s\S]*?"schedule"\s*:\s*\[[\s\S]*?\][\s\S]*?\}/;
  const rawMatch = text.match(rawRegex);
  if (rawMatch) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawMatch[0]);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.schedule)) {
        const idx = text.indexOf(rawMatch[0]);
        return {
          before: text.substring(0, idx).trim(),
          scheduleData: parsed,
          after: text.substring(idx + rawMatch[0].length).trim(),
        };
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return { before: text, scheduleData: null, after: "" };
}

function extractBookCard(text: string): {
  before: string;
  bookData: BookCardData | null;
  after: string;
} {
  const marker = /:::book_card\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*:::/;
  const match = text.match(marker);
  if (!match) {
    return { before: text, bookData: null, after: "" };
  }

  const idx = text.indexOf(match[0]);
  const before = text.substring(0, idx).trim();
  const after = text.substring(idx + match[0].length).trim();

  try {
    const bookData = JSON.parse(match[1]) as BookCardData;
    return { before, bookData, after };
  } catch {
    return { before: text, bookData: null, after: "" };
  }
}

function parseMessageSegments(content: string): Segment[] {
  if (!content) return [];

  // 1. Check for library schedule JSON block
  const sched = extractSchedule(content);
  if (sched.scheduleData) {
    const beforeSegments = sched.before ? parseMessageSegments(sched.before) : [];
    const afterSegments = sched.after ? parseMessageSegments(sched.after) : [];
    return [
      ...beforeSegments,
      { type: "library_hours", scheduleData: sched.scheduleData },
      ...afterSegments,
    ];
  }

  // 2. Check for book card block
  const book = extractBookCard(content);
  if (book.bookData) {
    const beforeSegments = book.before ? parseMessageSegments(book.before) : [];
    const afterSegments = book.after ? parseMessageSegments(book.after) : [];
    return [
      ...beforeSegments,
      {
        type: "book_card",
        bookData: book.bookData,
        shelfLocation: (book.bookData as any).shelf_location,
      },
      ...afterSegments,
    ];
  }

  // 3. Plain text segment
  const trimmed = content.trim();
  return trimmed ? [{ type: "text", content: trimmed }] : [];
}

export default function ChatTab() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";
  const { messages, sendMessage, isLoadingChat } = useAIWidgetStore();
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [messages, isLoadingChat]);

  const handleSend = async (customText?: string) => {
    const trimmed = (customText ?? input).trim();
    if (!trimmed || isLoadingChat) return;

    if (!customText) setInput("");
    await sendMessage(trimmed);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "100%" }}>
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, overflow: "auto", p: 2 }}>
        {messages.length === 0 ? (
          <Stack
            spacing={2}
            sx={{
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              height: "100%",
              py: 2,
            }}
          >
            <Avatar
              sx={{
                width: 52,
                height: 52,
                bgcolor: "primary.main",
                boxShadow: isDark
                  ? "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"
                  : "0 4px 16px rgba(30, 96, 145, 0.25)",
              }}
            >
              <SmartToyIcon sx={{ fontSize: 28 }} />
            </Avatar>
            <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center", px: 1 }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5 }}>
                Trợ lý AI Thư viện IUH
              </Typography>

                Hỏi tôi về sách, giờ mở cửa, lịch trực, quy định mượn trả...
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <Box
              sx={{
                display: "flex",

                gap: 1,
                justifyContent: "center",
                maxWidth: 340,
                mt: 1,
              }}
            >
              {QUICK_SUGGESTIONS.map((item) => (
                <Chip
                  key={item.label}
                  icon={item.icon}
                  label={item.label}
                  size="small"

                    cursor: "pointer",
                    borderRadius: 2,
                    fontSize: "0.75rem",
                    borderColor: isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)",

        ) : (
          <Stack spacing={2}>

                  AI đang xử lý câu trả lời...

function MessageBubble({ message }: { message: ChatMessage }) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";
  const isUser = message.role === "user";

  const segments: Segment[] = isUser
    ? [{ type: "text", content: message.content }]
    : parseMessageSegments(message.content);

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: isUser ? "row-reverse" : "row",
        alignItems: "flex-start",
        gap: 1.25,
        width: "100%",
      }}
    >
      <Avatar
        sx={{
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          bgcolor: isUser ? "secondary.main" : "primary.main",
          boxShadow: isDark
            ? "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"
            : "0 2px 8px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          flexShrink: 0,
          mt: 0.5,
        }}
      >
        {isUser ? <PersonIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} /> : <SmartToyIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
      </Avatar>

      <Box
        sx={{
          maxWidth: "88%",
          minWidth: 0,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          gap: 0.75,
        }}
      >
        {segments.map((seg, i) => {
          if (seg.type === "book_card") {
            return (
              <BookLocationCard
                key={i}
                data={{ ...seg.bookData, shelf_location: seg.shelfLocation }}
              />
            );
          }

          if (seg.type === "library_hours") {
            return <LibraryHoursCard key={i} data={seg.scheduleData} />;
          }

          return (
            <Paper

              elevation={0}

                    ? "primary.dark"

                color: isUser ? "primary.contrastText" : "text.primary",

                borderColor: isUser

                    "& p:first-of-type": { mt: 0 },

                    "& ul, & ol": { pl: 2.2, my: 0.5 },
                    "& li": { mb: 0.35, lineHeight: 1.55 },
                    "& strong": {
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      color: isDark ? "secondary.light" : "primary.main",
                    },
                    "& em": { fontStyle: "italic" },
                    "& h1, & h2, & h3, & h4": {
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      mt: 1,
                      mb: 0.5,

                    "& h2": { fontSize: "1.02rem" },
                    "& h3": { fontSize: "0.95rem" },

                      px: 0.6,

                      p: 1.25,
                      borderRadius: 1.5,
                      overflow: "auto",
                      my: 0.75,
                      "& code": { bgcolor: "transparent", p: 0 },
                    },

                      width: "100%",
                      borderCollapse: "collapse",
                      my: 1,
                      fontSize: "0.82rem",
                    },

                      border: "1px solid",
                      borderColor: isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.12)",
                      p: 0.75,
                    },

                      fontWeight: 700,
                    },

                      pl: 1.5,
                      my: 0.75,
                      fontStyle: "italic",
                      color: "text.secondary",
                    },
                    "& a": {
                      color: isDark ? "secondary.light" : "primary.main",
                      textDecoration: "none",
                      "&:hover": { textDecoration: "underline" },
                    },
                  }}
                >
                  <ReactMarkdown>{seg.content}</ReactMarkdown>
                </Box>
              )}
            </Paper>
          );
        })}

        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{
            display: "block",
            textAlign: isUser ? "right" : "left",
            opacity: 0.65,
            fontSize: 10,
            px: 0.5,
          }}
        >
          {new Date(message.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", {
            hour: "2-digit",
            minute: "2-digit",
          })}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Box, Chip, IconButton, Stack, Tooltip, Typography, useTheme } from "@mui/material";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Refresh";
import WbSunnyOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WbSunnyOutlined";
import NightlightOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/NightlightOutlined";
import WbTwilightOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WbTwilightOutlined";
import SensorIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SensorsOutlined";
import { fadeInUp } from "@/lib/animations";

interface GreetingBarProps {
  userName: string;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  liveConnected: boolean;
}

function getTimeGreeting() {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) return { text: "Chào buổi sáng", icon: <WbSunnyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#f59e0b" }} /> };
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return { text: "Chào buổi chiều", icon: <WbTwilightOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#f97316" }} /> };
  return { text: "Chào buổi tối", icon: <NightlightOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#D4AF37" }} /> };
}

export default function GreetingBar({ userName, onRefresh, liveConnected }: GreetingBarProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const [timeStr, setTimeStr] = useState<string>("");
  const greeting = getTimeGreeting();

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateTime = () => {
      const d = new Date();
      setTimeStr(d.toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" }));
    };
    updateTime();
    const interval = setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", {
    weekday: "long",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  });

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: { xs: "column", sm: "row" },
        alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", sm: "center" },
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        gap: 1.5,
        p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
        borderRadius: 2,
        border: "1px solid",
        borderColor: "divider",
        bgcolor: "background.paper",
        animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.4s ease-out`,
      }}
    >

        <Chip
          icon={<SensorIcon sx={{ fontSize: "15px !important" }} />}

          size="small"
          sx={{
