import { Avatar, Box, LinearProgress, Paper, Stack, Typography, useTheme } from "@mui/material";
import { fadeInUp } from "@/lib/animations";
import type { SvgIconComponent } from "@mui/icons-material";

interface MuiStatCardProps {
  label: string;
  value: number | string;
  icon: SvgIconComponent;
  /** gradient string — dùng để tô màu icon avatar và progress bar */
  gradient: string;
  pct?: number;
  index?: number;
  /** Optional: delta / trend text (e.g. "+12 hôm nay") */
  delta?: string;
  deltaColor?: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "default";
}

/**
 * Flat, data-first stat card — Anti-Slop compliant.
 *
 * Thiết kế:
 *  - Flat icon (no gradient avatar, no glow circle)
 *  - Left accent border 3px (color từ gradient parse)
 *  - Không hover dance (translateY / rotate)
 *  - Progress bar dùng flat color
 */
export default function MuiStatCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon: Icon,
  gradient,
  pct,
  index = 0,
  delta,
  deltaColor = "default",
}: MuiStatCardProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();

  const deltaColors = {
    success: "#059669",
    warning: "#D97706",
    error:   "#DC2626",
    default: "text.secondary",
  };

  // Parse accent color from gradient string (e.g. "linear-gradient(135deg, #1E40AF 0%, ...)")
  const accentColor = (() => {
    const match = gradient.match(/#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}/);
    return match ? match[0] : theme.palette.primary.main;
  })();

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        borderRadius: 2,
        p: 2,
        position: "relative",
        overflow: "hidden",
        transition: "border-color 0.2s ease",
        animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.4s ease-out both`,
        animationDelay: `${index * 0.06}s`,
        // Left accent bar — flat, purposeful color
        borderLeft: `3px solid ${accentColor}`,
        "&:hover": {
          borderColor: accentColor,
        },
      }}
    >
      {/* Icon + Label row */}
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", mb: 1.5 }}>
        <Avatar
          sx={{
            bgcolor: `${accentColor}18`, // 10% opacity flat bg
            width: 36,
            height: 36,
            borderRadius: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Icon sx={{ color: accentColor, fontSize: 18 }} />
        </Avatar>
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{
            fontWeight: 700,
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: "0.06em",
            color: "text.secondary",
            fontSize: "0.72rem",
          }}
        >
          {label}
        </Typography>
      </Stack>

      {/* Value */}
      <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1, mb: pct != null ? 1.5 : 0 }}>
        {typeof value === "number" ? value.toLocaleString("vi-VN") : value}
      </Typography>

      {/* Delta / trend */}
      {delta && (
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{ color: deltaColors[deltaColor], fontWeight: 600, display: "block", mt: 0.5 }}
        >
          {delta}
        </Typography>
      )}

      {/* Progress bar — flat color, no gradient */}
      {pct != null && (
        <LinearProgress
          variant="determinate"
          value={Math.min(pct, 100)}
          sx={{
            height: 3,
            borderRadius: 2,
            bgcolor: "action.hover",
            mt: delta ? 0.75 : 0,
            "& .MuiLinearProgress-bar": { bgcolor: accentColor, borderRadius: 2 },
          }}
        />
      )}
    </Paper>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Box, CircularProgress, Paper, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import {
  NotificationsOutlined,
  ErrorOutlined,
  CalendarMonthOutlined,
  BadgeOutlined,
  ShieldOutlined,
  BarChartOutlined,
  PersonOffOutlined,
  MenuBookOutlined,
  LocalFireDepartmentOutlined,
} from "@mui/icons-material";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { Notification } from "@/lib/types";

const NOTIFICATION_CONFIG: Record<string, { icon: React.ReactNode; color: string; label: string }> = {
  borrow: { icon: <MenuBookOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "success.main", label: "Mượn sách" },
  return: { icon: <MenuBookOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "primary.main", label: "Trả sách" },
  book_available: { icon: <MenuBookOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "success.main", label: "Sách có sẵn" },
  overdue_reminder: { icon: <ErrorOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "error.main", label: "Quá hạn" },
  due_soon_reminder: { icon: <ErrorOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Sắp đến hạn" },
  fine_notice: { icon: <ErrorOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "error.main", label: "Phí phạt" },
  schedule_change: { icon: <CalendarMonthOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Lịch trực" },
  shift_reminder: { icon: <CalendarMonthOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "secondary.main", label: "Nhắc lịch" },
  membership_expiry: { icon: <BadgeOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "error.main", label: "Hạn thẻ" },
  anomaly_alert: { icon: <ShieldOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "error.main", label: "Bất thường" },
  fire_hazard: { icon: <LocalFireDepartmentOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "error.main", label: "Cảnh báo cháy" },
  hazard_alert: { icon: <LocalFireDepartmentOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "error.main", label: "Nguy cơ cháy" },
  smoke_alert: { icon: <ShieldOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Cảnh báo khói" },
  smoke_hazard: { icon: <ShieldOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Phát hiện khói" },
  daily_report: { icon: <BarChartOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "primary.main", label: "Thống kê" },
  staff_absence: { icon: <PersonOffOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Vắng mặt" },
  bid_warning: { icon: <ErrorOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Đấu giá" },
  swap_warning: { icon: <ErrorOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "warning.main", label: "Đổi ca" },
};

function getConfig(type: string) {
  return NOTIFICATION_CONFIG[type] || { icon: <NotificationsOutlined fontSize="small" />, color: "primary.main", label: "Thông báo" };
}

function formatRelativeTime(isoString: string): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const date = new Date(isoString);
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
  const diffSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
  const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHour / 24);

  if (diffSec < 60) return "Vừa xong";
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin} phút trước`;
  if (diffHour < 24) return `${diffHour} giờ trước`;
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay} ngày trước`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN");
}

interface NotificationDropdownProps {
  anchorEl: HTMLElement | null;
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function NotificationDropdown({ anchorEl, open, onClose }: NotificationDropdownProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!open) return;
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const result = await api.getNotifications({ limit: 20 });
      setNotifications(result.items);
    } catch {
      // silently fail
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotifications();
  }, [fetchNotifications]);

  // Close on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        dropdownRef.current &&
        !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node) &&
        anchorEl &&
        !anchorEl.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, [open, onClose, anchorEl]);

  // Close on Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    const handleEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    try {
      await api.markAllNotificationsAsRead();
      setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
    } catch {
      // silently fail
    }
  };

  const handleNotificationClick = async (notification: Notification) => {
    if (!notification.isRead) {
      try {
        await api.markNotificationAsRead(notification.id);
        setNotifications((prev) =>
          prev.map((n) => (n.id === notification.id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n))
        );
      } catch {
        // silently fail
      }
    }
    onClose();
    router.push("/notifications");
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <Paper
      ref={dropdownRef}
      elevation={8}
      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      sx={{
        position: "absolute",
        top: "100%",
        right: 0,
        mt: 1,
        width: 380,
        maxHeight: 480,
        borderRadius: 2,
        overflow: "hidden",
        zIndex: 1300,
        border: "1px solid",
        borderColor: "divider",
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ p: 2, borderBottom: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
          Thông báo
        </Typography>
        <Typography
          variant="caption"
          sx={{ color: "primary.main", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 600, "&:hover": { textDecoration: "underline" } }}
          onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
        >
          Đánh dấu đã đọc tất cả
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      <Box sx={{ maxHeight: 400, overflow: "auto" }}>
        {loading ? (
          <Box sx={{ p: 4, display: "flex", justifyContent: "center" }}>
            <CircularProgress size={24} />
          </Box>
        ) : notifications.length === 0 ? (
          <Box sx={{ p: 4, textAlign: "center" }}>
            <NotificationsOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.secondary", mb: 1 }} />
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
              Không có thông báo
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          notifications.map((notification) => {
            const config = getConfig(notification.type);
            return (
              <Box
                key={notification.id}
                onClick={() => handleNotificationClick(notification)}
                sx={{
                  p: 2,
                  display: "flex",
                  gap: 1.5,
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  borderBottom: "1px solid",
                  borderColor: "divider",
                  bgcolor: notification.isRead ? "transparent" : "action.hover",
                  "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.selected" },
                }}
              >
                <Box sx={{ color: config.color, mt: 0.5 }}>{config.icon}</Box>
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: notification.isRead ? 400 : 700 }} noWrap>
                    {notification.title}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>
                    {notification.body}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.disabled" sx={{ mt: 0.5, display: "block" }}>
                    {formatRelativeTime(notification.createdAt)}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
                {!notification.isRead && (
                  <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "error.main", mt: 1, flexShrink: 0 }} />
                )}
              </Box>
            );
          })
        )}
      </Box>
    </Paper>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Avatar, Box, LinearProgress, Paper, Stack, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import { AreaChart, Area, ResponsiveContainer } from "recharts";
import { fadeInUp } from "@/lib/animations";
import PeopleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PeopleOutlined";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined";
import UpdateIcon from "@mui/icons-material/UpdateOutlined";
import FaceIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlined";
import type { PatronPublic } from "@/lib/types";

interface PatronStatCardsProps {
  patrons: PatronPublic[];
}

const STAT_GRADIENT = {
  total: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
  active: "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
  expired: "linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706 0%, #B45309 100%)",
  face: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
};

function Sparkline({ data, color, id }: { data: number[]; color: string; id: string }) {
  if (data.every((v) => v === 0)) return null;
  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: 36, width: "100%", minWidth: 0, mt: 1, mx: -0.5 }}>
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth={0} minHeight={36}>
        <AreaChart data={data.map((v) => ({ v }))} margin={{ top: 2, right: 0, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`spark-${id}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={0.4} />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={0.0} />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          <Area
            type="monotone"
            dataKey="v"
            stroke={color}
            strokeWidth={2}
            fill={`url(#spark-${id})`}
            fillOpacity={1}
            dot={false}
          />
        </AreaChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function PatronStatCards({ patrons }: PatronStatCardsProps) {
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const activeCount = patrons.filter((p) => p.status === "active").length;
    const expiredCount = patrons.filter((p) => p.status === "expired" || p.status === "inactive").length;
    const faceCount = patrons.filter((p) => p.has_face).length;

    const now = new Date();
    const dailyData: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const dateStr = d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
      const count = patrons.filter((p) => p.created_at?.startsWith(dateStr)).length;
      dailyData.push(count);
    }

    return { activeCount, expiredCount, faceCount, dailyData };
  }, [patrons]);

  const items = [
    { label: "Tổng độc giả", value: patrons.length, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.total, icon: PeopleIcon, pct: 100, sparkColor: "#0A2540" },
    { label: "Hoạt động", value: stats.activeCount, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.active, icon: PersonIcon, pct: patrons.length ? Math.round((stats.activeCount / patrons.length) * 100) : 0, sparkColor: "#059669" },
    { label: "Hết hạn / Khóa", value: stats.expiredCount, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.expired, icon: UpdateIcon, pct: patrons.length ? Math.round((stats.expiredCount / patrons.length) * 100) : 0, sparkColor: "#D97706" },
    { label: "Có khuôn mặt", value: stats.faceCount, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.face, icon: FaceIcon, pct: patrons.length ? Math.round((stats.faceCount / patrons.length) * 100) : 0, sparkColor: "#8B0000" },
  ];

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(4, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
      {items.map((item, idx) => (
        <Paper
          key={item.label}
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            borderRadius: 3, position: "relative", overflow: "hidden", p: 2.5,
            transition: "all 0.25s ease",
            animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.5s ease-out`,
            animationDelay: `${idx * 0.07}s`,
            animationFillMode: "both",
            "&:hover": { transform: "translateY(-2px)", boxShadow: 4 },
          }}
        >
          <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: -20, right: -20, width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: "50%", background: item.gradient, opacity: 0.12, pointerEvents: "none" }} />
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", mb: 1 }}>
            <Avatar sx={{ background: item.gradient, width: 44, height: 44 }}>
              <item.icon sx={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 22 }} />
            </Avatar>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", color: "text.secondary", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
              {item.label}
            </Typography>
          </Stack>
          <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 0.5 }}>
            {typeof item.value === "number" ? item.value.toLocaleString("vi-VN") : item.value}
          </Typography>
          <LinearProgress
            variant="determinate"
            value={item.pct}
            sx={{
              height: 3, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "rgba(99,102,241,0.08)",
              "& .MuiLinearProgress-bar": { background: item.gradient, borderRadius: 2 },
            }}
          />
          <Sparkline data={stats.dailyData} color={item.sparkColor} id={`card-${idx}`} />
        </Paper>
      ))}
    </Box>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Box, Button, ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup, Tooltip } from "@mui/material";
import AddIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AddOutlined";
import SearchField from "./SearchField";
import type { FilterValue } from "@/app/(dashboard)/patrons/page";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";

interface PatronToolbarProps {
  query: string;
  onQueryChange: (q: string) => void;
  filter: FilterValue;
  onFilterChange: (f: FilterValue) => void;
  onAddPatron: () => void;
}

const FILTERS: { value: FilterValue; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
  { value: "active", label: "Hoạt động" },
  { value: "inactive", label: "Tạm khóa" },
  { value: "expired", label: "Hết hạn" },
  { value: "has_face", label: "Có khuôn mặt" },
  { value: "no_face", label: "Chưa có khuôn mặt" },
  { value: "deleted", label: "Đã xóa" },
];

export default function PatronToolbar({ query, onQueryChange, filter, onFilterChange, onAddPatron }: PatronToolbarProps) {
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canCreate = can("patrons", "create");

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "sticky",
        top: 0,
        zIndex: 10,
        bgcolor: "background.paper",
        borderRadius: 3,
        border: 1,

        boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <SearchField value={query} onChange={onQueryChange} placeholder="Tìm theo tên, MSSV, mã thẻ..." />
      </Box>

      <ToggleButtonGroup
        value={filter}
        exclusive
        onChange={(_, v) => { if (v) onFilterChange(v); }}
        size="small"
        sx={{
          display: "flex",
          flexWrap: "wrap",
          gap: 0.75,
          "& .MuiToggleButton-root": {

            "&.Mui-selected": {
              bgcolor: "primary.main",

              "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" },

          },
        }}

          <ToggleButton key={f.value} value={f.value}>{f.label}</ToggleButton>

            Thêm độc giả
          </Button>

================
File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/BorrowIPCameraDialog.tsx
================
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Paper,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined";
import ErrorIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ReportOutlined";
import QrCodeScannerIcon from "@mui/icons-material/QrCodeScannerOutlined";
import SearchIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SearchOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";
import { getAlertSeverity } from "@/lib/alert-utils";
import { slideInRight, successPop } from "@/lib/animations";
import IPCameraStream from "./IPCameraStream";
import type { BorrowCartItem } from "./borrow/types";

interface ScannedBorrowItem {
  barcode: string;
  isbn: string;
  loading: boolean;
  can_borrow: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
  book: BookWithStats | null;
  copy_id: string | null;
  book_id: string | null;
  copy_barcode: string | null;
}

function toScannedItem(item: BorrowCartItem): ScannedBorrowItem {
  return {
    barcode: item.barcode,
    isbn: item.isbn,
    loading: false,
    can_borrow: item.can_borrow,
    reason: item.reason ?? null,
    // Cart books come from lookupBorrowSlip (serializeBookWithStats) at runtime,
    // even though BorrowCartItem declares the base BookInfo type.
    book: (item.book as BookWithStats | null) ?? null,
    copy_id: item.copy_id ?? null,
    book_id: item.book_id ?? null,
    copy_barcode: item.copy_barcode ?? null,
  };
}

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  patronId: string;
  patronName: string;
  maxItems?: number;
  cameraUrl: string;
  initialItems?: BorrowCartItem[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (result: { message: string; count: number }) => void;
}

export default function BorrowIPCameraDialog({
  open,
  patronId,
  patronName,
  maxItems,
  cameraUrl,
  initialItems,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: Props) {
  const initialItemsRef = useRef<BorrowCartItem[]>([]);
  initialItemsRef.current = initialItems ?? [];
  const [scanned, setScanned] = useState<ScannedBorrowItem[]>([]);
  const [lookingUp, setLookingUp] = useState(false);
  const [createError, setCreateError] = useState("");
  const [scanToast, setScanToast] = useState("");
  const [lookupError, setLookupError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [manualIsbn, setManualIsbn] = useState("");
  const [duplicateFlash, setDuplicateFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const lastScannedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const lookupItem = useCallback(async (barcode: string, isbn: string) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.map((item) =>
      item.barcode === barcode ? { ...item, loading: true } : item
    ));
    try {
      const result = await api.lookupBorrowSlip({
        patron_id: patronId,
        items: [{ barcode, isbn }],
      });
      const normBarcode = barcode.replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      const item = result.items.find((i) => {
        const iBarcode = (i.barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        const iCopyBarcode = (i.copy?.barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        const iIsbn = (i.isbn || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        return iBarcode === normBarcode || iCopyBarcode === normBarcode || iIsbn === normBarcode;
      }) || result.items[0];

      if (!item) {
        setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.barcode !== barcode));
        setLookupError(`Mã sách "${barcode}" không tồn tại trong thư viện`);
        return;
      }
      if (!item.can_borrow) {
        setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.barcode !== barcode));
        const msg = item.reason || "Sách không thể mượn";
        const title = item.book?.title || "";
        setLookupError(title ? `"${title}": ${msg}` : `${msg} (Mã: ${barcode})`);
        return;
      }
      setScanned((prev) => prev.map((i) =>
        i.barcode === barcode ? {
          ...i,
          loading: false,
          can_borrow: item.can_borrow,
          reason: item.reason,
          book: item.book,
          copy_id: item.copy?.id || null,
          book_id: item.book?.id || null,
          copy_barcode: item.copy?.barcode || null,
        } : i
      ));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.barcode !== barcode));
      setLookupError(`Lỗi tra cứu: ${barcode} — ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
    }
  }, [patronId]);

  const addScanned = useCallback((isbn: string) => {
    if (isbn.trim().length < 4) return;
    const normalized = isbn.replace(/-/g, "");
    lastScannedRef.current = normalized;
    setScanned((prev) => {
      const existing = prev.find((item) => item.barcode === normalized);
      if (existing) {
        setDuplicateFlash(normalized);
        setTimeout(() => setDuplicateFlash(null), 1500);
        setScanToast(`Sách ${existing.book?.title || normalized} đã quét rồi`);
        return prev;
      }
      if (maxItems !== undefined && prev.length >= maxItems) {
        setScanToast(`Chỉ được mượn tối đa ${maxItems} cuốn`);
        return prev;
      }
      setScanToast(`Đã quét: ${normalized}`);
      return [...prev, {
        barcode: normalized,
        isbn: normalized,
        loading: true,
        can_borrow: false,
        reason: null,
        book: null,
        copy_id: null,
        book_id: null,
        copy_barcode: null,
      }];
    });
    lookupItem(normalized, normalized);
  }, [lookupItem, maxItems]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setScanned([]);
      setCreateError("");
      setScanToast("");
      setNote("");
      setDuplicateFlash(null);
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
      return;
    }
    // Prefill with books already added on the manual step so one session creates one slip.
    setScanned(initialItemsRef.current.map(toScannedItem));
  }, [open]);

  const removeItem = (barcode: string) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.barcode !== barcode));
  };

  const handleCreateSlip = async () => {
    const validItems = scanned.filter((item) => item.can_borrow && item.book_id && item.copy_id);
    if (!validItems.length || !patronId) return;
    setCreateError("");
    try {
      const confirmResult = await api.confirmBorrowSlip({
        patron_id: patronId,
        items: validItems.map((item) => ({
          barcode: item.copy_barcode || item.barcode,
          isbn: item.isbn,
          book_id: item.book_id!,
          copy_id: item.copy_id!,
        })),
        note: note.trim() || null,
      });
      if (confirmResult.status === "success") {
        setScanned([]);
        onSuccess({ message: confirmResult.message, count: validItems.length });
        onClose();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const detail = getErrorMessage(err);
      setCreateError(detail);
    }
  };

  const validCount = scanned.filter((item) => item.can_borrow).length;
  const totalScanned = scanned.length;

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={open} onClose={lookingUp ? undefined : onClose} fullWidth maxWidth="xl">
        <DialogTitle>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" />
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>
                Quét mã vạch sách (IP Camera)
              </Typography>
            </Stack>
            {!lookingUp && (
              <IconButton size="small" onClick={onClose}><CloseIcon /></IconButton>
            )}
          </Stack>
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers sx={{ p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, flexDirection: { xs: "column", md: "row" }, flex: 1, overflow: "hidden" }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: { md: "50%" }, flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <IPCameraStream
                cameraUrl={cameraUrl}
                onBarcodeDetected={addScanned}
              />
            </Box>

            <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ flex: 1, overflow: "auto" }}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>
                  {totalScanned > 0 ? `Đã quét (${totalScanned} cuốn)` : "Sách đã quét"}
                </Typography>
              </Stack>

              {createError ? <Alert severity={getAlertSeverity(createError)} onClose={() => setCreateError("")}>{createError}</Alert> : null}

              {lookupError ? (
                <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 1.5, borderColor: "error.main", bgcolor: (t) => t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)" : "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)" }}>
                  <Stack spacing={1}>
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <ErrorIcon color="error" sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "error.main", flex: 1 }}>
                        {lookupError}
                      </Typography>
                      <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setLookupError(null)}>
                        <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Stack>
                    <Button
                      size="small"
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setManualIsbn("");
                        setLookupError(null);
                      }}
                      sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
                    >
                      Nhập ISBN thủ công
                    </Button>
                  </Stack>
                </Paper>
              ) : null}

              <TextField
                size="small"
                placeholder="Nhập ISBN thủ công..."
                value={manualIsbn}
                onChange={(e) => setManualIsbn(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && manualIsbn.trim()) {
                    addScanned(manualIsbn.trim());
                    setManualIsbn("");
                  }
                }}
                fullWidth
                slotProps={{
                  input: {
                    startAdornment: (
                      <InputAdornment position="start">
                        <SearchIcon fontSize="small" />
                      </InputAdornment>
                    ),
                  },
                }}
                sx={{ "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2 } }}
              />

              {scanned.length === 0 ? (
                <Alert severity="info" sx={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
                  Đưa mã vạch vào camera. Sách sẽ xuất hiện tại đây.
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                scanned.map((item) => {
                  const isLastScanned = item.barcode === lastScannedRef.current;
                  const isDupeFlash = item.barcode === duplicateFlash;
                  const hasError = !item.loading && !item.can_borrow;
                  const isSuccess = !item.loading && item.can_borrow;
                  return (
                    <Paper
                      key={item.barcode}
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        p: 1.5,
                        borderColor: isDupeFlash ? "warning.main" : isLastScanned ? "primary.main" : hasError ? "error.main" : undefined,
                        borderWidth: isDupeFlash ? 2 : undefined,
                        bgcolor: isDupeFlash ? (t) => t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.15)" : "rgba(245,158,11,0.08)" : isLastScanned ? "action.hover" : hasError ? (t) => t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)" : "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)" : undefined,
                        animation: isSuccess
                          ? `${successPop} 0.4s ease-out`
                          : isDupeFlash
                          ? `${slideInRight} 0.3s ease-out`
                          : isLastScanned
                          ? `${slideInRight} 0.3s ease-out`
                          : undefined,
                      }}
                    >
                      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
                        {item.loading ? (
                          <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, bgcolor: "background.default", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            <CircularProgress size={20} />
                          </Avatar>
                        ) : item.book?.cover_url ? (
                          <Box
                            component="img"
                            src={item.book.cover_url}
                            alt={item.book.title}
                            sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, bgcolor: hasError ? "error.main" : "background.default", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            {hasError ? <ErrorIcon fontSize="small" /> : <BookIcon />}
                          </Avatar>
                        )}
                        <Stack spacing={0.3} sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          {item.loading ? (
                            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Đang tra cứu...</Typography>
                          ) : item.can_borrow && item.book ? (
                            <>
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }} noWrap>
                                {item.book.title}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                                {item.book.author || "-"}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: "primary.main" }}>
                                {item.barcode}
                              </Typography>
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" label={`Kho: ${item.book.total_copies}`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                                <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" color="success" label={`Sẵn: ${item.book.available_copies}`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                              </Stack>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }} noWrap color="error">
                                {item.book?.title || item.barcode}
                              </Typography>
                              {item.reason && (
                                <Typography variant="caption" color="error">
                                  {item.reason}
                                </Typography>
                              )}
                            </>
                          )}
                        </Stack>
                        <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => removeItem(item.barcode)} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                          <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Stack>
                    </Paper>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </Stack>
          </Box>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions sx={{ flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "stretch", px: 3, pb: 2, gap: 1.5 }}>
          <TextField
            size="small"
            placeholder="Ghi chú phiếu mượn (tùy chọn)..."
            value={note}
            onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
            fullWidth
            multiline
            maxRows={3}
            sx={{ "& .MuiInputBase-root": { fontSize: 13 } }}
          />
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
            <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={lookingUp}>Hủy</Button>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              disabled={lookingUp || validCount === 0}
              onClick={handleCreateSlip}
            >
              {lookingUp ? "Đang xử lý..." : `Tạo phiếu mượn (${validCount} cuốn)`}
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      <Snackbar
        open={!!scanToast}
        autoHideDuration={scanToast?.includes("đã quét rồi") || scanToast?.includes("tối đa") ? 3500 : 2000}
        onClose={() => setScanToast("")}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        {scanToast ? (
          <Alert
            severity={
              scanToast.includes("đã quét rồi") || scanToast.includes("tối đa")
                ? "warning"
                : scanToast.startsWith("Đã quét")
                ? "success"
                : "info"
            }
            onClose={() => setScanToast("")}
            sx={{
              animation: `${slideInRight} 0.3s ease-out`,
              boxShadow: 4,
            }}
          >
            {scanToast}
          </Alert>
        ) : undefined}
      </Snackbar>
    </>
  );
}

================
File: src/app/(dashboard)/_components/ProfileDialog.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import {
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  Divider,
  IconButton,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemButton,
  ListItemIcon,
  ListItemText,
  Stack,
  Typography,
  CircularProgress,
  Alert,
} from "@mui/material";
import PhotoCameraIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PhotoCamera";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Delete";
import LockResetIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockReset";
import FaceIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlined";
import LogoutIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LogoutOutlined";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import AvatarUser from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/AvatarUser";

interface ProfileDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function ProfileDialog({ open, onClose }: ProfileDialogProps) {
  const { user, logout, updateUser } = useAuth();
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && user) {
      const fetchUser = async () => {
        try {
          const userData = await api.getCurrentUser();
          setAvatarUrl(userData.avatar_url ?? null);
          if (userData.avatar_url !== user.avatar_url) {
            updateUser({ avatar_url: userData.avatar_url ?? null });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Failed to fetch user data", err);
        }
      };
      fetchUser();
    }
  }, [open, user, updateUser]);

  const handleFileChange = async (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setUploading(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(false);

    try {
      const result = await api.uploadAvatar(file);
      setAvatarUrl(result.avatarUrl);
      updateUser({ avatar_url: result.avatarUrl });
      setSuccess(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Tải ảnh thất bại");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAvatar = async () => {
    setUploading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.deleteAvatar();
      setAvatarUrl(null);
      updateUser({ avatar_url: null });
      setSuccess(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Xóa ảnh thất bại");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    onClose();
    logout();
  };

  if (!user) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      maxWidth="xs"
      fullWidth
      slotProps={{
        paper: { sx: { borderRadius: 3, overflow: "visible" } },
        backdrop: { sx: { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)" } },
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent sx={{ p: 0 }}>
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: "relative",
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 2,
            pt: 4,
            pb: 3,
            px: 3,
          }}
        >
          <Box sx={{ position: "relative" }}>
            <AvatarUser
              avatarUrl={avatarUrl || user?.avatar_url}
              name={user?.full_name}
              email={user?.email}
              role={user?.role}
              size={88}
              border="3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.85)"
              sx={{
                fontSize: "2.2rem",
                transition: "transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease",
                "&:hover": {
                  transform: "scale(1.03)",
                  boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
                },
              }}
            />
            <IconButton
              component="label"
              size="small"
              sx={{
                position: "absolute",
                bottom: 0,
                right: 0,
                bgcolor: "primary.main",
                color: "white",
                "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" },
                boxShadow: 2,

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Box, Alert, Button, Chip, Divider, Stack, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import FaceOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceOutlined";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ErrorOutlineOutlined";
import RestartAltOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RestartAltOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useTaskSSE } from "@/lib/hooks/useTaskSSE";
import MultiAngleCapture, { type CaptureAngle } from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/MultiAngleCapture";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";

export default function EnrollPage() {
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [jobId, setJobId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const { state: sseState, start: startSSE, reset: resetSSE } = useTaskSSE();

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => resetSSE();
  }, [resetSSE]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sseState.status === "SUCCESS") {
      const inner = sseState.result as Record<string, any> | null;
      if (inner?.status === "error") setError(String(inner.error) || "Đăng ký thất bại.");
      setResult(inner);
      setIsLoading(false);
    } else if (sseState.status === "FAILURE" || sseState.status === "ERROR" || sseState.status === "TIMEOUT") {
      setError(sseState.error || "Không thể lấy trạng thái tác vụ.");
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [sseState.status, sseState.result, sseState.error]);

  const handleFilesReady = async (files: Record<CaptureAngle, File>) => {
    setError("");
    setIsLoading(true);
    setJobId(null);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const data = await api.enrollBatch(files, consent);
      setJobId(data.job_id);
      startSSE(data.job_id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Đăng ký nhiều góc thất bại.");
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setConsent(false);
    setJobId(null);
    setResult(null);
    setError("");
    setIsLoading(false);
  };

  const failedCount = result?.results?.filter((item: any) => item.status !== "success").length || 0;
  const success = result && result.status !== "error";

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3} sx={{ maxWidth: 920, mx: "auto" }}>
      <Box sx={staggerSx(0)}>
        <PageHeader
          title="Đăng ký khuôn mặt"
          subtitle="Chụp các góc để hệ thống tạo hồ sơ nhận diện khuôn mặt ổn định hơn."
          icon={FaceOutlinedIcon}
        />
      </Box>

      {error ? (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <Alert icon={<ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon />} severity="error">{error}</Alert>
        </Box>
      ) : null}

      {result ? (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard>
            <Stack spacing={2.5}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                {success ? <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon color="success" sx={{ fontSize: 44 }} /> : <ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon color="error" sx={{ fontSize: 44 }} />}
                <Box>
                  <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>
                    {success ? "Đăng ký thành công" : "Đăng ký thất bại một phần"}
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography color="text.secondary">
                    {success ? "Khuôn mặt đã được ghi nhận vào hệ thống." : `${failedCount} góc ảnh chưa đạt yêu cầu.`}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              </Stack>

              {result.results ? (
                <>
                  <Divider />
                  <Stack spacing={1}>
                    <Typography variant="overline" color="text.secondary">Kết quả từng góc</Typography>
                    {result.results.map((item: any, index: number) => (
                      <Stack key={`${item.angle}-${index}`} direction="row" sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ textTransform: "capitalize" }}>{item.angle}</Typography>
                        <Chip size="small" color={item.status === "success" ? "success" : "error"} label={item.status === "success" ? "Thành công" : "Thất bại"} />
                      </Stack>
                    ))}
                  </Stack>
                </>
              ) : null}

              <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<RestartAltOutlinedIcon />} onClick={handleReset} sx={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }}>
                {success ? "Đăng ký thêm" : "Thử lại"}
              </Button>
            </Stack>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>
      ) : jobId ? (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard>
            <LoadingOverlay loading message={jobId ? `Đang xử lý... (Job ID: ${jobId})` : undefined} />
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>
      ) : (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard>
            <MultiAngleCapture consent={consent} setConsent={setConsent} onFilesReady={handleFilesReady} />
            {isLoading ? <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>Đang gửi dữ liệu đăng ký...</Alert> : null}
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

File: src/hooks/useScheduleData.ts

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, useRef } from "react";
import useSWR from "swr";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import { usePermission } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import type { ScheduleStaff, LibraryZone, StaffShift, StaffScheduleAssignment } from "@/lib/types";

export function startOfWeek(date = new Date()) {
  const value = new Date(date);
  const day = value.getDay() || 7;
  value.setDate(value.getDate() - day + 1);
  value.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return value;
}

export function getWeekDays(anchor: Date) {
  return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
    const d = new Date(anchor);
    d.setDate(anchor.getDate() + i);
    return d;
  });
}

export function toDateInput(date: Date) {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

export function formatDateRange(days: Date[]) {
  const from = days[0].toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit" });
  const to = days[6].toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" });
  return `${from} — ${to}`;
}

interface ScheduleDataResult {
  staff: ScheduleStaff[];
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
}

export interface ScheduleData {
  staff: ScheduleStaff[];
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  assignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  weekStart: Date;
  days: Date[];
  from: string;
  to: string;
  goPrevWeek: () => void;
  goNextWeek: () => void;
  goToday: () => void;
  loadData: () => Promise<void>;
  setError: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>;
}

const fetchScheduleData = async (from: string, to: string, isAdmin: boolean): Promise<ScheduleDataResult> => {
  if (isAdmin) {
    const [staffResult, zoneResult, shiftResult, assignmentResult] = await Promise.all([
      api.getScheduleStaffOptions(),
      api.getScheduleZones(),
      api.getScheduleShifts(),
      api.getScheduleAssignments({ from, to }),
    ]);
    return {
      staff: staffResult.filter((s) => s.role === "admin" || s.role === "staff"),
      zones: zoneResult.filter((z) => z.isActive),
      shifts: shiftResult.filter((s) => s.isActive),
      assignments: assignmentResult.items,
    };
  } else {
    const [result, staffResult, shiftResult, zoneResult] = await Promise.all([
      api.getMySchedules({ from, to }),
      api.getScheduleStaffOptions(),
      api.getScheduleShifts(),
      api.getScheduleZones(),
    ]);
    return {
      assignments: result.items,
      staff: staffResult.filter((s) => s.role === "admin" || s.role === "staff"),
      shifts: shiftResult.filter((s) => s.isActive),
      zones: zoneResult.filter((z) => z.isActive),
    };
  }
};

export function useScheduleData(canViewAllOverride?: boolean): ScheduleData {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const canManageAll = isAdmin || (canViewAllOverride !== undefined ? canViewAllOverride : (can("schedules", "create") || can("schedules", "update")));
  const isStaff = !!user;
  const [weekStart, setWeekStart] = useState(startOfWeek);
  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<ScheduleStaff[]>([]);
  const [zones, setZones] = useState<LibraryZone[]>([]);
  const [shifts, setShifts] = useState<StaffShift[]>([]);
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<StaffScheduleAssignment[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const days = useMemo(() => getWeekDays(weekStart), [weekStart]);
  const from = toDateInput(days[0]);
  const to = toDateInput(days[6]);

  const cacheKey = `schedule:${from}:${to}:${canManageAll ? "all" : "my"}`;
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);

  const { data: cachedData, mutate } = useSWR<ScheduleDataResult>(
    isStaff ? cacheKey : null,
    () => fetchScheduleData(from, to, canManageAll),
    {
      dedupingInterval: 10000,
      revalidateOnFocus: true,
      onSuccess: (data) => {
        if (mountedRef.current && data) {
          setStaff(data.staff);
          setZones(data.zones);
          setShifts(data.shifts);
          setAssignments(data.assignments);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setError(getErrorMessage(err));
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
    }
  );

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isStaff) return;
    // Only show loading spinner when there is no cached data to display
    if (!cachedData) {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setError(null);
    try {
      await mutate();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isStaff, mutate, cachedData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    // If SWR already has cached data on mount, don't show loading spinner
    if (cachedData) setLoading(false);
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  const goPrevWeek = useCallback(() => {
    setWeekStart((prev) => { const d = new Date(prev); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 7); return d; });
  }, []);

  const goNextWeek = useCallback(() => {
    setWeekStart((prev) => { const d = new Date(prev); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 7); return d; });
  }, []);

  const goToday = useCallback(() => { setWeekStart(startOfWeek()); }, []);

  return {
    staff, zones, shifts, assignments, loading, error,
    weekStart, days, from, to,
    goPrevWeek, goNextWeek, goToday, loadData, setError,
  };
}

"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { CssBaseline, ThemeProvider, createTheme } from "@mui/material";
import type { PaletteMode } from "@mui/material";
import createCache from "@emotion/cache";
import { CacheProvider } from "@emotion/react";

type ColorModePreference = "auto" | "light" | "dark";
type ReducedMotionPreference = "reduce" | "no-preference" | "unknown";

type ColorModeContextValue = {
  mode: PaletteMode;
  effectiveMode: PaletteMode;
  preference: ColorModePreference;
  reducedMotion: ReducedMotionPreference;
  toggleMode: () => void;
  setMode: (mode: ColorModePreference) => void;
};

const ColorModeContext = createContext<ColorModeContextValue>({
  mode: "dark",
  effectiveMode: "dark",
  preference: "auto",
  reducedMotion: "unknown",
  toggleMode: () => {},
  setMode: () => {},
});

export function useColorMode() {
  return useContext(ColorModeContext);
}

function getSystemPreference(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return true;
  return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
}

function getReducedMotionPreference(): ReducedMotionPreference {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "unknown";
  const mq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  return mq.matches ? "reduce" : "no-preference";
}

function buildTheme(mode: PaletteMode, reducedMotion: ReducedMotionPreference) {
  const dark = mode === "dark";
  const shouldReduceMotion = reducedMotion === "reduce";
  const transitionDuration = shouldReduceMotion ? 0 : 200;

  // ── IUH Brand Identity Colors ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Primary Accent: Đỏ đô IUH (#8B0000 / #900C3F)
  // Secondary Accent: Vàng hoàng gia / Vàng đồng (#D4AF37 / #E6A100)
  // Navy Accent: Xanh Navy công nghiệp (#0A2540)
  // Background: Xám sáng (#F8F9FA)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const brand = {
    iuhRed:       "#8B0000",   // Primary — IUH Red
    iuhRedDark:   "#700000",   // Primary dark / hover
    iuhRedLight:  "#FFF5F5",   // Primary container light
    iuhGold:      "#D4AF37",   // Secondary — IUH Royal Gold
    iuhGoldDark:  "#B38E22",   // Secondary dark
    iuhGoldLight: "#FFF8E7",   // Secondary container light
    iuhNavy:      "#0A2540",   // Navy accent
    iuhNavyDark:  "#061729",   // Dark Navy
    iuhNavyLight: "#E8EEF5",   // Navy container light

const CYCLE_ORDER: ColorModePreference[] = ["auto", "light", "dark"];

export function MuiThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [preference, setPreferenceState] = useState<ColorModePreference>("auto");
  const [systemPrefersDark, setSystemPrefersDark] = useState(() => getSystemPreference());
  const [reducedMotion, setReducedMotion] = useState<ReducedMotionPreference>("unknown");
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = window.localStorage.getItem("themeMode") as ColorModePreference | null;
    if (stored && CYCLE_ORDER.includes(stored)) {
      setPreferenceState(stored);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const darkMq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    const motionMq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");

    setReducedMotion(getReducedMotionPreference());

    const handleDarkChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setSystemPrefersDark(e.matches);
    const handleMotionChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
      setReducedMotion(e.matches ? "reduce" : "no-preference");
    };

    darkMq.addEventListener("change", handleDarkChange);
    motionMq.addEventListener("change", handleMotionChange);

    return () => {
      darkMq.removeEventListener("change", handleDarkChange);
      motionMq.removeEventListener("change", handleMotionChange);
    };
  }, []);

  const effectiveMode = useMemo(() => {
    if (preference === "auto") {
      return systemPrefersDark ? "dark" : "light";
    }
    return preference;
  }, [preference, systemPrefersDark]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", effectiveMode === "dark");
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle("light", effectiveMode === "light");
  }, [effectiveMode]);

  const toggleMode = useCallback(() => {
    setPreferenceState((current) => {
      const idx = CYCLE_ORDER.indexOf(current);
      const next = CYCLE_ORDER[(idx + 1) % CYCLE_ORDER.length];
      window.localStorage.setItem("themeMode", next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const setMode = useCallback((mode: ColorModePreference) => {
    window.localStorage.setItem("themeMode", mode);
    setPreferenceState(mode);
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo<ColorModeContextValue>(() => ({
    mode: effectiveMode,
    effectiveMode,
    preference,
    reducedMotion,
    toggleMode,
    setMode,
  }), [effectiveMode, preference, reducedMotion, toggleMode, setMode]);

  const theme = useMemo(() => buildTheme(effectiveMode, reducedMotion), [effectiveMode, reducedMotion]);

  const emotionCache = useMemo(() => createCache({ key: "mui", prepend: true }), []);

  return (
    <CacheProvider value={emotionCache}>
      <ColorModeContext.Provider value={value}>
        <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>
          {mounted && <CssBaseline />}
          {children}
        </ThemeProvider>
      </ColorModeContext.Provider>
    </CacheProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Box, Backdrop } from "@mui/material";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import AIWidgetTrigger from "./AIWidgetTrigger";
import AIWidgetPanel from "./AIWidgetPanel";
import { useAIWidgetStore } from "./store/useAIWidgetStore";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";

const BLACKLIST_PATHS = ["/login", "/register", "/gate", "/liveness", "/identify"];

export default function AIWidget() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { isOpen, close, proactiveMessage } = useAIWidgetStore();
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading, user: authUser } = useAuth();

  const isBlacklisted = BLACKLIST_PATHS.some((p) => pathname?.startsWith(p));

  const role = authUser?.role || 'staff';

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen) {
        close();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, close]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (proactiveMessage && !isOpen) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        useAIWidgetStore.getState().open();
      }, 500);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [proactiveMessage, isOpen]);

  // Hide while auth is loading or when not authenticated
  if (isLoading) return null;
  if (!isAuthenticated || !authUser) return null;
  if (isBlacklisted) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <AIWidgetTrigger />
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <Backdrop
            open
            onClick={close}
            sx={{
              position: "fixed",
              inset: 0,
              bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
              zIndex: 99998,
              backdropFilter: "blur(2px)",
            }}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
      <AIWidgetPanel role={role} />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Modal from "antd/es/modal";
import Form from "antd/es/form";
import Select from "antd/es/select";
import Checkbox from "antd/es/checkbox";
import Button from "antd/es/button";
import Alert from "antd/es/alert";
import notification from "antd/es/notification";
import { useColorMode } from "@/lib/mui-theme";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { ScheduleStaff, StaffShift, LibraryZone, StaffScheduleAssignment } from "@/lib/types";

interface AssignStaffDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  date: string;
  shiftId: string;
  shiftName: string;
  shifts: StaffShift[];
  zones: LibraryZone[];
  staff: ScheduleStaff[];
  existingAssignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  dayAssignments: StaffScheduleAssignment[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onAssigned: () => void;
}

interface FormValues {
  zoneId: string;
  staffId: string;
  forceSave: boolean;
}

export default function AssignStaffDialog({
  open,
  date,
  shiftId,
  shiftName,
  shifts,
  zones,
  staff,
  existingAssignments,
  dayAssignments,
  onClose,
  onAssigned,
}: AssignStaffDialogProps) {
  const { effectiveMode } = useColorMode();
  const isDark = effectiveMode === "dark";
  const [apiAnt, contextHolder] = notification.useNotification();
  const [form] = Form.useForm<FormValues>();
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [warnings, setWarnings] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [forceSave, setForceSave] = useState(false);

  const shift = useMemo(() => shifts.find((s) => s.id === shiftId), [shifts, shiftId]);

  const existingStaffIds = useMemo(
    () => new Set(existingAssignments.map((a) => a.staffId)),
    [existingAssignments],
  );

  const availableStaff = useMemo(
    () => staff.filter((s) => !existingStaffIds.has(s.id)),
    [staff, existingStaffIds],
  );

  const reset = () => {
    form.resetFields();
    setError(null);
    setForceSave(false);
    setWarnings([]);
  };

  const gatherWarnings = (staffId: string): string[] => {
    const w: string[] = [];
    const selectedStaff = staff.find((s) => s.id === staffId);
    if (!selectedStaff) return w;
    const existAsg = dayAssignments.find((a) => a.staffId === staffId);
    if (existAsg) {
      const existShift = shifts.find((sh) => sh.id === existAsg.shiftId);
      const newStart = shift?.startTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const newEnd = shift?.endTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const existStart = existShift?.startTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const existEnd = existShift?.endTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const isOverlap = newStart && newEnd && existStart && existEnd && (newStart < existEnd && newEnd > existStart);
      if (isOverlap) {
        w.push(`${selectedStaff.fullName || selectedStaff.email} đã có ca ${existShift?.name || existAsg.shiftId} trùng giờ`);
      }
    }
    return w;
  };

  const handleAssign = async () => {
    try {
      const values = await form.validateFields();
      const w = gatherWarnings(values.staffId);
      if (w.length > 0 && !forceSave) {
        setWarnings(w);
        return;
      }
      setSaving(true);
      setError(null);
      setWarnings([]);
      const params: any = { staffId: values.staffId, shiftId, zoneId: values.zoneId, workDate: date };
      if (forceSave && w.length > 0) params.force = true;
      await api.createScheduleAssignment(params);
      apiAnt.success({ title: "Phân ca thành công", placement: "topRight" });
      reset();
      onAssigned();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.errorFields) return;
      const data = err?.response?.data;
      setError(data?.error || data?.message || data?.detail?.[0]?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const getStaffLabel = (s: ScheduleStaff) => {
    const existAsg = dayAssignments.find((a) => a.staffId === s.id);
    if (existAsg) {
      const existShift = shifts.find((sh) => sh.id === existAsg.shiftId);
      const newStart = shift?.startTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const newEnd = shift?.endTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const existStart = existShift?.startTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const existEnd = existShift?.endTime?.slice(0, 5);
      const isOverlap = newStart && newEnd && existStart && existEnd && (newStart < existEnd && newEnd > existStart);

      if (isOverlap) {
        return `${s.fullName || s.email} (⚠ Trùng ca: ${existShift?.name || existAsg.shiftId})`;
      }
      return `${s.fullName || s.email} (Đã có ca: ${existShift?.name || existAsg.shiftId})`;
    }
    return s.fullName || s.email;
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={() => { reset(); onClose(); }}
      title="Phân ca trực"
      width={420}
      footer={
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: 8 }}>
          <Button onClick={() => { reset(); onClose(); }} disabled={saving}>Hủy</Button>
          <Button
            type="primary"
            loading={saving}
            disabled={availableStaff.length === 0}
            onClick={handleAssign}
          >
            Xếp ca
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginBottom: 16, fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
        <span style={{ color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#344054" }}>Ngày: {date}</span>
        <span style={{ color: isDark ? "#D4AF37" : "#8B0000", fontWeight: 700 }}>Ca: {shiftName}</span>
        {shift && (
          <span style={{ color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999" }}>
            {shift.startTime?.slice(0, 5)} – {shift.endTime?.slice(0, 5)}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <Form
        form={form}
        layout="vertical"
        initialValues={{ zoneId: undefined, staffId: undefined, forceSave: false }}
        requiredMark={false}
        size="middle"
      >
        <Form.Item
          name="zoneId"
          label="Khu vực"
          rules={[{ required: true, message: "Vui lòng chọn khu vực" }]}
        >
          <Select
            placeholder="Chọn khu vực"
            options={zones.map((z) => ({ value: z.id, label: z.zoneName }))}
            allowClear
          />
        </Form.Item>

        <Form.Item
          name="staffId"
          label={
            <span>
              Nhân viên
              {availableStaff.length < staff.length && (
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999", marginLeft: 4 }}>
                  ({staff.length - availableStaff.length} đã xếp)
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          }
          rules={[{ required: true, message: "Vui lòng chọn nhân viên" }]}
        >
          <Select
            placeholder="Chọn nhân viên"
            options={availableStaff.map((s) => ({ value: s.id, label: getStaffLabel(s) }))}
            notFoundContent="Tất cả nhân viên đã được xếp"
            allowClear
          />
        </Form.Item>
      </Form>

      {error && <Alert title={error} type="error" showIcon closable onClose={() => setError(null)} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />}

      {warnings.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <Alert
            type="warning"
            showIcon
            description={warnings.map((w, i) => <div key={i}>⚠ {w}</div>)}
            style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
          />
          <Checkbox checked={forceSave} onChange={(e) => setForceSave(e.target.checked)}>
            Vẫn xếp ca bất chấp cảnh báo
          </Checkbox>
        </div>
      )}

      {contextHolder}
    </Modal>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Modal from "antd/es/modal";
import Alert from "antd/es/alert";
import Switch from "antd/es/switch";
import { useColorMode } from "@/lib/mui-theme";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { StaffScheduleAssignment } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  weekFrom: string;
  weekTo: string;
  affectedCount?: number;
  onDeleted: () => void;
}

function getApiError(err: any): string {
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  return data?.error || data?.message || err?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra";
}

function fmtDate(d: string) {
  const [y, m, day] = d.split("-");
  return `${day}/${m}/${y}`;
}

export default function DeleteWeekDialog({ open, onClose, weekFrom, weekTo, affectedCount, onDeleted }: Props) {
  const { effectiveMode } = useColorMode();
  const isDark = effectiveMode === "dark";
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ cancelled: number; skipped: number; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fetchedAffectedCount, setFetchedAffectedCount] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
  const effectiveFrom = weekFrom < today ? today : weekFrom;
  const isPast = effectiveFrom > weekTo;

  const loadAffectedCount = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!open || isPast) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.getScheduleAssignments({ from: effectiveFrom, to: weekTo });
      const activeAssignments = res.items.filter(
        (a: StaffScheduleAssignment) => a.status !== "cancelled" && a.status !== "completed"
      );
      setFetchedAffectedCount(activeAssignments.length);
    } catch {
      setFetchedAffectedCount(null);
    }
  }, [open, isPast, effectiveFrom, weekTo]);

  useEffect(() => { loadAffectedCount(); }, [loadAffectedCount]);

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.deleteWeekScheduleAssignments(weekFrom, weekTo, notify);
      setResult(res);
      onDeleted();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getApiError(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setResult(null);
    setError(null);
    setFetchedAffectedCount(null);
    onClose();
  };

  const displayCount = affectedCount ?? fetchedAffectedCount;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={handleClose}
      title={result ? "Đã xóa lịch trực" : "Xóa lịch trực trong tuần"}
      width={440}
      okText={result ? "Đóng" : "Xác nhận xóa"}
      cancelText={result ? undefined : "Hủy bỏ"}
      okButtonProps={result ? {} : { danger: true, loading, onClick: handleConfirm }}
      cancelButtonProps={result ? { style: { display: "none" } } : { disabled: loading }}
      onOk={result ? handleClose : undefined}
      mask={{ closable: !loading }}
    >
      {result ? (
        <div>
          <Alert title={result.message} type="success" showIcon style={{ marginBottom: 8 }} />
          {result.skipped > 0 && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", color: "#d97706" }}>
              Đã bỏ qua {result.skipped} ca trong quá khứ (không thể hủy).
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : isPast ? (
        <Alert title="Toàn bộ lịch trong tuần này đã qua. Không có ca nào để hủy." type="warning" showIcon />
      ) : (
        <div>
          <div style={{ padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${isDark ? "#2E3345" : "#D0D7E2"}`, marginBottom: 12, background: isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.02)" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#344054", marginBottom: 4 }}>
              Thao tác này sẽ <span style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontWeight: 700 }}>hủy toàn bộ ca trực</span> từ hôm nay đến cuối tuần:
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.875rem", color: isDark ? "#EDE2DF" : "#101828" }}>
              {effectiveFrom === today && weekFrom < today
                ? `${fmtDate(today)} → ${fmtDate(weekTo)} (các ngày quá khứ đã bỏ qua)`
                : `${fmtDate(weekFrom)} → ${fmtDate(weekTo)}`
              }
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "0.7rem", color: isDark ? "#B8B0A4" : "#999", marginTop: 6 }}>
              Tất cả yêu cầu đăng ký ca (bids) và đổi ca (swaps) đang chờ duyệt liên quan cũng sẽ bị hủy tự động.
            </div>
          </div>

          {displayCount !== undefined && displayCount !== null && (
            <Alert title={`${displayCount} ca trực sẽ bị ảnh hưởng trong khoảng thời gian này.`} type="info" showIcon style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
          )}

          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <Switch checked={notify} onChange={setNotify} size="small" />
            <span style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", fontWeight: 500 }}>Gửi thông báo hủy lịch đến nhân viên</span>
          </div>

          {notify && (
            <div style={{
              fontSize: "0.7rem",
              color: isDark ? "#93C5FD" : "#0A2540",
              background: isDark ? "rgba(10,37,64,0.3)" : "rgba(10,37,64,0.06)",
              border: `1px solid ${isDark ? "rgba(147,197,253,0.3)" : "rgba(10,37,64,0.18)"}`,
              borderRadius: 6,
              padding: 8
            }}>
              Nhân viên bị ảnh hưởng sẽ nhận thông báo qua hệ thống.
            </div>
          )}

          {error && <Alert title={error} type="error" showIcon closable onClose={() => setError(null)} style={{ marginTop: 12 }} />}
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}
