"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Step,
  StepLabel,
  Stepper,
  TextField,
  Typography,
  useMediaQuery,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CameraAltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined";
import ErrorIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ReportOutlined";
import QrCodeScannerIcon from "@mui/icons-material/QrCodeScannerOutlined";

import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";
import { getAlertSeverity } from "@/lib/alert-utils";
import { slideInRight, successPop } from "@/lib/animations";
import type { BorrowCartItem } from "./borrow/types";

interface ScannedBorrowItem {
  barcode: string;
  isbn: string;
  loading: boolean;
  can_borrow: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
  book: BookWithStats | null;
  copy_id: string | null;
  book_id: string | null;
  copy_barcode: string | null;
}

function toScannedItem(item: BorrowCartItem): ScannedBorrowItem {
  return {
    barcode: item.barcode,
    isbn: item.isbn,
    loading: false,
    can_borrow: item.can_borrow,
    reason: item.reason ?? null,
    // Cart books come from lookupBorrowSlip (serializeBookWithStats) at runtime,
    // even though BorrowCartItem declares the base BookInfo type.
    book: (item.book as BookWithStats | null) ?? null,
    copy_id: item.copy_id ?? null,
    book_id: item.book_id ?? null,
    copy_barcode: item.copy_barcode ?? null,
  };
}

export default function BorrowScannerDialog({
  open,
  patronId,
  maxItems,
  initialItems,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  patronId: string;
  maxItems?: number;
  initialItems?: BorrowCartItem[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (result: { message: string; count: number }) => void;
}) {
  const initialItemsRef = useRef<BorrowCartItem[]>([]);
  initialItemsRef.current = initialItems ?? [];
  const initializedRef = useRef(false);
  const html5QrCodeRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const lastScannedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const [scanned, setScanned] = useState<ScannedBorrowItem[]>([]);
  const scannedRef = useRef<ScannedBorrowItem[]>([]);
  scannedRef.current = scanned;
  // Debug: last raw decoded value (shown in UI so user can see if camera reads OK)
  const [debugRaw, setDebugRaw] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [lookingUp, setLookingUp] = useState(false);
  const [createError, setCreateError] = useState("");
  const [scanToast, setScanToast] = useState("");
  const [lookupError, setLookupError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [manualIsbn, setManualIsbn] = useState("");
  const [successResult, setSuccessResult] = useState<{ message: string; bookCount: number } | null>(null);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    if (html5QrCodeRef.current) {
      const qr = html5QrCodeRef.current;
      html5QrCodeRef.current = null;
      try {
        if (qr.isScanning) {
          await qr.stop();
        }
        qr.clear();
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Error stopping Html5Qrcode:", e);
      }
    }
    setCameraReady(false);
  }, []);

  const lookupItem = useCallback(async (barcode: string, isbn: string) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.map((item) =>
      item.barcode === barcode ? { ...item, loading: true } : item
    ));
    try {
      const isCopy = /^LIB/i.test(barcode.replace(/[-\s]/g, ""));
      const result = await api.lookupBorrowSlip({
        patron_id: patronId,
        items: [{ barcode, isbn: isCopy ? undefined : isbn }],
      });
      const normBarcode = barcode.replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      const item = result.items.find((i) => {
        const iBarcode = (i.barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        const iCopyBarcode = (i.copy?.barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        const iIsbn = (i.isbn || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        return iBarcode === normBarcode || iCopyBarcode === normBarcode || iIsbn === normBarcode;
      }) || result.items[0];

      if (!item) {
        lastScannedRef.current = null;
        setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.barcode !== barcode));
        setLookupError(`Mã sách "${barcode}" không tồn tại trong thư viện`);
        return;
      }
      if (!item.can_borrow) {
        lastScannedRef.current = null;
        setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.barcode !== barcode));
        const msg = item.reason || 'Sách không thể mượn';
        const title = item.book?.title || '';
        setLookupError(title && !msg.includes(title) ? `"${title}": ${msg}` : msg);
        return;
      }

      // Check if book title is already in other scanned items
      if (item.book?.id) {
        const isDuplicateTitle = scannedRef.current.some(
          (s) => s.barcode !== barcode && s.book_id === item.book?.id
        );
        if (isDuplicateTitle) {
          lastScannedRef.current = null;
          setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.barcode !== barcode));
          setLookupError(`Đầu sách "${item.book?.title}" đã có trong danh sách mượn. Không thể mượn nhiều bản sao cùng đầu sách.`);
          return;
        }
      }

      setScanned((prev) => prev.map((i) =>
        i.barcode === barcode ? {
          ...i,
          loading: false,
          can_borrow: item.can_borrow,
          reason: item.reason,
          book: item.book,
          copy_id: item.copy?.id || null,
          book_id: item.book?.id || null,
          copy_barcode: item.copy?.barcode || null,
        } : i
      ));
      setScanToast(`✓ Đã nhận: ${item.book?.title || barcode}`);
    } catch {
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
      setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.barcode !== barcode));
      setLookupError(`Lỗi tra cứu: ${barcode}`);
    }
  }, [patronId]);

  const addScanned = useCallback((rawCode: string) => {
    const trimmed = rawCode.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.length < 3) return;
    const normKey = trimmed.replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();

    // Check if already in scanned list
    const isDuplicate = scannedRef.current.some((item) => {
      const itemBarcode = item.barcode.replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      const itemCopyBarcode = (item.copy_barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      const itemIsbn = (item.isbn || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      return itemBarcode === normKey || itemCopyBarcode === normKey || itemIsbn === normKey;
    });

    if (isDuplicate) {
      setScanToast(`⚠️ Sách/Mã "${trimmed}" đã có trong danh sách`);
      return;
    }

    if (lastScannedRef.current === normKey) return;
    lastScannedRef.current = normKey;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (lastScannedRef.current === normKey) {
        lastScannedRef.current = null;
      }
    }, 1500);

    if (maxItems !== undefined && scannedRef.current.length >= maxItems) {
      setScanToast(`Chỉ được mượn tối đa ${maxItems} cuốn`);
      return;
    }

    setScanToast(`Đang tra cứu: ${trimmed}`);
    setScanned((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        barcode: trimmed,
        isbn: trimmed,
        loading: true,
        can_borrow: false,
        reason: null,
        book: null,
        copy_id: null,
        book_id: null,
        copy_barcode: null,
      },
    ]);
    lookupItem(trimmed, trimmed);
  }, [lookupItem, maxItems]);

  const validateIsbn13 = (digits: string): boolean => {
    if (!digits.startsWith('978') && !digits.startsWith('979')) return false;
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      sum += parseInt(digits[i], 10) * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 3);
    }
    const check = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10;
    return check === parseInt(digits[12], 10);
  };

  const isValidCode = (text: string): boolean => {
    const clean = text.replace(/[-\s]/g, "");
    // 1. Copy barcode: LIB-<isbn>-<seq> (e.g. LIB-9780140328721-001)
    if (/^LIB\d{11,18}$/i.test(clean)) return true;
    // 2. Glued barcode without LIB prefix: e.g. 9780140328721001 (14-17 digits)
    if (/^\d{14,17}$/.test(clean) && (clean.startsWith('978') || clean.startsWith('979'))) {
      return validateIsbn13(clean.slice(0, 13));
    }
    // 3. EAN-13: 13 digits starting 978/979 with valid checksum
    if (/^\d{13}$/.test(clean)) return validateIsbn13(clean);
    // 4. ISBN-10: 10 chars
    if (/^\d{9}[\dX]$/i.test(clean)) return true;
    return false;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      stopCamera();
      setScanned([]);
      setCameraError("");
      setCreateError("");
      setScanToast("");
      setSuccessResult(null);
      lastScannedRef.current = null;
      initializedRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    if (!initializedRef.current) {
      initializedRef.current = true;
      setScanned(initialItemsRef.current.map(toScannedItem));
    }

    let active = true;

    (async () => {
      try {
        setCameraError("");
        setCameraReady(false);

        const { Html5Qrcode, Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats } = await import("html5-qrcode");
        if (!active) return;

        // Ensure container is rendered
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
        if (!active) return;

        const container = document.getElementById("borrow-camera-reader");
        if (!container) return;

        const formatsToSupport = [
          Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats.CODE_128,
          Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats.EAN_13,
          Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats.QR_CODE,
          Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats.CODE_39,
          Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats.UPC_A,
          Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats.UPC_E,
        ];

        const qr = new Html5Qrcode("borrow-camera-reader", {
          formatsToSupport,
          verbose: false,
        });
        html5QrCodeRef.current = qr;

        // Configuration:
        // - DO NOT pass qrbox so canvas uses full 1280x720 video resolution
        //   (long Code 128 barcodes have ~286 modules; downsizing to a small box makes bars blend together)
        // - Disable Windows BarcodeDetector to avoid 0118521823333 corruption
        const config = {
          fps: 20,
          disableFlip: false,
          experimentalFeatures: { useBarCodeDetectorIfSupported: false },
          videoConstraints: {
            facingMode: { ideal: "environment" },
            width: { min: 1024, ideal: 1280, max: 1920 },
            height: { min: 720, ideal: 720, max: 1080 },
            focusMode: { ideal: "continuous" },
          },
        };

        let cooldownUntil = 0;

        // Choose camera: prefer environment/back camera if mobile, or first camera on desktop/laptop
        let cameraIdOrConfig: any = { facingMode: "environment" };
        try {
          const cameras = await Html5Qrcode.getCameras();
          if (cameras && cameras.length > 0) {
            const backCam = cameras.find((c: any) => /back|rear|environment/i.test(c.label));
            cameraIdOrConfig = backCam ? backCam.id : cameras[0].id;
          }
        } catch { /* fallback to facingMode */ }

        await qr.start(
          cameraIdOrConfig,
          config,
          (decodedText: string) => {
            if (!active) return;
            if (Date.now() < cooldownUntil) return;

            const clean = decodedText.trim();
            setDebugRaw(clean);
            console.debug("[Scanner] decoded:", clean);

            if (isValidCode(clean)) {
              cooldownUntil = Date.now() + 1500;
              addScanned(clean);
            }
          },
          () => {} // silent on frame decode failure
        );

        if (active) {
          setCameraReady(true);
        } else {
          qr.stop().catch(() => {});
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (!active) return;
        console.error("Html5Qrcode start error:", err);
        const errStr = String(err?.message || err);
        if (errStr.includes("NotAllowed") || errStr.includes("Permission")) {
          setCameraError("Không có quyền truy cập camera. Hãy cấp quyền camera cho trình duyệt.");
        } else if (errStr.includes("NotFound") || errStr.includes("DevicesNotFoundError")) {
          setCameraError("Không tìm thấy camera trên thiết bị.");
        } else {
          setCameraError("Không thể bật camera: " + errStr);
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      active = false;
      stopCamera();
    };
  }, [open, stopCamera, addScanned]);

  const removeItem = (barcode: string) => {
    setScanned((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.barcode !== barcode));
  };

  const handleCreateSlip = async () => {
    const validItems = scanned.filter((item) => item.can_borrow && item.book_id && item.copy_id);
    if (!validItems.length || !patronId) return;
    setCreateError("");
    try {
      const confirmResult = await api.confirmBorrowSlip({
        patron_id: patronId,
        items: validItems.map((item) => ({
          barcode: item.copy_barcode || item.barcode,
          isbn: item.isbn,
          book_id: item.book_id!,
          copy_id: item.copy_id!,
        })),
      });
      if (confirmResult.status === "success") {
        stopCamera();
        setSuccessResult({ message: confirmResult.message, bookCount: validItems.length });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const detail = getErrorMessage(err);
      const removedBarcodes: string[] = [];
      const toastMsg = detail;

      const matchTitle = detail.match(/^Sach "(.+)" da duoc doc gia nay muon$/);
      if (matchTitle) {
        const title = matchTitle[1];
        setScanned((prev) => {
          const filtered = prev.filter((item) => {
            if (item.book?.title === title) {
              removedBarcodes.push(item.barcode);
              return false;
            }
            return true;
          });
          return filtered;
        });
      } else {
        const matchBarcode = detail.match(/^(?:Ban sao|Ma vach) ([^\s]+) (?:dang duoc muon|khong ton tai)/);
        if (matchBarcode) {
          const barcode = matchBarcode[1];
          setScanned((prev) => {
            const filtered = prev.filter((item) => {
              if (item.barcode === barcode || item.barcode.includes(barcode)) {
                removedBarcodes.push(item.barcode);
                return false;
              }
              return true;
            });
            return filtered;
          });
        } else {
          setCreateError(detail);
        }
      }
      if (removedBarcodes.length > 0) {
        setScanToast(toastMsg);
      }
    }
  };

  const theme = useTheme();
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down("sm"));

  const validCount = scanned.filter((item) => item.can_borrow).length;
  const totalScanned = scanned.length;
  const currentStep = successResult ? 2 : lookingUp ? 1 : 0;

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog
        open={open}
        onClose={lookingUp ? undefined : onClose}
        fullWidth
        maxWidth="xl"
        fullScreen={isMobile}
      >
        <DialogTitle>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" />
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>Quét ISBN sách</Typography>
            </Stack>
            {!lookingUp && !successResult && (
              <IconButton size="small" onClick={onClose}><CloseIcon /></IconButton>
            )}
          </Stack>
          <Stepper
            activeStep={currentStep}
            sx={{
              mt: 1.5,
              "& .MuiStepIcon-root.Mui-active": { color: "primary.main" },
              "& .MuiStepIcon-root.Mui-completed": { color: "secondary.main" },
            }}
          >
            {["Quét sách", "Xác nhận", "Hoàn tất"].map((label) => (
              <Step key={label}>
                <StepLabel>{label}</StepLabel>
              </Step>
            ))}
          </Stepper>
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers sx={{ p: 2, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden" }}>
          {successResult ? (
            <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", py: 4, textAlign: "center" }}>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  width: 64,
                  height: 64,
                  borderRadius: "50%",
                  bgcolor: "success.light",
                  color: "success.dark",
                  display: "grid",
                  placeItems: "center",
                }}
              >
                <CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 36 }} />
              </Box>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                Tạo phiếu mượn thành công
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="text.secondary">
                {successResult.bookCount} cuốn sách đã được thêm vào phiếu
              </Typography>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSuccessResult(null);
                    setScanned([]);
                    onSuccess({ message: successResult.message, count: successResult.bookCount });
                    onClose();
                  }}
                sx={{ mt: 1, borderRadius: 2 }}
              >
                Đóng
              </Button>
            </Stack>
          ) : (
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, flexDirection: { xs: "column", md: "row" }, flex: 1, overflow: "hidden" }}>
            <Box sx={{ width: { md: "50%" }, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <Paper
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                  position: "relative",
                  overflow: "hidden",
                  bgcolor: "black",
                  width: "100%",
                  aspectRatio: { xs: "16/9", md: "4/3" },
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  borderRadius: 2,
                }}
              >
                {cameraError ? (
                  <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", color: "grey.300", p: 3, textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <CameraAltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 42 }} />
                    <Typography variant="body2">{cameraError}</Typography>
                  </Stack>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Box
                      id="borrow-camera-reader"
                      sx={{
                        width: "100%",
                        height: "100%",
                        position: "relative",
                        overflow: "hidden",
                        display: "flex",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        justifyContent: "center",
                        "& video": {
                          width: "100% !important",
                          height: "100% !important",
                          objectFit: "cover !important",
                        },
                        "& #borrow-camera-reader__scan_region": {

                          alignItems: "center !important",
                          justifyContent: "center !important",
                        },
                        "& #borrow-camera-reader__dashboard_section_csr": {
                          display: "none !important",
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                    {!cameraReady && (
                      <Stack
                        sx={{
                          position: "absolute",
                          inset: 0,
                          bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.7)",
                          color: "common.white",
                          alignItems: "center",
                          justifyContent: "center",
                          zIndex: 5,
                        }}
                        spacing={1}
                      >
                        <CircularProgress size={28} color="inherit" />
                        <Typography variant="body2">Đang kết nối camera...</Typography>
                      </Stack>
                    )}
                    {debugRaw && (
                      <Box
                        sx={{
                          position: "absolute",
                          bottom: 8,
                          left: 8,
                          right: 8,
                          bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)",
                          color: "#4eff91",
                          borderRadius: 1,
                          px: 1,
                          py: 0.5,
                          fontFamily: "monospace",
                          fontSize: 12,
                          textAlign: "center",
                          zIndex: 10,
                          pointerEvents: "none",
                        }}
                      >
                        {"📷"} {debugRaw}
                      </Box>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
              </Paper>

              
            </Box>

            <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ flex: 1, overflow: "auto" }}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <QrCodeScannerIcon color="primary" sx={{ fontSize: 20 }} />
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>
                  {totalScanned > 0 ? `Đã quét (${totalScanned} cuốn)` : "Sách đã quét"}
                </Typography>
              </Stack>

              {createError ? <Alert severity={getAlertSeverity(createError)} onClose={() => setCreateError("")}>{createError}</Alert> : null}

                    >
                      Nhập mã sách thủ công
                    </Button>
                  </Stack>
                </Paper>
              ) : null}

              <TextField
                size="small"
                placeholder="Quét hoặc nhập mã bản sao (VD: LIB-9780140328721-001) hoặc ISBN..."
                value={manualIsbn}
                onChange={(e) => setManualIsbn(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && manualIsbn.trim()) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    addScanned(manualIsbn.trim());
                    setManualIsbn("");
                  }
                }}
                slotProps={{
                  input: {
                    startAdornment: (
                      <InputAdornment position="start">
                        <QrCodeScannerIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                      </InputAdornment>

              {scanned.length === 0 ? (
                <Alert severity="info" sx={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
                  Đưa mã vạch sách (ISBN hoặc mã bản sao LIB-...) vào trước camera, hoặc nhập mã ở trên.
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                scanned.map((item) => {
                  const isLastScanned = item.barcode === lastScannedRef.current;
                  const hasError = !item.loading && !item.can_borrow;
                  const isSuccess = !item.loading && item.can_borrow;
                  return (
                    <Paper
                      key={item.barcode}
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        p: 1.5,
                        borderColor: isLastScanned ? "primary.main" : hasError ? "error.main" : undefined,
                        bgcolor: isLastScanned ? "action.hover" : hasError ? "error.50" : undefined,
                        animation: isSuccess
                          ? `${successPop} 0.4s ease-out`
                          : isLastScanned
                          ? `${slideInRight} 0.3s ease-out`

                          <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, bgcolor: "background.default", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            <CircularProgress size={20} />
                          </Avatar>
                        ) : item.book?.cover_url ? (
                          <Box
                            component="img"
                            src={item.book.cover_url}
                            alt={item.book.title}
                            sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Avatar variant="rounded" sx={{ width: 40, height: 56, bgcolor: hasError ? "error.main" : "background.default", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                            {hasError ? <ErrorIcon fontSize="small" /> : <BookIcon />}
                          </Avatar>
                        )}
                        <Stack spacing={0.3} sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          {item.loading ? (
                            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Đang tra cứu...</Typography>
                          ) : item.can_borrow && item.book ? (
                            <>
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }} noWrap>
                                {item.book.title}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                                {item.book.author || "-"}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: "primary.main" }}>
                                {item.barcode}
                              </Typography>
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" label={`Kho: ${item.book.total_copies}`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                                <Chip size="small" variant="outlined" color="success" label={`Sẵn: ${item.book.available_copies}`} sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11 }} />
                              </Stack>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }} noWrap color="error">
                                {item.book?.title || item.barcode}
                              </Typography>
                              {item.reason && (
                                <Typography variant="caption" color="error">
                                  {item.reason}
                                </Typography>
                              )}
                            </>
                          )}
                        </Stack>
                        <IconButton size="small" color="error" onClick={() => removeItem(item.barcode)} sx={{ mt: 0.5 }}>
                          <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Stack>
                    </Paper>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </Stack>
          </Box>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={lookingUp}>Hủy</Button>
          {!successResult && (
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              disabled={lookingUp || validCount === 0}
              onClick={handleCreateSlip}
            >
              {lookingUp ? "Đang xử lý..." : `Tạo phiếu mượn (${validCount} cuốn)`}
            </Button>
          )}
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

function formatRelativeTime(isoString: string): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const date = new Date(isoString);
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
  const diffSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
  const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHour / 24);

  if (diffSec < 60) return "Vừa xong";
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin} phút trước`;
  if (diffHour < 24) return `${diffHour} giờ trước`;
  if (diffDay === 1) return "Hôm qua";
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay} ngày trước`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

type TabCategory = "all" | "unread" | "borrow" | "schedule" | "system";

export default function NotificationsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";

  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabCategory>("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [expandedIds, setExpandedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const pageSize = 20;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !isAuthenticated) router.push("/login");
  }, [isAuthenticated, authLoading, router]);

  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const isUnreadOnly = activeTab === "unread";
      const result = await api.getNotifications({
        unread_only: isUnreadOnly ? true : undefined,
        skip: (page - 1) * pageSize,
        limit: pageSize,
      });

      setNotifications(result.items);
      setTotal(result.total);
      if (typeof result.unread === "number") {
        setUnreadCount(result.unread);
      } else {
        setUnreadCount(result.items.filter((n) => !n.isRead).length);
      }
    } catch {
      // Graceful fallback
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, activeTab, page]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotifications();
  }, [fetchNotifications]);

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    try {
      await api.markAllNotificationsAsRead();
      setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
      setUnreadCount(0);
    } catch {
      // Fallback
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAsRead = async (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      await api.markNotificationAsRead(id);
      setNotifications((prev) =>
        prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n))
      );
      setUnreadCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
    } catch {
      // Fallback
    }
  };

  const handleNotificationClick = async (notification: Notification) => {
    if (!notification.isRead) {
      try {
        await api.markNotificationAsRead(notification.id);
        setNotifications((prev) =>
          prev.map((n) => (n.id === notification.id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n))
        );
        setUnreadCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
      } catch {
        // Fallback
      }
    }
    // Auto-navigate if route exists
    const config = getConfig(notification.type);
    if (config.route) {
      router.push(config.route);
    }
  };

  const toggleExpand = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setExpandedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Filter list by selected Tab if category-specific
  const filteredNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeTab === "all" || activeTab === "unread") {
      return notifications;
    }
    return notifications.filter((n) => {
      const cfg = getConfig(n.type);
      return cfg.category === activeTab;
    });
  }, [notifications, activeTab]);

  // Group notifications by relative date
  const groupedNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const yesterday = new Date(today);
    yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);

    const weekAgo = new Date(today);
    weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);

    const groups: {
      today: Notification[];
      yesterday: Notification[];
      thisWeek: Notification[];
      earlier: Notification[];
    } = {
      today: [],
      yesterday: [],
      thisWeek: [],
      earlier: [],
    };

    filteredNotifications.forEach((item) => {
      const itemDate = new Date(item.createdAt);
      if (itemDate >= today) {
        groups.today.push(item);
      } else if (itemDate >= yesterday) {
        groups.yesterday.push(item);
      } else if (itemDate >= weekAgo) {
        groups.thisWeek.push(item);
      } else {
        groups.earlier.push(item);
      }
    });

    return [
      { key: "today", title: "Hôm nay", icon: <TodayOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, items: groups.today },
      { key: "yesterday", title: "Hôm qua", icon: <DateRangeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, items: groups.yesterday },
      { key: "thisWeek", title: "Trong 7 ngày qua", icon: <DateRangeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, items: groups.thisWeek },
      { key: "earlier", title: "Trước đó", icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />, items: groups.earlier },
    ].filter((g) => g.items.length > 0);
  }, [filteredNotifications]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

  if (authLoading) {
    return (
      <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ maxWidth: 880, mx: "auto", p: 2 }}>
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={60} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={48} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={100} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={100} />
        <Skeleton variant="rounded" height={100} />
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2.5} sx={{ maxWidth: 900, mx: "auto", pb: 5 }}>
      {/* ── HEADER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <PageHeader
        title="Trung tâm Thông báo"
        icon={NotificationsOutlinedIcon}
        statBadges={unreadCount > 0 ? `${unreadCount} chưa đọc` : undefined}
        onRefresh={fetchNotifications}
        actions={
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
            <Button
              size="small"
              variant="outlined"
              color="primary"
              startIcon={<DoneAllOutlinedIcon />}
              onClick={handleMarkAllRead}
              disabled={unreadCount === 0 || loading}
              sx={{
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 600,
                borderRadius: 1.5,
                fontSize: "0.8rem",
              }}
            >
              Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc
            </Button>
            <Tooltip title="Làm mới thông báo">
              <IconButton size="small" onClick={fetchNotifications} disabled={loading}>
                <RefreshOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>
          </Stack>
        }
      />

      {/* ── TABS BAR (MUI TABS + BADGE) ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Paper
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          borderRadius: 2,
          borderColor: "divider",
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", px: 1, bgcolor: isDark ? "background.default" : "#F8FAFC" }}>
          <Tabs
            value={activeTab}
            onChange={(_, val) => {
              setActiveTab(val);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            variant="scrollable"
            scrollButtons="auto"
            sx={{
              minHeight: 46,
              "& .MuiTab-root": {
                minHeight: 46,
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: "0.83rem",
                py: 1,
                px: 2,
              },
            }}
          >
            <Tab
              value="all"
              label={
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.75} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <span>Tất cả</span>
                  <Chip
                    size="small"
                    label={total}
                    sx={{
                      height: 20,
                      fontSize: "0.7rem",
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.08) : "#E2E8F0",
                    }}
                  />
                </Stack>
              }
            />
            <Tab
              value="unread"
              label={
                <Badge badgeContent={unreadCount} color="error" max={99} sx={{ "& .MuiBadge-badge": { fontSize: "0.65rem", height: 18, minWidth: 18 } }}>
                  <Box sx={{ pr: unreadCount > 0 ? 1 : 0 }}>Chưa đọc</Box>
                </Badge>
              }
            />
            <Tab value="borrow" label="Mượn - Trả sách" />
            <Tab value="schedule" label="Lịch trực nhân viên" />
            <Tab value="system" label="Cảnh báo & Hệ thống" />
          </Tabs>
        </Box>

        {/* ── NOTIFICATION LIST (MUI LIST & AVATAR BADGE) ───────────────── */}
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 1, sm: 2 } }}>
          {loading ? (
            <Stack spacing={1.5} sx={{ p: 1 }}>
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
                <Paper
                  key={i}
                  variant="outlined"
                  sx={{
                    p: 2,
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 2,
                    borderRadius: 2,

                  }}
                >
                  <Skeleton variant="circular" width={42} height={42} />
                  <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Skeleton variant="text" width="40%" height={24} />
                    <Skeleton variant="text" width="85%" height={20} />

              <EmptyState

                  activeTab === "unread"
                    ? "Bạn không có thông báo chưa đọc nào"
                    : activeTab === "borrow"
                    ? "Không có thông báo mượn trả sách"
                    : activeTab === "schedule"
                    ? "Không có thông báo lịch trực"
                    : activeTab === "system"

            <List disablePadding sx={{ width: "100%" }}>

                  <Stack spacing={1}>
                    {group.items.map((notification, idx) => {

                              ? "background.paper"
                              : isDark
                              ? alpha(config.color, 0.08)
                              : alpha(config.color, 0.04),

                            "&:hover": {
                              bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.04) : "#F8FAFC",
                              borderColor: config.color,

                                alignItems: "center",

                                whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",

                                display: isExpanded ? "block" : "-webkit-box",
                                WebkitLineClamp: isExpanded ? "unset" : 2,
                                WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical",
                                overflow: isExpanded ? "visible" : "hidden",

                            >
                              {notification.body}
                            </Typography>

                            {/* Expand toggle & Action buttons */}
                            <Stack
                              direction="row"
                              spacing={1.5}
                              sx={{
                                alignItems: "center",
                                justifyContent: "space-between",
                                mt: 1,
                              }}
                            >
                              <Box>
                                {(notification.body?.length ?? 0) > 100 && (
                                  <Button
                                    size="small"
                                    variant="text"
                                    onClick={(e) => toggleExpand(e, notification.id)}
                                    endIcon={
                                      isExpanded ? (
                                        <ExpandLessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />
                                      ) : (
                                        <ExpandMoreOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />

                                    sx={{

                                {hasRoute && (
                                  <Button
                                    size="small"
                                    variant="outlined"
                                    color="primary"
                                    endIcon={<OpenInNewOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "13px !important" }} />}
                                    onClick={(e) => {
                                      e.stopPropagation();
                                      handleNotificationClick(notification);

                                      fontSize: "0.72rem",

                                    }}
                                  >
                                    {config.routeLabel || "Mở tính năng"}
                                  </Button>
                                )}

                                {!notification.isRead && (
                                  <Tooltip title="Đánh dấu đã đọc" arrow>
                                    <IconButton
                                      size="small"
                                      color="primary"
                                      onClick={(e) => handleMarkAsRead(e, notification.id)}
                                      sx={{
                                        p: 0.5,
                                        bgcolor: isDark ? alpha("#FFFFFF", 0.05) : "#F1F5F9",
                                        "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
                                      }}
                                    >
                                      <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                                    </IconButton>
                                  </Tooltip>
                                )}
                              </Stack>
                            </Stack>
                          </Box>
                        </Paper>
                      );
                    })}
                  </Stack>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </List>
          )}

          {/* ── PAGINATION ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          {totalPages > 1 && (
            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", pt: 3, pb: 1 }}>
              <Pagination
                count={totalPages}
                page={page}
                onChange={(_, p) => {
                  setPage(p);
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
                }}
                color="primary"
                shape="rounded"
              />
            </Box>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Paper>
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  keyframes,
  Paper,
  Stack,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import VideocamOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VideocamOutlined";
import LaptopOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LaptopOutlined";
import CenterFocusWeakIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CenterFocusWeak";

interface CameraFeedProps {
  src: string;
  cameraId?: string;
  label: string;
  useWebcam?: boolean;
  onToggleWebcam?: () => void;
  overlay?: {
    bbox?: [number, number, number, number];
    landmarks?: [number, number][];
    status?: string;
  } | null;
  onStatusChange?: (ok: boolean) => void;
}

const OVERLAY_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  granted: "#10b981",
  wrong_direction: "#f59e0b",
  expired: "#f97316",
  spoof: "#ef4444",
};

const laserScan = keyframes`
  0% {
    top: 5%;
    opacity: 0.8;
  }
  50% {
    top: 90%;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    top: 5%;
    opacity: 0.8;
  }
`;

const pulseDot = keyframes`
  0% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.8; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.2); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.8; }
`;

const ONLINE_INTERVAL = 1000;
const OFFLINE_INTERVAL = 5000;

let globalWebcamStream: MediaStream | null = null;
const globalWebcamListeners = new Set<(stream: MediaStream | null) => void>();
let globalWebcamPromise: Promise<MediaStream> | null = null;

async function getSharedWebcamStream(): Promise<MediaStream> {
  if (globalWebcamStream && globalWebcamStream.active) {
    return globalWebcamStream;
  }
  if (!globalWebcamPromise) {
    globalWebcamPromise = navigator.mediaDevices
      .getUserMedia({
        video: { width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 }, facingMode: "user" },
        audio: false,
      })
      .then((stream) => {
        globalWebcamStream = stream;
        globalWebcamPromise = null;
        if (stream.getVideoTracks()[0]) {
          stream.getVideoTracks()[0].onended = () => {
            globalWebcamStream = null;
            globalWebcamListeners.forEach((fn) => fn(null));
          };
        }
        globalWebcamListeners.forEach((fn) => fn(stream));
        return stream;
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        globalWebcamPromise = null;
        throw err;
      });
  }
  return globalWebcamPromise;
}

function releaseSharedWebcamStream() {
  if (globalWebcamListeners.size === 0 && globalWebcamStream) {
    globalWebcamStream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    globalWebcamStream = null;
  }
}

export default function CameraFeed({
  src,
  cameraId,
  label,
  useWebcam = false,
  onToggleWebcam,
  overlay,
  onStatusChange,
}: CameraFeedProps) {
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [ts, setTs] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [ok, setOk] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const isStream = src.includes("/video") || src.includes("/mjpeg");

  useEffect(() => {
    onStatusChange?.(ok === true);
  }, [ok, onStatusChange]);

  // Webcam stream lifecycle (shares 1 hardware stream across both Cổng vào and Cổng ra)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!useWebcam) {
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    const listener = (stream: MediaStream | null) => {
      if (!active) return;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
      }
      setOk(!!stream);
    };

    globalWebcamListeners.add(listener);

    getSharedWebcamStream()
      .then((stream) => {
        if (!active) return;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        }
        setOk(true);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error("[CameraFeed] Webcam access error:", err);
        setOk(false);
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      globalWebcamListeners.delete(listener);
      releaseSharedWebcamStream();
    };
  }, [useWebcam]);

  // Webcam frame transmission to backend AI
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!useWebcam || !cameraId) return;
    let isMounted = true;
    let inFlight = false;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      if (!video || video.readyState < 2 || inFlight || !isMounted) return;
      inFlight = true;

      try {
        const offscreen = document.createElement("canvas");
        offscreen.width = video.videoWidth || 640;
        offscreen.height = video.videoHeight || 480;
        const ctx = offscreen.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) {
          inFlight = false;
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
        offscreen.toBlob(async (blob) => {
          if (blob && isMounted) {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append("file", blob, "webcam_frame.jpg");
            try {
              await fetch(`/api/camera/frame/${cameraId}`, {
                method: "POST",
                body: formData,
              });
            } catch {
              // Ignore transient network errors
            }
          }
          inFlight = false;
        }, "image/jpeg", 0.85);
      } catch {
        inFlight = false;
      }
    }, 1500);

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [useWebcam, cameraId]);

  const snapshotUrl = cameraId
    ? `/api/camera/snapshot/${cameraId}`
    : src;

  const scheduleNext = useCallback((success: boolean) => {
    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    if (isStream || useWebcam) return;
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setTs(Date.now()), success ? ONLINE_INTERVAL : OFFLINE_INTERVAL);
  }, [isStream, useWebcam]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cameraId || useWebcam) return;
    scheduleNext(true);
    return () => { if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current); };
  }, [cameraId, ts, scheduleNext, useWebcam]);

  // Overlay drawing
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    if (!overlay?.bbox && !overlay?.landmarks) {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      return;
    }

    const mediaEl = useWebcam ? videoRef.current : imgRef.current;
    if (!mediaEl) return;

    const rect = mediaEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const naturalW = useWebcam
      ? (mediaEl as HTMLVideoElement).videoWidth || 1
      : (mediaEl as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth || 1;
    const naturalH = useWebcam
      ? (mediaEl as HTMLVideoElement).videoHeight || 1
      : (mediaEl as HTMLImageElement).naturalHeight || 1;

    const scaleX = rect.width / naturalW;
    const scaleY = rect.height / naturalH;

    canvas.width = rect.width;
    canvas.height = rect.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    if (overlay.bbox) {
      const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = overlay.bbox;
      ctx.strokeStyle = OVERLAY_COLORS[overlay.status || "granted"] || "#10b981";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeRect(x1 * scaleX, y1 * scaleY, (x2 - x1) * scaleX, (y2 - y1) * scaleY);
    }

    if (overlay.landmarks) {
      overlay.landmarks.forEach(([x, y]) => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x * scaleX, y * scaleY, 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
        ctx.fill();
      });
    }
  }, [overlay, useWebcam]);

  const isGranted = overlay?.status === "granted";
  const isDenied = overlay?.status === "spoof" || overlay?.status === "wrong_direction" || overlay?.status === "expired" || overlay?.status === "denied";

  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        overflow: "hidden",
        height: "100%",
        borderRadius: 3,
        transition: "all 0.3s ease",
        borderColor: isGranted ? "#10b981" : isDenied ? "#ef4444" : "divider",
        borderWidth: isGranted || isDenied ? 2 : 1,
        boxShadow: isGranted
          ? "0 0 28px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4)"
          : isDenied
          ? "0 0 28px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)"
          : "0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)",
      }}
    >
      {/* Header bar */}
      <Stack
        direction="row"
        spacing={1.25}
        sx={{
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          px: 2,
          py: 1.25,
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: isGranted ? "#10b981" : isDenied ? "#ef4444" : "divider",
          bgcolor: isGranted
            ? "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)"
            : isDenied
            ? "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)"
            : "background.paper",
          transition: "all 0.3s ease",
        }}
      >
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          {useWebcam ? (
            <LaptopOutlinedIcon
              sx={{
                color: isGranted ? "#10b981" : isDenied ? "#ef4444" : "primary.main",
                fontSize: 22,
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <VideocamOutlinedIcon
              sx={{
                color: isGranted ? "#10b981" : isDenied ? "#ef4444" : "primary.main",
                fontSize: 22,
              }}
            />
          )}
          <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: isGranted ? "#10b981" : isDenied ? "#ef4444" : "text.primary" }}>
            {label}
          </Typography>
        </Stack>

        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          {onToggleWebcam && (
            <Button
              size="small"
              variant={useWebcam ? "contained" : "outlined"}
              color={useWebcam ? "info" : "inherit"}
              onClick={onToggleWebcam}
              startIcon={useWebcam ? <LaptopOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} /> : <VideocamOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
              sx={{
                textTransform: "none",
                py: 0.2,
                px: 1,

                fontWeight: 700,

              }}
            >
              {useWebcam ? "Webcam máy tính" : "IP Camera"}

      {/* Video Viewport with Cyber Biometric HUD */}
      <Box sx={{ position: "relative", aspectRatio: "16 / 9", bgcolor: "#070B14", overflow: "hidden" }}>

File: src/app/api/camera/proxy/route.ts

import { NextRequest } from "next/server";

const ALLOWED_HOSTS = (process.env.CAMERA_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS || "")
  .split(",")
  .map((h) => h.trim())
  .filter(Boolean);

function isHostAllowed(hostname: string): boolean {
  if (ALLOWED_HOSTS.length === 0) return true;
  if (ALLOWED_HOSTS.includes("*")) return true;
  return ALLOWED_HOSTS.includes(hostname);
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("url");
  if (!url) {
    return new Response("Missing url parameter", { status: 400 });
  }

  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(url);
  } catch {
    return new Response("Invalid URL", { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(parsed.protocol)) {
    return new Response("Protocol not allowed", { status: 403 });
  }

  if (!isHostAllowed(parsed.hostname)) {
    return new Response("Host not allowed", { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);

    const response = await fetch(parsed.toString(), {
      signal: controller.signal,
      headers: { Accept: "image/jpeg, multipart/x-mixed-replace, */*" },
    });
    clearTimeout(timeout);

    const contentType = response.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";
    const isStream = contentType.includes("multipart");

    if (isStream) {
      return new Response(response.body, {
        status: response.status,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": contentType,
          "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate",
          Pragma: "no-cache",
          Expires: "0",
        },
      });
    }

    const buffer = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());

    return new Response(buffer, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": contentType,
        "Content-Length": String(buffer.length),
        "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate",
        Pragma: "no-cache",
        Expires: "0",
      },
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("[camera-proxy] fetch failed:", parsed.toString(), err);
    return new Response("Failed to connect to camera", { status: 502 });
  }
}

function formatTime(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "--:--";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}

function statusChip(status?: string) {
  if (status === "success" || status === "granted") return <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Thành công" sx={{ animation: `${successPop} 0.35s ease-out` }} />;
  if (status === "denied") return <Chip size="small" color="error" label="Từ chối" />;
  return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label={status || "Không rõ"} />;
}

function accessTypeChip(type?: string) {
  if (type === "entry") return <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Vào" />;
  if (type === "exit") return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Ra" />;
  return <Chip size="small" label={type || "-"} />;
}

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { user, isLoading, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const data = useDashboardData();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !isAuthenticated) router.push("/login");
  }, [isLoading, isAuthenticated, router]);

  const stats = data.stats;
  const borrowStats = data.borrowStats;
  const cameras = data.cameraStatuses;

  // 1. Góc trên bên trái: Hiện diện thực tế (Active Patrons / Sức chứa phòng đọc)
  const LIBRARY_CAPACITY = 200; // Sức chứa danh định phòng đọc
  const activeCount = stats?.active_patrons ?? 0;
  const occupancyPct = stats?.active_patrons != null
    ? Math.min(100, Math.round((activeCount / LIBRARY_CAPACITY) * 100))
    : undefined;

  // 2. Lưu lượng ra/vào hôm nay & mốc so sánh
  const todayEntries = stats?.today_entries ?? 0;
  const todayExits = stats?.today_exits ?? 0;
  const totalFlow = todayEntries + todayExits;
  const entryPct = totalFlow > 0 ? Math.round((todayEntries / totalFlow) * 100) : undefined;

  // 3. Tình trạng mượn sách & Cảnh báo quá hạn (Tô màu có mục đích)
  const activeBorrows = borrowStats?.active ?? 0;
  const overdueBorrows = borrowStats?.overdue ?? 0;
  const hasOverdue = overdueBorrows > 0;
  const borrowPct = borrowStats?.total && borrowStats.total > 0
    ? Math.min(100, Math.round((activeBorrows / borrowStats.total) * 100))
    : undefined;

  // 4. Trạng thái hạ tầng AI (Camera & Cổng)
  const totalCams = cameras.length;
  const onlineCams = cameras.filter((c) => c.connected && c.running).length;
  const allCamsOnline = totalCams > 0 && onlineCams === totalCams;
  const hasOfflineCams = totalCams > 0 && onlineCams < totalCams;

  if (isLoading || !isAuthenticated) {
    return <LoadingOverlay loading message="Đang tải..." />;
  }

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      {data.error ? <Alert severity="warning">{data.error}</Alert> : null}

      <GreetingBar
        userName={user?.full_name || user?.email || "Admin"}
        onRefresh={data.refresh}
        liveConnected={!!stats}
      />

      {/* Dãy chỉ số KPI tuân thủ quy tắc 5 giây */}
      <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(4, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
        {/* Card 1 (Top-Left): Chỉ số sinh mạng tức thì - Đang có mặt & Sức chứa */}
        <MuiStatCard
          label="Đang có mặt"
          value={stats?.active_patrons ?? "—"}
          icon={UserCheckIcon}
          gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)"
          pct={occupancyPct}
          delta={occupancyPct != null ? `${occupancyPct}% sức chứa (${activeCount}/${LIBRARY_CAPACITY} chỗ)` : undefined}
          deltaColor={occupancyPct && occupancyPct >= 90 ? "error" : occupancyPct && occupancyPct >= 75 ? "warning" : "default"}
          index={0}
        />

        {/* Card 2: Lưu lượng check-in hôm nay kèm mốc đối chiếu lượt ra */}
        <MuiStatCard
          label="Lượt vào hôm nay"
          value={stats?.today_entries ?? "—"}
          icon={LoginIcon}
          gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B89628 100%)"
          pct={entryPct}
          delta={stats ? `Đã check-out: ${todayExits} lượt` : undefined}
          deltaColor="default"
          index={1}
        />

        {/* Card 3: Sách đang mượn - Chỉ dùng đỏ khi có sách quá hạn */}

          deltaColor={hasOverdue ? "error" : "success"}

          pct={totalCams > 0 ? Math.round((onlineCams / totalCams) * 100) : undefined}

import type { ColumnsType, TablePaginationConfig } from "antd/es/table";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import { successPop } from "@/lib/animations";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";
import type { AccessFrequencyDay, AccessLogPublic, CameraEvent } from "@/lib/types";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import MuiStatCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/MuiStatCard";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";

const CAMERA_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  entry_gate: "Cổng vào",
  exit_gate: "Cổng ra",
  kiosk: "Kiosk",
  web_login: "Đăng nhập web",
};

function getStatusLabel(status: string) {
  if (status === "success" || status === "granted") return "Thành công";
  if (status === "expired") return "Hết hạn";
  if (status === "spoof") return "Giả mạo";
  return "Thất bại";
}

function getStatusColor(status: string): "success" | "warning" | "error" {
  if (status === "success" || status === "granted") return "success";
  if (status === "expired") return "warning";
  return "error";
}

function mapEventStatus(status: CameraEvent["status"]) {
  return status === "granted" ? "success" : status;
}

export default function HistoryPage() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<AccessLogPublic[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [live, setLive] = useState(true);

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState("");
  const [accessType, setAccessType] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState("");
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState("");

  const [skip, setSkip] = useState(0);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(50);
  const currentPage = Math.floor(skip / limit) + 1;

  const [frequency, setFrequency] = useState<AccessFrequencyDay[]>([]);
  const [freqLoading, setFreqLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(search);
      setSkip(0);
    }, 350);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search]);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      setError(null);
      const data = await api.getAccessLogs({
        search: debouncedSearch || undefined,
        accessType: accessType || undefined,
        status: status || undefined,
        dateFrom: dateFrom || undefined,
        dateTo: dateTo || undefined,
        skip,
        limit,
      });
      setLogs(data.items);
      setTotal(data.total);
    } catch {
      setError("Không thể tải lịch sử ra/vào.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [debouncedSearch, accessType, status, dateFrom, dateTo, skip, limit]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      setFreqLoading(true);
      try {
        const data = await api.getAccessFrequency({
          dateFrom: dateFrom || undefined,
          dateTo: dateTo || undefined,
        });
        setFrequency(Array.isArray(data.daily) ? data.daily : []);
      } finally {
        setFreqLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [dateFrom, dateTo]);

  const liveCleanup = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!live || skip !== 0) {
      if (liveCleanup.current) {
        liveCleanup.current();
        liveCleanup.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    const cleanup = api.connectAccessSSE((event: CameraEvent) => {
      const mappedStatus = mapEventStatus(event.status);
      if (search) {
        const q = search.toLowerCase();
        if (!event.full_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !event.student_code?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return;
      }
      if (status && mappedStatus !== status) return;
      if (accessType && event.access_type !== accessType) return;

      const newLog: AccessLogPublic = {
        id: `sse-${Date.now()}`,
        patron_id: event.patron_id || null,
        patron_name: event.full_name || null,
        student_code: event.student_code || null,
        access_type: event.access_type || "entry",
        verify_method: "face",
        confidence: event.score || null,
        camera_id: event.camera_id,
        access_time: new Date().toISOString(),
        status: mappedStatus,
      };
      setLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev.filter((log) => !log.id.startsWith("sse-")).slice(0, limit - 1)]);
      setTotal((prev) => prev + 1);
    });
    liveCleanup.current = cleanup;
    return cleanup;
  }, [live, skip, search, status, accessType, limit]);

  const handleFilter = () => {
    if (skip === 0) {
      load();
    } else {
      setSkip(0);
    }
  };

  const entryTotal = useMemo(() => frequency.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.entry, 0), [frequency]);
  const exitTotal = useMemo(() => frequency.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.exit, 0), [frequency]);

  const columns: ColumnsType<AccessLogPublic> = [
    {
      title: "Thời gian",
      dataIndex: "access_time",
      key: "access_time",
      width: 180,
      sorter: (a, b) => new Date(a.access_time).getTime() - new Date(b.access_time).getTime(),
      render: (val: string) => (
        <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem", color: "#B8B0A4" }}>
          {new Date(val).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Độc giả",
      dataIndex: "patron_name",
      key: "patron_name",
      width: 160,
      render: (val: string) => <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{val || "-"}</span>,
    },
    {
      title: "MSSV",
      dataIndex: "student_code",
      key: "student_code",
      width: 120,
      render: (val: string) => <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{val || "-"}</span>,
    },
    {
      title: "Loại",
      dataIndex: "access_type",
      key: "access_type",
      width: 80,
      filters: [
        { text: "Vào", value: "entry" },
        { text: "Ra", value: "exit" },
      ],
      onFilter: (value, record) => record.access_type === value,
      render: (val: string) => (
        <Tag color={val === "entry" ? "green" : "orange"}>
          {val === "entry" ? "Vào" : "Ra"}
        </Tag>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Phương thức",
      dataIndex: "verify_method",
      key: "verify_method",
      width: 100,
      render: (val: string) => <span style={{ color: "#B8B0A4" }}>{val}</span>,
    },
    {
      title: "Cổng",
      dataIndex: "camera_id",
      key: "camera_id",
      width: 120,
      render: (val: string) => (
        <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>
          {CAMERA_LABELS[val] || val}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Độ tin cậy",
      dataIndex: "confidence",
      key: "confidence",
      width: 150,
      sorter: (a, b) => (a.confidence ?? 0) - (b.confidence ?? 0),
      render: (val: number | null) => {
        if (val == null) return <span style={{ color: "#B8B0A4" }}>-</span>;
        const pct = Math.round(val * 100);
        return (
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <LinearProgress
              variant="determinate"
              value={pct}
              color={pct >= 80 ? "success" : pct >= 60 ? "warning" : "error"}
              sx={{ width: 80, height: 7, borderRadius: 99 }}
            />
            <span style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", color: "#B8B0A4" }}>{pct}%</span>
          </Stack>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Kết quả",
      dataIndex: "status",
      key: "status",
      width: 110,
      filters: [
        { text: "Thành công", value: "success" },
        { text: "Thất bại", value: "failed" },
        { text: "Hết hạn", value: "expired" },
        { text: "Giả mạo", value: "spoof" },
      ],
      onFilter: (value, record) => record.status === value,
      render: (val: string) => {
        const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
          success: "green", granted: "green",
          expired: "orange",
          spoof: "red", failed: "red",
        };
        return (
          <Tag color={colorMap[val] || "default"}>
            {getStatusLabel(val)}
          </Tag>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Lịch sử ra vào cổng"
        subtitle={`Theo dõi lượt quét thẻ, nhận diện khuôn mặt và thời gian ra vào`}
        icon={HistoryOutlinedIcon}
        statBadges={`Tổng: ${total} lượt`}
        onRefresh={load}
        actions={
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Chip
              icon={<SensorsOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
              label={live ? "Trực tiếp" : "Tự làm mới"}
              size="small"
              sx={{
                bgcolor: live ? "rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.12)" : "action.hover",
                color: live ? "success.main" : "text.secondary",
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: live ? "rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.3)" : "divider",
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            />
          </Stack>
        }
      />

      <DashboardCard title="Bộ lọc tìm kiếm">
        <Grid container spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 3 }}>
            <TextField
              label="Tìm kiếm"
              placeholder="MSSV hoặc tên độc giả..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => event.key === "Enter" ? handleFilter() : undefined}
              fullWidth
              size="small"
              slotProps={{
                input: {
                  startAdornment: (
                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                      <SearchOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </InputAdornment>
                  ),
                },
              }}
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 1.7 }}>
            <TextField select label="Loại" value={accessType} onChange={(event) => setAccessType(event.target.value)} fullWidth size="small">
              <MenuItem value="">Tất cả</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="entry">Vào</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="exit">Ra</MenuItem>
            </TextField>
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 1.9 }}>
            <TextField select label="Kết quả" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value)} fullWidth size="small">
              <MenuItem value="">Tất cả</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="success">Thành công</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="failed">Thất bại</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="expired">Hết hạn</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="spoof">Giả mạo</MenuItem>
            </TextField>
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 3 }}>
            <RangePicker
              size="small"
              value={[
                dateFrom ? dayjs(dateFrom) : null,
                dateTo ? dayjs(dateTo) : null,
              ]}
              onChange={(dates) => {
                setDateFrom(dates?.[0]?.format("YYYY-MM-DD") || "");
                setDateTo(dates?.[1]?.format("YYYY-MM-DD") || "");
              }}
              style={{ width: "100%", height: 40 }}
              placeholder={["Từ ngày", "Đến ngày"]}
              format="DD/MM/YYYY"
            />
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 1.3 }}>
            <Button
              variant="contained"
              onClick={handleFilter}
              disabled={loading}
              fullWidth
              sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, height: 40 }}
            >
              Lọc
            </Button>
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 1.5 }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: { xs: "flex-start", md: "flex-end" } }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Live</Typography>
              <Switch checked={live} onChange={(event) => setLive(event.target.checked)} />
            </Stack>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </DashboardCard>

      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 8 }}>
          <DashboardCard title="Tần suất ra/vào theo ngày">
            <LoadingOverlay loading={freqLoading} message="Đang tải biểu đồ...">
              {frequency.length === 0 ? (
                <Alert severity="info">Chưa có dữ liệu tần suất trong khoảng thời gian đã chọn.</Alert>
              ) : (
                <Box sx={{ height: 270, width: "100%", minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth={0} minHeight={270}>
                    <BarChart data={frequency} margin={{ top: 8, right: 20, left: -10, bottom: 0 }}>
                      <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={theme.palette.divider} />
                      <XAxis
                        dataKey="date"
                        fontSize={12}
                        tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary }}
                        tickFormatter={(value: string) => new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit" })}
                      />
                      <YAxis allowDecimals={false} fontSize={12} tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary }} />
                      <Tooltip
                        cursor={{ fill: theme.palette.action.hover }}
                        contentStyle={{
                          background: theme.palette.background.paper,
                          border: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`,
                          borderRadius: 8,
                          color: theme.palette.text.primary,
                        }}
                        labelFormatter={(value) => new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", {
                          weekday: "long",
                          day: "2-digit",
                          month: "2-digit",
                          year: "numeric",
                        })}
                      />
                      <Legend />
                      <Bar dataKey="entry" fill={theme.palette.success.main} name="Vào" radius={[5, 5, 0, 0]} />
                      <Bar dataKey="exit" fill={theme.palette.warning.main} name="Ra" radius={[5, 5, 0, 0]} />
                    </BarChart>
                  </ResponsiveContainer>
                </Box>
              )}
            </LoadingOverlay>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Grid>

        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }}>
          <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ height: "100%" }}>
            <MuiStatCard
              label="Lượt vào trong biểu đồ"
              value={entryTotal}
              icon={LoginOutlinedIcon}
              gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)"
              pct={100}
              index={0}
            />
            <MuiStatCard
              label="Lượt ra trong biểu đồ"
              value={exitTotal}
              icon={LogoutOutlinedIcon}
              gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706 0%, #B45309 100%)"
              pct={100}
              index={1}
            />
          </Stack>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      <DashboardCard
        title="Nhật ký truy cập"
        subtitle={`Tổng: ${total} bản ghi`}
        noPadding
      >
        {error ? <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mx: 2.5, mt: 2 }}>{error}</Alert> : null}

        <Box sx={{ px: 1, py: 1 }}>
          <Table<AccessLogPublic>
            rowKey={(record) => record.id}
            columns={columns}
            dataSource={logs}
            loading={loading && logs.length === 0}
            pagination={{
              current: currentPage,
              pageSize: limit,
              total,
              showSizeChanger: true,
              pageSizeOptions: ["20", "50", "100"],
              showTotal: (total, range) => `${range[0]}–${range[1]} / ${total} bản ghi`,
              onChange: (page: number, pageSize: number) => {
                setLimit(pageSize);
                setSkip((page - 1) * pageSize);
              },
            }}
            scroll={{ x: 980 }}
            size="small"
            locale={{
              emptyText: (
                <EmptyState title="Không có dữ liệu lịch sử phù hợp" />
              ),
            }}
          />
        </Box>
      </DashboardCard>
    </Stack>
  );
}
