function borrowStatus(record: BorrowRecord) {
  const overdue = record.status === "borrowed" && new Date(record.due_at) < new Date();
  if (record.status === "returned") return { label: "Đã trả", color: "default" as const };
  if (overdue) return { label: "Quá hạn", color: "error" as const };
  return { label: "Đang mượn", color: "success" as const };
}

function MetaRow({ icon, label, value }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start", py: 1 }}>
      <Box sx={{ color: "text.secondary", mt: 0.3, minWidth: 20 }}>{icon}</Box>
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
          {label}
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, wordBreak: "break-word" }}>
          {value || "-"}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  );
}

export default function PatronDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();

  const [patron, setPatron] = useState<PatronPublic | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<AccessLogPublic[]>([]);
  const [logsTotal, setLogsTotal] = useState(0);
  const [logsSkip, setLogsSkip] = useState(0);
  const logsLimit = 20;
  const [borrows, setBorrows] = useState<BorrowRecord[]>([]);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(0);

  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<PatronUpdate>({});
  const [showEdit, setShowEdit] = useState(false);
  const [showDelete, setShowDelete] = useState(false);
  const [deleteConfirmText, setDeleteConfirmText] = useState("");
  const [showRestore, setShowRestore] = useState(false);
  const [restoreConfirmText, setRestoreConfirmText] = useState("");
  const [showEnroll, setShowEnroll] = useState(false);
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false);
  const [enrollError, setEnrollError] = useState("");
  const [enrollSuccess, setEnrollSuccess] = useState("");
  const [enrollLoading, setEnrollLoading] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info"; message: string } | null>(null);

  const showNotice = (severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info", message: string) => {
    setNotice({ severity, message });
  };

  const loadPatron = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await api.getPatron(id);
      setPatron(data);
    } catch {
      setPatron(null);
    }
  }, [id]);

  const loadLogs = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await api.getAccessLogs({ patronId: id, skip: logsSkip, limit: logsLimit });
      setLogs(data.items);
      setLogsTotal(data.total);
    } catch {
      setLogs([]);
      setLogsTotal(0);
    }
  }, [id, logsSkip]);

  const loadBorrows = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await api.getBorrowHistory({ patronId: id });
      setBorrows(data);
    } catch {
      setBorrows([]);
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      await Promise.all([loadPatron(), loadLogs(), loadBorrows()]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  }, [loadPatron, loadLogs, loadBorrows]);

  const openEdit = () => {
    if (!patron) return;
    setEditForm({
      full_name: patron.full_name,
      class_name: patron.class_name || undefined,
      identity_number: patron.identity_number || undefined,
      email: patron.email || undefined,
      phone: patron.phone || undefined,
      membership_expiry: patron.membership_expiry,
      status: patron.status,
      course: patron.course || undefined,
    });
    setShowEdit(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = async () => {
    if (!patron) return;
    await api.updatePatron(patron.id, editForm);
    setShowEdit(false);
    showNotice("success", "Đã cập nhật thông tin độc giả.");
    await loadPatron();
  };

  const handleRenew = async () => {
    if (!patron) return;
    const next = new Date(patron.membership_expiry);
    if (next < new Date()) next.setTime(Date.now());
    next.setFullYear(next.getFullYear() + 1);
    await api.updatePatron(patron.id, { membership_expiry: next.toISOString().split("T")[0] });
    showNotice("success", "Đã gia hạn thẻ thêm 1 năm.");
    await loadPatron();
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!patron || deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA") return;
    try {
      await api.deletePatron(patron.id);
      router.push("/patrons");
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.response?.status === 404) {
        showNotice("error", "Độc giả không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa.");
        router.push("/patrons");
      } else {
        showNotice("error", `Xóa thất bại: ${getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi không xác định"}`);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async () => {
    if (!patron || restoreConfirmText !== "KHÔI PHỤC") return;
    try {
      await api.restorePatron(patron.id);
      setShowRestore(false);
      setRestoreConfirmText("");
      showNotice("success", "Đã khôi phục độc giả.");
      await loadPatron();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotice("error", `Khôi phục thất bại: ${getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi không xác định"}`);
    }
  };

  const handleEnroll = async (files: Record<CaptureAngle, File>) => {
    if (!patron) return;
    setEnrollLoading(true);
    setEnrollError("");
    setEnrollSuccess("");
    try {
      await api.enrollPatronFaceBatch(patron.id, {
        frontal: files.frontal,
        right: files.right,
        left: files.left,
        down: files.down,
      });
      setEnrollSuccess("Đăng ký khuôn mặt thành công.");
      setShowEnroll(false);
      setConsent(false);
      await loadPatron();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errCode = err?.response?.data?.error || err?.response?.data?.detail;
      const errorMessages: Record<string, string> = {
        LIVENESS_FAILED: "Ảnh không phải khuôn mặt thật, vui lòng chụp trực tiếp.",
        NO_FACE_DETECTED: "Không tìm thấy khuôn mặt trong ảnh, vui lòng thử lại.",
        MULTIPLE_FACES: "Có nhiều hơn 1 khuôn mặt trong ảnh, vui lòng chụp lại.",
        LOW_QUALITY: "Ảnh quá mờ hoặc thiếu sáng, vui lòng chụp lại với ánh sáng tốt hơn.",
        FACE_DETECTION_FAILED: "Không thể trích xuất khuôn mặt, vui lòng thử lại.",
      };
      setEnrollError(errorMessages[errCode] || getErrorMessage(err) || "Đăng ký thất bại.");
    } finally {
      setEnrollLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const logsPageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(logsTotal / logsLimit));
  const logsCurrentPage = Math.floor(logsSkip / logsLimit) + 1;
  const activeBorrowCount = useMemo(() => borrows.filter((item) => item.status === "borrowed").length, [borrows]);
  const overdueCount = useMemo(() => borrows.filter((item) => item.status === "borrowed" && new Date(item.due_at) < new Date()).length, [borrows]);
  const expired = !patron ? false : new Date(patron.membership_expiry) < new Date();

  const headerActions = patron ? (
    patron.status === "deleted" ? (
      <Button variant="contained" color="success" onClick={() => setShowRestore(true)}>
        Khôi phục
      </Button>
    ) : (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        <Button variant="outlined" startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon />} onClick={openEdit}>
          Sửa
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outlined" startIcon={<UpdateOutlinedIcon />} onClick={handleRenew}>
          Gia hạn
        </Button>
        {!patron.has_face ? (
          <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon />} onClick={() => setShowEnroll(true)}>
            Đăng ký khuôn mặt
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        <Button color="error" variant="outlined" startIcon={<DeleteOutlineOutlinedIcon />} onClick={() => setShowDelete(true)}>
          Xóa
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    )
  ) : null;

  return (
    <LoadingOverlay loading={loading} message="Đang tải hồ sơ độc giả...">
      {!patron ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<PersonIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56 }} />}
          title="Không tìm thấy độc giả"
          description="Độc giả có thể đã bị xóa hoặc ID không hợp lệ."
          action={
            <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<PersonIcon />} onClick={() => router.push("/patrons")}>
              Quay lại danh sách
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={3}>
          <PageHeader
            backHref="/patrons"
            title={patron.full_name}
            subtitle={`MSSV: ${patron.student_code} · Mã thẻ: ${patron.card_number || "-"}`}
            icon={PersonIcon}
            actions={headerActions}
          />

          {patron.status === "deleted" && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Độc giả này đã bị xóa. Dữ liệu sẽ được giữ lại và có thể khôi phục.</Alert>}
          {patron.status === "inactive" && <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Thẻ độc giả đang bị tạm khóa.</Alert>}
          {patron.status === "expired" && <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Thẻ độc giả đã hết hạn. Vui lòng gia hạn để tiếp tục sử dụng.</Alert>}
          {enrollSuccess && <Alert severity="success">{enrollSuccess}</Alert>}

          <Grid container spacing={3}>
            {/* Left column — Profile card */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }} sx={staggerSx(0)}>
              <DashboardCard noPadding>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    height: 100,
                    background: patron.status === "active"
                      ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #059669 100%)"
                      : patron.status === "expired"
                        ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0%, #d97706 100%)"
                        : "linear-gradient(135deg, #64748b 0%, #475569 100%)",
                  }}
                />
                <Box sx={{ px: 2.5, pb: 2.5, mt: -5, textAlign: "center" }}>
                  <AvatarUser
                    user={patron}
                    role="patron"
                    size={80}
                    border="4px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"
                    sx={{ mx: "auto", boxShadow: 2, fontSize: "1.8rem" }}
                  />

                  <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mt: 1.5 }}>{patron.full_name}</Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{patron.student_code}</Typography>

                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.75} sx={{ justifyContent: "center", mt: 1.5, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5 }}>
                    <Chip label={statusLabel(patron.status)} color={statusColor(patron.status)} size="small" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }} />
                    <Chip
                      icon={<FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "16px !important" }} />}
                      label={patron.has_face ? "Đã có khuôn mặt" : "Chưa có khuôn mặt"}
                      color={patron.has_face ? "success" : "default"}
                      size="small"
                      variant="outlined"
                    />
                  </Stack>

                  <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }} />

                  <Stack spacing={0}>
                    <MetaRow icon={<SchoolIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Khóa học" value={patron.course} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Lớp" value={patron.class_name} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Hạn thẻ" value={
                      <span style={{ color: expired ? "#d32f2f" : undefined, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                        {formatDate(patron.membership_expiry)}{expired ? " (Hết hạn)" : ""}
                      </span>
                    } />
                    <MetaRow icon={<MailIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Email" value={patron.email} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<PhoneIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Số điện thoại" value={patron.phone} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<LocationOnIcon fontSize="small" />} label="HKTT" value={patron.permanent_address} />
                  </Stack>
                </Box>
              </DashboardCard>
            </Grid>

            {/* Right column — Tabs */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 8 }} sx={staggerSx(1)}>
              <Stack spacing={3}>
                {/* Stats row */}
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5}>
                  {[
                    { label: "Đang mượn", value: activeBorrowCount, color: "info" as const, icon: <AutoStoriesOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                    { label: "Quá hạn", value: overdueCount, color: "error" as const, icon: <EventAvailableOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                    { label: "Lượt ra/vào", value: logsTotal, color: "success" as const, icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                  ].map((item, idx) => (
                    <Paper key={item.label} variant="outlined" sx={{
                      flex: 1,
                      p: 1.5,
                      textAlign: "center",
                      borderColor: `${item.color}.main`,
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      background: item.color === "info" ? "rgba(2,136,209,0.08)" : item.color === "error" ? "rgba(211,47,47,0.08)" : "rgba(46,125,50,0.08)",
                      ...staggerSx(idx),
                    }}>
                      <Box sx={{ color: `${item.color}.main`, mb: 0.5 }}>{item.icon}</Box>
                      <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 900, color: `${item.color}.main` }}>{item.value}</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{item.label}</Typography>
                    </Paper>
                  ))}
                </Stack>

                {/* Tabs */}
                <DashboardCard noPadding>
                  <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", px: 2.5 }}>
                    <Tabs value={tab} onChange={(_, v) => setTab(v)}>
                      <Tab label="Thông tin chi tiết" />
                      <Tab label={`Lịch sử mượn (${borrows.length})`} />
                      <Tab label={`Lịch sử ra/vào (${logsTotal})`} />
                    </Tabs>
                  </Box>

                  {/* Tab 0: Info detail */}
                  {tab === 0 && (
                    <Box sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
                      <Grid container spacing={0.5}>
                        {[
                          { label: "Họ tên", value: patron.full_name, icon: <PersonIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "MSSV", value: patron.student_code, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Lớp", value: patron.class_name, icon: <SchoolIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Khóa học", value: patron.course, icon: <SchoolIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Mã thẻ", value: patron.card_number, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "CCCD/CMND", value: patron.identity_number, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Email", value: patron.email, icon: <MailIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Số điện thoại", value: patron.phone, icon: <PhoneIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "HKTT", value: patron.permanent_address, icon: <LocationOnIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Ngày cấp thẻ", value: formatDate(patron.issue_date), icon: <CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Ngày tạo", value: formatDateTime(patron.created_at), icon: <CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                        ].map((item) => (
                          <Grid key={item.label} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <MetaRow icon={item.icon} label={item.label} value={item.value} />
                          </Grid>
                        ))}
                      </Grid>
                    </Box>
                  )}

                  {/* Tab 1: Borrow history */}
                  {tab === 1 && (
                    <Box>
                      {borrows.length === 0 ? (
                        <Alert severity="info" sx={{ m: 2 }}>Độc giả này chưa mượn cuốn sách nào.</Alert>
                      ) : (
                        <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
                          <Table sx={{ minWidth: 700 }} size="small">
                            <TableHead>
                              <TableRow>
                                <TableCell>Sách</TableCell>
                                <TableCell>Mượn</TableCell>
                                <TableCell>Hạn trả</TableCell>
                                <TableCell>Trả</TableCell>
                                <TableCell>Trạng thái</TableCell>
                              </TableRow>
                            </TableHead>
                            <TableBody>
                              {borrows.map((record) => {
                                const status = borrowStatus(record);
                                return (
                                  <TableRow key={record.id} hover>
                                    <TableCell>
                                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{record.book?.title || record.book_id}</Typography>
                                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{record.book?.isbn || ""}</Typography>
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell>{formatDate(record.borrow_at)}</TableCell>
                                    <TableCell sx={{ color: status.color === "error" ? "error.main" : "inherit", fontWeight: status.color === "error" ? 800 : 400 }}>
                                      {formatDate(record.due_at)}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell>{formatDate(record.return_at)}</TableCell>
                                    <TableCell><Chip size="small" color={status.color} label={status.label} /></TableCell>
                                  </TableRow>
                                );
                              })}
                            </TableBody>
                          </Table>
                        </TableContainer>
                      )}
                    </Box>
                  )}

                  {/* Tab 2: Access logs */}
                  {tab === 2 && (
                    <Box>
                      {logs.length === 0 ? (
                        <Alert severity="info" sx={{ m: 2 }}>Chưa có lịch sử ra/vào.</Alert>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
                            <Table sx={{ minWidth: 700 }} size="small">
                              <TableHead>
                                <TableRow>
                                  <TableCell>Thời gian</TableCell>
                                  <TableCell>Loại</TableCell>
                                  <TableCell>Cổng</TableCell>
                                  <TableCell>Phương thức</TableCell>
                                  <TableCell>Độ tin cậy</TableCell>
                                  <TableCell>Kết quả</TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                              </TableHead>
                              <TableBody>
                                {logs.map((log) => {
                                  const confidence = log.confidence == null ? null : Math.round(log.confidence * 100);
                                  return (
                                    <TableRow key={log.id} hover>
                                      <TableCell sx={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{formatDateTime(log.access_time)}</TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>
                                        <Chip size="small" color={log.access_type === "entry" ? "success" : "warning"} label={log.access_type === "entry" ? "Vào" : "Ra"} />
                                      </TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>{CAMERA_LABELS[log.camera_id] || log.camera_id}</TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>{log.verify_method}</TableCell>
                                      <TableCell sx={{ minWidth: 120 }}>
                                        {confidence == null ? (
                                          <Typography color="text.secondary">-</Typography>
                                        ) : (
                                          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                                            <LinearProgress
                                              variant="determinate"
                                              value={confidence}
                                              color={confidence >= 80 ? "success" : confidence >= 60 ? "warning" : "error"}
                                              sx={{ width: 60, height: 6, borderRadius: 99 }}
                                            />
                                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{confidence}%</Typography>
                                          </Stack>
                                        )}
                                      </TableCell>
                                      <TableCell>
                                        <Chip size="small" color={["success", "granted"].includes(log.status) ? "success" : "error"} label={["success", "granted"].includes(log.status) ? "Thành công" : "Thất bại"} />
                                      </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                  );
                                })}
                              </TableBody>
                            </Table>
                          </TableContainer>
                          {logsTotal > logsLimit && (
                            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ p: 2, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                              <Typography color="text.secondary">Tổng: {logsTotal}</Typography>
                              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                                <Button variant="outlined" size="small" disabled={logsCurrentPage <= 1} onClick={() => setLogsSkip(0)}>Đầu</Button>
                                <Typography color="text.secondary" variant="body2">Trang {logsCurrentPage}/{logsPageCount}</Typography>
                                <Button variant="outlined" size="small" disabled={logsCurrentPage >= logsPageCount} onClick={() => setLogsSkip((logsPageCount - 1) * logsLimit)}>Cuối</Button>
                              </Stack>
                            </Stack>
                          )}
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Box>
                  )}
                </DashboardCard>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          {/* Face enrollment */}
          {showEnroll && !patron.has_face && (
            <DashboardCard
              title="Đăng ký khuôn mặt 4 góc"
              subtitle="Chụp đủ các góc để tăng độ chính xác khi nhận diện."
              actions={<Button onClick={() => { setShowEnroll(false); setEnrollError(""); setConsent(false); }}>Đóng</Button>}
            >
              <MultiAngleCapture consent={consent} setConsent={setConsent} onFilesReady={handleEnroll} />
              {enrollError && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>{enrollError}</Alert>}
              {enrollLoading && <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>Đang đăng ký khuôn mặt...</Alert>}
            </DashboardCard>
          )}

          {/* Edit dialog */}
          <Dialog open={showEdit} onClose={() => setShowEdit(false)} fullWidth maxWidth="sm">
            <DialogTitle>Sửa độc giả</DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent>
              <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
                <TextField label="Họ tên" value={editForm.full_name || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, full_name: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Lớp" value={editForm.class_name || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, class_name: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Khóa học" value={editForm.course || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, course: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="CCCD/CMND" value={editForm.identity_number || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, identity_number: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Email" value={editForm.email || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, email: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Số điện thoại" value={editForm.phone || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, phone: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Hạn thẻ" type="date" value={editForm.membership_expiry || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, membership_expiry: e.target.value })} fullWidth slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }} />
                <TextField select label="Trạng thái" value={editForm.status || "active"} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, status: e.target.value })} fullWidth>
                  <MenuItem value="active">Đang hoạt động</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="inactive">Tạm khóa</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="expired">Hết hạn</MenuItem>
                </TextField>
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <DialogActions>
              <Button onClick={() => setShowEdit(false)}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleEdit}>Lưu</Button>
            </DialogActions>
          </Dialog>

          {/* Delete dialog */}
          <Dialog open={showDelete} onClose={() => { setShowDelete(false); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }} fullWidth maxWidth="xs">
            <DialogTitle>Xóa độc giả?</DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent>
              <Stack spacing={2}>
                <Typography color="text.secondary">
                  Hồ sơ <strong>{patron.full_name}</strong> sẽ bị xóa khỏi danh sách độc giả.
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  Nhập <strong>XÓA</strong> để xác nhận:
                </Typography>
                <TextField value={deleteConfirmText} onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirmText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Nhập XÓA" size="small" autoFocus fullWidth />
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <DialogActions>
              <Button onClick={() => { setShowDelete(false); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button color="error" variant="contained" onClick={handleDelete} disabled={deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA"}>Xóa vĩnh viễn</Button>
            </DialogActions>
          </Dialog>

          {/* Restore dialog */}
          <Dialog open={showRestore} onClose={() => { setShowRestore(false); setRestoreConfirmText(""); }} fullWidth maxWidth="xs">
            <DialogTitle>Khôi phục độc giả?</DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent>
              <Stack spacing={2}>
                <Typography color="text.secondary">
                  Khôi phục hồ sơ <strong>{patron.full_name}</strong>? Nếu thẻ đã hết hạn, hạn thẻ sẽ được tự động gia hạn 1 năm.
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  Nhập <strong>KHÔI PHỤC</strong> để xác nhận:
                </Typography>
                <TextField value={restoreConfirmText} onChange={(e) => setRestoreConfirmText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Nhập KHÔI PHỤC" size="small" autoFocus fullWidth />
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <DialogActions>
              <Button onClick={() => { setShowRestore(false); setRestoreConfirmText(""); }}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button color="success" variant="contained" onClick={handleRestore} disabled={restoreConfirmText !== "KHÔI PHỤC"}>Khôi phục</Button>
            </DialogActions>
          </Dialog>

          <Snackbar
            open={Boolean(notice)}
            autoHideDuration={4000}
            onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
            anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
          >
            {notice ? (
              <Alert
                onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
                severity={notice.severity}
                variant="filled"
                sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: "8px", boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}
              >
                {notice.message}
              </Alert>
            ) : undefined}
          </Snackbar>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </LoadingOverlay>
  );
}

const STAT_GRADIENT: Record<string, string> = {

function toDateStr(d: Date) {
  return d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
}

function isPhysicalAccessLog(log: AccessLogPublic) {
  return ["entry_gate", "exit_gate", "kiosk"].includes(log.camera_id);
}

function formatCameraId(cameraId?: string | null) {
  if (!cameraId || !["entry_gate", "exit_gate", "kiosk"].includes(cameraId)) return "-";
  return cameraId;
}

function cameraLabel(id: string) {
  if (id === "entry_gate") return "Cổng vào";
  if (id === "exit_gate") return "Cổng ra";
  if (id === "kiosk") return "Kiosk";
  return id;
}

function formatTime(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "--:--";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" });
}

function formatShortTime(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "--:--";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}

function formatConfidence(value?: number | null) {
  if (typeof value !== "number") return "-";
  return `${Math.round(value * 100)}%`;
}

function buildAccessLogFromEvent(event: CameraEvent): AccessLogPublic {
  return {
    id: `${event.camera_id}-${event.patron_id || event.student_code || "unknown"}-${Date.now()}`,
    patron_id: event.patron_id || null,
    patron_name: event.full_name || null,
    student_code: event.student_code || null,
    access_type: event.access_type === "exit" ? "exit" : "entry",
    verify_method: "face",
    confidence: event.score ?? null,
    camera_id: event.camera_id,
    access_time: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: event.status,
  };
}

function AccessTypeChip({ type }: { type?: string }) {
  if (type === "entry") return <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Vào" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  if (type === "exit") return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Ra" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  return <Chip size="small" label={type || "?"} sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
}

function StatusChip({ status }: { status?: string }) {
  if (status === "success" || status === "granted") return <Chip size="small" color="success" label="Thành công" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  if (status === "no_match") return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Không khớp" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  if (status === "expired") return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Hết hạn" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  if (status === "spoof") return <Chip size="small" color="error" label="Giả mạo" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  if (status === "wrong_direction") return <Chip size="small" color="warning" label="Sai chiều" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  if (status === "already_granted") return <Chip size="small" color="info" label="Đã ghi nhận" variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
  return <Chip size="small" color="error" label={status === "denied" ? "Từ chối" : "Thất bại"} variant="outlined" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5 }} />;
}

export default function StatsPage() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<StatsResponse | null>(null);
  const [todayLogs, setTodayLogs] = useState<AccessLogPublic[]>([]);
  const [activePatrons, setActivePatrons] = useState<ActivePatron[]>([]);
  const [activeBorrows, setActiveBorrows] = useState<BorrowRecord[]>([]);
  const [borrowStats, setBorrowStats] = useState<{ total: number; active: number; overdue: number } | null>(null);
  const [cameraStatuses, setCameraStatuses] = useState<CameraStatus[]>([]);
  const [weeklyData, setWeeklyData] = useState<{ thisWeek: number[]; lastWeek: number[] }>({ thisWeek: [], lastWeek: [] });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [realtimeState, setRealtimeState] = useState<RealtimeState>("connecting");

  const refreshActivePatrons = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const active = await api.getActivePatrons();
      setActivePatrons(active.items);
    } catch {
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const today = toDateStr(new Date());
        const now = new Date();
        const thisMonday = new Date(now);
        thisMonday.setDate(now.getDate() - now.getDay() + 1);
        const lastMonday = new Date(thisMonday);
        lastMonday.setDate(thisMonday.getDate() - 7);
        const lastSunday = new Date(lastMonday);
        lastSunday.setDate(lastMonday.getDate() + 6);

        // Fetch all data in a single parallel batch to eliminate sequential waterfall
        const [
          sRes,
          logsRes,
          activeRes,
          bStatsRes,
          allActiveRes,
          camerasRes,
          thisWeekRes,
          lastWeekRes,
        ] = await Promise.allSettled([
          api.getStats(),
          api.getAccessLogs({ dateFrom: today, limit: 100 }),
          api.getActivePatrons(),
          api.getBorrowStats(),
          api.getAllActiveBorrows(),
          api.getCameraStatus(),
          api.getAccessFrequency({ dateFrom: toDateStr(thisMonday), dateTo: today }),
          api.getAccessFrequency({ dateFrom: toDateStr(lastMonday), dateTo: toDateStr(lastSunday) }),
        ]);

        if (sRes.status === "fulfilled") setStats(sRes.value);
        if (logsRes.status === "fulfilled") setTodayLogs(logsRes.value.items.filter(isPhysicalAccessLog));
        if (activeRes.status === "fulfilled") setActivePatrons(activeRes.value.items);
        if (bStatsRes.status === "fulfilled") setBorrowStats(bStatsRes.value);
        if (allActiveRes.status === "fulfilled") setActiveBorrows(allActiveRes.value || []);
        if (camerasRes.status === "fulfilled") setCameraStatuses(camerasRes.value);

        const thisWeekDaily = thisWeekRes.status === "fulfilled" ? thisWeekRes.value.daily || [] : [];
        const lastWeekDaily = lastWeekRes.status === "fulfilled" ? lastWeekRes.value.daily || [] : [];

        const thisWeekTotals = thisWeekDaily.reduce(
          (acc, d) => { acc.push(d.entry + d.exit); return acc; },
          [] as number[]
        );
        const lastWeekTotals = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
          const found = lastWeekDaily[i];
          return found ? found.entry + found.exit : 0;
        });

        setWeeklyData({ thisWeek: thisWeekTotals, lastWeek: lastWeekTotals });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load stats:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setRealtimeState("connecting");
    const cleanup = api.connectAccessSSE(
      (event: CameraEvent) => {
        if (event.status !== "granted") return;
        const log = buildAccessLogFromEvent(event);
        if (!isPhysicalAccessLog(log)) return;
        setTodayLogs((prev) => [log, ...prev].slice(0, 200));
        setStats((prev) => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          today_entries: prev.today_entries + (log.access_type === "entry" ? 1 : 0),
          today_exits: prev.today_exits + (log.access_type === "exit" ? 1 : 0),
        } : prev);
        refreshActivePatrons();
      },
      (connected) => setRealtimeState(connected ? "connected" : "disconnected"),
    );
    return cleanup;
  }, [refreshActivePatrons]);

  const todayLabel = useMemo(() => new Date().toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", {
    weekday: "long",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  }), []);

  const hourlyData = useMemo(() => {
    const buckets = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, hour) => ({ hour, entry: 0, exit: 0, total: 0 }));
    todayLogs.forEach((log) => {
      const hour = new Date(log.access_time).getHours();
      if (log.access_type === "entry") buckets[hour].entry += 1;
      if (log.access_type === "exit") buckets[hour].exit += 1;
      buckets[hour].total += 1;
    });
    return buckets;
  }, [todayLogs]);

  const hasHourlyData = hourlyData.some((item) => item.total > 0);

  const recentBorrows = useMemo(() => [...activeBorrows]
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.borrow_at).getTime() - new Date(a.borrow_at).getTime())
    .slice(0, 12), [activeBorrows]);

  const topPatrons = useMemo(() => {
    const countMap = new Map<string, { name: string; code: string; count: number; lastTime: string }>();
    todayLogs.forEach((log) => {
      if (!log.patron_id) return;
      if (log.access_type !== "entry") return;
      const existing = countMap.get(log.patron_id);
      if (existing) {
        existing.count += 1;
        if (log.access_time > existing.lastTime) existing.lastTime = log.access_time;
      } else {
        countMap.set(log.patron_id, {
          name: log.patron_name || "Không rõ",
          code: log.student_code || log.patron_id,
          count: 1,
          lastTime: log.access_time,
        });
      }
    });
    return Array.from(countMap.values())
      .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
      .slice(0, 5);
  }, [todayLogs]);

  const weeklyAvg = useMemo(() => {
    if (!weeklyData.thisWeek.length) return 0;
    return Math.round(weeklyData.thisWeek.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / weeklyData.thisWeek.length);
  }, [weeklyData]);

  const weeklyDayLabels = ["T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7", "CN"];

  const realtimeColor = realtimeState === "connected" ? "success" : realtimeState === "connecting" ? "warning" : "error";
  const realtimeLabel = realtimeState === "connected" ? "Đang cập nhật" : realtimeState === "connecting" ? "Đang kết nối" : "Mất kết nối";

  const onlineCameras = cameraStatuses.filter((c) => c.connected).length;
  const totalCameras = cameraStatuses.length;

  return (
    <LoadingOverlay loading={loading} message="Đang tải thống kê vận hành...">
      {!stats ? (
        <Alert severity="info">Không có dữ liệu thống kê.</Alert>
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={3}>
          <PageHeader
            title="Thống kê vận hành"
            subtitle={`${todayLabel} — Theo dõi ra/vào, hiện diện và mượn trả`}
            icon={ChartIcon}
            actions={
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <Chip
                  variant="outlined"
                  label={`Tổng độc giả: ${(stats.total_patrons ?? 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}`}
                  sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                />
                <Chip
                  color={realtimeColor as any}
                  icon={<RadioIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                  label={realtimeLabel}
                  sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                />
              </Stack>
            }
          />

          {/* Dãy KPI chuẩn 5 giây */}
          <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(4, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
            {/* Card 1 (Top-Left): Chỉ số cốt lõi nhất - Đang có mặt & Sức chứa */}
            <MuiStatCard
              label="Đang trong thư viện"
              value={activePatrons.length}
              icon={UserIcon}
              gradient={STAT_GRADIENT.entry}
              pct={Math.min(100, Math.round((activePatrons.length / 200) * 100))}
              delta={`${Math.min(100, Math.round((activePatrons.length / 200) * 100))}% sức chứa (${activePatrons.length}/200 chỗ)`}
              deltaColor={activePatrons.length / 200 >= 0.9 ? "error" : activePatrons.length / 200 >= 0.75 ? "warning" : "default"}
              index={0}
            />

            {/* Card 2: Lưu lượng vào hôm nay & Mốc so sánh với lượt ra + TB tuần */}
            <MuiStatCard
              label="Lượt vào hôm nay"
              value={stats.today_entries}
              icon={LoginIcon}
              gradient={STAT_GRADIENT.top}
              pct={(stats.today_entries + stats.today_exits) > 0 ? Math.round((stats.today_entries / (stats.today_entries + stats.today_exits)) * 100) : undefined}
              delta={`Đã ra: ${stats.today_exits} · TB tuần: ${weeklyAvg}/ngày`}
              deltaColor="default"
              index={1}
            />

            {/* Card 3: Sách đang mượn & Cảnh báo quá hạn (Tô màu có mục đích) */}
            <MuiStatCard
              label="Sách đang mượn"
              value={borrowStats?.active ?? "—"}
              icon={BookIcon}
              gradient={borrowStats && borrowStats.overdue > 0 ? STAT_GRADIENT.overdue : "linear-gradient(135deg, #475569 0%, #334155 100%)"}
              pct={borrowStats?.total ? Math.min(100, Math.round((borrowStats.active / borrowStats.total) * 100)) : undefined}
              delta={borrowStats ? (borrowStats.overdue > 0 ? `⚠ ${borrowStats.overdue} cuốn quá hạn cần thu hồi` : "✓ 0 sách quá hạn") : undefined}
              deltaColor={borrowStats && borrowStats.overdue > 0 ? "error" : "success"}
              index={2}
            />

            {/* Card 4: Tổng lượt mượn tích lũy */}
            <MuiStatCard
              label="Tổng lượt mượn"
              value={borrowStats?.total ?? "—"}
              icon={BookIcon}
              gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)"
              pct={100}
              delta={borrowStats ? `Đang lưu thông: ${borrowStats.active} cuốn` : undefined}
              deltaColor="default"
              index={3}
            />
          </Box>

          <DashboardCard title="So sánh tuần" subtitle="Tổng lượt ra/vào theo ngày — Tuần này vs Tuần trước">
            <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", md: "2fr 1fr" }, gap: 0 }}>
              <Box sx={{ height: 220, width: "100%", minWidth: 0, p: 2 }}>
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth={0} minHeight={220}>
                  <BarChart data={weeklyDayLabels.map((day, i) => ({
                    day,
                    thisWeek: weeklyData.thisWeek[i] || 0,
                    lastWeek: weeklyData.lastWeek[i] || 0,
                  }))} margin={{ top: 5, right: 10, left: -18, bottom: 0 }}>
                    <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={theme.palette.divider} vertical={false} />
                    <XAxis dataKey="day" tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }} />
                    <YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }} />
                    <Tooltip
                      contentStyle={{ background: theme.palette.background.paper, border: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`, borderRadius: 8 }}
                      formatter={(value: any, name: any) => [value, name === "thisWeek" ? "Tuần này" : "Tuần trước"]}
                    />
                    <Legend wrapperStyle={{ color: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 12 }} />
                    <Bar dataKey="lastWeek" name="Tuần trước" fill={alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.25)} radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
                    <Bar dataKey="thisWeek" name="Tuần này" fill="#06b6d4" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
                  </BarChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </Box>
              <Box sx={{ p: 2, borderLeft: { md: 1 }, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                <Stack spacing={2}>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                      Trung bình / ngày
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#06b6d4" }}>
                      {weeklyAvg.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                      Hôm nay
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                      {todayLogs.length.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                      {weeklyAvg > 0 ? `${todayLogs.length >= weeklyAvg ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(((todayLogs.length - weeklyAvg) / weeklyAvg) * 100)}% so với TB` : "—"}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                      Tổng tuần này
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                      {weeklyData.thisWeek.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                </Stack>
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </DashboardCard>

          <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", xl: "1.45fr 0.9fr" }, gap: 3 }}>
            <DashboardCard title="Lượt ra/vào theo giờ" subtitle="Tách lượt vào và ra để nhìn cao điểm trong ngày">
              {!hasHourlyData ? (
                <EmptyState
                  icon={<ClockIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
                  title="Chưa có lượt ra/vào hôm nay"
                />
              ) : (
                <Box sx={{ height: 288, width: "100%", minWidth: 0, px: 1 }}>
                  <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth={0} minHeight={288}>
                    <BarChart data={hourlyData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -18, bottom: 0 }}>
                      <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={theme.palette.divider} vertical={false} />
                      <XAxis dataKey="hour" tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }} interval={1} />
                      <YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fill: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 11 }} />
                      <Tooltip
                        contentStyle={{ background: theme.palette.background.paper, border: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`, borderRadius: 8 }}
                        labelFormatter={(label) => `${label}:00 - ${label}:59`}
                        formatter={(value: any, name: any) => [value, name === "entry" ? "Vào" : "Ra"]}
                      />
                      <Legend wrapperStyle={{ color: theme.palette.text.secondary, fontSize: 12 }} />
                      <Bar dataKey="entry" name="Vào" fill="#0A2540" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
                      <Bar dataKey="exit" name="Ra" fill="#D4AF37" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
                    </BarChart>
                  </ResponsiveContainer>
                </Box>
              )}
            </DashboardCard>

            <DashboardCard title="Đang trong thư viện" subtitle={`${activePatrons.length} độc giả đang hiện diện`}>
              {activePatrons.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  icon={<UsersIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
                  title="Không có ai trong thư viện"
                />
              ) : (
                <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ maxHeight: 288, overflowY: "auto" }}>
                  {activePatrons.slice(0, 20).map((p, idx) => (
                    <Paper
                      key={p.id}
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        p: 1.25,
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        transition: "background 0.15s",
                        "&:hover": { bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04) },
                        ...staggerSx(idx),
                      }}
                    >
                      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.25} sx={{ alignItems: "center", minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: STAT_GRADIENT.active, fontWeight: 900, width: 36, height: 36, fontSize: 14, boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}>
                            {p.full_name?.charAt(0) || "?"}
                          </Avatar>
                          <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.85rem" }} noWrap>{p.full_name || "Không rõ tên"}</Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{p.student_code || "---"}</Typography>
                          </Box>
                        </Stack>
                        <Box sx={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
                          <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{formatShortTime(p.entered_at)}</Typography>
                          <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
                            <CameraIcon sx={{ fontSize: 12 }} color="disabled" />
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{formatCameraId(p.camera_id)}</Typography>
                          </Stack>
                        </Box>
                      </Stack>
                    </Paper>
                  ))}
                </Stack>
              )}
            </DashboardCard>
          </Box>

          <DashboardCard title="Trạng thái camera" subtitle={`${onlineCameras}/${totalCameras} camera đang hoạt động`}>
            {cameraStatuses.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<CameraIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
                title="Không có camera nào"
              />
            ) : (
              <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", md: "repeat(3, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
                {cameraStatuses.map((cam, idx) => {
                  const isOnline = cam.connected && cam.running;
                  const hasError = cam.last_error && !isOnline;
                  return (
                    <Paper
                      key={cam.camera_id}
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        borderRadius: 3,
                        overflow: "hidden",
                        borderColor: isOnline ? "success.main" : "error.main",
                        borderWidth: isOnline ? 1 : 2,
                        transition: "transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s",
                        "&:hover": { transform: "translateY(-2px)", boxShadow: 4 },
                        ...staggerSx(idx),
                      }}
                    >
                      <Box sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
                        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", mb: 1.5 }}>
                          <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: isOnline ? "#10b981" : "#ef4444", width: 40, height: 40, boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}>
                            <CameraIcon sx={{ fontSize: 22 }} />
                          </Avatar>
                          <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
                            <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                              {cameraLabel(cam.camera_id)}
                            </Typography>
                            <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                              {isOnline ? (
                                <CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: "success.main" }} />
                              ) : (
                                <ErrorOutlineIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: "error.main" }} />
                              )}
                              <Typography variant="caption" color={isOnline ? "success.main" : "error.main"} sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                                {isOnline ? "Online" : "Offline"}
                              </Typography>
                            </Stack>
                          </Box>
                        </Stack>

                        <Stack spacing={1}>
                          <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Khung hình</Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{cam.frames_processed.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</Typography>
                          </Stack>
                          {cam.last_frame_time ? (
                            <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Khung cuối</Typography>
                              <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{formatShortTime(cam.last_frame_time)}</Typography>
                            </Stack>
                          ) : null}
                          {cam.retry_count > 0 ? (
                            <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Retry</Typography>
                              <Chip size="small" label={cam.retry_count} color="warning" sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: "0.7rem" }} />
                            </Stack>
                          ) : null}
                          {hasError ? (
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="error.main" sx={{ mt: 0.5, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>
                              {cam.last_error}
                            </Typography>
                          ) : null}
                        </Stack>
                      </Box>
                    </Paper>
                  );
                })}
              </Box>
            )}
          </DashboardCard>

          <DashboardCard title="Độc giả tích cực nhất hôm nay" subtitle="Top 5 độc giả lui tới thư viện nhiều nhất">
            {topPatrons.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<EmojiEventsIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
                title="Chưa có dữ liệu hôm nay"
              />
            ) : (
              <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", md: "repeat(5, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
                {topPatrons.map((patron, idx) => (
                  <Paper
                    key={idx}
                    variant="outlined"
                    sx={{
                      p: 2,
                      borderRadius: 3,
                      textAlign: "center",
                      position: "relative",
                      overflow: "hidden",
                      transition: "transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s",
                      "&:hover": { transform: "translateY(-2px)", boxShadow: 4 },
                      borderColor: idx === 0 ? "#f59e0b" : "divider",
                      borderWidth: idx === 0 ? 2 : 1,
                      ...staggerSx(idx),
                    }}
                  >
                    {idx === 0 ? (
                      <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: 3, background: STAT_GRADIENT.top }} />
                    ) : null}
                    <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: STAT_GRADIENT.top, width: 48, height: 48, mx: "auto", mb: 1, boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)", fontSize: idx === 0 ? 20 : 16 }}>
                      {idx === 0 ? "🏆" : `#${idx + 1}`}
                    </Avatar>
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} noWrap>{patron.name}</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{patron.code}</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#f59e0b", mt: 0.5 }}>
                      {patron.count}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">lượt</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", mt: 0.5 }}>
                      {formatShortTime(patron.lastTime)}
                    </Typography>
                  </Paper>
                ))}
              </Box>
            )}
          </DashboardCard>

          <DashboardCard title="Hoạt động hôm nay" subtitle="Các lượt ra/vào mới nhất từ entry_gate, exit_gate và kiosk">
            {todayLogs.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<RadioIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
                title="Chưa có hoạt động hôm nay"
              />
            ) : (
              <TableContainer>
                <Table size="small">
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow sx={{ "& .MuiTableCell-head": { fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: "action.hover", fontSize: "0.78rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, color: "text.secondary" } }}>
                      <TableCell>Thời gian</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Độc giả</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Loại</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Camera</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Độ tin cậy</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Trạng thái</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {todayLogs.slice(0, 30).map((log, idx) => (
                      <TableRow
                        key={log.id}
                        hover
                        sx={{
                          transition: "background 0.15s",
                          "&:hover": { bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04) },
                          "&:last-child td": { border: 0 },
                          animation: `${slideInRight} 0.3s ease-out`,
                          animationDelay: `${idx * 0.03}s`,
                          animationFillMode: "both",
                        }}
                      >
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{formatTime(log.access_time)}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>{log.patron_name || "Không rõ tên"}</Typography>
                          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{log.student_code || log.patron_id || "---"}</Typography>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell><AccessTypeChip type={log.access_type} /></TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{formatCameraId(log.camera_id)}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{formatConfidence(log.confidence)}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell><StatusChip status={log.status} /></TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </DashboardCard>

          {(borrowStats?.overdue ?? 0) > 0 ? (
            <Paper
              variant="outlined"
              sx={{
                p: 2.5,
                borderRadius: 3,
                borderColor: "error.main",
                borderWidth: 2,
                bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.error.main, 0.04),
              }}
            >
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: STAT_GRADIENT.overdue, width: 44, height: 44 }}>
                  <AlertIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24 }} />
                </Avatar>
                <Box>
                  <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "error.main" }}>
                    {borrowStats?.overdue} sách quá hạn cần xử lý
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    Vui lòng liên hệ độc giả để thu hồi sách
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              </Stack>
            </Paper>
          ) : null}

          <DashboardCard
            title="Sách đang mượn"
            subtitle="Các phiếu mượn chưa được trả"
            actions={<Chip size="small" label={borrowStats?.active ?? 0} color="primary" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, height: 24 }} />}
          >
            {recentBorrows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<BookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 40, color: "text.disabled" }} />}
                title="Không có sách đang được mượn"
              />
            ) : (
              <TableContainer>
                <Table size="small">
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow sx={{ "& .MuiTableCell-head": { fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: "action.hover", fontSize: "0.78rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, color: "text.secondary" } }}>
                      <TableCell>Sách</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Độc giả</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Ngày mượn</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Hạn trả</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Trạng thái</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {recentBorrows.map((record, idx) => {
                      const overdue = new Date(record.due_at) < new Date();
                      return (
                        <TableRow
                          key={record.id}
                          hover
                          selected={overdue}
                          sx={{
                            transition: "background 0.15s",
                            "&:hover": { bgcolor: (t) => alpha(t.palette.primary.main, 0.04) },
                            "&:last-child td": { border: 0 },
                            animation: `${slideInRight} 0.3s ease-out`,
                            animationDelay: `${idx * 0.04}s`,
                            animationFillMode: "both",
                          }}
                        >
                          <TableCell>
                            <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>{record.book?.title || record.book_id}</Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{record.book?.isbn || record.book_id}</Typography>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{record.patron_id}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{new Date(record.borrow_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN")}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell sx={{ fontSize: "0.82rem" }}>{new Date(record.due_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN")}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <Chip
                              size="small"
                              color={overdue ? "error" : "success"}
                              label={overdue ? "Quá hạn" : "Đúng hạn"}
                              variant="outlined"
                              sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.72rem", borderRadius: 1.5, animation: `${successPop} 0.35s ease-out` }}
                            />
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            )}
          </DashboardCard>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </LoadingOverlay>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTaskSSE } from "@/lib/hooks/useTaskSSE";

  Alert,

  Paper,

  StepLabel,

  TextField,

  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { StudentCardScanner, type ScannedCardData } from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/scanner";
import MultiAngleCapture, { type CaptureAngle } from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/MultiAngleCapture";

import EmailOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined";
import LockOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";
import BadgeOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/BadgeOutlined";
import PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlineOutlined";
import SchoolOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SchoolOutlined";
import ClassOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ClassOutlined";
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined";
import HomeOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/HomeOutlined";
import AutoStoriesOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AutoStoriesOutlined";
import FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlined";
import ShieldOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ShieldOutlined";
import ArrowBackIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";

const steps = ["Quét thẻ SV", "Xác nhận", "Thông tin tài khoản", "Khuôn mặt AI"];

type RegisterPhase = "scan" | "confirm" | "form" | "face" | "face-enrolling" | "done";

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<RegisterPhase>("scan");
  const [activeStep, setActiveStep] = useState(0);
  const [scannedData, setScannedData] = useState<ScannedCardData | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [registering, setRegistering] = useState(false);

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState("");
  const [studentCode, setStudentCode] = useState("");
  const [className, setClassName] = useState("");
  const [course, setCourse] = useState("");
  const [permanentAddress, setPermanentAddress] = useState("");
  const [dateOfBirth, setDateOfBirth] = useState("");
  const [faculty, setFaculty] = useState("");

  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false);
  const [faceResult, setFaceResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [faceLoading, setFaceLoading] = useState(false);
  const [faceError, setFaceError] = useState("");
  const { state: sseState, start: startSSE, reset: resetSSE } = useTaskSSE();

  const [registrationTokens, setRegistrationTokens] = useState<{
    access_token: string;
    refresh_token?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sseState.status === "SUCCESS") {
      if ((sseState.result as any)?.status === "error") {
        setFaceError((sseState.result as any)?.error || "Đăng ký khuôn mặt thất bại");
      }
      setFaceResult(sseState.result);
      setFaceLoading(false);
      setPhase("done");
    } else if (
      sseState.status === "FAILURE" ||
      sseState.status === "ERROR" ||
      sseState.status === "TIMEOUT"
    ) {
      setFaceError(sseState.error || "Không thể lấy trạng thái tác vụ");
      setFaceResult(sseState.result);
      setFaceLoading(false);
      setPhase("done");
    }
  }, [sseState, resetSSE]);

  useEffect(() => () => resetSSE(), [resetSSE]);

  const handleScanned = async (data: ScannedCardData) => {
    setError("");
    if (!data.studentCode) return;
    try {
      const existing = await api.lookupPatron(data.studentCode);
      if (existing.exists) {
        setError(
          "MSSV này đã được đăng ký trong hệ thống. Vui lòng đăng nhập hoặc liên hệ thư viện để được hỗ trợ."
        );
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Không thể kiểm tra thông tin MSSV. Vui lòng thử lại.");
      return;
    }
    setScannedData(data);
    setFullName(data.fullName || "");
    setStudentCode(data.studentCode || "");
    setClassName(data.className || "");
    setCourse(data.course || "");
    setPermanentAddress(data.permanentAddress || "");
    setDateOfBirth(data.dateOfBirth || "");
    setFaculty(data.faculty || "");
    setActiveStep(1);
    setPhase("confirm");
  };

  const handleConfirmNext = () => {
    setActiveStep(2);
    setPhase("form");
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = async () => {
    if (!email || !password || !fullName || !studentCode) {
      setError("Vui lòng điền đầy đủ Email, Mật khẩu, Họ tên và MSSV");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setRegistering(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.patronRegister({
        full_name: fullName,
        student_code: studentCode,
        email,
        password,
        class_name: className || undefined,
        course: course || undefined,
        permanent_address: permanentAddress || undefined,
        date_of_birth: dateOfBirth || undefined,
        faculty: faculty || undefined,
      });
      setRegistrationTokens({ access_token: res.access_token, refresh_token: res.refresh_token });
      setRegistering(false);
      setActiveStep(3);
      setPhase("face");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setRegistering(false);
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Đăng ký thất bại");
    }
  };

  const handleFilesReady = async (files: Record<CaptureAngle, File>) => {
    setFaceError("");
    setFaceLoading(true);
    setFaceResult(null);
    try {
      const token = registrationTokens?.access_token;
      const data = await api.enrollBatch(files, consent, token);
      setPhase("face-enrolling");
      startSSE(data.job_id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFaceError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Đăng ký khuôn mặt thất bại");
      setFaceLoading(false);
      setPhase("face");
    }
  };

  const handleSkipFace = () => {
    setPhase("done");
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setPhase("scan");
    setActiveStep(0);
    setScannedData(null);
    setError("");
    setFaceResult(null);
    setFaceError("");
    setConsent(false);
    setRegistrationTokens(null);
    setEmail("");
    setPassword("");
    setFullName("");
    setStudentCode("");
    setClassName("");
    setCourse("");
    setPermanentAddress("");
    setDateOfBirth("");
    setFaculty("");
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        display: "flex",
        bgcolor: "background.default",
      }}
    >
      {/* ── Left Hero Panel (matching IUH Brand Identity) ── */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          display: { xs: "none", md: "flex" },
          flexDirection: "column",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          flex: "0 0 440px",
          background: "linear-gradient(155deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 40%, #700000 100%)",
          p: { md: 5, lg: 6 },
          color: "#fff",
          position: "relative",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        {/* Decorative geometric background elements */}
        <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, overflow: "hidden", pointerEvents: "none" }}>
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: "absolute",
              top: -80,
              right: -80,
              width: 320,
              height: 320,
              borderRadius: "50%",
              border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
            }}
          />
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: "absolute",
              bottom: 80,
              left: -60,
              width: 280,
              height: 280,
              borderRadius: "50%",
              border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)",
            }}
          />
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: "absolute",
              bottom: -30,
              right: 80,
              width: 180,
              height: 180,
              borderRadius: "50%",
              bgcolor: "rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.12)",
            }}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* Brand Top Header */}
        <Box sx={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
          <Box
            component="img"
            src="/logo-white.png"
            alt="IUH Logo"
            sx={{ height: 44, width: "auto", objectFit: "contain" }}
          />
        </Box>

        {/* Center Content */}
        <Box sx={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }}>
          <Typography
            variant="h3"
            sx={{
              fontWeight: 800,
              lineHeight: 1.2,
              mb: 2,
              fontFamily: "Space Grotesk, sans-serif",
              fontSize: { md: "2rem", lg: "2.4rem" },
            }}
          >
            Đăng ký thẻ<br />
            <Box component="span" sx={{ color: "#FCD34D" }}>
              Thư Viện Thông Minh
            </Box>
          </Typography>
          <Typography sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)", fontSize: "0.95rem", lineHeight: 1.6, mb: 4 }}>
            Đăng ký tài khoản độc giả để mượn sách, tra cứu tài liệu và trải nghiệm công nghệ nhận diện khuôn mặt AI tại Thư viện IUH.
          </Typography>

          <Stack spacing={2}>
            {[
              { icon: <AutoStoriesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, text: "Mượn sách tự động qua quầy Self-Check" },
              { icon: <FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, text: "Ra vào cổng thư viện bằng nhận diện khuôn mặt" },
              { icon: <ShieldOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />, text: "Bảo mật sinh trắc học và quản trị mượn trả tức thì" },

          </Typography>
        </Box>

      {/* ── Right Form Panel ── */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          flex: 1,

          elevation={0}

          }}
        >
          <CardContent sx={{ p: { xs: 3, sm: 4.5 } }}>
            <Stack spacing={3}>

                spacing={0.5}
                sx={{

                <Box
                  component="img"
                  src={theme.palette.mode === "dark" ? "/logo-white.png" : "/logo.png"}

                    height: 38,
                    width: "auto",

                    mb: 1,

                </Typography>

                </Typography>
              </Stack>

              {/* Modern Stepper */}
              {phase !== "done" && (
                <Stepper
                  activeStep={activeStep}
                  alternativeLabel
                  sx={{
                    "& .MuiStepIcon-root.Mui-active": {
                      color: "primary.main",
