              {/* ── STEP 1: Scan Student Card ── */}
              {phase === "scan" && (
                <StudentCardScanner
                  onScanned={handleScanned}
                  onError={(msg) => setError(msg)}
                />
              )}

              {/* ── STEP 2: Confirm Information ── */}
              {phase === "confirm" && scannedData && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                  <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    Thông tin trích xuất từ thẻ sinh viên:
                  </Typography>
                  <Paper
                    variant="outlined"
                    sx={{
                      p: 2.5,
                      bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.primary.main, 0.02),
                      borderRadius: 2.5,
                    }}
                  >
                    <Stack spacing={1.2}>
                      <ConfirmRow label="MSSV" value={scannedData.studentCode} />
                      <ConfirmRow label="Họ tên" value={scannedData.fullName} />
                      {scannedData.className && <ConfirmRow label="Lớp" value={scannedData.className} />}
                      {scannedData.dateOfBirth && <ConfirmRow label="Ngày sinh" value={scannedData.dateOfBirth} />}
                      {scannedData.course && <ConfirmRow label="Khóa học" value={scannedData.course} />}
                      {scannedData.permanentAddress && <ConfirmRow label="HKTT" value={scannedData.permanentAddress} />}
                      {scannedData.faculty && <ConfirmRow label="Khoa" value={scannedData.faculty} />}
                    </Stack>
                  </Paper>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                    * Bạn có thể điều chỉnh và bổ sung thông tin chi tiết ở bước tiếp theo.
                  </Typography>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      onClick={handleConfirmNext}
                      fullWidth
                      size="large"
                      sx={{
                        py: 1.3,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        borderRadius: 2.5,
                        boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
                      }}
                    >
                      Xác nhận & Tiếp tục
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setPhase("scan");
                        setActiveStep(0);
                      }}
                      sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5, minWidth: 120 }}
                    >
                      Quét lại
                    </Button>
                  </Stack>
                </Stack>
              )}

              {/* ── STEP 3: Complete Account Form ── */}
              {phase === "form" && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                  <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "text.primary" }}>
                    1. Thông tin đăng nhập
                  </Typography>
                  <TextField
                    label="Email nhận thông báo"
                    type="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    slotProps={{
                      input: {
                        startAdornment: (
                          <InputAdornment position="start">
                            <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                          </InputAdornment>
                        ),
                        sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                      },
                    }}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Mật khẩu"
                    type="password"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    slotProps={{
                      input: {
                        startAdornment: (
                          <InputAdornment position="start">
                            <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                          </InputAdornment>
                        ),
                        sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                      },
                    }}
                  />

                  <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "text.primary", mt: 1 }}>
                    2. Thông tin sinh viên
                  </Typography>
                  <TextField
                    label="Họ và tên"
                    value={fullName}
                    onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    slotProps={{
                      input: {
                        startAdornment: (
                          <InputAdornment position="start">
                            <PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                          </InputAdornment>
                        ),
                        sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                      },
                    }}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Mã số sinh viên (MSSV)"
                    value={studentCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setStudentCode(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    slotProps={{
                      input: {
                        startAdornment: (
                          <InputAdornment position="start">
                            <BadgeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                          </InputAdornment>
                        ),
                        sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                      },
                    }}
                  />

                  <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={2}>
                    <TextField
                      label="Lớp học"
                      value={className}
                      onChange={(e) => setClassName(e.target.value)}
                      fullWidth
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          startAdornment: (
                            <InputAdornment position="start">
                              <ClassOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                            </InputAdornment>
                          ),
                          sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                    <TextField
                      label="Ngày sinh"
                      value={dateOfBirth}
                      onChange={(e) => setDateOfBirth(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="DD/MM/YYYY"
                      fullWidth
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          startAdornment: (
                            <InputAdornment position="start">
                              <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                            </InputAdornment>
                          ),
                          sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                  </Stack>

                  <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={2}>
                    <TextField
                      label="Khoa / Viện"
                      value={faculty}
                      onChange={(e) => setFaculty(e.target.value)}
                      fullWidth
                      slotProps={{
                        input: {
                          startAdornment: (
                            <InputAdornment position="start">
                              <SchoolOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                            </InputAdornment>
                          ),
                          sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                    <TextField
                      label="Khóa học"
                      value={course}
                      onChange={(e) => setCourse(e.target.value)}
                      fullWidth
                      slotProps={{
                        input: { sx: { borderRadius: 2 } },
                      }}
                    />
                  </Stack>

                  <TextField
                    label="Hộ khẩu thường trú (HKTT)"
                    value={permanentAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => setPermanentAddress(e.target.value)}
                    fullWidth
                    multiline
                    rows={2}
                    slotProps={{
                      input: {
                        startAdornment: (
                          <InputAdornment position="start" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                            <HomeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: "text.secondary" }} />
                          </InputAdornment>
                        ),
                        sx: { borderRadius: 2 },
                      },
                    }}
                  />

                  {scannedData && (
                    <Alert severity="info" sx={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", borderRadius: 2 }}>
                      Thông tin đã được tự động đối khớp từ thẻ sinh viên IUH.
                    </Alert>
                  )}

                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      onClick={handleFormSubmit}
                      disabled={registering}
                      fullWidth
                      size="large"
                      sx={{
                        py: 1.35,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        borderRadius: 2.5,
                        boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
                      }}
                    >
                      {registering ? <CircularProgress size={22} color="inherit" /> : "Hoàn tất đăng ký"}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setPhase("scan");
                        setActiveStep(0);
                      }}
                      sx={{ borderRadius: 2.5, minWidth: 120 }}
                    >
                      Quay lại
                    </Button>
                  </Stack>
                </Stack>
              )}

              {/* ── STEP 4: Face Enrollment (Optional) ── */}
              {phase === "face" && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5 }}>
                      Đăng ký khuôn mặt AI (Tùy chọn)
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                      Đăng ký dữ liệu khuôn mặt đa góc giúp bạn ra vào cổng thư viện và mượn sách không cần thẻ.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <MultiAngleCapture
                    consent={consent}
                    setConsent={setConsent}
                    onFilesReady={handleFilesReady}
                  />
                  <Button
                    color="inherit"
                    variant="text"
                    onClick={handleSkipFace}
                    fullWidth
                    sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontWeight: 600 }}
                  >
                    Bỏ qua bước này và hoàn tất
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              )}

              {/* ── STEP 4.1: Face Processing Progress ── */}
              {phase === "face-enrolling" && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", py: 5 }}>
                  <CircularProgress size={52} thickness={4} />
                  <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    Đang xử lý vector sinh trắc học khuôn mặt...
                  </Typography>
                  <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                    Vui lòng không đóng trình duyệt
                  </Typography>
                </Stack>
              )}

              {/* ── STEP 5: Registration Complete ── */}
              {phase === "done" && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", py: 3 }}>
                  {faceLoading ? (
                    <>
                      <CircularProgress size={52} thickness={4} />
                      <Typography variant="body2">Đang đồng bộ dữ liệu...</Typography>
                    </>
                  ) : faceError ? (
                    <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: 2 }}>
                      {faceError}
                    </Alert>
                  ) : faceResult ? (
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        width: 76,
                        height: 76,
                        borderRadius: "50%",
                        bgcolor: "success.light",
                        display: "grid",
                        placeItems: "center",
                      }}
                    >
                      <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 44, color: "success.main" }} />
                    </Box>
                  ) : (
                    <Alert severity="info" sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: 2 }}>
                      Bạn có thể đăng ký khuôn mặt sau trong phần quản lý tài khoản độc giả.
                    </Alert>
                  )}

                  <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 0.5, fontFamily: "Space Grotesk, sans-serif" }}>
                      Đăng ký tài khoản thành công!
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ maxWidth: 360, mx: "auto" }}>
                      Thẻ độc giả thư viện IUH của bạn đã sẵn sàng. Vui lòng đăng nhập để bắt đầu sử dụng.
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>

                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    onClick={() => router.push("/login")}
                    fullWidth
                    size="large"
                    sx={{
                      py: 1.35,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      borderRadius: 2.5,
                      boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.25)",
                    }}
                  >
                    Đăng nhập ngay
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="text"
                    onClick={handleReset}
                    fullWidth
                    sx={{ color: "text.secondary", fontWeight: 600 }}
                  >
                    Đăng ký tài khoản khác
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              )}
            </Stack>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Footer Login Link */}
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 3, textAlign: "center" }}>
          Đã có tài khoản thư viện?{" "}
          <Link
            href="/login"
            style={{
              color: theme.palette.primary.main,
              fontWeight: 700,
              textDecoration: "none",
            }}
          >
            Đăng nhập ngay
          </Link>
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

function ConfirmRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | null }) {
  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ minWidth: 95, flexShrink: 0, fontWeight: 500 }}>
        {label}:
      </Typography>
      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "text.primary" }}>
        {value || "—"}
      </Typography>
    </Stack>
  );
}

function NavSection({
  title,
  items,
  onClose,
}: {
  title: string;
  items: Array<{ href: string; label: string; icon: any }>;
  onClose?: () => void;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <Box>
      {/* Section label */}
      <Typography
        variant="overline"
        sx={{
          px: 1.5,
          fontSize: "0.68rem",
          fontWeight: 700,
          letterSpacing: "0.09em",
          color: "#D4AF37", // IUH Gold
          fontFamily: "'Space Grotesk', sans-serif",
          display: "block",
          mb: 0.5,
        }}
      >
        {title}
      </Typography>
      <List dense disablePadding>
        {items.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          const selected =
            item.href === "/dashboard"
              ? pathname === item.href
              : pathname.startsWith(item.href);

          return (
            <ListItemButton
              key={item.href}
              component={Link}
              href={item.href}
              selected={selected}
              onClick={onClose}
              sx={{
                mb: 0.25,
                borderRadius: "2px",
                py: 0.8,
                px: 1.25,
                color: selected ? "#FFFFFF" : "#CBD5E1",
                transition: "all 0.15s ease",
                "&.Mui-selected": {
                  bgcolor: "rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.16)",
                  color: "#FFFFFF",
                  "& .MuiListItemIcon-root": { color: "#D4AF37" },
                  "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.22)" },
                  // Left accent bar
                  "&::before": {
                    content: '""',
                    position: "absolute",
                    left: 0,
                    top: "15%",
                    bottom: "15%",
                    width: 3,
                    borderRadius: "0 2px 2px 0",
                    bgcolor: "#D4AF37", // IUH Gold
                  },
                },
                "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)", color: "#FFFFFF", "& .MuiListItemIcon-root": { color: "#FFFFFF" } },
                position: "relative",
              }}
            >
              <ListItemIcon
                sx={{ minWidth: 34, color: selected ? "#D4AF37" : "#94A3B8" }}
              >
                <Icon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
              </ListItemIcon>
              <ListItemText
                primary={
                  <Typography
                    variant="body2"
                    sx={{ fontWeight: selected ? 700 : 500, fontSize: "0.875rem" }}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </Typography>
                }
              />
              {selected && (
                <ChevronRightIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: "#D4AF37", opacity: 0.8 }} />
              )}
            </ListItemButton>
          );
        })}
      </List>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function Sidebar() {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const theme = useTheme();
  const router = useRouter();
  const role = user?.role || "staff";
  const isAdminOrStaff = role === "admin" || role === "staff";
  const isAdmin = role === "admin";

  const isMobile = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down("md"));
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleClose = () => setMobileOpen(false);

  const isDark = theme.palette.mode === "dark";

  const { canAccessPage } = usePermission();

  const visibleLibraryItems = libraryItems.filter((item) => canAccessPage(item.href));
  const visibleCirculationItems = circulationItems.filter((item) => canAccessPage(item.href));
  const visibleStaffItems = staffItems.filter((item) => canAccessPage(item.href));
  const visibleStaffAiItems = staffAiItems.filter((item) => canAccessPage(item.href));
  const visibleAiItems = aiItems.filter((item) => canAccessPage(item.href));
  const visibleAdminItems = adminItems.filter((item) => {
    if (item.href.startsWith("/dashboard/admin")) {
      return isAdmin;
    }
    return canAccessPage(item.href);
  });

  const drawerContent = (

      {/* ── Logo / Brand ─────────────────────────────────── */}

        {visibleAiItems.length > 0 && (

            "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
          }}
          onClick={() => router.push("/profile")}
        >
          <AvatarUser user={user} size={34} />
          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Typography
              variant="body2"
              sx={{
                fontWeight: 700,

              }}
            >
              {user?.full_name || user?.email?.split("@")[0] || "Thủ thư"}
            </Typography>
            <Chip
              label={role === "admin" ? "QUẢN TRỊ VIÊN" : "THỦ THƯ TRỰC"}
              size="small"
              sx={{
                height: 18,
                fontSize: "0.62rem",
                fontWeight: 700,
                bgcolor: role === "admin" ? "#8B0000" : "rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2)",
                color: role === "admin" ? "#FFFFFF" : "#D4AF37",
                border: "1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4)",
                borderRadius: "2px",
                "& .MuiChip-label": { px: 0.75 },
              }}
            />
          </Box>
          <Tooltip title="Đăng xuất">
            <IconButton
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); logout(); }}
              size="small"
              color="error"
              sx={{ opacity: 0.7, "&:hover": { opacity: 1 } }}
            >
              <LogoutIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  );

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <>
        <IconButton
          onClick={() => setMobileOpen(true)}
          sx={{
            position: "fixed",
            top: 12,
            left: 12,
            zIndex: 1400,
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
            boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(30,96,145,0.12)",
            border: "1px solid",
            borderColor: "divider",
          }}
        >
          <MenuIcon />
        </IconButton>
        <Drawer
          variant="temporary"
          open={mobileOpen}
          onClose={handleClose}
          ModalProps={{ keepMounted: true }}
          sx={{
            "& .MuiDrawer-paper": {
              boxSizing: "border-box",
              width: drawerWidth,
              bgcolor: "#0A2540",
              color: "#FFFFFF",
              borderRight: "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)",
            },
          }}
        >
          {drawerContent}
        </Drawer>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Drawer
      variant="permanent"
      sx={{
        width: drawerWidth,
        flexShrink: 0,
        "& .MuiDrawer-paper": {
          width: drawerWidth,
          boxSizing: "border-box",
          bgcolor: "#0A2540",
          color: "#FFFFFF",
          borderRight: "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)",
        },
      }}
    >
      {drawerContent}
    </Drawer>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Grid,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Stack,

  Snackbar,

import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined";
import AssignmentOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AssignmentOutlined";
import DoorFrontOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DoorFrontOutlined";
import ExitToAppOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ExitToAppOutlined";
import LocationOnOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LocationOnOutlined";
import LogoutIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LogoutOutlined";
import MenuBookOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import SearchOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/SearchOutlined";
import TerminalOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/TerminalOutlined";
import UserCheckIcon from "@mui/icons-material/HowToRegOutlined";
import WarningAmberOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberOutlined";
import PeopleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PeopleOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import MuiStatCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/MuiStatCard";

import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import AvatarUser from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/AvatarUser";
import type { ActivePatron, CameraEvent } from "@/lib/types";

const ACTIVE_CAMERA_IDS = new Set(["entry_gate", "exit_gate", "kiosk"]);

const CAMERA_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; icon: React.ElementType }> = {
  entry_gate: { label: "Cổng vào", icon: DoorFrontOutlinedIcon },
  exit_gate: { label: "Cổng ra", icon: ExitToAppOutlinedIcon },
  kiosk: { label: "Kiosk", icon: TerminalOutlinedIcon },
};

function formatTime(value: string) {
  return new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function getDuration(value: string) {
  const diffMs = Date.now() - new Date(value).getTime();
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 60000));
  if (minutes < 1) return { text: "Vừa vào", level: 0 as const };
  if (minutes < 60) return { text: `${minutes} phút`, level: 1 as const };
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const rest = minutes % 60;
  if (hours < 2) return { text: rest ? `${hours} giờ ${rest} phút` : `${hours} giờ`, level: 2 as const };
  return { text: rest ? `${hours} giờ ${rest} phút` : `${hours} giờ`, level: 3 as const };
}

const DURATION_ACCENT: Record<number, string> = {
  0: "#4A8C5C",
  1: "#4A8C5C",
  2: "#C49A3C",
  3: "#B85C4A",
};

function initials(name?: string) {
  const parts = (name || "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return "?";
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  return `${parts[0].charAt(0)}${parts[parts.length - 1].charAt(0)}`.toUpperCase();
}

function normalizeQuery(value: string) {
  return value.trim().toLowerCase();
}

export default function ActivePage() {
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canUpdate = can("borrows", "update");

  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: "success" | "error" }>({
    open: false,
    message: "",
    severity: "success",
  });
  const [patrons, setPatrons] = useState<ActivePatron[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [lastUpdate, setLastUpdate] = useState<Date>(new Date());
  const [exitPatron, setExitPatron] = useState<ActivePatron | null>(null);
  const [exiting, setExiting] = useState(false);
  const [sseConnected, setSseConnected] = useState(false);
  const hasLoadedRef = useRef(false);
  const fallbackRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const data = await api.getActivePatrons();
      const allowed = data.items
        .filter((p) => ACTIVE_CAMERA_IDS.has(p.camera_id))
        .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.entered_at).getTime() - new Date(a.entered_at).getTime());
      setPatrons(allowed);
      setLastUpdate(new Date());
      hasLoadedRef.current = true;
    } catch {
      setError("Không thể tải danh sách độc giả.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleSSEEvent = useCallback((event: CameraEvent) => {
    if (!event.access_type || !event.patron_id) return;
    if (!ACTIVE_CAMERA_IDS.has(event.camera_id)) return;

    if (event.access_type === "entry" && event.status === "granted") {
      setPatrons((prev) => {
        if (prev.some((p) => p.id === event.patron_id)) return prev;
        const newPatron: ActivePatron = {
          id: event.patron_id!,
          full_name: event.full_name || event.student_code || "",
          student_code: event.student_code || "",
          entered_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          camera_id: event.camera_id,
          image_url: null,
          confidence: event.score ?? null,
        };
        return [newPatron, ...prev];
      });
      setLastUpdate(new Date());
    } else if (event.access_type === "exit" && event.status === "granted") {
      setPatrons((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== event.patron_id));
      setLastUpdate(new Date());
    }
  }, []);

  const startFallbackPolling = useCallback(() => {
    if (fallbackRef.current) clearInterval(fallbackRef.current);
    fallbackRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      if (!hasLoadedRef.current) return;
      load();
    }, 60000);
  }, [load]);

  const stopFallbackPolling = useCallback(() => {
    if (fallbackRef.current) {
      clearInterval(fallbackRef.current);
      fallbackRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();

    const cleanup = api.connectAccessSSE(handleSSEEvent, (connected) => {
      setSseConnected(connected);
      if (connected) {
        stopFallbackPolling();
      } else {
        startFallbackPolling();
      }
    });

    startFallbackPolling();

    return () => {
      cleanup();
      stopFallbackPolling();
    };
  }, [handleSSEEvent, load, startFallbackPolling, stopFallbackPolling]);

  const q = normalizeQuery(search);
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!q) return patrons;
    return patrons.filter((p) =>
      p.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.student_code.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [patrons, search]);

  const stalePatrons = useMemo(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    return patrons.filter((p) => {
      const hours = (now - new Date(p.entered_at).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      return hours > 8;
    });
  }, [patrons]);

  // Chỉ số phục vụ nguyên tắc 5 giây
  const LIBRARY_CAPACITY = 200; // Sức chứa tối đa phòng đọc
  const activeCount = patrons.length;
  const occupancyPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((activeCount / LIBRARY_CAPACITY) * 100));

  const avgDurationMinutes = useMemo(() => {
    if (patrons.length === 0) return 0;
    const now = Date.now();
    const totalMinutes = patrons.reduce((acc, p) => {
      const diffMs = now - new Date(p.entered_at).getTime();
      return acc + Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 60000));
    }, 0);
    return Math.round(totalMinutes / patrons.length);
  }, [patrons]);

  const avgDurationText = useMemo(() => {
    if (avgDurationMinutes < 1) return "< 1 phút";
    if (avgDurationMinutes < 60) return `${avgDurationMinutes} phút`;
    const h = Math.floor(avgDurationMinutes / 60);
    const m = avgDurationMinutes % 60;
    return m > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m` : `${h} giờ`;
  }, [avgDurationMinutes]);

  const handleForceExit = async () => {
    if (!exitPatron) return;
    setExiting(true);
    try {
      await api.forceExitPatron(exitPatron.id);
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: `Đã đánh dấu ${exitPatron.full_name || exitPatron.student_code} đã ra`,
        severity: "success",
      });
      setExitPatron(null);
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setToast({
        open: true,
        message: getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi khi đánh dấu ra",
        severity: "error",
      });
    } finally {
      setExiting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Độc giả đang có mặt"
        subtitle="Giám sát phòng đọc thời gian thực qua hệ thống camera AI & cổng kiểm soát"
        icon={PeopleIcon}
        statBadges={`${patrons.length} độc giả đang ở trong thư viện — cập nhật ${lastUpdate.toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN")}`}
        onRefresh={load}
        actions={
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <Box sx={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: error ? "error.main" : sseConnected ? "#6ee7b7" : "#fcd34d", animation: sseConnected ? "pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite" : undefined }} />
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                {error ? "Lỗi" : sseConnected ? "Live" : "Polling"}
              </Typography>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
        }
      />

      {/* Dãy KPI chuẩn 5 giây */}
      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        {/* Card 1: Góc trên bên trái - Chỉ số cốt lõi nhất */}
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
          <MuiStatCard
            label="Đang trong phòng đọc"
            value={activeCount}
            icon={UserCheckIcon}
            gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)"
            pct={occupancyPct}
            delta={`${occupancyPct}% sức chứa (${activeCount}/${LIBRARY_CAPACITY} chỗ)`}
            deltaColor={occupancyPct >= 90 ? "error" : occupancyPct >= 75 ? "warning" : "default"}
            index={0}
          />
        </Grid>

        {/* Card 2: Cảnh báo lưu lại quá 8 giờ (Tô màu có mục đích) */}
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
          <MuiStatCard
            label="Lưu lại quá 8 giờ"
            value={stalePatrons.length}
            icon={WarningAmberOutlinedIcon}
            gradient={stalePatrons.length > 0 ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)" : "linear-gradient(135deg, #475569 0%, #334155 100%)"}
            pct={activeCount > 0 ? Math.round((stalePatrons.length / activeCount) * 100) : 0}
            delta={stalePatrons.length > 0 ? "⚠ Nghi vấn quên check-out, cần xử lý" : "✓ 0 độc giả quá thời gian quy định"}
            deltaColor={stalePatrons.length > 0 ? "error" : "success"}
            index={1}
          />
        </Grid>

        {/* Card 3: Thời gian lưu lại trung bình */}
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 4 }}>
          <MuiStatCard
            label="Thời gian lưu lại TB"
            value={avgDurationText}
            icon={AccessTimeOutlinedIcon}
            gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B89628 100%)"
            delta={activeCount > 0 ? `Tính trên ${activeCount} độc giả hiện diện` : "Chưa có lượt vào"}
            deltaColor="default"
            index={2}
          />
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {stalePatrons.length > 0 ? (
        <Alert severity="warning" sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
          <Typography variant="subtitle2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
            {stalePatrons.length} độc giả ở trong thư viện quá 8 giờ
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2">
            Có thể gate không detect exit. Kiểm tra và sử dụng nút &ldquo;Đánh dấu đã ra&rdquo; nếu cần.
          </Typography>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <DashboardCard
        title="Độc giả"
        subtitle={`${filtered.length} kết quả`}
        actions={
          <TextField
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Tìm theo tên hoặc MSSV..."
            size="small"

            slotProps={{
              input: {
                startAdornment: (
                  <InputAdornment position="start">
                    <SearchOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                  </InputAdornment>

              title="Thư viện đang yên tĩnh"

          {toast.message}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </Stack>
  );
}

export default function IdentifyPage() {

  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false);

  const [matches, setMatches] = useState<any[] | null>(null);
  const [connected, setConnected] = useState(false);
  const [lowLightWarning, setLowLightWarning] = useState(false);
  const [processingStats, setProcessingStats] = useState<{
    originalSize: number;
    processedSize: number;
    reduction: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const cleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {

      if (event.status === "SUCCESS" && event.result) {
        const resultMatches = event.result.matches;
        setMatches(Array.isArray(resultMatches) ? resultMatches : []);
        setIsLoading(false);
      } else if (event.status === "FAILURE") {
        setError((event.result?.error as string) || "Nhận diện thất bại.");
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    },
      (connected) => setConnected(connected),
    );
    cleanupRef.current = cleanup;
    return () => { cleanup(); cleanupRef.current = null; };
  }, []);

  const handleCapture = (file: File, url: string) => {
    setImageFile(file);
    setDataUrl(url);
    setMatches(null);
    setLowLightWarning(false);
    setProcessingStats(null);
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (file: File) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      const url = e.target?.result as string;
      setImageFile(file);
      setDataUrl(url);
      setMatches(null);
      setLowLightWarning(false);
      setProcessingStats(null);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!imageFile) return;
    setError("");
    setIsLoading(true);
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setMatches(null);
    setLowLightWarning(false);
    setProcessingStats(null);
    
    try {
      const preprocessed = await preprocessImage(imageFile, {
        maxWidth: 640,
        maxHeight: 480,
        quality: 0.85,
        convertToGrayscale: false,
        brightnessThreshold: 50,
      });

      setProcessingStats({
        originalSize: preprocessed.originalSize,
        processedSize: preprocessed.processedSize,
        reduction: getImageSizeReduction(preprocessed.originalSize, preprocessed.processedSize),
      });

      if (isImageTooDark(preprocessed.brightness, 50)) {
        setLowLightWarning(true);
        setIsLoading(false);
        setIsProcessing(false);
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      const base64 = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
        reader.onload = () => {
          const result = reader.result as string;
          const base64Data = result.split(',')[1];
          resolve(base64Data);
        };
        reader.onerror = reject;
        reader.readAsDataURL(preprocessed.blob);
      });

      setIsProcessing(false);

      const result = await api.processFaceImageSync({
        image: base64,
        camera_id: "identify_dashboard",
        process_type: "identify",
        consent_given: consent,
      });

      if (result.status === "success" && result.result?.matches) {
        setMatches(Array.isArray(result.result.matches) ? result.result.matches : []);
      } else if (result.result?.error) {
        setError(result.result.error as string);
      } else {
        setError("Nhận diện thất bại.");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Nhận diện thất bại.");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setMatches(null);
    setDataUrl("");
    setImageFile(null);
    setError("");
    setIsLoading(false);
    setIsProcessing(false);
    setLowLightWarning(false);
    setProcessingStats(null);
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3} sx={{ maxWidth: 1040, mx: "auto" }}>
      <Box sx={staggerSx(0)}>
        <PageHeader
          title="Nhận diện khuôn mặt"
          subtitle="Tìm người dùng gần nhất trong kho khuôn mặt đã đăng ký."
          icon={FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon}
        />
      </Box>

      {error ? (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <Alert severity={getAlertSeverity(error)}>{error}</Alert>
        </Box>
      ) : null}

      {lowLightWarning ? (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <Alert 
            severity="warning" 
            action={
              <Button color="inherit" size="small" onClick={reset}>
                Thử lại
              </Button>
            }
          >
            Ánh sáng yếu! Vui lòng di chuyển đến nơi có ánh sáng tốt hơn hoặc bật đèn.
          </Alert>
        </Box>
      ) : null}

      {isLoading ? (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <CircularProgress size={24} sx={{ color: "primary.main" }} />
              <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
                  {isProcessing ? "Đang tiền xử lý ảnh..." : "Đang nhận diện..."}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  {connected ? "Kết nối SSE đang chờ kết quả" : "Đang kết nối..."}
                </Typography>
                <LinearProgress sx={{ mt: 1, height: 6, borderRadius: 3 }} />
              </Box>
            </Stack>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>
      ) : matches ? (
        <Stack spacing={2} sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard
            title={`Tìm thấy ${matches.length} kết quả`}
            subtitle="Kết quả được sắp xếp theo độ tin cậy giảm dần."
            actions={<Button startIcon={<RestartAltOutlinedIcon />} variant="outlined" onClick={reset}>Thử lại</Button>}
          />

          {dataUrl ? (
            <DashboardCard noPadding>
              <Box component="img" src={dataUrl} alt="Ảnh đã chụp" sx={{ width: 160, height: 160, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 2, border: 1, borderColor: "divider", mx: "auto" }} />
            </DashboardCard>
          ) : null}

          {processingStats ? (
            <DashboardCard>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Ảnh đã xử lý: {processingStats.originalSize} → {processingStats.processedSize} 
                (giảm {processingStats.reduction}%)
              </Typography>
            </DashboardCard>
          ) : null}

          {matches.length === 0 ? (
            <DashboardCard>
              <EmptyState
                icon={<FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon />}
                title="Không tìm thấy khuôn mặt phù hợp"
                description="Không có kết quả nào khớp với khuôn mặt đã cung cấp."
              />
            </DashboardCard>
          ) : (
            <DashboardCard noPadding>
      <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
      <Table sx={{ minWidth: 820 }}>
                  <TableHead>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell>Độ tin cậy</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>User ID</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Tên</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Email</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>Vai trò</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableBody>
                    {matches.map((match, index) => {
                      const score = Number(match.score ?? 0);
                      const percent = Number((score * 100).toFixed(1));
                      return (
                        <TableRow key={`${match.user_id}-${index}`} hover>
                          <TableCell sx={{ minWidth: 180 }}>
                            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                              <LinearProgress
                                variant="determinate"
                                value={Math.min(percent, 100)}
                                color={score > 0.6 ? "success" : score > 0.3 ? "warning" : "error"}
                                sx={{ width: 90, height: 6, borderRadius: 3 }}
                              />
                              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{percent}%</Typography>
                            </Stack>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: "text.secondary" }}>{match.user_id}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 750 }}>{match.full_name || "-"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }}>{match.email || "-"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell><Chip size="small" label={match.role || "-"} /></TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </TableContainer>
            </DashboardCard>
          )}
        </Stack>
      ) : (
        <Box sx={staggerSx(1)}>
          <DashboardCard>
            <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                <CameraCapture onCapture={handleCapture} onFileUpload={handleFileUpload} />
       <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: { xs: "flex-start", sm: "center" } }}>
         <Checkbox checked={consent} onChange={(event) => setConsent(event.target.checked)} />
         <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: "text.secondary", lineHeight: 1.5, mt: { xs: -0.5, sm: 0 } }}>
           Tôi đồng ý cho hệ thống xử lý dữ liệu khuôn mặt để nhận diện.
         </Typography>
       </Stack>
                <Button type="submit" variant="contained" disabled={!imageFile || !consent || isLoading} fullWidth>
                  {isLoading ? "Đang gửi..." : "Nhận diện khuôn mặt"}
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </Box>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import api, {
  setStoredAccessToken,
  clearStoredAuth,
  getStoredRefreshToken,
  getCookieValue,
  decodeJwtPayload,
  isTokenExpiringSoon,
  getApiAccessToken,
} from "./api-client";
import type { AuthContextType, AuthUser, LoginRequest } from "./types";

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

function assertWebRole(role: string) {
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "staff") {
    throw new Error("Web quản trị chỉ dành cho admin hoặc staff. Độc giả vui lòng đăng nhập trên ứng dụng mobile.");
  }
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthUser | null>(null);
  const [accessToken, setAccessToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  const updateUser = useCallback((fields: Partial<AuthUser>) => {
    setUser((prev) => {
      if (!prev) return null;
      const hasChanged = Object.entries(fields).some(
        ([key, val]) => (prev as any)[key] !== val
      );
      if (!hasChanged) return prev;
      const updated = { ...prev, ...fields };
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch {}
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const refreshUser = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const currentUser = await api.getCurrentUser();
      if (currentUser) {
        updateUser({
          full_name: currentUser.full_name,
          avatar_url: currentUser.avatar_url ?? null,
          role: currentUser.role,
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore network errors on background profile refresh
    }
  }, [updateUser]);

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await api.logout();
    } catch { /* ignore */ }

    // Dọn dẹp an toàn bộ nhớ đệm AI Chat khi bàn giao ca trực
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try {
        const keysToRemove: string[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
          const k = localStorage.key(i);
          if (k && (k.startsWith("ai-assistant-session") || k === "ai-widget-storage")) {
            keysToRemove.push(k);
          }
        }
        keysToRemove.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
      } catch {}
    }

    clearStoredAuth();
    setUser(null);
    setAccessToken(null);
    router.push("/login");
  }, [router]);

  const loadUserFromStorage = useCallback(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

    const storedToken =
      getCookieValue("access_token") ||
      localStorage.getItem("access_token") ||
      localStorage.getItem("token") ||
      getApiAccessToken();
    const storedRefreshToken =
      getStoredRefreshToken() ||
      getCookieValue("refresh_token") ||
      localStorage.getItem("refresh_token");
    const storedUser = localStorage.getItem("user");

    if (storedToken) {
      try {
        const payload = decodeJwtPayload(storedToken);
        const exp = payload?.exp as number | undefined;
        const isExpired = exp ? exp * 1000 < Date.now() : false;

        if (isExpired) {
          if (storedRefreshToken) {
            // Silently refresh token using refresh_token
            api
              .refreshAuthToken(storedRefreshToken)
              .then((res) => {
                if (res.access_token) {
                  setAccessToken(res.access_token);
                  setStoredAccessToken(res.access_token, res.refresh_token || storedRefreshToken);
                  if (storedUser) {
                    try {
                      setUser(JSON.parse(storedUser));
                    } catch {}
                  } else {
                    const newPayload = decodeJwtPayload(res.access_token);
                    if (newPayload) {
                      const recovered: AuthUser = {
                        id: (newPayload?.sub as string) || "",
                        email: (newPayload?.email as string) || "",
                        role: ((newPayload?.roles as string[])?.[0]) || "user",
                        full_name: (newPayload?.full_name as string) || null,
                      };
                      localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(recovered));
                      setUser(recovered);
                    }
                  }
                  refreshUser();
                }
              })
              .catch(() => {
                logout();
              })
              .finally(() => {
                setIsLoading(false);
              });
            return;
          } else {
            logout();
            setIsLoading(false);
            return;
          }
        } else {
          setAccessToken(storedToken);
          setStoredAccessToken(storedToken, storedRefreshToken);
          if (storedUser) {
            try {
              setUser(JSON.parse(storedUser));
            } catch {}
          } else {
            const recovered: AuthUser = {
              id: (payload?.sub as string) || "",
              email: (payload?.email as string) || "",
              role: ((payload?.roles as string[])?.[0]) || "user",
              full_name: (payload?.full_name as string) || null,
            };
            localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(recovered));
            setUser(recovered);
          }
          refreshUser();
        }
      } catch {
        logout();
      }
    } else if (storedRefreshToken) {
      api
        .refreshAuthToken(storedRefreshToken)
        .then((res) => {
          if (res.access_token) {
            setAccessToken(res.access_token);
            setStoredAccessToken(res.access_token, res.refresh_token || storedRefreshToken);
            if (storedUser) {
              try {
                setUser(JSON.parse(storedUser));
              } catch {}
            }
            refreshUser();
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          logout();
        })
        .finally(() => {
          setIsLoading(false);
        });
      return;
    } else {
      if (storedUser) {
        try {
          setUser(JSON.parse(storedUser));
        } catch {
          localStorage.removeItem("user");
        }
      }
    }
    setIsLoading(false);
  }, [logout, refreshUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUserFromStorage();
  }, [loadUserFromStorage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (accessToken) {
      refreshUser();
    }
  }, [accessToken, refreshUser]);

  // Silent auto-refresh heartbeat: check every 60 seconds, refresh if expiring in < 3 minutes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!accessToken) return;
    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      const currentToken = getApiAccessToken() || accessToken;
      if (currentToken && isTokenExpiringSoon(currentToken, 3 * 60_000)) {
        try {
          const res = await api.refreshAuthToken();
          if (res.access_token) {
            setAccessToken(res.access_token);
          }
        } catch {
          // ignore background heartbeat error, request interceptor handles retry
        }
      }
    }, 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [accessToken]);

  const login = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const data: LoginRequest = { email, password };
    const response = await api.login(data);
    if (!response.access_token) {
      throw new Error("Backend did not return access_token");
    }

    setStoredAccessToken(response.access_token, response.refresh_token);
    setAccessToken(response.access_token);

    const payload = decodeJwtPayload(response.access_token);
    const userData: AuthUser = {
      id: (payload?.sub as string) || "",
      email,
      role: ((payload?.roles as string[])?.[0]) || "user",
      full_name: (payload?.full_name as string) || null,
    };
    assertWebRole(userData.role);
    localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(userData));
    setUser(userData);

    // Sync avatar_url and details immediately from backend
    try {
      const currentUser = await api.getCurrentUser();
      if (currentUser) {
        const enriched: AuthUser = {
          ...userData,
          full_name: currentUser.full_name || userData.full_name,
          avatar_url: currentUser.avatar_url ?? null,
          role: currentUser.role || userData.role,
        };
        localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(enriched));
        setUser(enriched);
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  const setAuthFromToken = (newAccessToken: string, refreshToken: string | null, email: string, role?: string) => {
    setStoredAccessToken(newAccessToken, refreshToken);
    setAccessToken(newAccessToken);

    const payload = decodeJwtPayload(newAccessToken);
    const userId = (payload?.sub as string) || "";
    const userRole = role || ((payload?.roles as string[])?.[0]) || "user";
    assertWebRole(userRole);

    const userData: AuthUser = { id: userId, email, role: userRole, full_name: (payload?.full_name as string) || null };
    localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(userData));
    setUser(userData);

    refreshUser();
  };

  const refreshAccessToken = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      const res = await api.refreshAuthToken();
      if (res.access_token) {
        setAccessToken(res.access_token);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        accessToken,
        login,
        setAuthFromToken,
        updateUser,
        refreshUser,
        logout,
        refreshAccessToken,
        isAuthenticated: !!user && !!accessToken,
        isLoading,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error("useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

export default function UserDetailPage() {
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: "success" | "error" }>({
    open: false,

    severity: "success",
  });

  const router = useRouter();

      course: user.course || "",
      identity_number: user.identity_number || "",
      permanent_address: user.permanentAddress || user.permanent_address || "",
      card_number: user.card_number || "",
      issue_date: user.issue_date || "",
      membership_expiry: user.membership_expiry || "",
      role: user.role,
      status: user.status || "active",
    });
    setEditError("");
    setShowEdit(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setEditError("");
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const data: Record<string, string> = {};
      if (editForm.full_name) data.full_name = editForm.full_name;
      if (editForm.phone) data.phone = editForm.phone;
      if (editForm.student_code) data.student_code = editForm.student_code;
      if (editForm.class_name) data.class_name = editForm.class_name;
      if (editForm.course) data.course = editForm.course;
      if (editForm.identity_number) data.identity_number = editForm.identity_number;
      if (editForm.permanent_address) data.permanent_address = editForm.permanent_address;
      if (editForm.card_number) data.card_number = editForm.card_number;
      if (editForm.issue_date) data.issue_date = editForm.issue_date;
      if (editForm.membership_expiry) data.membership_expiry = editForm.membership_expiry;
      data.role = editForm.role;
      data.status = editForm.status;

      const updated = await api.updateUser(id, data);
      setUser(updated);
      setShowEdit(false);
      setToast({ open: true, message: "Đã cập nhật thông tin người dùng.", severity: "success" });
      await loadUser();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const status = err?.response?.status;
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err) || "Lưu thất bại";
      setEditError(
        status === 409
          ? `${msg} — Số thẻ hoặc mã sinh viên đã tồn tại.`
          : msg
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!user || deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA") return;
    try {
      await api.deleteUser(user.id);
      setToast({ open: true, message: "Đã xóa người dùng.", severity: "success" });
      router.push("/dashboard/admin");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setToast({ open: true, message: `Xóa thất bại: ${getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi không xác định"}`, severity: "error" });
    }
  };

  const expired = !user ? false : user.membership_expiry != null && new Date(user.membership_expiry) < new Date();
  const isSuspended = user?.status === "suspended";

  const headerActions = user ? (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
      <Button variant="outlined" startIcon={<EditOutlinedIcon />} onClick={openEdit}>
        Sửa
      </Button>
      <Button color="error" variant="outlined" startIcon={<DeleteOutlineOutlinedIcon />} onClick={() => setShowDelete(true)}>
        Xóa
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  ) : null;

  return (
    <LoadingOverlay loading={loading} message="Đang tải hồ sơ người dùng...">
      {!user ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<PersonIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56 }} />}
          title="Không tìm thấy người dùng"
          description="Hồ sơ có thể đã bị xóa hoặc ID không hợp lệ."
          action={
            <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<PersonIcon />} onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard/admin")}>
              Quay lại danh sách
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={3}>
          <PageHeader
            backHref="/dashboard/admin"
            title={user.full_name || "Chưa cập nhật"}
            subtitle={`Email: ${user.email}`}
            icon={AdminPanelSettingsOutlinedIcon}
            actions={headerActions}
          />

          {isSuspended && user.suspended_reason && (
            <Alert severity="error" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
              Lý do khóa: {user.suspended_reason}
            </Alert>
          )}

          <Grid container spacing={3}>
            {/* Left column — Profile card */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }} sx={staggerSx(0)}>
              <DashboardCard noPadding>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    height: 100,
                    background: user.role === "admin"
                      ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B89628 100%)"
                      : user.role === "staff"
                        ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)"
                        : "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
                  }}
                />
                <Box sx={{ px: 2.5, pb: 2.5, mt: -5, textAlign: "center" }}>
                  <AvatarUser
                    user={user}
                    size={80}
                    border="4px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"
                    sx={{ mx: "auto", boxShadow: 2, fontSize: "1.8rem" }}
                  />

                  <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mt: 1.5 }}>{user.full_name || "Chưa cập nhật"}</Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{user.email}</Typography>

                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.75} sx={{ justifyContent: "center", mt: 1.5, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5 }}>
                    <Chip
                      label={roleLabel(user.role)}
                      color={user.role === "admin" ? "warning" : user.role === "staff" ? "primary" : "default"}
                      size="small"
                      sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
                    />
                    <Chip
                      label={statusLabel(user.status || "active")}
                      color={statusColor(user.status || "active")}
                      size="small"
                    />
                    {user.has_face && (
                      <Chip
                        icon={<FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: "16px !important" }} />}
                        label="Face ID"
                        color="success"
                        size="small"
                        variant="outlined"
                      />
                    )}
                  </Stack>

                  <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }} />

                  <Stack spacing={0}>
                    <MetaRow icon={<PhoneIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Điện thoại" value={user.phone} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<SchoolIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Lớp" value={user.class_name} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<SchoolIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Khóa học" value={user.course} />
                    <MetaRow icon={<CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Hạn thẻ" value={
                      <span style={{ color: expired ? "#d32f2f" : undefined, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                        {formatDate(user.membership_expiry)}{expired ? " (Hết hạn)" : ""}
                      </span>
                    } />
                  </Stack>
                </Box>
              </DashboardCard>
            </Grid>

            {/* Right column — Tabs */}
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 8 }} sx={staggerSx(1)}>
              <Stack spacing={3}>
                {/* Stats row */}
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5}>
                  {[
                    { label: "Vai trò", value: roleLabel(user.role), color: user.role === "admin" ? "warning" as const : user.role === "staff" ? "info" as const : "default" as const, icon: <ShieldIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                    { label: "Trạng thái", value: statusLabel(user.status || "active"), color: statusColor(user.status || "active"), icon: <VerifiedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                    { label: "Thẻ", value: user.card_number || "-", color: "success" as const, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                  ].map((item, idx) => (
                    <Paper key={item.label} variant="outlined" sx={{
                      flex: 1,
                      p: 1.5,
                      textAlign: "center",
                      borderColor: `${item.color}.main`,
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      background: item.color === "warning" ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.08)" : item.color === "info" ? "rgba(2,136,209,0.08)" : item.color === "success" ? "rgba(46,125,50,0.08)" : "rgba(100,116,139,0.08)",
                      ...staggerSx(idx),
                    }}>
                      <Box sx={{ color: `${item.color}.main`, mb: 0.5 }}>{item.icon}</Box>
                      <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 900, color: `${item.color}.main`, fontSize: "1rem" }}>{item.value}</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{item.label}</Typography>
                    </Paper>
                  ))}
                </Stack>

                {/* Tabs */}
                <DashboardCard noPadding>
                  <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", px: 2.5 }}>
                    <Tabs value={tab} onChange={(_, v) => setTab(v)}>
                      <Tab label="Thông tin chi tiết" />
                      <Tab label="Hệ thống" />
                    </Tabs>
                  </Box>

                  {/* Tab 0: Info detail */}
                  {tab === 0 && (
                    <Box sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
                      <Grid container spacing={0.5}>
                        {[
                          { label: "Họ tên", value: user.full_name, icon: <PersonIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Email", value: user.email, icon: <MailIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Số điện thoại", value: user.phone, icon: <PhoneIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Địa chỉ thường trú", value: user.permanent_address || user.permanentAddress, icon: <LocationOnIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Số CCCD/CMND", value: user.identity_number, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Mã sinh viên", value: user.student_code, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Lớp", value: user.class_name, icon: <SchoolIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Khóa học", value: user.course, icon: <SchoolIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Số thẻ thư viện", value: user.card_number, icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Ngày cấp thẻ", value: formatDate(user.issue_date), icon: <CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Hạn membership", value: formatDate(user.membership_expiry), icon: <CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Vai trò", value: roleLabel(user.role), icon: <ShieldIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                        ].map((item) => (
                          <Grid key={item.label} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <MetaRow icon={item.icon} label={item.label} value={item.value} />
                          </Grid>
                        ))}
                      </Grid>
                    </Box>
                  )}

                  {/* Tab 1: System */}
                  {tab === 1 && (
                    <Box sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
                      <Grid container spacing={0.5}>
                        {[
                          { label: "ID người dùng", value: user.id, icon: <FingerprintOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Ngày tạo", value: formatDateTime(user.created_at), icon: <CalendarTodayIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Lần vào gần nhất", value: formatDateTime(user.last_entry_at), icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Cổng ghi nhận", value: user.last_entry_camera || "-", icon: <HistoryOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                          { label: "Trạng thái hiện tại", value: user.current_status || "-", icon: <VerifiedIcon fontSize="small" /> },
                        ].map((item) => (
                          <Grid key={item.label} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                            <MetaRow icon={item.icon} label={item.label} value={
                              item.label === "ID người dùng"
                                ? <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>{item.value}</span>
                                : item.value
                            } />
                          </Grid>
                        ))}
                      </Grid>
                    </Box>
                  )}
                </DashboardCard>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          {/* Edit dialog */}
          <Dialog open={showEdit} onClose={() => !saving && setShowEdit(false)} fullWidth maxWidth="sm">
            <DialogTitle>Sửa thông tin người dùng</DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent>
              <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ pt: 1 }}>
                {editError && <Alert severity="error">{editError}</Alert>}

                <TextField label="Họ và tên" value={editForm.full_name} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, full_name: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Email không thể chỉnh sửa từ đây (yêu cầu luồng OTP).</Typography>

                <TextField label="Số điện thoại" value={editForm.phone} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, phone: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Mã sinh viên" value={editForm.student_code} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, student_code: e.target.value })} fullWidth helperText="Phải là duy nhất nếu điền" />
                <TextField label="Lớp" value={editForm.class_name} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, class_name: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Khóa học" value={editForm.course} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, course: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Số CCCD/CMND" value={editForm.identity_number} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, identity_number: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Địa chỉ thường trú" value={editForm.permanent_address} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, permanent_address: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
                <TextField label="Số thẻ thư viện" value={editForm.card_number} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, card_number: e.target.value })} fullWidth helperText="Phải là duy nhất nếu điền" />
                <TextField label="Ngày cấp thẻ" type="date" value={editForm.issue_date} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, issue_date: e.target.value })} fullWidth slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }} />
                <TextField label="Hạn membership" type="date" value={editForm.membership_expiry} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, membership_expiry: e.target.value })} fullWidth slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }} helperText={editForm.membership_expiry && new Date(editForm.membership_expiry) < new Date() ? "Đã hết hạn" : ""} />

                <TextField select label="Vai trò" value={editForm.role} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, role: e.target.value })} fullWidth>
                  {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
                    <MenuItem key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</MenuItem>
                  ))}
                </TextField>

                <TextField select label="Trạng thái" value={editForm.status} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, status: e.target.value })} fullWidth>
                  {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
                    <MenuItem key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</MenuItem>
                  ))}
                </TextField>
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <DialogActions>
              <Button onClick={() => setShowEdit(false)} disabled={saving}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
                {saving ? "Đang lưu..." : "Lưu thay đổi"}
              </Button>
            </DialogActions>
          </Dialog>

          {/* Delete dialog */}
          <Dialog open={showDelete} onClose={() => { setShowDelete(false); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }} fullWidth maxWidth="xs">
            <DialogTitle>Xóa người dùng?</DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent>
              <Stack spacing={2}>
                <Typography color="text.secondary">
                  Hồ sơ <strong>{user.full_name || user.email}</strong> sẽ bị xóa khỏi hệ thống.
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  Nhập <strong>XÓA</strong> để xác nhận:
                </Typography>
                <TextField value={deleteConfirmText} onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirmText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Nhập XÓA" size="small" autoFocus fullWidth />
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <DialogActions>
              <Button onClick={() => { setShowDelete(false); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button color="error" variant="contained" onClick={handleDelete} disabled={deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA"}>Xóa vĩnh viễn</Button>
            </DialogActions>
          </Dialog>

          <Snackbar
            open={toast.open}
            autoHideDuration={4000}
            onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
            anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
          >
            <Alert severity={toast.severity} onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
              {toast.message}
            </Alert>
          </Snackbar>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </LoadingOverlay>
  );
}
