"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Grid,
  IconButton,
  InputAdornment,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Typography,
  Snackbar,
  LinearProgress,
} from "@mui/material";
import EmailIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined";
import PhoneIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined";
import LockIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";
import PersonIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined";
import CameraAltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CameraAltOutlined";
import ShieldIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ShieldOutlined";
import CheckIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Check";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import KeyIcon from "@mui/icons-material/KeyOutlined";
import AtSignIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AlternateEmailOutlined";
import LocationOnIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LocationOnOutlined";
import EditIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";
import MarkEmailReadIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MarkEmailReadOutlined";
import ArrowForwardIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowForward";
import ArrowBackIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack";
import AccessTimeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AccessTime";
import VisibilityIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined";
import VisibilityOffIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOffOutlined";
import CheckCircleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined";
import OtpPinInput from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/OtpPinInput";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { UserPublic } from "@/lib/types";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import AvatarUser from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/AvatarUser";

export default function ProfilePage() {
  const { updateUser } = useAuth();
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info" }>({
    open: false,
    message: "",
    severity: "info",
  });
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserPublic | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    full_name: "",
    phone: "",
    permanent_address: "",
  });

  const [savingProfile, setSavingProfile] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingAvatar, setUploadingAvatar] = useState(false);
  const avatarInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [showPasswordModal, setShowPasswordModal] = useState(false);
  const [showEmailModal, setShowEmailModal] = useState(false);

  const [passData, setPassData] = useState({ old_password: "", new_password: "", confirm_password: "", code: "" });
  const [passStep, setPassStep] = useState<"form" | "otp">("form");
  const [changingPass, setChangingPass] = useState(false);
  const [passResendCooldown, setPassResendCooldown] = useState(0);
  const [showOldPass, setShowOldPass] = useState(false);
  const [showNewPass, setShowNewPass] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPass, setShowConfirmPass] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (passResendCooldown <= 0) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setPassResendCooldown((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [passResendCooldown]);

  const [emailData, setEmailData] = useState({ new_email: "", code: "" });
  const [emailStep, setEmailStep] = useState<"request" | "verify">("request");
  const [emailLoading, setEmailLoading] = useState(false);
  const [resendCooldown, setResendCooldown] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resendCooldown <= 0) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setResendCooldown((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [resendCooldown]);

  const showNotice = (severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info", message: string) => {
    setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
  };

  useEffect(() => { fetchProfile(); }, []);

  const fetchProfile = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await api.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(data);
      if (data.avatar_url) {
        updateUser({ avatar_url: data.avatar_url, full_name: data.full_name });
      }
      setFormData({
        full_name: data.full_name || "",
        phone: (data as any).phone || "",
        permanent_address: (data as any).permanentAddress || (data as any).permanent_address || "",
      });
    } catch {
      showNotice("error", "Không thể tải thông tin cá nhân");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAvatarUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) return showNotice("error", "Vui lòng chọn file ảnh");
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return showNotice("error", "Kích thước ảnh tối đa 5MB");
    try {
      setUploadingAvatar(true);
      const result = await api.uploadAvatar(file);
      setUser((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, avatar_url: result.avatarUrl } : prev);
      updateUser({ avatar_url: result.avatarUrl });
      showNotice("success", "Cập nhật ảnh đại diện thành công!");
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Upload ảnh thất bại");
    } finally {
      setUploadingAvatar(false);
      if (avatarInputRef.current) avatarInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const handleProfileUpdate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      setSavingProfile(true);
      await api.updateProfile(formData);
      showNotice("success", "Cập nhật hồ sơ thành công!");
      fetchProfile();
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Cập nhật thất bại");
    } finally {
      setSavingProfile(false);
    }
  };

  const calculatePasswordStrength = (pwd: string) => {
    let score = 0;
    if (pwd.length >= 8) score += 25;
    if (pwd.length >= 10) score += 15;
    if (/[A-Z]/.test(pwd)) score += 20;
    if (/[a-z]/.test(pwd)) score += 20;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(pwd)) score += 20;
    return Math.min(100, score);
  };

  const getPasswordStrengthLabel = (score: number) => {
    if (score < 40) return { label: "Yếu", color: "error" as const };
    if (score < 80) return { label: "Trung bình", color: "warning" as const };
    return { label: "Mạnh", color: "success" as const };
  };

  const handleRequestPasswordOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!passData.old_password) return showNotice("error", "Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu hiện tại");
    if (!passData.new_password) return showNotice("error", "Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu mới");
    if (passData.new_password !== passData.confirm_password) {
      return showNotice("error", "Mật khẩu xác nhận không trùng khớp");
    }
    if (passData.old_password === passData.new_password) {
      return showNotice("error", "Mật khẩu mới không được trùng với mật khẩu hiện tại");
    }
    if (passData.new_password.length < 8) {
      return showNotice("error", "Mật khẩu mới phải có tối thiểu 8 ký tự");
    }
    if (!/[A-Z]/.test(passData.new_password)) {
      return showNotice("error", "Mật khẩu mới phải có ít nhất 1 chữ cái in hoa (A-Z)");
    }
    if (!/[a-z]/.test(passData.new_password)) {
      return showNotice("error", "Mật khẩu mới phải có ít nhất 1 chữ cái in thường (a-z)");
    }
    if (!/[0-9]/.test(passData.new_password)) {
      return showNotice("error", "Mật khẩu mới phải có ít nhất 1 chữ số (0-9)");
    }

    try {
      setChangingPass(true);
      await api.requestPasswordChangeOtp({
        old_password: passData.old_password,
        new_password: passData.new_password,
      });
      showNotice("success", "Đã gửi mã xác thực OTP về email của bạn");
      setPassResendCooldown(60);
      setPassStep("otp");
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Không thể gửi mã OTP đổi mật khẩu");
    } finally {
      setChangingPass(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResendPasswordOtp = async () => {
    if (passResendCooldown > 0) return;
    try {
      setChangingPass(true);
      await api.requestPasswordChangeOtp({
        old_password: passData.old_password,
        new_password: passData.new_password,
      });
      showNotice("success", "Đã gửi lại mã OTP mới về email của bạn");
      setPassResendCooldown(60);
      setPassData((prev) => ({ ...prev, code: "" }));
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Không thể gửi lại OTP");
    } finally {
      setChangingPass(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmPasswordChange = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!passData.code || passData.code.length !== 6) {
      return showNotice("error", "Vui lòng nhập đủ 6 số mã OTP");
    }
    try {
      setChangingPass(true);
      await api.changePassword({
        code: passData.code,
        otp: passData.code,
        new_password: passData.new_password,
      });
      showNotice("success", "Đổi mật khẩu thành công! Tài khoản của bạn đã được bảo vệ.");
      setShowPasswordModal(false);
      setPassData({ old_password: "", new_password: "", confirm_password: "", code: "" });
      setPassStep("form");
      setPassResendCooldown(0);
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Xác thực OTP đổi mật khẩu thất bại");
    } finally {
      setChangingPass(false);
    }
  };

  const requestEmailOtp = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!emailData.new_email) return showNotice("error", "Vui lòng nhập email mới");
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(emailData.new_email)) {
      return showNotice("error", "Địa chỉ email không hợp lệ");
    }
    if (emailData.new_email.toLowerCase() === user?.email?.toLowerCase()) {
      return showNotice("error", "Email mới không được trùng với email hiện tại");
    }
    try {
      setEmailLoading(true);
      await api.requestEmailChangeOtp({ new_email: emailData.new_email });
      showNotice("success", "Đã gửi mã OTP đến email mới");
      setResendCooldown(60);
      setEmailStep("verify");
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Không thể gửi OTP");
    } finally {
      setEmailLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResendOtp = async () => {
    if (resendCooldown > 0 || !emailData.new_email) return;
    try {
      setEmailLoading(true);
      await api.requestEmailChangeOtp({ new_email: emailData.new_email });
      showNotice("success", "Đã gửi lại mã OTP mới");
      setResendCooldown(60);
      setEmailData((prev) => ({ ...prev, code: "" }));
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Không thể gửi lại OTP");
    } finally {
      setEmailLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const verifyEmailOtp = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!emailData.code || emailData.code.length !== 6) {
      return showNotice("error", "Vui lòng nhập đủ 6 chữ số mã OTP");
    }
    try {
      setEmailLoading(true);
      await api.verifyAndChangeEmail({ new_email: emailData.new_email, code: emailData.code, otp: emailData.code });
      showNotice("success", "Đổi email thành công!");
      setShowEmailModal(false);
      setEmailData({ new_email: "", code: "" });
      setEmailStep("request");
      setResendCooldown(0);
      fetchProfile();
    } catch (error: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(error) || "Xác thực thất bại");
    } finally {
      setEmailLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const roleMeta = (role?: string) => {
    if (role === "admin") return { label: "Quản trị viên", color: "#D4AF37", bg: "rgba(212,175,55,0.12)" };
    if (role === "staff") return { label: "Nhân viên", color: "#0A2540", bg: "rgba(10,37,64,0.08)" };
    return { label: "Độc giả", color: "#8B0000", bg: "rgba(139,0,0,0.08)" };
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <LoadingOverlay message="Đang tải hồ sơ..." />;
  }

  const role = roleMeta(user?.role);

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Hồ Sơ Cá Nhân"
        subtitle="Quản lý thông tin cá nhân và bảo mật tài khoản"
        icon={PersonIcon}
      />

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }}>
          <Stack spacing={3}>
            <DashboardCard>
              <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center", py: 1 }}>
                <Box
                  onClick={() => avatarInputRef.current?.click()}
                  sx={{ position: "relative", cursor: "pointer", "&:hover .avatar-overlay": { opacity: 1 } }}
                >
                  <input ref={avatarInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" hidden onChange={handleAvatarUpload} />
                  <AvatarUser
                    user={user}
                    size={112}
                    border="4px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.85)"
                    sx={{ fontSize: "2.4rem" }}
                  />
                  <Box
                    className="avatar-overlay"
                    sx={{
                      position: "absolute", inset: 0, borderRadius: "50%",
                      bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)", display: "grid", placeItems: "center",
                      opacity: 0, transition: "opacity 0.2s",
                    }}
                  >
                    {uploadingAvatar ? <CircularProgress size={28} sx={{ color: "#fff" }} /> : <CameraAltIcon sx={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 28 }} />}
                  </Box>
                </Box>

                <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  {user?.full_name || "Chưa cập nhật"}
                </Typography>
                <Chip
                  label={role.label}
                  size="small"
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    color: role.color,
                    bgcolor: role.bg,
                    border: "1px solid",
                    borderColor: role.color,
                  }}
                />

                <Stack spacing={1} sx={{ width: "100%", pt: 2, borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", overflow: "hidden" }}>
                    <EmailIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: "text.secondary", flexShrink: 0 }} />
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" noWrap>{user?.email}</Typography>
                  </Stack>
                  {(user as any)?.phone ? (
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <PhoneIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: "text.secondary", flexShrink: 0 }} />
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">{(user as any).phone}</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : null}
                  {(user as any)?.studentCode ? (
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>MSSV:</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{(user as any).studentCode}</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  ) : null}
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
            </DashboardCard>

            <DashboardCard title="Bảo mật tài khoản">
              <Stack spacing={1}>
                <Button
                  fullWidth variant="outlined" startIcon={<AtSignIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setShowEmailModal(true)}
                  sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-start", borderRadius: 2, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Đổi Email
                </Button>
                <Button
                  fullWidth variant="outlined" startIcon={<KeyIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setShowPasswordModal(true)}
                  sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-start", borderRadius: 2, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Đổi Mật Khẩu
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </DashboardCard>
          </Stack>
        </Grid>

        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 8 }}>
          <DashboardCard title="Thông tin cơ bản">
            <form onSubmit={handleProfileUpdate}>
              <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                <Grid container spacing={2.5}>
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                    <TextField
                      label="Họ và tên" fullWidth value={formData.full_name}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, full_name: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Nguyễn Văn A"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                    <TextField label="Email" fullWidth value={user?.email || ""} disabled helperText='Dùng nút "Đổi Email" để thay đổi' />
                  </Grid>
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                    <TextField
                      label="Số điện thoại" fullWidth value={formData.phone}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="0912 345 678"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                  <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                    <TextField
                      label="Địa chỉ thường trú" fullWidth value={formData.permanent_address}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, permanent_address: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="12 Nguyễn Văn Bảo, Gò Vấp, TP.HCM"
                    />
                  </Grid>
                </Grid>
                <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", pt: 2, borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
                  <Button type="submit" variant="contained" disabled={savingProfile} startIcon={savingProfile ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <CheckIcon />} sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}>
                    {savingProfile ? "Đang lưu..." : "Lưu thay đổi"}
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
            </form>
          </DashboardCard>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Secure Password Change Modal (2-Step Verification) */}
      <Dialog
        open={showPasswordModal}
        onClose={() => {
          if (!changingPass) {
            setShowPasswordModal(false);
            setPassStep("form");
            setPassData({ old_password: "", new_password: "", confirm_password: "", code: "" });
            setPassResendCooldown(0);
          }
        }}
        maxWidth="xs"
        fullWidth
        slotProps={{
          paper: {
            sx: {
              borderRadius: 3.5,
              overflow: "hidden",
              boxShadow: (th) =>
                th.palette.mode === "dark"
                  ? "0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)"
                  : "0 20px 45px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.16)",
            },
          },
        }}
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            px: 3,
            pt: 3,
            pb: 2,
            position: "relative",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            gap: 2,
            borderBottom: "1px solid",
            borderColor: "divider",
          }}
        >
          <Box
            sx={{
              width: 48,
              height: 48,
              borderRadius: 2.5,
              display: "grid",
              placeItems: "center",
              bgcolor: (th) =>
                th.palette.mode === "dark"
                  ? "rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15)"
                  : "rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.08)",
              color: (th) =>
                th.palette.mode === "dark" ? "#F59E0B" : "primary.main",
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {passStep === "form" ? (
              <KeyIcon sx={{ fontSize: 26 }} />
            ) : (
              <ShieldIcon sx={{ fontSize: 26 }} />
            )}
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, pr: 3 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
              {passStep === "form" ? "Đổi Mật Khẩu" : "Xác Thực Mã OTP"}
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", mt: 0.5 }}>
              {passStep === "form"
                ? "Bảo mật tài khoản 2 lớp qua mã xác nhận gửi về email"
                : "Nhập mã gồm 6 số đã được gửi qua email"}
            </Typography>
          </Box>

          <IconButton
            size="small"
            disabled={changingPass}
            onClick={() => {
              setShowPasswordModal(false);
              setPassStep("form");
              setPassData({ old_password: "", new_password: "", confirm_password: "", code: "" });
              setPassResendCooldown(0);
            }}
            sx={{
              position: "absolute",
              right: 14,
              top: 14,
              color: "text.secondary",
            }}
          >
            <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>

        {/* 2-Step Progress Indicator */}
        <Box sx={{ px: 3, pt: 2 }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Box
              sx={{
                flex: 1,
                height: 4,
                borderRadius: 2,
                bgcolor: "primary.main",
              }}
            />
            <Box
              sx={{
                flex: 1,
                height: 4,
                borderRadius: 2,
                bgcolor: passStep === "otp" ? "primary.main" : "action.disabledBackground",
                transition: "background-color 0.3s ease",
              }}
            />
          </Stack>
          <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", mt: 0.75 }}>
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main", fontSize: "0.7rem" }}>
              1. Mật khẩu mới
            </Typography>
            <Typography
              variant="caption"
              sx={{
                fontWeight: passStep === "otp" ? 700 : 500,
                color: passStep === "otp" ? "primary.main" : "text.secondary",
                fontSize: "0.7rem",
              }}
            >
              2. Xác thực OTP
            </Typography>
          </Stack>
        </Box>

        <DialogContent sx={{ px: 3, pt: 2, pb: 3 }}>
          {passStep === "form" ? (
            <form onSubmit={handleRequestPasswordOtp}>
              <Stack spacing={2.2}>
                <TextField
                  label="Mật khẩu hiện tại"
                  type={showOldPass ? "text" : "password"}
                  fullWidth
                  required
                  autoFocus
                  value={passData.old_password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassData({ ...passData, old_password: e.target.value })}
                  slotProps={{
                    input: {
                      startAdornment: (
                        <InputAdornment position="start">
                          <LockIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                        </InputAdornment>
                      ),
                      endAdornment: (
                        <InputAdornment position="end">
                          <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setShowOldPass(!showOldPass)} edge="end">
                            {showOldPass ? <VisibilityOffIcon fontSize="small" /> : <VisibilityIcon fontSize="small" />}
                          </IconButton>
                        </InputAdornment>
                      ),
                      sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
                    },
                  }}
                />

                <TextField
                  label="Mật khẩu mới"
                  type={showNewPass ? "text" : "password"}
                  fullWidth
                  required
                  value={passData.new_password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassData({ ...passData, new_password: e.target.value })}
                  slotProps={{
                    input: {
                      startAdornment: (
                        <InputAdornment position="start">
                          <KeyIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                        </InputAdornment>
                      ),
                      endAdornment: (
                        <InputAdornment position="end">
                          <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setShowNewPass(!showNewPass)} edge="end">
                            {showNewPass ? <VisibilityOffIcon fontSize="small" /> : <VisibilityIcon fontSize="small" />}
                          </IconButton>
                        </InputAdornment>
                      ),
                      sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
                    },
                  }}
                />

                {/* Password Strength Indicator */}
                {passData.new_password && (
                  <Box sx={{ mt: -1 }}>
                    {(() => {
                      const strength = calculatePasswordStrength(passData.new_password);
                      const meta = getPasswordStrengthLabel(strength);
                      return (
                        <Box>
                          <Stack direction="row" sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", mb: 0.5 }}>
                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Độ an toàn mật khẩu:</Typography>
                            <Typography variant="caption" color={`${meta.color}.main`} sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                              {meta.label}
                            </Typography>
                          </Stack>
                          <LinearProgress
                            variant="determinate"
                            value={strength}
                            color={meta.color}
                            sx={{ height: 6, borderRadius: 3 }}
                          />
                        </Box>
                      );
                    })()}

                    {/* Requirements checklist */}
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.8} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap", mt: 1, gap: 0.6 }}>
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        icon={<CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />}
                        label="≥ 8 ký tự"
                        color={passData.new_password.length >= 8 ? "success" : "default"}
                        variant={passData.new_password.length >= 8 ? "filled" : "outlined"}
                        sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", height: 22 }}
                      />
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        icon={<CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />}
                        label="Chữ hoa & thường"
                        color={/[A-Z]/.test(passData.new_password) && /[a-z]/.test(passData.new_password) ? "success" : "default"}
                        variant={/[A-Z]/.test(passData.new_password) && /[a-z]/.test(passData.new_password) ? "filled" : "outlined"}
                        sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", height: 22 }}
                      />
                      <Chip
                        size="small"
                        icon={<CheckCircleIcon sx={{ fontSize: "14px !important" }} />}
                        label="Số (0-9)"
                        color={/[0-9]/.test(passData.new_password) ? "success" : "default"}
                        variant={/[0-9]/.test(passData.new_password) ? "filled" : "outlined"}
                        sx={{ fontSize: "0.68rem", height: 22 }}
                      />
                    </Stack>
                  </Box>
                )}

                <TextField
                  label="Xác nhận mật khẩu mới"
                  type={showConfirmPass ? "text" : "password"}
                  fullWidth
                  required
                  value={passData.confirm_password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassData({ ...passData, confirm_password: e.target.value })}
                  error={Boolean(passData.confirm_password && passData.new_password !== passData.confirm_password)}
                  helperText={
                    passData.confirm_password && passData.new_password !== passData.confirm_password
                      ? "Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp"
                      : ""
                  }
                  slotProps={{
                    input: {
                      startAdornment: (
                        <InputAdornment position="start">
                          <CheckIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                        </InputAdornment>
                      ),
                      endAdornment: (
                        <InputAdornment position="end">
                          <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setShowConfirmPass(!showConfirmPass)} edge="end">
                            {showConfirmPass ? <VisibilityOffIcon fontSize="small" /> : <VisibilityIcon fontSize="small" />}
                          </IconButton>
                        </InputAdornment>
                      ),
                      sx: { borderRadius: 2.5 },
                    },
                  }}
                />

                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", pt: 1 }}>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    onClick={() => setShowPasswordModal(false)}
                    disabled={changingPass}
                    sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}
                  >
                    Hủy
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="submit"
                    variant="contained"
                    disabled={
                      changingPass ||
                      !passData.old_password ||
                      !passData.new_password ||
                      passData.new_password !== passData.confirm_password ||
                      passData.new_password.length < 8
                    }
                    endIcon={changingPass ? <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" /> : <ArrowForwardIcon fontSize="small" />}
                    sx={{ borderRadius: 2, px: 2.5, fontWeight: 700 }}
                  >
                    {changingPass ? "Đang xử lý..." : "Tiếp tục"}
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmPasswordChange}>
              <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                {/* Email info card */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    p: 1.5,
                    borderRadius: 2.5,
                    bgcolor: (th) =>
                      th.palette.mode === "dark"
                        ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)"
                        : "rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.04)",
                    border: "1px solid",
                    borderColor: (th) =>
                      th.palette.mode === "dark"
                        ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)"
                        : "rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.15)",
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 1.5,
                  }}
                >
                  <EmailIcon color="primary" />
                  <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", fontSize: "0.72rem" }}>
                      Mã OTP xác thực đã được gửi đến email:
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography
                      variant="body2"
                      sx={{
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        whiteSpace: "nowrap",
                        overflow: "hidden",
                        textOverflow: "ellipsis",
                      }}
                    >
                      {user?.email || "Email của bạn"}
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                </Box>

                {/* 6-slot OTP Input */}
                <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center", py: 0.5 }}>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1.5, fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
                    Nhập mã PIN 6 số để xác thực đổi mật khẩu:
                  </Typography>

                  <OtpPinInput
                    length={6}
                    value={passData.code}
                    onChange={(code) => setPassData((prev) => ({ ...prev, code }))}
                    disabled={changingPass}
                    autoFocus
                  />
                </Box>

                {/* Resend Cooldown Section */}
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    gap: 0.5,
                  }}
                >
                  {passResendCooldown > 0 ? (
                    <Chip
                      icon={<AccessTimeIcon sx={{ fontSize: "16px !important" }} />}
                      label={`Gửi lại mã sau ${passResendCooldown}s`}
                      size="small"
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        fontSize: "0.75rem",
                        borderColor: "divider",
                      }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      size="small"
                      variant="text"
                      startIcon={<RefreshIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                      onClick={handleResendPasswordOtp}
                      disabled={changingPass}
                      sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.8rem" }}
                    >
                      Chưa nhận được mã? Gửi lại
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </Box>

                {/* Actions */}
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", pt: 0.5 }}>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon fontSize="small" />}
                    onClick={() => setPassStep("form")}
                    disabled={changingPass}
                    sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}
                  >
                    Quay lại
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="submit"
                    variant="contained"
                    disabled={changingPass || passData.code.length !== 6}
                    startIcon={
                      changingPass ? (
                        <CircularProgress size={16} color="inherit" />
                      ) : (
                        <CheckIcon fontSize="small" />
                      )
                    }
                    sx={{
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      px: 2.5,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  >
                    {changingPass ? "Đang xác thực..." : "Xác thực & Đổi"}
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
            </form>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Email Change Modal */}
      <Dialog
        open={showEmailModal}
        onClose={() => {
          if (!emailLoading) {
            setShowEmailModal(false);
            setEmailStep("request");
            setEmailData({ new_email: "", code: "" });
            setResendCooldown(0);
          }
        }}
        maxWidth="xs"
        fullWidth
        slotProps={{
          paper: {
            sx: {
              borderRadius: 3.5,
              overflow: "hidden",
              boxShadow: (th) =>
                th.palette.mode === "dark"
                  ? "0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)"
                  : "0 20px 45px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.16)",
            },
          },
        }}
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            px: 3,
            pt: 3,
            pb: 2,
            position: "relative",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            gap: 2,

            borderColor: "divider",
          }}

          <Box

                th.palette.mode === "dark"
                  ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)"
                  : "rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.08)",
              color: (th) =>
                th.palette.mode === "dark" ? "#38BDF8" : "primary.main",
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {emailStep === "request" ? (
              <AtSignIcon sx={{ fontSize: 26 }} />
            ) : (
              <MarkEmailReadIcon sx={{ fontSize: 26 }} />
            )}
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, pr: 3 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
              {emailStep === "request" ? "Đổi Địa Chỉ Email" : "Xác Thực Mã OTP"}
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ display: "block", mt: 0.5 }}>
              {emailStep === "request"
                ? "Bảo mật tài khoản qua mã OTP gửi về hòm thư mới"

            <Box
              sx={{
                flex: 1,

      <Snackbar
        open={toast.open}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  AppBar,
  Avatar,
  Badge,
  Box,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
  Stack,
  Toolbar,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
  useTheme,
  alpha,
} from "@mui/material";
import BellIcon from "@mui/icons-material/NotificationsOutlined";
import Brightness6Icon from "@mui/icons-material/Brightness6Outlined";
import DarkModeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DarkModeOutlined";
import LightModeIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LightModeOutlined";
import UserIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import { useColorMode } from "@/lib/mui-theme";
import api from "@/lib/api-client";
import Sidebar from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/Sidebar";
import NotificationDropdown from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/NotificationDropdown";
import AvatarUser from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/AvatarUser";
import BreadcrumbsNav from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/BreadcrumbsNav";

function Topbar({ user }: { user: any }) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const { mode, effectiveMode, preference, reducedMotion, toggleMode } = useColorMode();
  const [bellAnchorEl, setBellAnchorEl] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const bellOpen = Boolean(bellAnchorEl);

  const modeIcon = useMemo(() => {
    if (preference === "auto") return <Brightness6Icon fontSize="small" />;
    return preference === "dark" ? <DarkModeIcon fontSize="small" /> : <LightModeIcon fontSize="small" />;
  }, [preference]);

  const modeTooltip = useMemo(() => {
    if (reducedMotion === "reduce") return "Chế độ hiển thị (Đã bật giảm chuyển động)";
    if (preference === "auto") return `Chế độ tự động (${effectiveMode === "dark" ? "Tối" : "Sáng"}) - Nhấn để thay đổi`;
    if (preference === "dark") return "Chế độ tối - Nhấn để chuyển";
    return "Chế độ sáng - Nhấn để chuyển";
  }, [preference, effectiveMode, reducedMotion]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    const fetchCount = async () => {
      try {
        const { count } = await api.getUnreadCount();
        if (mounted) setUnreadCount(count);
      } catch {
        // silently fail
      }
    };

    fetchCount();

    // Poll every 30 seconds as fallback
    const interval = setInterval(fetchCount, 30000);

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleBellClick = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (bellAnchorEl) {
      setBellAnchorEl(null);
    } else {
      setBellAnchorEl(event.currentTarget);
    }
  };

  const handleBellClose = () => {
    setBellAnchorEl(null);
    // Refresh count after closing
    api.getUnreadCount().then(({ count }) => setUnreadCount(count)).catch(() => {});
  };

  return (
    <>
      <AppBar
        position="sticky"
        color="default"
        elevation={0}
        sx={{
          borderBottom: 1,
          borderColor: "divider",
          borderTop: `3px solid ${theme.palette.primary.main}`, // IUH Red Brand Accent Stripe
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          color: "text.primary",
        }}
      >
        <Toolbar sx={{ justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 1.5, minHeight: 64, pl: { xs: 6.5, md: 3 }, pr: { xs: 2, md: 3 } }}>
          {/* IUH Academic Branding Title */}
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ display: { xs: "none", md: "flex" }, alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 8,
                height: 8,
                borderRadius: "50%",
                bgcolor: theme.palette.primary.main,
              }}
            />
            <Typography
              variant="subtitle2"
              sx={{
                fontFamily: "'Space Grotesk', sans-serif",
                fontWeight: 700,
                letterSpacing: "0.02em",
                color: "text.primary",
                fontSize: "0.88rem",
              }}
            >
              TRƯỜNG ĐẠI HỌC CÔNG NGHIỆP TP.HCM • TRẠM THỦ THƯ
            </Typography>
            <Chip
              label="HỌC THUẬT & KỸ THUẬT"
              size="small"
              sx={{
                height: 20,
                fontSize: "0.65rem",
                fontWeight: 700,
                borderRadius: "2px",
                bgcolor: alpha(theme.palette.secondary.main, 0.12),
                color: theme.palette.mode === "dark" ? theme.palette.secondary.light : theme.palette.secondary.dark,
                border: `1px solid ${alpha(theme.palette.secondary.main, 0.35)}`,
              }}
            />
          </Stack>

          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Box sx={{ position: "relative" }}>
            <Tooltip title="Thông báo">
              <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={handleBellClick}>
                <Badge badgeContent={unreadCount > 0 ? (unreadCount > 99 ? "99+" : unreadCount) : 0} color="error" invisible={unreadCount === 0}>
                  <BellIcon fontSize="small" />
                </Badge>
              </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>
            <NotificationDropdown anchorEl={bellAnchorEl} open={bellOpen} onClose={handleBellClose} />
          </Box>
          <Tooltip title={modeTooltip} arrow>
            <IconButton color="inherit" onClick={toggleMode}>
              {modeIcon}
            </IconButton>
          </Tooltip>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.25} sx={{ alignItems: "center", pl: 1.5, borderLeft: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}` }}>
            <AvatarUser user={user} size={34} />
            <Box sx={{ display: { xs: "none", sm: "block" }, minWidth: 0, maxWidth: 160 }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                {user?.full_name || "Admin"}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "capitalize", display: "block", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                {user?.role || "staff"}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Toolbar>
    </AppBar>
    </>
  );
}

import { PermissionProvider, usePermission } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@mui/material";
import LockOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";

function DashboardGuard({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { canAccessPage, loading, permissions } = usePermission();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();

  const isAllowed = canAccessPage(pathname);

  if (loading && !permissions) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, display: "grid", placeItems: "center", minHeight: 300 }}>
        <CircularProgress size={32} />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isAllowed) {
    return (
      <Box
        sx={{
          flex: 1,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          p: 4,
          textAlign: "center",
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          borderRadius: 3,
          border: 1,
          borderColor: "divider",
          my: "auto",
        }}
      >
        <Avatar
          sx={{
            width: 56,
            height: 56,
            bgcolor: "error.light",
            color: "error.main",
            mb: 2,
          }}
        >
          <LockOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" />
        </Avatar>
        <Typography variant="h5" color="error.main" gutterBottom sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
          Truy cập bị từ chối (403 Forbidden)
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 3, maxWidth: 500 }}>
          Tài khoản của bạn chưa được cấp quyền truy cập trang này (<code>{pathname}</code>). Vui lòng liên hệ Quản trị viên để được cấp quyền.
        </Typography>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard")}
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", borderRadius: 2 }}
        >
          Quay lại Bảng điều khiển
        </Button>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

export default function DashboardLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading, user } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !isAuthenticated) {
      router.push("/login");
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, isLoading, router]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ minHeight: "100vh", bgcolor: "background.default", display: "grid", placeItems: "center" }}>
        <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <CircularProgress color="primary" />
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Đang tải...</Typography>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) return null;

  return (
    <PermissionProvider>
      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", minHeight: "100vh", bgcolor: "background.default" }}>
        <Sidebar />
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
          <Topbar user={user} />
          <Box component="main" sx={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", p: { xs: 2, md: 3 } }}>
            <BreadcrumbsNav />
            <DashboardGuard>{children}</DashboardGuard>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    </PermissionProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  CircularProgress,
  Stack,
  Typography,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlineOutlined";
import LockOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LockOutlined";
import FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlined";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  LoginBrandHero,
  LoginFormPassword,
  LoginFormFace,
  ForgotPasswordDialog,
} from "./_components";

type LoginMode = "password" | "face";

export default function LoginPage() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const { login, setAuthFromToken } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<LoginMode>("password");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [forgotOpen, setForgotOpen] = useState(false);

  const faceFailCountRef = useRef(0);

  const handlePasswordSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email, password);
      window.location.href = "/dashboard";
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Đăng nhập thất bại.");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFaceLogin = useCallback(async (file: File) => {
    setError("");
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.faceLogin(file);
      if (!res.access_token) throw new Error("Backend did not return access_token");
      const payload = JSON.parse(atob(res.access_token.split(".")[1]));
      const userEmail = payload?.email || "";
      const role = ((payload?.roles as string[])?.[0]) || "user";
      setAuthFromToken(res.access_token, res.refresh_token, userEmail, role);
      setSuccess(true);
      setIsLoading(false);
      faceFailCountRef.current = 0;
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.location.href = "/dashboard";
      }, 500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err) || "Đăng nhập thất bại.";
      setError(msg);
      setIsLoading(false);
      const newCount = faceFailCountRef.current + 1;
      faceFailCountRef.current = newCount;
      if (newCount >= 2) {
        setMode("password");
        faceFailCountRef.current = 0;
        setError(`${msg} Chuyển sang đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu.`);
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }, [setAuthFromToken]);

  const switchMode = (newMode: LoginMode) => {
    setMode(newMode);
    setError("");
    faceFailCountRef.current = 0;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Box
        sx={{
          minHeight: "100vh",
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", md: "1fr 1fr", lg: "55% 45%" },
        }}
      >
        {/* Left Hero Panel */}
        <LoginBrandHero />

        {/* Right Form Panel */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            justifyContent: "center",
            alignItems: "center",
            p: { xs: 3, sm: 4, md: 5 },
            bgcolor: "background.default",
            minHeight: "100vh",
          }}
        >
          {/* Mobile-only logo */}
          <Box sx={{ display: { xs: "flex", md: "none" }, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", mb: 4 }}>
            <Box
              component="img"
              src={theme.palette.mode === "dark" ? "/logo-white.png" : "/logo.png"}
              alt="IUH Logo"
              sx={{ height: 44, width: "auto", objectFit: "contain" }}
            />
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 420 }}>
            {/* Header */}
            <Box sx={{ mb: 3.5 }}>
              <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, mb: 0.5, fontFamily: "Space Grotesk, sans-serif" }}>
                Đăng nhập
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontSize: "0.95rem" }}>
                Chào mừng trở lại! Vui lòng đăng nhập để tiếp tục.
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            {/* Mode Tabs */}
            <Box
              sx={{
                display: "flex",
                bgcolor: "action.hover",
                borderRadius: 2.5,
                p: 0.5,
                mb: 3,
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: "divider",
              }}
            >
              {(["password", "face"] as LoginMode[]).map((m) => (
                <Box
                  key={m}
                  onClick={() => switchMode(m)}
                  sx={{
                    flex: 1,
                    py: 1.1,
                    borderRadius: 2,
                    textAlign: "center",
                    cursor: "pointer",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: "0.875rem",
                    transition: "all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    gap: 0.75,
                    ...(mode === m
                      ? {
                          bgcolor: "background.paper",
                          color: "primary.main",
                          boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.12)",
                        }
                      : {
                          color: "text.secondary",
                          "&:hover": { color: "text.primary" },
                        }),
                  }}
                >
                  {m === "password" ? (
                    <>
                      <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />
                      Mật khẩu
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 17 }} />
                      Khuôn mặt AI
                    </>
                  )}
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Box>

            {/* Error Alert */}
            {error && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: 2 }}>{error}</Alert>}

            {/* Success */}
            {success && (
              <Alert icon={<CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon />} severity="success" sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: 2 }}>
                Đăng nhập thành công. Đang chuyển hướng...
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* Render Forms */}
            {mode === "password" ? (
              <LoginFormPassword
                email={email}
                setEmail={setEmail}
                password={password}
                setPassword={setPassword}
                showPassword={showPassword}
                setShowPassword={setShowPassword}
                onSubmit={handlePasswordSubmit}
                onForgotClick={() => setForgotOpen(true)}
                isLoading={isLoading}
              />
            ) : (
              <LoginFormFace
                onFaceLogin={handleFaceLogin}
                isLoading={isLoading}
                onSwitchToPassword={(prefillEmail) => {
                  if (prefillEmail) setEmail(prefillEmail);
                  setMode("password");
                }}
                setError={setError}
              />
            )}

            {/* Register Link */}
            <Box sx={{ mt: 3.5, pt: 2.5, borderTop: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", textAlign: "center" }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Chưa có tài khoản thư viện?{" "}
                <Link
                  href="/register"
                  style={{
                    color: theme.palette.primary.main,
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    textDecoration: "none",
                  }}
                >
                  Đăng ký thẻ độc giả
                </Link>
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            {/* Footer */}
            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.disabled" sx={{ display: "block", textAlign: "center", mt: 3 }}>
              © {new Date().getFullYear()} Thư Viện IUH — Hệ thống Quản lý Thư viện Thông minh
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Forgot Password Dialog */}
      <ForgotPasswordDialog
        open={forgotOpen}
        onClose={() => setForgotOpen(false)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

================
File: src/app/(dashboard)/return/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  AlertTitle,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  Grid,
  Paper,
  Slide,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import ReturnIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AssignmentReturnOutlined";
import ReceiptLongIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLong";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { slideInRight } from "@/lib/animations";
import { getAlertSeverity, getAlertTitle } from "@/lib/alert-utils";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import OverdueGuideModal from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/OverdueGuideModal";
import type { BorrowRecord, StaffActiveBorrowerSummary, StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse } from "@/lib/types";

import {
  ReturnMetricsBar,
  ReturnBorrowerList,
  type BorrowerFilter,
  ReturnActiveBorrows,
  ReturnScannerDialog,
  ReturnConfirmDialog,
  ReturnReceipt,
} from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/return";

export default function ReturnPage() {
  const [snackbar, setSnackbar] = useState<{
    open: boolean;
    message: string;
    severity: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info";
  }>({
    open: false,
    message: "",
    severity: "info",
  });
  const [borrowers, setBorrowers] = useState<StaffActiveBorrowerSummary[]>([]);
  const [selectedStudentCode, setSelectedStudentCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<StaffPatronActiveBorrowsResponse | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<BorrowerFilter>("all");
  const [loadingBorrowers, setLoadingBorrowers] = useState(true);
  const [loadingDetail, setLoadingDetail] = useState(false);
  const [returningId, setReturningId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmRecord, setConfirmRecord] = useState<BorrowRecord | null>(null);
  const [condition, setCondition] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [scannerOpen, setScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [overdueGuideOpen, setOverdueGuideOpen] = useState(false);

  const [fineConfig, setFineConfig] = useState<any>(null);
  const [receiptRecord, setReceiptRecord] = useState<BorrowRecord | null>(null);
  const [unpaidFines, setUnpaidFines] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [payingFineId, setPayingFineId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const showNotice = useCallback((type: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info", msg: string, _duration?: number) => {
    setSnackbar({
      open: true,
      message: msg,
      severity: type,
    });
  }, []);

  const showNoticeRef = useRef(showNotice);
  useEffect(() => {
    showNoticeRef.current = showNotice;
  }, [showNotice]);

  const loadBorrowers = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingBorrowers(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const data = await api.getActiveBorrowers();
      setBorrowers(data.items);
      setSelectedStudentCode((current) => {
        if (current && data.items.some((item) => item.patron.student_code === current)) return current;
        return data.items[0]?.patron.student_code ?? null;
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể tải danh sách độc giả đang mượn");
    } finally {
      setLoadingBorrowers(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadPatronDetail = useCallback(async (studentCode: string) => {
    setLoadingDetail(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const data = await api.getActiveBorrowsByStudentCode(studentCode);
      setDetail(data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setDetail(null);
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể tải sách đang mượn của độc giả");
    } finally {
      setLoadingDetail(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadUnpaidFines = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const rows = await api.getUnpaidFines();
      setUnpaidFines(rows);
    } catch {
      setUnpaidFines([]);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getBorrowConfig()
      .then((cfg) => setFineConfig(cfg.fine ?? null))
      .catch(() => setFineConfig(null));
    void loadUnpaidFines();
  }, [loadUnpaidFines]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadBorrowers();
  }, [loadBorrowers]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedStudentCode) {
      loadPatronDetail(selectedStudentCode);
    } else {
      setDetail(null);
    }
  }, [selectedStudentCode, loadPatronDetail]);

  const filteredBorrowers = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return borrowers.filter((borrower) => {
      const matchesSearch = !q
        || borrower.patron.student_code.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        || (borrower.patron.full_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesFilter = filter === "all"
        || (filter === "overdue" && borrower.overdue_count > 0)
        || (filter === "active" && borrower.overdue_count === 0);
      return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
    });
  }, [borrowers, filter, search]);

  const totals = useMemo(() => ({
    borrowers: borrowers.length,
    books: borrowers.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.total_borrowed, 0),
    overdue: borrowers.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.overdue_count, 0),
  }), [borrowers]);

  const selectedBorrower = useMemo(
    () => borrowers.find((item) => item.patron.student_code === selectedStudentCode) ?? null,
    [borrowers, selectedStudentCode],
  );

  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canUpdateBorrow = can("borrows", "update");

  const handlePayFine = async (recordId: string, paymentMethod: "cash" | "qr_code" = "cash") => {
    setPayingFineId(recordId);
    try {
      const res = await api.payFines([recordId], paymentMethod);
      if (res.activated && res.activated.length > 0) {
        showNoticeRef.current("success", "Đã thu phí thành công. Thẻ độc giả đã được tự động mở khóa!");
      } else {
        showNoticeRef.current("success", "Đã thu phí thành công.");
      }
      void loadUnpaidFines();
      await loadBorrowers();
      if (selectedStudentCode) await loadPatronDetail(selectedStudentCode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNoticeRef.current("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi khi thu phí");
    } finally {
      setPayingFineId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReturnRecord = async (payment?: { isPaidImmediately: boolean; paymentMethod: "cash" | "qr_code" }) => {
    if (!confirmRecord) return;
    setReturningId(confirmRecord.id);
    setError("");
    try {
      const result = await api.staffReturnBorrowRecord(confirmRecord.id, note || null, condition || "good", {
        is_paid_immediately: payment?.isPaidImmediately ?? true,
        payment_method: payment?.paymentMethod ?? "cash",
      });
      showNoticeRef.current("success", "Trả sách thành công");
      setCondition("");
      setNote("");
      setConfirmRecord(null);
      setReceiptRecord(result.record ?? null);
      void loadUnpaidFines();
      await loadBorrowers();
      if (selectedStudentCode) await loadPatronDetail(selectedStudentCode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNoticeRef.current("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Trả sách thất bại");
    } finally {
      setReturningId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleBatchComplete = async () => {
    await loadBorrowers();
    if (selectedStudentCode) await loadPatronDetail(selectedStudentCode);
  };

  const statBadges = `${totals.borrowers} độc giả | ${totals.books} sách đang mượn | ${totals.overdue} quá hạn`;

  const headerActions = selectedStudentCode ? (
    <Button
      variant="outlined"
      size="small"
      onClick={() => { setSelectedStudentCode(null); setDetail(null); }}
      sx={{
        color: "text.primary",
        borderColor: "divider",
        "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.main", bgcolor: "action.hover" },
      }}
    >
      Hủy chọn
    </Button>
  ) : null;

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Trả sách"
        icon={ReturnIcon}
        statBadges={statBadges}
        onRefresh={loadBorrowers}
        actions={headerActions}
      />

      <ReturnMetricsBar totals={totals} />

      {error ? (
        <Slide direction="down" in={!!error} timeout={250}>
          <Alert
            severity={getAlertSeverity(error)}
            onClose={() => setError("")}
            sx={{ animation: `${slideInRight} 0.25s ease-out`, borderRadius: 2 }}
          >
            <AlertTitle>{getAlertTitle(error)}</AlertTitle>
            {error}
          </Alert>
        </Slide>
      ) : null}

      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 5, lg: 4 }}>
          <ReturnBorrowerList
            filteredBorrowers={filteredBorrowers}
            selectedStudentCode={selectedStudentCode}
            onSelectBorrower={setSelectedStudentCode}
            search={search}
            onSearchChange={setSearch}
            filter={filter}
            onFilterChange={setFilter}
            loading={loadingBorrowers}
            selectedBorrower={selectedBorrower}
            onOpenScanner={() => setScannerOpen(true)}
            onOpenOverdueGuide={() => setOverdueGuideOpen(true)}
          />
        </Grid>

        <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 7, lg: 8 }}>
          <ReturnActiveBorrows
            selectedBorrower={selectedBorrower}
            detail={detail}
            loadingDetail={loadingDetail}
            returningId={returningId}
            onConfirmReturn={(record) => {
              setConfirmRecord(record);
              setCondition(record.copy?.condition || "good");
              setNote("");
            }}
          />
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Sổ nợ phí phạt (Khoản phí chưa thu) */}
      <Paper
        elevation={0}
        variant="outlined"
        sx={{
          p: 2.5,
          borderRadius: 2,
          bgcolor: (t) => (t.palette.mode === "dark" ? "background.paper" : "#ffffff"),
        }}
      >
        <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
          <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={1.5}>
            <ReceiptLongIcon color="warning" />
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800 }}>
              Khoản phí chưa thu (Sổ nợ)
            </Typography>
            <Chip
              label={`${unpaidFines.length} khoản`}
              size="small"
              color={unpaidFines.length > 0 ? "warning" : "default"}
              sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}
            />
          </Stack>
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            onClick={() => void loadUnpaidFines()}
            sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
          >
            Làm mới
          </Button>
        </Stack>

        {unpaidFines.length === 0 ? (
          <Box sx={{ py: 3, textAlign: "center" }}>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
              Hiện không có khoản phí phạt hay hư hỏng nào chưa thu.
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        ) : (
          <TableContainer>
            <Table size="small">
              <TableHead>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Độc giả</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Sách & Mã vạch</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Phí trễ hạn</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Phí hư hỏng</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Tổng nợ</TableCell>
                  <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Ngày trả</TableCell>
                  <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Hành động</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHead>
              <TableBody>
                {unpaidFines.map((item) => (
                  <TableRow key={item.record_id} hover>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {item.patron?.full_name || "—"}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {item.patron?.student_code || item.patron?.id}
                      </Typography>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {item.book?.title || "—"}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                        {item.barcode || item.book?.isbn || "—"}
                      </Typography>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="right">
                      {Number(item.overdue_fine || 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="right">
                      {Number(item.damage_fee || 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="right">
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "error.main" }}>
                        {Number(item.total || 0).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ
                      </Typography>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Typography variant="caption">
                        {item.return_at ? new Date(item.return_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN") : "—"}
                      </Typography>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell align="center">
                      <Tooltip title={!canUpdateBorrow ? getPermissionDeniedReason("borrows", "update") : ""}>
                        <span>
                          <Button
                            variant="contained"
                            color="success"
                            size="small"
                            disabled={!canUpdateBorrow || payingFineId === item.record_id}
                            onClick={() => handlePayFine(item.record_id, "cash")}
                            sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: 1.5 }}
                          >
                            {payingFineId === item.record_id ? "Đang thu..." : "Thu phí"}
                          </Button>
                        </span>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </TableContainer>
        )}
      </Paper>

      <ReturnScannerDialog
        open={scannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setScannerOpen(false)}
        detail={detail}
        onBatchComplete={handleBatchComplete}
        showNotice={(type, msg, duration) => showNoticeRef.current(type, msg, duration)}
      />

      <ReturnConfirmDialog
        record={confirmRecord}
        detail={detail}
        condition={condition}
        note={note}
        fineConfig={fineConfig}
        onConditionChange={setCondition}
        onNoteChange={setNote}
        onClose={() => { setConfirmRecord(null); setCondition(""); setNote(""); }}
        onConfirm={handleReturnRecord}
        loading={!!returningId}
      />

      <ReturnReceipt
        record={receiptRecord}
        onClose={() => setReceiptRecord(null)}
      />

      <OverdueGuideModal
        open={overdueGuideOpen}
        onClose={() => setOverdueGuideOpen(false)}
      />

      <Snackbar
        open={snackbar.open}
        autoHideDuration={3500}
        onClose={() => setSnackbar((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        <Alert
          onClose={() => setSnackbar((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
          severity={snackbar.severity}
          variant="filled"
          sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: 2 }}
        >
          {snackbar.message}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </Stack>
  );
}

import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Divider,
  Grid,
  IconButton,
  Paper,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import MenuBookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CalendarTodayIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CalendarTodayOutlined";
import CategoryIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CategoryOutlined";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DescriptionIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined";
import EditIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined";
import ExpandIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ExpandMoreOutlined";
import GridViewIcon from "@mui/icons-material/GridViewOutlined";
