import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlineOutlined";
import StarIcon from "@mui/icons-material/StarOutlined";
import ViewInArIcon from "@mui/icons-material/ViewInArOutlined";
import VerifiedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VerifiedOutlined";
import PaymentsIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PaymentsOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { BookCopy, BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import { BookCopiesTable } from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/books/BookCopiesTable";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";

const Book3DViewer = dynamic(
  () => import("@/app/(dashboard)/_components/Book3DViewer"),
  { ssr: false, loading: () => <Box sx={{ height: 300, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", background: "grey.100", borderRadius: 2 }}><CircularProgress /></Box> }
);

const VRViewer = dynamic(
  () => import("@/app/library/vr-tour/_components/VRViewer"),
  { ssr: false, loading: () => <Box sx={{ height: 400, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}><CircularProgress /></Box> }
);

function StatCard({ label, value, color, icon }: { label: string; value: number; color: "primary" | "info" | "success" | "warning"; icon: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Paper
      variant="outlined"
      sx={{
        flex: 1,
        p: 1.5,
        textAlign: "center",
        borderColor: `${color}.main`,
        borderRadius: 2,
        background:
          color === "primary"
            ? "rgba(139,0,0,0.06)"
            : color === "success"
            ? "rgba(5,150,105,0.08)"
            : color === "warning"
            ? "rgba(217,119,6,0.08)"
            : "rgba(10,37,64,0.06)",
      }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ color: `${color}.main`, mb: 0.5 }}>{icon}</Box>
      <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 900, color: `${color}.main` }}>
        {value}
      </Typography>
      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
        {label}
      </Typography>
    </Paper>
  );
}

function MetaItem({ icon, label, value }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ py: 1.5, px: 0 }}>
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
        <Box sx={{ color: "text.secondary", mt: 0.3 }}>{icon}</Box>
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
            {label}
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 500, wordBreak: "break-word" }}>
            {value}
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
      <Divider sx={{ mt: 1.5 }} />
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function BookDetailPage() {
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info"; message: string } | null>(null);
  const showNotice = (severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info", message: string) => {
    setNotice({ severity, message });
  };
  const theme = useTheme();
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const bookId = params.id as string;

  const [book, setBook] = useState<BookWithStats | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [descExpanded, setDescExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [show3D, setShow3D] = useState(false);
  const [showVR, setShowVR] = useState(false);

  const [copies, setCopies] = useState<BookCopy[]>([]);
  const [copiesLoading, setCopiesLoading] = useState(false);

  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editSaving, setEditSaving] = useState(false);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [editErrors, setEditErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const [showDelete, setShowDelete] = useState(false);
  const [deleteConfirmText, setDeleteConfirmText] = useState("");

  const fetchCopies = async () => {
    if (!bookId) return;
    setCopiesLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await api.getBookCopies(bookId);
      setCopies(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load copies", err);
    } finally {
      setCopiesLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!bookId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    api.getBookById(bookId).then(setBook).catch((err) => setError(getErrorMessage(err))).finally(() => setLoading(false));
    fetchCopies();
  }, [bookId]);

  const openEdit = () => {
    if (!book) return;
    setEditErrors({});
    setEditForm({
      title: book.title || "",
      subtitle: book.subtitle || "",
      author: book.author || "",
      publisher: book.publisher || "",
      published_date: book.published_date || "",
      description: book.description || "",
      page_count: book.page_count ?? "",
      categories: book.categories || "",
      average_rating: book.average_rating ?? "",
      language: book.language || "",
      shelf_location: book.shelf_location || "",
      price: book.price ?? "",
      cover_url: book.cover_url || "",
      quantity: book.total_copies ?? 0,
    });
    setEditOpen(true);
  };

  const validateEditForm = () => {
    const errors: Record<string, string> = {};

    if (!editForm.title?.trim()) {
      errors.title = "Tiêu đề không được để trống";
    }

    if (editForm.quantity === "" || editForm.quantity === null || Number(editForm.quantity) < 0) {
      errors.quantity = "Số lượng phải là số từ 0 trở lên";
    }

    if (editForm.page_count !== "" && editForm.page_count !== null && Number(editForm.page_count) < 0) {
      errors.page_count = "Số trang không được âm";
    }

    if (editForm.price !== "" && editForm.price !== null && Number(editForm.price) < 0) {
      errors.price = "Giá bìa không được âm";
    }

    if (editForm.average_rating !== "" && editForm.average_rating !== null) {
      const rating = Number(editForm.average_rating);
      if (rating < 0 || rating > 5) {
        errors.average_rating = "Đánh giá phải nằm trong khoảng 0 đến 5";
      }
    }

    if (editForm.cover_url?.trim()) {
      try {
        new URL(editForm.cover_url);
      } catch {
        errors.cover_url = "URL hình ảnh không hợp lệ (cần bắt đầu bằng http:// hoặc https://)";
      }
    }

    setEditErrors(errors);
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleEditChange = (field: string, value: any) => {
    setEditForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (editErrors[field]) {
      setEditErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: "" }));
    }
  };

  const handleEditSave = async () => {
    if (!validateEditForm()) return;
    if (!book) return;

    setEditSaving(true);
    try {
      const quantity = editForm.quantity === "" || editForm.quantity === null ? null : Number(editForm.quantity);
      const metadataPayload: Record<string, any> = {};

      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(editForm)) {
        if (k === "quantity") continue;
        if (k === "page_count" || k === "average_rating" || k === "price") {
          metadataPayload[k] = v === "" || v === null ? null : Number(v);
        } else {
          metadataPayload[k] = v || null;
        }
      }

      let updated = await api.updateBook(book.id, metadataPayload);

      if (quantity !== null && quantity !== book.total_copies) {
        updated = await api.updateBookQuantity(book.id, quantity);
      }

      setBook(updated);
      setEditOpen(false);
      showNotice("success", "Cập nhật sách thành công");
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Cập nhật sách thất bại");
    } finally {
      setEditSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!book || deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA") return;
    try {
      await api.bulkDeleteBooks([book.id]);
      router.push("/books");
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.response?.status === 404) {
        showNotice("error", "Sách không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa.");
        router.push("/books");
      } else {
        showNotice("error", `Xóa thất bại: ${getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi không xác định"}`);
      }
    }
  };

  const headerActions = book ? (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
      <Tooltip title="Chỉnh sửa thông tin sách">
        <Button variant="outlined" startIcon={<EditIcon />} onClick={openEdit}>
          Sửa
        </Button>
      </Tooltip>
      <Button color="error" variant="outlined" startIcon={<DeleteIcon />} onClick={() => setShowDelete(true)}>
        Xóa
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  ) : null;

  const borrowed = book ? book.total_copies - book.available_copies : 0;
  const isLongDescription = book?.description ? book.description.length > 300 : false;

  return (
    <LoadingOverlay loading={loading} message="Đang tải thông tin sách...">
      {error || !book ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<MenuBookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 56 }} />}
          title={error || "Không tìm thấy sách"}
          description="Sách có thể đã bị xóa hoặc ID không hợp lệ."
          action={
            <Button variant="contained" startIcon={<MenuBookIcon />} onClick={() => router.push("/books")}>
              Quay lại danh sách
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <Stack spacing={3}>
          <PageHeader
            backHref="/books"
            title={book.title}
            subtitle={book.subtitle || book.author || undefined}
            icon={MenuBookIcon}
            actions={headerActions}
          />

          <Grid container spacing={3}>
            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }} sx={staggerSx(0)}>
              <DashboardCard noPadding>
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: "relative",
                    height: 340,
                    background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${theme.palette.grey[900]} 0%, ${theme.palette.grey[800]} 100%)`,
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    overflow: "hidden",
                  }}
                >
                  {book.cover_url ? (
                    <Box
                      component="img"
                      src={book.cover_url}
                      alt={book.title}
                      sx={{
                        maxWidth: "100%",
                        maxHeight: "100%",
                        objectFit: "contain",
                        transition: "transform 0.3s ease",
                        "&:hover": { transform: "scale(1.02)" },
                      }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <Avatar sx={{ width: 140, height: 140, bgcolor: "grey.700" }}>
                      <MenuBookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 72 }} />
                    </Avatar>
                  )}
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      position: "absolute",
                      top: 12,
                      left: 12,
                      bgcolor: book.is_available ? "success.main" : "error.main",
                      color: "white",
                      px: 1.5,
                      py: 0.5,
                      borderRadius: 5,
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  >
                    {book.is_available ? "Còn hàng" : "Hết hàng"}
                  </Box>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    color="primary"
                    startIcon={<ViewInArIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setShow3D(true)}
                    sx={{
                      position: "absolute",
                      bottom: 16,
                      left: 16,
                      right: book.shelf_location ? "calc(50% + 4px)" : 16,
                      width: "auto",
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      boxShadow: 3,
                      bgcolor: "rgba(139, 0, 0, 0.9)",
                      backdropFilter: "blur(4px)",
                      "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" },
                    }}
                  >
                    Góc nhìn 3D
                  </Button>
                  {book.shelf_location ? (
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      color="success"
                      startIcon={<LocationOnIcon />}
                      onClick={() => setShowVR(true)}
                      sx={{
                        position: "absolute",
                        bottom: 16,
                        left: "calc(50% + 4px)",
                        right: 16,
                        width: "auto",
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        boxShadow: 3,
                        bgcolor: "rgba(16,185,129,0.9)",
                        backdropFilter: "blur(4px)",
                      }}
                    >
                      Chỉ đường đến kệ
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                </Box>

                <Box sx={{ p: 2.5 }}>
                  <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}>
                    <StatCard label="Tổng" value={book.total_copies} color="primary" icon={<GridViewIcon fontSize="small" />} />
                    <StatCard label="Sẵn sàng" value={book.available_copies} color="success" icon={<VerifiedIcon fontSize="small" />} />
                    <StatCard label="Đang mượn" value={borrowed} color="warning" icon={<MenuBookIcon fontSize="small" />} />
                  </Stack>

                  <Divider sx={{ mb: 1.5 }} />

                  <Box>
                    <MetaItem
                      icon={<GridViewIcon fontSize="small" />}
                      label="ISBN-13"
                      value={book.isbn13 || book.isbn}
                    />
                    {book.isbn10 ? (
                      <MetaItem icon={<GridViewIcon fontSize="small" />} label="ISBN-10" value={book.isbn10} />
                    ) : null}
                    {book.shelf_location ? (
                      <MetaItem icon={<LocationOnIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Vị trí" value={book.shelf_location} />
                    ) : null}
                    {book.language ? (
                      <MetaItem icon={<LanguageIcon fontSize="small" />} label="Ngôn ngữ" value={book.language} />
                    ) : null}
                    {book.price != null ? (
                      <MetaItem
                        icon={<PaymentsIcon fontSize="small" />}
                        label="Giá bìa"
                        value={`${Number(book.price).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} đ`}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                  </Box>
                </Box>
              </DashboardCard>
            </Grid>

            <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 8 }} sx={staggerSx(1)}>
              <Stack spacing={3}>
                <DashboardCard title="Chi tiết sách">
                  <Stack spacing={2}>
                    {book.author ? (
                      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                        <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary">
                          Tác giả:
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {book.author}
                        </Typography>
                      </Stack>
                    ) : null}

                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 1 }}>
                      {book.publisher ? (
                        <Chip icon={<MenuBookIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />} label={book.publisher} size="small" variant="outlined" />
                      ) : null}
                      {book.published_date ? (
                        <Chip
                          icon={<CalendarTodayIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                          label={book.published_date}
                          size="small"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ) : null}
                      {book.page_count ? (
                        <Chip
                          icon={<DescriptionIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                          label={`${book.page_count} trang`}
                          size="small"
                          variant="outlined"
                        />
                      ) : null}
                      {book.average_rating ? (
                        <Chip
                          icon={<StarIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                          label={`${book.average_rating}/5`}
                          size="small"
                          variant="outlined"
                          color="warning"
                        />
                      ) : null}
                      {book.categories ? (
                        <Chip
                          icon={<CategoryIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                          label={book.categories}
                          size="small"
                          variant="outlined"
                          sx={{ bgcolor: "primary.main", color: "primary.contrastText", borderColor: "primary.main" }}
                        />
                      ) : null}
                    </Stack>
                  </Stack>
                </DashboardCard>

                <Box sx={staggerSx(2)}>
                  <BookCopiesTable
                    bookId={book.id}
                    isbn={book.isbn13 || book.isbn}
                    copies={copies}
                    loading={copiesLoading}
                    onRefresh={() => {
                      fetchCopies();
                      api.getBookById(bookId).then(setBook);
                    }}
                    showNotice={showNotice}
                  />
                </Box>

                {book.description ? (
                  <Box sx={staggerSx(2)}>
                    <DashboardCard title="Mô tả">
                    <Box
                      sx={{
                        bgcolor: "grey.900",
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        position: "relative",
                        maxHeight: descExpanded ? "none" : 200,
                        overflow: "hidden",
                      }}
                    >
                      <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", lineHeight: 1.8, color: "common.white" }}>
                        {book.description}
                      </Typography>
                      {isLongDescription ? (
                        <Box
                          sx={{
                            position: "absolute",
                            bottom: 0,
                            left: 0,
                            right: 0,
                            height: 60,
                            background: descExpanded ? "transparent" : `linear-gradient(transparent, ${theme.palette.grey[900]})`,
                            display: "flex",
                            alignItems: "flex-end",
                            justifyContent: "center",
                            pb: 1,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Button
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => setDescExpanded(!descExpanded)}
                            endIcon={descExpanded ? <CloseIcon /> : <ExpandIcon />}
                            sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }}
                          >
                            {descExpanded ? "Thu gọn" : "Xem thêm"}
                          </Button>
                        </Box>
                      ) : null}
                    </Box>
                  </DashboardCard>
                  </Box>
                ) : null}

                <Box
                  sx={{
                    display: "grid",
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "1fr 1fr" },
                    gap: 2,
                    ...staggerSx(3),
                  }}
                >
                  <DashboardCard>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                      Ngày tạo
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mt: 0.5 }}>
                      {book.created_at ? new Date(book.created_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "long", year: "numeric" }) : "-"}
                    </Typography>
                  </DashboardCard>
                  <DashboardCard>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
                      Ngày cập nhật
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body1" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mt: 0.5 }}>
                      {book.updated_at ? new Date(book.updated_at).toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { day: "2-digit", month: "long", year: "numeric" }) : "-"}
                    </Typography>
                  </DashboardCard>
                </Box>

                <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ mt: 1, ...staggerSx(4) }}>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    size="large"
                    startIcon={<MenuBookIcon />}
                    onClick={() => router.push(`/borrow?barcode=${book.isbn}`)}
                    sx={{ flex: 1, py: 1.5, fontWeight: 700 }}
                  >
                    Mượn sách
                  </Button>
                  <Tooltip title="Chỉnh sửa thông tin sách">
                    <Button
                      variant="outlined"
                      size="large"
                      startIcon={<EditIcon />}
                      onClick={openEdit}
                      sx={{ py: 1.5 }}
                    >
                      Sửa
                    </Button>
                  </Tooltip>
                </Stack>
              </Stack>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          <Dialog open={show3D} onClose={() => setShow3D(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
            <DialogTitle sx={{ m: 0, p: 2, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <Typography variant="h6">Góc nhìn 3D</Typography>
              <IconButton onClick={() => setShow3D(false)}>
                <CloseIcon />
              </IconButton>
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent dividers sx={{ p: 0, overflow: "hidden" }}>
              {show3D ? <Book3DViewer coverUrl={book.cover_url || "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/69/1-2-3-go-book-cover.jpg/2560px-1-2-3-go-book-cover.jpg"} /> : null}
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>

          <Dialog open={showVR} onClose={() => setShowVR(false)} maxWidth="lg" fullWidth fullScreen>
            <DialogTitle sx={{ m: 0, p: 2, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", bgcolor: "#0f172a", color: "white" }}>
              <Typography variant="h6">Chỉ đường đến kệ — {book.shelf_location}</Typography>
              <IconButton onClick={() => setShowVR(false)} sx={{ color: "white" }}>
                <CloseIcon />
              </IconButton>
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent dividers sx={{ p: 0, overflow: "hidden" }}>
              {showVR ? <VRViewer /> : null}
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>

          <Dialog open={editOpen} onClose={() => setEditOpen(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
            <DialogTitle sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Chỉnh sửa thông tin sách
              <IconButton onClick={() => setEditOpen(false)} size="small"><CloseIcon /></IconButton>
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent dividers sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
              <Stack spacing={2.5}>
                <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={2}>
                  <TextField
                    label="Tiêu đề"
                    required
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.title || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("title", e.target.value)}
                    error={!!editErrors.title}
                    helperText={editErrors.title}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Số lượng tồn kho"
                    type="number"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.quantity ?? 0}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("quantity", e.target.value)}
                    error={!!editErrors.quantity}
                    helperText={editErrors.quantity}
                  />
                </Stack>
                <TextField
                  label="Phụ đề"
                  fullWidth
                  value={editForm.subtitle || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("subtitle", e.target.value)}
                />
                <TextField
                  label="Tác giả"
                  fullWidth
                  value={editForm.author || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("author", e.target.value)}
                />
                <TextField
                  label="Nhà xuất bản"
                  fullWidth
                  value={editForm.publisher || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("publisher", e.target.value)}
                />
                <TextField
                  label="Ngày xuất bản"
                  fullWidth
                  value={editForm.published_date || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("published_date", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="VD: 2024-01-01"
                />
                <TextField
                  label="Mô tả"
                  fullWidth
                  multiline
                  minRows={4}
                  value={editForm.description || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("description", e.target.value)}
                />
                <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={2}>
                  <TextField
                    label="Số trang"
                    type="number"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.page_count ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("page_count", e.target.value)}
                    error={!!editErrors.page_count}
                    helperText={editErrors.page_count}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Danh mục"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.categories || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("categories", e.target.value)}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Đánh giá (0-5)"
                    type="number"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.average_rating ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("average_rating", e.target.value)}
                    error={!!editErrors.average_rating}
                    helperText={editErrors.average_rating}
                  />
                </Stack>
                <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }} spacing={2}>
                  <TextField
                    label="Ngôn ngữ"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.language || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("language", e.target.value)}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Vị trí kệ"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.shelf_location || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("shelf_location", e.target.value)}
                  />
                  <TextField
                    label="Giá bìa (VNĐ)"
                    type="number"
                    fullWidth
                    value={editForm.price ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("price", e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="VD: 150000"
                    error={!!editErrors.price}
                    helperText={editErrors.price}
                  />
                </Stack>
                <TextField
                  label="URL ảnh bìa"
                  fullWidth
                  value={editForm.cover_url || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => handleEditChange("cover_url", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="https://..."
                  error={!!editErrors.cover_url}
                  helperText={editErrors.cover_url}
                />
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: 1.5 }}>
              <Button onClick={() => setEditOpen(false)} disabled={editSaving}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                onClick={handleEditSave}
                disabled={editSaving || !editForm.title?.trim()}
                startIcon={editSaving ? <CircularProgress size={16} /> : null}
              >
                {editSaving ? "Đang lưu..." : "Lưu"}
              </Button>
            </Box>
          </Dialog>

          <Dialog open={showDelete} onClose={() => { setShowDelete(false); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }} fullWidth maxWidth="xs">
            <DialogTitle>Xóa sách?</DialogTitle>
            <DialogContent>
              <Stack spacing={2}>
                <Typography color="text.secondary">
                  Sách <strong>{book.title}</strong> sẽ bị xóa khỏi hệ thống. Hành động này không thể hoàn tác.
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  Nhập <strong>XÓA</strong> để xác nhận:
                </Typography>
                <TextField
                  value={deleteConfirmText}
                  onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirmText(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Nhập XÓA"
                  size="small"
                  autoFocus
                  fullWidth
                />
              </Stack>
            </DialogContent>
            <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: 1.5 }}>
              <Button onClick={() => { setShowDelete(false); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }}>Hủy</Button>
              <Button color="error" variant="contained" onClick={handleDelete} disabled={deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA"}>
                Xóa vĩnh viễn
              </Button>
            </Box>
          </Dialog>

          <Snackbar
            open={Boolean(notice)}
            autoHideDuration={4000}
            onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
            anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
          >
            {notice ? (
              <Alert
                onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
                severity={notice.severity}
                variant="filled"
                sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: "8px", boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}
              >
                {notice.message}
              </Alert>
            ) : undefined}
          </Snackbar>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </LoadingOverlay>
  );
}

================

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Alert,
  Box,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  Chip,
  Fade,
  IconButton,
  LinearProgress,
  Paper,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TablePagination,
  TableRow,
  TableSortLabel,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import AssignmentIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AssignmentOutlined";
import BookIcon from "@mui/icons-material/MenuBookOutlined";
import CheckIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlineOutlined";
import DescriptionIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined";
import TableChartIcon from "@mui/icons-material/TableChartOutlined";
import InventoryIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Inventory2Outlined";
import LibraryIcon from "@mui/icons-material/LocalLibraryOutlined";
import PrintIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PrintOutlined";
import QrCodeScannerIcon from "@mui/icons-material/QrCodeScannerOutlined";
import UploadIcon from "@mui/icons-material/UploadFileOutlined";
import EditNoteOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EditNoteOutlined";
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined";

import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import DashboardCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/DashboardCard";
import MuiStatCard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/MuiStatCard";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import SearchField from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/SearchField";
import IsbnScannerDialog from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/IsbnScannerDialog";
import type { BookImportPreviewRow, BookImportResultRow, BookWithStats } from "@/lib/types";

import {
  BookQuantityDialog,
  BookBulkDeleteDialog,
  BookImportPreviewSection,
  BookImportResultSection,
} from "../_components/books";

type Notice = { severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info"; message: string } | null;

export default function BooksPage() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canCreateBook = can("books", "create");
  const canUpdateBook = can("books", "update");
  const canDeleteBook = can("books", "delete");
  const canReadBook = can("books", "read");
  const canPrintBook = can("books", "print");

  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice>(null);
  const router = useRouter();
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [books, setBooks] = useState<BookWithStats[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [aggregateStats, setAggregateStats] = useState<{ totalCopies: number; availableCopies: number; borrowedCopies: number } | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<BookWithStats[]>([]);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewData, setPreviewData] = useState<BookImportPreviewRow[] | null>(null);
  const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPreviewIndices, setSelectedPreviewIndices] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [importResults, setImportResults] = useState<BookImportResultRow[] | null>(null);
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = useState(false);
  const [recentlyPrinted, setRecentlyPrinted] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const limit = 30;
  const [selectedBook, setSelectedBook] = useState<BookWithStats | null>(null);
  const [editQuantity, setEditQuantity] = useState(0);
  const [savingQuantity, setSavingQuantity] = useState(false);
  const [quantityError, setQuantityError] = useState("");
  const [isbnScannerOpen, setIsbnScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [deleteConfirmOpen, setDeleteConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteInput, setDeleteInput] = useState("");
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const deleteConfirmed = deleteInput === "XÓA";

  const showNotice = useCallback((severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info", message: string) => {
    setNotice({ severity, message });
  }, []);

  const showNoticeRef = useRef(showNotice);
  useEffect(() => {
    showNoticeRef.current = showNotice;
  }, [showNotice]);

  const loadBooks = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [res, statsRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.listBooks({ skip: page * limit, limit }),
        typeof (api as any).getBookStats === "function" ? (api as any).getBookStats().catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null),
      ]);
      setBooks(res.items);
      setTotal(res.total);
      if (statsRes) {
        setAggregateStats({
          totalCopies: statsRes.totalCopies,
          availableCopies: statsRes.availableCopies,
          borrowedCopies: statsRes.borrowedCopies,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showNoticeRef.current("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể tải danh sách sách");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, limit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadBooks();
  }, [loadBooks]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      setSearchResults([]);
      setSearching(false);
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setSearching(true);
      try {
        const results = await api.searchBooks(searchQuery);
        setSearchResults(results);
      } catch (err) {
        showNoticeRef.current("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Tìm kiếm thất bại");
      } finally {
        setSearching(false);
      }
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setPreviewFile(file);
    setPreviewLoading(true);
    setPreviewData(null);
    setSelectedPreviewIndices(new Set());
    try {
      const data = await api.getBarcodePreview(file);
      setPreviewData(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.rows);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể đọc file");
      setPreviewFile(null);
    } finally {
      setPreviewLoading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const handleImport = async () => {
    if (!previewFile) return;
    setImporting(true);
    setShowResults(false);
    try {
      let result;
      if (previewData && previewData.length > 0) {
        result = await api.importBooksFiltered(previewData.map((row) => ({
          isbn: row.isbn,
          quantity: row.quantity,
          title: row.title,
          subtitle: row.subtitle ?? null,
          author: row.author ?? null,
          publisher: row.publisher ?? null,
          published_date: row.published_date ?? null,
          page_count: row.page_count ?? null,
          categories: row.categories ?? null,
          cover_url: row.cover_url ?? null,
          description: (row as any).description ?? null,
          average_rating: (row as any).average_rating ?? null,
          language: (row as any).language ?? null,
          isbn10: (row as any).isbn10 ?? null,
          isbn13: (row as any).isbn13 ?? null,
        })));
      } else {
        result = await api.importBooks(previewFile);
      }
      setImportResults(result.results);
      setShowResults(true);
      setPreviewData(null);
      setPreviewFile(null);
      setSearchQuery("");
      setPage(0);
      await loadBooks();
      showNotice(result.errors === 0 ? "success" : "warning", result.errors === 0
        ? `Đã nhập ${result.imported} đầu sách`
        : `${result.imported} nhập thành công, ${result.errors} lỗi`);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi nhập kho");
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuantitySave = async () => {
    if (!selectedBook) return;
    const borrowed = selectedBook.total_copies - selectedBook.available_copies;
    if (editQuantity < borrowed) {
      setQuantityError(`Tối thiểu ${borrowed} bản vì đang có ${borrowed} bản được mượn`);
      return;
    }
    if (editQuantity < 1) {
      setQuantityError("Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0");
      return;
    }
    setSavingQuantity(true);
    try {
      const updated = await api.updateBookQuantity(selectedBook.id, editQuantity);
      setBooks((prev) => prev.map((book) => book.id === updated.id ? updated : book));
      setSearchResults((prev) => prev.map((book) => book.id === updated.id ? updated : book));
      showNotice("success", `Đã cập nhật số lượng: ${updated.total_copies} bản`);
      setSelectedBook(null);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Cập nhật thất bại");
    } finally {
      setSavingQuantity(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrintBarcodes = async (bookId?: string) => {
    try {
      const barcodes = await api.getBarcodes(bookId);
      if (barcodes.length === 0) {
        showNotice("info", "Không tìm thấy mã vạch để in");
        return;
      }
      setRecentlyPrinted(barcodes.map((item) => item.barcode));
      showNotice("success", `${barcodes.length} mã vạch sẵn sàng in`);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể lấy mã vạch");
    }
  };

  const handleIsbnImportComplete = (results: BookImportResultRow[]) => {
    setIsbnScannerOpen(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
    setPage(0);
    loadBooks();
    const importedCount = results.filter((r) => r.status === "imported" || r.status === "updated").length;
    const errorCount = results.filter((r) => r.status === "error").length;
    if (errorCount === 0) {
      showNotice("success", `Đã nhập ${importedCount} đầu sách từ ISBN`);
    } else {
      showNotice("warning", `${importedCount} thành công, ${errorCount} lỗi`);
    }
  };

  const openQuantityDialog = (book: BookWithStats) => {
    setSelectedBook(book);
    setEditQuantity(book.total_copies);
    setQuantityError("");
  };

  const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
    if (selectedIds.size === 0) return;
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      const result = await api.bulkDeleteBooks(Array.from(selectedIds));
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      setDeleteConfirmOpen(false);
      setDeleteInput("");
      setPage(0);
      await loadBooks();
      if (result.errors.length === 0) {
        showNotice("success", `Đã xóa ${result.deleted} cuốn sách`);
      } else {
        showNotice("warning", `Xóa ${result.deleted} thành công, ${result.errors.length} lỗi: ${result.errors.join("; ")}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Xóa thất bại");
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  const stats = aggregateStats
    ? {
        totalBooks: total,
        totalCopies: aggregateStats.totalCopies,
        availableCopies: aggregateStats.availableCopies,
        borrowedCopies: aggregateStats.borrowedCopies,
      }
    : {
        totalBooks: total,
        totalCopies: books.reduce((sum, book) => sum + book.total_copies, 0),
        availableCopies: books.reduce((sum, book) => sum + book.available_copies, 0),
        borrowedCopies: books.reduce((sum, book) => sum + (book.total_copies - book.available_copies), 0),
      };
  const displayBooks = searchQuery.trim() ? searchResults : books;

  const [orderBy, setOrderBy] = useState<string>("title");
  const [order, setOrder] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("asc");

  const handleRequestSort = (property: string) => {
    const isAsc = orderBy === property && order === "asc";
    setOrder(isAsc ? "desc" : "asc");
    setOrderBy(property);
  };

  const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => {
    const list = [...displayBooks];
    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA: any = "";
      let valB: any = "";
      if (orderBy === "isbn") {
        valA = a.isbn || "";
        valB = b.isbn || "";
      } else if (orderBy === "title") {
        valA = a.title || "";
        valB = b.title || "";
      } else if (orderBy === "author") {
        valA = a.author || "";
        valB = b.author || "";
      } else if (orderBy === "total_copies") {
        valA = a.total_copies ?? 0;
        valB = b.total_copies ?? 0;
      } else if (orderBy === "available_copies") {
        valA = a.available_copies ?? 0;
        valB = b.available_copies ?? 0;
      } else if (orderBy === "borrowed") {
        valA = a.total_copies - a.available_copies;
        valB = b.total_copies - b.available_copies;
      }
      if (typeof valA === "number" && typeof valB === "number") {
        return order === "asc" ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
      }
      return order === "asc"
        ? String(valA).localeCompare(String(valB))
        : String(valB).localeCompare(String(valA));
    });
    return list;
  }, [displayBooks, orderBy, order]);

  const isAllSelected = displayBooks.length > 0 && displayBooks.every((b) => selectedIds.has(b.id));
  const isSomeSelected = displayBooks.some((b) => selectedIds.has(b.id)) && !isAllSelected;

  const handleSelectAll = (checked: boolean) => {
    if (checked) {
      const newSelected = new Set(selectedIds);
      displayBooks.forEach((b) => newSelected.add(b.id));
      setSelectedIds(newSelected);
    } else {
      const newSelected = new Set(selectedIds);
      displayBooks.forEach((b) => newSelected.delete(b.id));
      setSelectedIds(newSelected);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectOne = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const next = new Set(selectedIds);
    if (next.has(id)) {
      next.delete(id);
    } else {
      next.add(id);
    }
    setSelectedIds(next);
  };

  const outOfStockCount = books.filter((b) => b.available_copies === 0).length;

  const statItems = [
    {
      label: "SẴN SÀNG PHỤC VỤ",
      value: stats.availableCopies,
      gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
      icon: CheckIcon,
      pct: stats.totalCopies > 0 ? Math.round((stats.availableCopies / stats.totalCopies) * 100) : 0,
      delta: stats.totalCopies > 0 ? `${Math.round((stats.availableCopies / stats.totalCopies) * 100)}% tổng số ${stats.totalCopies.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} bản sao` : undefined,
      deltaColor: "success" as const,
    },
    {
      label: "ĐANG ĐƯỢC MƯỢN",
      value: stats.borrowedCopies,
      gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
      icon: AssignmentIcon,
      pct: stats.totalCopies > 0 ? Math.round((stats.borrowedCopies / stats.totalCopies) * 100) : 0,
      delta: stats.totalCopies > 0 ? `${Math.round((stats.borrowedCopies / stats.totalCopies) * 100)}% tổng kho` : undefined,
      deltaColor: "warning" as const,
    },
    {
      label: "HẾT BẢN SAO SẴN CÓ",
      value: outOfStockCount,
      gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
      icon: InventoryIcon,
      delta: outOfStockCount > 0 ? `${outOfStockCount} đầu sách cần bổ sung` : "Tất cả sách đều sẵn có",
      deltaColor: outOfStockCount > 0 ? ("error" as const) : ("success" as const),
    },
    {
      label: "TỔNG ĐẦU SÁCH",
      value: stats.totalBooks,
      gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B89628 100%)",
      icon: LibraryIcon,
      delta: `${stats.totalCopies.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} tổng số bản sao`,
      deltaColor: "default" as const,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2.5}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Quản lý Kho Sách"
        subtitle="Quản lý thông tin sách, bản sao và nhập kho tự động bằng Excel"
        icon={BookIcon}
        statBadges={`${total} đầu sách trong hệ thống`}
        onRefresh={() => { setPage(0); setSearchQuery(""); loadBooks(); }}
        actions={
          <>
            <Tooltip title="Tải mẫu">
              <IconButton
                onClick={() => api.downloadBookTemplate()}
                size="small"
                sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}
              >
                <DescriptionIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>
            <Tooltip title={!canReadBook ? getPermissionDeniedReason("books", "read") : "Xuất Excel"}>
              <span>
                <IconButton
                  disabled={!canReadBook}
                  onClick={() => api.exportBooks()}
                  size="small"
                  sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider" }}
                >
                  <TableChartIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          </>
        }
      />

      <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(4, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
        {statItems.map((item, idx) => (
          <MuiStatCard
            key={item.label}
            label={item.label}
            value={item.value}
            icon={item.icon}
            gradient={item.gradient}
            pct={item.pct}
            delta={item.delta}
            deltaColor={item.deltaColor}
            index={idx}
          />
        ))}
      </Box>

      <DashboardCard>
        <Stack direction={{ xs: "column", lg: "row" }} spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: { lg: "center" } }}>
          <SearchField
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={setSearchQuery}
            placeholder="Tìm kiếm sách theo ISBN, tên, tác giả..."
            sx={{ flexGrow: 1, minWidth: 240, "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: "4px", bgcolor: "background.paper", "&:hover": { "& fieldset": { borderColor: "primary.main" } } } }}
          />
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 1 }}>
            <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept=".xlsx,.xls" hidden onChange={handleFileChange} />
            <Tooltip title={!canCreateBook ? getPermissionDeniedReason("books", "create") : ""}>
              <span>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  disabled={!canCreateBook}
                  startIcon={<UploadIcon />}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!canCreateBook) return;
                    fileInputRef.current?.click();
                  }}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: "4px", fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Nhập Excel
                </Button>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
            <Tooltip title={!canCreateBook ? getPermissionDeniedReason("books", "create") : ""}>
              <span>
                <Button
                  variant="outlined"
                  disabled={!canCreateBook}
                  startIcon={<QrCodeScannerIcon />}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!canCreateBook) return;
                    setIsbnScannerOpen(true);
                  }}
                  sx={{ borderRadius: "4px", fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "none" }}
                >
                  Quét ISBN
                </Button>
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </DashboardCard>

      {searchQuery.trim() ? (
        <DashboardCard>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                Kết quả tìm kiếm: <strong>{searchResults.length}</strong> cuốn sách
              </Typography>
            </Stack>
            {searchResults.length > 0 ? (
              <Tooltip title={!canPrintBook ? getPermissionDeniedReason("books", "print") : ""}>
                <span>
                  <Button
                    color="primary"
                    size="small"
                    disabled={!canPrintBook}
                    startIcon={<PrintIcon />}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!canPrintBook) return;
                      handlePrintBarcodes();
                    }}
                    sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600 }}
                  >
                    In mã vạch
                  </Button>
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            ) : null}
          </Stack>
        </DashboardCard>
      ) : null}

      {/* Book Import Preview Component */}
      <BookImportPreviewSection
        previewFile={previewFile}
        previewData={previewData}
        setPreviewData={setPreviewData}
        selectedPreviewIndices={selectedPreviewIndices}
        setSelectedPreviewIndices={setSelectedPreviewIndices}
        onCancel={() => {
          setPreviewFile(null);
          setPreviewData(null);
          setSelectedPreviewIndices(new Set());
        }}
        onImport={handleImport}
        importing={importing}
        showNotice={showNotice}
      />

      {/* Book Import Result Component */}
      <BookImportResultSection
        showResults={showResults}
        importResults={importResults}
        onPrintBarcodes={() => handlePrintBarcodes()}
        canPrint={canPrintBook}
      />

      {recentlyPrinted.length > 0 ? (
        <DashboardCard title={`Mã vạch sẵn sàng in (${recentlyPrinted.length})`}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {recentlyPrinted.map((barcode) => (
              <Chip key={barcode} label={barcode} sx={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace" }} />
            ))}
          </Stack>
        </DashboardCard>
      ) : null}

      <DashboardCard noPadding>
        {loading && <LinearProgress color="primary" sx={{ height: 3 }} />}
        <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: "auto", maxHeight: 720 }}>
          <Table size="small" stickyHeader sx={{ minWidth: 800 }}>
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow sx={{ bgcolor: "background.neutral" }}>
                <TableCell padding="checkbox">
                  <Checkbox
                    indeterminate={isSomeSelected}
                    checked={isAllSelected}
                    onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                    size="small"
                  />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 130 }}>
                  <TableSortLabel
                    active={orderBy === "isbn"}
                    direction={orderBy === "isbn" ? order : "asc"}
                    onClick={() => handleRequestSort("isbn")}
                  >
                    ISBN
                  </TableSortLabel>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 260 }}>
                  <TableSortLabel
                    active={orderBy === "title"}
                    direction={orderBy === "title" ? order : "asc"}
                    onClick={() => handleRequestSort("title")}
                  >
                    Tiêu đề sách
                  </TableSortLabel>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 150 }}>
                  <TableSortLabel
                    active={orderBy === "author"}
                    direction={orderBy === "author" ? order : "asc"}
                    onClick={() => handleRequestSort("author")}
                  >
                    Tác giả
                  </TableSortLabel>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 130 }}>
                  Nhà xuất bản
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 80 }}>
                  <TableSortLabel
                    active={orderBy === "total_copies"}
                    direction={orderBy === "total_copies" ? order : "asc"}
                    onClick={() => handleRequestSort("total_copies")}
                  >
                    Tổng
                  </TableSortLabel>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 100 }}>
                  <TableSortLabel
                    active={orderBy === "available_copies"}
                    direction={orderBy === "available_copies" ? order : "asc"}
                    onClick={() => handleRequestSort("available_copies")}
                  >
                    Sẵn sàng
                  </TableSortLabel>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell align="center" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 80 }}>
                  <TableSortLabel
                    active={orderBy === "borrowed"}
                    direction={orderBy === "borrowed" ? order : "asc"}
                    onClick={() => handleRequestSort("borrowed")}
                  >
                    Mượn
                  </TableSortLabel>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell align="right" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 90 }}>
                  Thao tác
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {sortedBooks.length === 0 ? (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={9} sx={{ py: 6, textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <EmptyState
                      icon={<BookIcon fontSize="large" />}
                      title={searchQuery ? "Không tìm thấy sách phù hợp" : "Chưa có sách nào trong hệ thống"}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ) : (
                sortedBooks.map((record: BookWithStats) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedIds.has(record.id);
                  const borrowed = record.total_copies - record.available_copies;
                  return (
                    <TableRow
                      key={record.id}
                      hover
                      selected={isSelected}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "test") {
                          openQuantityDialog(record);
                        } else {
                          router.push(`/books/${record.id}`);
                        }
                      }}
                      sx={{
                        cursor: "pointer",
                        "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" },
                        transition: "background-color 0.15s ease",
                      }}
                    >
                      <TableCell padding="checkbox" onClick={(e) => handleSelectOne(record.id, e)}>
                        <Checkbox checked={isSelected} size="small" />
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Typography
                          variant="caption"
                          sx={{
                            fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
                            color: "primary.main",
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            letterSpacing: 0.5,
                          }}
                        >
                          {record.isbn || "-"}
                        </Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                          {record.cover_url ? (
                            <Box
                              component="img"
                              src={record.cover_url}
                              alt={record.title}
                              sx={{
                                width: 34,
                                height: 46,
                                objectFit: "cover",
                                borderRadius: "4px",
                                border: "1px solid",
                                borderColor: "divider",
                                flexShrink: 0,
                              }}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <Paper
                              variant="outlined"
                              sx={{
                                width: 34,
                                height: 46,
                                display: "grid",
                                placeItems: "center",
                                bgcolor: "background.default",
                                borderRadius: "4px",
                                flexShrink: 0,
                              }}
                            >
                              <BookIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: "text.secondary" }} />
                            </Paper>
                          )}
                          <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                            <Typography
                              variant="body2"
                              sx={{
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                overflow: "hidden",
                                textOverflow: "ellipsis",
                                display: "-webkit-box",
                                WebkitLineClamp: 2,
                                WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical",
                              }}
                            >
                              {record.title}
                            </Typography>
                          </Box>
                        </Stack>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          {record.author || "-"}
                        </Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                          {record.publisher || "-"}
                        </Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell align="center">
                        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {record.total_copies}
                        </Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell align="center">
                        <Chip
                          size="small"
                          color={record.available_copies > 0 ? "success" : "error"}
                          variant={record.available_copies > 0 ? "filled" : "outlined"}
                          label={record.available_copies}
                          sx={{ fontWeight: 700, minWidth: 36 }}
                        />
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell align="center">
                        <Typography variant="body2" color={borrowed > 0 ? "warning.main" : "text.secondary"} sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {borrowed}
                        </Typography>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell align="right" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
                          <Tooltip title={!canUpdateBook ? getPermissionDeniedReason("books", "update") : "Chỉnh số lượng"}>
                            <span>
                              <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={!canUpdateBook}
                                onClick={() => {
                                  if (!canUpdateBook) return;
                                  openQuantityDialog(record);
                                }}
                                sx={{ color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { color: "primary.main" } }}
                              >
                                <EditNoteOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                              </IconButton>
                            </span>
                          </Tooltip>
                          <Tooltip title="Chi tiết sách">
                            <IconButton
                              size="small"
                              onClick={() => router.push(`/books/${record.id}`)}
                              sx={{ color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { color: "primary.main" } }}
                            >
                              <VisibilityOutlinedIcon fontSize="small" />
                            </IconButton>
                          </Tooltip>
                        </Stack>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>

        {!searchQuery && total > limit ? (
          <TablePagination
            component="div"
            count={total}
            page={page}
            onPageChange={(_, newPage) => setPage(newPage)}
            rowsPerPage={limit}
            rowsPerPageOptions={[limit]}
            labelDisplayedRows={({ from, to, count }) => `${from}–${to} trên ${count !== -1 ? count : `hơn ${to}`} đầu sách`}
            sx={{ borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </DashboardCard>

      {/* Book Quantity Dialog Component */}
      <BookQuantityDialog
        selectedBook={selectedBook}
        onClose={() => setSelectedBook(null)}
        editQuantity={editQuantity}
        setEditQuantity={setEditQuantity}
        quantityError={quantityError}
        setQuantityError={setQuantityError}
        onSave={handleQuantitySave}
        savingQuantity={savingQuantity}
      />

      <Snackbar
        open={Boolean(notice)}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        {notice ? (
          <Alert
            onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
            severity={notice.severity}
            variant="filled"
            sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: "8px", boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}
          >
            {notice.message}
          </Alert>
        ) : undefined}
      </Snackbar>

      <IsbnScannerDialog
        open={isbnScannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsbnScannerOpen(false)}
        onImportComplete={handleIsbnImportComplete}
      />

      {/* Floating Selection Bar */}
      <Fade in={selectedIds.size > 0}>
        <Paper
          elevation={4}
          sx={{
            position: "fixed",
            bottom: { xs: 12, sm: 24 },
            left: "50%",
            transform: "translateX(-50%)",
            zIndex: 1300,
            maxWidth: "calc(100vw - 32px)",
            width: "auto",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 1.5,
            px: { xs: 1.5, sm: 3 },
            py: 1.5,
            borderRadius: "4px",
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
            border: "1px solid",
            borderColor: "warning.main",
            boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)",
          }}
        >
          <Chip
            label={`${selectedIds.size} đã chọn`}
            color="warning"
            size="small"
            sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}
          />
          <Button
            size="small"
            variant="text"
            color="inherit"
            onClick={() => setSelectedIds(new Set())}
            sx={{ textTransform: "none" }}
          >
            Bỏ chọn
          </Button>
          <Tooltip title={!canDeleteBook ? getPermissionDeniedReason("books", "delete") : ""}>
            <span>
              <Button
                size="small"
                variant="contained"
                color="error"
                disabled={!canDeleteBook}
                startIcon={<DeleteIcon />}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!canDeleteBook) return;
                  setDeleteInput("");
                  setDeleteConfirmOpen(true);
                }}
                sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700 }}
              >
                Xóa
              </Button>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        </Paper>
      </Fade>

      {/* Book Bulk Delete Dialog Component */}
      <BookBulkDeleteDialog
        open={deleteConfirmOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setDeleteConfirmOpen(false);
          setDeleteInput("");
        }}
        selectedIds={selectedIds}
        displayBooks={displayBooks}
        deleteInput={deleteInput}
        setDeleteInput={setDeleteInput}
        deleteConfirmed={deleteConfirmed}
        deleting={deleting}
        onDelete={handleBulkDelete}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}
