"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  AlertTitle,
  Box,
  Button,
  Paper,
  Slide,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  Step,
  StepButton,
  StepLabel,
  Stepper,
  useTheme,
} from "@mui/material";
import BorrowIcon from "@mui/icons-material/AssignmentIndOutlined";
import RefreshIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshOutlined";

import BorrowScannerDialog from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/BorrowScannerDialog";
import BorrowIPCameraDialog from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/BorrowIPCameraDialog";
import OverdueGuideModal from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/OverdueGuideModal";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { useTaskSSE } from "@/lib/hooks/useTaskSSE";
import { slideInRight } from "@/lib/animations";
import { staggerSx } from "@/lib/useStaggeredAnimation";
import { getAlertSeverity, getAlertTitle } from "@/lib/alert-utils";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";

import {
  BorrowStepPatron,
  BorrowStepScanBooks,
  BorrowStepConfirm,
  BorrowStepSuccess,
  type BorrowCartItem,
} from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/borrow";

export default function BorrowPage() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const [snackbar, setSnackbar] = useState<{
    open: boolean;
    message: string;
    severity: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info";
  }>({
    open: false,
    message: "",
    severity: "info",
  });

  const showNotice = useCallback((type: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info", msg: string) => {
    setSnackbar({
      open: true,
      message: msg,
      severity: type,
    });
  }, []);

  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState<number>(0);

  // Patron state
  const [patronCode, setPatronCode] = useState("");
  const [patronId, setPatronId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [patronName, setPatronName] = useState("");
  const [activeCount, setActiveCount] = useState(0);
  const [overdueCount, setOverdueCount] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [checkingIn, setCheckingIn] = useState(false);

  // Cart / Scanned books state (Step 2 & 3)
  const [cartItems, setCartItems] = useState<BorrowCartItem[]>([]);
  const [manualIsbn, setManualIsbn] = useState("");
  const [isLookingUpBook, setIsLookingUpBook] = useState(false);
  const [creatingSlip, setCreatingSlip] = useState(false);
  const [slipSuccess, setSlipSuccess] = useState<{ message: string; count: number } | null>(null);

  // Dialogs
  const [webcamScannerOpen, setWebcamScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [ipScannerOpen, setIpScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [overdueGuideOpen, setOverdueGuideOpen] = useState(false);

  // Camera & Face verify state
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [cameraStarted, setCameraStarted] = useState(false);
  const [cameraLoading, setCameraLoading] = useState(false);
  const [cameraReady, setCameraReady] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const [faceScanning, setFaceScanning] = useState(false);

  const { state: sseState, start: startSSE } = useTaskSSE(30000);
  const [borrowConfig, setBorrowConfig] = useState<{ max_borrow_books: number }>({ max_borrow_books: 3 });

  const borrowCamUrl = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BORROW_CAM_URL;
    if (!raw) return null;
    return `/api/camera/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(raw)}`;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getBorrowConfig().then(setBorrowConfig).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const remaining = borrowConfig.max_borrow_books - activeCount;
  const canBorrow = remaining > 0 && overdueCount === 0;

  const setPatron = useCallback((code: string, id: string, name: string) => {
    setPatronCode(code);
    setPatronId(id);
    setPatronName(name);
  }, []);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setCameraReady(false);
    setCameraStarted(false);
    setCameraLoading(false);
  }, []);

  const startWebcam = useCallback(async () => {
    setCameraError("");
    setCameraStarted(true);
    setCameraLoading(true);
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "user", width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.onloadedmetadata = () => {
          setCameraReady(true);
          setCameraLoading(false);
        };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCameraStarted(false);
      setCameraLoading(false);
      if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") setCameraError("Không có quyền truy cập camera.");
      else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") setCameraError("Không tìm thấy camera.");
      else setCameraError("Không thể khởi động camera.");
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (patronId) {
      stopCamera();
    }
    return () => stopCamera();
  }, [patronId, stopCamera]);

  // Handle SSE result for face verification
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sseState.status === "SUCCESS") {
      const taskResult = sseState.result;
      if (taskResult?.verified) {
        api.getActiveBorrowsByStudentCode(patronCode.trim())
          .then((data) => {
            stopCamera();
            setPatron(patronCode.trim(), data.patron.id, data.patron.full_name || data.patron.student_code);
            setActiveCount(data.total);
            setOverdueCount(data.overdue_count);
            showNotice("success", `Đã xác minh: ${data.patron.full_name || data.patron.student_code}`);
            setFaceScanning(false);
          })
          .catch((err: any) => {
            const status = err?.response?.status || err?.status;
            if (status === 403) {
              setError("Độc giả chưa ở trong thư viện hoặc thẻ đã bị khóa.");
            } else {
              setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể kiểm tra thông tin độc giả");
            }
            setFaceScanning(false);
          });
      } else {
        setError("Khuôn mặt không khớp với độc giả này");
        setFaceScanning(false);
      }
    } else if (sseState.status === "FAILURE" || sseState.status === "ERROR" || sseState.status === "TIMEOUT") {
      setError(sseState.error || "Xác minh thất bại");
      setFaceScanning(false);
    }
  }, [sseState.status, sseState.result, sseState.error, patronCode, stopCamera, setPatron, showNotice]);

  const handleFaceVerify = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current || !patronCode.trim()) return;
    setFaceScanning(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) { setError("Canvas context error"); setFaceScanning(false); return; }
      ctx.translate(canvas.width, 0);
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
        canvas.toBlob((b) => { if (b) resolve(b); else reject(new Error("toBlob failed")); }, "image/jpeg", 0.85);
      });
      const file = new File([blob], "capture.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });

      const lookupResult = await api.lookupPatron(patronCode.trim());
      if (!lookupResult.exists || !lookupResult.patron) {
        setError("Không tìm thấy độc giả"); setFaceScanning(false); return;
      }
      if (lookupResult.is_expired) {
        setError("Thẻ độc giả đã hết hạn"); setFaceScanning(false); return;
      }
      const verifyResult = await api.verifyFace(file, lookupResult.patron.id, true);

      startSSE(verifyResult.job_id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi xác minh khuôn mặt");
      setFaceScanning(false);
    }
  }, [patronCode, startSSE]);

  const handleClearSession = useCallback(() => {
    setPatronId(null);
    setPatronName("");
    setActiveCount(0);
    setOverdueCount(0);
    setPatronCode("");
    setCartItems([]);
    setSlipSuccess(null);
    setCurrentStep(0);
    setError("");
    stopCamera();
  }, [stopCamera]);

  const handleManualPresenceCheckIn = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!patronCode.trim()) return;
    setCheckingIn(true);
    try {
      const lookup = await api.lookupPatron(patronCode.trim());
      if (lookup.patron?.id) {
        await api.kioskPresence(lookup.patron.id, patronCode.trim(), "staff-desk");
        showNotice("success", "Đã xác nhận độc giả có mặt tại quầy!");
        setError("");
        startWebcam();
      } else {
        showNotice("error", "Không tìm thấy thông tin độc giả");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể xác nhận trạng thái có mặt");
    } finally {
      setCheckingIn(false);
    }
  }, [patronCode, showNotice, startWebcam]);

  const handleLookupAndOpenCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!patronCode.trim()) return;
    setError("");
    try {
      const result = await api.lookupPatron(patronCode.trim());
      if (!result.exists) {
        setError("Không tìm thấy độc giả với MSSV này.");
        return;
      }
      if (result.is_expired) {
        setError("Thẻ độc giả đã hết hạn. Vui lòng gia hạn thẻ.");
        return;
      }
      if (result.is_locked) {
        setError("Thẻ độc giả đang bị khóa. Liên hệ quản trị viên.");
        return;
      }
      if (result.patron?.status === "deleted") {
        setError("Độc giả đã bị xóa. Không thể mượn sách.");
        return;
      }
      if (result.patron?.status === "inactive") {
        setError("Thẻ độc giả đang bị tạm khóa. Liên hệ quản trị viên.");
        return;
      }
      startWebcam();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Lỗi kiểm tra thông tin độc giả.");
    }
  }, [patronCode, startWebcam]);

  // Lookup single book item and add to cart
  const handleAddBookToCart = useCallback(async (barcodeOrIsbn: string) => {
    const raw = barcodeOrIsbn.trim();
    if (!raw) return;
    if (!patronId) {
      setError("Vui lòng xác minh độc giả trước khi quét sách.");
      return;
    }
    const normRaw = raw.replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
    if (cartItems.some((item) => {
      const bNorm = item.barcode.replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      const cNorm = (item.copy_barcode || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      const iNorm = (item.isbn || "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "").toLowerCase();
      return bNorm === normRaw || cNorm === normRaw || iNorm === normRaw;
    })) {
      showNotice("warning", "Sách này đã có trong danh sách mượn.");
      setManualIsbn("");
      return;
    }
    if (cartItems.length >= remaining) {
      showNotice("warning", `Độc giả chỉ được mượn thêm tối đa ${remaining} cuốn.`);
      return;
    }

    setIsLookingUpBook(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const isCopy = /^LIB/i.test(raw.replace(/[-\s]/g, ""));
      const result = await api.lookupBorrowSlip({
        patron_id: patronId,
        items: [{ barcode: raw, isbn: isCopy ? undefined : raw }],
      });
      const item = result.items[0];
      if (!item) {
        showNotice("error", `Không tìm thấy sách với mã "${raw}"`);
        return;
      }
      if (!item.can_borrow) {
        const msg = item.reason || "Sách không có sẵn để mượn.";
        const title = item.book?.title;
        showNotice("error", title && !msg.includes(title) ? `Không thể mượn "${title}": ${msg}` : msg);
        return;
      }

      if (item.book?.id && cartItems.some((c) => c.book_id === item.book?.id)) {
        showNotice("warning", `Đầu sách "${item.book.title}" đã có trong danh sách mượn.`);
        return;
      }

      setCartItems((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          barcode: item.barcode,
          isbn: item.isbn || raw,
          loading: false,
          can_borrow: item.can_borrow,
          reason: item.reason,
          book: (item.book as any) || null,
          copy_id: item.copy?.id || null,
          book_id: item.book?.id || null,
          copy_barcode: item.copy?.barcode || null,
          shelf_location: item.copy?.shelf_location || null,
          condition: (item.copy as any)?.condition || null,
          status: (item.copy as any)?.status || null,
        },
      ]);
      setManualIsbn("");
      showNotice("success", `Đã thêm "${item.book?.title || raw}" vào phiếu mượn`);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || `Lỗi tra cứu mã ${raw}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLookingUpBook(false);
    }
  }, [patronId, cartItems, remaining, showNotice]);

  const handleRemoveFromCart = (barcode: string) => {
    setCartItems((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.barcode !== barcode));
  };

  // Confirm and create slip in Step 3
  const handleConfirmBorrowSlip = async () => {
    const validItems = cartItems.filter((i) => i.can_borrow && i.book_id && i.copy_id);
    if (!patronId || validItems.length === 0) return;
    setCreatingSlip(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const confirmResult = await api.confirmBorrowSlip({
        patron_id: patronId,
        items: validItems.map((item) => ({
          barcode: item.copy_barcode || item.barcode,
          isbn: item.isbn,
          book_id: item.book_id!,
          copy_id: item.copy_id!,
        })),
      });
      if (confirmResult.status === "success") {
        setSlipSuccess({
          message: confirmResult.message || "Tạo phiếu mượn thành công!",
          count: validItems.length,
        });
        showNotice("success", "Tạo phiếu mượn thành công!");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể hoàn tất tạo phiếu mượn.");
    } finally {
      setCreatingSlip(false);
    }
  };

  const faceVerifyDisabled = faceScanning || !patronCode.trim() || !!patronId;

  // Date summaries for Step 3
  const borrowDateStr = useMemo(() => new Date().toLocaleDateString("vi-VN"), []);
  const dueDateStr = useMemo(() => {
    const due = new Date();
    due.setDate(due.getDate() + 14);
    return due.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN");
  }, []);

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3} sx={{ height: "calc(100vh - 120px)" }}>
      <Box sx={staggerSx(0)}>
        <PageHeader
          title="Mượn sách"
          subtitle={
            patronId
              ? `Đang phục vụ độc giả: ${patronName} (${patronCode}) — Đang mượn ${activeCount}/${borrowConfig.max_borrow_books} sách`
              : "Quy trình lập phiếu mượn sách 3 bước trực quan cho Thủ thư"
          }
          icon={BorrowIcon}
          actions={
            patronId ? (
              <Button
                variant="outlined"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<RefreshIcon />}
                onClick={handleClearSession}
                sx={{
                  borderRadius: "4px",
                  borderColor: "divider",
                  textTransform: "none",
                }}
              >
                Làm mới phiên
              </Button>
            ) : null
          }
        />
      </Box>

      {/* 3-Step Wizard Navigation */}
      <Box sx={{ px: 1 }}>
        <Paper
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{
            p: 2.5,
            borderRadius: 2.5,
            bgcolor: "background.paper",
          }}
        >
          <Stepper
            activeStep={slipSuccess ? 3 : currentStep}
            alternativeLabel
            sx={{
              "& .MuiStepIcon-root.Mui-active": { color: "primary.main" },
              "& .MuiStepIcon-root.Mui-completed": { color: "secondary.main" },
              "& .MuiStepLabel-label.Mui-active": { fontWeight: 700, color: "primary.main" },
            }}
          >
            {[
              { label: "Xác minh độc giả", disabled: false },
              { label: "Quét mã vạch sách", disabled: !patronId || !canBorrow },
              { label: "Xác nhận & Hoàn tất", disabled: !patronId || cartItems.length === 0 },
            ].map((stepItem, idx) => (
              <Step key={idx} completed={idx < currentStep || !!slipSuccess}>
                <StepButton
                  onClick={() => setCurrentStep(idx)}
                  disabled={stepItem.disabled}
                >
                  <StepLabel>{stepItem.label}</StepLabel>
                </StepButton>
              </Step>
            ))}
          </Stepper>
        </Paper>
      </Box>

      {/* Global Notice / Error Alert */}
      {error ? (
        <Slide direction="down" in={!!error} timeout={250}>
          <Alert
            severity={getAlertSeverity(error)}
            onClose={() => setError("")}
            action={
              error.includes("chưa vào thư viện") ? (
                <Button
                  color="inherit"
                  size="small"
                  variant="outlined"
                  disabled={checkingIn}
                  onClick={handleManualPresenceCheckIn}
                  sx={{ textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 700, ml: 1, whiteSpace: "nowrap", borderRadius: "4px" }}
                >
                  {checkingIn ? "Đang xác nhận..." : "Xác nhận có mặt tại quầy"}
                </Button>
              ) : undefined
            }
            sx={{ animation: `${slideInRight} 0.25s ease-out`, borderRadius: "4px", alignItems: "center" }}
          >
            <AlertTitle>{getAlertTitle(error)}</AlertTitle>
            {error}
          </Alert>
        </Slide>
      ) : null}

      {/* STEP 1: XÁC MINH ĐỘC GIẢ (Verify Patron) */}
      {currentStep === 0 && !slipSuccess && (
        <BorrowStepPatron
          patronCode={patronCode}
          setPatronCode={setPatronCode}
          patronId={patronId}
          patronName={patronName}
          activeCount={activeCount}
          overdueCount={overdueCount}
          borrowConfig={borrowConfig}
          remaining={remaining}
          canBorrow={canBorrow}
          faceVerifyDisabled={faceVerifyDisabled}
          handleLookupAndOpenCamera={handleLookupAndOpenCamera}
          startWebcam={startWebcam}
          handleFaceVerify={handleFaceVerify}
          setOverdueGuideOpen={setOverdueGuideOpen}
          setCurrentStep={setCurrentStep}
          videoRef={videoRef}
          cameraStarted={cameraStarted}
          cameraLoading={cameraLoading}
          cameraReady={cameraReady}
          cameraError={cameraError}
          faceScanning={faceScanning}
        />
      )}

      {/* STEP 2: QUÉT MÃ VẠCH SÁCH (Scan Books) */}
      {currentStep === 1 && !slipSuccess && (
        <BorrowStepScanBooks
          manualIsbn={manualIsbn}
          setManualIsbn={setManualIsbn}
          isLookingUpBook={isLookingUpBook}
          cartItems={cartItems}
          remaining={remaining}
          handleAddBookToCart={handleAddBookToCart}
          handleRemoveFromCart={handleRemoveFromCart}
          setWebcamScannerOpen={setWebcamScannerOpen}
          setIpScannerOpen={setIpScannerOpen}
          borrowCamUrl={borrowCamUrl}
          setCurrentStep={setCurrentStep}
          patronCode={patronCode}
        />
      )}

      {/* STEP 3: XÁC NHẬN & HOÀN TẤT (Confirm) */}
      {currentStep === 2 && !slipSuccess && (
        <BorrowStepConfirm
          patronName={patronName}
          patronCode={patronCode}
          borrowDateStr={borrowDateStr}
          dueDateStr={dueDateStr}
          cartItems={cartItems}
          creatingSlip={creatingSlip}
          handleConfirmBorrowSlip={handleConfirmBorrowSlip}
          setCurrentStep={setCurrentStep}
          finePerDay={borrowConfig?.fine?.fine_per_day}
          maxBorrowDays={borrowConfig?.max_borrow_days}
        />
      )}

      {/* SUCCESS SCREEN */}
      {slipSuccess && (
        <BorrowStepSuccess
          slipSuccess={slipSuccess}
          patronName={patronName}
          patronCode={patronCode}
          dueDateStr={dueDateStr}
          handleClearSession={handleClearSession}
        />
      )}

      {/* Camera Barcode Scanner Dialogs */}
      <BorrowScannerDialog
        open={webcamScannerOpen}
        patronId={patronId || ""}
        maxItems={Math.max(remaining, 0)}
        initialItems={cartItems}
        onClose={() => setWebcamScannerOpen(false)}
        onSuccess={(result) => {
          setWebcamScannerOpen(false);
          setCartItems([]);
          if (patronCode.trim()) {
            api.getActiveBorrowsByStudentCode(patronCode.trim()).then((data) => {
              setActiveCount(data.total);
              setOverdueCount(data.overdue_count);
            }).catch(() => {});
          }
          setSlipSuccess({ message: result.message, count: result.count });
        }}
      />

      {borrowCamUrl && (
        <BorrowIPCameraDialog
          open={ipScannerOpen}
          patronId={patronId || ""}
          patronName={patronName}
          maxItems={Math.max(remaining, 0)}
          initialItems={cartItems}
          cameraUrl={borrowCamUrl}
          onClose={() => setIpScannerOpen(false)}
          onSuccess={(result) => {
            setIpScannerOpen(false);
            setCartItems([]);
            if (patronCode.trim()) {
              api.getActiveBorrowsByStudentCode(patronCode.trim()).then((data) => {
                setActiveCount(data.total);
                setOverdueCount(data.overdue_count);
              }).catch(() => {});
            }
            setSlipSuccess({ message: result.message, count: result.count });
          }}
        />
      )}

      <OverdueGuideModal
        open={overdueGuideOpen}
        onClose={() => setOverdueGuideOpen(false)}
      />

      <Snackbar
        open={snackbar.open}
        autoHideDuration={3500}
        onClose={() => setSnackbar((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        <Alert
          onClose={() => setSnackbar((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
          severity={snackbar.severity}
          variant="filled"
          sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: 2 }}
        >
          {snackbar.message}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </Stack>
  );
}

interface TodayCounts {
  entries: number;
  exits: number;
  no_match: number;
  spoof: number;
}

type Step = "idle" | "verify" | "result";

const _ENTRY_CAM = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENTRY_CAM;
if (!_ENTRY_CAM) throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_ENTRY_CAM is not set");
const ENTRY_CAM: string = _ENTRY_CAM;

function formatGateTime(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "--:--";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
  });
}

function formatConfidence(value?: number | null) {
  if (typeof value !== "number") return null;
  return `${Math.round(value * 100)}%`;
}

function buildLogFromEvent(event: CameraEvent): AccessLogPublic {
  return {
    id: `${event.camera_id}-${event.patron_id || event.student_code || "unknown"}-${Date.now()}`,
    patron_id: event.patron_id || null,
    patron_name: event.full_name || null,
    student_code: event.student_code || null,
    access_type: event.access_type === "exit" ? "exit" : "entry",
    verify_method: "face",
    confidence: event.score ?? null,
    camera_id: event.camera_id,
    access_time: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: event.status,
  };
}

function playGateSound(type: "granted" | "denied") {
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);

    if (type === "granted") {
      // Pleasant double ding (880Hz -> 1320Hz)
      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1320, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
    } else {
      // Gentle warning beep (300Hz -> 180Hz)
      osc.type = "triangle";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(180, ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
      osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
    }
  } catch {
    // AudioContext autoplay blocked or unsupported
  }
}

function resultStatus(result: KioskResult | null) {
  if (!result) return "processing";
  if (result.success) return "success";
  if (result.message?.toLowerCase().includes("đăng ký tại quầy")) return "unregistered";
  return "error";
}

export default function GatePage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);

  const [todayCounts, setTodayCounts] = useState<TodayCounts>({ entries: 0, exits: 0, no_match: 0, spoof: 0 });

    confidence?: number | null;

  useEffect(() => {

    if (!cached) return;

      setTodayCounts({ entries: 0, exits: 0, no_match: 0, spoof: 0 });

    return () => resetSSE();
  }, [resetSSE]);

      const taskResult = sseState.result;
      const success = taskResult?.status === "success";
      const confidence = (taskResult as any)?.score ?? (taskResult as any)?.confidence;
      if (!success) {

    } else if (sseState.status === "FAILURE" || sseState.status === "ERROR" || sseState.status === "TIMEOUT") {
      const message = sseState.error || "Xác thực thất bại.";
      setResult({ success: false, message, patron: null, job_id: null });
      setStep("result");

      setStatusText("");
      showToast("error", message);
      if (lookup?.patron?.id) {
        api.revertPending(lookup.patron.id).catch(() => {});
      }
    } else if (sseState.status === "WAITING") {
      setStatusText("Đang xử lý...");
    }
  }, [sseState.status, sseState.result, sseState.error, lookup, mssv, showToast]);

  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      if (streamRef.current) streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "user", width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
    } catch {
      showToast("error", "Không thể mở camera.");
    }
  }, [showToast]);

  const captureImage = useCallback((): Promise<File> => (
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      if (!video || !video.videoWidth) {
        reject(new Error("Camera chưa sẵn sàng"));
        return;
      }
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) {
        reject(new Error("Không thể tạo canvas"));
        return;
      }
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
      canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
        if (!blob) {
          reject(new Error("Không thể tạo ảnh"));
          return;
        }
        resolve(new File([blob], "face_capture.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" }));
      }, "image/jpeg", 0.9);
    })
  ), []);

  const handleLookup = async (inputMssv: string) => {
    const normalized = inputMssv.trim();
    if (!normalized) return;
    setMssv(normalized);
    setLoading(true);
    setStatusText("Đang tra cứu...");
    try {
      const response = await api.kioskLookup(normalized);
      setLookup(response);
      if (response.exists && response.has_face && !response.is_expired && response.patron) {
        api.kioskPresence(response.patron.id, normalized, "kiosk-1").catch(() => {});
        setStep("verify");
        setStatusText("Mở camera...");
        await startCamera();
      } else if (response.exists && !response.has_face) {
        setStep("result");
        setResult({
          success: false,
          message: "Tài khoản chưa được đăng ký khuôn mặt. Vui lòng đăng ký tại quầy.",
          patron: response.patron,
          job_id: null,
        });
      } else if (response.exists && response.is_expired) {
        setStep("result");
        setResult({ success: false, message: "Thẻ hội viên đã hết hạn.", patron: response.patron, job_id: null });
      } else {
        setStep("result");
        setResult({ success: false, message: "Không tìm thấy tài khoản. Vui lòng đăng ký tại quầy.", patron: null, job_id: null });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStep("result");
      setResult({ success: false, message: getErrorMessage(err) || "Tra cứu thất bại.", patron: null, job_id: null });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setStatusText("");
    }
  };

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setStatusText("Đang chụp ảnh...");
    try {
      const imageFile = await captureImage();
      stopCamera();
      setStatusText("Đang xác thực khuôn mặt...");
      const response = await api.kioskEnter(imageFile, mssv);
      if (response.job_id) {
        startSSE(response.job_id);
      } else {
        setResult(response);
        setStep("result");
        setLoading(false);
        setStatusText("");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const message = getErrorMessage(err) || "Xác thực thất bại.";
      setResult({ success: false, message, patron: null, job_id: null });
      setStep("result");
      setLoading(false);
      setStatusText("");
      showToast("error", message);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!approvalEventCode) return;
    if (approvalTimer <= 0) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setApprovalTimer((p) => p - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [approvalEventCode, approvalTimer]);

  const reset = () => {
    setStep("idle");
    setMssv("");
    setMssvInput("");
    setLookup(null);
    setResult(null);
    setApprovalEventCode(null);
    setApprovalTimer(300);
    stopCamera();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getStats().then((stats) => {
      if (!stats) return;
      const fresh: TodayCounts = { entries: stats.today_entries ?? 0, exits: stats.today_exits ?? 0, no_match: 0, spoof: 0 };
      setTodayCounts(fresh);
      setActivePatrons(stats.active_patrons ?? Math.max(0, (stats.today_entries ?? 0) - (stats.today_exits ?? 0)));
      localStorage.setItem("gate_today_counts", JSON.stringify(fresh));
    }).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getRecentLogs()
      .then((response) => setRecentLogs(response.items.slice(0, HISTORY_LIMIT * 2)))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("gate_today_counts", JSON.stringify(todayCounts));
  }, [todayCounts]);

  const recentEventTimestamps = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanup = api.connectAccessSSE((event: CameraEvent) => {
      if (event.bbox || event.landmarks) {
        const overlay = { bbox: event.bbox, landmarks: event.landmarks };
        if (event.camera_id === ENTRY_CAM_ID) {
          setEntryOverlay({ ...overlay, status: event.status });
        } else if (event.camera_id === EXIT_CAM_ID) {
          setExitOverlay({ ...overlay, status: event.status });
        }
        if (overlayTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(overlayTimeoutRef.current);
        overlayTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          setEntryOverlay(null);
          setExitOverlay(null);
        }, 2000);
      }

      if (event.status === "granted") {
        const type = event.access_type === "entry" ? "entry" : "exit";
        const key = `${event.patron_id || event.student_code || event.full_name || "unknown"}-${type}`;
        const now = Date.now();
        const lastTime = recentEventTimestamps.current.get(key) || 0;
        if (now - lastTime < 5000) {
          // Debounce duplicate scans within 5s
          return;
        }
        recentEventTimestamps.current.set(key, now);

        playGateSound("granted");
        addRecentLog(buildLogFromEvent(event));
        showToast(
          type === "entry" ? "success" : "info",
          `${event.full_name || "Độc giả"} - ${type === "entry" ? "Vào" : "Ra"} thư viện`,
        );
        setTodayCounts((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [type === "entry" ? "entries" : "exits"]: prev[type === "entry" ? "entries" : "exits"] + 1,
        }));
        setActivePatrons((prev) => (type === "entry" ? prev + 1 : Math.max(0, prev - 1)));
        setLastScanEvent({
          status: "granted",
          type,
          name: event.full_name || undefined,
          studentCode: event.student_code || undefined,
          confidence: event.score ?? null,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      } else if (event.status === "wrong_direction") {
        playGateSound("denied");
        const dirMsg = event.access_type === "exit"
          ? "Chưa quét vào cổng nên không thể ra!"
          : "Bạn đang ở trong thư viện!";
        showToast("warning", `${event.full_name || "Độc giả"}: ${dirMsg}`);
        setLastScanEvent({
          status: "denied",
          type: event.access_type === "exit" ? "exit" : "entry",
          name: event.full_name || undefined,
          studentCode: event.student_code || undefined,
          confidence: event.score ?? null,
          message: dirMsg,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      } else if (event.status === "expired") {
        playGateSound("denied");
        showToast("error", `${event.full_name || "Độc giả"}: Thẻ hội viên đã hết hạn hoặc bị khóa!`);
        setLastScanEvent({
          status: "denied",
          type: event.access_type === "exit" ? "exit" : "entry",
          name: event.full_name || undefined,
          studentCode: event.student_code || undefined,
          confidence: event.score ?? null,
          message: "THẺ HỘI VIÊN ĐÃ HẾT HẠN HOẶC BỊ KHÓA!",
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      } else if (event.status === "no_match") {
        setTodayCounts((prev) => ({ ...prev, no_match: prev.no_match + 1 }));
        showToast("info", "Khuôn mặt mới - không nhận diện được.");
        setLastScanEvent({
          status: "no_match",
          type: event.access_type === "exit" ? "exit" : "entry",
          confidence: event.score ?? null,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      } else if (event.status === "spoof") {
        playGateSound("denied");
        setTodayCounts((prev) => ({ ...prev, spoof: prev.spoof + 1 }));
        showToast("error", "Phát hiện giả mạo!");
        setLastScanEvent({
          status: "spoof",
          type: event.access_type === "exit" ? "exit" : "entry",
          confidence: event.score ?? null,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      }
    });
    return cleanup;
  }, [addRecentLog, showToast]);

  const entryLogs = recentLogs.filter((log) => log.access_type === "entry").slice(0, HISTORY_LIMIT);
  const exitLogs = recentLogs.filter((log) => log.access_type === "exit").slice(0, HISTORY_LIMIT);
  const currentResultStatus = resultStatus(result);

  const renderHistoryColumn = (
    title: string,
    subtitle: string,
    logs: AccessLogPublic[],
    type: "entry" | "exit",
  ) => {
    const Icon = type === "entry" ? LoginOutlinedIcon : LogoutOutlinedIcon;
    const color = type === "entry" ? "success" : "info";

    return (
      <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ overflow: "hidden", height: "100%" }}>
        <Stack
          direction="row"
          spacing={1.5}
          sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 2, py: 1.5, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", bgcolor: "action.hover" }}
        >
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.25} sx={{ alignItems: "center", minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Avatar sx={{ bgcolor: `${color}.main`, color: `${color}.contrastText`, width: 40, height: 40 }}>
              <Icon fontSize="small" />
            </Avatar>
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>{title}</Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{subtitle}</Typography>
            </Box>
          </Stack>
          <Typography variant="h5" color={`${color}.main`} sx={{ fontWeight: 900 }}>{logs.length}</Typography>
        </Stack>

        <Stack divider={<Box sx={{ borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }} />}>
          {logs.length === 0 ? (
            <Box sx={{ px: 2, py: 4, textAlign: "center" }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Chưa có lượt {type === "entry" ? "vào" : "ra"} gần đây
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          ) : (
            logs.map((log) => {
              const confidence = formatConfidence(log.confidence);
              return (
                <Stack key={log.id} direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ px: 2, py: 1.5, alignItems: "flex-start", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                  <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontWeight: 750 }}>{log.patron_name || "Không rõ tên"}</Typography>
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.25} sx={{ flexWrap: "wrap", mt: 0.5 }}>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{log.student_code || "---"}</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{formatGateTime(log.access_time)}</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{log.camera_id || "-"}</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  </Box>
                  {confidence ? (
                    <Chip size="small" color={color} label={confidence} sx={{ animation: `${successPop} 0.35s ease-out` }} />
                  ) : (
                    <ShieldOutlinedIcon color="disabled" fontSize="small" />
                  )}
                </Stack>
              );
            })
          )}
        </Stack>
      </Paper>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ minHeight: "100vh", bgcolor: "background.default", color: "text.primary" }}>
      <Box sx={{ maxWidth: 1500, mx: "auto", p: { xs: 2, md: 3 } }}>
        <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
          <Button startIcon={<ArrowBackOutlinedIcon />} onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard")} sx={{ mb: 1, textTransform: "none" }}>
            Quay lại Dashboard
          </Button>
          <Box
            sx={{
              p: { xs: 2, sm: 2.5 },
              borderRadius: 3,
              background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #312e81 50%, #1e1b4b 100%)",
              color: "white",
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              flexWrap: "wrap",
              gap: 2,
              position: "relative",
              overflow: "hidden",
              boxShadow: "0 10px 25px -5px rgba(30, 27, 75, 0.4)",
            }}
          >
            <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: -40, right: -40, width: 180, height: 180, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)", pointerEvents: "none" }} />
            <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", bottom: -60, left: 200, width: 220, height: 220, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)", pointerEvents: "none" }} />

            {/* Trái: Logo + Tên Cổng + Badge AI Live */}
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ zIndex: 1, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <Box
                component="img"
                src="/logo.png"
                alt="IUH Logo"
                sx={{
                  height: 48,
                  bgcolor: "white",
                  px: 1.5,
                  py: 0.5,
                  borderRadius: 2,
                  boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)",
                }}
              />
              <Box>
                <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#FFFFFF" }}>CỔNG KIỂM SOÁT THƯ VIỆN IUH</Typography>
                  <Chip
                    size="small"
                    label="AI LIVE"
                    sx={{
                      bgcolor: "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)",
                      color: "#6ee7b7",
                      border: "1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4)",
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      fontSize: "0.7rem",
                    }}
                  />
                </Stack>
                <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)", mt: 0.3 }}>
                  Nhận diện khuôn mặt AI tự động · Sức chứa phòng đọc: {LIBRARY_CAPACITY} chỗ
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Stack>

            {/* Phải: Dãy số liệu thời gian thực (Đang có mặt + Đã vào + Đã ra) */}
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ zIndex: 1, alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              {/* Thẻ quan trọng nhất: Đang có mặt */}
              <Paper sx={{ px: 2, py: 1, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "rgba(99,102,241,0.25)", border: "1px solid rgba(165,180,252,0.4)", textAlign: "center" }}>
                <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#c7d2fe", lineHeight: 1 }}>{activePatrons}</Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "rgba(199,210,254,0.9)", fontWeight: 700, display: "block", mt: 0.25 }}>
                  Đang có mặt ({occupancyPct}%)
                </Typography>
              </Paper>

              {/* Lượt vào */}
              <Paper sx={{ px: 2, py: 1, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "rgba(16,185,129,0.15)", border: "1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3)", textAlign: "center" }}>
                <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#6ee7b7", lineHeight: 1 }}>{todayCounts.entries}</Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "rgba(110,231,183,0.85)", fontWeight: 700, display: "block", mt: 0.25 }}>Đã vào</Typography>
              </Paper>

              {/* Lượt ra (dùng tone xanh dương) */}
              <Paper sx={{ px: 2, py: 1, borderRadius: 2, bgcolor: "rgba(59,130,246,0.15)", border: "1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.3)", textAlign: "center" }}>
                <Typography variant="h4" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#93c5fd", lineHeight: 1 }}>{todayCounts.exits}</Typography>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "rgba(147,197,253,0.85)", fontWeight: 700, display: "block", mt: 0.25 }}>Đã ra</Typography>
              </Paper>

              <IconButton onClick={toggleMode} sx={{ color: "#a5b4fc", border: "1px solid rgba(165,180,252,0.3)", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(165,180,252,0.1)" } }}>
                {mode === "dark" ? <LightModeOutlinedIcon /> : <DarkModeOutlinedIcon />}
              </IconButton>
            </Stack>
          </Box>
        </Box>

        <Grid container spacing={2.5}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, lg: 8 }}>
            <Grid container spacing={2}>
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.4s ease-out`, animationFillMode: "both" }}>
                <CameraFeed
                  src={ENTRY_CAM}
                  cameraId={ENTRY_CAM_ID}
                  label="Cổng vào"
                  useWebcam={useEntryWebcam}
                  onToggleWebcam={() => setUseEntryWebcam((p) => !p)}
                  overlay={entryOverlay}
                />
              </Grid>
              <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.4s ease-out`, animationDelay: "0.1s", animationFillMode: "both" }}>
                <CameraFeed
                  src={EXIT_CAM}
                  cameraId={EXIT_CAM_ID}
                  label="Cổng ra"
                  useWebcam={useExitWebcam}
                  onToggleWebcam={() => setUseExitWebcam((p) => !p)}
                  overlay={exitOverlay}
                />
              </Grid>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>

          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, lg: 4 }} sx={{ animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.45s ease-out`, animationDelay: "0.2s", animationFillMode: "both" }}>
            <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 2.5, height: "100%" }}>
              {/* Thẻ hiển thị kết quả quét khuôn mặt AI tự động theo thời gian thực */}
              {isRecentScanActive && step === "idle" && lastScanEvent && (
                <Box sx={{ mb: 2.5, animation: `${fadeInUp} 0.35s ease-out` }}>
                  <ResultCard
                    status={lastScanEvent.status === "granted" ? "success" : lastScanEvent.status === "no_match" ? "unregistered" : "error"}
                    message={
                      lastScanEvent.message || (
                        lastScanEvent.status === "granted"
                          ? (lastScanEvent.type === "entry" ? "XIN MỜI VÀO THƯ VIỆN" : "XIN MỜI RA — HẸN GẶP LẠI")
                          : lastScanEvent.status === "spoof"
                          ? "CẢNH BÁO GIẢ MẠO HÌNH ẢNH!"
                          : "KHUÔN MẶT CHƯA ĐƯỢC ĐĂNG KÝ"
                      )
                    }
                    patronInfo={
                      lastScanEvent.name
                        ? {
                            fullName: lastScanEvent.name,
                            mssv: lastScanEvent.studentCode || "",
                            faculty: lastScanEvent.confidence ? `Độ tin cậy AI: ${Math.round(lastScanEvent.confidence * 100)}%` : "",
                          }
                        : undefined
                    }
                  />
                  <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }} />
                </Box>
              )}

              {step === "idle" && (
                <Stack spacing={2} sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                  {!isRecentScanActive && (
                    <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
                      <Avatar sx={{ mx: "auto", width: 56, height: 56, bgcolor: "primary.main", color: "primary.contrastText", mb: 1.5 }}>
                        <PersonSearchOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" />
                      </Avatar>
                      <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>Nhận diện tự động AI</Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                        Vui lòng đứng trước camera để hệ thống mở cổng.
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  )}

                  <Box sx={{ p: 2, borderRadius: 2.5, bgcolor: "action.hover", border: "1px dashed", borderColor: "divider" }}>
                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: "text.secondary", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, display: "block", mb: 1 }}>
                      Không nhận diện được? Nhập MSSV hoặc Quét thẻ:
                    </Typography>
                    <TextField
                      value={mssvInput}
                      onChange={(event) => setMssvInput(event.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={(event) => {
                        if (event.key === "Enter") handleLookup(mssvInput);
                      }}
                      disabled={loading}
                      placeholder="Nhập MSSV..."
                      fullWidth
                      size="small"
                      sx={{
                        "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
                          borderRadius: 2,
                          bgcolor: "background.paper",
                          textAlign: "center",
                          "&:hover": {
                            "& fieldset": { borderColor: "primary.main" },
                          },
                        },
                      }}
                      slotProps={{
                        htmlInput: {
                          style: {
                            textAlign: "center",
                            fontFamily: "monospace",
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            letterSpacing: 1,
                          },
                        },
                      }}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="contained"
                      onClick={() => handleLookup(mssvInput)}
                      disabled={loading || !mssvInput.trim()}
                      fullWidth
                      sx={{
                        mt: 1.25,
                        background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        textTransform: "none",
                        boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139,0,0,0.3)",
                        "&:hover": {
                          background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #700000 0%, #500000 100%)",
                        },
                      }}
                    >
                      Xác thực thủ công
                    </Button>
                  </Box>

                  {loading && (
                    <Stack spacing={1.25} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <CircularProgress size={24} sx={{ color: "primary.main" }} />
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">{statusText || "Đang xử lý..."}</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  )}
                </Stack>
              )}

              {step === "verify" && (
                <Stack spacing={2}>
                  <Box sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>Xác thực khuôn mặt</Typography>
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">{lookup?.patron?.full_name || mssv}</Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ position: "relative", overflow: "hidden", aspectRatio: "4 / 3", bgcolor: "#070B14", borderRadius: 3 }}>
                    <Box component="video" ref={videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted sx={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", objectFit: "cover" }} />

                    {/* Biometric Oval Reticle with Corner Brackets */}
                    <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "grid", placeItems: "center", pointerEvents: "none" }}>
                      <Box
                        sx={{
                          width: { xs: 150, sm: 180 },
                          height: { xs: 200, sm: 240 },
                          borderRadius: "48%",
                          border: "2px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.8)",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4), inset 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)",
                          position: "relative",
                        }}
                      />
                    </Box>

                    {loading && (
                      <Stack sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, bgcolor: "rgba(7, 11, 20, 0.75)", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)", color: "common.white", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} spacing={1.5}>
                        <CircularProgress size={44} sx={{ color: "#10b981" }} />
                        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{statusText}</Typography>
                      </Stack>
                    )}
                  </Paper>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    size="large"
                    startIcon={<CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon />}
                    onClick={handleVerify}
                    disabled={loading}
                    fullWidth
                    sx={{
                      background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #059669 100%)",
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      textTransform: "none",
                      "&:hover": {
                        background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #34d399 0%, #10b981 100%)",
                      },
                    }}
                  >
                    Xác thực
                  </Button>
                  <Button onClick={reset} disabled={loading} fullWidth>Hủy</Button>
                </Stack>
              )}

              {step === "result" && !approvalEventCode && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5} sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                  <Avatar
                    sx={{
                      mx: "auto",
                      width: 72,
                      height: 72,
                      bgcolor: currentResultStatus === "success" ? "success.main" : currentResultStatus === "unregistered" ? "warning.main" : "error.main",
                      color: currentResultStatus === "success" ? "success.contrastText" : currentResultStatus === "unregistered" ? "warning.contrastText" : "error.contrastText",
                      animation: `${successPop} 0.45s ease-out`,
                    }}
                  >
                    {currentResultStatus === "success" ? <CheckCircleOutlineOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" /> : <ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" />}
                  </Avatar>
                  {result?.patron && (
                    <Box>
                      <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>{result.patron.full_name}</Typography>
                      <Typography color="primary.main" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontWeight: 800 }}>{result.patron.student_code || result.patron.id}</Typography>
                    </Box>
                  )}
                  {result?.message && (
                    <Alert severity={currentResultStatus === "success" ? "success" : currentResultStatus === "unregistered" ? "warning" : "error"}>
                      {result.message}
                    </Alert>
                  )}
                  {result?.confidence != null && (
                    <Stack spacing={1}>
                      <LinearProgress variant="determinate" value={Math.round(result.confidence * 100)} color={currentResultStatus === "success" ? "success" : "warning"} sx={{ height: 8, borderRadius: 99 }} />
                      <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">Độ tin cậy {Math.round(result.confidence * 100)}%</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  )}
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<RestartAltOutlinedIcon />}
                    onClick={reset}
                    fullWidth
                    sx={{
                      background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      textTransform: "none",
                      boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139,0,0,0.3)",
                      "&:hover": {
                        background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #700000 0%, #500000 100%)",
                      },
                    }}
                  >
                    Thử lại
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              )}

              {step === "result" && approvalEventCode && (
                <Stack spacing={2.5} sx={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                  <Avatar
                    sx={{ mx: "auto", width: 72, height: 72, bgcolor: "warning.main", color: "warning.contrastText" }}
                  >
                    <ErrorOutlineOutlinedIcon fontSize="large" />
                  </Avatar>
                  <Box>
                    <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 850 }}>Xác thực thất bại</Typography>
                    <Typography color="text.secondary">Vui lòng ra quầy thủ thư để được hỗ trợ</Typography>
                  </Box>
                  <Paper variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 2, bgcolor: "grey.50" }}>
                    <Typography variant="overline" color="text.secondary">Mã phiên</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="h3" sx={{ fontWeight: 900, fontFamily: "monospace", letterSpacing: 4 }}>
                      {approvalEventCode}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                      Còn {Math.floor(approvalTimer / 60)}:{(approvalTimer % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0")} trước khi hết hạn
                    </Typography>
                  </Paper>
                  {result?.patron && (
                    <Box>
                      <Typography variant="h6">{result.patron.full_name}</Typography>
                      <Typography color="primary.main" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{result.patron.student_code || result.patron.id}</Typography>
                    </Box>
                  )}
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<RestartAltOutlinedIcon />}
                    onClick={reset}
                    fullWidth
                    sx={{
                      background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
                      borderRadius: 2,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      textTransform: "none",
                      boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139,0,0,0.3)",
                      "&:hover": {
                        background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #700000 0%, #500000 100%)",
                      },
                    }}
                  >
                    Quay lại
                  </Button>
                </Stack>
              )}
            </Paper>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>

        <Grid container spacing={2.5} sx={{ mt: 2.5 }}>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ animation: `${slideInRight} 0.4s ease-out`, animationFillMode: "both" }}>
            {renderHistoryColumn("Lịch sử vào", "Các lượt vừa qua cổng vào", entryLogs, "entry")}
          </Grid>
          <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }} sx={{ animation: `${slideInRight} 0.4s ease-out`, animationDelay: "0.1s", animationFillMode: "both" }}>
            {renderHistoryColumn("Lịch sử ra", "Các lượt vừa qua cổng ra", exitLogs, "exit")}
          </Grid>
        </Grid>

        <Box sx={{ position: "fixed", bottom: 16, left: 16, zIndex: 1000 }}>
          <Alert severity="success" icon={<Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "success.main" }} />} sx={{ py: 0 }}>
            Hệ thống đang hoạt động
          </Alert>
        </Box>

        <Snackbar
          open={Boolean(toast)}
          autoHideDuration={6000}
          onClose={() => setToast(null)}
          anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
        >
          {toast ? (
            <Alert
              onClose={() => setToast(null)}
              severity={toast.severity}
              variant="filled"
              sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: "8px", fontWeight: 600, boxShadow: "0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)" }}
            >
              {toast.msg}
            </Alert>
          ) : undefined}
        </Snackbar>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

function roleChipColor(role: string): "warning" | "primary" | "default" | "success" {
  if (role === "admin") return "warning";
  if (role === "staff") return "primary";
  return "default";
}

const STAT_GRADIENT: Record<string, string> = {
  total:  "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
  admin:  "linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B89628 100%)",
  staff:  "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
  patron: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1E6091 0%, #154E78 100%)",
  face:   "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
};

export default function AdminPage() {
  const { user, isLoading, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const { canAccessPage, loading: permLoading } = usePermission();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserPublic[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [createForm, setCreateForm] = useState({ email: "", password: "", role: "staff" });
  const [createError, setCreateError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<"all" | "admin" | "staff" | "patron">("all");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !permLoading) {
      if (!isAuthenticated) {
        router.push("/login");
      } else if (user?.role !== "admin" && !canAccessPage("/dashboard/admin")) {
        router.push("/dashboard");
      }
    }
  }, [isLoading, permLoading, isAuthenticated, user, canAccessPage, router]);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await api.listUsers({ skip: 0, limit: 200 });
      setUsers(data.users);
      setTotal(data.total);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = users;
    if (roleFilter !== "all") list = list.filter((u) => u.role === roleFilter);
    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(
        (u) =>
          u.email.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (u.full_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }
    return list;
  }, [users, roleFilter, search]);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!createForm.email || !createForm.password) {
      setCreateError("Vui lòng nhập email và mật khẩu.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      setCreateError("");
      await api.register({ ...createForm, skip_verification: true } as any);
      setShowCreate(false);
      setCreateForm({ email: "", password: "", role: "staff" });
      setNotice("Tạo người dùng thành công. Tài khoản đã active.");
      load();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCreateError(err?.response?.data?.detail || "Tạo người dùng thất bại.");
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Stack sx={{ minHeight: 400, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
        <CircularProgress sx={{ animation: `${shimmer} 1.5s ease-in-out infinite` }} />
      </Stack>
    );
  }
  if (!isAuthenticated) return null;

  const adminCount  = users.filter((u) => u.role === "admin").length;
  const staffCount  = users.filter((u) => u.role === "staff").length;
  const patronCount = users.filter((u) => u.role === "patron").length;
  const faceCount   = users.filter((u) => u.has_face).length;
  const noFaceCount = Math.max(0, total - faceCount);
  const faceRate    = total > 0 ? Math.round((faceCount / total) * 100) : 0;

  const STATS: { key: string; label: string; value: number | string; icon: any; gradient: string; pct?: number; delta?: string; deltaColor?: "success" | "warning" | "error" | "default" }[] = [
    {
      key: "face",
      label: "Đã có khuôn mặt (AI)",
      value: faceCount,
      icon: FaceRetouchingNaturalOutlinedIcon,
      gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
      pct: faceRate,
      delta: total > 0 ? `${faceRate}% đã kích hoạt Face-ID` : undefined,
      deltaColor: "success",
    },
    {
      key: "noface",
      label: "Chưa có khuôn mặt",
      value: noFaceCount,
      icon: AccountBoxOutlinedIcon,
      gradient: noFaceCount > 0 ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706 0%, #B45309 100%)" : "linear-gradient(135deg, #475569 0%, #334155 100%)",
      pct: total > 0 ? Math.round((noFaceCount / total) * 100) : 0,
      delta: noFaceCount > 0 ? `⚠ ${noFaceCount} người chưa thể nhận diện AI` : "✓ 100% đã đăng ký khuôn mặt",
      deltaColor: noFaceCount > 0 ? "warning" : "success",
    },
    {
      key: "total",
      label: "Tổng người dùng",
      value: total,
      icon: GroupsOutlinedIcon,
      gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.total,
      pct: 100,
      delta: `${patronCount} độc giả sinh viên / giảng viên`,
      deltaColor: "default",
    },
    {
      key: "staff",
      label: "Đội ngũ quản trị & nhân viên",
      value: adminCount + staffCount,
      icon: SupervisorAccountOutlinedIcon,
      gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.staff,
      pct: total > 0 ? Math.round(((adminCount + staffCount) / total) * 100) : 0,
      delta: `${adminCount} Admin · ${staffCount} Nhân viên trực`,
      deltaColor: "default",
    },
  ];

  const statBadges = `${total} người dùng · ${faceCount} đã có khuôn mặt (${faceRate}%) · ${adminCount} admin · ${staffCount} nhân viên`;

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Quản trị người dùng"
        subtitle="Tạo tài khoản admin/staff và theo dõi tỷ lệ bao phủ sinh trắc học khuôn mặt AI."
        icon={AdminPanelSettingsOutlinedIcon}
        statBadges={statBadges}
        onRefresh={load}
        actions={
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            startIcon={<AddOutlinedIcon />}
            onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)}
            sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: "primary.main", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" }, boxShadow: "0 4px 14px rgba(139,0,0,0.3)" }}
          >
            Thêm người dùng
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Grid container spacing={2}>
        {STATS.map((s, idx) => (
          <Grid key={s.key} size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6, lg: 3 }}>
            <MuiStatCard
              label={s.label}
              value={s.value}
              icon={s.icon}
              gradient={s.gradient}
              pct={s.pct}
              delta={s.delta}
              deltaColor={s.deltaColor}
              index={idx}
            />
          </Grid>
        ))}
      </Grid>

      <DashboardCard title="" noPadding>
        <Stack
          direction={{ xs: "column", sm: "row" }}
          spacing={1.5}
          sx={{ px: 2.5, py: 2, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", alignItems: { sm: "center" } }}
        >
          <SearchField
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            placeholder="Tìm theo email, họ tên..."
            sx={{ flex: 1 }}
          />
          <ToggleButtonGroup
            value={roleFilter}
            exclusive
            onChange={(_, v) => v && setRoleFilter(v)}
            size="small"
            sx={{
              "& .MuiToggleButton-root": {
                px: 2, py: 0.6,
                borderRadius: "20px!important",
                textTransform: "none",
                fontWeight: 600,
                fontSize: "0.8rem",
                border: "1px solid",
                borderColor: "divider",
              },
              gap: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            <ToggleButton value="all">Tất cả</ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="admin">Admin</ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="staff">Nhân viên</ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="patron">Độc giả</ToggleButton>
          </ToggleButtonGroup>
          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
            {filtered.length} / {total} người

        </Stack>

      <TableContainer sx={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
      <Table sx={{ minWidth: 600 }}>

              <TableRow sx={{ "& .MuiTableCell-head": { fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: "action.hover", fontSize: "0.78rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, color: "text.secondary" } }}>
                <TableCell>Người dùng</TableCell>

                1. Thông tin đăng nhập

                <TextField
                  label="Mật khẩu khởi tạo"
                  type="password"
                  value={createForm.password}
                  onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, password: e.target.value })}
                  fullWidth
                  sx={{ "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2 } }}
                  helperText="Mật khẩu cần ít nhất 6 ký tự"
                />
              </Stack>
            </Box>

            <Divider />

            <Box>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 2, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 1 }}>
                2. Vai trò hệ thống
              </Typography>
              <Box sx={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, flexDirection: { xs: "column", sm: "row" } }}>
                {[
                  { role: "staff",  label: "Nhân viên",     desc: "Có quyền xử lý mượn/trả và cấp phát thẻ.", icon: <BadgeOutlinedIcon />,            gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.staff,  border: "primary.main" },
                  { role: "admin",  label: "Quản trị viên", desc: "Toàn quyền hệ thống, quản lý nhân sự.",   icon: <SupervisorAccountOutlinedIcon />, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.admin,  border: "warning.main" },
                ].map((opt) => (
                  <Box key={opt.role} sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Card
                      variant="outlined"
                      sx={{
                        borderRadius: 2,
                        borderColor: createForm.role === opt.role ? opt.border : "divider",
                        borderWidth: createForm.role === opt.role ? 2 : 1,
                        transition: "all 0.2s",
                        boxShadow: createForm.role === opt.role ? 2 : 0,
                      }}
                    >
                      <CardActionArea
                        onClick={() => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, role: opt.role })}
                        sx={{ p: 2.5, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 1.5 }}
                      >
                        <Avatar sx={{ background: createForm.role === opt.role ? opt.gradient : "action.selected", width: 44, height: 44 }}>
                          {opt.icon}
                        </Avatar>
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{opt.label}</Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 0.5, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{opt.desc}</Typography>
                        </Box>
                      </CardActionArea>
                    </Card>
                  </Box>
                ))}
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        </Box>

        <Box sx={{ p: 3, bgcolor: "background.paper", borderTop: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
            <Button variant="outlined" color="inherit" onClick={() => setShowCreate(false)} fullWidth sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
              Hủy
            </Button>
            <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleCreate} fullWidth sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, background: STAT_GRADIENT.total, "&:hover": { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#700000,#500000)" } }}>
              Cấp tài khoản
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      </Drawer>

      <Snackbar
        open={!!notice}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setNotice("")}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        <Alert severity="success" onClose={() => setNotice("")} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>
          {notice}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </Stack>
  );
}

import AssignStaffDialog from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/staff-schedule/AssignStaffDialog";
