const FILTERS = [
  { value: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
  { value: "active", label: "Đang trực" },
  { value: "future", label: "Sắp tới" },
  { value: "past", label: "Đã qua" },
] as const;

const STAT_GRADIENT = {
  total: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
  active: "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
  staff: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
};

export default function StaffSchedulesPage() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const isStaff = !!user;

  // Quyền thao tác lịch: Admin toàn quyền, hoặc nhân viên được cấp quyền riêng qua RBAC
  const canCreate = isAdmin || can("schedules", "create");
  const canUpdate = isAdmin || can("schedules", "update");
  const canDelete = isAdmin || can("schedules", "delete");
  const canManage = isAdmin || canCreate || canUpdate || canDelete;

  const {
    staff, zones, shifts, assignments, loading, error, setError,
    weekStart, days, from, to,
    goPrevWeek, goNextWeek, goToday, loadData,
  } = useScheduleData(canManage);

  const {
    filter, zoneFilter, shiftFilter,
    setFilter, setZoneFilter, setShiftFilter,
    shiftList, filteredAssignments, filteredShifts, weekStats,
  } = useScheduleFilters(assignments, shifts, staff, zones);

  const { pendingManualCount } = usePendingCounts(isAdmin || canUpdate, loading);

  const auto = useAutoSchedule(loadData, setError);

  const [showManagement, setShowManagement] = useState(false);
  const [assignDialog, setAssignDialog] = useState<{ date: string; shiftId: string; shiftName: string } | null>(null);
  const [showAuditLogs, setShowAuditLogs] = useState(false);
  const [showGeofence, setShowGeofence] = useState(false);
  const [showTemplates, setShowTemplates] = useState(false);
  const [showDeleteWeek, setShowDeleteWeek] = useState(false);
  const [showManualCheckIn, setShowManualCheckIn] = useState(false);

  const handleCellClick = (date: string, shiftId: string) => {
    const shift = shifts.find((s) => s.id === shiftId);
    setAssignDialog({ date, shiftId, shiftName: shift?.name || "" });
  };

  const [confirmingId, setConfirmingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { pendingDelete, countdown, markForDelete, undo } = useUndo<string>({
    onConfirm: async (id) => {
      setConfirmingId(id);
      try { await api.deleteScheduleAssignment(id); await loadData(); }
      catch (err) { setError(getErrorMessage(err)); }
      finally { setConfirmingId(null); }
    },
  });

  const hiddenIds = useMemo(() => new Set([pendingDelete, confirmingId].filter(Boolean) as string[]), [pendingDelete, confirmingId]);
  const filteredAssignmentsWithUndo = useMemo(
    () => filteredAssignments.filter((a) => !hiddenIds.has(a.id)),
    [filteredAssignments, hiddenIds],
  );

  const handleDeleteAssignment = (id: string) => markForDelete(id);

  const handleViewStaff = (_staffId: string) => {
    // placeholder for staff detail navigation
  };

  if (!isStaff) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={<ScheduleOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />}
        title="Không có quyền truy cập"
        description="Bạn không có quyền xem trang này."
      />
    );
  }

  const isCurrentWeek = from === (() => { const d = new Date(); const day = d.getDay() || 7; d.setDate(d.getDate() - day + 1); return d; })().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const headerActions = (
    <>
      <Tooltip title="Tuần trước">
        <IconButton onClick={goPrevWeek} size="small" sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "primary.main" } }}>
          <PrevIcon fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
      <Button onClick={goToday} size="small" variant={isCurrentWeek ? "contained" : "outlined"} startIcon={<TodayIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
        sx={{ borderRadius: 2, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.75rem",
          ...(isCurrentWeek
            ? { bgcolor: "primary.main", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "primary.dark" } }
            : { color: "text.secondary", borderColor: "divider", "&:hover": { borderColor: "primary.main", color: "primary.main" } }
          ),
        }}
      >
        Hôm nay
      </Button>
      <Tooltip title="Tuần sau">
        <IconButton onClick={goNextWeek} size="small" sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "primary.main" } }}>
          <NextIcon fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
      {canCreate && (
        <Tooltip title="Gợi ý lịch tự động">
          <IconButton onClick={() => auto.setShowAutoSchedule(true)} size="small" sx={{ color: "#D4AF37", border: "1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.4)", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(212,175,55,0.1)" } }}>
            <AutoAwesomeIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      {(isAdmin || canUpdate) && (
        <Tooltip title="Quản lý ca/khu vực">
          <IconButton onClick={() => setShowManagement(true)} size="small" sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "primary.main" } }}>
            <SettingsIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      {(isAdmin || canCreate) && (
        <Tooltip title="Mẫu lịch">
          <IconButton onClick={() => setShowTemplates(true)} size="small" sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "primary.main" } }}>
            <TotalIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      {(isAdmin || canUpdate) && (
        <Tooltip title="Geofence">
          <IconButton onClick={() => setShowGeofence(true)} size="small" sx={{ color: "#D97706", border: "1px solid rgba(217,119,6,0.3)", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(217,119,6,0.1)" } }}>
            <MapIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      {(isAdmin || canUpdate) && (
        <Tooltip title="Check-in thủ công">
          <IconButton onClick={() => setShowManualCheckIn(true)} size="small" sx={{ color: "primary.main", border: "1px solid", borderColor: "primary.light", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover" }, position: "relative" }}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} style={{ width: 18, height: 18 }}>
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m-6 9l2 2 4-4" />
            </svg>
            {pendingManualCount > 0 ? (
              <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", top: -4, right: -4, minWidth: 16, height: 16, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: "#ef4444", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: "0.6rem", fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1 }}>{pendingManualCount > 9 ? "9+" : pendingManualCount}</Typography>
              </Box>
            ) : null}
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      {canManage && (
        <Tooltip title="Nhật ký">
          <IconButton onClick={() => setShowAuditLogs(true)} size="small" sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "primary.main" } }}>
            <HistoryIcon fontSize="small" />
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      {canDelete && (
        <Tooltip title="Xóa lịch tuần này">
          <IconButton
            onClick={() => setShowDeleteWeek(true)}
            size="small"
            sx={{ color: "#ef4444", border: "1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35)", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)" } }}
          >
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} style={{ width: 18, height: 18 }}>
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
            </svg>
          </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
      )}
      <Tooltip title="In lịch">
        <IconButton onClick={() => window.print()} size="small" sx={{ border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider", color: "text.secondary", "&:hover": { bgcolor: "action.hover", color: "primary.main" } }}>
          <PrintIcon fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      </Tooltip>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Lịch trực theo tuần"
        subtitle={formatDateRange(days)}
        icon={ScheduleOutlined}
        onRefresh={loadData}
        actions={headerActions}
      />

      <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(3, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
        {[
          { key: "total", label: "Tổng ca tuần", value: weekStats.total, icon: TotalIcon, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.total, pct: 100 },
          { key: "active", label: "Đang trực", value: weekStats.active, icon: ActiveIcon, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.active, pct: weekStats.total ? (weekStats.active / weekStats.total) * 100 : 0 },
          { key: "staff", label: "Nhân viên", value: weekStats.staffCount, icon: StaffIcon, gradient: STAT_GRADIENT.staff, pct: 100 },
        ].map((s, idx) => (
          <Box key={s.key} sx={staggerSx(idx)}>
            <MuiStatCard label={s.label} value={s.value} icon={s.icon} gradient={s.gradient} pct={s.pct} index={idx} />
          </Box>
        ))}
      </Box>

      <DashboardCard>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1.5} sx={{ alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 0.5 }}>
          <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, mr: 1, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, fontSize: "0.7rem" }}>
            Bộ lọc:
          </Typography>
          <ToggleButtonGroup
            value={filter} exclusive onChange={(_, v) => v ? setFilter(v) : undefined} size="small"
            sx={{ "& .MuiToggleButton-root": { px: 2, py: 0.6, borderRadius: "20px!important", textTransform: "none", fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.78rem", border: "1px solid", borderColor: "divider" }, gap: 0.5 }}
          >
            {FILTERS.map((f) => (
              <ToggleButton key={f.value} value={f.value}>{f.label}</ToggleButton>
            ))}
          </ToggleButtonGroup>
          <TextField
            select size="small" label="Khu vực" value={zoneFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setZoneFilter(e.target.value)}
            sx={{ minWidth: 160, "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2 } }}
            slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
          >
            <MenuItem value="">Tất cả khu vực</MenuItem>
            {zones.map((z) => (
              <MenuItem key={z.id} value={z.id}>{z.zoneName}</MenuItem>
            ))}
          </TextField>
          <TextField
            select size="small" label="Ca trực" value={shiftFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setShiftFilter(e.target.value)}
            sx={{ minWidth: 140, "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": { borderRadius: 2 } }}
            slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
          >
            <MenuItem value="">Tất cả ca trực</MenuItem>
            {shiftList.map((s) => (
              <MenuItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</MenuItem>
            ))}
          </TextField>
        </Stack>
      </DashboardCard>

      {error ? (
        <Alert severity="error" onClose={() => setError(null)} sx={{ borderRadius: 2 }}>{error}</Alert>
      ) : null}

      <LoadingOverlay loading={loading} message="Đang tải lịch trực...">
        <DashboardCard noPadding>
          <TimetableGrid
            days={days} shifts={filteredShifts} assignments={filteredAssignmentsWithUndo}
            filter={filter} isAdmin={canManage}
            onCellClick={canCreate ? handleCellClick : undefined}
            onDeleteAssignment={canDelete ? handleDeleteAssignment : undefined}
            onViewStaff={canManage ? handleViewStaff : undefined}
          />
        </DashboardCard>
      </LoadingOverlay>

      <DashboardCard>
        <TimetableLegend />
      </DashboardCard>

      <AssignStaffDialog
        open={!!assignDialog} date={assignDialog?.date || ""} shiftId={assignDialog?.shiftId || ""} shiftName={assignDialog?.shiftName || ""}
        shifts={shiftList} zones={zones} staff={staff}
        existingAssignments={assignments.filter((a) => a.shiftId === assignDialog?.shiftId && a.workDate === assignDialog?.date && a.status !== "cancelled")}
        dayAssignments={assignments.filter((a) => a.workDate === assignDialog?.date && a.status !== "cancelled")}
        onClose={() => setAssignDialog(null)}
        onAssigned={() => { setAssignDialog(null); loadData(); }}
      />

      <ScheduleManagementPanel open={showManagement} onClose={() => setShowManagement(false)} zones={zones} shifts={shiftList} onUpdate={loadData} />
      <AuditLogsPanel open={showAuditLogs} onClose={() => setShowAuditLogs(false)} />
      <GeofenceConfigPanel open={showGeofence} onClose={() => setShowGeofence(false)} zones={zones} onUpdated={loadData} />
      <TemplateManagementPanel open={showTemplates} onClose={() => setShowTemplates(false)} zones={zones} shifts={shifts} staff={staff} onUpdated={loadData} />
      <AutoScheduleDialog
        open={auto.showAutoSchedule}
        onClose={() => { auto.setShowAutoSchedule(false); }}
        onConfirm={auto.handleAutoSchedule}
        onConfirmFinal={auto.handleAutoScheduleConfirm}
        loading={auto.autoLoading} step={auto.autoStep}
        proposals={auto.autoProposals} skippedCount={auto.autoSkipped} actualRange={auto.autoActualRange}
      />
      <ManualCheckInAdmin open={showManualCheckIn} onClose={() => setShowManualCheckIn(false)} onUpdated={loadData} />
      <DeleteWeekDialog
        open={showDeleteWeek} onClose={() => setShowDeleteWeek(false)}
        weekFrom={from} weekTo={to}
        affectedCount={assignments.filter(a => a.status !== "cancelled" && a.workDate >= from && a.workDate <= to).length}
        onDeleted={loadData}
      />

      <UndoSnackbar
        open={!!pendingDelete}
        message="Đã xóa lịch trực"
        countdown={countdown}
        onUndo={undo}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Alert,
  Avatar,
  Box,
  Button,
  Chip,
  CircularProgress,
  Dialog,
  DialogActions,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  Drawer,
  IconButton,
  MenuItem,
  Snackbar,
  Stack,
  TextField,
  Tooltip,
  Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import AddIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Add";
import CloseIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Close";
import DeleteIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined";
import EditIcon from "@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined";
import PeopleIcon from "@mui/icons-material/PeopleOutlined";
import UpdateIcon from "@mui/icons-material/UpdateOutlined";
import api, { getErrorMessage } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { usePermission, getPermissionDeniedReason } from "@/lib/permission-context";
import { initials } from "@/lib/utils";
import PageHeader from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PageHeader";
import EmptyState from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/EmptyState";
import LoadingOverlay from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/LoadingOverlay";
import ConfirmDialog from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/ConfirmDialog";
import PatronStatCards from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PatronStatCards";
import PatronToolbar from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PatronToolbar";
import PatronListView from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PatronListView";
import PatronWizard from "@/app/(dashboard)/_components/ui/PatronWizard";
import type { PatronCreate, PatronPublic, PatronUpdate } from "@/lib/types";

export type FilterValue = "all" | "active" | "inactive" | "expired" | "has_face" | "no_face" | "deleted";
type Notice = { severity: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info"; message: string } | null;

const STAT_GRADIENT = {
  total: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A2540 0%, #0F3C5C 100%)",
  active: "linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #047857 100%)",
  expired: "linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706 0%, #B45309 100%)",
  face: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
};

export default function PatronsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { can } = usePermission();
  const canCreatePatron = can("patrons", "create");
  const canUpdatePatron = can("patrons", "update");
  const canDeletePatron = can("patrons", "delete");

  const [patrons, setPatrons] = useState<PatronPublic[]>([]);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [debouncedQuery, setDebouncedQuery] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterValue>("all");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedQuery(query);
    }, 350);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query]);

  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);

  const [editTarget, setEditTarget] = useState<PatronPublic | null>(null);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<PatronUpdate>({});
  const [editSaving, setEditSaving] = useState(false);

  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<PatronPublic | null>(null);
  const [deleteConfirmText, setDeleteConfirmText] = useState("");

  const [restoreTarget, setRestoreTarget] = useState<PatronPublic | null>(null);
  const [restoreConfirmText, setRestoreConfirmText] = useState("");

  const [renewTarget, setRenewTarget] = useState<PatronPublic | null>(null);
  const [renewMonths, setRenewMonths] = useState(12);

  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice>(null);
  const showNotice = (severity: NonNullable<Notice>["severity"], message: string) => {
    setNotice({ severity, message });
  };

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { items } = await api.searchPatrons(debouncedQuery || undefined);
      setPatrons(items);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Không thể tải danh sách độc giả");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [debouncedQuery]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = patrons;
    if (filter === "active") list = list.filter((p) => p.status === "active");
    else if (filter === "inactive") list = list.filter((p) => p.status === "inactive");
    else if (filter === "expired") list = list.filter((p) => p.status === "expired");
    else if (filter === "deleted") list = list.filter((p) => p.status === "deleted");
    else if (filter === "has_face") list = list.filter((p) => p.has_face);
    else if (filter === "no_face") list = list.filter((p) => !p.has_face);
    return list;
  }, [patrons, filter]);

  const openEdit = (patron: PatronPublic) => {
    setEditTarget(patron);
    setEditForm({
      full_name: patron.full_name,
      class_name: patron.class_name || undefined,
      identity_number: patron.identity_number || undefined,
      email: patron.email || undefined,
      phone: patron.phone || undefined,
      membership_expiry: patron.membership_expiry,
      status: patron.status,
      course: patron.course || undefined,
      permanent_address: patron.permanent_address || undefined,
    });
  };

  const handleEdit = async () => {
    if (!editTarget) return;
    setEditSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.updatePatron(editTarget.id, editForm);
      setEditTarget(null);
      setEditForm({});
      await load();
      showNotice("success", "Đã cập nhật độc giả");
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Cập nhật thất bại");
    } finally {
      setEditSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRenew = async () => {
    if (!renewTarget) return;
    const next = new Date(renewTarget.membership_expiry);
    if (next < new Date()) next.setTime(Date.now());
    next.setMonth(next.getMonth() + renewMonths);
    try {
      await api.updatePatron(renewTarget.id, { membership_expiry: next.toISOString().split("T")[0] });
      setRenewTarget(null);
      setRenewMonths(12);
      await load();
      showNotice("success", `Đã gia hạn thẻ ${renewTarget.full_name} ${renewMonths} tháng`);
    } catch (err) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Gia hạn thất bại");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTarget || deleteConfirmText !== "XÓA") return;
    const target = deleteTarget;
    setDeleteTarget(null);
    setDeleteConfirmText("");
    setPatrons((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== target.id));
    try {
      await api.deletePatron(target.id);
      showNotice("success", `Đã xóa độc giả ${target.full_name}`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.response?.status === 404) showNotice("info", "Độc giả đã bị xóa trước đó");
      else { showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Xóa thất bại"); await load(); }
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async () => {
    if (!restoreTarget || restoreConfirmText !== "KHÔI PHỤC") return;
    const target = restoreTarget;
    setRestoreTarget(null);
    setRestoreConfirmText("");
    setPatrons((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== target.id));
    try {
      await api.restorePatron(target.id);
      showNotice("success", `Đã khôi phục độc giả ${target.full_name}`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotice("error", getErrorMessage(err) || "Khôi phục thất bại");
      await load();
    }
  };

  const statBadges = `${patrons.length} độc giả · ${patrons.filter((p) => p.status === "active").length} đang hoạt động · ${patrons.filter((p) => p.has_face).length} đã đăng ký khuôn mặt`;

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Quản lý Độc giả"
        icon={PeopleIcon}
        statBadges={statBadges}
        onRefresh={load}
        actions={
          <Tooltip title={!canCreatePatron ? getPermissionDeniedReason("patrons", "create") : ""}>
            <span>
              <Button
                variant="contained"
                disabled={!canCreatePatron}
                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!canCreatePatron) return;
                  setShowCreate(true);
                }}
                sx={{
                  background: !canCreatePatron
                    ? undefined
                    : "linear-gradient(135deg, #8B0000 0%, #700000 100%)",
                  borderRadius: 2,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  textTransform: "none",
                  boxShadow: !canCreatePatron ? "none" : "0 4px 14px rgba(139,0,0,0.3)",
                  "&:hover": {
                    background: !canCreatePatron
                      ? undefined
                      : "linear-gradient(135deg, #700000 0%, #500000 100%)",
                  },
                }}
              >
                Thêm độc giả
              </Button>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        }
      />

      <PatronStatCards patrons={patrons} />

      <PatronToolbar
        query={query}
        onQueryChange={setQuery}
        filter={filter}
        onFilterChange={setFilter}
        onAddPatron={() => setShowCreate(true)}
      />

      {loading && filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <LoadingOverlay loading message="Đang tải danh sách độc giả..." />
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<PeopleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />}
          title="Không tìm thấy độc giả nào"
          action={<Button size="small" sx={{ textTransform: "none" }} onClick={() => { setQuery(""); setFilter("all"); }}>Xóa bộ lọc</Button>}
        />
      ) : (
        <PatronListView
          patrons={filtered}
          onEdit={openEdit}
          onRenew={(p) => { setRenewTarget(p); setRenewMonths(12); }}
          onDelete={(p) => { setDeleteTarget(p); setDeleteConfirmText(""); }}
          onRestore={(p) => { setRestoreTarget(p); setRestoreConfirmText(""); }}
        />
      )}

      <PatronWizard open={showCreate} onClose={() => setShowCreate(false)} onComplete={load} />

      <Drawer
        anchor="right"
        open={!!editTarget}
        onClose={() => { if (!editSaving) setEditTarget(null); }}
        slotProps={{ backdrop: { invisible: true } }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ width: { xs: "100vw", sm: 440 }, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "100%" }}>
          <Stack direction="row" sx={{ alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", px: 2.5, py: 2, borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider" }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Sửa độc giả</Typography>
            <IconButton onClick={() => setEditTarget(null)}><CloseIcon /></IconButton>
          </Stack>

          {editTarget ? (
            <Stack spacing={2.5} sx={{ flex: 1, overflow: "auto", px: 2.5, py: 2.5 }}>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={2} sx={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
                <Avatar sx={{ width: 48, height: 48, bgcolor: STAT_GRADIENT.total, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  {initials(editTarget.full_name)}
                </Avatar>
                <Box>
                  <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{editTarget.full_name}</Typography>
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
                    {editTarget.student_code}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              </Stack>

              <TextField label="Họ tên" value={editForm.full_name || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, full_name: e.target.value })} fullWidth />
              <TextField label="Lớp" value={editForm.class_name || ""} onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, class_name: e.target.value })} fullWidth />

          <Tooltip title={!canUpdatePatron ? getPermissionDeniedReason("patrons", "update") : ""}>

            </span>

        <DialogTitle>Xóa độc giả?</DialogTitle>

                Xóa vĩnh viễn
              </Button>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog open={!!restoreTarget} onClose={() => { setRestoreTarget(null); setRestoreConfirmText(""); }}>
        <DialogTitle>Khôi phục độc giả?</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Stack spacing={2}>
            <Typography>
              Khôi phục <strong>{restoreTarget?.full_name}</strong>? Nếu thẻ đã hết hạn, hạn thẻ sẽ được tự động gia hạn 1 năm.
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
              Nhập <strong>KHÔI PHỤC</strong> để xác nhận:
            </Typography>
            <TextField
              value={restoreConfirmText}
              onChange={(e) => setRestoreConfirmText(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nhập KHÔI PHỤC"
              size="small"
              autoFocus
              fullWidth
            />
          </Stack>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => { setRestoreTarget(null); setRestoreConfirmText(""); }} color="inherit">Hủy</Button>
          <Tooltip title={!canUpdatePatron ? getPermissionDeniedReason("patrons", "update") : ""}>
            <span>
              <Button color="success" variant="contained" onClick={handleRestore} disabled={restoreConfirmText !== "KHÔI PHỤC" || !canUpdatePatron}>
                Khôi phục
              </Button>
            </span>
          </Tooltip>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      <Snackbar
        open={Boolean(notice)}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        {notice ? (
          <Alert
            onClose={() => setNotice(null)}
            severity={notice.severity}
            variant="filled"
            sx={{ width: "100%", borderRadius: "8px", boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" }}
          >
            {notice.message}
          </Alert>
        ) : undefined}
      </Snackbar>
    </Stack>
  );
}

function getCookieValue(name: string): string | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp("(^| )" + name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "=([^;]*)"));
  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[2]) : null;
}

function setAccessTokenCookie(token: string): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  const expires = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toUTCString();
  const secure = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
  document.cookie = `access_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; expires=${expires}; path=/; SameSite=Lax${secure}`;
}

function clearAccessTokenCookie(): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  document.cookie = "access_token=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/";
}

function setRefreshTokenCookie(token: string): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  const expires = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toUTCString();
  const secure = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
  document.cookie = `refresh_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; expires=${expires}; path=/; SameSite=Lax${secure}`;
}

function clearRefreshTokenCookie(): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  document.cookie = "refresh_token=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/";
}

let _accessToken: string | null = null;
let _refreshToken: string | null = null;

function setStoredAccessToken(token: string | null, refreshToken?: string | null) {
  _accessToken = token;
  if (token) {
    setAccessTokenCookie(token);
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("token", token);
        localStorage.setItem("access_token", token);
      } catch {}
    }
  } else {
    clearAccessTokenCookie();
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem("token");
        localStorage.removeItem("access_token");
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  if (refreshToken !== undefined) {
    _refreshToken = refreshToken;
    if (refreshToken) {
      setRefreshTokenCookie(refreshToken);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        try { localStorage.setItem("refresh_token", refreshToken); } catch {}
      }
    } else {
      clearRefreshTokenCookie();
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        try { localStorage.removeItem("refresh_token"); } catch {}
      }
    }
  }
}

function getStoredRefreshToken(): string | null {
  if (_refreshToken) return _refreshToken;
  const cookieVal = getCookieValue("refresh_token");
  if (cookieVal) return cookieVal;
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem("refresh_token");
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}

function clearStoredAuth() {
  _accessToken = null;
  _refreshToken = null;
  clearAccessTokenCookie();
  clearRefreshTokenCookie();
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem("user");
      localStorage.removeItem("token");
      localStorage.removeItem("access_token");
      localStorage.removeItem("refresh_token");
    } catch {}
  }
}

function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const base64Url = token.split(".")[1];
    if (!base64Url) return null;
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      atob(base64)
        .split("")
        .map((c) => "%" + ("00" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join("")
    );
    return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function isTokenExpiringSoon(token: string, skewMs = 30_000): boolean {
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  if (!payload || typeof payload.exp !== "number") return false;
  return Date.now() >= payload.exp * 1000 - skewMs;
}

function getErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  if (!err) return "Đã xảy ra lỗi không xác định. Vui lòng thử lại.";
  if (typeof err === "string") return translateError(err);
  if (typeof err === "object" && err !== null) {
    const ax = err as any;
    if (ax.response?.data) {
      const data = ax.response.data;
      if (typeof data === "string") return translateError(data);
      if (data.detail) return translateError(typeof data.detail === "string" ? data.detail : JSON.stringify(data.detail));
      if (data.error) return translateError(typeof data.error === "string" ? data.error : JSON.stringify(data.error));
      if (data.message) return translateError(data.message);
      if (Array.isArray(data.errors) && data.errors.length > 0) {
        const raw = data.errors.map((e: any) => e.msg || e.message || JSON.stringify(e)).join("; ");
        return translateError(raw);
      }
      // Last resort: hide raw JSON from the user
      return "Máy chủ trả về dữ liệu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng thử lại.";
    }
    if (ax.message) return translateError(ax.message);
  }
  if (err instanceof Error) return translateError(err.message);
  return translateError(String(err));
}

function setApiAccessToken(token: string | null, refreshToken?: string | null) {
  _accessToken = token;
  if (refreshToken !== undefined) {
    _refreshToken = refreshToken;
  }
}

function getApiAccessToken(): string | null {
  return _accessToken;
}

function getApiRefreshToken(): string | null {
  return getStoredRefreshToken();
}

class ApiClient {
  private client: AxiosInstance;
  private refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;
  private pendingRequests: Array<{ resolve: (token: string) => void; reject: (err: any) => void }> = [];

  constructor() {
    this.client = axios.create({
      baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
      timeout: 10000, // 10s — was 30s; long-running uploads override per-request
      withCredentials: true,
    });

    this.client.interceptors.request.use(
      async (config) => {
        const url = config.url || "";
        const isAuthEndpoint =
          url.includes("/api/auth/login") ||
          url.includes("/api/auth/register") ||
          url.includes("/api/auth/refresh");

        let token =
          _accessToken ||
          getCookieValue("access_token") ||
          (typeof window !== "undefined"
            ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") || localStorage.getItem("token")
            : null);

        // Proactive silent refresh: if token expires in less than 60s, refresh before sending
        if (token && !isAuthEndpoint && isTokenExpiringSoon(token, 60_000)) {
          const newToken = await this.refreshToken();
          if (newToken) {
            token = newToken;
          }
        }

        if (token) {
          config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
        }
        return config;
      },
      (error) => Promise.reject(error)
    );

    this.client.interceptors.response.use(
      (response) => response,
      async (error: AxiosError) => {
        const originalRequest = error.config as any;
        const url = originalRequest?.url || "";
        const isAuthEndpoint =
          url.includes("/api/auth/login") ||
          url.includes("/api/auth/register") ||
          url.includes("/api/auth/refresh");

        if (error.response?.status === 401 && originalRequest && !originalRequest._retry && !isAuthEndpoint) {
          originalRequest._retry = true;
          try {
            // Wait for existing refresh if in progress
            let newToken: string | null = null;
            if (this.refreshPromise) {
              newToken = await this.refreshPromise;
            } else {
              newToken = await this.handleUnauthorized();
            }

            if (newToken) {
              originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newToken}`;
              return this.client(originalRequest);
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        return Promise.reject(error);
      }
    );
  }

  private async handleUnauthorized(): Promise<string | null> {
    const newToken = await this.refreshToken();
    if (newToken) {
      this.retryPendingRequests(newToken);
      return newToken;
    }
    this.cancelPendingRequests();
    clearStoredAuth();
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      const pathname = window.location.pathname;
      if (pathname !== "/login" && pathname !== "/register") {
        window.location.href = `/login?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(pathname)}&reason=session-expired`;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  retryPendingRequests(newToken: string) {
    this.pendingRequests.forEach(({ resolve }) => resolve(newToken));
    this.pendingRequests = [];
  }

  cancelPendingRequests() {
    this.pendingRequests.forEach(({ reject }) => reject(new Error("Request cancelled")));
    this.pendingRequests = [];
  }

  private async refreshToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (this.refreshPromise) return this.refreshPromise;
    this.refreshPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const storedRefreshToken = getStoredRefreshToken();
        if (!storedRefreshToken) return null;
        const resp = await axios.post(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/api/auth/refresh`,
          {
            refresh_token: storedRefreshToken,
          },
          {
            withCredentials: true,
            timeout: 10000,
          }
        );
        const data = resp.data;
        const token = data?.access_token || data?.accessToken;
        const newRefreshToken = data?.refresh_token || data?.refreshToken;
        if (token) {
          setStoredAccessToken(token, newRefreshToken || storedRefreshToken);
          return token;
        }
        return null;
      } catch {
        return null;
      } finally {
        this.refreshPromise = null;
      }
    })();
    return this.refreshPromise;
  }

  async login(data: LoginRequest): Promise<TokenResponse> {
    const response = await this.client.post<TokenResponse>("/api/auth/login", data);
    if (response.data.access_token) {
      setStoredAccessToken(response.data.access_token, response.data.refresh_token);
    }
    return response.data;
  }

  async register(data: RegisterRequest): Promise<TokenResponse> {
    const response = await this.client.post<TokenResponse>("/api/auth/register", data);
    if (response.data.access_token) {
      setStoredAccessToken(response.data.access_token, response.data.refresh_token);
    }
    return response.data;
  }

  async verifyEmail(data: { email: string; code: string }): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ message: string }>("/api/auth/verify-email", data);
    return response.data;
  }

  async verifyEmailCorrection(data: { current_email: string; new_email: string; code: string } | { otp: string; new_email: string; current_email?: string }): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const payload = "code" in data ? data : { current_email: data.current_email || "", new_email: data.new_email, code: (data as any).otp };
    const response = await this.client.post<{ message: string }>("/api/auth/correct-email/verify", payload);
    return response.data;
  }


  async refreshAuthToken(refreshToken?: string): Promise<TokenResponse> {
    const tokenToUse = refreshToken || getStoredRefreshToken();
    if (!tokenToUse) {
      throw new Error("No refresh token available");
    }
    const response = await axios.post<TokenResponse>(
      `${API_BASE_URL}/api/auth/refresh`,
      { refresh_token: tokenToUse },
      { withCredentials: true, timeout: 10000 }
    );
    if (response.data.access_token) {
      setStoredAccessToken(response.data.access_token, response.data.refresh_token || tokenToUse);
    }
    return response.data;
  }

  async logout(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.client.post("/api/auth/logout");
    } finally {
      clearStoredAuth();
    }
  }

  async faceLogin(imageFile: File): Promise<TokenResponse> {

    const response = await this.client.post<TokenResponse>("/api/auth/face-login", formData, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    });
    if (response.data.access_token) {
      setStoredAccessToken(response.data.access_token, response.data.refresh_token);
    }
    return response.data;
  }

  async getAccessLogs(
    params?: {
      patronId?: string;
      cameraId?: string;
      status?: string;
      accessType?: string;
      dateFrom?: string;
      dateTo?: string;
      search?: string;
      skip?: number;
      limit?: number;
    }
  ): Promise<AccessLogList> {
    const query: any = {};
    if (params) {
      if (params.patronId) query.patron_id = params.patronId;
      if (params.cameraId) query.camera_id = params.cameraId;
      if (params.status) query.status = params.status;
      if (params.accessType) query.access_type = params.accessType;
      if (params.dateFrom) query.date_from = params.dateFrom;
      if (params.dateTo) query.date_to = params.dateTo;
      if (params.search) query.search = params.search;
      query.skip = params.skip ?? 0;
      query.limit = Math.min(params.limit ?? 50, 200);
    }
    const response = await this.client.get<AccessLogList | AccessLogPublic[]>("/api/access/logs", { params: query });
    const data = response.data;
    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
      const items = data.map(normalizeAccessLog);
      return { items, total: items.length };
    }
    const items = Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items.map(normalizeAccessLog) : [];
    return {
      items,
      total: typeof data?.total === "number" ? data.total : items.length,
    };
  }

  connectAccessSSE(
    onEvent: (event: CameraEvent) => void,
    onConnectionChange?: (connected: boolean) => void,
  ): () => void {
    const es = new EventSource(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/access/events`, { withCredentials: true });
    es.addEventListener("open", () => onConnectionChange?.(true));
    es.addEventListener("camera_event", (msg: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(msg.data) as CameraEvent;
        onEvent(data);
      } catch { /* ignore parse errors */ }
    });
    es.addEventListener("error", () => { onConnectionChange?.(false); });
    return () => es.close();
  }

  connectFaceResultSSE(
    onEvent: (event: FaceResultEvent) => void,
    onConnectionChange?: (connected: boolean) => void,
  ): () => void {
    const es = new EventSource(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/access/events`, { withCredentials: true });
    es.addEventListener("open", () => onConnectionChange?.(true));
    es.addEventListener("face_result", (msg: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(msg.data) as FaceResultEvent;
        onEvent(data);
      } catch { /* ignore parse errors */ }
    });
    es.addEventListener("error", () => { onConnectionChange?.(false); });
    return () => es.close();
  }

  async getActivePatrons(): Promise<{ items: ActivePatron[]; total: number }> {

      entered_at: item.entered_at || item.last_entry_at || item.lastEntryAt || "",

  async getAccessFrequency(params?: { dateFrom?: string; dateTo?: string }): Promise<AccessFrequencyResponse> {
    const query: any = {};
    if (params?.dateFrom) query.date_from = params.dateFrom;
    if (params?.dateTo) query.date_to = params.dateTo;
    const response = await this.client.get<AccessFrequencyResponse | any[]>("/api/access/frequency", { params: query });
    const data = response.data;
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
      return { daily: Array.isArray(data?.daily) ? data.daily : [] };
    }
    const byDate = new Map<string, { date: string; entry: number; exit: number }>();
    data.forEach((row: any) => {
      const date = new Date(row.date).toISOString().split("T")[0];
      const item = byDate.get(date) || { date, entry: 0, exit: 0 };
      const type = row.access_type || row.accessType;
      const count = Number(row.count || 0);
      if (type === "entry") item.entry += count;
      if (type === "exit") item.exit += count;
      byDate.set(date, item);
    });
    return { daily: [...byDate.values()].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)) };
  }

  async downloadBookTemplate(): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.client.get("/api/borrow/books/template", { responseType: "blob" });
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([response.data]));
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "book_import_template.xlsx";
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  async streamCompanionChat(
    message: string | undefined,
    audioBase64: string | undefined,
    sessionId: string | undefined,
    onChunk: (chunk: any) => void,
    onError?: (error: Error) => void,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const token =
      _accessToken ||
      getCookieValue("access_token") ||
      (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("accessToken") || localStorage.getItem("token") : null);

    const body: Record<string, any> = {};
    if (message) body.message = message;
    if (audioBase64) body.audioBase64 = audioBase64;
    if (sessionId) body.sessionId = sessionId;

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/ai/companion/stream", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }

      const reader = response.body?.getReader();
      if (!reader) throw new Error("No response body");

      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = "";

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;

        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const lines = buffer.split("\n");
        buffer = lines.pop() || "";

        for (const line of lines) {
          if (line.startsWith("data: ")) {
            try {
              const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
              onChunk(data);
            } catch {}
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      onError?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));
    }
  }

  async testSmtpConfig(config: { to: string; host: string; port: number; secure: boolean; user: string; pass: string; from: string }): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ success: boolean; message: string }>("/api/borrow/admin/settings/test-email", config);
    return response.data;
  }

  async getAdminResourceSchema(resource: string): Promise<any> {
    const response = await this.client.get<any>(`/api/borrow/admin/schema/${resource}`);
    return response.data;
  }

  async getAllAdminSchemas(): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
    const response = await this.client.get<Record<string, any>>("/api/borrow/admin/schema");
    return response.data;
  }

  async forgotPassword(email: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ message: string }>("/api/auth/forgot-password", { email });
    return response.data;
  }

  async verifyResetCode(email: string, code: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ message: string }>("/api/auth/verify-reset-code", { email, code });
    return response.data;
  }

  async resetPassword(email: string, code: string, newPassword: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const response = await this.client.post<{ message: string }>("/api/auth/reset-password", { email, code, new_password: newPassword });
    return response.data;
  }

  // --- Permissions & Dynamic RBAC ---
  async getPermissionMatrix(): Promise<{
    roles: Record<string, RolePermissionConfig>;
    metadata: {
      routes: { path: string; label: string }[];
      resources: string[];
      actions: string[];
    };
  }> {
    const response = await this.client.get<{
      success: boolean;
      data: {
        roles: Record<string, RolePermissionConfig>;
        metadata: {
          routes: { path: string; label: string }[];
          resources: string[];
          actions: string[];
        };
      };
    }>("/api/permissions/matrix");
    return response.data.data;
  }

  async updateRolePermissions(
    role: string,
    config: RolePermissionConfig
  ): Promise<RolePermissionConfig> {
    const response = await this.client.put<{ success: boolean; data: RolePermissionConfig }>(
      `/api/permissions/roles/${encodeURIComponent(role)}`,
      config
    );
    return response.data.data;
  }

  async getUserPermissionOverride(userId: string): Promise<UserPermissionOverride> {
    const response = await this.client.get<{ success: boolean; data: UserPermissionOverride }>(
      `/api/permissions/users/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}`
    );
    return response.data.data;
  }

  async updateUserPermissionOverride(
    userId: string,
    override: UserPermissionOverride
  ): Promise<UserPermissionOverride> {
    const response = await this.client.put<{ success: boolean; data: UserPermissionOverride }>(
      `/api/permissions/users/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}`,
      override
    );
    return response.data.data;
  }

  async getMyPermissions(): Promise<EffectivePermissions> {
    const response = await this.client.get<{ success: boolean; data: EffectivePermissions }>(
      "/api/permissions/me"
    );
    return response.data.data;
  }
}

const api = new ApiClient();

function retryPendingRequests(token: string) {
  api.retryPendingRequests(token);
}

function cancelPendingRequests() {
  api.cancelPendingRequests();
}

  ApiClient,

  setStoredAccessToken,
  clearStoredAuth,
  decodeJwtPayload,
  isTokenExpiringSoon,
  getCookieValue,
  setAccessTokenCookie,
  clearAccessTokenCookie,
  setRefreshTokenCookie,
  clearRefreshTokenCookie,
  getStoredRefreshToken,
  getErrorMessage,
  setApiAccessToken,
  getApiAccessToken,
  getApiRefreshToken,
  retryPendingRequests,
  cancelPendingRequests,
};

export default api;
